You'll notice there are is a corpse being eaten by two Misbegotten enemies. Loot that body to find x2 Arteria Leaf. There are also Miners that are excavating, kill them and check the walls to find x4 Smithing Stone [1] and x1 Somber Smithing Stone [1]. Go through the tunnel path on the west side after clearing this section where you can loot x1 Soft Cotton off a corpse. Go back and proceed north where you'll see a closedwooden gate, don't open it first, check the right side and you'll find another x1 Somber Smithing Stone [1] - if you're prepared, open the large wooden gate to fight the mini-boss of this location, the Scaly Misbegotten.
MINI-BOSS: Scaly Misbegotten

The Scaly Misbegotten appears as a larger variant of the common Misbegotten enemy. It moves slow and wields a large axe. When it attacks, you can easily react to block or dodge its attacks when it start to swing the heavy weapon. If you are wielding heavy weapons, you can interrupt its attacks if you can land a jumping attack, hitting its head. If you land a critical hit, it temporarily gets stunned, you can attack it multiple times before it recovers. Successfully defeating it rewards you with 2000 Runes and drops the Rusted Anchor weapon - to return back to the entrance, simply use the white portal mist that will appear in the boss arena after the battle.

title: Flame Crest Wooden Shield
text: Return to the cottage and follow the dirt path to a village. Turn left before entering to find a campfire by the cliff and a Golden Rune [2].
Golden Rune [2]: Consumable. Found on a corpse partially hanging on a ledge at the top level of the castle. Beware the harpies nearby.
Continue along the cliff edge to discover the Ailing Village Outskirts grace up on a ledge.
Pick up Flame Crest Wooden Shield from an empty cottage in the village.
Flame Crest Wooden Shield: You can loot the Flame Crest Wooden Shield from a naked commoner's corpse inside one of the cabins.

place.title: Ailing Village
walk: In this village, there is a large bonfire in the center where several Frenzied Villagers are found taking on strange poses, covering their flame-tinged eyes. There is a hut in the north where the Flame Crest Wooden Shield can be looted off of a corpse.

Directly south of the village is the ruins of the Callu Baptismal Church where several Frenzied Rats and a Giant Rat can be found. Players can pick up The Flame of Frenzy spell by a pillar on the left. Like most churches, you can find a Sacred Tear towards the front of the church at the foot of the main statue piece.
notes: Known as Callu, Isolated Village in the 1.00 version of the game.

title: The Flame of Frenzy
text: Head into the church near the village. Loot The Flame of Frenzy and Sacred Tear, but be wary of the rats.
The Flame of Frenzy: Incantation . Found on a corpse by one of the pillars on the left side of the Callu Baptismal Church .

place.title: Callu Baptismal Church
walk: Just before you enter the church, there are a couple of Frenzied Villagers just outside by the campfire. Once you enter the church, you will encounter a couple of Rats and a Giant Rat inside, a Sacred Tear can be found in front of the statue by the end of the church, you quickly skip past the rats and just pick up the Sacred Tear and be on your way if you don't want to engage the enemies, since a group of Rats can be a tough challenge.

title: Sacred Tear
text: Head into the church near the village. Loot The Flame of Frenzy and Sacred Tear, but be wary of the rats.
Sacred Tear: Found inside the Church of Irith

title: Sacred Tear
text: Return to Castle Morne Rampart and head up the north-northwest slope. In front of a gibbet on the cliff, you'll find Rainbow Stone x5.
Rainbow Stone: Can be found at the foot at the cruficix.
Grab the South of the Lookout Tower grace on the ledge behind the pond with dogs around it.
Follow the rocky path west and across a bridge until you reach the church at the top. Grab the Church of Pilgrimage grace and Sacred Tear inside.
Sacred Tear: Flask Upgrade Material. Found on the ground in front of the altar at the Church of Pilgrimage .

place.title: Church of Pilgrimage
walk: The Church of Pilgrimage can be found at the north peak of the Weeping Peninsula. A group of pilgrims can be seen leaving the Church. Outside the entrance of the Church players will find a spirit ghost NPC sitting on a chair with a book around their neck. Inside the Church players can find a Site of Grace and a large statue where they will find a body with a Sacred Tear. There is a Graveyard connected to the church where players can find multiple tombs with some loot as well as skeleton enemies to face.
Further to the north and in the surroundings around the Church players can find Eagles perched on the cliffs and sheep grazing the fields as well as a variety of gathering options.
Warhawk Ashes can be obtained close to this location. Rewarded upon finding the location Prophecy Painting depicts.
Inside the church in the northeast corner, 5 Golden Centipede can be found.

title: Gilded Iron Shield
text: Optional: Talk to Melina at the Church of Pilgrimage grace.
Pick up Gilded Iron Shield and Blood Grease x2 from the small graveyard outside the church.
Gilded Iron Shield: Shield. Found on a corpse sitting on a grave in the graveyard.
Blood Grease: Consumable Item. Two can be found by a grave with a wooden pole next to it.

title: Sacred Tear
text: Head down the slope toward the mausoleum, keeping along the cliff wall on the left until you reach the Tombsward grace on a ledge.
Enter the church at the top of the slope near the mausoleum to grab the Fourth Church of Marika grace and Sacred Tear inside.
Sacred Tear: Flask Upgrade Material. Found on the ground in front of the altar at the Fourth Church of Marika .

place.title: Fourth Church of Marika
walk: There is not much to do at the Fourth Church of Marika other than collect the Sacred Tear on the ground in front of the altar. There is also a Site of Grace nearby. There are two Mausoleum Soldiers that guard the entrance and are hostile when approached. There are more patrolling the fields nearby.

region: First steps in Limgrave · meeting 1 of 2
title: Talk to Isolated Merchant
text: Go back down the slope, then head southwest toward a shack near the beach to grab the Isolated Merchant's Shack grace.
Isolated Merchant: General Goods vendor found sitting in his shack. Sells the Lantern and Lost Ashes of War , among other useful items.

place.title: Tower of Return
walk: On the way to the tower itself, beware the numerous Godrick Foot Soldiers in the nearby fields. There is a group of 3 surrounding the nearby effigies and one sitting atop the tower, operating a ballista. A Great Dragonfly Head can be found on the ground by one of the effigies. There is also a mounted Godrick Knight patrolling near the tower (which can be farmed for its armor set), accompanied by two Wandering Nobles and three more Godrick Foot Soldiers at the foot of the tower. Engage these enemies one by one or in small groups as they can quickly overwhelm you despite their relative weakness.

There is little to do at the Tower of Return itself. The chest at the top is a Teleporter Chest that transports the player to the Divine Bridge Site of Grace when opened. The only way forward leads to a platform with a Golem resting in the area, a chest containing a Blessed Dew Talisman on the right, and an inactive Waygate on the left that would lead to the Isolated Divine Tower much later in the game. This Golem may be a difficult fight if the player is sent there early in the game; to leave, rest at the Site of Grace and fast-travel should be enabled to get you out of this area.

title: Finger Snap
text: Buy a Lantern from the Isolated Merchant (Weeping Peninsula) if you can spare the runes. If not, you can buy it later.
On the beach, you can find a Golden Rune [5], and a Golden Rune [1] behind a fallen tree.
Golden Rune [5] B: Found at the shore surrounded by Skeleton enemies.
Golden Rune [1]: Found on a dead body.
Continue along the beach for a Golden Rune [2] surrounded by Land Octopuses.
Golden Rune [2]: Can be looted off of defeated Rats within the Tombsward Cave.
Travel to the Church of Elleh and talk to Kale about the howling in Mistwood to learn the Finger Snap gesture.

region: First steps in Limgrave · meeting 2 of 5
title: Talk to Blaidd
text: Locate Blaidd at the top of Mistwood Ruins. Use the Finger Snap gesture below him, then talk to him after he jumps down.

Blaidd: Blaidd's First Location: When visiting Mistwood, the player can occasionally hear a wolf howl. At this point, they can ask Merchant Kale about the howling. The merchant will teach the player the Finger Snap gesture. Blaidd can be seen resting on the tallest point in the Mistwood Ruins, and will jump down after the player uses the gesture while standing below him. Blaidd will tell the player he is searching for a man who goes by the name Darriwil.

place.title: Mistwood Ruins
walk: You can discover the path to Mistwood Ruins by interacting with an antique spectral tree located south of Third Church of Marika, alongside the main road. Upon examination, grace will manifest as a golden human spirit that will wander without a clear destination. The spirit often disappears, but its footsteps can be traced not to lose track of it. Finally, the grace manifestation will arrive to the hidden ruins and fade away.

One questline begins in Mistwood Ruins. Players may come across some howling. If you look up at the taller parts of the ruins, you may come across Blaidd. You will have to speak to Merchant Kale in the Church of Elleh to continue this questline. When interacting with Blaidd, make sure you have no wolf attire on as this will make him hostile towards you and may affect the progress of your quest.

title: Boss: Bloodhound Knight Darriwil
text: Optional: Return to Kale and talk to him about Blaidd.
Travel to Agheel Lake South and pick up the Golden Rune [2] in front of a gibbet just south of the grace.
Golden Rune [2]: Found by the statue.
Enter the evergaol at the top of the slope, then kill Bloodhound Knight Darriwil for Bloodhound's Fang and 1,900 runes.
Bloodhound Knight Darriwil: Boss of Forlorn Hound Evergaol . Drops the Bloodhound's Fang Curved Greatsword
Bloodhound's Fang: Curved Greatsword. Dropped by the boss of Forlorn Hound Evergaol , Bloodhound Knight Darriwil .
Optional: Blaidd's summon sign can be found in the evergaol if you spoke to him in Mistwood Ruins. (Summoning NPCs is generally not needed to progress questlines and will result in 25% fewer runes.)
After the fight, talk to Blaidd to receive a Somber Smithing Stone [2], then speak with him again to unlock a talisman for sale later.
Somber Smithing Stone [2]: Upgrade Material. Obtained as a reward for completing Forlorn Hound Evergaol with Blaidd, then talking to him outside the Jail.
miss: Must be done before entering Ranni's service, or before talking to Blaidd or Jerren at the Radahn Festival.

place.title: Forlorn Hound Evergaol
walk: You can summon the NPC Blaidd to help you in this fight. Go to Mistwood Ruins and hear his howl, then travel back to Church of Elleh and speak to the merchant there About the howling in the woods He will give you a gesture to be used under the tower so that Blaidd jumps down. You can then speak to him and summon him in the fight. His summoning sign will appear after you have entered the Evergaol.
Upon entry of the Evergaol, you will face the Bloodhound Knight Darriwil. For combat notes and tips visit his page. Defeat him to obtain Bloodhound's Fang.

After entering into Ranni's service, Blaidd will become trapped in this location if it is still uncleared. You'll be able to hear howling in the area. He will start speaking with you when you reach the center of the evergaol. You will then be prompted to open the evergaol.

title: Ash of War: Wild Strikes
text: From Stormhill Shack, follow the uphill road to a scarab and kill it for Ash of War: Wild Strikes.
Ash of War: Wild Strikes: Dropped from a Teardrop Scarab located in the middle of the path leading from the Stormhill Shack site of grace to the Castleward Tunnel site of grace.

title: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [7]
text: On a ledge under the leftmost arch of the massive bridge, you'll find a Lump of Flesh.
Lump of Flesh: Can be found on a dead body by the road.
Past the massive bridge is a broken span that once connected to Liurnia. At the end of it sits a corpse with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [7].
Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [7]: It can be taken from a dead man sitting at the edge of the collapsed bridge.

region: Early Liurnia and Caelid · meeting 1 of 6
title: Talk to Finger Reader (Collapsed Bridge)
text: Finger Reader: She is sitting on at table at the start of the collapsed bridge.

title: Ash of War: Storm Wall
text: Drop down to the area below the span and kill the scarab near the right edge to obtain Ash of War: Storm Wall.
Ash of War: Storm Wall: Find a Teardrop Scarab , defeat it to obtain the Ash of War .

region: Early Liurnia and Caelid · meeting 1 of 2
title: Talk to Thops
text: Continue up the nearby slope until you reach the Lake-Facing Cliffs grace.
Head inside the church to the southwest to pick up a Sacred Tear.
Talk to Thops and spare him 10 runes. Optionally, select "Talk", then speak to him about the academy glintstone key.
Thops: Tops is a former student of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Teaches basic Sorceries, and will move if you give him a Glintstone Academy Key.

title: Academy Scroll
text: Outside the church is a ravine path. At the end of the upper left side of the ravine, you'll find Warming Stone x3.
In front of a gravestone on the opposite hill across the ravine, you'll pick up the Academy Scroll.
Academy Scroll: Key Item. Give to a mage to unlock more sorceries. It's by one of the big gravestones where the Skeleton Mages are rising.

guide.title: The Student of Raya Lucaria Academy
text: ## Liurnia of the Lakes: South
Elden Ring Main Quest Guide - Liurnia of the Lakes (South) Points of Interest
Speak to some NPCs.
Clear out Malefactor's Evergaol.
Acquire some Important Items as you explore.
Find Patches and collect upgrade items for your Flasks.
Acquire the Academy Glintstone Key and explore Raya Lucaria Academy.
Optional: Fight the dragon, Glintstone Dragon Smarag.
Explore the Lakeside Crystal Cave
## Speak to Boc the Seamster

Congratulations! You've completed the first of many Legacy Dungeons in Elden Ring, and you've beaten the first Demigod, Godrick the Grafted. If you were following our walkthrough for Stormveil Castle, you should formally arrive in Liurnia of the Lakes from the throne room of Godrick the Grafted. As soon as you enter the new region, you'll find the Lake-Facing Cliffs Site of Grace, examine it to discover the checkpoint, and if you were also following the walkthrough and have encountered Boc twice, you should find him here kneeling by the Lake-Facing Site of Grace, a cliff above to the entrance to Stillwater Cave. Make sure to talk to him and he'll offer to alter your armor. If he's not there when you first find the grace just rest.
## The Wandering Maiden

You can also find Hyetta's initial location, found near the Lake-Facing Cliffs site of grace. But for her to show up, you must complete Irina's questline in the Weeping Peninsula, which is to deliver a letter to her father, Edgar who is at Castle Morne. Hyetta is initially found next to the Lake-Facing Cliffs site of grace. Hyetta says she roams The Lands Between in search of the distant light, drawn to her destiny by a guiding shine she feels in the back of her eyes when eating Shabriri Grapes. She will ask for one and if you choose to supply one to her, she will reward you with the As You Wish Gesture.
## The Student of Raya Lucaria Academy

Next, if you move towards the southwest, you should find the Church of Irith, it's easy to find and you'll meet a new NPC here named Thops, he is a student at the Academy of Raya Lucaria. You can find him sitting on a bench inside the destroyed church. By the statue, don't forget to grab the Sacred Tear material for your flask. As for Thops, if you speak to him, you can learn some spells from him in exchange for Runes. First, you must donate 10 Runes, and then you can learn some Sorcery spells from him.

These are just basic spells, but if you are not playing as an Astrologer and if you need to but the basic sorcery like Glintstone Pebble, then you can learn it from Thops for 1000 Runes. Eventually, if you speak to him again, he will share that he wishes to return to the academy, this means you will need to find a second Academy Glintstone Key for him later on which can be found in the academy. This church has a graveyard section, you may want to check it to find some Warming Stone, an Academy Scroll. just be cautious since there are Skeleton enemies there.

title: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [1]
text: Head down the ravine path to a camp with Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [1] and Smoldering Butterfly x6 (in a tent).
Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [1]: Dropped by one of the Nobles in that enemy outpost.

title: Sacrificial Twig
text: Continue downhill and activate the Liurnia Lake Shore grace.
Climb the slanted rock next to the grace and jump onto the gravestones in the cliff face to reach a Sacrificial Twig.
Sacrificial Twig: Special Consumable Talisman. Found on a corpse on a stone platform jutting out of the cliff to the east. Accessible from above only, by heading east from Malefactor's Evergaol.

title: Talk to Nomadic Merchant Liurnia of the Lakes
text: Nomadic Merchant Liurnia of the Lakes: Found by a campfire on the west road after passing through the outpost to the northwest of Church of Irith, before entering the forest in Liurnia of the Lakes.

title: Talk to Nomadic Merchant Caelid South
text: Buy a Lantern from the Nomadic Merchant (South Liurnia) if you didn't get it earlier.
Nomadic Merchant Caelid South: Nomadic Merchant. General Goods vendor found sitting by a campfire in south Caelid. Sells the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook (15) , among other items.

title: Map (Liurnia, East)
text: Follow the watery path lined with broken arcades and fences until you reach a stele with Map: Liurnia, East.
Map (Liurnia, East): It's in the middle of the swampy lake, by a monument that has highlightened texts over it.

title: Idus Sword
text: If you own the Tarnished Pack DLC, you'll find the Idus Sword next to a tree west-southwest of the stele.

title: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [2]

Pick up Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [2] from the corpse near the grace.
Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [2]: Found in a corpse just by the Laskyar Ruins Site of Grace. Unlocks crafting of Freezing Grease .

place.title: Laskyar Ruins
walk: Search the northern section for a corpse with a Ritual Pot. It is sitting in front of a set of pillars.
Go to the northwestern section of the ruins to find a set of stairs leading to a dark underground hall. There is a room at the end of this hall with a chest containing the Wraith Calling Bell.

There is a gazebo in the center of the ruins with a Waygate that transports users to the entrance of the Raya Lucaria Academy, you will need a Glintstone Key to proceed through the gates. There is a Smithing Stone [3] on the corpse outside the gazebo. Map Link.
Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [2] can be looted from a corpse amongst the ruins in the southern part of this location. Elden Ring Map Link.
Beware the powerful enemy that spawns in the middle of the ruins, in front of the gazebo.

title: Meeting Place Map
text: Grab the Smithing Stone [3] beside the stairs to the building with spires northwest of the grace, then use the sending gate inside.
Smithing Stone [3]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse to the right of the steps to the gazebo in the center of the Laskyar Ruins .
After arriving, head up to grab the South Raya Lucaria Gate grace and Meeting Place Map.
Meeting Place Map: Can be found at the entrace of the Raya Lucarian academy, on lying corpse.

guide.title: Find the Academy Glintstone Key
text: Now, the next legacy dungeon you will need to explore is the Raya Lucaria Academy, mainly found at the center of Liurnia of the Lakes region. The only way in is by passing through the South Raya Lucaria Gate which is actually blocked by a barrier and can only be entered if the person is holding the Academy Glintstone Key. If you were exploring and stumbled upon the South Raya Lucaria Gate through the Academy Gate Town you should find a corpse of a Raya Lucaria Sorceror that's lying near the South Raya Lucaria Gate, if you loot the corpse, it holds the coordinates (Meeting Place Map - ) for the Academy Glintstone Key.

The coordinates or location of the key will take you to a lake area that is guarded by the Glintstone Dragon Smarag. When you arrive, if you want to just grab the key, make sure you are riding your mount, and quickly run behind it. You'll see that it's guarding some corpses, the Raya Lucaria Sorcerer corpse holds the Academy Glintstone Key, while the other two holds a Dragonwound Grease and Kukri. The choice is yours if you want to fight this dragon or just avoid it - with the key, you can now enter Raya Lucaria Academy via the South Raya Lucaria Gate.
## The Magical Dragon

Glintstone Dragon Smarag can be found due south of the Crystalline Woods site of grace, in central Liurnia of the Lakes. You will arrive at this location while exploring the lake area north of Temple District, he is usually asleep and guarding the Academy Glintstone Key, x6 Kukri, and a Dragonwound Grease. Regardless of class focus, get into your most highly protective gear against magic, fire (unknown which his breath attacks inflict), and physical and aim to execute the majority of the fight from horseback, getting off your steed only to gain I-frames, especially during his dive attack, an easy to prepare for attack because of the long buildup animation.

As often as possible try to hit Smarag's head. With enough pressure, he will go to the ground and open himself to a critical strike. Poise damage is minimally inflicted against the legs, wings, and torso, though Banished Knight Oleg's additional pressure against Smarag's flanks is enough to push the meter to full, so don't dismiss those areas of attack altogether. The majority of damage you will be able to inflict will be against the flanks and wings because Smarag so often holds his head out of reach, even with a double jump.

Most of Smarag's attacks will deal significant damage, but a vitality stat of 20+ should be enough to survive a single hit from any of his attacks. For a more detailed strategy and if you want to find our video guide on how to defeat this boss, check our Glintstone Dragon Smarag page - successfully defeating this dragon rewards you with 14,699 Runes and a Dragon Heart which you can use at the Church of Dragon Communion to learn unique Incantations - make further preparation after the battle as you make your way to Raya Lucaria Academy.

title: Golden Seed
text: Head down the bridge and pick up the Smithing Stone [3] to the left of the enemies past the spiked barricades.
Smithing Stone [3]: Upgrade Material. Found along the south of the waters within Liurnia of the Lakes.
Continue down the nearby stairs, then head southeast at the bottom to find a Golden Seed.
Golden Seed: Can be found north of the Main Academy Gate site of grace, on the bridge.

title: Map: Liurnia, North
text: From the golden tree, head southeast until the town is on your left, then continue along the outskirts to find the Academy Gate Town grace.
Pick up Map: Liurnia, North from the stele near the grace.
Map: Liurnia, North: Can be found over a grave-like big stone, at Academy Gate Town,

place.title: Academy Gate Town
walk: Many enemies can be found lurking between the half-submerged buildings of what remains of the Academy Gate Town. The roofs and parts of many buildings stick out from the lake, giving players raised surfaces to use as vantage points or use as height advantage against the surrounding enemies. Though this area takes up quite a large portion of the map, there are few points of interest located here. At one point players may come across Diallos and interact with him while he mourns over Lanya at this location. Elden Ring Map Link Palm ReaderCan be found at the edge of the broken bridge that leads to the Raya Lucaria Academy.
Other than that, some notable items could be found around this sunken town as well.
The Map, for Map: Liurnia, North can be found in this location. Elden Ring Map Link
Ash of War: Charge Forth is dropped by a Teardrop Scarab that is attached to a ceiling under some Land Squirts. Elden Ring Map Link.

Glintstone Craftman's Cookbook [4] can be found in this location. From the Academy Gate Town Site of Grace, head northwest and look for a sunken church building with enemies on the roof. The chest is located inside a tower that you can jump inside open the chest to obtain the cookbook. Elden Ring Interactive Map Here.
Golden Seed can be found on the ground next to a glowing sapling. Elden Ring Map Link.
Smithing Stone (1) can be looted off a corpse. The corpse is resting against a wall. Elden Ring Map Link
Blue-White Wooden Shield is looted en route towards Raya Lucaria Academy. Elden Ring Map Link Here

region: Early Liurnia and Caelid · meeting 1 of 3
title: Talk to Diallos
text: West of the grace is a larger tree. From that tree, go north to find Diallos on the northern outskirts and talk to him.
Diallos: NPC. He leaves the Roundtable Hold and then be found over the corpse of Lanya.

title: Map (Liurnia, West)
text: On a church roof just northwest of Diallos is a scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [2].
Use the sending gate in the isolated building north-northwest of the scarab. After arriving, pick up Map: Liurnia, West from the stele.
Map (Liurnia, West): Map Fragment. Reveals western Liurnia. Found on a monolith along the road by a junction.

title: Talk to War Counselor Iji
text: Just southwest of the map stele lies the Northern Liurnia Lake Shore grace.
Follow the dirt path north-northeast through Kingsrealm Ruins and hit the illusory wall at the end to discover the Road to the Manor grace behind it.
Optional: Exhaust Iji's dialogue, then select "Please take care" and "Talk".
War Counselor Iji: Blacksmith - sells Upgrade Materials such as Somber Smithing Stone [1] through [4].

title: Carian Filigreed Crest
text: If you exhausted Blaidd's dialogue after killing Darriwil, tell him that Blaidd sent you to unlock the Carian Filigreed Crest for purchase. Otherwise, it'll be available after entering Ranni's service.

title: Talk to Miriel, Pastor of Vows
text: Note: Don't buy any Somberstones from him; you'll have one of each by the end of this section.
Return to the Northern Liurnia Lake Shore and head east-southeast across the lake. A chair with a Somber Smithing Stone [3] sits past the leftmost bridge pillar.
Somber Smithing Stone [3]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse sitting on a chair overlooking the cliffs. Beware of enemies that spawn behind you.
Head south from the chair until you reach the Gate Town North grace on the remains of some roofs.
Continue east-southeast toward a round building, then once you reach it, go east into the woods to find a building with Smithing Stone [3] x3 inside.
Smithing Stone [3]: Upgrade Material. Looted off a corpse in the middle of the upper road by the Flame Chariot and Raya Lucaria Soldiers that guard the path to Raya Lucaria Academy.
On the shore east of the building, you'll discover the Eastern Liurnia Lake Shore grace.
From the grace, head south-southwest to find Smithing Stone [3] x3 behind the magic Miranda Blossom on your right.
Smithing Stone [3]: Upgrade Material. Three can be looted from a corpse sitting on a chair amid a group of Poison Flowers.
Return to the grace and follow the dirt path to a fork. Take the right path downhill to grab the Study Hall Entrance grace inside a building.
Below the tip of a slanted rock outside the building is a scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [3].
Return to the fork and follow the other path uphill until you reach the church at the top. Activate the Church of Vows grace in front of it.
Talk to Miriel in the church. Optionally, exhaust his dialogue about Radagon, then about Rennala.
Miriel, Pastor of Vows: Miriel is the steward of Church of Vows , and will accept Scrolls and Tomes and teach lore, Incantations and Sorceries.

guide.title: Travel to the Church of Vows
text: The road north has two paths: One has a Golem that is guarding access to Ainsel River Well. Ignore this, for now, you'll check this later on. Take the other path up the slopes. The area to the left of the site of grace will have an Incantation (Flame, Cleanse Me!) and the Fire Monk Gauntlets. Stay the road and access the higher ground to arrive at the Church of Vows ( and meet Miriel, Pastor of Vows who can teach you both Incantations and Sorceries, receive Scrolls and Prayerbooks, and give you information about the Lore of major characters.

This location is important because it allows you to cleanse your SIN (aggro'd NPCs) by using Celestial Dew and performing an "Absolution" at the altar. Make sure to discover and rest at the site of grace for the Church of Vows. And grab some items such as the Golden Tailoring Tools and the Gold Sewing Needle inside a chest. There is another field boss here that roams around the church at night, and this is the Bell Bearing Hunter. If you successfully defeat this boss, you'll be rewarded with the Meat Peddler's Bell Bearing.

title: Gold Sewing Needle, Golden Tailoring Tools
text: Note: Give him the Academy Scroll and any future scrolls or prayerbooks to unlock their spells for purchase. Scrolls can also be given to Sellen or Seluvis (and prayerbooks to Corhyn or Miriel), but Miriel never moves and is the only NPC to accept both types.
Pick up the Gold Sewing Needle and Golden Tailoring Tools from the chest in the church.
Gold Sewing Needle: Sewing needle made of gold. Unique item made to alter demigod attire. Located inside a chest at the right of Church of Vows' main entrance.
Golden Tailoring Tools: Tools made of gold brought with the red-haired Radagon when he married into the Carian line. Located inside a chest at the right of Church of Vows' main entrance.

title: Twinblade
text: At the edge of the cliff behind the church sits a corpse with Stormhawk Feather x5.
Pick up the Grave Violet in front of a dead tree at the top of the hillside.
Grave Violet: Crafting Material. One can be found by a tombstone north from the Chuch of Vows. Beware of an undead ambush.
Optional: Talk to Varre at The First Step, answer "I'll fly straight and true!", then exhaust his dialogue.
Head around the building south of Varre and drop down next to the broken pillar to find Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot x2 on a ledge below the cliff.
Drop down and head toward the gibbets to find a Smithing Stone [1] next to a bottomless pit.
Smithing Stone [1]: Upgrade Material. A total of 3 can be found in the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel .
Just east-northeast of the pit lies the Dragon-Burnt Ruins:
Use Torrent to get inside the rightmost ruin and open the chest in the cellar to obtain the Twinblade.
Twinblade: Underground. Can be found once you take the stairs down Dragon-Burnt Ruins .

place.title: Dragon-Burnt Ruins
walk: The Dragon-Burnt Ruins in Elden Ring can be found around the center section of the Agheel Lake. Within the ruins, are such creatures like Rats, Dogs, Zombie Dogs, and Undead Soldiers. Outside the small room, on the right side, there is a Golden Rune (2) on the ground, near the campsite.

Atop a set of rocks usually found with a swarm of Giant Bat creatures, players can loot Golden Rune (1). Elden Ring Map Link Shoo the bats away to gain access, clear them if you can. Head into the Ruins.

Be careful here since there are multiple servant enemies around the campsite. Approaching the group will trigger the Flying Dragon Agheel Boss to appear, flying down from the sky and killing the whole group. It's best to fight the dragon if you have your mount available, since you will need to be sprinting around the dragon as you also try to avoid its wide ranged attacks. While mounted, using ranged spells is a good start to lessen its HP. Keep an eye out for its movements, since it will fly up in the air and swoop in while it breathes out flames onto the ground. The flames do not remain in the area, so you can just wait a few seconds, and they will extinguish on their own. Just don't try to walk through it and keep away from the flames.

The Flying Dragon Agheel will also charge up and breathe out flames in a straight line. To identify this, you'll notice the dragon charging up as if it is inhaling, and its mouth in flames. Be ready to sprint around it and head over to its back, while it releases the flames, you can land a few melee attacks, and then be ready to move away after it telegraphs its flame throwing attack. Do not position yourself or move to its side, since the dragon will try to follow you while spitting fire.

Head to the very center of the ruins on the map. If you find an entrance to the basement, just to the left of it should be a body to loot. Pillage remains to gain Golden Rune (2). Elden Ring Map Link In the same area, directly behind the entrance, there will be a a ruin wall that looks somewhat enclosed. Move past the basement entrance, get to the other side of the wall where there will be an opening, to be greeted by a large Rat. Clear the rat and loot the body in the corner to obtain a Stonesword Key. Elden Ring Map Link Hold off using the basement entrance in this area for last. There will be one other cellar entrance within this location. Finish looting in the ruins before you decide to go down this route as it is laced with a transporter trap. You can identify this cellar in particular since it it is filled with rats.

Towards the southeast part of the ruins, you may encounter a dog. You will also see some ruin walls are shorter. There will be another body at the corner of some ruined walls. This will contain Crab Eggs. You may come cross one of the other cellar entrances nearby. This entrance is in a more obscure spot and is completely walled off. Elden Ring Map Link Click on the link for the coordinates to this cellar entrance, You may need to double jump in order to reach it. Head down the other entrance, open the chest. This one should contain a Twinblade. If you descend the set of stairs and the first room is teeming with rats, this is the wrong cellar and should first be avoided.

Going further north, within the shallow waters are a group of Land Squirts about northeast of the main ruin site. You may come across a group of Land Squirts to clear to be able to loot 1x Arteria Leaf, 1x Poisonbloom.

Lastly, you can now descend the first basement cellar you came across. Clear the rats and enter the next room. If you open this chest, it will notify you: "Ensnared in a transporter trap!" as a pinkish mist coming from the Teleporter Chest surrounds you. You will be then taken the Sellia Crystal Tunnel. [To be confirmed] Visiting the Sellia Crystal Tunnel before opening the chest will make the chest be open next time you visit it.

region: Early Liurnia and Caelid · meeting 1 of 4
title: Talk to Bloody Finger Hunter Yura
text: Bloody Finger Hunter Yura: First encounter with this NPC, warns you about the dragon in the nearby ruins.

title: Stonesword Key
text: In a corner just east past the rightmost ruin lies a corpse with Crab Eggs.

Go inside the ruined tower to find a Stonesword Key guarded by a rat.
Stonesword Key: Stonesword Key . Found on a corpse sitting high above on a ledge connecting two buildings. Accessible by jumping across the rooftops.

title: Poison Armament
text: Pick up the Golden Rune [2] next to the tower.
Head down the cellar full of rats and open the trap chest to be transported to Sellia Crystal Tunnel.
After arriving in Sellia, open the chest in front of you for Gravity Stone Fan x6 and Gravity Stone Chunk x3.

Gravity Stone Chunk: Offensive Throwable. 6x found inside a chest in the central storage shed in the main cavern. This is the same shed you are teleported to upon using the trap coffer at the Dragon-Burnt Ruins .

Gravity Stone Fan: Offensive Throwable. 6x found inside a chest in the central storage shed in the main cavern. This is the same shed you are teleported to upon using the trap coffer at the Dragon-Burnt Ruins .
Crouch down and exit the hut toward the right side. Continue downward while crouched to reach the Sellia Crystal Tunnel grace.
Pick up Rot Grease from the corner of the room.
Rot Grease: Weapon Coating. Found on a body in the middle of the raised garden-like area in the main keep.
Exit the tunnel and head south-southwest toward the glowing footprints. Kill the invisible scarab to obtain Poison Armament.

Poison Armament: Incantation . Dropped by an invisible Teardrop Scarab roaming around the northeast section of Aeonia Swamp. Figure out its pattern via the footprints and wait for the prints to approach and then attack.

place.title: Sellia Crystal Tunnel
walk: ## Alternate Entry

You can reach this location (and by extension Caelid) early by opening the chest in Dragon-Burnt Ruins. It will envelop you in smoke and transport you to the mine but be warned, the enemies within may be too difficult for you at this time.If you enter via this method, you will appear in a small wooden shed with a chest. Be very careful stepping outside of the shed as you will be hit pursuing rains of hell above from three Lesser Kindred of Rot, one of which is sitting atop the shed you arrive in. To get to the Site of Grace safely, you will need to turn right as soon as you exit the shed, curve around and go down the hill. Follow this path heading west, and take the left cavern exit at the end to get to the Site of Grace.
## Main Dungeon Walkthrough

This section assumes you reached the dungeon naturally by exploring Caelid. From the Site of Grace, head north and up the ladder to reach a large cavern with many Glintstone Miner enemies mining for crystals. These enemies are weak against magic and piercing attacks but resistant against other attack types. You can ascend by heading up the slope on the right but be careful of the Lesser Kindred of Rot (Pests) along the way. There is one standing atop the storage shed on the left. When you reach the top of the path, head for the end of the wooden walkway on the left and kill the Lesser Kindred on the way. At the end of the walkway is a corpse with a Rune Arc. Opposite the walkway, you can find a Smithing Stone (5) on the wall behind some crates. Head back to the storage shed with the Lesser Kindred that you passed on the way and jump up on its roof to reach the wooden platform in the east. To jump onto the shed roof, start your jump from the candle on the ground just outside the shed. Next, drop down the edge of this platform to proceed

In the tunnels ahead, beware of an ambush by a particularly strong Glintstone Miner to the right, and pick up the Smithing Stone (5) on the ground on the left. In the next section, climb up the ladder and go around the wooden walkway to find a corpse with a Somber Smithing Stone (4). Head north and take out the Lesser Kindred above the storage shed ahead. A Glintstone Miner will also come out the side towards you. Enter the shed for a chest containing the Rock Blaster spell. Go around the shed and take the ladder to the roof. There is a Golden Rune (4) on a corpse by the ladder. Kill the Glintstone Miners on the roof and head west to spot a tunnel. There is a Somber Smithing Stone (4) before the entrance to the right. Be sure to kick down the ladder on the left which leads downward for a nice shortcut in case you head through here again. The ladder will be located directly across from the shed

When you enter the next section, be careful of an ambush by a Lesser Kindred of Rot in the wooden structure to the left. There's a corpse with a Dragonwound Grease in front of the room and a Somber Smithing Stone (4) inside the room. There are two more Lesser Kindred on the elevated platform to the northeast. Take them out and collect the Faithful's Canvas Talisman on the corpse by the wall and the Smithing Stone (5) to the left. Head back down the raised platform and through the tunnel to the southwest and through the large wooden gate to engage this dungeon's boss.
## Boss: Fallingstar Beast

The Fallingstar Beast is a massive quadruped made up of crystals or rock. It has a long spiky tail and a head reminiscent of a centipede's, with massive mandibles extending from its face. Because of the boss' size, you will have little room for maneuvering. The main attacks to watch out for are its head swipe combo, in which it bashes its head from side to side multiple times as well as its charge attack, in which it dashes towards you three times, quickly changing directions after each charge. The beast can also cause the ground to erupt in a rock burst. This is telegraphed by lightning forming on its mandibles, as well as on the ground, indicating where the ground will burst. The key to defeating this boss is to constantly be on the move and attack during its long recovery animations.
Defeating the Fallingstar Beast awards the Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing (1), 4 x Gravity Stone Chunk, a Somber Smithing Stone (6) and 5 x Smithing Stone (7), as well as 7,600 Runes.

title: Rock Sling
text: Note: An easy way to deal with invisible scarabs is to mount up on Torrent and holding R2 or Shift + Left Click to charge a Heavy Attack along its path. When timed right, it should die running into your weapon.
Pick up Rune Arc from the small island with a thin tree in the rot swamp.
Rune Arc: Consumable. Found inside Sellia Crystal Tunnel . Head up the slope in the main cavern all the way to the top and then look for a corpse hanging off the edge of a wooden walkway on the left.
Continue southwest from the island to discover the Inner Aeonia grace.
Head toward the large scarab northwest of the grace, then go through the ravine to find a Somber Smithing Stone [5] in front of some glintstone crystals.
Somber Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. Found at the bottom of the main chamber. Head behind the northern storage shed and follow the tunnel to a small cavern where you can find the stone.
Exit the ravine, then follow the west wall to the corner of the swamp. On a root in the corner is a corpse with Sacramental Bud.
Just south-southeast of the corner lies the Street of Sages Ruins:
Head down the cellar in the ruin closest to the corner for a chest with Rock Sling.
Rock Sling: Gravity Sorcery . Found inside a chest in a cellar in the northern section of the Street of Sages Ruins .

place.title: Street of Sages Ruins
walk: Of note in these ruins are the Traveler's Set and Perfume Bottle that can be looted from a corpse in the corner of one of the ruined structures, guarded by several Poison Flowers and a Servant of Rot. Heading northwest, you can find a large group of Servants of Rot guarding a set of stairs leading to an underground area where you can loot the Rock Sling sorcery spell. In the southwest, there is another set of ruins guarded by more Poison Flowers. There is a corpse hanging from a window in this building that contains the Meteorite Staff.
Meteorite Staff can be found on a corpse hanging from a window in a small room with several poison flowers.
Perfumer Traveler's Set: Traveler's Hat, Perfumer's Traveling Garb, Traveler's Gloves, Traveler's Slops can be found on a corpse in a corner in the ruins.

title: Perfumer Traveler's Set, Perfume Bottle
text: Loot the Perfumer Traveler's Set and Perfume Bottle from the ruin in the middle.
Perfumer Traveler's Set: Set includes: Traveler's Hat , Perfumer's Traveling Garb , Traveler's Gloves , Traveler's Slops , can be found on a corpse in a corner in the ruins.
Perfume Bottle: Key Item. Found on a corpse in the corner of the ruins along with the Traveler's Set .

title: Meteorite Staff
text: In the ruined tower, you'll find the Meteorite Staff and a Golden Rune [4].
Meteorite Staff: Glintstone Staff with S scaling but no upgrades. Found on a corpse hanging from a window in Street of Sages Ruins in the swamp of Caelid.
Golden Rune [4]: Golden Rune (4) held by a corpse within one of the shattered buildings.

title: Ash of War: Poisonous Mist
text: Head around the wall southeast of the ruined tower to discover the Aeonia Swamp Shore grace on a ledge near the shore.
Ride southeast from the grace to find a teleporting scarab on a small island in the rot. Kill it to obtain Ash of War: Poisonous Mist.
Ash of War: Poisonous Mist: Ash of War. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in the southwest section of the Swamp of Aeonia .

title: Map (Caelid)
text: Southwest of the island, in the distance, is a small mushroom-covered mountain. Head around it to find a Golden Rune [3] guarded by putrid Miranda Sprouts.
Climb the mushroom-covered mountain to find a Golden Rune [4] at the top, overlooking the swamp.
East-southeast below the mountain lies a small campsite. Destroy the wagon there to find Crab Eggs x4 underneath.
Continue east from the campsite to discover the Southern Aeonia Swamp Bank grace behind a mushroom-covered branch.
Pass time until morning, then head southwest to find the Nomadic Merchant (South Caelid) by the road.
Pick up Map: Caelid from the stele next to the road.
Map (Caelid): Map Fragment. Reveals the Caelid region excluding Dragonbarrow . Found on a monolith at the Caelid Highway South intersection.

title: Golden Seed
text: Follow the southeast path near the stele to a Golden Seed.
Golden Seed: Flask Upgrade Material. Found under a Phantom Tree by the side of the road in south Caelid .

title: Ash of War: Sacred Ring of Light
text: Return to the grace and head northwest to find Smithing Stone [4] x3, Sacramental Bud x2, and a Rune Arc on some chairs at the shore.
Smithing Stone [4]: Upgrade Material. 3x found on a body sat on a chair on the southern bank of the Swamp of Aeonia .
Sacramental Bud: Crafting Material. Found on a body sat on a chair in the southern bank of the Swamp of Aeonia .
Rune Arc: Consumable. Found on a body on a chair on the southern bank of the Swamp of Aeonia .
Ride north-northeast from the chairs to pick up Aeonian Butterfly and Somber Smithing Stone [4] from the corpses between two trees in the swamp.
Aeonian Butterfly: 1 Aeonian Butterfly can be found on a body in the middle of the swamp here
Somber Smithing Stone [4]: Found by the sea past the Minor Erdtree.
Continue up the nearby slope and kill the exploding scarab for Ash of War: Sacred Ring of Light.
Ash of War: Sacred Ring of Light: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in the southeast section of Aeonia Swamp.

title: Gold Scarab
text: Travel to Roundtable Hold and talk to Roderika in front of the fireplace.
Talk to Hewg about Roderika.
Return to Roderika and tell her what the blacksmith said.
Talk to Hewg about Roderika, then ask if he'll watch over her; your answer doesn't matter.
Reload the area to find them in the same room. Roderika will now offer to upgrade your spirit ashes.
Optional: Talk to Hewg about Roderika now that she's become a spirit tuner.
Talk to Diallos, who is now back at Roundtable Hold.

Note: At this point, you should have eight flasks upgraded to +5 and enough materials to upgrade any Somber weapon to +5. For beginners, I'd go with the Bloodhound's Fang (requires 18 Strength and 17 Dexterity) until you find a weapon you like.
Optional: Here are some steps I didn't include. I wouldn't bother with them unless you know what you're doing:
Get the Gold Scarab for 20% more runes from enemies. You'll need to kill the duo boss in Abandoned Cave in Caelid to obtain it.

title: Boss: Night's Cavalry (Caelid)
text: Cheese the Night's Cavalry on the bridge near Lenne's Rise to ride off the cliff.
Night's Cavalry: Night's Cavalry Miniboss. Roams the Caelid Highway South. Only appears at night. Drops Ash of War: Poison Moth Flight upon defeat.
Ash of War: Poison Moth Flight: Ash of War Upgrade. Dropped by the Night's Cavalry miniboss roaming the highway upon defeat. Only appears at night.

title: Dectus Medallion, Radagon's Soreseal
text: Grab the Dectus Medallion (Right) and Radagon's Soreseal from Fort Faroth.
Dectus Medallion: Key Quest Item. Found in a chest atop the eastern tower in Fort Faroth , accessible via ladder past all the bats on the bottom level.
Radagon's Soreseal: Talisman. Found on a corpse by dropping down the opening on the roof and looking around the wooden walkways.

place.title: Fort Faroth
walk: Of note in this fort are the Dectus Medallion (Right) and the Radagon's Soreseal talisman.

To get the Dectus Medallion piece, head inside the main entrance and make your way through the dark room, fighting off the Giant Bats and Chanting Winged Dames. Beware as they are significantly tougher than any you've encountered in Limgrave. Once you reach the back of the room, climb the ladder to reach the top of the tower. There is a chest here containing the Medallion. It is one of two halves required to activate the Grand Lift of Dectus, with the other half being in Fort Haight in Mistwood.

To get Radagon's Soreseal, from the top of the tower with the Medallion, jump off onto the main roof, kill the Spectral Knight enemies, then drop down onto the wooden platform from the second smaller square opening on the top of the fort (it has a ladder to climb down, but you can just jump down). You then proceed on the wooden platform where you encounter a small rat. After killing it, you would need to make a running jump onto another wooden platform (perpendicular to the current one you're on) where you encounter a small rat and giant rat. After disposing them, just follow the path and ladder down to retrieve Radagon's Soreseal.

Elder Dragon Greyoll can also be found laying on the fields just west of the fort. She can easily be killed by equipping any Weapons or Skills that proc the bleed effect. She will not engage you but you should only attack her from her tail. Otherwise her lesser dragon underlings will attack. Killing Greyoll will yield 5 Dragon Hearts and also unlock Elder Dragon Greyoll's Roar at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion.
notes: Rune Farming Guide
This is a great rune farming location.

Elden Dragon Greyoll is nearby, by attacking her with Spinning Weapon, you can apply Bleed pretty fast with a weapon that already inflicts Bleed passively, but even quicker if you apply Bloodflame Blade on it.
Apply Bloodflame Blade on your bleed weapon that has Spinning Weapon Ash of War equipped. (I use a Morningstar +0 without Blood affinity)
Run straight towards Greyoll, and land on the small fungus pile.
Spam Spinning Weapon until she has ~10% HP left.
Use a Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot.
Use Spinning Weapon 2 or 3 more times, always keeping Bloodflame Blade active.
Summon Torrent and deal the final blow while on horse.
As soon as she moves after her HP reaches 0, run towards Fort Faroth's Site of Grace and sit down.

If you got it right, Greyoll won't despawn and you get about ~80k runes (on NG with Gold Scarab and Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot) every ~2 minutes, quick enough to kill Greyoll twice per Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot use.

title: Boss: Elder Dragon Greyoll
text: Kill Elder Dragon Greyoll with a bleed weapon and use a Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot (and Gold Scarab) before she dies.
Elder Dragon Greyoll: Massive boss surrounded by dragons. Drops 10,845 Runes and x5 Dragon Heart

title: Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [2]
text: Obtain the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [1] in Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel and Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [2] in Sealed Tunnel (note that going for the latter will trigger the festival in Caelid, which will progress quite a few questlines).
Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [2]: Bell Bearing. Found in a chest in the first hidden chamber of the Sealed Tunnel . Drop down into the lower section and look to the west to find the chest.

title: Golden Seed
text: With Roderika now at Roundtable Hold, pick up the Golden Seed she left at Stormhill Shack.
Golden Seed: Golden Seeds allow the user to upgrade the number of Crimson and Cerulean Flask Uses, but not the amount of Wondrous Physik flasks available.

title: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [6]
text: Travel to Fort Haight West and make your way into Fort Haight:
Pick up Bloodrose x3 from the corpse on the ground.
In the room up the first set of stairs is the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [6].
Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [6]: Cookbook item. Can be looted from the chest in the room at the top of the main stairs of Fort Haight .

guide.title: Liberate Fort Haight
text: If you were traveling first to the Third Church of Marika, you might have encountered Kenneth Haight located at some broken structures along the northern cliff of the area. The area is inhabited by a group of demi-humans, and you will need to get rid of them before talking to the NPC. If you agreed to help him, your task is to find Fort Haight and liberate it. Fort Haight.

Fort Haight can be found on the southeast side of the map from Mistwood Ruins, it's along the road. The outskirts of the fort, as expected, is guarded by enemies such as Godrick Soldiers, Demi-Humans, and a Lesser Mad Pumpkin Helm. By the stairs, you can find an illusory tree that has x1 Golden Seed, make sure to grab this for your Crimson and Cerulean Flasks. The way in is by going up the stairs and entering the main gate. Inside, there are more enemies here such as the Commoner, Rats, and a Godrick Knight. Make sure to clear the fort for items such as finding the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [6], Smithing Stone [1], the Dectus Medallion (Left), and the Ash of War: Bloody Slash that drops from the Godrick Knight upon defeating it.

Once the area is clear, make sure to activate the site of grace for Fort Haight, and return to Kenneth to acquire your reward, the Erdsteel Dagger. This NPC will then move to another location and can be found at the top section of Fort Haight.
## Fight Against the First of Many Dragons

Now, if you want to gain access to some unique Incantation spells, then you may want to head over to the Dragon-Burnt Ruins to fight the Flying Dragon Agheel. You can check the page for Flying Dragon Agheel to find our written guide on how to defeat this boss, as well as a video guide. By killing this dragon, you'll be able to acquire the Dragon Heart which is used at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion. Below is a list of the available incantations you can exchange, including information on the number of hearts and conditions required to gain access to it.

title: Ash of War: Bloody Slash
text: Kill the Godrick Knight on the upper level to receive Ash of War: Bloody Slash, then pick up the Bloodrose x5 behind him.
Ash of War: Bloody Slash: Ash of War Upgrade. Dropped by a Beast Crest Heater Knight fought at the top of the ramparts of Fort Haight .
Bloodrose: can be found at the hight level of Fort Haight on a dead body

title: Dectus Medallion
text: Head down the wooden staircase to the right of the ladder to find a Smithing Stone [1].
Smithing Stone [1]: Upgrade Material. Found by looting a corpse on the battlements of Fort Haight .
Climb the ladder to the top for a chest with the Dectus Medallion (Left).
Dectus Medallion: Key Quest Item. Found in a chest that can be reached by climbing the ladder in the tallest tower of Fort Haight .

place.title: Fort Haight
walk: You will come to Fort Haight after running to Kenneth Haight who needs help clearing his fort from the enemies that have overrun it. He will be north of Mistwood outskirts. There will a large topped structure and he will be standing towards the edge. He will mention that the fort lies to the south, beyond the Mistwood. His advice is also to take great care to avoid Godrick's Tarnished hunts.

Players can expect plenty of enemies in this mini-dungeon, but will not be expected to face any large bosses in this area. Be prepared for enemy bombs and clear the area as you see fit. Make your way to the top of the fort to loot the chest containing an item that seems to be half of a crescent - the Dectus Medallion (Left). Clear the Knight atop the fort walls to gain a chance to obtain his armor. Complete the task by clearing the fort and speaking to Sir Kenneth and he will state that a festival will be thrown in your honor. He will reward you with an Erdsteel Dagger.
Return to the fort to meet Kenneth Haight again.
notes: The fort holds Dectus Medallion (Left), one of the two halves needed to raise the Grand Lift of Dectus and reach the Altus Plateau.
Clearing it advances Kenneth Haight's questline — he asks for the fort before he will move here himself.
Ash of War: Bloody Slash is found here, an early source of a blood-loss skill.
The full Godrick Knight armor set drops in the fort, alongside the Chainlink Flail and Partisan.
It sits on a cliff southeast of Limgrave, past the Mistwood Ruins.
Garrison is light — Giant Rat, Godrick Knight and a Lesser Mad Pumpkin Head — so it is clearable well before the medallion becomes relevant.

title: Erdsteel Dagger, Talk to Kenneth Haight
text: Return to Kenneth Haight on top of the arched ruin to receive the Erdsteel Dagger. Exhaust his dialogue and pledge service to him.
Erdsteel Dagger: Dagger. Rewarded by Kenneth Haight for clearing out Fort Haight .
Kenneth Haight: Kenneth Haight is first encountered at this spot. He is seen dramatically calling out for someone to aid him in his plight.

title: Cracked Pot
text: Re-enter the fort and talk to Kenneth Haight where the knight was.
Travel to the Church of Elleh and head north to find the entrance to Groveside Cave:
Activate the Groveside Cave grace inside and equip your lantern.
Below the ledge in the room is a Cracked Pot.
Cracked Pot: Crafting Pot. Can be found inside Groveside Cave . By the bonfire, there is a body that you can loot to find x1 Cracked Pot.

place.title: Groveside Cave
walk: Early in the game, you can find minor dungeons that you can complete to find various items and equipment to help you through your journey. One of the locations we would recommend you to travel to is the Groveside Cave situated at West Limgrave, north of Church of Elleh and southwest of Gatefront Ruins Map Coordinates Here. This cave is small in terms of exploring it, and as you move forward, you'll first encounter a pack of Wolves below, and some Cave Moss around. By the bonfire, there is a body that you can loot to find x1 Cracked Pot. Straight ahead is a dead end with two more wolves, there are two more bodies that you can pillage to find x3 Glowstone and x1 Golden Rune (1), as well as some Silver Firefly that's flying by the wall.

Next, head to the east side of the cave where you'll find a gold fog door, beyond it is a boss arena where the Beastman of Farum Azula is. You can visit the boss page for the Beastman of Farum Azula to find our guide on how to defeat it. This enemy rewards you with the Flamedrake Talisman and 1000 Runes. You've now cleared the area and you can interact with the portal mist to fast travel back to the entrance.

title: Boss: Beastman of Farum Azula (Groveside Cave)
text: Pick up the Glowstone x3 and Golden Rune [1] in the water.
Glowstone: Can be found on a corpse. Beware of the two goblins that will spawn near it.
Golden Rune [1]: Loot the dead bodies.
Kill the Beastman of Farum Azula for Flamedrake Talisman and 1,000 runes.
Flamedrake Talisman: Talisman. Dropped by the Beastman of Farum Azula boss inside Groveside Cave .
Beastman of Farum Azula: Optional Boss. Found at the end of the Groveside Cave mini-dungeon. Drops the Flamedrake Talisman .

guide.title: The Groveside Cave
text: Early in the game, you can find minor dungeons that you can complete early in the game, and by doing so, you can find various items and equipment that can help you through your journey. One of the locations we would recommend you travel to is the Groveside Cave situated on the west side of the map, north of Church of Elleh and southwest of Gatefront Ruins. This cave is small in terms of exploring it, as you move forward, you'll first encounter a pack of Wolves below, and some Cave Moss around. By the bonfire, there is a body that you can loot to find x1 Cracked Pot. Straight ahead is a dead end with two more wolves, there are two more bodies that you can pillage to find x3 Glowstone and x1 Golden Rune (1), as well as some Silver Firefly that's flying by the wall.

Next, head to the east side of the cave where you'll find a gold fog door, beyond it is a boss arena where the Beastman of Farum Azula is. You can visit the boss page for the Beastman of Farum Azula to find our guide on how to defeat it. This enemy rewards you with the Flamedrake Talisman and 1000 Runes. You've now cleared the area, and you can interact with the portal mist to fast travel back to the entrance.

title: Armorer's Cookbook [1]
text: Travel to Agheel Lake North and head northeast toward a camp with Kaiden Sellswords. Pick up the Armorer's Cookbook [1] in front of some pots.
Armorer's Cookbook [1]: Can be found inside a small camp of Soldiers and Wolves.

title: Homing Instinct Painting
text: Just past the camp you'll see a pack of wolves. Pick up the Golden Rune [2] below the pack leader.
Golden Rune [2]: Found on a dead body around the ruins.
Below the ledge east of the wolves, you'll discover the Murkwater Coast grace.
Drop down northeast of the grace, where the edge of the ruin meets the cliff, and pick up the Poisonbloom x2 on a boulder in the water.
Poisonbloom: Can be found on a dead body in the waters.
Use the spiritspring while facing southeast to reach a shack. Pick up the Smithing Stone [1] next to it and interact with the painting inside for the "Homing Instinct" Painting.
Homing Instinct Painting: Key Info Item. Painting inside the Artist's Shack in Limgrave .
Smithing Stone [1]: On a dead body.

title: Boss: Grave Warden Duelist (Limgrave)
text: Grab the Artist's Shack grace just outside the shack.
On the rocky ledge near the grace is an exploding scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [1].
Return to the spiritspring, then follow the water northwest to reach Murkwater Catacombs:
Head inside and activate the Murkwater Catacombs grace.
Pick up the 2x Grave Glovewort [1] in the first corridor.
Grave Glovewort [1]: Multiple found inside Murkwater Catacombs .
In the room straight ahead is a corpse with Root Resin x5 and a lever that, when pulled, unlocks the door to the boss.
Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [1] on the way to the boss.
Kill the Grave Warden Duelist for Banished Knight Engvall and 1,700 runes.
Grave Warden Duelist: Found within Murkwater Catacombs.
Banished Knight Engvall Ashes: Spirit Ashes. Dropped by the boss of Murkwater Catacombs: Grave Warden Duelist, after Patch 1.03.
Battle Hammer: Dropped by Grave Warden Duelist in Murkwater Catacombs .

place.title: Artist's Shack
walk: Information on how to complete the area and relevant tips for the player go here

title: Invader: Bloody Finger Nerijus, Reduvia
text: Return to the catacomb entrance and head along the water until you get invaded by Bloody Finger Nerijus. Kill him to obtain the Reduvia.
Bloody Finger Nerijus: Found while traversing the Murkwater River. Blood Finger Hunter Yura joins to aid you during the fight.
Reduvia: Dropped by Bloody Finger Nerijus

guide.title: A Familiar Feeling
text: Before you head over to Stormhill, you may want to complete Murkwater Cave and Murkwater Catacombs first. Murkwater Cave can be found up the ravine from Agheel Lake, while Murkwater Catacombs is at the end of the ravine. Make sure you have a Torch before going into the cave, if you don't have one, buy it from Merchant Kale at Church of Elleh. There are some Skeleton enemies along the way, and as you reach the entrance of the cave, you'll get a notification and will be invaded by an NPC Invader, Bloody Finger Nerijuss. Some say he appears as you approach Murkwater Catacombs, but in some cases, the NPC Invader appears when you're about to enter Murkwater Cave, either way, just be prepared.

Hold your ground and wait for a few minutes, Bloody Finger Hunter Yura will be summoned to help you fight this NPC Invader. When he appears, you can just sit tight and let Yura handle it or join the fight and help him. Successfully defeating Bloody Finger Nerijuss drops the Reduvia dagger weapon, some Runes, and a Furlcalling Finger Remedy, Yura on the other hand will leave, but you'll find him later on just ahead of the ravine before reaching Murkwater Catacombs.

Enter the cave, rest at the site of grace, continue further, and kill the Highwayman enemies. As you see the one that's running back and forth, make sure to look at the ground, there are some bells here, if you trip the chains, it will alert the rest of the Highwaymen, and there are about 5 of them ahead. Clear the cave and make sure to open the chest to find some Mushroom materials. Now, check the east side of the cave and you'll see a gold mist. Beyond the mist, you'll find a campsite, and there's no one as well.

Open the chest and someone will call you out as a thief, you'll find this voice to be Patches, a veteran From Softwater character, who makes his grandiose entrance. This "boss" fight is quite simple and easy to manage, when his health is at 50% he tells you that he surrenders. It's your choice to stop or continue attacking him. If you stop, the battle ends, and he'll act friendly towards you, speak to him and he'll mention to you about opening a shop of his own. But if you kill him, he drops his bell bearing, Patches Bell Bearing, which you can give to the Two Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold. If you do choose to spare him, make sure to talk to him and choose the option of forgiving him, return to the entrance and speak to him again at his camp in Murkwater Caves, you'll gain access to his shop if you want to buy some important items like the Stonesword Key - oh, and there's also a chest that you can open.

Go back outside and at this point, we recommend that you clear out Murkwater Catacombs which is inhabited by Imps, it's a small dungeon that hosts a mini-boss as well at the end, the Grave Warden Duelist. There are some upgrade materials that you can grab here such as the Grave Glovewort (1), some materials and some Runes if you defeat the Grave Warden Duelist.

From here, it's entirely up to you if you want to explore or check some parts of the map or if you want to farm Runes, whatever you feel like doing. But if you're wondering what to do next, that would be to enter Stormhill which is beyond the Stormgate at Gatefront Ruins.

title: Talk to Bloody Finger Hunter Yura
text: Optional: Head back along the water after killing Nerijus and talk to Yura below the ruin where the jellyfish were.

Bloody Finger Hunter Yura: NPC Questline: Found on the ground level under a broken structure. Talk to Bloody Finger Hunter Yura by resting at a grace after defeating NPC invader Bloody Finger Nerijus.

place.title: Murkwater Catacombs
walk: As you enter the Catacombs, you will immediately find the Site of grace. Head down the stairs and you can examine the object to your left. Then it will tell you this summoning pool is now functional. By heading down a little longer, you will be welcomed by a couple of Cat Imps that dwell on the roof of the room, you can choose to attack them before they are animated. These Cat Imps may also appear as static figures in the corners of the room. You will find 2 Grave Glovewort (1) in this room. Keep moving forward.

If you head straight towards the room with the statue, beware of the square platform on the floor, as this will activate a trap shooting 3 sets of 3 projectiles. If you do activated it, stay close to the walls to avoid them.

There will be more Cat Imps in the area. Deal with them, and you will find Root Resin on the ground and a lever against the wall. Push the lever. Turn back and head to where the path forks and take the other way down. There are more Cat Imps waiting for you in the next room, two on the ground and another one hanging on the roof waiting for you to enter.
Once you are done with them, you will reach the set of doors leading down to the fog gate boss area. You will find the Grave Warden Duelist there.
## Boss Battle: Grave Warden

The Grave Warden Duelist is an optional boss and probably one of the easiest to beat. As soon as the battle starts, summon a Spirit and let the spirit companion do the hard work for you. It will serve as a distraction for the Grave Warden Duelist and will most likely attack it first. While this is happening, you can attack the boss with your ranged magic attack spells or, if there is a window of opportunity, rush in and land a few attacks with your strongest melee weapon. Depending on the spirit, some have quite a large amount of health, so it won't go down that easily and its attacks deal quite a lot of damage and can knockback the Grave Warden Duelist. Successfully defeating this boss yields 1200 Runes and drops 1700 Runes as well as Banished Knight Engvall Ashes. After the battle, you can use the teleporter ahead to return to the entrance or just travel back by foot if you prefer to.

title: Cloth Garb, Cloth Trousers
text: Look for a cave opening along the western cliff, where you got invaded, to find Murkwater Cave:
Head inside and grab the Murkwater Cave grace.
Loot Mushroom x5 from the chest straight ahead.
Open the chest in the boss room to obtain Cloth Garb and Cloth Trousers.
Cloth Garb: Can be found at the chest at the end of the dungeon in Murkwater Cave
Cloth Trousers: Can be found at the chest at the end of the dungeon in Murkwater Cave

title: Grovel for Mercy
text: After opening the chest, you'll be ambushed by Patches. Bring his HP below 50% without killing him and he'll surrender, giving you Golden Rune [1] x2 and the Grovel for Mercy gesture.
Golden Rune [1]: Found by a ruin next to the lake.
miss: Becomes unobtainable if Patches is killed before he can surrender.

title: Extreme Repentance
text: Talk to the now friendly Patches after the fight; your answer doesn't matter.

Remove your weapon and punch him until he becomes hostile. Let him hit you until you're almost dead and he'll give you the Extreme Repentance gesture. Either use it in front of him, or let him kill you.
miss: Unobtainable if Patches is killed before he gives the gesture. If missed, you can still get it from him in Liurnia or Mt. Gelmir.

title: Calm Down!
text: Optional: Reload the area and talk to Patches about the bandits, then about the new chest.
After opening the new chest, turn around and grab the Gold-Tinged Excrement x5, Golden Rune [5], and Throwing Dagger x5 in the pond.
Gold-Tinged Excrement: Can be found at Earthbore Cave on some dead bodies
Ride west-northwest past the sleeping Runebear to find the Mistwood Outskirts grace near a road.
Rest at the grace, then follow the cliff edge west-southwest of the grace to a ruin. Pick up the Golden Rune [1] hanging from its edge.
Return to Patches to learn the Calm Down! gesture.
miss: Unobtainable if Patches is killed before he gives the gesture. If missed, you can still get it from him in Liurnia or Mt. Gelmir.

title: Ash of War: Unsheathe
text: Note: I strongly recommend buying Margit's Shackle from Patches. It can reveal illusory walls, trigger fire-breathing pillars, and (in the DLC) unlock sealed spiritsprings and break pots hanging from cliffs, all from a safe distance.
Exit the cave and continue along the water to find a corpse with Fire Grease under a bridge.
Head south-southwest past the bridge for a corpse with Arteria Leaf surrounded by Land Squirts behind a stone coffin.
Arteria Leaf: Can be found at Mistwood Ruins behind a grave near the Sacrificial Twig.
Kill the scarab southeast of the coffin for Ash of War: Unsheathe, but be wary of the Giant Crabs burrowed in the water.
Ash of War: Unsheathe: Can be obtained from a Teardrop Scarab located in the water. Beware of the Giant Crab nearby.

title: Incantation Scarab
text: Pick up Crab Eggs from the nearby corpse surrounded by smaller crabs.
Crab Eggs: Found on a body located on the edge. Beware of the small skeleton army you have to face before.
Head toward the ruin west of the crabs and pick up the Slumbering Egg on top of it.
Talk to Yura standing under the ruin.
Grab the Seaside Ruins grace next to the cliff just west of the ruin.
On top of a rock north-northwest of the grace is a Golden Rune [1] guarded by some bats.
Golden Rune [1] J: Next to a big arch structure, besides a large rock.
Continue northwest along the ledge, then drop down to see the Incantation Scarab appear in front of some gravestones (painting reward).

Incantation Scarab: Need to examine the Homecoming Painting at Artist's Shack first. The Incantation Scarab can be found Southwest of the Dragon Burnt Ruins , there will be a gravestone with a ghost sitting in front of it. Interact with the ghost, and it will drop the Incantation Scarab.

title: Boss: Flying Dragon Agheel
text: Kill Flying Dragon Agheel in the lake for Dragon Heart and 5,000 runes.
Flying Dragon Agheel: Optional Dragon Boss of Agheel Lake . Rewards a Dragon Heart you can use at the Church of Dragon Communion .

Dragon Heart: Key Consumable. Dropped by Flying Dragon Agheel . Dragon Hearts are used to acquire Dragon Communion Incantations at the Church of Dragon Communion and the Cathedral of Dragon Communion .

title: Boss: Stonedigger Troll (Limgrave)
text: Optional: If you die, you can return to Yura and exhaust his dialogue. His summon sign will then be available near a flat ruin in the lake.
In the northern corner of the lake lies the entrance to Limgrave Tunnels:
Instead of taking the lift, drop down to the left of it for a Golden Rune [4] in a narrow tunnel.
Golden Rune [4]: Golden Rune [4] held by a corpse within the Limgrave Tunnels .
Drop down all the way and activate the Limgrave Tunnels grace at the bottom.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [1] on the wall next to the first miner.
Smithing Stone [1]: Approximately x8 found in Limgrave Tunnels (mostly as yellow glowing stones on wall).
On the wall next to the miner down the first set of stairs is another Smithing Stone [1].
Smithing Stone [1]: You can find a couple of these stones within Morne Tunnel .
Pick up the Smithing Stone [1] in an alcove on the ground level.
Follow the southwest tunnel to a room with a Smithing Stone [1] and some rats.
Take the other tunnel to a lift and ride it to the bottom. Loot Large Glintstone Scrap x5 inside a hut.
Large Glintstone Scrap: Two can be looted off a corpse behind the small shack in Morne Tunnel .
In the area around the hut, you'll find 2x Smithing Stone [1].
Take the lift back up, then drop off while facing southeast to continue. On the wall between the two paths is a Smithing Stone [1].
Pick up Glintstone Scrap x3 from the right path.

Glintstone Scrap: Offensive Consumable. Found inside the Altus Tunnel . In the second cavern, head through the tunnel in the south to find a wooden balcony overlooking a pit. Drop down onto the overgrown root on the left side to reach a lower balcony below where you can find the item on a corpse.
Take the other path for a Smithing Stone [1] next to the miner near the lift.
Drop down to the left of the lift for a Golden Rune [1] on a ledge, then drop to the ledge below it for a Somber Smithing Stone [1].
Grab a final Smithing Stone [1] from the right wall before the boss.
Kill the Stonedigger Troll for Roar Medallion and 1,800 runes.
Roar Medallion: Dropped by Stonedigger Troll . Located in Limgrave Tunnels.
Stonedigger Troll: Optional Boss. Found at the end of Limgrave Tunnels. Drops Roar Medallion

place.title: Limgrave Tunnels
walk: The Limgrave Tunnels can be found on the southeast side of the map from the Gatefront Ruins Map Coordinates Here. NOTE: Bring a Torch to light up some sections that are dark. Upon arriving at the Limgrave Tunnels, you'll see a lift that will take you down, step on the button platform and you'll find a Site of Grace there to rest or use as a checkpoint. Notice that when you ride the lift down from the entrance, you'll see that there are two pathways that you'll pass as you go down to the section with the site of grace.

First go back to the top, and on the left (west) side of the lift, you'll see that you can drop down onto the pathway below from the ledge. This is a dead-end, instead, drop down to the other pathway just below and you'll find a corpse at the end, you can pillage it to find x1 Golden Rune (4). Head to the lower section where the site is by dropping onto the platforms that are lit with candles.

Now, proceed north from the checkpoint and you'll encounter Miner enemies. These enemies with their stone skin are resistant to slashing and piercing damage, but weak to strike. Kill the first three on the wooden path, check the locations of the two miners picking at the wall to find x2 Smithing Stone (1). Then head down, turn right and check the nearby corner. There is another Miner there and in front of it, you can pick up x1 Smithing Stone (1). Check the south section where you'll see another Miner and at the tunnel path, there are three Rats and another body that you can pillage to find x1 Smithing Stone (1) - go back to the opposite tunnel path near the wooden steps and ride the elevator down.

You'll notice as you move down that there is another pathway. Check this later, for now, investigate this section. Go straight when you reach the lower level where you'll see a small shack that is being guarded by a Zombie Dog inside, another one of that hound under the shack, as well as more Miners. Kill the enemies and loot the corpse inside the shack to find x5 Large Glintstone Scrap, also, make sure to check the spot where the Miner enemy was mining to find another Smithing Stone (1) that you can pick up. Also, if you check the back of the shack, there's a tight path that you can pass through, at the end is another Smithing Stone (1). This area is now clear, go back to the lift, and make sure you are facing southeast as you go up - be ready to dodge roll or jump off the lift when you nearly pass the mid pathway of this elevator.

Move forward and you'll see more Miners here. There is one in front, another on the right, and three more at the path on the left side. Before going left, check the path on the right which is a dead-end, you'll find another body that can be pillaged to find x3 Glintstone Scrap. Next, go to the path on the left (make sure to check the sides of the wall to pick up Smithing Stones), and you'll find the third lift that goes down even further. The lower-most level contains a closed gate, and on the other side of it is the boss of this location.

As you were riding the third lift down, you should notice that there are some platforms here, one of it, having a corpse that holds an item, and a another smithing stone that you can pick up. To easily reach these platforms, ride the elevator back to the top, then start to drop down to the platforms below from the left (south) side of the lift. First, you'll find x1 Golden Rune (1) from the body and on the platform below the corpse, you can pick up x1 Somber Smithing Stone (1) - go all the way to the lower-section where the gate is.

From the closed gate (leading to the boss arena), go right towards a dead-end to find x1 Smithing Stone (1). When you're ready to fight the boss, simply open the gate and the battle against the Stonedigger Troll will begin.
