Slashing weapons and presumably pierce damage work fine. You can check out Stonedigger Troll page to find more guides and strategies on how to defeat this enemy - successfully defeating it rewards the player with x1 Roar Medallion and 1800 Runes.
To leave the boss arena, walk up to the portal mist and use it to return to the entrance.

title: Boss: Night's Cavalry (Limgrave)
text: Travel to Agheel Lake North and pass time until nightfall. Follow the road southeast and kill the Night's Cavalry on the bridge for Ash of War: Repeating Thrust and 2,400 runes.
Ash of War: Repeating Thrust: Dropped by Night's Cavalry that roams the bridge near Agheel Lake North, only appears at night.
Night's Cavalry: Night's Cavalry roams the bridge near Agheel Lake North, only appears at night. Drops Ash of War: Repeating Thrust

title: Greataxe
text: On top of the cliff east of the bridge, at the base of a gibbet, you'll find a Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot.
Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot: Can be found at the base of the crucifix on a small hill.
Stop the caravan traveling the road below, then loot the Greataxe in the back of the carriage.
Greataxe: Found inside the treasure chest within the carriage being pulled by two large Trolls and defended by militia and aristocracy.

title: Boss: Mad Pumpkin Head (Waypoint Ruins)
text: Continue along the road until it meets a large ruin blocking the path. Pick up the Smoldering Butterfly x4 nearby.
Smoldering Butterfly: Find by looting a dead body at the base of the cliff.
On the hill near the blocked road lies Waypoint Ruins:
In a small alley in the back of the ruins is a corpse with Glowstone x2.
Loot the Immunizing Cured Meat and Golden Rune [1] around the Miranda Blossom in the center.
Immunizing Cured Meat: Found in the small group of Poison Flowers in the outskirts of the Waypoint Ruins .
Hanging off the wall above the Miranda Blossom is a corpse with Trina's Lily x4.
Trina's Lily: Can be found in nearby bushes on the edge cliff.
Head down the cellar visible from the top of the wall and kill the Mad Pumpkin Head for 1,100 runes.
Mad Pumpkin Head: Field Boss. Found directly below the Waypoint Ruins .

place.title: Waypoint Ruins
walk: This small area is towards the east side of the map. Players will want to bring poison resistance as the Miranda Sprouts in the area can inflict the Poison Status Effect. Defeat the Giant Miranda Sprout to gain Immunizing Cured Meat. Consuming this item will temporarily boost Immunity. There will be other Miranda Sprouts in the area to farm Poisonbloom and Miranda Power. Other lootable materials in the area include Ruin Fragment found atop the large topped stone structure, and Trina's Lily x4, looted off a draped body on one of the taller ruined walls of this location.
After clearing the area, use Torrent to double-jump into the central and blocked area that features a staircase leading to the cellar. Within the cellar, you will find a Boss: Mad Pumpkin Head.

After defeating the boss, Waypoint Ruins Cellar site of grace becomes accessible and the player can interact with Sorceress Sellen, starting her questline and giving you access to her shop. Completing her questline will reward you with a Sellian Sealbreaker, Sellen's Primal Glintstone, Eccentric's Hood, Eccentric's Armor, Eccentric's Manchettes, Eccentric's Breeches, Shard Spiral, Glintstone Kris, Witch's Glintstone Crown.
notes: Elden Ring Waypoint Ruins notes, tips and trivia goes here.

title: Talk to Sorceress Sellen, Nod In Thought
text: Grab the Waypoint Ruins Cellar grace and talk to Sellen. Answer "I want to learn sorcery", then "I still want to learn" to receive the Nod In Thought gesture.
Sorceress Sellen: Considered a witch and exiled member of the Raya Lucaria Academy, Sorceress Sellen sells Sorceries.

guide.title: Sorceress Sellen - A Damsel in Distress
text: If you are playing as a class that specializes in using Sorceries, then it's a must that you find Sorceress Sellen and free her! Her initial location is at the Waypoint Ruins, found in the eastern part of West Limgrave. When you arrive, you will encounter some Poison Flowers around the ruins and a Giant Poison Flower that is guarding the entrance to the crypt.

It's not that difficult to kill the Giant Poison Flower if you want to get rid of it, you just have to watch out for the poison it releases as well as a projectile attack where it conjures energy rays from your position. It can easily be avoided when you see a light that shines above you, just move away from it to avoid getting hit. This attack will not track your movement. Before you head down the crypt, make sure to grab the materials around here or make further preparations before going through the mist.

Behind the mist, you will have to fight the Mad Pumpkin Head, a mini-boss that is guarding the room where Sorceress Sellen is. The room where you'll be fighting is quite small and only has minimal space for you to be dodging. If you explore this section a bit early in the game, we suggest that you at least acquire the Spirit Calling Bell, as well as the Lone Wolf Ashes that are given by Renna, or at least, have a good shield like the Brass Shield that can drop from Godrick Soldiers at the Gatefront Ruins (you'll have to repeatedly kill the soldiers though until it finally drops from them). By having the Brass Shield, you can block 100% of its attack.

The Mad Pumpkin Head moves quite slow when it attacks, so patience and carefully watching its attacks to time your dodges right is key to winning this encounter. If you do have the Spirit Calling Bell, summon the Lone Wolf Ashes and attack the guardian when it is distracted or when you have a window. After defeating it, open the steel door and you'll find Sorceress Sellen in her study room, speak to her and accept being her student and you can gain access to her shop - don't forget to use the site of grace as well so that you can fast travel here later on.

title: Glintstone Staff
text: Kill the lone Noble Sorcerer on the hillside south of Waypoint Ruins, below the ruin, to obtain the Glintstone Staff (first time).

title: Great Epee
text: Loot 3x Golden Rune [1], Golden Rune [2], and a Golden Rune [3] from the nearby cemetery.
Golden Rune [2]: Found by looting the sarcophagi.
Head toward the camp on the slope just south of the cemetery. In front of a tent on the left side sits a chest containing the Great Epee.

Great Epee: Head southeast from the Agheel Lake South site of grace, head to the top of a cliff and you'll see a statue of an object that looks like the half piece of a bowl or a circle. Face the other way, and get down, you will find a group of enemies. The Great Epee is inside a chest. on the right side.

title: Royal House Scroll
text: Continue up the slope for a Golden Rune [1], then pick up the Royal House Scroll on top of the ruin next to it.

Royal House Scroll: Head southeast from the Agheel Lake South site of grace, head to the top of a cliff and you'll see a statue of an object that looks like the half piece of a bowl or a circle. Face the other way, to see a Knight. Keep going to a structure to see a man standing watching over the big structure, alongside a dead body. In that body, you will find the Royal House Scroll.

guide.title: Gain Access to New Sorceries
text: If you are playing as a Mage that focuses on Sorceries, then you might want to grab a scroll that you can give to Sorceress Sellen to gain access to more sorcery spells. Giving the Royal House Scroll unlocks the Glintblade Phalanx and Carian Slicer in her inventory. To find this scroll, head southeast from the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace, head to the top of a cliff and you'll see a statue of an object that looks like the half piece of a bowl or a circle. Face the other way, to see a Knight. Keep going to a structure to see a man standing watching over the big structure, alongside a dead body. In that body, you will find the Royal House Scroll - once you have it, fast travel to the Waypoint Ruins site and give the scroll to Sorceress Sellen.

title: Larval Tear
text: An astrolabe with Starlight Shards sits at the edge of a small cliff south-southeast of the ruin.
Starlight Shards: Starlight Shards : Do a Spiritspring Jumping, and keep jumping until you reach the top.You will find the item over a cup-like monument, on the edge.
On a lower ledge, west-southwest of the astrolabe, is a gibbet with a Golden Rune [1] next to it.
Drop onto the road and follow it northwest while hugging the right wall to a slope. Kill the lone enemy on the slope and he'll turn into a Runebear that drops a Larval Tear.
Larval Tear: Key item used for Rebirth. Obtained by defeating a regular Noble enemy, that transforms into a Lesser Rune Bear. If you kill the Bear form a larval tear will drop.

title: Ash of War: Stamp
text: Optional: Talk to Yura under the ruin just west of the slope.
Travel to The First Step and head west-northwest toward the beach. Down the slope with a Troll, you'll find an invisible scarab that drops Ash of War: Stamp (Sweep).

Ash of War: Stamp: Ash of War Upgrade. Found by defeating an invisible Teardrop Scarab roaming around the beach. You will see glowing footprints appearing in a set pattern around the area. Stand in front of its path and attack as it approaches you to reveal the creature.

guide.title: Finding the Invisible Scarab
text: From the Groveside Cave, travel west until you reach a beach. Look to the right and you'll see some rock formations, you'll notice that there is a trail of glowing lights that are circling the rocks. This is an invisible Scarab; all you have to do is stand directly in its path and strike at the moment it approaches you. Killing it rewards you with x1 Ash of War: Stamp (Sweep). From here, you can travel southwest to clear out the Coastal Cave.

title: Talk to Nomadic Merchant West Limgrave
text: Pick up the Strip of White Flesh next to a campfire at the north end of the beach.
Strip of White Flesh: Found on a dead body, sitting across a Soldier.
Follow the shoreline to a corpse with Land Octopus Ovary beside a fallen tree.
Land Octopus Ovary: Defeat Land Octopus to obtain.
Continue along the shoreline to find the Nomadic Merchant (West Limgrave) under a ruin.
Nomadic Merchant West Limgrave: General Goods vendor found southeast of the Coastal Cave entrance along the beach, sitting by a fire under a collapsed stone structure.

guide.title: Clear out the Coastal Cave
text: If you were following the walkthrough, you should have the Torch that you can buy from Merchant Kale. You will need the Torch here since this cave is dark inside. If you haven't purchased the item, fast travel back to the Church of Elleh site. Similar to the Groveside Cave, this is a small area to explore and also has an optional boss.

You'll find a few things here when you reach the bonfire past the cave's entrance. First, is the Coastal Cave Site of Grace, a Martyr's Effigy, and Boc ONLY IF YOU WERE ABLE TO FIND HIM AT HIS INITIAL LOCATION. You will find him writhing in pain on the ground right next to the Site of Grace, speak to him and he'll ask you to leave the place, but this area serves as a side quest for Boc where you need to acquire an item and give it to him. Make sure to examine/rest at the site of grace before you continue forward.

As mentioned, the cave is dark, so you'll need the Torch as your main source of light. When you drop down into the pit, you'll encounter a couple of Demi-Human enemies. You are outnumbered here, so you can die if you are not careful. Kill all the Demi-Human enemies and loot their bodies to find items such as the Rickety Shield, Rainbow Stone, and x1 Land Octopus Ovary that is looted off a nearby body, next to the entrance of the boss lair. Now before going in, there is a Gold Summon Sign by the entrance that you can use to summon a companion NPC that can help you fight against the boss.

Upon entering, you'll be fighting against two Demi-Human Chief, along with its minions, the Demi-Humans. You can check our Demi-Human Chief page to find our guide on how to beat this enemy. Successfully defeating both Demi-Human Chief enemies rewards you with x1 Tailoring Tools, x1 Sewing Needle, and 900 Runes. Before leaving the lair, make sure to grab the Silver Fireflies, and near the portal mist, there's a path leading to another exit where you can loot x1 Smoldering Butterfly and x1 String from two corpses that are being guarded by two more Demi-Human enemies.

Continue out the exit from the boss lair and activate the Church of Dragon Communion Site of Grace so you can easily fast travel here later on. At the moment, you won't be able to commune via the altar since you will need an item to use it. However, you can find a Teardrop Scarab here. Walk to the cliffside on the south side of the island to find a scarab. Kill it to acquire x1 Somber Smithing Stone (1). Apart from that, you can find some Herba, Rowa Fruit, Mushroom here and there are Guillemot around that you can kill to acquire some materials such as a Flight Pinion or a Four-Toed Fowl Foot.

Exit the cave and go west where you'll find the Nomadic Merchant West Limgrave. Next to the merchant, you can pick up x1 Smoldering Butterfly. Speak to the merchant to check his wares and if you have enough Runes, make sure to buy some of the useful items such as the Armorer's Cookbook [2] and notes.

title: Boss: Demi-Human Chief, Sewing Needle
text: Near the waterfall at the end of the beach is a Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot.
Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot: Near the waterfall, beware of the lurking skeletons
Head back along the beach while hugging the cliff to discover the entrance to Coastal Cave:
Grab the Coastal Cave grace, then talk to Boc next to it.
The only item in this cave is a Land Octopus Ovary just outside the boss room.
Kill the two Demi-Human Chiefs for Tailoring Tools, Sewing Needle and 1,200 runes.

Demi-Human Chief: Optional Boss. A duo of Demi-Human bosses found deep within the Coastal Cave . Required to defeat in order to access the Church of Dragon Communion location. Drops the Tailoring Tools and Sewing Needle key items upon defeat.
Tailoring Tools: Key Item. Dropped by the Demi-Human Chief boss upon defeat.
Sewing Needle: Key Quest Item. Dropped by the Demi-Human Chief boss upon defeat. Return it to Boc the Seamster in the Coastal Cave to further his storyline.
Optional: Old Knight Istvan's summon sign can be found just outside the room.
A corpse with Smoldering Butterfly lies in the tunnel past the boss.
Continue through the tunnel to emerge on a small island, then head uphill and grab the Church of Dragon Communion grace.
Optional: Examine the altar in the church and buy any dragon communion incantations you need.
Climb the slanted ruin next to the church to find Exalted Flesh at the top.
Exalted Flesh: Can be found at the top of the ruins.
Northwest of the ruin, next to some trees at the edge, lies a corpse with Great Dragonfly Head x4.
Follow the cliff edge south-southeast to a scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [1].
Somber Smithing Stone [1]: You can find a few in Morne Tunnel .
Continue along the edge to find a Smithing Stone [2].
Return to Boc in Coastal Cave and give him the sewing needle.

place.title: Coastal Cave
walk: If you were following the walkthrough, you should have the Torch that you can buy from Merchant Kale. You will need the Torch here since this cave is dark inside. If you haven't purchased the item, fast travel back to the Church of Elleh site. Similar to the Groveside Cave, this is a small area to explore and also has an optional boss Map Coordinates for Coastal Cave.

You'll find a few things here when you reach the bonfire past the cave's entrance. First, is the Coastal Cave Site of Grace, a Martyr's Effigy, and Boc (only if you found him at his first location). You will find him writhing in pain on the ground right next to the Site of Grace, speak to him and he'll ask you to leave the place, but, this area serves as a side quest for Boc where you need to acquire an item and give it to him. Make sure to examine/rest at the site of grace before you continue forward.

As mentioned, the cave is dark, so you'll need the Torch as your main source of light. When you drop down into the pit, you'll encounter a couple of Demi-Human enemies. You are outnumbered here, so you can die if you are not careful. Kill all the Demi-Human enemies and loot their bodies to find items such as the Rickety Shield, Rainbow Stone, and x1 Land Octopus Ovary that is looted off a nearby body, next to the entrance of the boss lair. Now before going in, there is a Gold Summon Sign by the entrance that you can use to summon a companion NPC that can help you fight against the boss.

Upon entering, you'll be fighting against two Demi-Human Chief, along with its minions, the Demi-Humans. You can check our Demi-Human Chief page to find our guide on how to beat this enemy. Successfully defeating both Demi-Human Chief enemies rewards you with x1 Tailoring Tools, x1 Sewing Needle, and 900 Runes. Before leaving the lair, make sure to grab the Silver Fireflies, and near the portal mist, there's a path leading to another exit where you can loot x1 Smoldering Butterfly and x1 String from two corpses that are being guarded by two more Demi-Human enemies.

You can fast travel back to the entrance and give Boc the Sewing Needle by speaking to him. You've now cleared the Coastal Cave, before you continue to leave the Coastal Cave, we suggest that you check out the opposite exit from the boss lair and activate the Church of Dragon Communion Site of Grace so you can easily fast travel here later on.

Upon exiting the cave and go east where you'll find the Nomadic Merchant West Limgrave Map Coordinates Here. Next to the merchant, you can pick up x1 Smoldering Butterfly. Speak to the merchant to check his wares and if you have enough Runes, make sure to buy some of the useful items such as the Armorer's Cookbook [2] and notes.
notes: This cave was previously known as the Dissenter's Cave in the Elden Ring Network Test.

guide.title: Church of Dragon Communion
text: You can only access this region by passing through and completing the boss room in Coastal Cave in western Limgrave. There is not much to do at the Church of Dragon's communion, at least until players have faced and defeated Flying Dragon Agheel. Once you have done so, bring the Dragon Heart to this island, and present it at the church's altar at night, to purchase one of three dragon-related Incantations. Dragonclaw, Dragonfire or Dragonmaw.

You've now cleared the Coastal Cave, before you continue to leave the Coastal Cave, we suggest that you check out the opposite exit from the boss lair and activate the Church of Dragon Communion Site of Grace so you can easily fast travel here later on. At the moment, you won't be able to commune via the altar since you will need an item to use it. However, you can find a Teardrop Scarab here, walk to the cliffside, southwest, and you'll see the scarab. Kill it to acquire x1 Somber Smithing Stone (1) To obtain Smithing Stone (2) loot the remains towards the southeast corner of the isalnd.Apart from that, you can find some Herba, Rowa Fruit, Mushroom here and there are Guillemot around that you can kill to acquire some materials such as a Flight Pinion or a Four-Toed Fowl Foot.

And lastly, if you go around the church, somewhere around the northwest, you'll encounter two Spirit Jellyfish enemies. Kill it, and then use your mount to jump to the top of the ruined walls of the church. At the top, you'll find a corpse that you can loot to find x1 Exalted Flesh. Back on the ground, there's also another corpse by the bushes that you can loot to find x4 Great Dragonfly Head. You've now cleared the area, for now, go ahead and fast travel back to the Coastal Cave site.

title: Talk to Boc the Seamster
text: Boc the Seamster: Boc the Seamster Location 2. After meeting him for the first time, Boc will move into the Coastal Cave . You will find him writhing on the ground next to the Site of Grace.

title: Boss: Tree Sentinel (Limgrave)
text: Travel to The First Step and kill the Tree Sentinel for Golden Halberd and 3,200 runes.
Golden Halberd: Drops from Tree Sentinel
Tree Sentinel: Field Boss roaming the area. Drops Golden Halberd

guide.title: Optional Field Boss: Tree Sentinel
text: At this point, you should be able to upgrade your main weapon to at least +1 and you should be comfortable in the combat mechanics of your character. You can return to either The First Step or Church of Elleh Sites of Grace and find the Tree Sentinel field enemy/boss. You can find this champion roaming around on his mount between the Church of Elleh and the First Step checkpoint. Since you also have your mount, you can use the Spectral Steed Whistle to summon torrent and fight while mounted. Successfully defeating this field enemy/boss rewards you with Runes and drops the Golden Halberd weapon.

title: Talk to White-Faced Varre
text: White-Faced Varre: White-Faced Varre , Location 1. Found right next to The First Step Site of Grace . Provides Lore info. You will encounter this NPC multiple times in different locations.

title: Prattling Pate
text: At the base of the cliff northwest of the Church of Elleh lies the entrance to Stormfoot Catacombs:
Head inside and activate the Stormfoot Catacombs grace.
Pick up Root Resin x2 from the room straight ahead.
Take the other path to a Grave Glovewort [1] in the boss door room.

Grave Glovewort [1]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. The first one is found by a sarcophagus in the room with the boss door. The second one is found in the next room, behind a pillar near the entrance to the narrow corridor. The third is found after climbing the ladder in the hallway where the second flamethrower pillar is. The fourth is found in a room west of where you got the third one. The final one is found to the left of the boss' door's lever.
Behind an unlit brazier in the next room is a Grave Glovewort [1].
Head past the first fire-breathing pillar and attack it to deactivate it, or just use Margit's Shackle if you have it. Pick up Prattling Pate "Hello" behind the pillar.
Prattling Pate: Can be found in Stormfoot Catacombs on a corpse behind the first pillar that exudes fire.

place.title: Stormfoot Catacombs
walk: The Stormfoot Catacombs is a dungeon crypt, it is inhabited by Fanged Imps. It is due West and north from Church of Elleh, Map Coordinates Here. Upon arriving, open the doors leading to the catacombs and you'll find the Site of Grace for this location below. As always, make sure to discover or rest here to make it your last checkpoint. At the bottom of the steps, you'll find a Commoner ghost sitting in a chair that you can talk to. At the first intersection, you'll see a dead-end ahead and a path that goes further in the crypt on the right. The path ahead is where 2 Fanged Imps will ambush you, one is hiding by the corner on the left, while the other is by the corpse behind the chair in the center. - kill the Fanged Imps and loot the corpse to find x2 Root Resin.

Head down the steps and you'll see another path on the left side, a door that is in the middle of two statues, x1 Grave Glovewort [1] next to a stone coffin and on the left side of the statue is a summoning pool that you can activate. This door is locked at the moment and you will need to find the mechanism that will unlock this. Continue heading down the stairs at the north side of the crypt where you'll see more Fanged Imps that are above, you can kill them with magical ranged attacks from afar while they are unaware of your presence. In this room, you can find items such as x1 Grave Violet and another Grave Glovewort [1].

Continue forward through the narrow path, but as you reach the other end, walk carefully since you'll see a flamethrower mechanism ahead will begin to project a jet of fire. Wait by the corner and when it stops projecting the flames, quickly sprint straightforward and turn right before it projects the flames again. When it stops, go back and sprint forward. Behind this mechanism, there is a corpse that you can pillage to find x1 Prattling Pate Hello. Before you go back to the next path that has another flamethrower, you can hit the back of the mechanism to deactivate it.

Now for the next, do the same thing, sprint forward, take cover by the corner on the right, and when it stops, sprint towards it and hit the back of the mechanism to disable it. The area where this second flamethrower is, is being guarded by a couple of Fanged Imps that are on the wall, and two by each corner. Kill the enemies, loot the body to find x3 Smoldering Butterfly and grab the Ghost Glovewort [1] - next, go back to the corner where you took cover and climb the ladder.

At the top of the ladder, tread carefully since there is a Fanged Imp hiding by the corner on the left, while another which you can see ahead of you. By the corner where the Fanged Imp was, there's another Grave Glovewort [1] that you can get. Continue forward towards another dead-end room that is being guarded by two Fanged Imps, one ahead, and the other, hiding by the corner on the right, ready to ambush you. Kill both enemies and loot the body resting against a stone coffin on the left to find x1 Wandering Noble Ashes, as well as picking up another Grave Glovewort [1] at the center of this room. Retrace your steps and jump down onto the platform below you, where you'll find another Grave Glovewort [1] and the lever by the grim reaper statue at the center that will unlock the locked door - from here, you may want to rest at the site of grace first before passing through the gold mist door that leads to the boss of this location.

Beyond the mist lies the Erdtree Burial Watchdog enemy, you can visit our Erdtree Burial Watchdog page to find our guide on how to beat this enemy/boss. Succesfully defeating it rewards the player with x1 Noble Sorcerer Ashes and 1300 Runes. You've completed this area, and you can use the portal mist by the roots to fast travel back to the crypt's entrance.

title: Wandering Noble Ashes
text: Go past the second pillar and loot the Smoldering Butterfly x3 and Ghost Glovewort [1] behind it, guarded by several Imps.
Ghost Glovewort [1]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Found behind the second flamethrower pillar.
Climb the ladder in the corridor to a Grave Glovewort [1] immediately to the left.
In the room at the end, you'll find a Grave Glovewort [1] and Wandering Noble Ashes.

Wandering Noble Ashes: Located on a corpse that is resting against a stone coffin in the Stormfoot Catacombs in Limgrave. Proceed through the catacombs as normal until reaching a ladder that is going up, once you've reached the top continue forward past some Jade Goblins until reaching a dead end room that is being guarded by two Jade Goblins, the corpse resting against the stone coffin will hold the ashes

guide.title: Complete the Stormfoot Catacombs
text: The Stormfoot Catacombs is a dungeon crypt, it is inhabited by Fanged Imps. It is due West and north of Church of Elleh,. Upon arriving, open the doors leading to the catacombs and you'll find the Site of Grace for this location below. As always, make sure to discover or rest here to make it your last checkpoint. At the bottom of the steps, you'll find a Commoner ghost sitting in a chair that you can talk to. At the first intersection, you'll see a dead-end ahead and a path that goes further in the crypt on the right. The path ahead is where 2 Fanged Imps will ambush you, one is hiding by the corner on the left, while the other is by the corpse behind the chair in the center. - kill the goblins and loot the corpse to find x2 Root Resin.

Head down the steps and you'll see another path on the left side, a door that is in the middle of two statues, x1 Grave Glovewort [1] next to a stone coffin, and on the left side of the statue is a summoning pool that you can activate. This door is locked at the moment, and you will need to find the mechanism that will unlock this. Continue heading down the stairs at the north side of the crypt where you'll see more Fanged Imps that are above, you can kill them with magical ranged attacks from afar while they are unaware of your presence. In this room, you can find items such as x1 Grave Violet and another Grave Glovewort [1].

Continue forward through the narrow path, but as you reach the other end, walk carefully since you'll see a flamethrower mechanism ahead that will begin to project a jet of fire. The fire is coming from a stone pillar that can rise and fall. If you have a bow and arrow you can aim down the hallway to hit the pillar when the fire stops, making the pillar descend into the floor and the flames stop. These pillars will reappear in multiple catacombs in the game, so if you can hit them before passing through the fiery areas it will make your travels safer. You can also hit the pillars by activating Mohg's Shackle or Margit's Shackle, or if a pillar is already descended into the ground you can raise it up by jumping on top of it.

If you don't have an arrow, wait by the corner and as soon as it stops projecting the flames, quickly sprint straight and turn right before it projects the flames again. When it stops, go back and sprint forward towards the source of the flames. Behind the pillar, there is a corpse that you can pillage to find x1 Prattling Pate Hello. Before you go back to the next path that has another flamethrower, you can hit the back of the mechanism to deactivate it.

Now for the next set of flames, do the same thing, sprint forward, take cover by the corner on the right, and when it stops, sprint towards the source of the flames and hit the back of the mechanism to disable it. Behind the second flamethrower, the area is being guarded by a few Fanged Imps that are on the walls, and two by each corner. You do not have to kill these enemies, but if you do you get a couple items. Instead of running straight into the group, try to lure one imp out at a time by throwing projectiles or spells. Fighting one will be a lot easier than taking on the whole group. After you kill the enemies, loot the body to find x3 Smoldering Butterfly, and grab the Ghost Glovewort [1]. Next, go back to the corner where you took cover and climb the ladder.

At the top of the ladder, tread carefully since there is a Fanged Imp that is hiding by the corner on the left that while ambush you as you walk forward, while there is another you can see ahead of you. By the corner where the Fanged Imp was, there's another Grave Glovewort [1] that you can get. Continue forward towards another dead-end room that is being guarded by two Fanged Imps, one ahead, and the other, hiding by the corner on the right, ready to ambush you. Kill both enemies and loot the body resting against a stone coffin on the left to find x1 Wandering Noble Ashes, as well as picking up another Grave Glovewort [1] at the center of this room. Retrace your steps and jump down onto the platform you see below you (on the right side, looking down), where you'll find another Grave Glovewort [1] and the lever by the grim reaper statue at the center that will unlock the large, locked door you saw earlier. From here, jump down and run back to the beginning of the catacombs. You may want to rest at the site of grace near the opening of the catacombs before passing through the gold mist door that leads to the boss of this location. That will refill your HP, FP, and flasks, but it will also regenerate the enemies in the catacombs, so be careful as you head to the boss door.

Beyond the mist lies the Erdtree Burial Watchdog enemy. You can visit our Erdtree Burial Watchdog page to find our guide on how to beat this enemy/boss. Successfully defeating it rewards the player with x1 Noble Sorcerer Ashes and 1300 Runes. You've completed this area, and you can use the portal mist by the roots to fast travel back to the crypt's entrance.

title: Boss: Erdtree Burial Watchdog (Stormfoot Catacombs)
text: Drop to the ledge outside the room for a Grave Glovewort [1] and the boss lever.
Kill the Erdtree Burial Watchdog for Noble Sorcerer Ashes and 1,300 runes.
Noble Sorcerer Ashes: Dropped by the Erdtree Burial Watchdog inside the Stormfoot Catacombs .
Erdtree Burial Watchdog: Optional Boss found at the end of Stormfoot Catacombs . Drops Noble Sorcerer Ashes upon defeat.

title: Godrick Soldier Ashes
text: Travel to Stormhill Shack and head south-southwest to a cliff wall, then follow it to a slope near the edge. A Smithing Stone [1] is in the graveyard up the slope.
Smithing Stone [1] A: A Smithing Stone found on top of a corpse that lays on the ground. Found together with 3 other dead bodies and a rounded group of chairs.
Continue east-southeast to find another graveyard, but with Magic Grease x3, Godrick Soldier Ashes, and Bloodrose x3 (next to a gibbet).
Godrick Soldier Ashes: Found at the Cemetery at the west of Stormhill that is filled with Spirit Jellyfish, next to a grave. Check both sides of each grave to find it.
Magic Grease: Can be found inside Stormveil Castle, on a corpse laying in the courtyard.

guide.title: The Woman in the Red Hood
text: ## Things you Should do in Stormhill
Elden Ring Main Quest Guide - Stormhill Points of Interest
Speak to some early NPCs.
Acquire some Important Items.
Complete Castle Morne, as well as the Father-Daughter's questline.
Fight Margit the Fell Omen and Receive an invitation to the Roundtable Hold.
## The Woman in the Red Hood

The first thing we would like to point out is when you are about to go through Stormgate. It is heavily guarded by Godrick Soldiers, Foot Soldiers, as well as Troll that will try to block your path as soon as you march in. There are two ways for you to tackle this, (1) simply pass through the enemies on Mount, at this point, you should have the Spectral Steed Whistle to summon Torrent, it will be a challenge for you if you try to go on foot, the Troll will eventually catch up to you and you'll be outnumbered by the soldiers, they will also shoot you with their crossbow, so, that's quite a lot to handle. (2) You can take them out one at a time, fight the Troll enemy first, then kill the Soldiers that you see, you'll at least be rewarded with Runes, and you have the time to gather the materials and some loot here.

When you pass the fortified gate, you'll formally enter Stormhill. At the top, you'll immediately see an illusory tree. Make sure to check it to find a Golden Seed on the ground. The Golden Seed in Elden Ring is a very important upgrade item, it allows the user to upgrade the number of Crimson and Cerulean Flask Uses, but not the amount of Wondrous Physick flasks available. Continue following the path and a pack of wolves will appear, take them out, continue forward and you will find the Stormhill Shack. Make sure to discover the Site of Grace here.

Check the destroyed shack and you'll find a woman wearing a red hood, she won't introduce herself at first, but this NPC is Roderika, a vital character who is responsible for upgrading your Spirit Ashes if you complete her questline. Speak to her and exhaust her lines to (1) acquire the Spirit Jellyfish Ashes and (2) she will mention some clues about her questline, this simply requires you to find a key item, and you will need to give it to her - there's also a Stonesword Key that you can grab here.

Now, if you want to find another Spirit Ash item, from the shack, go southwest, you'll find a cemetery that is inhabited by multiple Spirit Jellyfish enemies, as well as some Skeletons that will come out from the ground. You can find the Godrick Soldier Ashes here.

title: Crossed Legs, Crossed Legs Gesture
text: At the cliff edge south of the second graveyard, you'll find an astrolabe with Starlight Shards.
On top of the nearby ruin is a corpse with the Crossed Legs gesture.
Crossed Legs Gesture: Gesture. Obtained by interacting with a corpse on a large piece of debris, South of Stormhill Shack .

title: Boss: Crucible Knight
text: Kill the Crucible Knight in the evergaol east of the ruin for Aspects of the Crucible: Tail and 2,100 runes.
Crucible Knight: Found within Stormhill Evergaol, this is a solo fight without Spirit Ashes or player summons. Drops the Incantation Aspects of the Crucible: Tail
Aspects of the Crucible: Tail: Incantation. Dropped by the Crucible Knight boss in Stormhill Evergaol.

place.title: Stormhill Evergaol
walk: Stormhill Evergoals is made up of large round arena where you will face the Crucible Knight. Players will still have the option to enter the Evergaol or not. If you do choose to enter, players will face the Crucible Knight. Defeating him drops 2100 Runes and Aspects of the Crucible: Tail. For Combat Strategy and tips against The Crucible Knight, click here.

title: Arrow's Reach Talisman
text: Enter the gate just northeast of the evergoal for a chest containing the Arrow's Reach Talisman.
Arrow's Reach Talisman: Found in a chest inside the Tower above Stormgate that can be accessed going all around it.

place.title: Stormgate
walk: The entrance of Stormgate can be found on the north side of Gatefront Ruins in Limgrave. There is a Site of Grace by the entrance, don't forget to activate it as your checkpoint in case you die. Right off the bat, as you walk up the slope, you'll hear a loud roar and a Troll will appear, you'll also notice a multiple guards on each corner, as well as barricades along the path. The Storgmate is a guarded narrow path that leads to the Stormhill region. If you want to avoid any combat here (which is possible), you can do so by horseback riding. Just make sure you have the Spectral Steed Whistle item before you rush through the barricades and the enemies. There should also be a chariot in the area leading out of Gatefront Ruins where you can open the chest and obtain a Lordsworn's Greatsword.

title: Invader: Recusant Henricus, Hammer Talisman
text: Return to the evergaol, then head north toward the cliff edge and drop onto the ruin with a Troll. Pick up the Golden Rune [2] hanging off its edge.
Golden Rune [2]: Found in a dead body at the ruins past the Stormgate.
Travel to Warmaster's Shack and follow the path north-northwest of the grace until you get invaded by Recusant Henricus. Kill him for the Hammer Talisman.
Recusant Henricus: Hostile invader equipping a mace and wearing full body armor.
Hammer Talisman: Enhances stamina-reducing attacks against blockers.
miss: You must kill Henricus before joining the Volcano Manor.

title: Talk to Frustrated Spirit
text: Frustrated Spirit: Laying down on the floor, next to the remains of a burnt pillage.

title: Small Red Effigy, Duelist's Furled Finger
text: Pick up Small Red Effigy and Duelist's Furled Finger from the corpse in front of the colosseum.
Small Red Effigy: Sends competitive sign to summoning pool.
Duelist's Furled Finger: Creates competitive multiplayer summon sign.

title: Ash of War: Golden Vow
text: Optional: Enter the colosseum to access it from the Marika statue in Roundtable Hold.
Go around the ledge of the farthest bridge pillar east of the colosseum to find Soporific Grease x3.
Jump back onto the cliff and head toward the ruin south-southwest. Kill the mounted Godrick Knight near it to receive Ash of War: Golden Vow.
Ash of War: Golden Vow: Ash of War: Golden Vow provides Sacred affinity and the Golden Vow Skill. Dropped upon defeating Mounted Knight.

title: Lance
text: Kill the scarab on top of the ruin to obtain a Somber Smithing Stone [1].
Somber Smithing Stone [1]: As a drop when defeating a Teardrop Scarab at the top of a ruined building.
Below the cliff edge south of the ruin with the scarab is another ruin. Jump onto it and grab the Lance hanging off its edge.
Lance: On top of the big square structure to the west of Deathtouched Catacombs . Jump off the nearby cliff to reach the top.

title: Uchigatana
text: Drop to the camp below and head northeast, this time going up the left ledge to find the entrance to Deathtouched Catacombs on your left:
Head inside and activate the Deathtouched Catacombs grace.
Pick up the 2x Grave Glovewort [1] in the first room.

Grave Glovewort [1]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. The first one is located in the first large room left of the boss' door, right in front of the stairs. The second one is an alcove under the stairs in the same room. The third is found by going through the very narrow corridor adjacent to the stairs in the same room. The fourth one is found by going through the doorway south of where you collected the previous one, sitting on an L-shaped ledge. The fifth one is found by dropping down from where you collected the fourth.
Go through the narrow passageway beside the staircase for a Grave Glovewort [1].
Take the other passageway to a ledge with Uchigatana and a Grave Glovewort [1].
Uchigatana: Found inside the Deathtouched Catacombs. It is in a body, hanging from the upper platform. You need to use the lever in order to reach that room. Beware of the Skeleton Archers.

title: Boss: Black Knife Assassin
text: Pick up the Grave Glovewort [1] in the room below.
Pull the boss lever in the final room, then turn around for a corpse with Bloodrose x3.
Bloodrose: Can be found inside the Deathtouched Catacombs . On a body, against a wall, past a big hall with many Skeletons .
Kill the injured Black Knife Assassin for Assassin's Crimson Dagger and 1,600 runes.
Assassin's Crimson Dagger: Dropped by Black Knife Assassin , found inside Deathtouched Catacombs.
Black Knife Assassin: Field Boss. Can be found inside the Deathtouched Catacombs. Drops Assassin's Crimson Dagger .

place.title: Deathtouched Catacombs
walk: At the entrance of the catacombs, you will find a tormented spirit. Open the wooden door, and enter. There is a Site of Grace immediately after. Head down and turn to the left, prepare to fight some Skeletons. Some are melee combatants, while others are ranged ones. Remember that skeletons need to be “killed again” once they are down to be put to rest, if not, they will keep returning to life. You will find 2 Grave Glovewort (1) in the first big room.

Keep moving further down, there are more skeletons in the next room. Beware of the Ranged ones that are on the platform as you turn around., get to safety quickly. There is a Grave Glovewort (1) to the right side of the room.

There is a body against a wall that contains Bloodrose in the next room. Also in that room, you will find a statue with a lever, activate it. Retrace your steps, and as you reach the stairs when you fought the first skeletons. Drop down and enter a narrow corridor, now open. More skeletons await, as well as Grave Violet and Grave Glovewort (1). Kill them and take the left exit, you will reach the elevated platform from where the ranged skeletons were shooting you previously. Deal with them. At the end of the platform you will find another Grave Glovewort (1) and a Uchigatana on a hanging body.

Get back to the beginning of the Catacombs, to the room after the Site of Grace. You will notice that the big door is now open. Enter to fight the Black Knife Assassin. Once you have dealt with her, you will obtain an Assassin's Crimson Dagger and the dungeon will be completed. Before leaving, don't forget to loot the chest to obtain a Deathroot.

title: Deathroot
text: Open the chest in the boss room to obtain a Deathroot.
Deathroot: Inside Deathtouched Catacombs. Found on a chest behind the Black Knife Assassin.

title: Lance Talisman
text: Exit the catacombs and head north-northeast toward a field of Golem remains. Pick up the Lance Talisman on the remains of a Golem near the cliff.
Lance Talisman: Found at the north of Limgrave past the main road close to the edge.

title: Shamshir
text: Head south toward some gibbets near the edge for a Golden Rune [3] beneath one of them.

Travel to Saintsbridge and jump down the gap to the right of the bridge while on horseback, landing near the spiritspring. Then, head up north and drop down near the cliff to find a campsite with Turtle Neck Meat.
Turtle Neck Meat: Crafting Material. Looted from a corpse at an abandoned campsite in Altus Plateau .
In the cliff just below the campsite lies the entrance to Highroad Cave:
Head inside and activate the Highroad Cave grace.
After dropping down once, go through the northeast tunnel for a Golden Rune [1] guarded by some wolves.
Drop down the hole in the middle, follow the downward path to some wolves, then take the left path up to a ledge with Arteria Leaf.
Arteria Leaf: Two can be looted off a corpse that is being eaten by two Misbegotten enemies in Morne Tunnel .
Below the ledge lies a corpse with Fire Grease x2.
When the cave opens up, drop down at the end of a ledge, then turn around to find Smithing Stone [1] x3.
Smithing Stone [1]: Smithing Stone (1) Upgrade Material can be found within Highroad Cave
Follow the tunnel at the top of the waterfall to a Smithing Stone [2], then a Golden Rune [4] farther in.
Smithing Stone [2]: Smithing Stone (2) Upgrade Material can be found within Highroad Cave
Golden Rune [4]: One can be looted off a corpse inside the small shack in Morne Tunnel .
Drop down the waterfall and cross the pillar in the water to pick up Shamshir next to some bats.
Shamshir: Found inside the Highroad Cave, on a platform after the waterfall section, being feasted on by Giant Bats.

place.title: Highroad Cave
walk: It is recommended to enter this cave with a Torch. Drop down into the lower platform and continue dropping to each lower platform. You'lll move through a short tunnel that will lead to another small area with a hole. There is a Golden Rune (1) in a side cave here. Drop down to the next platforms to get to the lower levels.

Once you reach the bottom, take the lower route. The upper path will lead to a dead end. the lower will contain some wolves. Roll through the barrels to the left and continue to find a corpse with Arteria Leaves x3. If you loot them, there will be a wolf behind you. Drop down to find more wolves and Fire Grease.

You'll eventually reach an opening and a waterfall. Expect an encounter with Giant Bats. There is a Smithing Stone (1) behind you after you have dropped for the first time. there is a cave upstream from the waterfall too with more bats and Land Octopus. You will come across Smithing Stone (2) and Golden Rune (4).

Head back out towards and drop down along the waterfall, no jumping required. Hop onto the platform with the fallen pillar and take it across to the next platform. Take out the bats and on this platform you can loot a Shamshir. Continue to your left and you will face a Giant Land Octopus and there is a Furlcalling Finger Remedy on a ledge further down the tunnels. Hop off into the bigger waterfall and go through. You are now on the right side of the cave from the central platform with the Shamshir. Drop down behind the waterfall to proceed to the boss encounter. Defeating the Guardian Golem will drop the Blue Dancer Charm. Map Link.

title: Furlcalling Finger Remedy
text: Continue across and through a tunnel until you reach the Furlcalling Finger Remedy hanging off a ledge.
Furlcalling Finger Remedy: Furlcalling Finger Remedy can be dropped in Highroad Cave

title: Boss: Guardian Golem
text: Go through the tunnel under a waterfall and kill the Guardian Golem for Blue Dancer Charm and 1,700 runes.
Guardian Golem: Found within the Highroad Cave . Drops Blue Dancer Charm
Blue Dancer Charm: Dropped by the Guardian Golem within Highroad Cave

title: Bone Peddler's Bell Bearing +1
text: Travel to Warmaster's Shack, pass time until nightfall, and kill the Bell Bearing Hunter in the shack for Bone Peddler's Bell Bearing and 2,700 runes.
Bone Peddler's Bell Bearing: Bell Bearing. Dropped by the Bell Bearing Hunter that invades the War Master's Shack at night.

Bell Bearing Hunter: Field Boss. Invades the Warmaster's Shack , but only at night time, replacing Knight Bernahl . You have to travel here from another site of grace to trigger it. Drops Bone Peddler's Bell Bearing upon defeat.

title: Boss: Deathbird (Stormhill)
text: While it's still night, kill the Deathbird on the flat ruin east of Warmaster's Shack for Blue-Feathered Branchsword and 2,800 runes.
Blue-Feathered Branchsword: Talisman. Dropped from miniboss that only spawns at night: Deathbird (Stormhill)
Deathbird: Appears only at night. East of Warmaster's Shack just over the cliff. It drops the Blue-Feathered Branchsword

title: Skeletal Militiaman Ashes
text: Travel to Summonwater Village Outskirts and kill the Tibia Mariner in the village for Deathroot, Skeletal Militiaman Ashes and 2,400 runes.
Skeletal Militiaman Ashes: Spirit Ashes. Obtained when defeating the Tibia Mariner in Summonwater Village .

title: Boss: Tibia Mariner (Wyndham Ruins)
text: Travel to Summonwater Village Outskirts and kill the Tibia Mariner in the village for Deathroot, Skeletal Militiaman Ashes and 2,400 runes.
Tibia Mariner: Found in the waterlogged section of Wyndham Ruins. Drops A Deathroot and Tibia's Summons
Tibia's Summons: Drops from the Tibia Mariner at Wyndham Ruins .
Deathroot: Dropped by the Tibia Mariner Boss.

guide.title: The Wyndham Ruins & Catacombs
text: ## Mt. Gelmir
Elden Ring Main Quest Guide - Mt. Gelmir Points of Interest
Complete Wyndham Ruins
Complete Wyndham Catacombs
Travel to Fort Laeidd
Defeat the Magma Wyrm
Explore Gelmir Hero's Grave
Travel to the Volcano Manor
## The Wyndham Ruins & Catacombs

Elden Ring Map: Mt. Gelmir Starting Point. We'll complete a couple of locations that are technically Altus Plains to make it easier to understand progress. From the Erdtree-Gazing Hill site of grace, go straight north and up to arrive at Wyndham Ruins and Wyndham Catacombs. There's a Tibia Mariner at the Wyndham Ruins to defeat and earn a Deathroot as well as Tibia's Summons spell.

Wyndham Catacombs is just near the ruins on the northwest side of the map from the ruins. Leaving the Wyndham Catacombs Site of Grace the only room at the top of the catacombs is the locked door with the 2 statues, locked by some contraption. Moving past this door is a room with an elevator, beware of the trap button between the rooms as this will fire a row of 3 lightning shots 3 times. The elevator is a simple platform with a button that players can step on to get the elevator to move. At the top and bottom of the elevator shaft are levers that will call the elevator to the player when needed.

While in the sewer area players can see an area locked behind a rusted gate. To reach this area players have to get underneath the platform in the spike ceiling room. Get the platform to rise at the entrance then walk off and jump down underneath while the platform is moving. From this area, a tunnel will lead you to the locked sewer area where multiple skeletons are seen. When you walk to the end of the room where the 2 bodies to loot are, 2 Giant Crabs will rise from below. The tunnel you enter from is too small for them to fit so kiting them there can help make for an easier fight. Once the Giant Crabs are dead you can loot the Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook (1) from one of the bodies. The rusted gate can be opened by a lever on the right.

title: Sacred Scorpion Charm +1
text: Pick up the Smithing Stone [1] in front of some gravestones in the water.
Smithing Stone [1]: Upgrade Material. Found among the flooded gravestones surrounding Summonwater Village .
In the ruined structure near the gravestones is a corpse with Mushroom x3.
Mushroom: Can be found at Summonwater Village on a dead body
Head toward the part of the ruins up on the hill to find a Golden Rune [4] in a small tower.
Golden Rune [4]: Found by the ruins on a dead body.
In front of the church where Limgrave meets Caelid, you'll be invaded by Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater. Kill her for the Sacred Scorpion Charm.
Sacred Scorpion Charm: Talisman. Dropped by invader Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater when defeated.
Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater A: Hostile invader with cloth armor and a curved greatsword equipped. Invades when you first approach the Smoldering Church .

place.title: Smoldering Church
walk: To claim the two cookbooks available in this area, loot the remains that are resting on the side of the church. You should find Missionary's Cookbook (3) and Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook (14),

Before entering the church, prepare for battle as the NPC invader Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater shows up for battle. She deals quick attacks with her greataxe and can dodge, so time your attacks well. You will gain Sacred Scorpion Charm and Furlcalling Finger Remedy.
After the fight, you can rest at the Site of Grace found in the far end of the Smoldering Church and loot the two corpses next to it for some cookbooks.

guide.title: The Smoldering Church
text: ## Caelid
Elden Ring Main Quest Guide - Caelid (South) Points of Interest
Defeat the NPC Invader at Smoldering Church.
Clear out Fort Gael.
Complete Sellia Crystal Tunnels.
Travel to Sellia, Town of Sorcery.
Participate in the Festival at Redmane Castle.
## The Smoldering Church

To begin the walkthrough for Caelid, let us start at the Smoldering Church, located northeast of Stormhill. You'll notice that there are multiple bloodstains around the entrance of the church, this is because an NPC Invader, Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater, will appear here when you walk up to the entrance of the church. This NPC invader wields a curved greatsword and her moves can easily be read. Make sure to dodge when she does that leaping attack and you can follow up with your attacks before she recovers as soon as she hits the ground or if she uses an attack where she swings her weapon while she walks forward, use this opportunity to hit her with ranged attacks. Defeating this NPC invader drops the Sacred Scorpion Charm and a Furlcalling Finger Remedy - make sure to check inside the church to find the site of grace and two bodies holding the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [14] and the Missionary's Cookbook [3].

title: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [14], Missionary's Cookbook [3]
text: Grab the Smoldering Church grace and loot the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [14] and Missionary's Cookbook [3] next to it.
Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [14]: Cookbook item. Found on one of the two corpses in the Smoldering Church .
Missionary's Cookbook [3]: Cookbook item. Found on one of the two corpses in the Smoldering Church .

title: Bestial Sling, Clawmark Seal
text: Next to some dogs and a wagon southeast of the grace is a corpse with Drawstring Lightning Grease x2.
Drawstring Lightning Grease: Consumable Item. Two can be found on a corpse by the side of the road guarded by a Zombie Dog .
Beyond the smoldering fence at the end of the road lies the Rotview Balcony grace.
Pick up the Nascent Butterfly x2 in front of the grace.
Nascent Butterfly: Can be found on a corpse on the cliff.
Loot the Golden Rune [3] and Preserving Boluses x5 from the shacks near the grace.
Golden Rune [3]: Found within the Sarcophagi located in the northwestern zone of Caelid .
Preserving Boluses: Consumable Item. Five can be found inside the Shack of the Rotting .
Climb the ledge south-southwest of the grace to discover a cemetery with a Golden Rune [1], Golden Rune [2], and a Golden Rune [3].
Golden Rune [1]: Found within the Sarcophagi located in the northwestern zone of Caelid .
Golden Rune [2]: Found within the Sarcophagi located in the Northwestern zone of Caelid .
Travel to Bestial Sanctum and feed Gurranq the two Deathroots you got earlier to receive Bestial Sling, Clawmark Seal, and Beast Eye.
Offer the Bone Peddler's Bell Bearing and any future bell bearings to the Twin Maiden Husks in Roundtable Hold to unlock new items.

place.title: Forsaken Ruins
walk: Around the destroyed structures, you can find items such as Faded Erdleaf Flower, Trina's Lily, Golden Rune [5], and Smithing Stone [4]. Be careful here since there are two Giant Crow enemies guarding this location.

Once you've cleared the area, look on the western portion of the ruins to find an Imp Statue here that you can use a Stonesword Key to dispel the fog of the cellar. Beyond the white fog is a treasure chest containing x1 Sword of St. Trina.
notes: Overlooking the Forsaken Ruins from the Rotview Balcony site of grace.

title: Hand Ballista
text: From the South of the Lookout Tower grace, head northeast up the slope, then turn left to find 2x Golden Rune [1] x3 on the stretch leading to the tower.
Golden Rune [1]: Can be found inside the abandoned Ailing Village.
Climb the ladders in the lookout tower for a chest at the top containing Hand Ballista and Ballista Bolt x5.
Hand Ballista: At the top of the Forest Lookout Tower, west of the Bridge of Sacrifice.
Ballista Bolt: Ammo Item. Found by a cart alongside the road leading to the Evergaol

place.title: Forest Lookout Tower
walk: This location is surrounded by the plains of the Weeping Peninsula. Its surrounded by all the Weeping Peninsula's natural gathering materials and Items. Soldiers also roam the area. The tower itself is build over the edge of a cliff. Enter the tower through any of the broken down stone wall gaps. Climb the ladder to be greeted by an enemy Soldier. An archer Soldier also awaits you at the highest level of the Tower. Clear the soldier then loot the chest to obtain a Hand Ballista and x5 Ballista Bolt. Map Link.

title: Boss: Runebear
text: Return to South of the Lookout Tower and head north down the cliff. After dropping down, pick up a Rainbow Stone from the campsite.
Rainbow Stone: Can be found on a dead body nerby to the campfire.
Follow the downward slope north of the campsite to enter Earthbore Cave:
Head inside and activate the Earthbore Cave grace.
Avoid the crack in the floor that collapses when stepped on, and open the chest behind it for Pickled Turtle Neck x3.
Pickled Turtle Neck: Found in the chest just inside Earthbore Cave
Follow the tunnel to a Golden Rune [1].
Continue ahead to pick up Glowstone x5 and Kukri x8 from two corpses next to each other.
Glowstone: Can be found at Earthbore Cave on a dead body.
Drop down and kill the Runebear for Spelldrake Talisman and 2,600 runes.
Runebear: Optional Miniboss. Found in the lower level of Earthbore Cave after leaping down into a hole near the end. Drops the Spelldrake Talisman upon defeat.
Spelldrake Talisman: Talisman. Acquired by defeating the Runebear boss inside Earthbore Cave .

place.title: Earthbore Cave
walk: Earthbore Cave can be found on the north side of Weeping Peninsula. Players can get to the cave by heading west from the Lookout Tower along the cliffside of the map or going north through the forest area. At the entrance of the cave players can see a small fire on the left, and will find a Site of Grace inside. This cave is a linear path with no branching directions for players to take, players will want to bring a torch to help them get through the cave but the fight with the boss is naturally lit.

Leaving the Site of Grace heading into the caves, the first chamber players will see is a room with a treasure chest and cave moss on the left. Looking carefully at the ground players will see that the ground directly between the entrance of the room and the chest are riddled in cracks. Carefully walk around this area of the ground to loot the chest and cave moss. The ground here will crumble when walked over and will drop players down into the large chamber right in front of the Large Rat and 3 Rats.

If players do not fall through the ground, the next room they visit will be a small room with 2 rats and a body to loot. Players will then walk through a small tunnel into the Large Chamber to face the Large Rat and 3 rats. Using ranged abilities or through kiting and positioning you can retreat into the tunnel to isolate the giant rat to make the fight easier and avoid being surrounded. Past the large chamber is a tunnel with 2 Rats and 2 bodies to pillage ending with hole players have to jump down at the end of the tunnel. Jump down the rocks to get to the bottom safely then walk through the thin tunnel to find the sleeping Runebear, this cavern has natural lighting so players can stow the torch away for the fight.
BOSS BATTLE: RUNEBEAR

This fight is with just the boss with no additional enemies involved. The boss is found sleeping when the players first enter the cavern so players can prepare themselves for the fight without any surprise.

The cavern that the player has to fight in is not very large, there is one elevated platform that players can get on to but otherwise no obstacles to use to kite the boss. A good strategy for the boss fight here is to use spirit ashes that will summon allies to help deal damage and also to take the focus of the boss off the player giving time to replenish lost HP and FP.
The reward for this fight is the Spelldrake Talisman, loot the two corpses then exit the cave using the shortcut.

title: Faith-knot Crystal Tear
text: Pick up the Smoldering Butterfly x5 and Trina's Lily at the end of the room.
Trina's Lily: Can be found near to a Stone pilar.
Head back up the slope outside the cave, then follow the cliff edge above it northwest to a basin with the Faith-knot Crystal Tear.
Faith-knot Crystal Tear: North of the Demi-Human Forest Ruins . Directly east of the Church of Pilgrimage , just down the cliff. It's in a bowl under a tree and surrounded by Poison Flowers .

title: Demi-Human Queen's Staff, Boss: Demi-human queen
text: Just south of the basin lies Demi-Human Forest Ruins:
Kill the Demi-Human Queen near the entrance for Demi-Human Queen's Staff and Crystal Burst.
Demi-Human Queen's Staff: Dropped by the Demi-Human Queen elite enemy in Demi-Human Forest Ruins.
Crystal Burst: Drops from the Demi-Human Queen mini-boss in the Demi-Human Forest Ruins
Demi-human queen: Demi-Human Queen guarding the site. Drops Crystal Burst and Demi-Human Queen's Staff .

place.title: Demi-Human Forest Ruins
walk: The ruins can be found just west of Earthbore Cave. As you reach the ruins, you'll encounter a couple of Demi-humans in the area, and in the middle of the ruins, a Demi-Human Queen is located. Defeating the Demi-Human Queen will drop the Demi-Human Queen's Staff as well as the Crystal Burst.

There's also a corpse in the middle of the area holding an Arteria Leaf. In the cellar area of the ruins, before the main building before you encounter the Demi-Human Queen mini boss, jump over a wall to access the stairs to the cellar and find the Shield of the Guilty.
Outside north of the ruins by the cliff, there's an area where you'll see three Poison Flowers and an item in the middle. The item in the middle is a Faith-knot Crystal Tear.

title: Shield of the Guilty
text: Pick up Arteria Leaf x2 from the corpse near the queen.
Arteria Leaf: Can be found at Demi-human Forest Ruins near to Demi-human
Head down the cellar in the southernmost part of the ruins for a chest containing Shield of the Guilty

Shield of the Guilty: In the cellar area of the Demi-Human Forest Ruins , before the main building with the Demi-Human Queen mini-boss. You will need to jump over a wall to access the stairs leading into the cellar.

title: Boss: Scaly Misbegotten
text: Among the flowers southeast of the ruins, you'll find Gold-Tinged Excrement x2 and String x5.
String: Can be found at Earthbore Cave on some dead bodies
Head south from the patch of flowers to find a Golden Rune [2] next to some Miranda Blossoms.
Golden Rune [2]: Found by the side of the road on a dead body.
Follow the dirt path south of the Miranda Blossoms to Morne Tunnel:
Drop down to the left of the lift for a Smithing Stone [1] on the wall.
Activate the Morne Tunnel grace at the bottom.
Climb the ladder at the end of the first room for a Smithing Stone [1] on the wall.
Head into the next room without falling, and pick up the Golden Rune [2] down the first set of stairs.
Golden Rune [2]: One can be looted off a corpse sitting in between some crates and barrels in Morne Tunnel .
In the alcove just northeast of the rune is an outcrop with Smithing Stone [1].
Pick up the Smithing Stone [1] near the bottom of the stairs.
Follow the south tunnel to a hut with a Golden Rune [4] and a chest with Exalted Flesh.
Exalted Flesh: Consumable Item. Looted from a chest inside a shack within Morne Tunnel.
Pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [1] behind the hut, then the Large Glintstone Scrap x2 in the nearby alcove.
In the area below the stairs in the previous room, you'll find a Smithing Stone [1] on the wall and Stanching Boluses on a corpse.
Stanching Boluses: One can be looted off a corpse in Morne Tunnel .
Follow the west tunnel to a large room. At the west end of it, you'll find a smaller room with Soft Cotton.
Soft Cotton: One can be looted off a corpse in Morne Tunnel .
Pick up the 4x Smithing Stone [1], Somber Smithing Stone [1], and Arteria Leaf x2 in the large room.
On the wall to the right before the boss is a Somber Smithing Stone [1].
Kill the Scaly Misbegotten for Rusted Anchor and 2,000 runes.
Scaly Misbegotten: Optional Boss, found within Mourne Tunnel . Drops Rusted Anchor
Rusted Anchor: Greataxe dropped by Scaly Misbegotten located in Morne Tunnel .

guide.title: Explore the Weeping Peninsula
text: Next, from the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace, if you head south, down the road, you'll find the Bridge of Sacrifice, and just past that, you will run into a woman named Irina who can be found sitting on a rock at the beginning of the main road in eastern Weeping Peninsula, upon speaking to her, you'll learn that she's from Castle Morne and that she will hand you a key item, Irina's Letter. She will ask you to deliver this letter to her father who is in Castle Morne, this formally starts the questline of Irina and her father, Edgar -your next side quest is to liberate Castle Morne and to deliver the letter to Edgar.

Castle Morne can be found at the end of the main road, situated on the southwest side of the map. There are a couple of locations you may want to stop over since there are some helpful items that you can find there.
Oridys's Rise: You can find a Memory Stone here at the top of the tower. Useful when you need an extra slot to equip more Magic Spells.

Impaler's Catacombs: Located near Irina, if you want to farm for some Runes and acquire a new Spirit Ash, the Demi-Human Ashes, then clear out this mini-dungeon and beat the boss, the Erdtree Burial Watchdog.

Demi-Human Forest Ruins: Inhabited by Demi-Humans and the Demi-Human queen, you can find items here such as the Shield of the Guilty, the Crystal Burst sorcery spell, and the Demi-Human Queen's Staff that drops from the Demi-Human Queen upon defeating it.
Make sure you also check the north section of the Demi-human forest Ruins to find the Faith-knot Crystal Tear
Callu Baptismal Church: You can loot the "The Flame of Frenzy" incantation off a corpse, and you can also find x1 Sacred Tear in front of the altar.

Morne Tunnel: Heavily guarded by Misbegotten enemies and is the location of a mini-boss, the Scaly Misbegotten, clearing out this tunnel location is a must to find multiple Smithing Stones, some Golden Runes, and materials.

title: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [9]
text: From the Church of Pilgrimage, head south toward a stone arch against a cliff. Behind it lies the entrance to Tombsward Catacombs:
Head inside and grab the Tombsward Catacombs grace.
Unlock the imp seal for a corpse with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [9].
Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [9]: Cookbook item. Found inside the Tombsward Catacombs , locked behind an imp statue barrier. Requires a Stonesword Key to break the seal.

place.title: Tombsward Catacombs
walk: The entrance to Tombsward Catacombs is a set of doors hidden behind a stone pillar on the side of the mountain. It can be easily found by heading directly south from the Church of Pilgrimage. Stepping into the Catacombs players will immediately find a Site of Grace to use. Heading into the catacombs from the Site of Grace players will see a room sealed by an imp statue. You can choose to use a Stonesword Key here to open the seal for a Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [9] within. Otherwise heading left and down the stairs will bring you further into the Catacombs.

The Tombsward Catacombs is filled with Skeleton enemies that use various weaponry, including skeletal archers, sword users and skeletons throwing fire pots. In the first room you will find a set of ornate doors flanked by large stone statues holding lights. The doors are locked by some contraption. Head right to go deeper into the Catacombs, this second room spawns a skeleton that throws fire pots at the player as well as some some Grave Glovewort (1).

After dealing with the skeleton head deeper into the catacombs to find 2 skeletal archers standing amongst pillars. Turn right as you enter the room to get out of sight from the archers and face the 1 skeletal warrior standing in this corner of the room, there is also a Grave Glovewort (1) here to gather. Use the pillars to position the archers to face them one at a time to make the fight easier.

Heading out from this room is a tunnel with 1 skeleton holding a Grossmesser, a big sword. Slow down at the bend of the tunnel because there is a fire breathing statue at the end of the next tunnel that will breathe fire down the tunnel in pulses. The fire does huge damage and can kill players outright but you can cause it to descend by hitting it (using a bow helps quite a lot). Looking down the tunnel you can see a body on the path next to a small pocket that is safe, this pocket also features a single skeleton enemy lying in wait. Time yourself to the rhythm of the fire then head for the pocket, being careful to dispatch the skeleton without throwing yourself into the fire. Once at the fire breathing statue simply hit it to have it descend partway into the ground and turn off. This will also allow you to advance to the last room in this part of the catacombs where 4 skeleton enemies will be waiting.

Take care when leaving the final room, a skeleton that throws fire pots will appear above where the fire breathing statue. In the final room players will be able to find the Prattling Pate "Thank you".

To complete the catacombs jump on to the fire breathing statue, the statue will then raise with the player on it bringing them up to the second floor. Follow the path to find a room with a Grave Violet then a narrower room with a Grave Glovewort (2) at the end. This second room has a skeleton archer at the end of the room as well as a skeleton using a Grossmesser at the entrance. Past this room players will find the lever to open the doors at the beginning of the catacombs and also find themselves above the room with 2 skeletal archers.
BOSS BATTLE: Cemetery Shade

The boss battle for these catacombs is the Cemetery Shade, a humanoid shaped enemy that teleports short distances. This boss will teleport short distances and attack the player with their weapons applying bleed. The boss will also prepare then throw a green orb of poison at the player, the pillars in the room can be used to block this attack. The boss is relatively weak with only around 800 health so dispatch them quickly to claim your reward of 2200 runes and Lhutel the Headless.

title: Prattling Pate
text: Pick up Grave Glovewort [1] and Grave Glovewort [2] from the first room.

Grave Glovewort [1]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One found in the room to the right of the boss door. A second one is found near a sarcophagus on the bottom level of the first room with a second floor.

Grave Glovewort [2]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One found in the room to the right of the boss door, behind the central column. A second one is found in the room to the left of the flamethrower pillar. A third one is found in a room on the upper level after riding the flamethrower pillar and before the room with the boss door's lever.
Go down the stairs for a Grave Glovewort [1] to the right and a Ghost Glovewort [1] in the back.
Ghost Glovewort [1]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One found in the bottom level of the first room with a second floor, near the back.
Pick up the Grave Glovewort [1] in the corridor.
Deactivate the fire-breathing pillar, then pick up the Human Bone Shard x5 on the ground.
In the room east of the pillar, you'll find a Grave Glovewort [2] and Prattling Pate "Thank you".
Prattling Pate: Reusable Item. Obtained inside the Tombsward Catacombs . Found on a corpse at the end of the main path, past the flamethrowing pillar.

title: Boss: Cemetery Shade
text: Activate the pillar while standing on top of it to reach the Golden Rune [2] on the ledge.
Golden Rune [2]: Found on a dead body by the sea.
Pick up the Grave Glovewort [2] in front of a coffin, then pull the lever ahead.
Kill the Cemetery Shade for Lhutel the Headless and 2,200 runes.
Lhutel the Headless: Dropped by the Cemetery Shade inside the Tombsward Catacombs
Cemetery Shade: Found inside Tombsward Catacombs . Drops Lhutel the Headless

title: Boss: Erdtree Avatar
text: Exit the catacombs and kill the Erdtree Avatar in front of the Minor Erdtree for Opaline Bubbletear, Crimsonburst Crystal Tear, and 3,600 runes.
Opaline Bubbletear: Crystal Tear for the Flask of Wondrous Physick. Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar boss upon defeat.
Crimsonburst Crystal Tear: Crystal Tear for the Flask of Wondrous Physick. Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar boss upon defeat.
Erdtree Avatar: Miniboss found guarding the Erdtree. Drops the Opaline Bubbletear and Crimsonburst Crystal Tear upon defeat.

title: Eclipse Crest Heater Shield
text: Kill the Operatic Bat below the cliff past the Erdtree for a Golden Rune [6] (first time), then pick up the nearby Sliver of Meat.
Sliver of Meat: Crafting Material. Found on a corpse where a singing Bat is sitting.

Head west-northwest from the bats to a large ruin, then go north-northeast toward a stone arch and drop to the ledge below it. On a pillar below the ledge sits a corpse with Eclipse Crest Heater Shield.
Eclipse Crest Heater Shield: Ledge of the pillar near Tombsward Site of Grace. Can be reached from the ledge near Minor Erdtree

title: Winged Scythe
text: Travel to the Tombsward grace and head north-northwest toward Tombsward Ruins:
Pick up Beast Liver next to a rat in the middle of the ruins.
Beast Liver: Can be found on a dead body in the ruins.
Open the chest in the cellar to obtain Winged Scythe.

Winged Scythe: Located In the center of Tombsward Ruins , there is a set of stairs leading underground into a dark hall with a door to a small room at the end. The scythe is inside a chest in the small room.

place.title: Tombsward Ruins
walk: There isn't much to see at these ruins. Above ground, there are a couple of Rats feasting on corpses, one of which contains a Beast Liver crafting material. At the center of the ruins, there is a set of stairs that leads underground to a dark hall protected by two Page enemies. Be sure to bring a Torch or lead the Pages outside. Watch out for their quick two-hit thrust and two-hit slash attacks. They can also shoot at you from a distance using their crossbows. At the end of the dark hall is a small room containing a chest. Inside, you will find the Winged Scythe weapon.

title: Divine Fortification
text: Kill the scarab at the top of the large ruin next to the ruins for Divine Fortification.
Divine Fortification: Incantation . Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab found atop a collapsed stone structure overgrown with yellow moss.

title: Boss: Ancient Hero of Zamor
text: Unlock the evergaol west of the ruins, then kill the Ancient Hero of Zamor for Radagon's Scarseal and 5,400 runes.
Radagon's Scarseal: Dropped by Ancient Hero of Zamor
Ancient Hero of Zamor: Optional Boss imprisoned within the Weeping Evergaol .

place.title: Weeping Evergaol
walk: The Weeping Evergaol is located between the Fourth Church of Marika and the Tombsward Ruins in the western portion of the Weeping Peninsula. An Imp Statue stands guard along the outer circle. Inserting a Stonesword Key unlocks the portal mechanism in the middle, allowing players to enter the dimensional jail to challenge the Ancient Hero of Zamor boss imprisoned within.

title: Furlcalling Finger Remedy H
text: On a lower ledge south of the evergaol lies the entrance to Tombsward Cave:
Go inside and grab the Tombsward Cave grace.
Pick up the Golden Rune [2] right before the poison swamp.
On the opposite end of the swamp is a Furlcalling Finger Remedy.
Furlcalling Finger Remedy H: Can be looted off from a corpse once you head straight inside the Tombsward Cave.

place.title: Tombsward Cave
walk: Once you reach the area, you'll know you've reached Tombsward Cave when you see a lit brazier just by the entrance of the cave. This is an optional dungeon area that is not as large as the regular Legacy Dungeons. Equip a torch before you enter the cave as it is almost pitch black upon entering.
Since a lot of enemies in this location inflict an additional Poison effect, an option would be to bring Neutralizing Boluses with you which could alleviate poison build up and cure you of poison.

As you move deeper into the cave, you'll see a Site of Grace. Beyond that, you'll find more cave moss by just following the path of the cave. You will then reach a cavern that's filled with poisonous liquid which will slowly build up your poison meter and once it's filled, you will receive damaging status effect continously. This can be a difficult area to traverse since there's also a couple of Servant of Rots patrolling the area, this type of enemy will often drop Toxic Mushroom. Also be wary of their poisonous projectile that shoots out of their staff as it is homing.

If you just follow a straight path, you'll see a corpse with the item Furlcalling Finger Remedy beside another entrance. Go through the entrance, there should be some Poison Flowers in the area and a corpse holding a Poisonbone Dart.

Exit the room by going through where you first entered, then turn left and proceed in following the path, jump down. There are multiple Poisonblooms in the area as you proceed, turn left on the next cavern you see, turn left again and you'll see two Poisonblooms just before you make your way up the slope. Continue following the path, you will come across a Cave Moss just before you enter another area.

Once you enter this area, you'll encounter three Poison Flowers and a Giant Rat. There's also a corpse holding an Arteria Leaf in the area. Now exit the area from where you came in, continue following the path and then turn left, you'll encounter a Rat and a Giant Rat guarding two corpses. The one in the middle holds the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [8], the other one holds an Immunizing Cured Meat.

Now go back and head right on the first corner and go up the slope again, you'll end up back in the room where you got the Arteria Leaf, jump down, go straight and down the slope til you reach a yellow mist blocking your way. Make sure to stock up on health as this will be the boss fight of the area.

Once you pass through the mist, you will encounter a boss fight, you will be fighting against Miranda the Blighted Bloom. There are also three smaller Poison Flowers surrounding Miranda. The best tactic is to take out the smaller enemies first before fully engaging with the boss. This boss only has two moves, the first one is a familiar move where it shoots out an AoE poison spray which will most likely cover the entire area in this. This is easily telegraphed as you will see Miranda closing her petals before releasing the toxic cloud. There's no counter for this attack and you will suffer the effects nonetheless, just see this as an opportunity to land your attacks.
