The other attack is where Miranda will start summoning white beams of light and shoot down the ground, this will most likely occur at the start when you enter the area. This is telegraphed as you'll see Miranda rear upwards but with her petals open, then beams o light will rise from the ground around your character's radius, then the beams will start to shoot down and deal massive damage. This can be easily dodge rolled. Miranda will unlikely repeat the second move and will continue to resort to the AoE poison spray.

After defeating Miranda, she will drop the Viridian Amber Medallion, you can then exit the cave go back to the Site of Grace at the entrance of the cave to remove the remaining poison debuff effects and fully heal your character.

title: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [8]
text: Follow the northeast tunnel past some rats to pick up Immunizing White Cured Meat and Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [8].
Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [8]: Can be found on a corpse within the Tombsward Cave.

place.title: Walking Mausoleum
notes: Note that if you don't find the white skulls on its feet, you will need to find a way to get to the top level of the structure. There should be elements in the environment around the area that can help you. Areas like cliffs or Spiritsprings nearby can assist with climbing the structure. After reaching the top, the skulls should appear much like those found its feet in other mausoleums. Clear them the same way to be able to enter and use the Wandering Mausoleum.
Wandering mausoleums can be put to sleep by passing time until the morning at a site of grace, which will help to deal with them more easily. They will sleep around 2 minutes and 15 seconds.

title: Boss: Miranda the Blighted Bloom
text: Head back and take the path on the right side to an Arteria Leaf on a ledge.
Drop down to find a corpse in the poison with Poisonbone Dart x6.
Poisonbone Dart: An offensive consumable that can be found on a corpse inside Tombsward Cave.
Kill Miranda the Blighted Bloom for Viridian Amber Medallion and 2,100 runes.
Viridian Amber Medallion: Viridian Amber Medallion Raises maximum stamina. It is dropped by Miranda the Blighted Bloom, found inside the Tombsward Cave.
Miranda the Blighted Bloom: Miranda the Blighted Bloom is a large, poisonous flower within the Tombsward Cave.

title: Ambush Shard
text: Exit the cave and take down the Wandering Mausoleum by hacking away at the skull formations on its feet until it collapses. Optionally, mark its location on your map so that you can easily come back when you want to duplicate a remembrance.
In the area next to the slope that leads to the church lies Witchbane Ruins:
Pick up Great Dragonfly Head from a corpse in the back of the ruins.
Great Dragonfly Head: A Great Dragonfly Head can be found on the ground by one of the effigies.
Head down the cellar to find Ambush Shard next to Sellen's body.
Ambush Shard: Weeping Peninsula : Found on a corpse in the underground jail of the Witchbane Ruins .

place.title: Witchbane Ruins
walk: Once you reach Witchbane Ruins, you'll see a School of Graven Mages in the middle of the area. There's also a Marionette Soldier in the area so be wary of that. There's also a Marionette Soldier in the area that can drop theMarionette Soldier Set and the Spiked Spear. After you defeat the Graven Mass, head down the stairs and open the door blocking the path. On the right side of the room, you'll see a corpse, go towards it and pillage the remains, you'll receive the Ambush Shard. In the middle, you'll see Sorceress Sellen pinned to the wall. There is no way to free her. It is recommended not to hit her, as this will anger her and will cause complications with her questline.

title: Blessed Dew Talisman
text: Head south from the cellar to discover a cemetery on your left with 4x Golden Rune [1], Golden Rune [2], and a Golden Rune [3].
Golden Rune [1]: Found at the top of the ruined structure.
Golden Rune [3] E: Can be looted off of defeated Giant Rats within the Tombsward Cave.
On top of the slope northeast of the cemetery, in front of some gibbets, you'll find Great Dragonfly Head x3.
Drop below the cliff southeast of the gibbets to discover a corpse in a chair with Mushroom x4.
Mushroom: Can be found at Tower of Return area on a dead body near to the ledge cliff.
Return to the gibbets and climb the lookout tower to open the trap chest at the top. After arriving, grab the Divine Bridge grace just ahead.
Open the chest to the right of the Golem for the Blessed Dew Talisman.
Blessed Dew Talisman: Talisman. Found in a chest west of the Divine Bridge Site of Grace. Guarded by a Golem.

title: Boss: Giant Golem
text: Giant Golem: Dormant Golem guarding the divine bridge.

title: Great Turtle Shell
text: Travel to Castle Morne Rampart and use the nearby spiritspring while facing south to reach the top of a tower with Great Turtle Shell and Warming Stone x2.

Great Turtle Shell: Small Shield. Found on a corpse atop the eastern-most tower of the Castle Morne Ramparts. This area can be reached by using Torrent to jump from the Spiritspring located just east of the Site of Grace nearby.

Warming Stone: Consumable Item. 2 can be found on a corpse atop the eastern-most tower of the Castle Morne Ramparts. This area can be reached by using Torrent to jump from the Spiritspring located just east of the Site of Grace nearby.

title: Talk to Nomadic Merchant Castle Morne Rampart
text: Nomadic Merchant Castle Morne Rampart: Nomadic Merchant. General Goods vendor found sitting by a campfire near the Castle Morne Rampart site of grace. Sells Stonesword Key

title: Memory Stone
text: An astrolabe with Starlight Shards sits at the cliff edge east of the tower.
Starlight Shards: Can be found on an altar, by the cliff.
Head toward Oridys's Rise and examine the book in front of it. You'll need to hit three "Wise Beasts" to gain entry:
#1: On the road leading to the tower. Just look behind you after interacting with the book. [Location 1]
#2: In a bush to the left of the stairs. In front of you as you interact with the book. [Location 2]
#3: In a pond to the right of the tower. It's invisible so aim where the water splashes. [Location 3]
Enter the tower and loot the chest at the top to obtain a Memory Stone.
Memory Stone: Memory Upgrade Material. Found in a chest at the top floor of Oridys's Rise .

place.title: Oridys's Rise
walk: The entrance to Oridys's Rise is initially sealed by a barrier. There is a statue holding a glowing book by the entrance. Inspecting this statue presents players with a challenge to "Seek three wise beasts".
These beasts are represented as Ghostly Tortoises found nearby. These Tortoises need to be attacked to break parts of the seal.
The first Tortoise can be found just a few steps to the north, opposite the tower's entrance.
2. The second Tortoise is hiding in the bushes to the left of the steps leading up to the tower's entrance. If you pay close attention you'll see a blue shade emanating through the bushes.

3. The final Tortoise can be found in a small pond southwest of the tower. This Tortoise is invisible until struck but will make splashes on the water. Attack where the splashes are to reveal the Tortoise.

Once all three Tortoises are killed, players will get a notification that the seal has been broken. Go back to the tower, climb the ladder, then turn right to proceed up the stairs to reach a chest containing a Memory Stone which grants increases your Memory Slots by one, allowing for the memorization of more Sorceries or Incantations. Aside from this, there isn't much else to do at the tower.

title: Stonesword Key
text: Exit the tower and go north to find the Beside the Crater-Pocked Glade grace next to a ruin.
Head north past the craters until you reach the cliff's edge, where you'll find a corpse in a chair with Stonesword Key.
Stonesword Key: Stonesword Key . Found on a corpse sitting in a chair at the northern edge of the plateau, overlooking the sea.

title: Prattling Pate
text: Down the slope below the cliff southeast of the chair lies the entrance to Impaler's Catacombs:
Head inside to grab the Impaler's Catacombs grace.
On a coffin in the first room is a Grave Glovewort [1].

Grave Glovewort [1]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. The first is found on top of a sarcophagus in the room to the left of the boss door. A second one can be found in the second section of the sewers with Zombies, after dropping down underneath the Impaler Lift and one more can be found in the third section before climbing up the ladder.
Follow the path straight ahead to a Grave Glovewort [2].

Grave Glovewort [2]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. The first is found in a dead end room with two statues and a sarcophagus. A second one can be found in the first section of the sewers with Zombies after dropping down underneath the impaler lift. A final one can be found in the corridor after pulling the boss door's lever.
Momentarily step inside the room down the other path. When the floor rises to impale you, drop down beneath it for a Ghost Glovewort [2].
Ghost Glovewort [2]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Found under the impaler lift, right by the entrance to the next corridor.
Loot the Grave Glovewort [2], Prattling Pate "Please help", Root Resin x3, and 2x Grave Glovewort [1] from the sewage area with respawning enemies.
Prattling Pate: Found within Impaler's Catacombs , held by a corpse in the water underneath the spikes trap.

place.title: Impaler's Catacombs
walk: The Impaler's Catacombs is filled with Imps that crawl on the walls and jump at the player. When walking into new rooms you can slowly move your camera to check the walls around the entrance to look for enemies crawling on the wall to avoid being jumped in the back. The entrance can be easily found by following the cliffside on the eastern edge of Weeping Peninsula with a Site of Grace found inside at the top of the catacombs.

Heading into the Catacombs the first room players walk into is a square room with a large hole and stairs against the wall leading down. There are 2 Imps in this room, one on the wall of the entrance and one on the wall on the other end of the stairs. Avoid being pushed off into the hole while fighting them and continue to the next room where an ornate door flanked by 2 large stone statues can be found. The door is locked by some contraption but a path exists to the left for you to take.

The catacombs are a series of tunnels and rooms connecting them, often with an imp on each wall where the tunnels connect to the rooms. The first room you enter will have 3 imps, one on the ground, one on the wall in front and one on the wall of the entrance you enter from. Watch out for the third one as it will jump at you from the wall if left unchecked. Past this room the path branches into 2, one to the right and down stairs, and one forward with a left turn. Go forward first to find a room with a single Imp and a Grave Glovewort [2].

Turning around and taking the path down the stairs leads to a large empty room, looking up players will notice a lot of spikes. Stepping on the floor will trigger the mechanism and raise the floor up pushing the player into the spikes dealing damage. In the room there is a pocket in the top left where a Grave Violet can be found. You can run across the raising floor and get to the pocket in time. If you stand on the floor for too long it will raise you all the way up into the spikes, then repeatedly push you into the spikes until dead or you make it back to the pocket.

It is not possible to get out directly by running to the exit as the floor will raise above the entrance keeping you in the room. To get out players have to engage the floor mechanism then stay in the pocket and let it reach the roof. Start moving to the entrance while the floor is descending back to the original position so that there is enough time to get out.

To complete this catacombs players will have to go to the room with the spike ceiling. At the entrance to the room step on the raising floor to have it raise up then quickly step back off and have it raise past you, fall down underneath the floor to go deeper. In this lower part of the Catacombs an infinite number corpses can be found raising up from the watery path. Following the pathway will lead to more rooms full of Putrid Corpses as well as a Prattling Pate "Please help". There are a set number of Putrid Corpses in each room, but a new replacement will stand up a few seconds after one is killed. At the end of the underground watery area there is a ladder leading upwards, at the top of the ladder is the lever that opens the doors at the start of the catacombs.

Watch out when turning the corner after leaving the lever, an imp is hiding around the corner ready to jump at players rounding the corner. Simply climb out of the window at the end to get back to the starting room.
BOSS BATTLE: Erdtree Burial Watchdog

This fight involves the boss as well as multiple Imps. The melee attacks of the Imps apply bleed and being surrounded by them while fighting the boss in this small room can quickly lead to the bleed threshold being reached and dealing large damage to the player. Clear out the imps before turning and focusing on the boss. This boss has around 1400 health but is slow and kiteable making for an easy fight once the imps are out of the way.

The boss has 2 modes of attack, one where they are standing and one where they are sitting, with only 1 attack in each mode that are both easily dodged. While sitting the boss will jump or float up then move towards the player before dropping down with their attack in a small AOE, simply move away from the landing spot and continue to hurt the boss. When it is not sitting the boss will stand tall on their hind legs and walk towards the player, when they are near they will slam their sword down.
Defeating the boss will grant you Demi-Human Ashes as well as 2400 Runes.

title: Boss: Erdtree Burial Watchdog (Impaler's Catacombs)
text: Climb the ladder in the back, pull the lever, and pick up the Grave Glovewort [2] in the corner guarded by an Imp.
Kill the Erdtree Burial Watchdog for Demi-Human Ashes and 2,400 runes.
Demi-Human Ashes: Found within Impaler's Catacombs . Dropped by Erdtree Burial Watchdog
Erdtree Burial Watchdog: Found within Impaler's Catacombs. Drops Demi-Human Ashes upon defeat.

title: Boss: Night's Cavalry (Weeping Peninsula)
text: Travel to Castle Morne Rampart, pass time until nightfall, and kill the Night's Cavalry there for Ash of War: Barricade Shield, Nightrider Flail, and 3,400 runes.
Ash of War: Barricade Shield: Dropped by Night's Cavalry Miniboss found patrolling the roads around the Castle Morne Ramparts. Only appears at night.
Nightrider Flail: Dropped by Night's Cavalry that spawns at night near Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace.
Night's Cavalry: Night's Cavalry Miniboss found patrolling the roads around the Castle Morne Ramparts. Only appears at night. Drops Ash of War: Barricade Shield

title: Boss: Deathbird (Weeping Peninsula)
text: Head southwest through the rampart and kill the Deathbird behind a large ruin for Sacrificial Axe and 3,900 runes.
Sacrificial Axe: Axe. Dropped from miniboss that only spawns at night: Deathbird (Weeping Peninsula)
Deathbird: Spawns only at night, drops the Sacrificial Axe
Continue southwest toward a beach to find a Golden Rune [1] in front of a gibbet.
Golden Rune [1]: Found by the statue.
Enter Castle Morne and activate the Castle Morne Lift grace.

title: Claymore
text: After taking the lift, go up the stairs on the left for a Smithing Stone [2].
Smithing Stone [2] A: Upgrade Material. From the main courtyard entrance of Castle Morne, head up the steps on the left side to find the item on a corpse. Beware the skeletal dogs in the area.
To the left of a tree at the southwest end of the area is a corpse with Smithing Stone [1] x3.
Smithing Stone [1]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse in the left side at the back of Castle Morne 's courtyard.
Pick up Fire Grease x2 from a ledge next to the mound of corpses in the courtyard.
Fire Grease: Consumable. 2 can be found on a corpse near the the burning pile of corpses in the courtyard.
Enter the room accessible from the ledge for a chest by the entrance containing the Claymore.

Claymore: Greatsword. From the main courtyard entrance, hug the right wall past the burning corpses and harpies to reach the entrance to the building in the north. The sword is found in a chest to the left as you enter.

guide.title: Liberate Castle Morne
text: If you want to find a list of all the items you can find, as well as entries on NPC, Enemies, and Boss encounters, simply visit the Castle Morne page. This is an optional dungeon area that is not as large as the regular Legacy Dungeons. Players may find this castle by wandering the paths along Southern Limgrave and The Weeping Peninsula. Some NPCs encountered around Limgrave may speak about this castle, as well. If players come across the Bridge of Sacrifice, they may encounter Irina, an escapee of the castle south of the bridge, referring to Castle Morne.

Upon riding the lift up to Castle Morne, you'll see the Misbegotten enemies all around the castle grounds. As you enter, make a hard left and go up the steps where you'll see a bonfire. There are two Zombie Dog enemies here, kill the hounds and loot the body to find x1 Smithing Stone (2). Go back down to the courtyard section where the Misbegotten enemies are and continue going straight. You can fight them if you want, but you'll easily be outnumbered. Or you can sneak around by moving to the left side where there are about three Zombie Dog enemies.

As you move forward, you'll notice a Lesser Pumpkin Head sitting on the ground. This enemy drops x1 Pumpkin Helm and x1 Sanctuary Stone. From where the Lesser Pumpkin Head was sitting, look to the left, behind the tree to find a corpse in a sitting position, pillage the body to find x3 Smithing Stone (1). On the right side, is a narrow path that is blocked by a single Misbegotten. You can sneak behind to backstab it - continue up the stairs and climb up the ladder at the end.

As you reach the top, a single Misbegotten enemy will rush in to attack you. Be ready to take it out. Head up the stairs where you'll see countless bodies of men hanged, and ahead of the path, is another Misbegotten on the left side of the runway, while two Winged Misbegotten are just a few steps ahead. You'll also notice on the right that there is a body that's hanging by the ledge of the wooden fence, you can loot the body to find x1 Golden Rune (2). Go straight towards another bonfire where you can pick up x1 Smoldering Butterfly.

Now, go back to the spot where the two Winged Misbegotten enemies were, check the left side to find a ladder that you can climb down. Move forward along the runway where you'll see a single Misbegotten at the end, near another corpse that can be pillaged. Don't run forward since there is another Misbegotten enemy hiding behind the barrels on the right. It will jump and attack you the moment you are close to it. Kill both enemies and loot the corpse to find x2 Smithing Stone (2). Retrace your steps and climb the ladder back to the top - from where you got the Smoldering Butterfly material, look to your right and you'll see a part of the stone fence broken, you can jump down to find the Behind the Castle Site of Grace.

After discovering the site and resting if needed, jump down to the lower section of the cliffs until you set foot on the platforms of the castle. Look to your left towards the broken stone fence and you'll see there's a wooden platform below with a corpse that can be looted. Jump down and pillage the body to find x1 Stonesword Key. Jump down and you'll encounter more Misbegotten enemies ahead. On the right side, however, is an open gate that leads to a prison cell.

Inside that prison cell, there is a single Misbegotten enemy here that you can backstab. Kill it and then loot the body here to find x1 Pickled Turtle Neck. Move away as soon as you grab the item to avoid getting hit by the Skeletal Slime enemy that will drop from above. On the left side of the prison cell, you'll see a spirit NPC locked in a cage. Speak to it and it will plead for help. There isn't anything special here, so you can go back outside and take out the Misbegotten enemies one at a time as you move northwest.

Walk along the runway, kill the Misbegotten and Skeletal Slime enemies. On the other side, you'll see a bigger Misbegotten. Kill the enemy, and grab x2 Smoldering Butterfly near the bonfire. Climb the ladder to the top of the tower and circle around to find a treasure chest containing x1 Twinblade Talisman. Next, go back down, walk towards the runway (facing southeast), look to the right, and you'll see that you can jump down on the roof of what seems to be a castle gazebo. Jump on the roof and then to the ground to find two things, there is a special-looking Teardrop Scarab that you can kill which gives an additional usage for your Flask of Crimson Tears. You'll find it hiding by a bush, and you can identify it with its glow and ringing sound. Also, there's a tree nearby, check it to find a body next to it that can be pillaged to find x3 Tarnished Golden Sunflower.

Continue moving east until you've set foot on the east section of the castle. You'll notice that there is a square opening on the ground that you can enter. Below, there is a narrow beam, on that beam is a corpse with an item, x1 Smithing Stone (2). Drop down on the next beam but don't go all the way down since there is mischief (a group of Rats) and a single Misbegotten. We suggest you stay on the second beam and kill it one at a time while on high ground. If you accidentally fall, just sprint out of the prison cell, and fight them outside where there's more space for you to move around.

Inside that cell with the mischief, there's a body that you can loot to find x1 Whip. And outside, you can grab x1 Smoldering Butterfly near the bonfire, and if you go left, around the corner, you'll find the Beside the Rampart Gaol site of grace. Next, cross the narrow wooden bridge, as you approach the other end, move slowly since there are two Misbegotten enemies here, a winged one, and the other large variant that wields a large axe. In that spot where the two enemies were, there's another body next to the barrels and crates, loot it to find x8 Throwing Dagger.

Next, climb down the nearby ladder where you'll see multiple Spirit Jellyfish enemies. These aren't hostile and remain at rest unless you attack them. Move around to the left side of the ladder and you'll see an entrance that can only be entered by going through the gold mist. Beyond it is the boss for this location, Leonine Misbegotten - make sure you have made further preparations before fighting this boss, you can visit our Leonine Misbegotten page for guides on how to defeat this boss.

Defeating Leonine Misbegotten drops x1 Grafted Blade Greatsword and 2850 Runes. There still are some sections of the castle you'll need to explore here, so after the battle, first, make sure to examine the Morne Moangrave site of grace at the boss arena then fast travel back to the Castle Morne Lift site. Ride the elevator up and this time, you will need to explore the section on the right where there are multiple Misbegotten enemies standing on a pile of bones and corpses. You could try to sneak behind them.

If you're able to pass, there's a doorway that you can enter. Inside the armory, by the doorway, there's a chest on the left, open it to find x1 Claymore. Continue straight, down the stairs, and head outside where you'll see two Misbegotten enemies attacking a Godrick Soldier. Clear the path and climb up the nearby ladder. At the top, you'll see more Godrick Soldiers fight against the Misbegotten. You can simply watch them fight first, and whoever is left, you can finish them off.

Upon clearing the area, on the right side, there's another ladder that goes up, an execution podium at the center, and a path that you can explore on the left. Check the podium first and you can find x1 Furlcalling Finger Remedy looted off a corpse. While on the left side of the podium, there's also another body that's being guarded by two more Misbegotten enemies. Search the corpse to find x1 Steel-Wire Torch. Go back and climb up the other ladder on the right.

Return to the castle grounds, specifically where there are piles of bodies and Misbegotten enemies around a corpse that is tied to a wooden beam that is burning. Clear out the enemies and check the pile to find some corpses that can be looted such as x2 Fire Grease, Smoldering Butterfly that is flying around the flames.

Now, if you were able to speak to Irina (and exhaust her dialogue), she'll ask you to give a letter to her father, Edgar, a warden who's in Castle Morne. Irina can be found sitting on a rock just beyond the Bridge of Sacrifice, at the start of the main road in the eastern Weeping Peninsula [ Interactive Map Location]. To deliver the letter, fast travel to the Castle Morne Lift site, go straight towards the Lesser Pumpkin Head, make a right, climb the ladder.

At the top of the ladder, go straight towards the runway with the hanging corpses, drop down from the wooden platform on the left side just a few steps after going up the short stairs, go straight until you reach the end, go up and around the wooden stairs where you'll find Edgar on one of the castle tower's rooftops. Give the letter and he'll give you x1 Sacrificial Twig. If you spoke to Edgar before clearing the castle, he will mention that he still must defend the castle and recover a sword before he can return to Irina. This means that you just need to clear out the castle by defeating Leonine Misbegotten and acquiring the Grafted Blade Greatsword, by doing so, return to Edgar and he'll mention that he is in your debt, that he is no longer bound by duty, and he can now return to Irina. This completes Castle Morne and as for the Father-Daughter questline, make sure you return to the spot where Irina was, near the Bridge of Sacrifice. You'll find Edgar discovering that Irina has been killed.
## An Invitation to the Roundtable Hold

At this point in the game, Melina should have appeared to you when you rest at a site of grace, and she should have invited you to the Roundtable Hold. The Roundtable Hold serves as the central hub of Elden Ring, where fellow Tarnished and adventurers alike gather. You'll meet more NPCs here and you can request their services such as upgrading your armaments or purchasing items, spells, and more.

Now, if you're following the linear path of the game (in terms of story), by resting at the Site of Grace after defeating Margit the Fell Omen who is guarding the main gate of Stormveil Castle, will have Melina appear and bring you to the roundtable. On the other hand, if you have been exploring and wandering into further regions (at some point upon accidentally reaching the region of Caelid), Melina will appear and invite you over to visit the Roundtable Hold. Now, we are not entirely sure how far you need to explore in terms of you wandering around the map, but to set an example, this triggered Melina to invite us to the Roundtable Hold upon resting at a Site of Grace when we were somewhere in Caelid.

Either way, we highly suggest you make further preparations such as strengthening your Weapons by using the smithing table at Church of Elleh, and if you want to have an advantage during the battle against Margit the Fell Omen, purchase the Margit's Shackle item from Patches who's at Murkwater Cave. Margit's Shackle is a reusable consumable item that stuns/binds Margit for a few seconds. However, this can only be used twice per fight and only in the first phase. For future purposes, it can also be used against Morgott, the Omen King. If you're ready, proceed to Stormveil Castle and get ready to fight Margit the Fell Omen - you can find our strategy guide and video guide on how to beat this boss on our Margit the Fell Omen page.

There is a place in Leyndell Royal Capital that looks exactly like the Roundtable Hold, only that the NPCs found in Roundtable Hold are not there, giving us the idea that the Roundtable Hold seems to be the same place but located in a parallel realm.
It's required to visit the Roundtable Hold to enter Leyndell, Royal Capital.
Confessors including Crepus served the Two Fingers of the Roundtable Hold as assassins.
As of Patch 1.08, players can interact with the statue next to Roderika to access any of the three Colosseums. Note that in order to do so, players must have visited any of them previously.

title: Steel-Wire Torch, Furlcalling Finger Remedy
text: Go down the stairs and climb the ladder. On the rampart you'll find a Furlcalling Finger Remedy and the Steel-Wire Torch.
Steel-Wire Torch: Torch. Found on a corpse at the end of a narrow path at the top level of the castle. Guarded by two harpies.

Furlcalling Finger Remedy: Multiplayer Item. Found on a corpse to the right of the gallows on the top level on the castle. This area is accessed by hugging the right wall from the main courtyard area, past the burning corpses and harpies and then following the linear path to reach the roof.

title: Talk to Edgar, Sacrificial Twig 1x
text: Climb the ladder on the rampart, then drop down for a Golden Rune [2] hanging off the edge of a bridge.
Golden Rune [2]: Looted off a corpse by the ledge of the wooden fence.
On the right side past the bridge is a ladder that leads to a corpse with Smithing Stone [2] x2.
Smithing Stone [2] B: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse being chopped up by a Misbegotten.
Descend the ladder on the left side past the bridge for a Golden Rune [2] near the clashing enemies.
Go up the wooden stairs and talk to Edgar to receive a Sacrificial Twig, then deliver him Irina's Letter.
Edgar: Edgar can be found sitting on a bench up on the ramparts of Castle Morne .
Sacrificial Twig 1x: Give the letter to Edgar and he'll give you x1 Sacrificial Twig.

place.title: Castle Morne
walk: This is an optional dungeon area that is not as large as the regular Legacy Dungeons. Players may find this castle by wandering the paths along Southern Limgrave and The Weeping Peninsula. Some NPCs encountered around Limgrave may speak about this castle, as well. If players come across the Bridge of Sacrifice, they may encounter Irina, an escapee of the castle south of the bridge, referring to Castle Morne. Map Coordinates

Upon riding the lift up to Castle Morne, you'll see the Misbegotten enemies all around the castle grounds. As you enter, make a hard left and go up the steps where you'll see a bonfire. There are two Rotten Stray enemies here, kill the hounds and loot the body to find x1 Smithing Stone (2). Go back down to the courtyard section where the Misbegotten enemies are and continue going straight. You can fight them if you want, but you'll easily be outnumbered. Or you can sneak around by moving to the left side where there are about three Rotten Stray enemies.
## The Pumpkin Head

As you move forward, you'll notice a Lesser Pumpkin Head sitting on the ground. This enemy could drop x1 Pumpkin Helm and/or x1 Sanctuary Stone. From where the Lesser Pumpkin Head was sitting, look to the left, behind the tree to find a corpse in a sitting position, pillage the body to find x3 Smithing Stone (1). On the right side, is a narrow path that is blocked by a single Misbegotten. You can sneak behind to backstab it - continue up the stairs and climb up the ladder at the end.

As you reach the top, a single Misbegotten enemy will rush in to attack you. Be ready to take it out. Head up the stairs where you'll see countless bodies of men hanged, and ahead of the path, is another Misbegotten on the left side of the runway, while two Winged Misbegotten are just a few steps ahead. You'll also notice on the right that there is a body that's hanging by the ledge of the wooden fence, you can loot the body to find x1 Golden Rune (2). Go straight towards another bonfire where you can pick up x1 Smoldering Butterfly.
## Find the Site of Grace

Now, go back to the spot where the two Winged Misbegotten enemies were, check the left side to find a ladder that you can climb down. Move forward along the runway where you'll see a single Misbegotten at the end, near another corpse that can be pillaged. Don't run forward since there is another Misbegotten enemy hiding behind the barrels on the right. It will jump and attack you the moment you are close to it. Kill both enemies and loot the corpse to find x2 Smithing Stone (2). Retrace your steps, and climb the ladder back to the top - from where you got the Smoldering Butterfly material, look to your right and you'll see a part of the stone fence broken, you can jump down to find the Behind the Castle Site of Grace. Map Coordinates

After discovering the site and resting if needed, jump down to the lower section of the cliffs until you set foot on the platforms of the castle. Look to your left towards the broken stone fence and you'll see there's a wooden platform below with a corpse that can be looted. Jump down and pillage the body to find x1 Stonesword Key Map Coordinates. Jump down and you'll encounter more Misbegotten enemies ahead. On the right side, however, is an open gate that leads to a prison cell.
## Get the Twinblade Talisman

Inside that prison cell, there is a single Misbegotten enemy here that you can backstab. Kill it and then loot the body here to find x1 Pickled Turtle Neck. Move away as soon as you grab the item to avoid getting hit by the Skeletal Slime enemy that will drop from above. On the left side of the prison cell, you'll see a spirit NPC locked in a cage. Speak to it and it will plead for help. There isn't anything special here, so you can go back outside and take out the Misbegotten enemies one at a time as you move northwest.

Walk along the runway, kill the Misbegotten and Skeletal Slime enemies. On the other side, you'll see a bigger Misbegotten. Kill the enemy, and grab x2 Smoldering Butterfly near the bonfire. Climb the ladder to the top of the tower and circle around to find a treasure chest containing x1 Twinblade Talisman. Next, go back down, walk towards the runway (facing southeast), look to the right, and you'll see that you can jump down on the roof of what seems to be a castle gazebo. Jump on the roof and then to the ground to find two things, there is a special-looking Teardrop Scarab that you can kill which gives an additional usage for your Flask of Crimson Tears. You'll find it hiding by a bush, and you can identify it with its glow and a ringing sound. Also, there's a tree nearby, check it to find a body next to it that can be pillaged to find x3 Tarnished Golden Sunflower.
## Drop Down to the Next Site of Grace

Continue moving east until you've set foot on the east section of the castle. You'll notice that there is a square opening on the ground that you can enter. Below, there is a narrow beam, on that beam is a corpse with an item, x1 Smithing Stone (2). Drop down on the next beam but don't go all the way down since there is mischief (group of Rats) and a single Misbegotten. We suggest you stay on the second beam and kill it one at a time while on high ground. If you accidentally fall, just sprint out of the prison cell, and fight them outside where there's more space for you to move around.

Inside that cell with the mischief, there's a body that you can loot to find x1 Whip. And outside, you can grab x1 Smoldering Butterfly near the bonfire, and if you go left, around the corner, you'll find the Beside the Rampart Gaol site of grace. Next, cross the narrow wooden bridge, as you approach the other end, move slowly since there are two Misbegotten enemies here, a winged one, and the other large variant that wields a large axe. In that spot where the two enemies were, there's another body next to the barrels and crates, loot it to find x8 Throwing Dagger.
## Loot the Somber Smithing Stone

Next, climb down the nearby ladder where you'll see multiple Spirit Jellyfish enemies. These aren't hostile and remain at rest unless you attack them. Move around to the left side of the ladder and you'll see an entrance that can only be entered by going through the gold mist. Before you enter, explore the nearby edges of the water to find a Somber Smithing Stone. Beyond it is the boss for this location, Leonine Misbegotten - make sure you have made further preparations before fighting this boss, you can visit our Leonine Misbegotten page for guides on how to defeat this boss.
## Boss and Finishing Up

Defeating Leonine Misbegotten drops x1 Grafted Blade Greatsword and 3800 Runes. There still are some sections of the castle you'll need to explore here, so after the battle, first, make sure to examine the Morne Moangrave site of grace at the boss arena then fast travel back to the Castle Morne Lift site. Ride the elevator up and this time, you will need to explore the section on the right where there are multiple Misbegotten enemies standing on a pile of bones and corpses. You could try to sneak behind them.

If you're able to pass, there's a doorway that you can enter. Inside the armory, by the doorway, there's a chest on the left, open it to find x1 Claymore. Continue straight, down the stairs, and head outside where you'll see two Misbegotten enemies attacking a Godrick Soldier. Clear the path and climb up the nearby ladder. At the top, you'll see more Godrick Soldiers fight against the Misbegotten. You can simply watch them fight first, and whoever is left, you can finish them off.

Upon clearing the area, on the right side, there's another ladder that goes up, an execution podium at the center, and a path that you can explore on the left. Check the podium first and you can find x1 Furlcalling Finger Remedy looted off a corpse. While on the left side of the podium, there's also another body that's being guarded by two more Misbegotten enemies. Search the corpse to find x1 Steel-Wire Torch. Go back and climb up the other ladder on the right.

Return to the castle grounds, specifically where there are piles of bodies and Misbegotten enemies around a corpse that is tied to a wooden beam that is burning. Clear out the enemies and check the pile to find some corpses that can be looted such as x2 Fire Grease, Smoldering Butterfly that is flying around the flames.

Now, if you were able to speak to Irina (and exhausting her dialogue), she'll ask you to give a letter to her father, Edgar, a warden who's in Castle Morne. Irina can be found sitting on a rock just beyond the Bridge of Sacrifice, at the start of the main road in the eastern Weeping Peninsula Interactive Map Location. To deliver the letter, from the Castle Morne Lift site, go up the lift, and make a right just after the Lesser Pumpkin Head and climb the ladder.

At the top of the ladder, go over the runway with the hanging corpses, continuing up both sets up stairs until you reach the first turret in the SE corner. Then either drop down from the wooden platform in between the turrets, or you could just take the ladder on the left down- and continue until you reach the end, (avoiding or dispatching the multiple enemies along the way). At the end up this area (back at the front of the castle, in the NE corner) go up and around the wooden stairs on the right where you'll find Edgar sitting atop the turret. Give the letter and he'll give you x1 Sacrificial Twig. If you spoke to Edgar before clearing the castle, he will mention that he still must defend the castle and recover a sword before he can return to Irina.

This means that you just need to clear out the castle by defeating Leonine Misbegotten and acquiring the Grafted Blade Greatsword, by doing so, return to Edgar and he'll mention that he is in your debt, that he is no longer bound by duty, and he can now return to Irina. (Note that if you have already killed the Leonine Misbegotten before you first talk to Edgar, you will have to rest at a site of grace and then talk to him again to finish out his quest dialogue. I spoke to him for the first time after defeating the boss and had no such issues.) This almost completes Castle Morne and the Father-Daughter questline of Irina and Edgar. Map Coordinates for Edgar's position - Return to Irina for the final [maybe] chapter of the questline.

title: Stonesword Key
text: Head back down and step on the brick rubble at the end of the rampart, then jump over the fence to grab the Behind the Castle grace.
Drop to the top of a rampart, then drop down southwest to land on a wooden platform with a Stonesword Key.

Stonesword Key: Stonesword Key . Found on a corpse partially hanging from a wooden platform. The platform can be found by walking down west from the nearby Site of Grace and back onto a section of the castle. Look to the left edge.

title: Twinblade Talisman
text: Enter the room below to find a corpse with Pickled Turtle Neck.
Climb the ladder across the bridge for a chest containing the Twinblade Talisman.
Twinblade Talisman: Talisman. Found in the tower section of the walls of Castle Morne. Climb up the ladder and go around the tower to find a chest containing the talisman.

title: Whip
text: Drop onto the rooftop below the bridge and pick up the Tarnished Golden Sunflower x3 next to a tree.
Tarnished Golden Sunflower 10x: Can be found x10 Tarnished Golden Sunflower araund the Erdtree.
Continue down until you reach a castle platform, then drop onto a wooden beam down the hole to pick up Smithing Stone [2].

Smithing Stone [2] C: Upgrade Material. Inside a building known as the Rampart Gaol at the back of the castle. This is the same building where the Whip can be found and is first accessed by walking atop the western walls at the back of the castle from the "Behind the Castle" Site of Grace. There is a building to the left with a blue roof. Jump onto this roof and then down to the cliffs below. Follow the cliffs southeast until you return onto a section of the castle with a square opening. Descend into the opening by using the wooden beams below. The stone can be found on a corpse on one of these wooden beams.
In the room at the bottom sits a corpse with the Whip.

Whip: Whip. Found on a corpse inside the building known as the Rampart Gaol. This building is first accessed by walking atop the western wall of the castle. Look to the left for a building with a blue roof. Jump onto this roof and then jump down to the cliffs below. Follow the cliffs southeast until you return to a section of the castle with a big square opening. Descend into the opening by landing on the wooden beams. There is a corpse with a Smithing Stone [2] on one of the beams and there are several Rats and a Harpy at the ground level. The corpse with the whip is sitting against a wall.

title: Boss: Leonine Misbegotten
text: Turn left outside the room to discover the Beside the Rampart Gaol grace.
Cross the wooden bridge to pick up Throwing Dagger x8.
Throwing Dagger: Held by a corpse across the wooden bridge that's in front of Raumpart Gaol at Castle Morne.
Descend the ladder, then head around the side of the structure to find a Somber Smithing Stone [1].
Somber Smithing Stone [1]: Found at the edge of the sea.
In the narrow passage north-northeast of the ladder is a corpse with Fire Arrow x15.
Kill Leonine Misbegotten for Grafted Blade Greatsword and 3,800 runes. (This earns an achievement.)

Leonine Misbegotten: Optional Greater Enemy Boss. Can be found by heading southeast from the "Beside the Rampart Gaol" Site of Grace, through the wooden bridge and down a ladder onto the shores below. Drops the Grafted Blade Greatsword upon defeat.
Grafted Blade Greatsword: Greatsword. Dropped by Leonine Misbegotten upon defeat.
Optional: Edgar's summon sign can be found outside the entrance if you gave him Irina's Letter.
There are no items in the arena, so go ahead and activate the Morne Moangrave grace.
Optional: Return to Edgar and exhaust his dialogue.
Travel to the Bridge of Sacrifice and talk to Edgar beside Irina's corpse.
Optional: Collect all non-respawning crafting materials in Weeping Peninsula.

links.t: Video: non-respawning crafting materials in Weeping Peninsula

title: Boss: Margit, the Fell Omen
text: From Stormhill Shack, follow the uphill road to the castle entrance. Head inside and grab the Castleward Tunnel grace in an alcove.
Defeat Margit, the Fell Omen for Talisman Pouch and 12,000 runes. (This earns an achievement.)
Margit, the Fell Omen: A large, apparently elder creature, self-proclaimed as "The last of all kings". Drops Talisman Pouch and 12000 Runes upon defeat.
Talisman Pouch: Small, withered bag, knitted by hand. Bestowed upon the ruling lord, or those atempting to become lord, by the elderly Finger Reader. Dropped by Margit, the Fell Omen upon defeat.
miss: Margit disappears if Morgott is killed first, and Morgott will drop the Talisman Pouch instead.

title: Furlcalling Finger Remedy
text: Optional: Rogier's summon sign can be found outside the entrance.
Activate the Margit, the Fell Omen grace, then grab the Stormveil Main Gate grace in front of the gate.
Descend the stairs northeast of the grace for a Furlcalling Finger Remedy.
Furlcalling Finger Remedy: Can be found at Stormveil Castle on the main gate.

title: Talk to Gatekeeper Gostoc
text: Drop to the wooden platform below the stairs to find Fire Grease x2 at the end of a small tunnel.
Fire Grease: Can be found beneath the bridge. You have to drop down onto a ledge on the east side of the bridge to access it.
Optional: Return to the gate and talk to Gostoc. Don't worry about the main gate, you can open it yourself later.
Gatekeeper Gostoc: Gatekeeper Gostoc can be found by the entrance of Stormveil Castle , in the room next to the main gate into the castle

place.title: Stormveil Castle
walk: ## The Castle's Entrance

Once you've cleared out the area, check the spot where the eyrie was to find a corpse that you can loot to find x1 Smithing Stone (3). From the same spot where you picked up the smithing stone, first, go left and work your way around the cliffside, at the end of it, is another body that you can loot to find x10 Bolt. Now, continue towards the overlooking area where you'll find the Stormveil Cliffside Site of Grace, use it to save it as your checkpoint and to rest if needed. There's also another summoning pool on the left side of it.

Once you've defeated the first three guards, go inside and look to the left, there's another arch door where you'll see a body that's sitting by the edge of the platform, but before approaching it, look up, you'll see another Exile Soldier that is ready to shoot you as you approach the body. Take out the enemy first and then loot the corpse to find x1 Golden Rune (2) or you can just quickly grab the item and dodge to avoid getting hit. Now inside and head into the next room which is the castle's wine cellar where you'll encounter two commoner enemies resting by the barrels.
## The Wine Cellar

Go back down from the hole and continue forward towards the narrow path with the archway, be careful here, and be ready to dodge back since there is another Commoner enemy ahead that will throw a bomb at you, as soon as you try to pick up the item by the arch doorway. Sprint and dodge forward to close the gap and then kill the enemy, or you can use a ranged spell to kill it while it's unaware of your presence. You'll also find a body here to pillage to find x3 Smoldering Butterfly.
## The Banished Knight

You may want to keep your distance as you fight the enemy since the knight's swings from the sword have long reach, and aggressively using the shield causes a swirl of wind. One tip is to use Glintblade Phalanx against it since the magical swords will automatically attack, causing the knight to flinch. Successfully defeating the Banished Knight yields 400 runes.
## Wine Cellar - Top Level

Go back a bit and jump across to the platform on your left, go through the archway in the outer wall (you may have noticed some loot in the hole to the right of the archway; ignore it for now). Turn left. An Exile Soldier is on the ramparts, and another guard is down the stairs in the tower. There is a corpse on the ledge behind the second Guard that can be looted to find the Brick Hammer. You can jump down from here if you wish to return to the bottom of the ladder. Otherwise, retrace your steps back to where you came up the ladder. Be ready to sprint and dodge towards the set of stairs since there is a Commoner that is waiting to ambush you by the corner, on the left side.

After defeating the knight, you can make a detour for an Arteria leaf, which you may have seen earlier in the hole in the wall, or continue and head to the second floor (and touch the site of grace first):

Continue to site of grace: Go up the stairs to the second floor and you'll find a large room on the left that hosts the Rampart Tower Site of Grace - take this opportunity to rest and manage your equipment if needed.

Arteria Leaf: Go back outside where you fought the Banished Knight. Go the left side and jump down on the ledge below. Continue to the left along the edge until it ends. Jump down again on the wooden blanks to get the Arteria leaf. Go through the hole and make you way back up again.
## Castle Rooftops
## The Grafted Scion

IMPORTANT NOTE: The Chrysalids' Memento can be given to Roderika to advance her quest. (However, before following these steps, it is advised that you first unlock the short-cut to the Rampart Tower site of grace. Move back into the room where the Grafted Scion was, and enter the doorway on the left (west) to reach an elevator that will bring you up to where it is located.) After unlocking said short-cut, you can now fast travel to the Stormhill Shack site of grace and give her the item, by doing so, make sure to speak to her and she'll mention that she will head to the Roundtable Hold where you can find her later on. If you return to the Hub, you can find her standing by the fireplace, if you speak to her, she will give you x1 Golden Seed as a reward. Once you have progressed her quest further (which can be easily done: at the Roundtable Hold, talk to Roderika and Hewg, always choose the dialogue options about either of them, and eventually, Hewg will agree to teaching Roderika about spirit tuning. You'll know you're done when Roderika is sitting across from Hewg). Once this is done and she has turned into a Spirit tuner, you can find a Crimson Hood where the Chrysalids' Memento was previously.

If you still want to avoid fighting the guardian at this point, you can continue to sneak through by going through the next room on the left from the corpse you've just looted. On the other hand, if you do decide to fight this guardian, you can bait it towards the arch doorway, either one since it won't be able to go through it. Defeating the guardian yields 1176 Runes.
## Courtyard Stock Room
## An Extra Stonesword Key
## Stormveil Castle - Courtyard

At this point, you'll want to rest at a Site of Grace, luckily if you look to your left from the corpse you just looted, there is a room that holds one, on the right side, however, you'll see another Warhawk enemy. As you walk towards the room with the site of grace, look ahead and you'll see a corpse sitting by the ledge. You can loot its body to find x2 Smithing Stone (1) - grab the item and head inside another armory room with the Liftside Chamber site of grace - in this room, there is also a lever that you can activate to call down the lift, riding it will take you to the upper section of the castle.
## Clearing the Castle

Head towards the southeast gate and make your way to the main grounds of the castle, which will lead you down near the entrance of the castle gate. Tread carefully as you make your way to the main grounds since there are Exile Soldiers stationed on the high ground who will shoot with a ballista - be ready to dash and dodge your way until you reach the main castle grounds. If you are intending to clear this area, it is recommended to start from the Castle Gate grace location and run in the front, which (if you zig and you zag) will get you a clear path right up to the ballista shooters, which will clear up the rest of the encounter. Make sure to get the guy up top with a projectile.
## Mini-Boss: Lion Guardian

When you return to the courtyard, tread carefully, since the Lion Guardian will jump in and start to attack you. If you want to gain a bit of advantage to deal large damage before you even aggro the mini-boss, you can crouch and sneak around the runaway, move from the left side and go around to the right, you'll see the Lion Guardian just waiting and hiding on the right side of the runway.

Go back inside the room and you'll notice a lever that you can interact with, have your character push it to open the castle's main gate. Head to the main gate and you'll see some corpses that you can loot to find the following items: x5 Ballista Bolt, x1 Golden Rune (2), and x1 Golden Rune (1). From here, you can now head back to the Secluded Cell Site of Grace and make further preparations before facing Godrick the Grafted.
## Where to find the Claw Talisman
## Facing Godrick the Grafted

By receiving a Great Rune, you can use it to restore the power at Divine Towers throughout the Lands Between. You will need to check the description of each Great Rune to discover which Divine Tower you should visit. At the center of the arena is a lost site of grace that you can examine and activate.
## Godrick the Grafted's Throne Room
## Using Godrick's Great Rune
## Exploring the Castle's Underground Crypt

The path from here is pretty linear and you'll find a pit that you'll need to drop down to, just make further preparations since a strong enemy will appear here. Also, if you notice there are multiple bodies in the pit that you can loot, there is a Stonesword Key among these. Take care of that later and fight the enemy first. As soon as you drop down, the creature will appear from the ground. The Ulcerated Tree Spirit is a towering, centipede-like creature that heavily features bodies composed of tree-like structures.
## Where to find the Crucible Knight
notes: Speak to Gatekeeper Gostoc at the castle's gatehouse.
Enter the castle using the secret, back entrance.
Find Sorcerer Rogier at the castle's chapel.
Meet Nepheli before reaching Godrick the Grafted.
Defeat Godrick the Grafted and claim his Great Rune.
Explore the Castle's Crypt.

title: Marred Leather Shield
text: Go through the hole in the wall and pick up the Golden Rune [1] immediately on the left, then the Ruin Fragment x3 on the nearby ledge.
Golden Rune [1] B: Looted from one of the three bodies at the entrance of Stormveil Castle.
Continue to a broken wall but instead of dropping down, climb it up to discover a corpse with Smithing Stone [2].
Smithing Stone [2] A: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on the outside of the castle walls. Reachable by climbing on broken sections nearby.
After dropping down, head south-southeast and down the slope to find Bolt x10 at the end.
Head up the slope for a Smithing Stone [3] guarded by Stormhawks on the left side.
Smithing Stone [3] A: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse around the southwestern cliffs. Watch out for the Bladed Talon Eagles roosting in the area.
Continue north and drop down to discover the Stormveil Cliffside grace.
Pick up Marred Leather Shield from the corpse up the first set of stairs.
Marred Leather Shield: Shield. Found on a corpse on a wooden platform, outside the castle walls.

title: Hookclaws
text: Before you enter the castle, pick up the Golden Rune [2] on the scaffolding around the entrance.
Golden Rune [2] B: Found on a dead body on a wooden platform in the back entrance.
Head inside and loot the Hookclaws in a corner on the first floor.
Hookclaws: Claw weapon. Found on a corpse in the corner of a small corridor on the first level of the wine cellar, filled with crates and patrolled by a single Castle Guard.

title: Rusty Key, Curved Sword Talisman
text: Note: Gostoc will now steal 30% of your runes each time you die inside the castle.
Go up the stairs and pick up the Throwing Dagger x5 in a narrow passage next to a locked door.
Pick up St. Trina's Arrow x10 from a hole in the wall covered with vines.
Back inside, jump to the ledge east-southeast of the hole for a Golden Rune [2], then back across to grab the Smoldering Butterfly x3 in front of the barrels.
Golden Rune [2] C: Found on a wooden platform that can be reached by falling from above.
Smoldering Butterfly: Can be found Stormveil Castle in the Underground Crypt area on a dead body inside the Root Monster room.
Enter the room at the top. Kill the knight to unlock the door, then loot the corpse for Rusty Key and the chest for Curved Sword Talisman.
Rusty Key: Key Item. Found on a corpse inside the room with the Banished Knight.
Curved Sword Talisman: Talisman. Found in Stormveil Castle, a chest inside a dark room in the Wine Cellar with the Banished Knight .

title: Brick Hammer
text: Unlock the earlier door and step through the doorway at the top of the ladder. This will trigger Gostoc to spawn on the first floor. Talk to him to receive a Grace Mimic. [Location 2]
Grace Mimic: Consumable. Given as a reward by a non-hostile Commoner NPC sitting on the roof of a building. Use the ladder nearby to reach him.
Kill the greataxe-wielding soldier next to him, then return to the top of the ladder. Head northwest first for a Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot.
Head outside and go around the ledge below the stairs to find Mushroom x3.
Mushroom: Can be found at Stormveil Castle , on a dead body down stars.
Ascend the outside stairs, then the first set of stairs inside. Grab the Rampart Tower grace in the north room, but do not rest at it.

Head out the north exit and run for the downward staircase that leads to a rooftop past the Stormhawks. Either kill them or lose their aggro, then fast travel to the Rampart Tower grace. You should now see Gostoc behind a nearby lift. Talk to him and he'll stop stealing your runes. Also pick up the Drawstring Fire Grease x2 beside him.
Drawstring Fire Grease: Two of them can be looted from a corpse located at Stormveil Castle.

Note: If he's not there, check to see if he's stuck at his earlier location. Clear his path of enemies, run to the stairs past the Stormhawks without resting, then teleport to the Rampart Tower and he should appear. [Location 4]
Descend the stairs with a Banished Knight close by and look for thorny vines outside. Drop to the ledge below the vines and follow it to a hole in the wall with Arteria Leaf x3.
Arteria Leaf: Can be found at Stormveil Castle . There is an Arteria Leaf inside the tower, guarded by a Giant Bat
Drop onto the wooden platform inside, then go across the plank for a corpse with Fire Grease.
Jump to the elevated platform near the plank and head down the outside scaffolding to pick up the Brick Hammer.
Brick Hammer: Can be found on the 3rd floor. It is in a corpse dangling from a window.You have to access from the 4th floor, using the wooden platforms outside.
miss: This Grace Mimic is missable if not received before you kill Godrick.

Turn left. An Exile Soldier is on the ramparts, and another guard is down the stairs in the tower. There is a corpse on the ledge behind the second Guard that can be looted to find the Brick Hammer. Arteria Leaf: Go back outside where you fought the Banished Knight. Go the left side and jump down on the ledge below. Continue to the left along the edge until it ends. Jump down again on the wooden blanks to get the Arteria leaf. Go through the hole and make you way back up again.

title: Marred Wooden Shield
text: Travel to the Rampart Tower and head outside toward the Stormhawks. Drop down below the left side balcony and pick up the Marred Wooden Shield below a narrow ledge.

Marred Wooden Shield: Medium Shield. From the Rampart Tower site of grace, exit onto the walkway with explosive barrels and War Hawks . Kill the War Hawk sitting on the western tower and then jump down the edge onto a ledge below. Follow the ledge north and jump down to the broken pillar below to find the shield.

title: Ash of War: Storm Assault
text: Continue down until the platform collapses. After landing, take out the scarab to obtain Ash of War: Storm Assault.

Ash of War: Storm Assault: Starting from the Rampart Tower grace, exit onto the ramparts where the war hawks and explosive barrels are. At the tower on the west side where the second war hawk holding an explosive barrel is, jump up onto the battlements on the north side. There is a corpse visible with an item (Marred Wooden Shield). Jumping down to the walls beneath will allow the player to get to the shield. Jumping down further will land the player on a ledge that will collapse, causing them to fall far below into some bushes. A Silver Teardrop Scarab holds the Ash of War

title: Aspects of the Crucible: Horns
text: Kill the Crucible Knight for Aspects of the Crucible: Horns. If you want to play it safe, you could run a short distance past him to grab a shortcut lift.
Aspects of the Crucible: Horns: Incantation. Dropped by Crucible Knight found at the bottom floor of the Rampart Tower

title: Dozing Cross-Legged Gesture, Dozing Cross-Legged +1
text: Pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [2] in the alcove near the Crucible Knight.
Take the shortcut lift back to the Rampart Tower and go up the stairs. Jump across the lift's wheels to pick up Throwing Dagger x5.
Continue outside to pick up a Golden Rune [2] from a wooden platform.
Golden Rune [2] D: x2 Found at the top of the castle on a dead body over a platform.
Jump onto the stone fence and follow it to the southeast tower. Then, jump to the ledge around the east tower and drop down inside it for a Stonesword Key.
Pick up the Dozing Cross-Legged gesture from the corpse on the rooftop below.
Dozing Cross-Legged Gesture: Gesture. Found on a corpse on the largest roof in the area. Accessible from the top floor of the Rampart Tower with careful platforming.
Stonesword Key: At Stormveil Castle's Underground Crypt.

title: Claw Talisman
text: Head around the narrow ledge of the tower west of the gesture to find a corpse with Smithing Stone [2] x2.
Smithing Stone [2] C: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on the rooftops accessible from the top of the very top of the Rampart Tower.
Go back to the rooftops, then go around the ledge up a slanted pillar. Climb the ladder in front of a tower and pick up the Claw Talisman at the top.
Claw Talisman: Talisman. Found on a corpse atop a tower accessible by ladder. The tower has several none-hostile Eagles at the top.

title: Talk to Sorcerer Rogier
text: Return to the Rampart Tower and loot the Smithing Stone [2] at the end of the rampart with the Stormhawks.
Smithing Stone [2] B: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on an upper platform where Castle Guards are mounted on ballistae.
A corpse with Golden Rune [2] lies on the rooftop down the stairs.
Golden Rune [2] A: Looted from one of the three bodies at the entrance of Stormveil Castle.
From the corpse, turn southeast and jump to the lower part of the roof for Kukri x5.
Optional: Enter through the window and talk to Rogier next to the altar. Answer that you're here to defeat Godrick.

Sorcerer Rogier: Sorcerer Rogier Location 1. Friendly NPC who sells Ashes of War . Initially met in the Chapel in the western section of the Castle. After you defeat Godrick, he moves to the Roundtable Hold .

title: Mimic's Veil
text: Exit the church and continue to a room with Golden Rune [2] x2.
Golden Rune [2] H: Found on a dead body laying on the roof in the northern section of the castle.
Continue until you reach a room with a Banished Knight, then open the chest next to a table for Mimic's Veil.
Mimic's Veil: Reusable Key Item. Found in a chest inside the assembly room with the large war table. There is a Banished Knight in this room.

title: Highland Axe, Boss: Grafted Scion +1
text: Exit the room the way you entered, then climb the sacks against the fence to an area with a Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot.
Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot: Can be found at a stone balcony, above one of the rooms.
Head up the wooden platform and climb the ladder at its end. Drop down straight ahead and enter the dark room for a Stonesword Key and a chest with Pickled Turtle Neck x3.
Turn back and open the shortcut door, then descend the stairs to the dark room. Below the staircase lies an Exalted Flesh.
Exalted Flesh: Can be found on a corpse in the back of the first floor.
Loot the Highland Axe and Stanching Boluses from the room with the Grafted Scion (won't respawn if killed).
Highland Axe: Axe. Found in the same hall as the Grafted Scion miniboss, under a large painting.
Grafted Scion: Optional Miniboss. Patrols the main hall of his fortress. No special drops.
Stonesword Key: Held by a corpse above the Grafted Scion .

title: Crimson Hood
text: At the west-southwest end of the room is a shortcut lift back to the Rampart Tower if you need to rest.
Enter the south-southeast room to pick up Crimson Hood, Lump of Flesh, and Golden Rune [1] around a pile of corpses.

Crimson Hood: Roderika's questline must be completed and spirit tuning must be unlocked for this item to appear on top of the pile of corpses surrounded by the Rotten Strays where the Chrysalids' Memento was acquired.
Golden Rune [1] C: Found on a pile of limbs and dead bodies in the main courtyard.

title: Hawk Crest Wooden Shield, Misericorde +1
text: Note: If Roderika still hasn't moved to Roundtable Hold, you'll find the Chrysalid's Memento instead of the hood. You'll need to follow her questline at the roundtable until she becomes a spirit tuner. She'll then throw away her hood, which replaces the memento.
Enter the north-northwest room and pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [2] beneath the statue on the right.
Unlock the imp seal and loot the Hawk Crest Wooden Shield, Misericorde, and Iron Whetblade in the room.
Hawk Crest Wooden Shield: Medium Shield. Found on a corpse inside the Armory. Requires a Stonesword Key to dispel the fog gate barring entry.
Misericorde: Dagger. Found on a corpse inside the Armory. Requires a Stonesword Key in order to dispel the fog gate barring entry.
Iron Whetblade: Key Item. Found on a corpse inside the Armory. Requires a Stonesword Key in order to dispel the fog gate barring entry.

title: Godslayer's Seal, Godskin Prayerbook
text: Head through the remaining doorway in the dark room. Immediately on the left is a staircase that leads to Arrow x10 on a wooden platform.
Arrow: Ammunition. Found on a corpse atop some rocks near the Seethewater River Site of Grace
Enter the courtyard, then immediately head left to find a cellar entrance. Pick up the Fireproof Dried Liver beside a table.
Unlock the imp seal and open the two chests to obtain Godslayer's Seal and Godskin Prayerbook.

Godslayer's Seal: Found in a room barred by an Imp Statue seal, requiring a to access. From the Rampart Tower, take the lift that leads to the Grafted Scion 's hall. Exit into the courtyard where plenty of Castle Guards are mounted on ballistae. Take a hard left from this exit to find a small stairway leading into a cellar. There are several Rats in this cellar and the Imp Statue barrier behind them. The Seal is found in one of the chests behind the barrier.

Godskin Prayerbook: Can be found at Stormveil Castle , Nearest Site of Grace: Rampart Tower. From the Rampart Tower site of grace, go out the door to the outside (where the birds are). Take a running jump onto the roof across from the door. On the left side of the roof, there will be two separate areas you can drop down to. Drop down to the one without stairs on it, and drop down again. You'll land by a set of steps going down. Go down the steps to find some rats and a white fog wall. You'll need a Stonesword Key to pass through the fog wall, and inside will be two chests. One contains the Godskin Prayerbook, the other contains the Godslayer's Seal . Alternatively, from the Liftside Chamber Site of Grace, exit from the door to the courtyard and turn right. Hug the right side wall past all the enemies. You'll find the set of stairs going down on the wall on the other side.

title: Festering Bloody Finger
text: Pick up the Golden Rune [4] on the outside ledge. Remember this ledge, because you'll return here to drop down later.
Golden Rune [4] A: Looted from a dead body hanging from the higher level.
For now, climb the ladder to the left of the cellar exit and pick up Arrow x10 from behind a barrel.
Continue to another ladder. At the top of it lies a corpse with Festering Bloody Finger x3.
Festering Bloody Finger: Can be found x3 Festering Bloody Finger at Stormveil Castle on a rooftop, in the courtyard

title: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [10]
text: Note: Skip this step until you've received the Festering Bloody Fingers from Varre during South Liurnia. Picking it up now makes About Invasion Multiplayer unobtainable for the rest of the playthrough. For more info, see Varre's questline.
Continue past the Banished Knights and across the wooden bridge for a ladder that leads to the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [10] on a wooden platform.

Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [10]: Can be found on a dead body in Stormveil Castle . From Rampart Tower (Site of Grace), head out the north door. Jump to the roof immediately visible to the east. Follow the left ledge, then jump down to the level with the 2 enemies (optional combat). Cross the bridge, the recipe is on the corpse directly ahead guarded by 2 weak enemies.

title: Wooden Greatshield
text: From the wooden platform, jump onto the roof next to it, then drop down the hole to find a corpse with Wooden Greatshield.
Wooden Greatshield: Greatshield. Found in a guardhouse near the northern section of the castle courtyard.

title: Furlcalling Finger Remedy
text: Head down the stairs and look to the right past some trees to find Mushroom x8 in a corner.
On the nearby stairs lies a corpse with Furlcalling Finger Remedy.
Furlcalling Finger Remedy: One is held by a corpse at Stormveil Castle , reached by descending through the stairs beside Stormveil Front Gates Site of Grace

title: Prophecy Painting
text: Pick up the Smithing Stone [1] x2 in the alley west of the stairs, then grab the Liftside Chamber grace in the room next to it.
Smithing Stone [1]: Upgrade Material. 4 can be found on a corpse in the same room where Nepheli Loux is.
Enter the courtyard and grab the "Prophecy" Painting from the room on the west side.
Prophecy Painting: Info Item. Found by inspecting the large painting inside a building in the northwest section of the main courtyard.

title: Pike
text: Loot the Magic Grease, Golden Rune [1], 2x Golden Rune [2], Pike, and Smoldering Butterfly x5 around the flamespitters in the courtyard.
Pike: Can be looted off a corpse that's lying on the heavily guarded courtyard. The nearest checkpoint is the Liftside Chamber site of grace
Golden Rune [1] D: Found on one of the dead bodies at the ramp in the northern section of the main courtyard.
Golden Rune [2] F: x2 Found on one of the dead bodies at the ramp in the northern section of the main courtyard.

Smoldering Butterfly: Can be found at the Stormveil Castle courtyard, there are some corpses you can loot to find x1 Magic Grease , x1 Golden Rune (1), x2 Golden Rune (2), x1 Pike1, and x5 Smoldering Butterfly.

title: Commoner's Simple Garb
text: Pick up the Golden Rune [4] and Kukri x5 on the incline that leads up to the courtyard.
Golden Rune [4] B: Found on one of the dead bodies at the ramp in the northern section of the main courtyard.
Return to the courtyard and pick up Fire Arrow x12 from a wooden guard post.
Head through the cellar again and drop down the ledge from earlier. Pick up the Smithing Stone [2] behind the ballistas, then go down the stairs for a Smithing Stone [1].
Smithing Stone [2] E: Upgrade Material. Found behind some explosive barrels on the top level of the castle walls accessed from the Rampart Tower.
Smithing Stone [1]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse by a staircase leading to a platform with ballistae emplacements.
Enter the room to the right of the main gate to grab a Golden Rune [5] and the Gateside Chamber grace.
Golden Rune [5] A: Looted from one of the three bodies behind the Stormveil Main Gate
Through the door past the grace sits a corpse with Commoner's Simple Garb.
Commoner's Simple Garb: Chest Armor. Found on a corpse on the balcony accessible from the Gateside Chamber Site of Grace.

title: Arbalest
text: Push the lever to open the main gate if Gostoc didn't do it earlier, then loot the Ballista Bolt x5, Golden Rune [2], and Golden Rune [1] behind the gate.
Golden Rune [2] E: Found on a dead body in a room with very long tables one level below the top one.
Golden Rune [1] A: Found on a dead body by the Effigy.
Kill the Elder Lion in the corner on the right at the top of the slope for Somber Smithing Stone [1], Beast Blood, and Old Fang x2.
Somber Smithing Stone [1]: Upgrade Material. Dropped by the Lion Guardian east of the castle courtyard.
Beast Blood: Can be acquierd at Stormveil Castle by defeating the Lion Guardian.
Old Fang: Can be acquierd at Stormveil Castle main castle grounds by defeating the Lion Guardian.
Go through the east-northeast corridor to grab the Limgrave Tower Bridge grace for later.

Head back through the corridor and to a doorway that leads to multiple sets of stairs. Jump up the rocks left of the stairs, then onto the cliff on the opposite side to grab the Arbalest from a walled area.

Arbalest: Using a Stonesword Key to access, additionally obtaining the Godskin prayerbook and Godslayer Seal: From the Rampart Tower bonfire, take the shortcut lift down to where the Grafted miniboss is fought inside the storeroom (or reach this point manually). Exit into the courtyard with the flamethrowers and barricades. Take an immediate left and hug the wall until you enter a cellar containing rats. You will hit a fog wall that requires one Stonesword Key to open. Continue past this fog wall until you reach an outdoors area again. Pull an immediate right and hug the wall until you reach a ladder. Continue past this point and almost all the way across the bridge, then jump to the rocky outcropping to your right (it's a tight jump). Continue and jump back into a walled-in area with a ballista. The Arbalest is on a corpse in that area.

title: Talk to Nepheli Loux
text: Travel to the Liftside Chamber, go up the nearby stairs, then up the staircase on the left that leads to a Smithing Stone [2].
Smithing Stone [2] F: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse sitting on an upper ledge in the corridor leading up to the Secluded Chamber site of grace.
Turn back and head past the spiked barricades for a Golden Rune [2] beside some breakable crates.
Golden Rune [2] I: Found on the roof of the castle in the northern section.
Enter the room on the right and exhaust Nepheli's dialogue for a talisman later.

Nepheli Loux: Nepheli Loux Location 1. A fellow Tarnished warrior NPC found in a small room near the north of the castle. The entrance to this room is behind the courtyard, along the path leading up to the huge steps guarded by a Troll.
miss: To receive the Arsenal Charm from Nepheli in Roundtable Hold, you must exhaust her dialogue in Stormveil Castle before killing Godrick.

title: Golden Seed
text: Pick up the Smithing Stone [1] x4 in the corner of the room.
Smithing Stone [1]: Held by a corpse sitting against a grave, surrounded by Spirit Jellyfishes and Skeleton Enemies .
Exit the room and pick up the Golden Seed between two trees to the right of the path.
Golden Seed: Flask Upgrade Material. Found next to a Phantom Tree in the northeastern section of the castle, behind the courtyard. This tree is outside the cellar where you meet Nepheli Loux .

title: Ash of War: Stormcaller
text: In an alley between two houses on the right, you'll find a Smithing Stone [2].
Smithing Stone [2] D: Upgrade Material. Held by a corpse outside the room where Nepheli Loux is located, passing the wooden barricades to the west and up the stairs on your right.
Bait the Troll into following you and attacking the fallen statue back in the courtyard to obtain 5x Smithing Stone [1] and a Smithing Stone [2].
Return to the stairs and grab the Secluded Cell grace in the room on the right before the boss.
Kill the scarab past the southwest doorway to obtain Ash of War: Stormcaller.
Ash of War: Stormcaller: Ash of War Upgrade. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in the northern section of the castle.

title: Cracked Pot
text: Pick up the 2x Cracked Pot behind the Living Jars in the back.
Cracked Pot: Found behind the Living Jar enemies between the Secluded Cell and Liftside Chamber (after 2nd shortcut) Sites of Grace .

title: Manor Towershield
text: Optional: Beyond the south-southeast doorway is a shortcut lift that goes down to the Liftside Chamber.
On a wooden ledge northeast of the jars sits a corpse with Kukri x8.
Jump to the ledge on the wall and follow it to a ledge with two archways. In the area past them, you'll find Lump of Flesh x3.
Climb the sacks and head through the doorway. At the top of the room, turn right for Smithing Stone [2] x3 on a wooden ledge.
Pick up Golden Rune [2] and Smithing Stone [1] from a corner before the next room.
Golden Rune [2] G: Found on a dead body sitting on the ground in the wine cellar where you meet Nepheli Loux .
Beneath the stairs at the bottom floor of the room, you'll find the Manor Towershield.

Manor Towershield: Greatshield. From the Secluded Cell site of grace, backtrack to the west and up the ramp where the Living Jars are and turn around towards the wooden platform. At the end of the platform, jump onto the ledge on the wall and follow it to the right towards some archways. Past the archways, enter the storage room on the right and head up the stairs to a walkway above. Head to the left towards a larger storage room full of Commoners . You can find the shield under the second set of stairs in this room.

title: Rancorcall
text: Pick up the Smithing Stone [3] next to the glowing message outside.
Drop onto the ledge below and make your way down to a Golden Rune [5] hanging off a balcony.
Golden Rune [5] B: Found on a dead body reached by a walking on a ledge at the outer side of the northern section of the castle.
Grab the Rainbow Stone x5 inside, then open the shortcut door east of the corpse.
Rainbow Stone: Can be found on a corpse near the Lifside Chamber site of grace. You can only access if you head through the hidden passage and drop down.
Return to the corpse and jump across the broken platforms to reach a corpse with Arteria Leaf on the other side.
At the end of a broken buttress sits a corpse with Smithing Stone [2] x2.
Drop to the bottom for a Golden Rune [2] in the corner.
Pick up the Poisonbloom x3 past the rats, then kill the scarab just past it to obtain Rancorcall.
Rancorcall: Dropped from a Teardrop Scarab that can be found at the underground crypt of the castle
Poisonbloom: Can be found at Stormveil Castle Castle's Underground Crypt, on a dead body nex to the ruins.

title: Golden Seed +1
text: Kill the Ulcerated Tree Spirit in the arena below for a Golden Seed. This will also unlock Rogier's dialogue about the corpse under Stormveil for later.
