Golden Seed: Obtained by defeating a Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit in the underground area of Stormveil Castle. This area can be accessed via a hidden path above the door of the room with some Living Jar enemies, or by making a damaging drop outside the Liftside Chamber Site of Grace.
Ulcerated Tree Spirit: Found at the bottom of a gutter. The entrance to the crypt is found near the Liftside Chamber site of grace within Stormveil Castle . Defeating it grants a Golden Seed .

guide.title: Exploring the Castle's Underground Crypt
text: The path from here is pretty linear and you'll find a pit that you'll need to drop down to, just make further preparations since a strong enemy will appear here. Also, if you notice there are multiple bodies in the pit that you can loot, there is a Stonesword Key among these. Take care of that later and fight the enemy first. As soon as you drop down, the creature will appear from the ground. The Ulcerated Tree Spirit is a towering, centipede-like creature that heavily features bodies composed of tree-like structures.

guide.title: Finding Important Items in the Field
text: Once you're back to exploring the center section or south area of Liurnia, you'll want to grab a few items first and probably stop over some locations. We will be listing down the coordinates of the item and/or location marked on the Elden Ring Map so that you have a better picture of where the

Academy Scroll: It can be found just north of Church of Irith. It's by one of the big gravestones where the Skeleton Mages are rising. You can present this scroll to a sorcerer such as Sorceress Sellen so that you can gain access to additional Sorceries that you can learn. Sorceress Sellen is at Waypoint Ruins in Limgrave.
Map (Liurnia East): Found in the south of the swampy lake, in the middle by a monument with enlightened texts on it. A bit north from the Lake-Facing Cliffs site.

Laskyar Ruins: This ruins location can be found just a bit north of the monolith where you got the map fragment. You can find some useful items here such as a Ritual Pot, a Wraith Calling Bell, Smithing Stone [3], and the Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook (2). Don't forget as well to discover the site of grace for the ruins. In the middle of the ruin is a waygate that will take you right in front of the South Raya Lucaria Gate grace site, take it and unlock this site because you'll need it later.
Map (Liurnia North): This map fragment can be found just a bit south near the Academy Gate Town Site.
Golden Seed: You can find one by an illusory sapling. It can be found near the Academy Gate Town Site and the Academy Gate Town.

title: Prince of Death's Pustule, Stonesword Key
text: Loot the Smoldering Butterfly x3, Stonesword Key, and Throwing Dagger x8 from the corpses in the arena.
Pick up the Prince of Death's Pustule next to the squid-like visage at the end.
Prince of Death's Pustule: Looted off a corpse that can be found at the pit of the castle's crypt after defeating the Ulcerated Tree Spirit . The body can be found next to a giant face.
Stonesword Key: Stonesword Key . Found on a corpse inside a building section with a broken roof. Accessed from the very top of the Rampart Tower with careful platforming.

title: Boss: Godrick the Grafted
text: Travel to the Secluded Cell and kill Godrick the Grafted for Godrick's Great Rune, Remembrance of the Grafted, and 20,000 runes. (This earns an achievement.)
Godrick's Great Rune: Dropped as a reward for defeating Godrick the Grafted located at Stormveil Castle .
Remembrance of the Grafted: Obtained as a reward for defeating Godrick the Grafted at Stormveil Castle .
Godrick the Grafted: The Lord of Stormveil and the first Demigod encountered. Drops Godrick's Great Rune and Remembrance of the Grafted upon defeat.

guide.title: Mini-Boss: Lion Guardian
text: When you return to the courtyard, tread carefully, since the Lion Guardian will jump in and start to attack you. If you want to gain a bit of advantage to deal large damage before you even aggro the mini-boss, you can crouch and sneak around the runaway, move from the left side and go around to the right, you'll see the Lion Guardian just waiting and hiding on the right side of the runway.

Go back inside the room and you'll notice a lever that you can interact with, have your character push it to open the castle's main gate. Head to the main gate and you'll see some corpses that you can loot to find the following items: x5 Ballista Bolt, x1 Golden Rune (2), and x1 Golden Rune (1). From here, you can now head back to the Secluded Cell Site of Grace and make further preparations before facing Godrick the Grafted.
## Facing Godrick the Grafted

By receiving a Great Rune, you can use it to restore the power at Divine Towers throughout the Lands Between. You will need to check the description of each Great Rune to discover which Divine Tower you should visit. At the center of the arena is a lost site of grace that you can examine and activate.

guide.title: After Godrick
text: Defeating Godrick yields x1 Godrick's Great Rune and x1 Remembrance of the Grafted, as well as 15000 Runes. After the battle, make sure to check the throne room ahead and go to the west side, head to the lower section and you'll immediately see a spirit NPC that looks like it's praying. Approach it and you can find an item next to it, pick it up to obtain x1 Shabriri Grape. If you turn back, you'll see a passage that goes outside, formally arriving at Liurnia of the Lakes. If you return to the Roundtable Hold, you'll find Nepheli Loux, the warrior who helped you in fighting Godrick, at the northeast side, by the library. Don't forget to speak to her so that she can give you x1 Arsenal Charm.

Now, if you want to use Godrick's Great Rune, you will need to fast travel to the Limgrave Tower Bridge site at Stormveil Castle. Work your way through the reanimated Colossal Statues, interact with the waygate portal and continue forward to reach the Divine Tower of Limgrave. Continue to the top until you reach the peak where you'll find a glowing sigil at the center. Approach and interact with it to restore the power of the great rune. Godrick's Great Rune blesses the player's character by raising all attributes.

title: Spectral Steed Regalia: Tree Sentinel
text: Optional: Nepheli's summon sign can be found near the entrance if you exhausted her dialogue earlier.
Rest at the Godrick the Grafted grace, then talk to Gostoc in the arena.
If you own the Tarnished Pack DLC, you'll find a chest containing Spectral Steed Regalia: Tree Sentinel in the room to the right of the throne.

title: Shabriri Grape
text: Head down the other room and pick up the Shabriri Grape on the bottom floor.
Shabriri Grape: Key Item. Found next to a ghostly NPC in the underground section of Godrick's throne room.

title: Talk to Gatekeeper Gostoc
text: Gatekeeper Gostoc: Gatekeeper Gostoc can be located in the��Throne Room in Stormveil Castle ��for his final location.

title: Talk to Hyetta, As You Wish
text: Go outside and talk to Hyetta next to the Lake-Facing Cliffs. Give her the Shabriri Grape to learn the As You Wish gesture.
Hyetta: Hyetta , Location 1. Hyetta roams The Lands Between in search of the distant light, drawn to her destiny by a guiding shine she feels in the back of her eyes when eating Shabriri grapes.

title: Talk to Boc the Seamster
text: Boc the Seamster: Boc the Seamster Location 3. After meeting him for the second time, Boc will move to Liurnia of the Lakes. Find him kneeling by the Lake-Facing Site of Grace, a cliff above to the entrance to Stillwater Cave .

title: Boltdrake Talisman
text: Optional: Talk to Boc next to the Lake-Facing Cliffs grace and select "Don't tell me...".
Travel to the Limgrave Tower Bridge and pick up the Boltdrake Talisman up the stairs.
Boltdrake Talisman: Talisman. Found on a corpse sitting against a tall brazier.

title: Ash of War Scarab
text: In the crater on the right before the Archer Golem, you'll find a Warming Stone.

Warming Stone: Consumable. From Stormveil Castle, on the bridge linking to Divine Tower of Limgrave. Can be found near the edge of the cratered portion of the bridge that leads to the tower, same area as the golem fight.
Loot the Soft Cotton and Ash-of-War Scarab down the rubble at the end of the bridge.

Ash of War Scarab: Head Armor. Found on a corpse in the broken bridge leading from Stormveil Castle to the Divine Tower of Limgrave. After the three golems, continue on without taking the waygate and drop down to find the item.
Soft Cotton: Consumable. Can be found on the broken part of the bridge leading to the Divine Tower of Limgrave, past the teleporter waygate, by dropping down.
Use the sending gate to reach the other side. Pick up the Golden Rune [2] on a balcony, then grab the Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot next to the Golem remains.
Golden Rune [2]: Located within a grave area, in a sarcophagi on the hill south-west above Warmaster's Shack .
At the end of the bridge is a corpse with Stormhawk Feather x5 hanging off the right side edge.
Go back and ride the lift in the tower to reach the Divine Tower of Limgrave grace.
Interact with the rune at the top and restore the power of Godrick's Great Rune. (This earns an achievement.)
Note: Great Runes can be equipped at sites of grace and activated with Rune Arcs. The effects are lost on death, so you'll need a new Rune Arc each time you die.

title: Rapture
text: Note: Make sure to equip a bow or crossbow for destroying the chariot.
Optional: Talk to Varre now that Godrick is dead.
Travel to Roundtable Hold and exhaust Enia's dialogue in the newly opened room.
Touch the Two Fingers to learn the Rapture gesture.

place.title: Divine Tower of Limgrave
walk: This is the location where you can restore Godrick's Great Rune to full strength and have it grant you its power. To reach the location, take the long bridge east of Stormveil Castle from the Limgrave Tower Bridge Site of Grace. Many players won't have this Site of Grace initially, as it requires you to have navigated the ballistae gauntlet from Stormveil Main Gate or from having navigated most of Stormveil Castle and approaching from the opposite direction.
Some tips, if coming from the Stormveil Main Gate Site of Grace:
Summoning just as you enter the area is helpful, as it will provide additional targets for the ballistae
Run forward about 50 yards until there is an opening to the right
Sprint for the large open arch, but beware: a tough enemy will try to stop you
Once through, the Limgrave Tower Bridge Site of Grace is a short sprint away!

You can loot the Boltdrake Talisman from a body ascending the stairs toward the tower. This leads to a long Stormhill bridge covered with Giant Golems. You can choose to fight them or run through them. Killing the Giant Archers will give you a chance to gain the Golem Greatbow. Before using the waygate, you can safely drop down behind the ledge to find a Soft Cotton and the Ash-of-War Scarab helm.

Interact with the waygate at the end of the bridge to reach the other side. This will take you to the front steps of the Divine Tower of Limgrave. Step to the center to activate the lift. Continue forward, and there will be another Site of Grace. Continue heading up the stairs and you'll eventually reach a site where you can restore the power of the Great Rune. This is only available after defeating Godrick the Grafted at Stormveil Castle. You will then obtain Godrick's Great Rune. You must have defeated Godrick; otherwise, the gate of the tower will be locked.
notes: Notes and Tips for the Divine Tower of Limgrave Location in Elden Ring go here.
There is a Two Fingers on a mound of earth at the top of this tower, in the centre of eight meteorite fragments.

The door entering this divine tower faces east-northeast, and the entrance to the top faces north-northwest, an angle of ninety degrees from entering the tower. The tower is covered with what appears to be molten rock on its north face.

title: Rogier's Rapier
text: On the balcony opposite Enia's room sits Rogier:
Tell him that you've defeated Godrick to receive Rogier's Rapier+8.

title: Ash of War: Glintblade Phalanx
text: Optional: His weapon is equipped with Ash of War: Glintblade Phalanx. Remove it to make it available for compatible weapons.

title: Reverential Bow, Taunter's Tongue
text: Talk to him about the corpse under Stormveil to unlock dialogue about the black knifeprints with Fia.
Talk to him about D and he'll additionally drop Rogier's Letter when he dies, detailing the location of D, Hunter of the Dead's brother.
In the hall below the balcony, you'll be invaded by Mad Tongue Alberich. Let him finish his gesture to learn the Reverential Bow gesture, then kill him for Taunter's Tongue.
miss: The gesture becomes unobtainable if Alberich is interrupted and then killed before he can do his gesture at the start of the fight.

title: Cipher Pata
text: Head through the open door that leads to a corpse on a bed with the Cipher Pata.

title: Knifeprint Clue
text: Optional: Talk to Hewg and he'll comment that you've felled your mark. Reload the area, then talk to him about his prayer.
Let Fia hold you, then select "Do you know...?" and "About the Black Knifeprint" to receive the Knifeprint Clue.
miss: Becomes unobtainable after entering Ranni's service or giving D the Weathered Dagger.

title: Arsenal Charm
text: Optional: Talk to D, Hunter of the Dead about Rogier.
Exhaust Nepheli's dialogue in the library. If you talked to her in Stormveil Castle, you'll receive the (missable) Arsenal Charm.

title: Warhawk Ashes
text: Optional: Exhaust Gideon Ofnir's dialogue, then talk to him about Nepheli.
Travel to the Church of Pilgrimage and grab the Warhawk Ashes on the cliff edge behind the church (painting reward).
Warhawk Ashes: Rewarded upon finding the location Prophecy Painting depicts. The location is north of the Church of Pilgrimage .

title: Ash of War: Gravitas
text: Descend the pillar behind the church to find Bewitching Branch x3 and Sliver of Meat on a ledge below the cliff.
Bewitching Branch: Can be found on a corpse, surrounded by bats.
Sliver of Meat: Can be found at Church of Pilgrimage area, down the cliffside on a dead body
Travel to Seaside Ruins and jump down the spiritspring below the cliff south-southwest of the grace. Kill the Alabaster Lord on the beach for Ash of War: Gravitas (first time).

Ash of War: Gravitas: Looted from a Lesser Alabaster Lord that uses the Gravitas skill as one of its attacks when it fights. You can find the enemy roaming by the beach-side at the stone arch that has a bonfire, near the Seaside Ruins Site of Grace.

title: Haligdrake Talisman
text: Past the fallen pillar on the beach lies a corpse with Lump of Flesh x3.
Enter the cave on the beach to find the Haligdrake Talisman hanging off a ledge.

Haligdrake Talisman: Talisman. Drop down from the cliff near the Seaside Ruins site of grace. Explore the lower area and between fallen columns, there is a small entrance. Enter and take the path until you fing a hanging body.There you will find the Haligdrake Talisman - this is the unreachable item seen in the Cave of Knowledge starting tutorial

title: Erdtree's Favor
text: Drop down to go up some stairs and unlock the entrance to Fringefolk Hero's Grave:
Descend the ladder and run past the poison. Wait for the chariot to appear, then pick up the Poisonbone Dart x5.

Continue until you reach a thin bridge with an item. Drop to the first ledge below the bridge, use Margit's Shackle to deactivate the fire-breathing pillar, then enter the north-northwest room for Lightning Grease x2.
Pick up the Erdtree's Favor in the other room, then immediately run back across to drop to the ledge below the start of the bridge.

Erdtree's Favor: Head down until you see the path narrow on both sides and drop just at the edge where it begins to find a secret area. Defeat the imps and proceed past the fire trap to find the item resting at an altar. Two Grafted Scions wait hanging above, so be sure to avoid them when they land and grab it really quickly

place.title: Fringefolk Hero's Grave
walk: When entering Fringefolk Hero's Grave, players will need to be ready with two Stonesword Keys. They can be found or purchased in multiple locations. For Stonesword Key locations check the page here. Bring them to the stranded graveyard.It's also recommended to bring a bow and some arrows (you can buy cheap arrows at the merchant at the Church of Elleh).

Once obtained, examine the figure at the fog gate entrance of the Fringefolk Hero's Grave then use the Stonesword Keys. You can drop down without taking damage or use the ladder.Dropping down will cause you to stagger, however, and make it easier to proc poison. Run through, do not roll as this will cause poison to stick on your armor and speeds up poison build-up. Keep going until you reach solid ground again. Take a few steps and pause to wait for the Chariot to approach.
Once it approaches and leaves, run forward and use the gaps on the sides of the path to continue to avoid getting hit. Be prepared, some gaps will have enemies.

The easiest way to do the first stretch is to run as soon as the Chariot turns around at the top of the hill.Follow it, past the first openings, straight to the second set of openings and stick to the left side. There will be an archer spawn that wont be ready for you. Kill him and wait for the Chariot to to climb back up, turn around and go down again. This time when it passes you immediately dart down to the opposite, third side opening. There will be another archer and an opening behind him. Be careful not to fall of the cliff yet. On your other side a swordsman will start charging you. If you've timed this right the Chariot should already be on its way back up and will kill him.

If you are planning to drop off the side of the ramp in the second stretch, you should move up to the edge where you can drop down out of this opening, and look towards the uphill end of the second ramp. On top of the wall at the end, you will be able to see a phantom, which will not become hostile until you reach that area. If you have a bow or other ranged attack which can reach him, you should shoot him now, which will cause him to drop down to the ramp level and head towards you. Before reaching you, he will be killed by the Chariot. Note: As of 3/28/22, the phantom can now teleport directly to you if you are hiding in one of the wall opening, so it may not be wise to lure him into such a tight space and you'll have to fight him while avoiding the chariot.

As the Chariot is going back up from where you came, dash out of the hole in the wall and immediately start running down.There is a wall opening immediately before the narrow ramp section, so run down to that opening before attempting to do the following.From here you will have three options: Run down the narrow ramp, drop off the left side of the narrow ramp, or drop off the right side.If this is your first time going through and you want to clear everything, dropping down to the right will make this all much easier.

Dropping on the right: Standing at the top of the narrow ramp looking directly over the opening on the right, you can drop down to the ledge below. Walk off the ledge slowly, since you can drop past it and die if you're moving too fast. There will be a few Imps to take care of. When you drop down on the right, you will be standing behind the first imp and it might not notice you, allowing you to backstab it. After dealing with a second imp, continue down the hallway and down a set of stairs. Stop before reaching the bottom as there will be a pillar shooting flame towards you. Shoot the pillar with a bow and it will go down. Continue forward, being wary of the right opening with an Imp waiting to ambush you. If you go to the left of the pillar there will be an Imp with a strange polearm, he's not too different from the hatchet variation but his skill set can be unpredictable. But in the same room, an imp will jump down from the ceiling making it a little more difficult, if you want to be safe, lock on to the imp in the room then shoot it a couple of times with your bow, luring it to you, defeat him and proceed to defeat the other one jumping out at you. Defeating them grants access to a corpse with Lightning Grease.
(Photo depicts left hallway and the hallway behind the now down flame pillar)

Take the route behind the pillar and you should come across an archway leading to a room with a large statue surrounded by candles. Directly above you will be a menacing, Grafted Scion and another above the altar with the item.

The Grafted Scions will drop from the ceiling as you near the bridge. It might be wiser to attack the furthest enemy with a bow or spell, lure it to the door, and kill it there before proceeding to the bridge which will cause the nearest Grafted Scion to drop from the ceiling. Otherwise, rush ahead and grab the item, which is an Erdtree's Favor amulet that buffs HP, Stamina, and Equip Load. The Grafted Scions do not respawn if defeated.

Then, make your way back to the entrance of this room and look down over the ledge where you originally entered. You should see another ledge. Drop down to the ledge, and then drop down again to the water below. It looks poisonous but it is not.

From the bottom, turn to find the opening leading up to an elevator. Take the elevator up and you'll now be on an outlook, over the Chariot. Immediately to your left will be another Castle Guard Phantom with a polearm, if you didn't previously bait him out into the chariot's path with a ranged attack. He appears simple but will use whirlwind attacks to pull you in and continuously spin in circles. This phantom is also immune to all status effects and can phase past your attacks to strike you from a different angle.

After you've defeated him walk to the south edge of this balcony and look to the ceiling. You'll see three pots suspended by ropes. Using a bow or crossbow, manually aim for these ropes. Fire the moment you hear the chariot loudly stop at the balcony below you, and the pot should fall onto the chariot and destroy it. You only need to land one pot to succeed. If you've missed all three times, the pots regenerate when you rest at a Site of Grace.

Destroying the Chariot not only makes progression much simpler, but also nets you the Erdtree Greatbow and some arrows. The Chariot will also now be gone permanently. From this ledge you can safely drop down below.Move forward down the ramp and you'll be back at the narrow bridge, free to go wherever you please.So you're back at the narrow ramp! From here you can simply walk down the ramp.

Dropping to the left of the ramp: This will simply give you a shortcut to the boss at the bottom and I imagine is great for speedrunners. (Note: If you haven't destroyed the chariot standing on this platform will act the same as standing on the narrow ramp. This means the chariot will still be stuck going up and down on the original pathway and wont follow you down until you get back on the ramp. Timing this right gives you a massive headstart toward the boss.) Following the ramp down will lead to the same area.Assuming you're at the narrow ramp, run down it and take the left turn at the bottom. There will be one archer spawn on the left opening at the bottom of the narrow ramp.From here you have the option to go left, leading you to the boss. Or right, which leads you up in another direction. Both should need little explaining and I'll assume the chariot is no longer around.Going right/West takes you up a ramp, with four Castle Guard Phantom along the way. At the top of the ramp is is a ghost-soldier kneeling by the statue.

He has a shield, uses pyromancy and is very aggressive. Defeat him and he'll drop the Dragon Communion Seal. Behind the spot he was guarding, pick up Dragonwound Grease. Turn around and head back down.Going left/North (or continuing down the ramp, after defeating the phantom for the Dragon Communion Seal) takes you past the spawn point of several ghost soldiers. It's fairly easy to run past them as they don't net many runes. Eventually you'll get to the boss room containing the Ulcerated Tree Spirit. Dropping a Golden Seed and Banished Knight Oleg Ashes.
While there is not a site of grace here there is a statue for respawning (Stake of Marika) just outside the fog wall.

title: Stonesword Key
text: After dropping down, take the lift up to a ledge with a Stonesword Key and a Banished Knight.
Stonesword Key: Held by a corpse within Fringefolk Hero's Grave . Look for the body on a platform above the chariot.

title: Erdtree Greatbow
text: Equip a bow or crossbow, then once the chariot slams into the wall below and the screen starts shaking, shoot one of the ceiling ropes to drop a giant pot onto it, destroying the chariot and earning you the Erdtree Greatbow and Great Arrow x10.
Erdtree Greatbow: Dropped from the Chariot inside Fringefolk Hero's Grave
Great Arrow: Consumable Ammunition. Looted from a body atop one of the ladders in Mt. Gelmir

title: Dragon Communion Seal
text: Note: You can respawn the pots by resting at the grace.
With the chariot dead, drop down and pick up the Golden Rune [5] on the thin bridge.
Follow the uphill path to a spectral Banished Knight. Kill him for the Dragon Communion Seal, then loot the Dragonwound Grease on the corpse.

Dragon Communion Seal: Found in the Fringefolk Hero's Grave . Progress down the tunnel with the mechanized chariot until the path splits and you can go either up or down. Go up until you reach the end of the tunnel and inside the small room is an enemy that once killed will give you the weapon.

title: Boss: Ulcerated Tree Spirit (Limgrave), Golden Seed
text: Head all the way down while picking up the Grave Glovewort [1] along the way.
Kill the Ulcerated Tree Spirit for a Golden Seed, Banished Knight Oleg, and 15,000 runes.
Ulcerated Tree Spirit: Ulcerated Tree Spirit is found underneath the Stranded Graveyard within Fringefolk Hero's Grave . Defeating it drops Banished Knight Oleg's Ashes .
Banished Knight Oleg Ashes: This Spirit is obtained after Defeating the Ulcerated Tree Sprit located within Fringefolk Hero's Grave .
Golden Seed: This item is obtained after Defeating the Ulcerated Tree Sprit located within Fringefolk Hero's Grave .

title: Bravo!
text: Travel to The First Step and read the glowing message at Varre's location to learn the Bravo! gesture.
Optional: Collect all non-respawning crafting materials in Limgrave.
miss: Becomes unobtainable once you receive the Pureblood Knight's Medal from Varre.

links.t: Video: non-respawning crafting materials in Limgrave

title: Sage Set
text: At the bottom of the cliff face southeast of Liurnia Lake Shore lies the entrance to Stillwater Cave:
Head inside and grab the Stillwater Cave grace.
Pick up the Golden Rune [3] on a ledge just past the grace.
Golden Rune [3]: Held by a corpse within Stillwater Cave , beyond the Stillwater Cave Site of Grace .
Follow the upper section across a gap and through a tunnel that leads to an Operatic Bat that drops a guaranteed Golden Rune [6] (first time).
Loot the Sage Set, Serpent Arrow x15, and Golden Rune [5] in the room.

Sage Set: Armor Set comprised of the Sage Hood , Sage Robe and Sage Trousers . Can be found in Stillwater Cave - Liurnia of the Lakes , just ahead and below the Lake Facing Cliffs. Sitting on a poison submerged corpse near the end, guarded by Giant Bats that will attack you when you take it.
Serpent Arrow: Consumable Ammunition. Fifteen can be looted from a corpse inside Stillwater Cave, in the dark room with several bats.
Golden Rune [5]: Found on a dead body, inside Stillwater Cave. In the same room as the Golden Rune (6).

place.title: Stillwater Cave
walk: Stillwater Cave is a dark cave comprised of many pits where Miranda Sprouts and their giant counterparts bloom undisturbed. It is recommended to bring along a Torch and a handful of Neutralizing Boluses to counteract the poison build-up inflicted by its denizens. The Site of Grace is found shortly after entering the cave.

The cave itself is rather small and there is a very straight forward path you can take to get to the boss. Also be mindful not to roll or dodge when walking on poison water, as poison will get on your armor and hasten and lengthen poison build up.
From the Site of Grace, hug the right wall and refrain from dropping down into the pits below as they are hotbeds for the Miranda Sprouts.
There will be a single Giant Bat and some Cave Moss, you can try and stealth kill it.

There is a single Servant of Rot along the way. These are the mushroom-faced humanoids that cast poison bolts at targets from a distance. Take him out and jump the gap to reach the ledge ahead where two more servants await.
Enter the tunnel to the left of the two Servants of Rot you just killed (after jumping the gap). Pick up some Cave Moss and Budding Cave Moss.

You'll come to a room with a lootable corpse in some deep poison water. Before doing anything, look up and target lock and you'll find x2 Giant Bats above the body, dispose of them with range attacks.
After killing the two bats, turn right and look up once more to find more bats hanging from the ceiling, please note that one of these will be a stronger variation of bats.

After clearing the room, you can safely pick up the two treasures in this room, one of them being the Sage Set. Take note that the poison water in this room is deep, and your poison bar will fill slightly faster.
Go back out of the room by backtracking through the tunnel, back to where you killed the 2 Servants of Rot and continue.
Hug the edge and head southeast until you see another servant around the bend.
Jump down into the pit from here and run past all the Miranda Sprouts to find a tunnel in the southeast.

This tunnel is filled with Servants of Rot but they are all in a rested state and will take a long time to get combat ready, allowing you to simply weave around them to get to the mist gate at the end and challenge this dungeon's boss: The Cleanrot Knight.
## Boss: Cleanrot Knight

The Cleanrot Knight is an imposing figure wielding a spear and a sword. After traversing through the mist gate, the boss will almost always run towards you and use his Impale attack. This is his most dangerous move and if the attack connects, he will raise you high in the air, deal tremendous amounts of damage and inflict the scarlet rot status on you. Dodge to the side when you see his spear glowing. Use your best spirit summons to distract him and take potshots at the knight from behind. Watch out for the water on the floor which will rapidly cause you to build up the poison stat. The Cleanrot Knight drops the Winged Sword Insignia upon defeat.

Stillwater Cave is a good source of Cave Moss should you require it for farming. Nearly every stretch of the cave has nodes of this material to collect from. Exploring the cave will also yield a good amount of Budding Cave Moss as well as Crystal Cave Moss crafting items. In general, the Giant Miranda Sprouts are not worth killing as they are highly resistant to magic and release a deadly poison at melee range. It's best to skip these while exploring the cave.

title: Boss: Cleanrot Knight
text: Exit the tunnel and drop into the poison for a Golden Rune [4] next to two Miranda Blossoms.
Golden Rune [4]: Consumable Item. Held by a corpse in the central area near the tower. Beware of a spirit ambush.
Return to the upper section and continue to a corpse with Glowstone x5.
Glowstone: Consumable Item. Five can be looted off a corpse on the walkway leading to the boss area, where you are ambushed by three bats.
Pick up the Poison Grease x2 in the corner opposite the boss entrance.
Poison Grease: Consumable Item. Two can be looted from a corpse found just before the boss room fog in Stillwater Cave.
Kill the Cleanrot Knight for Winged Sword Insignia and 3,300 runes.
Cleanrot Knight: Optional Boss found at the end of the Stillwater Cave . Drops the Winged Sword Insignia upon defeat.
Winged Sword Insignia: Talisman. Dropped by the Cleanrot Knight boss inside the Stillwater Cave .

title: Boss: Adan, Thief of Fire
text: Return to Liurnia Lake Shore, head north-northwest and follow the wall on your left to a spiritspring. Use it facing southeast to find an evergaol and kill Adan, Thief of Fire for Flame of the Fell God and 3,800 runes.
Adan, Thief of Fire: Optional Boss. Imprisoned within the Malefactor's Evergaol . Drops the Flame of the Fell God spell upon defeat.
Flame of the Fell God: Incantation . Dropped by Adan, Thief of Fire inside the Malefactor's Evergaol .

place.title: Malefactor's Evergaol
walk: Unlike most evergaols, this one does not require a Stonesword Key to unlock. The transporter mechanism is active as soon as you reach the area. Enter the portal to challenge the boss imprisoned within: Adan, Thief of Fire.

Adan is a very straightforward fight. Despite his stout stature, he is quite agile and capable of quick dodge rolls. His main form of attack is his Flame of the Fell God spell, where he summons a large orb of fire that explodes after a short delay, dealing damage in a large radius and setting the area ablaze. This attack is easy enough to avoid due to the clear telegraph and slow animation. He will also use a combo of multiple swings with his flail, ending in a spinning attack. This move has a long animation and can easily be exploited by ranged players.
Adan drops the Flame of the Fell God incantation upon defeat, allowing you to summon the same orb of fire that he does.

title: Fire Spur Me
text: Head west-northwest from the evergaol until you reach a wagon with Ballista Bolt x5 in front.
Loot the Fire Spur Me gesture, Fire Monks' Prayerbook, and Dappled Cured Meat (in a tent) in the camp down the slope.
Fire Spur Me: Gesture. Collected from the Fire Altar within the Fire Monk camp north-west from Lakeside Cave in Southern Liurnia of the Lakes
Dappled Cured Meat: Consumable. Found in Miquella's Haligtree , looted from a corpse after two patrolling Oracle Envoy enemies.

title: Fire Monks' Prayerbook
text: Loot the Fire Spur Me gesture, Fire Monks' Prayerbook, and Dappled Cured Meat (in a tent) in the camp down the slope.
Fire Monks' Prayerbook: Incantation Tome. Found on a corpse in an enemy outpost in the area.

title: Talk to Rya (First Location), Ritual Pot
text: Travel to Laskyar Ruins and explore the ruins just northwest of the grace:
Optional: Kill the Revenant spawning in the middle for a Ghost Glovewort [2] (first time).
Grab the Smithing Stone [3] beside the stairs to the building with the spires if you haven't already.
Pick up the Ritual Pot northeast of the sending gate, then the Golden Rune [3] on the ground behind it.
Head down the cellar west of the rune to obtain the Wraith Calling Bell.

Wraith Calling Bell: Offensive Consumable Item. Found in a chest in a small room of an underground aea in the northwestern section of the Laskyar Ruins . Find a set of steps leading downwards to locate the area.
From the cellar, head north-northwest to a round stone building on your right. Talk to Rya inside and hear her request.
Rya (First Location): Npc. She can be found next to the telescope. She is runnng an errand for the Volcano Manor but was robbed. She asks you to retrieve Rya's Necklace
Ritual Pot: Special Tool Key Item. Found on a corpse in the northern section of the Laskyar Ruins , in front of a set of pillars.
miss: You must hear Rya's request before joining the Volcano Manor in Mt. Gelmir to prevent Blackguard's questline from becoming permanently locked.

title: Talk to Patches
text: Head toward the island west of Rya to discover the Scenic Isle grace.
Optional: Talk to Patches next to the grace. Select "Speaking of" and "Talk".
Patches: Location of Patches if forgiven during the Bossfight .

guide.title: Patches, a Crystal Tear, a Church, and More Items!
text: If you travel northwest, open the map, and place a beacon on the small isle near the telescope. You'll find the Scenic Isle Site here. You will only find Patches here if you didn't kill him and decided to forgive him during your encounter with him at the Murkwater Cave in Limgrave. You can check his wares and purchase any items that you need. Continue moving northwest and you'll find another isle that has the Dexterity-knot Crystal Tear.

From the isle where you got the crystal tear, move west and you should find the Folly on the Lake Site. You can find it inside a gazebo, on the southwestern side of the lake. Travel north from this site and you should find the Rose Church. White-Faced Varre can be found in this location and if you exhaust his dialogue, you can acquire the Festering Bloody Finger. There are also some items that you can find here such as the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [12] and the Bloodflame Blade incantation that drops from a Teardrop Scarab found along the marshes outside of the nearby island. Note that there is another scarab nearby that does not drop anything.

Also from the Folly on the Lake Site, if you travel to the east, you should find the Boilprawn Shack. You can find the site for this location, as well as a new NPC, Blackguard Big Boggart. Make sure that you exhaust his lines and befriend him so he can be summoned later on for the Magma Wyrm Makar fight. Note, Blackguard Big Boggart will not speak with you beyond a line or two unless you speak with Rya first and she tells you about her stolen necklace. You first meet her at Liurnia of the Lakes under the pavilion next to the Birdseye Telescope north of Laskyar ruins. Exhausting her dialogue she will ask you to retrieve a necklace from someone who stole it.
You can visit Blackguard Big Boggart's page to learn more about his questline and to find a list of items that can be bought from him.

Now from the Rose Church, continue northwest and you should find the Temple Quarter. For this location, you can grab some materials such as Bloodrose and kill the Albinauric and Glintstone Flower enemies to farm Runes. In one of the destroyed buildings, however, there is a treasure chest containing the Icerind Hatchet weapon.

title: Dexterity-knot Crystal Tear
text: On an island west-northwest of Patches, you'll find a basin with the Dexterity-knot Crystal Tear.
Dexterity-knot Crystal Tear: Physick Flask Material. Found inside a stone receptacle on top of a craggy hill.

title: Talk to Blackguard
text: Continue northeast from the island to grab the Boilprawn Shack grace in front of a shack.
Talk to Blackguard and buy Rya's Necklace from him.
Blackguard: Merchant. He appears here if you bought Rya's Necklace and Boiled Prawn

place.title: Boilprawn Shack
walk: This location is needed for Rya's questline. After speaking with Rya (Elden Ring Map link), you will get a quest to receive this stolen necklace.
Speak to Blackguard to haggle Rya's Necklace and to be able to purchase Boiled Prawn and Boiled Crab from him. Continue speaking to him to eventually obtain a new Gesture: Spread Out.
An alternative to paying 1000 runes for the necklace is to kill him, but it is unnecessary.

title: Spread Out
text: Buy one Boiled Prawn from him to learn the Spread Out gesture. Optionally, select "About Rya" and "Talk".
Spread Out: Gesture. Unlocked by befriending Blackguard Boggart by purchasing a Boiled Prawn from his shop in Liurnia of the Lakes.
miss: Unobtainable if you kill Blackguard before buying prawn or fail to hear Rya's request before joining the Volcano Manor.

title: Larval Tear
text: Climb the large ruin north of Boilprawn Shack to find a corpse with Rainbow Stone x4 at the top.
On top of another ruin just west lies a corpse with Tarnished Golden Sunflower x4.
Go back down the slope of the ruin, then head west-northwest to discover the Fallen Ruins of the Lake grace on a third ruin.
In the building surrounded by Crayfish south of the grace, you'll find Smithing Stone [2] x3.
Smithing Stone [2] C: Upgrade Material. Found inside a gazebo.
Kill the lone Crayfish west-northwest of the building and it'll turn into a Grafted Scion that drops a Larval Tear.
Larval Tear: Key item used for Rebirth. Dropped by a Grafted Scion disguised as a Giant Lobster when defeated. Located between Rose Church and Boilprawn Shack .

title: Festering Bloody Finger, Bloody Finger
text: Continue west-northwest to an island with a church. Talk to Varre in front, answer that they didn't seem right, then talk to him again for Festering Bloody Finger x5.
Festering Bloody Finger: Multiplayer Item. Given by White-Faced Varre after exhausting his dialogue.
Bloody Finger: Key Multiplayer Item. Reward for advancing White-Mask Varre questline and giving him the blood-soaked Lord of Blood's Favor item.

title: Talk to White Mask Varre Invasion Sign
text: If this is the first time you obtain a Festering Bloody Finger, you will also receive About Invasion Multiplayer.
White Mask Varre Invasion Sign: The invasion sign for this NPC can be found in Mohgwyn Palace .
miss: Becomes unobtainable once you buy or loot a Festering Bloody Finger in the current playthrough. If missed, it can still be obtained in NG+, but only if you acquire it before picking up any new Festering Bloody Fingers in that NG+ cycle. Those obtained from a previous NG cycle do not count. However, you'll still need to leave (not discard) your old ones on the ground before talking to Varre at Rose Church, then pick them back up afterward.

title: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [12]
text: Pick up Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [12] from the corpse in the church.
Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [12]: Cookbook item found inside the Rose Church, by the southern walls.

place.title: Rose Church
walk: There is not much to do at this church other than speak to White Mask Varre at the entrance, if visiting for the first time. He will give players a Festering Bloody Finger. Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook (12) can be found on the ground along the southern walls and the area is rich in Bloodroses. Beware of the single Lesser Sanguine Noble assassin that emerges from the center of the church when you get close, as well as the multiple Albinaurics outside its walls. When the assassin is cleared, he drops another Bloodrose.
notes: Elden Ring Rose Church Notes and Tips goes here.

title: Bloodflame Blade
text: In the water just northwest of the church is a scarab that drops Bloodflame Blade.
Bloodflame Blade: Incantation . Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab along the marshes outside of the nearby island. Note that there is another scarab nearby that does not drop anything.

title: Ash of War: Vow of the Indomitable
text: Return to the church, then head west until you reach a building. Inside is a corpse with Smithing Stone [2] x3.
Smithing Stone [2]: Upgrade Material. Three can be found Inside a gazebo south-west from Temple Quarter.
Pop the balloon south of the building to receive a Golden Rune [6]. You can use any ranged weapon, but I prefer to use throwing knives.
Head east-southeast from the balloon until you see a large rock jutting from the water. Pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [1] x2 in a chair behind it, guarded by a Giant Crab.
Somber Smithing Stone [1]: Found on a dead body.
Southeast of the chair, past the large rocks, is a small building with the Folly on the Lake grace inside.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [2] x2 below a dead tree in the nearby poison swamp.
Smithing Stone [2]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse being eaten by crabs under a large tree, where the poison ground starts after going south from the Folly on the Lake site of grace.
On a small island south-southeast of the tree is a scarab that drops Ash of War: Vow of the Indomitable.
Ash of War: Vow of the Indomitable: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab, in the southwestern swampy area.

title: Larval Tear
text: From the island, head west toward a slope with several gibbets. However, continue along the swamp to grab a Smithing Stone [2] between a tree and a rock on the left side.
Smithing Stone [2]: Smithing Stone (4) and Smithing Stone (2) are Looted from two corpses on one of the lower levels of the Lakeside Crystal Cave , just before the fog gate.
Return to the slope with the gibbets to enter the Village of the Albinaurics:
Exhaust Nepheli's dialogue on the slope leading up to the village.
Enter the village and pick up a Larval Tear behind one of the stone coffins.
Larval Tear: Key Item. Can be found at the graveyard in the Village of the Albinaurics , near the town well.

place.title: Deep Ainsel Well
walk: The Deep Ainsel Well serves as a lift platform from the underground Grand Cloister to the Moonlight Altar plateau.

title: Talk to Nepheli Loux
text: Nepheli Loux: NPC. If her quest is being progressed, she can be found at the Village of the Albinaurics after meeting her at the Roundtable Hold .

title: Talk to Albus, Haligtree Secret Medallion
text: Activate the Village of the Albinaurics grace inside the small shack.
Head up the slope east of the grace and roll through the glowing pot to reveal Albus. Talk to him to receive the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right).
Albus: NPC who is hiding from the calamity that befell the Village of the Albinaurics

Haligtree Secret Medallion: Key Item. Hit Albus , who is disguised as a pot past the Perfumer guarding the path up from the Village of the Albinaurics Site of Grace. This medallion opens the path to a secret location past Lyndell.

place.title: Village of the Albinaurics
walk: The Village of the Albinaurics can be located at the northwest section of the map from Stormveil Castle and the nearest starting point to travel to the village is at the Liurnia Lake Shore site. Map Link. As you travel by mount, simply move northwest and run alongside the cliff. Remain on the left side, pass through a swamp section, and just ignore the enemies you run into until you reach the distressed village. You'll know when you're near once you reach the swamp section and upon going up to a rise of the land - the name of the location will appear upon formally arriving at the village.

As you enter, move towards the house, check behind it to find the Village of the Albinaurics Site. Map Link. Discover and rest here before you start to explore. Now, clear this section first around the house where the player will encounter First-Generation Albinaurics. Make sure to also loot the body near a stone coffin to obtain a Larval Tear, and grab the materials around to find Mushroom and Rowa Fruit. Next, turn around and heap up the hill where you'll encounter a single Depraved Perfumer, killing it may drop 5x Budding Cave Moss. If you walk forward, passing the two houses, on the right side, you'll see a disguised NPC. This turns out to be Albus, who will give you an important key item for your journey. Hit the pot to reveal him.

Before exhausting his dialogue, he will give you a key item, the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right). Speak to him again, exhaust his lines, and he will eventually die due to old age. Before you continue towards the boss, make sure to check behind the stone coffin next to Albus, there's another corpse that you can pillage to acquire an Ivory Sickle. If you don't need to rest at the site, you can proceed to the boss by crossing the stone bridge on this hill.

As you cross, you'll see a golden teardrop scarab. Make sure to kill it before it disappears. On the other side, you'll see a willow tree and a bonfire. The Omenkiller boss is there, as well as a few Rotten Stray. We suggest that you kill the hounds first so that you can fight the boss one on one. Instead of going down the slope, straight to the bonfire, jump down from the right side of the cliff and kill the Rotten Stray. Once the area is clear, then you can approach the bonfire and fight the Omenkiller.

You can visit the Omenkiller page to find more information about this boss, as well as guides and strategies on how to defeat this enemy. Successfully killing this boss yields 4900 Runes and drops the Crucible Knot Talisman. Make sure to also check the right side of this small arena and you will another body at the end of the path, pillage it to find a Rune Arc.

Before you leave this location, there is just one more section you need to clear. Return to the site of the village, next to the house near it, you'll find a wooden bridge. Cross the wooden bridge, kill the First-Generation Albinaurics and make sure to loot the bodies here to find some items, as well as gathering Erdleaf Flower. One can be found resting by the tree trunk, loot it to acquire an Albinauric Bloodclot, while the other is near a ledge, pillage that body to find a Crystal Sword.

title: Ivory Sickle
text: Loot the coffin next to Albus to obtain the Ivory Sickle.
Ivory Sickle: Dagger. Can be found at the Village of the Albinaurics .It is up a small hill from the Site of Grace, past a perfumer enemy, behind a coffin. Nearby, Albus hides as a pot.

title: Boss: Omenkiller (Village of the Albinaurics)
text: Cross the upper bridge and kill the Omenkiller for Crucible Knot Talisman and 4,900 runes.
Crucible Knot Talisman: Dropped by Omenkiller , located in the Village of the Albinaurics
Omenkiller: Field Boss.Found at the Village of the Albinaurics . Drops Crucible Knot Talisman

place.title: Moonfolk Ruins
walk: There is little of note in these ruins other than an illusory floor in the northeast section of the ruins where a path to an underground treasure room can be found.

Hit the floor to reveal the path and collect a Somber Smithing Stone (8) from the chest in the room. Beware when traversing the ruins as there are plenty of teleport-capable Noble Sorcerers as well as glintstone traps on the ground that burst into projectiles that shoot upwards upon stepping on them.

title: Crystal Sword
text: Optional: Nepheli's summon sign can be found on the slope overlooking the boss if you exhausted her dialogue under the bridge.
At the bottom of the slope past the boss is a Rune Arc.
Rune Arc: After fighting Omenkiller , turn to the right and you will find it at the end of the path, on a body.
Return to the grace in the village and cross the nearby bridge. Behind a tree on the left is an Albinauric Bloodclot.
Albinauric Bloodclot: Crafting Material. One can be looted from a corpse behind a tree across the hanging wooden bridge heading toward the light from Village of the Albinaurics site of grace.
Next to the edge at the end is a corpse with the Crystal Sword.
Crystal Sword: CStraight Sword. Can be found at Village of the Albinaurics . Past the well and the wooden bridge, on a body near the edge.

title: Clinging Bone
text: Drop down next to the corpse, then head north up a ledge to find a scarab on the left side cliff edge. Kill it for a Somber Smithing Stone [2].
Somber Smithing Stone [2]: Upgrade Material. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab near the edge of the cliffs.
Make your way to the tower in the distance west of the cliff edge to grab the Converted Tower grace in front of it.
Travel to Roundtable Hold, where Ensha will now attempt to ambush you. Kill him to obtain the Clinging Bone, then pick up the Royal Remains Set outside Gideon's study.
miss: Ensha must be killed before burning the Erdtree at the Forge of the Giants.

place.title: Converted Tower
walk: There are a few items to be gathered at the Converted Tower. You can find a Cuckoo Glintstone just as you enter the tower. In between the tower and the walls behind it, there is a Magic Grease to be found.
You can find a Memory Stone at the top of the tower. The top of the tower is sealed by a puzzle. Read the message at the foot of the statue to find out what the puzzle is.
To clear the puzzle, perform the Erudition gesture in front of the statue. The gesture can be obtained by giving Thops an Academy Glintstone Key at the Church of Irith.

If you don't have the Erudition gesture unlocked yet and you're skilled enough on horseback, the puzzle can be skipped by climbing the broken stone wall on the sides of the tower (either on foot or by horse) and then using Torrent to jump into the balcony from the back. While the climb up the wall can be done on foot, you must use Torrent's double jump to reach the balcony.
Once you reach the balcony simply climb up the steps to reach the room at the top, with the chest in the middle of it.
After collecting the Memory Stone, the seal on the door should release.
notes: Converted Tower appears to be very frequently mistaken for the Converted Fringe Tower, that is located northwest of Liurnia of the Lakes near the Black Knife Catacombs. This tower contains the sorceries Cannon of Haima and Gavel of Haima instead of the Memory Stone.

If you choose to use Erudition, note that it takes several seconds before the ladder appears, so just let the gesture animation keep going and don't end it prematurely until you see the ladder materialize.

title: Spear Talisman
text: Talk to Gideon Ofnir about Ensha twice.
Go down the stairs next to the blacksmith and talk to Nepheli.
Return to Gideon Ofnir and talk to him about Nepheli's despair.
Head back to Nepheli and select "I heard from Gideon", then talk to her again.
Travel to the Scenic Isle and head south toward an island with a Glass Shard in the middle, guarded by some Demi-Humans.
In the cliff face south of the island lies the entrance to Lakeside Crystal Cave:
Grab the Lakeside Crystal Cave grace and open the chest containing an Arteria Leaf.
Arteria Leaf: Can be found near to the bat, in front cliffside.
Up the rubble on the left is corpse with Hefty Beast Bone x3.
Head inside the tunnel at the end that leads to a chest with the Spear Talisman.
Spear Talisman: Talisman found in a chest within Lakeside Crystal Cave

place.title: Lakeside Crystal Cave
walk: After entering the cave you will find yourself in a large open area and in front of the grace is a chest containing an Arteria Leaf. Stick to your left and jump up the hill to clear out the Demi-Humans. Follow the pathway along the cliff as normal however, don't drop down into the chasm. Enter the room at the end of the cliff, kill the Demi-Human Chieftain inside the room and open the chest containing the Spear Talisman. Afterwards, head back and to the middle of the cliff to find an area to drop down to. Once you are at the bottom, you will enter a room containing 3 Crystal Snails and another room with many more, but these will take some time to attack. Drop down again to find Soft Cotton x2 on a body on the ledge and then drop down to grab a Smithing Stone (2), Smithing Stone (4) looted from two more corpses, and a Lump of Flesh. Once you proceed, you will get ambushed by three more snails. Turn left to fight the Boss, Bloodhound Knight. He is very agile and can close gaps quickly. Upon his Death he drops the Cerulean Amber Medallion.
After defeating the boss, continue through the arena to find the Slumbering Wolf's Shack. You can meet Latenna here and there is a Rune Arc behind the shack.
notes: After defeating the Bloodhound Knight boss, players may proceed to the Slumbering Wolf's Shack Site of Grace, which is only accessible through this cave and is the first location of NPC Latenna.
If you're having trouble locating the cave use this photo to help:

title: Boss: Bloodhound Knight
text: Exit the tunnel and descend the ledges below the cliff until you reach a campfire. Pick up the Throwing Dagger x5 in the room.
Continue to a Golden Rune [5] surrounded by snails.
When dropping down the cliff, drop from the left side to land on a ledge with Soft Cotton x2.
Loot the Smithing Stone [4], Smithing Stone [2], and Lump of Flesh at the bottom.
Smithing Stone [4]: Smithing Stone (4) and Smithing Stone (2) are Looted from two corpses on one of the lower levels of the Lakeside Crystal Cave , just before the fog gate.
Kill the Bloodhound Knight for Cerulean Amber Medallion and 3,600 runes.
Bloodhound Knight: Found within Lakeside Crystal Cave . Drops Cerulean Amber Medallion
Cerulean Amber Medallion: Talisman dropped by Bloodhound Knight , the miniboss of Lakeside Crystal Cave

place.title: Slumbering Wolfs Shack
walk: At this shack, players will find Latenna and her wolf companion Lobo. If players have spoken to Albus at the Village of the Albinaurics and have acquired the Haligtree Medallion (Right), Latenna will realize that she can trust you as Albus does and will request that you bring her to the Haligtree. She will then willingly become a spirit ash companion in the form of Latenna The Albinauric.

title: Talk to Latenna, Latenna the Albinauric
text: Talk to Latenna outside and show her the secret medallion. Hear her request, then talk to her again to receive Latenna the Albinauric.

Latenna: NPC found in Slumbering Wolf's Shack . Promising Latenna to take her to the Haligtree, she will join the player and willingly become a Spirit Ash summon, Latenna the Albinauric. She will also hint at the location of the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left).

Latenna the Albinauric: In order for Latenna to be friendly and become a spirit, one has to have the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right) , give to the player by Albus at the Village of the Albinaurics .
Activate the Slumbering Wolf's Shack grace and pick up the Rune Arc on the elevated platform.

place.title: Slumbering Wolfs Shack
walk: At this shack, players will find Latenna and her wolf companion Lobo. If players have spoken to Albus at the Village of the Albinaurics and have acquired the Haligtree Medallion (Right), Latenna will realize that she can trust you as Albus does and will request that you bring her to the Haligtree. She will then willingly become a spirit ash companion in the form of Latenna The Albinauric.

title: Memory Stone
text: Travel to the Converted Tower and go inside to pick up Cuckoo Glintstone x5 from a desk.
Cuckoo Glintstone: Consumable Item. Five can be found on a desk, inside the Converted Tower.
Behind the tower is a corpse with Magic Grease x2.
Magic Grease: Consumable Item.Two can be looted from a corpse behind Converted Tower
Climb the walls surrounding the tower and double jump onto the stairs to get inside. Open the chest at the top to obtain a Memory Stone.
Memory Stone: Memory Upgrade Material. Found in a chest on the top floor of the Converted Tower .

guide.title: Seek the Converted Tower
text: ## Liurnia of the Lakes: West
Elden Ring Main Quest Guide - Liurnia of the Lakes (West) Points of Interest
Clear out the Village of the Albinaurics
Complete other Locations
Visit The Four Belfries
Meet Smithing Master Iji
Complete Caria Manor
Meet Renna and her Allies
Complete Siofra River (Underground)
## Folly on the Lake - Site of Grace

If you were following our walkthrough, you've just returned from the underground map and completed some parts of it within Ainsel River. For this section, we will guide you to exploring the west section of Liurnia of the Lakes before we proceed onto the next region which is Caelid. We suggest that you start at the Folly on the Lake Site of Grace and work your way from the bottom to the top ( Elden Ring Map: Liurnia of the Lakes West Starting Point). Take note that it's entirely up to you on which location you want to complete first, you can always check the interactive Elden Ring Map to find what you need - now, your first stop, the Village of the Albinaurics.

Along the way, you will pass by a swamp that is filled with poison, so we highly recommend that you travel to the village on mount. From the site, you can find the village on the southwest side of the map. As you travel by mount, simply move northwest and run alongside the cliff. Remain on the left side, pass through a swamp section, and just ignore the enemies you run into until you reach the distressed village. You'll know when you're near once you reach the swamp section and upon going up to a rise of the land - the name of the location will appear upon formally arriving at the village.

There are some locations near the Village of the Albinaurics that you can also visit before you continue exploring the northwest side of the Liurnia Map, but some can only be accessed if you've made significant progress to Ranni's questline:

Chelona's Rise: A tower found in the very corner of the upper plateau in Liurnia's southwest. This tower is initially sealed, with an imp statue at the entrance holding a glowing book, instructing you to "seek three great wise beasts". See the tower's page for details. You can find the sorcery spell, Ranni's Dark Moon in a chest at the top of this tower. Nearby is the Altar South Site of Grace as well.
Moonfolk Ruins: A ruins section where you can gather some materials and find x1 Somber Smithing Stone [8].

Lunar Estate Ruins: The ruins of a large estate found in the southern plateau of Liurnia, accessible only after making significant progress in Ranni's questline. Once accessible, you can find a Golden Rune [8] in this ruins location.

Cathedral of Manus Celes: Located at South West Liurnia of The Lakes. Accessible only after making significant progress in Ranni's questline. You can find the Glintstone Dragon Adula roaming around only if you've dealt enough damage to it at its initial location in Three Sisters.
## Seek the Converted Tower

Return to the Folly on the Lake Site and this time, head west, before you reach the tower, you should find a Teardrop Scarab near the edge of the cliffs that drop a Somber Smithing Stone [2]. You should find the entrance of the Converted Tower, use the Erudition Gesture in front of the statue for the ladder to appear. Climb to the top to find a Memory Stone. The Erudition Gesture is obtained by giving Thops the second Academy Glintstone Key at the Church of Irith. Alternatively, if you don't have the Erudition gesture unlocked yet and you're skilled enough on horseback, the puzzle can be skipped by using Torrent to climb the wall surrounding the tower. Then just jump up on the balcony in the back and jump off Torrent - also don't forget to discover the site of grace of this tower.

title: Boss: Erdtree Avatar (Mountaintops East)
text: Head toward the Minor Erdtree northwest of the tower and kill the Erdtree Avatar for Cerulean Crystal Tear, Ruptured Crystal Tear and 5,800 runes.
Erdtree Avatar: Field Boss found roaming the fields near the Minor Erdtree . Drops Cerulean Crystal Tear and Crimson Bubbletear upon defeat.
Cerulean Crystal Tear B: Physick Flask material. Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar guarding this tree.
Crimson Bubbletear: Physick Flask material. Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar guarding this tree.

guide.title: The Mountaintop of Giants
text: Elden Ring Map: Mountaintops of the Giants Starting Point. Unlike other areas, you begin this zone with an easy one-way forward that leads you straight to the first map fragment Map Mountaintops of the Giants, West. Activate the site of grace and talk to Shabriri for some quick information. You should now explore Zamor Ruins and find the stairs leading down to a chest to get Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [3] as it will allow you to buy Smithing Stone (5) and (6) from the Roundtable hold. there's also Zamor Ice Storm (Spell) that can be looted here.

Follow the road east and north through a narrow passage that brings you about to a small landing with Fire Monk enemies. You can loot Briars of Punishment before braving the narrow road north past an Archer Golem. Keep moving and make good use of double-jump! You will arrive at Ancient Snow Valley Ruins, and notice there is plenty to explore at a higher level than you are. Travel the canyon floor north until you reach a frozen river with Guardian Golems, then head EAST and take your first right to loot a Golden Seed. Backtrack to the spot you first reached the river and now instead travel West past demi-humans and bats until you discover Shack of the Lofty. Here you can loot Traveling Maiden Set, and fight Juno Hoslow if you're doing the Volcano Manor quests.

To the south of the shack, take the spirit spring to the higher ground and complete Stargazer's Ruins by summoning the Jelly Fish Spirit Ashes. You'll be rewarded with Primal Glintstone Blade. You should now also talk to Brother Corhyn before crossing the narrow bridge southeast, looting a Somber Smithing Stone (9), and arriving at the region's Minor Erdtree. Defeat the Erdtree Avatar and loot Crimson Bubbletear and Cerulean Crystal Tear before taking the northern bridge to cross over to the Snow Valley Ruins Overlook site of grace.

title: Ash of War: Sword Dance
text: In the lower area past the Erdtree, near the cliff, you'll see a downward slope. Kill the scarab on the slope to obtain Ash of War: Sword Dance.
Ash of War: Sword Dance: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab found along the narrow path west of the Minor Erdtree.

title: Watchdog's Staff
text: Continue down the slope to discover the entrance to Road's End Catacombs:
Go inside and grab the Road's End Catacombs grace.
Pull the boss lever in the first room, then pick up the Grave Glovewort [2] and 2x Grave Glovewort [3] below.

Grave Glovewort [2]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 4 are found inside the dungeon. 1) In the room with the boss' door lever, drop down one level to find it on the floor. 2) Found in a corridor to the east of the room with the boss door lever, accessed from the bottom-most floor of the room. 3) From the second glovewort, the third one is found in the right corner by the entrance of the next room. 4) Found just before the illusory wall concealing the boss door.

Grave Glovewort [3]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 4 are found inside the dungeon. 1) In the room with the boss' door lever, drop down one level to find it on the floor. 2) Just a few steps from the first. 3) In the same room, drop down to the bottom most level and hit the wall under the arch in the back, closest to the stairs to reveal a hidden room. 4) In the next room to the east, near the back.
Hit the illusory wall next to the second staircase to find a Grave Glovewort [3], Human Bone Shard x5 and the Watchdog's Staff.
Watchdog's Staff: Located in Road's End Catacombs , behind an illusory wall near the stairs at the beginning of the dungeon.

Grave Glovewort [3]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. The first one is found in the center of a small room past the hall with the cleaver traps. The second one is found in the second section of the sewer area, after dropping down the ladder. The third one is found by returning to the cleaver trap room, waiting for the second-to-last cleaver to fall and then standing on top of it. It will bring you up where you can jump onto a tunnel entrance. Follow this path past the statues and the glovewort will be in a small alcove on the right. The final one is found by dropping down the hole in the alcove where the third glovewort was found to a sewer section where the boss door's lever can also be found.

place.title: Road's End Catacombs
walk: Road's End Catacombs is a pretty straightforward dungeon with 7 Illusory Walls. As soon as you enter, you will find the Site of grace. Keep going, and after facing a few Fanged Imps, you will find a lever. Pull it, then keep going, facing the little resistance you will find.

You will find several Grave Glovewort (2) to grab. When you reach the end, you'll notice that there is not much to do. Hit the wall at the very end to reveal a secret door. Beware of the Fanged Imps that are hiding on the back of the wall as soon as you enter.
Loot the final chest at the end of the tunnel to obtain a new Spirit Ashes called Raya Lucaria Soldier Ashes.
## Another Secret Door

As you are making your way back to the entrance, at the bottom of the two sets of stairs leading to the exit, hit the archway next to the stairs to reveal a secret door with some Fanged Imps and the Watchdog's Staff and Grave Glovewort (3). Exit the hidden doorway and proceed up the first set of stairs. Once you are before the last set of stairs, head right and hit the second and fourth archway to reveal two secret doors. There is a single Fanged Imp as well as a Ghost Glovewort (2) and a Rune Arc to loot in the room on the left. Continue through the narrow path until you loot the Root Resin. Hit the wall in front of you to reveal another secret door. Keep going to obtain Grave Glovewort (2). Hit the wall to unveil ANOTHER secret door, which leads to a boss fight, the Spirit-Caller Snail. Defeat it to obtain the Glintstone Sorcerer Ashes and 3000 Runes.

guide.title: Minor Erdtree & Road's End Catacombs
text: Follow the road going north from the Converted Tower and you should find the Minor Erdtree for the southwest section of Liurnia. This section is guarded by an Erdtree Avatar and if you defeat it, you'll be able to acquire the Cerulean Crystal Tear and the Ruptured Crystal Tear.

Also, situated in between the Minor Erdtree and the Converted Tower, on the west side of the map, the Road's End Catacombs location can be found. Road's End Catacombs is a pretty straightforward dungeon, with just some slight changes to it. As you open the doors of the catacombs, head down the stairs and you will find the site of grace for the Road's End Catacombs. Make sure to discover it and rest if needed before exploring.

Just like the previous catacombs, this section is inhabited by Imps that love to hide around corners, on ceilings, walls, and are ready to ambush you. Head down the stairs and you will encounter the first Imp, grab x1 Grave Violet, and as you move towards the arched doorway, there is another Imp ready to ambush you on the right side corner. Get ready to dodge or put your shield up as soon as you approach the doorway. Before going down, make sure to pull the lever next to the reaper statue.

By the bush, you can gather some upgrade materials such as Grave Glovewort [2], continue going down, go straight, and you'll notice a dead end on the left. Look up, you'll find another Imp on the ceiling. Shoot it down, kill it and grab another Grave Glovewort [2] material. Be careful not to step on the pedestal that triggers arrows to shoot you. Grab the Grave Glovewort [2] on the right and another Grave Glovewort [3] ahead. Now you may think that there's nothing left to explore. But if you hit the wall of the dead-end where the Grave Glovewort [3] was, you'll reveal the illusory wall.

Beyond that path are more Imps inside a room that has an altar. Kill all the enemies and open the chest to find the Raya Lucaria Soldier Ashes. Now, go back to that spot where you grabbed a few glovewort materials by the bush, there is another illusory wall next to the stairs that go back up. Kill the imp and grab some items here such as another Ghost Glovewort [2] and a Rune Arc. The path ahead is dark so equip a Torch if you're having a hard time seeing. Past the body that you just looted, move forward a bit and turn left, enter the narrow path and you'll find another body at a dead-end. Loot it to find x3 Root Resin.

Now, hit the wall in front of the body you just looted to reveal yet another illusory wall. Go down, grab another Grave Glovewort [2], and hit the illusory wall ahead to reveal another section behind it. You'll find the path that leads to the mini-boss of this location, the Spirit-Caller Snail. You can visit our Spirit-Caller Snail to find guides on how to defeat this boss - successfully defeating it drops the Glintstone Sorcerer Ashes and 3000 Runes.

title: Raya Lucaria Soldier Ashes
text: Pick up Grave Glovewort [2] in an alcove in the corridor ahead.

Grave Glovewort [2]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. The first is found to the left of the boss door, just before the steps leading downwards. The second one is found just past the Imp Statue-sealed room, in a dead end to the left. The third and fourth are found in the first section of the sewer area after dropping down the ladder.
In the room past the corridor, you can find a Grave Glovewort [2] and a Grave Glovewort [3].
Hit the illusory wall at the end to discover a chest with the Raya Lucaria Soldier Ashes.

Raya Lucaria Soldier Ashes: Found inside a chest at the end of the Road's End Catacombs . Hit the final wall to dispel the illusion, allowing you to move on. Beware of the many Imps in the final room.

title: Boss: Spirit-Caller Snail, Glintstone Sorcerer Ashes
text: Return to the first room and hit the illusory wall next to the first staircase. Inside you'll find a Ghost Glovewort [2] and a Rune Arc.

Ghost Glovewort [2]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. In the room with the boss' door lever, drop down one level and hit the wall under the arch in the back, closest to the stairs to dispel it and reveal a hidden corridor where the glovewort can be found.

Rune Arc: Consumable. In the room with the boss' door lever, drop down one level and hit the wall under the arch in the back, closest to the stairs to reveal a hidden corridor. The Rune Arc is found on a corpse on the right.
Go through the narrow path to find Root Resin x3, then hit the illusory wall behind it.
Root Resin: Can be found by breaking a hidden wall next to the stairs, inside Road's End Catacomb
Pick up the Grave Glovewort [2] at the end, then hit the illusory wall behind it to reveal the boss room.
Kill the Spiritcaller Snail for Glintstone Sorcerer Ashes and 3,000 runes.
Spirit-Caller Snail: Optional Boss. Found at the end of the Road's End Catacombs . Drops the Glintstone Sorcerer Ashes upon defeat.
Glintstone Sorcerer Ashes: Inside Road's End Catacombs. Defeat the Spirit-Caller Snail to obtain.

title: Banished Knight's Halberd +8, Shabriri Grape
text: Exit the catacombs, then at the top of the slope, head north-northeast toward a shack. Quickly grab the Revenger's Shack grace in front of it as you get invaded.
Kill Edgar for a Shabriri Grape, Banished Knight's Halberd+8, and Raw Meat Dumpling x5.
Banished Knight's Halberd +8: An upgraded Banished Knight's Halberd dropped by Edgar the Revenger .
Shabriri Grape: Key Item. Dropped by Edgar the Revenger upon defeat.
Raw Meat Dumpling: Consumable Item. Five can be looted from corpses within the Revenger's Shack.
miss: This invasion is skipped if Edgar is killed beforehand. If so, make sure to pick up the Shabriri Grape from whichever location you killed him at.

place.title: Revenger's Shack
walk: Revenger's Shack is a minor location found north of the Minor Erdtree in southwest Liurnia. On your first visit, Edgar the Revenger will invade as soon as you touch the Site of Grace. Edgar is a straightforward fight as his moveset only includes physical attacks and he is easily staggered with magic. Upon defeat, he drops his halberd, a +8 variant of the Banished Knight's Halberd as well as a Shabriri Grape, a Furlcalling Finger Remedy and 5 Raw Meat Dumplings.
Inspecting the 5 corpses inside the shack will give you 5 more Raw Meat Dumplings.

guide.title: Revenger's Shack - Edgar, the Revenger
text: Just north from the Minor Erdtree, you'll find the Revenger's Shack, if you followed the father-daughter questline of Irina and Edgar, resting at the shack's site will trigger a hostile NPC invader to appear, and this is Edgar the Revenger. Killing him drops the following: 316 Runes, Furlcalling Finger Remedy, Shabriri Grape, Banished Knight's Halberd (+8), and x5 Raw Meat Dumpling.

title: Invader: Edgar the Revenger
text: Edgar the Revenger: Hostile NPC invader. Invades when you interact with the Site of Grace at the Revenger's Shack .

title: Ash of War: Spinning Strikes
text: Optional: His weapon is equipped with Ash of War: Spinning Strikes. Remove it to make it available for compatible weapons.

title: Boss: Bols, Carian Knight
text: Grab the 5x Raw Meat Dumpling inside the Revenger's Shack; they only spawn if Edgar invades.
Kill Bols, Carian Knight in the evergaol past the shack for Greatblade Phalanx and 4,600 runes.
Bols, Carian Knight: Optional Boss. Imprisoned within the Cuckoo's Evergaol . Drops the Greatblade Phalanx spell upon defeat.
Greatblade Phalanx: Sorcery . Dropped by Bols, Carian Knight inside the Cuckoo's Evergaol .

place.title: Cuckoo's Evergaol
walk: Cuckoo's Evergaol is located along Liurnia's western landmass, easily accessed on foot or horseback. This Evergaol does not require a Stonesword Key to unlock. The portal mechanism in the center is active as soon as you enter the area. Enter the portal to challenge the boss within: Bols, Carian Knight.

Bols is a Troll Knight clad in Carian armor, wielding a massive greatsword. Due to his size, his movements are rather slow and his attacks have a hefty weight behind them. He compensates for this by frequently roaring, which not only increases his damage, but releases a burst of pressure that staggers players. Be careful as he tends to combo into his attacks after a roar. Bols is tall enough that you can easily and safely dodge under his legs to avoid most of his attacks, but never take your eyes off him as he can quickly turn around for a devastating follow-up.
Bols drops the Greatblade Phalanx spell upon defeat.

title: Jellyfish Shield
text: Optional: Kill the Operatic Bat beneath the tall rock north of the evergoal for a Golden Rune [6] (first time).
Follow the dirt path next to the tall rock to discover the Foot of the Four Belfries grace on the left side.
Loot the Blood Grease x3 and Jellyfish Shield next to a wagon on the road north of the grace.
Jellyfish Shield: On a dead body surrounded by four Jellyfish directly north of the Foot of the Four Belfries Site of Grace.
Blood Grease: Can be found alongside the road, on a corpse. Near the cart with the Jellyfish Shield

title: Imbued Sword Key
text: Continue north toward a camp. In the lower section you can find a Rune Arc and a chest with Cuckoo Glintstone x10.
Rune Arc: Consumable Item. Found on a corpse inside a large enemy outpost.
Cuckoo Glintstone: COnsumable Item. Can be found inside a chest in an enemy camp.
In the upper part of the camp, to the left of a Pumpkin Head, are two chests you can loot for Albinauric Bloodclot x6 and Smithing Stone [4].
Albinauric Bloodclot: Crafting Material. Three can be looted from a chest in the higher area of the enemy encampment, protected by a Cuckoo Knight, some soldiers and a Mad Pumpkin Head.
Smithing Stone [4]: Upgrade material. Looted from a chest in the higher area of the enemy encampment, protected by a Cuckoo Knight, some soldiers and a Mad Pumpkin Head.
Follow the path in the woods south-southeast of the chests to a fork, then follow the east path all the way up to The Four Belfries grace at the top.
Loot the chest near the grace to obtain an Imbued Sword Key.
Imbued Sword Key: Key Item used to activate a Waygate at The Four Belfries . Found in a chest at the very top of the hill, at the fourth belfry tower.

place.title: The Four Belfries
walk: Situated along a hill in western Liurnia, The Four Belfries serve as a hub for 3 waygates that transports users to various locations. Each waygate is located at the foot of a belfry and requires an Imbued Sword Key to activate.

The First Belfry: The first waygate is located closest to the foot of the hill and is denoted by the message reading "Crumbling Lands". This transports you to a small sub-area of the Crumbling Farum Azula containing the Pearldrake Talisman. You cannot access the rest of the region from this sub-area. Map Link

The Second Belfry: The second waygate is located further up the hill to the east and is denoted by the message reading "Precipice of Anticipation". This transports you to the Chapel of Anticipation, the starting area of the game, to fight the Grafted Scion boss who drops Golden Beast Crest Shield and Ornamental Straight Sword, plus lootables: The Stormhawk King and the Stormhawk Deenh.
