Note: you are able to soak Lord of Blood's Favor in the blood of a deceased maiden near the starting area of the game, providing an alternative to going to the Church of Inhibition or killing Irina. Map Link.

The Third Belfry: The third waygate is located further up the hill to the west and and is denoted by the message reading "Night Sky Unceasing". This transports you to an otherwise inaccessible location in Nokron, Eternal City, housing the Mottled Necklace and a Lesser Crucible Knight. Map Link. The Knight does not drop any loot except for runes.

The Fourth Belfry: The final belfry is located at the peak of the hill. This belfry does not contain a waygate, but instead houses a chest containing an Imbued Sword Key. This can be used to unlock a waygate at the First, Second or Third Belfry.

title: Boss: Grafted Scion (Tutorial)
text: Unlock the imp-sealed belfry marked by the message "Precipice of Anticipation":
Use the sending gate and kill the Grafted Scion for Ornamental Straight Sword, Golden Beast Crest Shield, and 3,200 runes.
Ornamental Straight Sword: Straight Sword. Dropped by the Grafted Scion upon defeat.
Golden Beast Crest Shield: Greatshield. Dropped by the Grafted Scion upon defeat.
Grafted Scion: Boss fought within the tutorial stage at Chapel of Anticipation .

title: The Stormhawk King
text: Continue to the chapel where you first started out and go through the previously closed side entrance to pick up The Stormhawk King.
The Stormhawk King: Key Item. Found on a corpse in the southern wing of the chapel, up on the roof.

title: Stormhawk Deenh
text: Loot the chest in the chapel to obtain Stormhawk Deenh.
Stormhawk Deenh: Spirit Ash. Found in a chest on the wooden walkway above the southern wing's main room. Accessible from where The Stormhawk King key item is found.

title: Carian Knight's Sword
text: Return to Foot of the Four Belfries and head past the camp to encounter a caravan with the Carian Knight's Sword.
Carian Knight's Sword: Straight Sword. Found in a chest at the back of a large stagecoach being pulled by 2 Trolls.

title: Memory Stone
text: Head east from the camp's exit to find a chair with a Somber Smithing Stone [3].
In front of a wagon below the cliff lies a corpse with Throwing Dagger x6.
Throwing Dagger: Consumable Throwable Item. Six can be looted off a corpse by a cart being protected by several soldiers on the shore of the lake.
Head southeast from the wagon to find a cemetery with 2x Golden Rune [1], 3x Golden Rune [2], 5x Golden Rune [3], 2x Golden Rune [4], and a Golden Rune [5].
Golden Rune [1]: At the edge of the lake on the ground.
Golden Rune [3]: Held by a corpse at inside the tower, west side.
Golden Rune [4]: In a balcony on a dead body.
Pop the balloon northeast of the cemetery to receive a Golden Rune [6].
Golden Rune [6]: Found within the graveyard.
Continue toward the island and grab the Sorcerer's Isle grace on a ledge by the water.
Examine the book in front of Testu's Rise to activate the three beasts:
#1: By the cliff edge just north from the book. [Location 1]
#2: Hanging onto the back of a tree behind the tower. [Location 2]
#3: Found below the cliff edge to the right of the tower when facing the entrance. [Location 3]
Loot the chest at the top of the tower to obtain a Memory Stone.
Memory Stone: Memory Slot Upgrade Material. Found in a chest at the top floor of Testu's Rise .

place.title: Testu's Rise
walk: ## Testu's Rise Where to Find Three Wise Beasts
The entrance to Testu's Rise is initially sealed by a barrier. By the entrance, you will find an imp statue holding a glowing book that asks you to "Seek three wise beasts".

These beasts are represented as Ghostly Tortoises that spawn somewhere in the area. Each Tortoise needs to be found and attacked in order to break parts of the seal. This is the same challenge as the one at Oridys's Rise at the Weeping Peninsula except this time, a large number of Ghostly Skeletons will also spawn to hinder your progress.
The first Tortoise can be found by the cliffs northwest of the tower on the same level.
The second Tortoise is found high up on one of the trees east of the tower. Use a ranged or magical attack to hit it, and it will fall from the tree and die of fall damage.
The final Tortoise is to the southeast of the tower on a ledge halfway down the cliff.
If players rest at a Site of Grace before all of the Tortoises are killed, they may have to activate the book statue again to spawn the remaining Tortoise(s).
Once all three Tortoises are killed, players will get a notification that the seal has been broken.
Go back to the now-opened door, and climb up the ladder.

When you reach the top of the ladder, turn right, and proceed up the stairs. You'll see a room with a chest in the middle of it containing a Memory Stone which increases your Memory Slots by one, allowing for the memorization of more Sorceries or Incantations.

title: Intelligence-knot Crystal Tear
text: Pop the four balloons on the side of the island for 4x Golden Rune [6].
Underneath the large ruin behind the island lies a corpse with Old Fang x2, surrounded by Land Squirts.
Old Fang: Crafting Material. 2 are found on a corpse hidden within a huge clutch of Poison Pods under a fallen structure.
East of the ruin lies a campsite with Lump of Flesh.
Lump of Flesh: The item can be looted from a dead body.
From the campsite, head northwest to some ruins with Soporific Grease x3 in between.
Soporific Grease: Consumable Item. 3 are found under a fall structure.
Up a short cliff northwest of the ruins, on a ledge in the corner of the area, you'll find a basin with the Intelligence-knot Crystal Tear.

Intelligence-knot Crystal Tear: From Road to the Manor Site of Grace, head southeast down the slope and turn back towards north. Loot from a small, half-bowl structure guarded by a few Lesser Spider Hand and one Spider Hand .

title: Golden Seed
text: Optional: Kill the large Fingercreeper burrowed in the ground near the basin for a Somber Smithing Stone [2] (first time).
Head east-southeast from the basin until you see a chair on your left with a Somber Smithing Stone [4].
Somber Smithing Stone [4]: Found on a dead body sitting on a chair.
Continue east to discover The Ravine grace in front of a ravine.
Go through the ravine to find a Golden Seed at the other side.
Golden Seed: Flask Upgrade material. Found under a Phantom Tree in the manor's upper level.

title: Ash of War: Barbaric Roar
text: Pick up the Smithing Stone [5] in a shack, then grab the Ravine-Veiled Village grace behind it.
Smithing Stone [5]: Within Ravine-Veiled Village, near Site of Grace.
In the water just northwest of the grace is a scarab that drops Ash of War: Barbaric Roar.
Ash of War: Barbaric Roar: On a Teardrop Scarab in Ravine-Veiled Village, found by going as far northeast as possible in Lake of Liurnia (near but not accessible from Grand Lift of Dectus)

title: Boss: Royal Revenant
text: Travel to Road to the Manor, then turn around to explore Kingsrealm Ruins:
Pick up the Rimed Crystal Bud x8 in the tower southwest of the grace.
In the lower part of the ruins, you can find a corpse with Glintstone Firefly x4.
Glintstone Firefly: Crafting Material. Four can be looted from a corpse near the ghost that tells you about the area.
Roll through the hidden cellar just north-northeast of the corpse and kill the Royal Revenant for 3,100 runes.

Royal Revenant: Optional Boss found in an underground area of the Kingsrealm Ruins . The stairs leading down to the location is hidden by an illusory floor in the northeast section of the ruins. You need to step on the floor to dispel the illusion.

place.title: Kingsrealm Ruins
walk: Kingsrealm Ruins hosts a hidden, underground area where the optional boss Royal Revenant can be fought. The stairs leading down into this area is covered by an illusory floor. You can find this in the northeast section of the ruins. The floor needs to be rolled on to dispel the illusion or hit with a melee weapon to be revealed.
Royal Revenant is a very quick and agile multi-limbed creature that can teleport around the arena and release a toxic breath in a long, straight line ahead of it.

Defeating the Royal Revenant does not drop anything other than runes. However you do gain access to the small room at the end of the hall. There is a chest inside that contains the Frozen Needle rapier.
notes: Approximate location of the passage:

title: Frozen Needle
text: Note: As with any Revenant, attempting to heal the boss will instead deal significant damage, making the fight laughably easy.
Loot the chest past the boss to obtain the Frozen Needle.
Frozen Needle: Thrusting Sword. Found in a chest inside a small room in an underground area of the ruins. The Royal Revenant needs to be defeated to gain access to this room.

title: Ash of War: Hoarfrost Stomp
text: Return to the grace, then head up the north-northwest slope to a cemetery with Golden Rune [1], Golden Rune [2], 4x Golden Rune [3], Golden Rune [4], and a Golden Rune [5].
Golden Rune [1]: Looted from the many sarcophagi within the area. Watch out for the Giant Rats .
Golden Rune [2]: Looted from the many sarcophagi within the area. Watch out for the Giant Rats .
Golden Rune [3]: Multiple Golden Runes can be found within the sarcophagi under the cliffs.
Golden Rune [4]: Looted from the many sarcophagi within the area. Watch out for the Giant Rats .
Golden Rune [5]: Looted from the many sarcophagi within the area. Watch out for the Giant Rats .
Approach Caria Manor while dodging the enchanted snare to grab the Main Caria Manor Gate grace outside the entrance.
Kill the invisible scarab in the pond east-southeast of the manor gate to obtain Ash of War: Hoarfrost Stomp.
Ash of War: Hoarfrost Stomp: Ash Of War Upgrade. Dropped by an invisible Teardrop Scarab roaming around the shallow water. Look for its glowing footprints and attack as the prints move towards you.

title: Sacred Tear
text: Cross the bridge-like rock that extends past the cliff, then go up the slope on the other side to find the Nomadic Merchant (North Liurnia).
Continue up the slope to a church. Grab the Bellum Church grace and the Sacred Tear in front of a statue.
Sacred Tear: Flask Upgrade Material. Found Inside Bellum Church , below the big statue.

place.title: Bellum Church
walk: The Bellum Church can be found in the North side of the Liurnia of the Lakes region. Players can reach the Bellum Church either by going up the ramp on the west of the church, going through the valley and the watery areas of the north part of the lakes then up the ramp, or by following the east path atop the cliffs. Around the outskirts of the Church are many Cuckoo Knight enemies and even a Night's Cavalry that roams once the sun has set. Come in the evening time to defeat the Night's Calvary and obtain Ash of War: Giant Hunt as a boss drop. Pick up the Sacred Tear found in the front of the church amongst the flowers directly in front of the main statue piece.
notes: Bellum Church is very clearly built on top of a prior structure, which you can see as the Church foundation is sitting on top of a larger foundation which you can descend through on the left side of the Church. The stone slabs from this prior structure do not match the Church slabs.

title: Talk to Nomadic Merchant North Liurnia of the Lakes
text: Nomadic Merchant North Liurnia of the Lakes: Merchant NPC located next to the river, just pass the Bellum Church's hole in order to find him.

title: Boss: Night's Cavalry (Liurnia of the Lakes North)
text: From Bellum Church, pass time until nightfall, then head southeast to a large ruin. Behind it is a corpse with Sanctuary Stone x3.
Sanctuary Stone: x3 are Found on a corpse among the ruins, guarded by several weak enemies and a shielded one.
Kill the Night's Cavalry on the southwest road for Ash of War: Giant Hunt, Nightrider Glaive, and 5,600 runes.
Ash of War: Giant Hunt: Ash of War dropped by miniboss Night's Cavalry. Only appears at night.
Nightrider Glaive: Halberd dropped by miniboss Night's Cavalry . Only appears at night.
Night's Cavalry: Spawns only at night. Drops Ash of War: Giant Hunt and Nightrider Glaive

title: Talk to Finger Reader Crone
text: Finger Reader Crone: NPC. Talk to the Finger Reader to obtain some lore information regarding the lift ahead, and a hint about the secret passage to Altus Plains.

title: Talk to Boc the Seamster
text: Boc the Seamster: NPC. He can be found kneeling by the East Raya Lucaria Gate Site of Grace (southwest most point of the Bellum Road). You have to rest at this Site of Grace for him to appear.

title: Crystal Knife
text: Continue southwest along the road to discover the East Raya Lucaria Gate grace on the right side.
Optional: Talk to Melina at the East Raya Lucaria Gate grace.

Jump down the spiritspring below the cliff southeast of the grace. Wait for the Wandering Mausoleum to get close, then use the spiritspring to leap onto it. Destroy the skull formations around it until it collapses. Optionally, mark its location on your map.
In the cliffside east-southeast of the spiritspring lies the entrance to Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel:
Ride the lift down and activate the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel grace.
Open the chest up the stairs in the first room for a Somber Smithing Stone [2].
Somber Smithing Stone [2]: Upgrade Material. A total of 3 can be found in the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel .
Jump from the newly opened chest to a ledge to find a Somber Smithing Stone [3] in the wall behind a stele.
Somber Smithing Stone [3]: Upgrade Material. A total of 4 can be found in the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel .
Continue into a larger room, then go right to pick up a Smithing Stone [2] from the floor.
Smithing Stone [2]: Upgrade Material. A total of 5 can be found in the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel .
Head across the wooden beam and platforms for a Smithing Stone [3] on a wall and a corpse with Somber Smithing Stone [3].
Smithing Stone [3]: Upgrade Material. A total of 8 can be found in the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel .
Somber Smithing Stone [3] B: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse sitting on a chair by the shore.
Below the stairs in the next room, you'll find a Smithing Stone [3] and a Golden Rune [3].
Golden Rune [3]: Consumable Item. Looted from a corpse under the ramparts leading to the first working elevator of Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel.
Pick up the 2x Smithing Stone [3] in the southeast side room.
Drop down to the left of the lift to discover a path that leads to a Somber Smithing Stone [2] on a wall.
Drop to the narrow ledge directly below for a Somber Smithing Stone [3].
Pick up the Smithing Stone [2] next to a miner on the wooden platform below.
Go across the wooden beam to find 2x Smithing Stone [3] and a Smithing Stone [2] near a shortcut lift.
Enter the first room with a wooden doorway for a corpse with Smithing Stone [1] x3 and a Smithing Stone [2] beside it.
In the second room with a wooden doorway is a chest containing the Crystal Knife.
Crystal Knife: Dagger. Found in a chest inside the storage room in the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel protected by Marionettes.

place.title: Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel
walk: Two things to note right off the bat:1) I explored the first floor of this place when I first found it so I might be missing a few items. I'll make a note when I'm missing an item.2) This area took me about an hour to get through because I wasn't using a magic imbued weapon. I highly recommend using one. Throughout most of this mine the only enemies attacking you are the Digger guards watching over the Diggers and the Marionette soldiers. The Diggers will not attack unless either you hit them or steal the material they are mining.
The Crystalized enemies in this dungeon have a rare chance to drop Somber Smithing Stone (2)

With that out of the way let's begin. When first entering the mine you'll find an elevator. Going down it will put you in front of the Site of Grace for this area. On the way down the elevator you might notice two doorways on the left side of the wall. If you want to reach these, go back up the elevator and destroy the boxes on the left right before you get on the elevator then jump down. Be careful because if you fall you will die. In the first doorway you will find x1 Cracked Crystal. Following the ledge left drop down and enter the next doorway. You'll get 3 Cracked Crystals. Continue following the ledges down. There are lamps to guide you. At the bottom of the elevator, before you head through the doorway, look behind you and grab the x2 Cracked Crystal that are in the corners.

Heading through the tunnel in front of the elevator will lead you to a fork in the path. Going right will bring you to a chest guarded by two Diggers. One of which will patrol the area. Inside the chest you'll find Somber Smithing Stone (2) 1x, and a Somber Smithing Stone (3) behind the raised icon. You can grab 4 Cracked Crystals from this room. Going to the left will lead you to an open area with one Digger on the left and three on the right. One of the Diggers on the right is patrolling the area while the other two are mining. You'll notice a support beam in the area. If you cross it you can jump on the wooden ledges that are jutting out. Near the top grab the Smithing Stone [3]. At the top you'll find a corpse with one Somber Smithing Stone [3]. This room holds six Cracked Crystals.

In the next room, looking to the right you'll notice another Digger sitting down. Down the first set of stairs are two more Diggers who are also sitting down. They will attack you when you near them, just like the previous one who was sitting. After killing them look to your right. You should see a Digger and a path that leads to a small room. Be careful when attacking the Digger outside of it because one from beneath the stairs will attack you. The small room holds 2 Smithing Stone [3]. One on a wall to the left and one on a corpse to the right. Going behind the stairs you'll find a corpse with 1 Golden Rune [3]. This room contains a total of sixteen Cracked Crystals and a further Smithing Stone [3]. Exiting this room leads you to an elevator with more ledges. Just like last time, stick to the left. You'll find a tunnel that leads to a ledge with Somber Smithing Stone [2] and x2 Cracked Crystal. Either return to the elevator shaft or carefully drop below to access a corpse with a Somber Smithing Stone (3).

Either path connects you to a cavern with another support beam and another elevator. Before crossing the beam, kill the Digger on your left and grab the Smithing Stone [2]. After crossing the beam, kill the patrolling Digger but don't go up the stairs. Instead go to the right of them and grab the Smithing Stone [3]. Go up the stairs and kill the other Digger that is patrolling, then take the elevator up so you have a shortcut if you die. This level holds eight Cracked Crystals, one Smithing Stone [3], and one Smithing Stone [2] in total.

Be careful going through the tunnel leading out because a Marionette soldier will run out of the room to your right and attack you with four daggers. Kill him quickly if possible. Before going into the room they came out of look at the other doorway and look up. You'll notice two more Marionette soldiers hanging waiting to attack you. Getting close will make them fall. Both have two bows each and can be annoying if not dealt with quickly. The room the first Marionette soldier came out of holds three Smithing Stone (1) and one Smithing Stone [2]. Going through the other doorway where the two Marionette soldiers dropped down from leads you to another section with two doors. As soon as you pass the doorway on the right look up and you'll see another Marionette soldier wielding bows. They won't drop down until you attack them or the other two Marionette soldiers in the room. The two on the ground both wield daggers and are guarding a chest. Kill them then the archer if you haven't yet. The chest holds a Crystal Knife.

Go through the doorway that has a tunnel in view. The first level has no enemies on it. Go down the first set of stairs and kill the Digger. After you killed him look to the left. You should see three Diggers in a circle and two Crystal Sorcerers. Take out the sorcerers first. They have more health than the Diggers and the Diggers here won't attack you unless you attack them first. After dealing with the sorcerers, kill the three Diggers in a circle and collect the three Smithing Stone [3] and the Somber Smithing Stone [1]. There are two more Diggers in this area. After killing them all (if you want to) you can collect the eight Cracked Crystals, the Smithing Stone [2], and the Smithing Stone [3]. The last two smithing stones can be found in the collapsed tunnel in the back of the room. Looking north from the bottom of the stairs, there is a tunnel with the Shatter Earthsorcery on the right side.

The tunnel in front of the stairs leads you to an elevator. To the left of it, after you break the items there, jumping down will lead you to a small tunnel with a Somber Smithing Stone [3]. Once at the bottom of the elevator you'll sell the golden boss fog, but pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [1] to your left first. If you want to go back to the Site of Grace to rest and take the elevators you found along the way down.
BOSS FIGHT:

This boss is the Crystalian. It's moves are easy to predict and you can summon spirits to help you. You won't be doing much damage in the beginning until their armor breaks at half health. Strike weapons like maces and clubs will do a lot more damage in that first phase. After their armor breaks at half health all weapons will do full damage again. Getting hit with one of her throwing blades seemed to cause one resembling it to show around my wrist allowing me to do full damage.
Spirit Ashes like Banished Knight Engvall Ashes can help keep the boss stunlocked.

title: Shatter Earth
text: Loot the 4x Smithing Stone [3], Somber Smithing Stone [1], and Smithing Stone [2] below the stairs in the room ahead.
Somber Smithing Stone [1]: Upgrade Material. One can be found in the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel .
In the side room is a corpse with Shatter Earth.
Shatter Earth: Sorcery. Found on a corpse in the second-to-last level of Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel . Inside an opening in the north.

title: Boss: Crystalian
text: Drop down to the left of the lift for a passage with a Somber Smithing Stone [3] at the end.
Drop to the bottom and pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [1] on the way to the boss.
Kill the Crystalian for Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [1] and 3,000 runes.
Crystalian: Optional Boss. Found at the bottom-most level of Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel . Drops Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing (1) .
Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [1]: Key Item. Dropped by the Crystalian (Ring Blade) Boss at the bottom-most level of Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel .

title: Blue-White Wooden Shield
text: Travel to the South Raya Lucaria Gate, head down the slope, and follow the right-side fence to a corpse with the Blue-White Wooden Shield.
Blue-White Wooden Shield: Shield in Academy Gate Town (near Raya Lucaria Academy Entrance). Can be found on the outskirts of the buildings, towards the west side.

title: Ash of War: Charge Forth
text: Return to the slope and follow the left-side fence to a corpse with Glintstone Firefly x4 on the right.
Glintstone Firefly: You can loot 4 on a corpe that is on the side of the building.
Head down the first set of stairs past the spiked barricades and pick up Shattershard Arrow (Fletched) x6 hanging on the right-side fence.
Shattershard Arrow: Consumable Ammunition. Ten can be looted from a corpse at the base of Ainsel River Sluice Gate.
Jump over the fence opposite the corpse, then pick up the Smithing Stone [2] x3 in the water below.
Smithing Stone [2]: Upgrade Material. Three found on one of the corpses in this ant nest.
Shoot down the scarab attached to the underside arch of a bridge to obtain Ash of War: Charge Forth.
Ash of War: Charge Forth: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab. You'll find it attached to a ceiling, under some Poison Pods.

title: Talk to Finger Reader (Academy Bridge)
text: Finger Reader: Palm Reader. Can be found at the edge of the broken bridge that leads to the Raya Lucaria Academy.

title: Icerind Hatchet
text: From under the bridge, follow the west wall to a cemetery with 2x Golden Rune [1], 3x Golden Rune [2], 2x Golden Rune [3], 2x Golden Rune [4], and a Golden Rune [5].
Golden Rune [2]: Within the terrace reached by the principal courtyard.
Golden Rune [3]: Looted off a corpse that is hanging on a balcony fence that you can jump over to reach the rooftops. West side of the academy's courtyard.
Golden Rune [4]: Within a tunnel, on a dead noble's body. On a noble's corpse at the 2nd floor's balcony.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [2] x3 in the building west of the cemetery.
Smithing Stone [2]: Upgrade Material. Found on a gazebo near Giant Flowers on the outskirts of Raya Lucaria Academy.
Continue west toward a large ruins site and loot Rimed Crystal Bud x3 from the corpse in the middle of two rings of flowers.
Rimed Crystal Bud: Crafting Material. 3 are found as a treasure within a circle of white flowers in Temple Quarter. They are protected by Albinaurics and entering the circle triggers an ambush.
In the tower south-southwest of the corpse is a chest containing the Icerind Hatchet.
Icerind Hatchet: Axe found inside a chest in the Temple Quarter . The chest is located in what remains of the tower of a ruined building, by some poison flowers.

place.title: Temple Quarter
walk: The Temple Quarter in Liurnia of the Lakes is a ruined area that is inhabited by Albinauric and Glintstone Flower enemies. You can harvest some materials here such as Bloodrose, Trina's Lily, and Miquella's Lily. In one of the destroyed buildings, there is a treasure chest containing the Icerind Hatchet weapon. Map Coordinates Here.

title: Boss: Glintstone Dragon Smarag
text: Head northwest from the tower to discover the Temple Quarter grace.
Kill Glintstone Dragon Smarag north of the grace for Dragon Heart and 14,000 runes.
Glintstone Dragon Smarag: A fearsome magic dragon with crystalized magic formation for scales. Guards the Academy Glintstone Key . Also drops a Dragon Heart upon defeat.
Dragon Heart: Key Consumable. Drops from Glintstone Dragon Smarag upon defeat. Dragon Hearts are used to acquire at the Church of Dragon Communion and the Cathedral of Dragon Communion .

title: Academy Glintstone Key
text: Loot the Dragonwound Grease, Kukri x6, and Academy Glintstone Key from the corpses behind the dragon's resting spot.
Dragonwound Grease: Looted off a corpse behind the Glintstone Dragon Smarag.
Academy Glintstone Key: Key used to unlock the gate of Raya Lucaria Academy

title: Stonesword Key
text: On the island just southwest of the dragon is a teleporting scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [2].
From the island, head north toward the shore riddled with Crayfish and pick up the Strip of White Flesh next to a sleeping one in the back.
Strip of White Flesh: Crafting Material. One can be looted off a body surrounded by giant lobsters.
Continue east from the shore to discover the Crystalline Woods grace.
In the cliff face southeast of the grace lies the entrance to Academy Crystal Cave:
Unlock the imp seal and grab the Academy Crystal Cave grace inside.
When you reach the large crystal-filled room, head right to find a corpse with Cuckoo Glintstone x5 in the back.
Cuckoo Glintstone: Inside the Academy Crystal Cave . On the room full of Sages, turn to the right. It is against the wall.
At the opposite end of the room is a passage that leads to a Stonesword Key in a cage.
Stonesword Key: Found inside the Academy Crystal Cave . Head to the left to where the Sages are, and enter the next room. You will find it inside a cage.

place.title: Academy Crystal Cave
walk: The Academy Crystal Cave can be accessed by following the Liurnia shallows towards the west of the Raya Lucaria Academy. The entrance is found on the western cliff below the academy, barred by an Imp Statue. Look for the entrance on our Elden Ring Map Here. Two Stonesword Keys are required to dispel the fog barrier. These caves are very dark except for the flashes of glintstone spells cast by the sorcerers within. It is highly recommended to equip a Torch whilst traversing the caves.

Shortly after the entry, you will find the area's Site of Grace. Continue on into the cave and look to the left for a Crystal Cave Moss. This cave is rich in this item so be on the lookout for them if you require them for crafting. There is a Rat with its back turned which you can assassinate or skip if you wish. A couple more Rats lie in the path ahead. Following the linear path, you will arrive in a large foggy cave with many pillar-sized crystals.

There are several Twinsage Sorcerers in this cave, armed with powerful glintstone spells. Utilize the crystal pillars to block their line of sight, as well as their projectiles. At the start of the cave, look for the lone sorcerer facing a pillar and take this chance to ambush him with a critical attack. Beware of a second sorcerer just behind that pillar and the group of three sorcerers approaching from the back of the cave. Weave around the crystals and take them out one by one, mixing in any AoE attacks when you see an opportunity to hit multiple of them. There are two more sorcerers next to each other near the north section of this cave, and one more behind a pillar a few steps ahead.

After defeating all the sorcerers, look for an opening in the northwest for a small room with a cage. You can pick up a Stonesword Key from the corpse in the cage as well as some Budding Cave Moss along the walls. Go back to the large cave area and go east through a tunnel leading to a wooden doorway. Open the door and you will arrive in a storage area of sorts with a Battlemage guarding the doorway on the left. Battlemages are tanky and can take a lot more hits than the Twinsage Sorcerers. There is also a Glintstone Sorcerer patrolling the room. Go through the room the Battlemage was guarding to find another room where a Sorcerer is standing on a raised platform. Defeat the sorcerer and loot the chest in the room for a Rune Arc. To access the raised platform, attack an illusory walls close by (screenshot here) and loot another chest to collect the Crystal Staff.

Head back to the storage area and look to the east to find the fog gate leading to this dungeon's boss: The Crystalians. This boss encounter is against a pair of Crystalian opponents. One wields a spear, while the other wields a staff. Both are protected by a thick, crystal shield, significantly reducing the damage they take from your attacks. These shields will eventually break after each Crystalian's HP reaches a certain percentage. Cracks will be visible in their shields, signifying that you can now deal full damage to them. It is highly recommended that you use a tanky summon such as the Kaiden Sellsword Ashes to distract one of the Crystalians as you focus on the other. See the Crystalians page for further details on the fight.

Defeating this pair of bosses yields the Crystal Release Sorcery spell. Continue on to the door behind the bosses to reach an elevator that will take you to a tower within the academy. Climb the tower to find a chest containing the Terra Magica spell.

title: Crystal Staff
text: Go through the tunnel opposite the passage, open the door, then hit the illusory wall behind a Budding Cave Moss on the left to reach a chest with Crystal Staff.

Crystal Staff: Crystal Staff can be found in Academy Crystal Cave . It's in a room guarded by a sorcerer behind a fog wall, located right before the boss gate. The path to the chest containing the staff is through an illusory rock wall on the left side of the tunnel, just before the stone archway.

title: Boss: Crystalians
text: Loot the chest below for a Rune Arc.
Rune Arc: Found inside the Academy Crystal Cave . Enter the room protected by a Great Sage, open the chest to find the Rune Arc.
Kill the two Crystalians for Crystal Release and 3,300 runes.
Crystal Release: Sorcery Spell . Dropped by the Crystalians duo bosses inside the Academy Crystal Cave upon their defeat.
Crystalians: Duo Field Bosses. Found at the end of the Academy Crystal Cave . Drops the Crystal Release sorcery spell upon defeat.

title: Terra Magica
text: Ride the lift past the boss and loot the chest at the top to obtain Terra Magica.

Terra Magica: Sorcery . Found at the top of a tower in the middle of the Raya Lucaria Academy. This area is accessed by completing the Academy Crystal Cave dungeon and taking the lift behind the boss' door.

title: Ash of War: Shield Bash
text: Travel to Crystalline Woods and head north toward a building in the woods with Smithing Stone [3] x3.

Smithing Stone [3]: Upgrade Material. Found in Raya Lucaria Academy Rooftops, by jumping from the Tower with the Imbued Sword Key and going around until they can be looted off a corpse overseeing the lift and graveyard.
Continue northeast toward a building in the lake with Smithing Stone [2] x3.
Smithing Stone [2]: Upgrade Material. One can be found inside the Altus Tunnel .
From the building, head east-southeast to discover the East Gate Bridge Trestle grace under the large bridge.
Kill the teleporting scarab at the top of a slope around the corner east of the grace for Ash of War: Shield Bash.
Ash of War: Shield Bash: Ash of War. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab under a bridge very close to East Gate Bridge Trestle site of grace.

title: Stonesword Key
text: Head up the left-side edge of the slope south of the grace to discover a chair with a Stonesword Key between two bridge pillars.
Stonesword Key: Key Item. Found on a body sitting on a chair, in the open field, north from Ainsel River Well.

place.title: Ainsel River Well
walk: Once the Golem has been defeated simply walk through the entrance of the building to find a lever on the right wall and the elevator in the center of the building. Stepping on the button in the middle of the elevator will lower you down into the Ainsel River underground region.

title: Boss: Deathbird (Liurnia of the Lakes South)
text: Travel to the Scenic Isle, pass time until nightfall, and kill the Deathbird near a ruin north-northeast of the grace for Red-Feathered Branchsword and 6,600 runes.
Red-Feathered Branchsword: Dropped by the Deathbird at Liurnia of the Lakes
Deathbird: Only spawns at night. North east of the Scenic Isle site of grace in Liurnia under the ruin wall. It drops the Red-Feathered Branchsword

title: Volcano Manor Invitation
text: Return to Rya in the building east of the grace and give her necklace back to receive the Volcano Manor Invitation.
miss: Unobtainable if you join the Volcano Manor before returning her necklace.

title: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [4]
text: From Rya, head north toward a building with Smithing Stone [3] x3 inside.
On the severed bridge past the building lies a Golden Rune [3].
Golden Rune [3]: Held by a corpse within Academy Gate Town next to some Albinaurics , on the bridge.
Pick up the Golden Rune [4] on the left end of a roof just north of the bridge.
Golden Rune [4]: Within the ruined chapel, surrounded by Albinaurics .
From the roof, head north-northwest to find a corpse with Magic Grease on the tip of a fallen spire on your left.
Go straight west from the spire until you reach the corner of a building. Pick up Crystal Bud x2 from the rubble in the corner.
Crystal Bud: Found within the proximities of the Liurnia Lake Shore Site of Grace .
Climb the building with a tower southeast of the rubble. Loot the chest in the tower for Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [4], then the Arteria Leaf x2 on the roof.
Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [4]: Key Item. Found at Academy Gate Town inside a chest within a tower on the rooftop of a destroyed building.

title: Boss: Death Rite Bird (Raya Lucaria Academy East)
text: Travel to Gate Town North, pass time until nightfall, then kill the Death Rite Bird just south of the grace for Ancient Death Rancor and 7,800 runes.
Ancient Death Rancor: Dropped by the Death Rite Bird in Liurnia of the Lake , to the east of Raya Lucaria Academy at night, south of the Gate Town North site of grace.
Death Rite Bird: Death Rite Bird Miniboss that spawns only at night, south from the Gate Town North site of grace. Drops Ancient Death Rancor.

title: Stonesword Key
text: In the tower south of the boss, you'll find a chest with a Stonesword Key.
Stonesword Key: Found within a chest, in one of the small islands next to the Raya Lucaria Academy .

title: Talk to Isolated Merchant (Raya Lucaria), Fanged Imp Ashes
text: Behind the building east of the tower, next to some gravestones, lies a corpse with Crystal Cave Moss x3.
Travel to the South Raya Lucaria Gate and examine the gate seal. Grab the Main Academy Gate grace after arriving.
Down the slope east-southeast of the grace, you'll find the Isolated Merchant (Raya Lucaria). Buy the Fanged Imp Ashes for solving a puzzle later.
Isolated Merchant: Merchant. Sells Spirit Ashes, Cookbook, Stonesword Key, Warrior Set, and several useful items.

title: Celestial Dew
text: Loot the Strip of White Flesh x2 past the merchant, then the Celestial Dew guarded by a Bloodhound Knight at the end.
Strip of White Flesh: Crafting Material. Two can be looted from a corpse by traveling the road south from Main Academy Gate, past the Isolated Merchant.
Celestial Dew: Used to seek absolution at the Church of Vows. Found on a corpse leaning against the inner side of the locked gate.

title: Invader: Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin +2
text: Return to the Main Academy Gate and interact with the red summon sign on the northeast bridge. Help Yura kill the Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin for Rune Arc, Furlcalling Finger Remedy, and Ash of War: Raptor of the Mists.
Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin: Technically you are the invader of an NPC called "Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin".
Ash of War: Raptor of the Mists: Questline Reward: Found after aiding Bloody Finger Hunter Yura in defeating his target in Raya Lucaria
Furlcalling Finger Remedy F: Looted off a corpse in the middle part of the Iron Ball trap stairs.
miss: You must talk to Yura at least once before approaching the Grand Lift of Rold in the Forbidden Lands.

title: Talk to Bloody Finger Hunter Yura
text: Bloody Finger Hunter Yura: He can be found requesting aid from the player in the form of a Red Summon Sign on the bridge north of the Main Gate Grace. Walk past the magic seal to find. Enter his world and defeat Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin. Afterward, talk to Yura who will be standing against the railing near to where his summon sign was

title: Golden Seed
text: Talk to Yura afterward to receive a Smithing Stone [5], then exhaust his dialogue.
Smithing Stone [5] B: Looted off a corpse at the end of the cut out steps of the Iron ball trap.
Pick up the Golden Seed at the end of the bridge.
Golden Seed: 1 can be found on the ground, next to the glowing sapling. West of the academy's courtyard.
miss: Must be obtained before approaching the Grand Lift of Rold in the Forbidden Lands.

guide.title: Courtyard
text: If you check around as well, there are some materials that you can grab such as Rowa Fruit, Herba, and Trina's Lily. If you check the northwest section of the courtyard, you'll encounter a Giant Crab that will burrow out from the ground. Killing it yields Runes and drops x1 Crab Eggs. Head west of the courtyard and you'll see a glowing sapling that is guarded by three Wandering Nobles. Kill the enemies and check the glowing sapling to find x1 Golden Seed on the ground.

Go back to where the glowing sapling is and check the right-side corner where you'll spot a corpse that you can loot. Tread carefully as you approach it since a Giant Crab will ambush you from the ground. Kill the enemy and loot to the body to find x1 Golden Rune (2). Also near this body, if you go check the ledge of the cliff on the left side of the body, there's another corpse that you can pillage to find x1 Golden Rune (4).

title: Marionette Soldier Ashes
text: Ride the lift at the Main Academy Gate up to enter the academy. Turn right in the small courtyard to find Magic Grease next to a tree.
Magic Grease: Consumable Item. Found on a corpse on the platform to the right of the gate after entering Raya Lucaria Academy
Open the door up the stairs, then hit the illusory wall immediately on the right to discover an area with a Rune Arc.
Back in the church room, loot the Somber Smithing Stone [3] behind the altar, then the Golden Rune [2] in a passage west of it.
Somber Smithing Stone [3] A: Looted off a corpse behind the altar of the Church of the Cuckoo in the academy.
Golden Rune [2]: Looted off a corpse at the Church of the Cuckoo in Raya Lucaria Academy
Grab the Church of the Cuckoo grace in the corridor at the opposite side of the room.
When entering the graveyard, head left to find a corpse with Grace Mimic x3 at the edge.
Grace Mimic: Consumable Item. Three can be Looted off a corpse at the northwest of the graveyard. The body is next to a gravestone, sitting by the ledge.
Drop down east of the corpse to pick up Spellproof Dried Liver next to some gravestones.
Spellproof Dried Liver: One can be found in Liurnia of the Lakes area at the foot of a large tombstone.
Head toward the tree southeast of the gravestones and follow the ledge in the cliff to a Smithing Stone [4].
Smithing Stone [4]: Upgrade Material. Looted off a corpse found by dropping down to the right of the door as soon as entering the first graveyard in Raya Lucaria Academy .
After crossing the bridge, drop toward the left side and follow the ledge up to a corpse with Marionette Soldier Ashes.

Marionette Soldier Ashes: When you reach the graveyard section, as you cross the other side of the bridge, make a hard left and drop down to find a path that curves to where the Marionette Soldiers are, kill the two soldiers and then loot the corpse that is hanging by the ledge to find this item.

title: Ash of War: Spectral Lance
text: Pick up the Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot below the ledge.
Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot: Consumable Item. Looted from a corpse guarded by dogs and undead in the second graveyard of the area, after crossing a wooden hanging bridge.
Go up the slanted gravestones at the left-side cliff, then pick up the Golden Rune [4] immediately after dropping down.

Golden Rune [4]: On a dead body with its back to the precipice, near the main courtyard. Held by a corpse lying against one of the stones. On a corpse lying against one of the walls of the small garden, next to the stairs.
Kill the scarab on the slope for Ash of War: Spectral Lance, then continue southeast to find Mushroom x5 between some gravestones at the top.

Ash of War: Spectral Lance: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in the large graveyard east of the Church of the Cuckoo site of grace. From the site of grace, exit east into the graveyard and head northeast to find a wooden bridge. Just past the bridge, head slightly southeast towards the cliff edge behind a cluster of gravestones. There should be a lower path you can jump down onto and the scarab should be in view at this point.
Mushroom: You can find x5 Mushroom at the Raya Lucaria Academy on a corpse that is behind a tree by the wall.

guide.title: Academy Graveyard
text: While on the left side of the arch doorway, you'll see a path that is lit with a torch, down the slope, you'll find a Teardrop Scarab, kill it to obtain x1 Ash of War: Spectral Lance. If you continue going down the slope, you'll see another corpse that you can loot that is being guarded by another Putrid Corpse. Kill the enemy and loot the corpse at the end of the slope to find x1 Golden Rune (4) - retrace your steps back to the arch doorway and pass through the hall.

By the arch doorway, look to your right and you'll see a slope that goes up, to a corner, there is another Wandering Nobles with a torch here, kill it and walk up a bit, on the right side, there's a body hanging by the ledge, loot it to find a Golden Rune (4) - after grabbing the Golden Rune, go back down and head through the arch doorway where you'll find the Schoolhouse Classroom Site of Grace.

Now go back where you left the rotating lift. Turn left and kill a Wandering Noble at the end to take the lift going down. Take off when you see the ground sticking out. Defeat the group containing 2 Avionette Soldiers and Wandering Nobles to get the Avionette Soldier Ashes.

title: Carian Knight Set
text: Next to a tree before the doorway that leads to the next area, you'll find a corpse with Magic Grease x2.
Magic Grease: Consumable Item. Looted of a corpse in the second graveyard of Raya Lucaria Academy, before the room leading to the elevator to the higher areas.
Drop down the cliff west-southwest of the tree to pick up the Carian Knight Set in front of a gravestone.

Carian Knight Set: The Carian Knight Set can be picked up next to a large tombstone, past the graveyard section of Raya Lucaria Academy. When you reach the gate entrance leading to the large rotating lift, make a hard right and look below the ledge, jump down and follow the narrow path where you'll see a group of Glintstone Zombies worshipping a tombstone.

title: Gravity Well
text: Follow the ledge to a Golden Rune [4] next to the brick wall at the end.
Golden Rune [4]: Looted off a corpse that's sitting on a ledge. Past the first two Marionette Soldiers, you encounter on the rooftops of the academy.
Return to the graveyard. Kill the Alabaster Lord past the waterwheel for Gravity Well, then pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [3] on the shrine.
Gravity Well: Dropped by the Monolith Guardian enemy that appears from a gravity portal. The section is near the graveyard and the large rotating lift of Raya Lucaria Academy .

Somber Smithing Stone [3] B: Looted on the monolith. It can be found past the Graveyard section where you'll see a large rotating lift. It is protected by a Monolith Guardian in Raya Lucaria Academy .

title: Avionette Soldier Ashes
text: Ride the waterwheel up, then jump off midway to discover an alcove with Crystal Dart x5.
Crystal Dart: Looted off a corpse on the broken beam connected to the stars of the Iron ball trap.
Go up the stairs to grab the Schoolhouse Classroom grace in advance.
Head back out and up the slope for a Golden Rune [4] near the top of the wheel.
Golden Rune [4]: Held by a corpse situated on top of the roofs of the Academy.
Ride the waterwheel down while facing north, then jump to the first available ledge to pick up a Golden Rune [3] and Avionette Soldier Ashes.
Avionette Soldier Ashes: Spirit Ashes. Located on a corpse after taking the rotating lift down in Raya Lucaria Academy.

Golden Rune [3]: Pillaged from a corpse located on a wooden beam of the Church of the Cuckoo ceiling. The only way though is going through the broken glass window of the church via the rooftops of Raya Lucaria Academy .

title: Longtail Cat Talisman
text: Ride the wheel until you fall off, then pick up Smithing Stone [5] from the corpse where you land.
Smithing Stone [5] A: At the lower level accessed descending from the elevator. On a dead body.
Climb the crystals near the corpse to pick up Lost Ashes of War at the end of a cliff.
Drop back down and loot the Longtail Cat Talisman next to the rubble of crystals behind an Abductor Virgin.

Longtail Cat Talisman: Looted off a corpse that can be found at the bottom section of the large rotating lift. Past the graveyard section of Raya Lucaria Academy, simply ride the lift down and defeat the single Pendulum Statue enemy.

title: Conspectus Scroll, Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [5]
text: Note: If you died to its grab attack, follow the tunnel past the lava until you reach a site of grace. After resting, you should be able to return to the academy.
Return to the Schoolhouse Classroom and turn left in the hallway for a corpse with Conspectus Scroll and a chest with Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [5].
Conspectus Scroll: Looted off a body inside a room. From the Schoolhouse Classroom site of Raya Lucaria Academy , go to the hallway, turn left. You'll see the corpse in front a an illusory wall.
Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [5]: Looted from a treasure chest inside a room. From the Schoolhouse Classroom site of Raya Lucaria Academy , go to the hallway, turn left.

region: Academy of Raya Lucaria · meeting 2 of 2
title: Talk to Thops (Deceased)
text: Thops: If you give him the Academy Glintstone Key that you find in Raya Lucaria Academy, you'll find him dead, sitting in a chair, outside the Schoolhouse Classroom Site. You can loot the following from his body: Thops's Bell Bearing , Academy Glintstone Staff , and Thops's Barrier .

title: Olivinus Glintstone Crown
text: Hit the illusory wall behind the corpse to reveal a balcony with a Smithing Stone [4].

Smithing Stone [4]: Looted from a corpse on the balcony behind an illusory wall. From the Schoolhouse Classroom site of Raya Lucaria Academy , go to the hallway, turn left. The illusory wall is in front of the corpse inside the room.
Jump over the balcony and follow the lower ledge to some lilies. Climb the rocky ledge and jump over the gap to a corpse with Olivinus Glintstone Crown.

Olivinus Glintstone Crown: Looted from a corpse on a narrow path that leads back to the Schoolhouse Classroom site of Raya Lucaria Academy . You need to pass through the illusory wall and jump over the balcony on the left, and circle back to the said site of grace. To find the illusory wall, go to the hallway from the schoolhouse classroom site, turn left. The illusory wall is in front of the corpse inside the room.

title: Ritual Pot
text: Return to the hallway and continue to a room with several sorcerers. Open the chest in the room to obtain a Ritual Pot.

Ritual Pot: Special Tool Key Item. Found inside a treasure chest, at the end of the hallway that is guarded by sorcerers and a giant Living Jar. The nearest site of grace is the Schoolhouse Classroom in Raya Lucaria Academy .

title: Furlcalling Finger Remedy E
text: Go up the stairs and pick up the Furlcalling Finger Remedy on the balcony.
Furlcalling Finger Remedy E: Looted off a corpse hanging on the fence of the second-floor balcony. The nearest site of grace is the Schoolhouse Classroom in Raya Lucaria Academy .

title: Comet, Stonesword Key
text: Hit the illusory wall on the left up the second set of stairs to reveal a room with Comet and a Stonesword Key.
Comet: Found behind an Illusory Wall before the Debate Hall Site of Grace.
Stonesword Key: Found in Raya Lucaria through an Illusory Wall just before the Site of Grace at Debate Parlor.

guide.title: The Great Hall
text: We suggest that you kill both sorcerers first and then shift your attention towards the Lazuli Sorcerer. Upon defeating the enemies on the second floor, walk towards the balcony with large arc-looking statue, look to the left, and you'll see a corpse that's hanging by the balcony's fence, loot it to find x1 Furlcalling Finger Remedy - you've cleared the second floor.

Secret Wall: Upon reaching the top of the stairs (just before the boss room door), the first empty bookshelf on the left of the staircase is an illusionary wall. See picture below. This leads to a chest containing the spell Comet and a corpse behind the altar containing a Stonesword Key. Climb the ladder in this room and make your way to the terrace along the back wall. There is a hole that will drop you into another room containing the Graven-School Talisman. The pots will come alive once you approach the talisman.
## Greater Enemy: Red Wolf of Radagon

During our encounter with this mini-boss, at the start of the battle, we used the Lone Wolf Ashes to summon three wolves to help in combat. They help in attacking the Red Wolf, and most importantly, they can catch its attention, allowing our character to attack it with ranged magical attacks while it is busy fighting the wolves. The wolf has low health and it is slightly weak against Slash Damage and/or Pierce Damage.

This either happens when it uses a lunging bite attack, this move usually has a max of three hits, and after the third lunge, you can counterattack. Another will be after it leaps into the air and lands on the ground with the magical sword in its mouth, there is a chance for you to land one to two hits before it fully recovers. Just don't be greedy and remember to back away after landing your counters - as you defeat this greater enemy, it rewards you with 14000 Runes and x1 Memory Stone, you'll also find the Debate Parlor Site of Grace in this arena.

title: Graven-School Talisman
text: Climb the ladder in the room, then drop down the holes to a room with the Graven-School Talisman in front of some crystals.

Graven-School Talisman: Talisman. Found beyond the illusory wall before the Red Wolf of Radagon boss fight. Go up the ladder close to the Debate Hall Site of Grace and then down the hole to another the room with potboys. This opens the door inaccessible as you entered this area.

title: Boss: Red Wolf of Radagon
text: Open the shortcut door back, then kill the Red Wolf of Radagon for Memory Stone and 14,000 runes. (This earns an achievement.)
Red Wolf of Radagon: Sub-boss of the area. A giant red wolf Great Enemy Boss found in Raya Lucaria within Liurnia of the Lakes. Drops 1x Memory Stone.
Memory Stone: Rewarded as a drop upon defeating Red Wolf of Radagon .

title: Stonesword Key
text: Activate the Debate Parlor grace and pass time until nightfall.
Head into the courtyard and pick up the Stonesword Key on the fountain.
Stonesword Key: Looted on a fountain, center of the academy's courtyard.

title: Golden Seed
text: Just north past the fountain lies a corpse with Glintstone Firefly x5.
Glintstone Firefly: You can find x5 Glintstone Firefly Looted off a corpse, north section of the courtyard.
Around the corner northwest of the corpse, you'll find a Golden Rune [2] guarded by a Giant Crab.
Golden Rune [2]: North area of the courtyard, beware of the Giant Crab .
Pick up the Golden Rune [4] behind the nearby tower, then the Golden Seed near the cliff.
Golden Rune [4]: Two ( 2 ) found within the sarcophagi in West Liurnia of the Lakes .
Golden Seed: Flask Upgrade Material. One can be found on the ground next to a glowing sapling.

title: Karolos Glintstone Crown
text: Head around the southwest corner to find a Glintstone Crab that drops Karolos Glintstone Crown.
Karolos Glintstone Crown: Drops from the Crystallized Crab that can be found by a corner on the west side of the academy's courtyard.

title: Invader: Moongrum, Carian Knight, Carian Knight's Shield
text: Return to the courtyard and ascend the large curved staircase, picking up a Furlcalling Finger Remedy while dodging the boulder.
Kill Moongrum, Carian Knight for Carian Knight's Shield. Behind him is the lift to the boss, so avoid that for now.
Moongrum, Carian Knight: Moongrum, Carian Knight. The last line of denfense before reaching Rennala's arena. Drops the Carian Knight's Shield upon defeating the hostile NPC.
Carian Knight's Shield: Dropped by Moongrum Carian Knight .

guide.title: Grand Library Outskirts
text: He can also use a flask to recover his health, and he can use a great amount of it. So apart from trying to be careful with fighting this knight, you will need to apply pressure by quickly attacking to stop him from healing. Now, we did discover one tactic that you can exploit. Bait and lead him towards the entrance of the doorway where the iron ball trap is. He will follow you, but not all the way. He will, however, keep walking side to side by the door and back inside, and he will wait for you to approach him. Remain at the sides of the stairs as you hug the fence to avoid getting hit by the iron ball and bombard him with ranged attacks when he's within your sight - successfully defeating this hostile NPC drops x1 Carian Knight's Shield.

From the garden where Moongrum was initially standing, straight ahead is a lift that you can ride to reach the upper level leading to the boss, while the left side of the courtyard goes down to a garden. This is guarded by a Glintstone Sorcerer and Wandering Noble. Go straight through the garden and unlock the door that serves as a shortcut back to the courtyard.
Once you are ready, ride the lift to the top where you'll find doors leading to Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.

title: Glintstone Scarab
text: Follow the south-southwest path through a covered walkway to open a shortcut back to the courtyard, then return the way you came to find a Golden Rune [4].
Golden Rune [4]: Consumable Item. Held by a corpse within the Caria Manor grounds. It is situated near a Stake of Marika.
Jump over the balustrade near the corpse to reach a room with a ladder. Open the shortcut door first, then climb up and kill the sorcerers who summon the boulder.
Open the chest in the room to obtain the Glintstone Scarab.

Glintstone Scarab: Found inside a chest. From the garden section where you encountered the hostile NPC Moongrum Carian Knight, go west, by the gate, hug the wall and jump over the fence. Follow the path and then climb the ladder. The chest is inside the room at the top of the ladder.

title: Boss: Bell Bearing Hunter (Church of Vows)
text: Head out the balcony and pick up the Golden Rune [7] on the roof below it.

Golden Rune [7]: Consumable. Held by a corpse accessible only by taking the ladder in the hidden room leading to the Sorcerers summoning the magic ball trap, then jumping out the window above the waygate.
Confirm that it's still nighttime, then use the sending gate below and kill the Bell Bearing Hunter in Church of Vows for Meat Peddler's Bell Bearing and 6,000 runes.
Meat Peddler's Bell Bearing: Key Item. Dropped by the Bell Bearing Hunter at the Church of Vows upon defeat.

Bell Bearing Hunter: Field Boss. Found at the Church of Vows during night time. Alternatively, you can spawn him by advancing to night, resting at the grace once more and then advancing to morning. Drops the Meat Peddler's Bell Bearing</a. upon defeat.

place.title: Church of Vows
walk: Upon arrival, you are greeted by Miriel, Pastor of Vows, guardian of the church. Upon your first meeting, Miriel will tell the story of the church and offer to share its knowledge on Sorceries, Incantations, as well as Lore related to Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon and Lord Radagon.
Check the right side of the church's entrance for a chest containing the Golden Tailoring Tools and Gold Sewing Needle key items.

Located at the center of the church, a statue of Lady Rennala stands out. Player's can interact with the statue as an "Atone" option is displayed. If you are in possession of a Celestial Dew, atoning for your sins will reverse any antagonizations you have with NPCs, whether caused by accident or on purpose, making them friendly again. However, if the NPC has been killed atonement will not revive them. Celestial Dews are key items obtained from various sources. For details, see the Celestial Dew page.

There is a Bell Bearing Hunter boss that can be fought at the church if you come in during night time. It drops the Meat Peddler's Bell Bearing upon defeat. If you are having trouble spawning the boss, rest at the Site of Grace outside, advance til night and then rest once more. The boss should spawn afterwards.
notes: The Church of Vows can be reached through a Portal. It is located at the right side, in front of the Carian Knight (hostile NPC) in Raya Lucaria Academy.

title: Radagon Icon
text: Optional: Reload the area and talk to Miriel. Show him the Celestial Dew, then select "Talk". If you've killed or aggro'ed any NPCs, you can cleanse your sins at the statue. Any previously hostile NPCs will then become friendly again.
Return to Debate Parlor, but turn right when entering the courtyard. Jump over the balustrade to discover a ladder and climb it to a broken window. Head left once inside to pick up Crystal Bud x5.
Crystal Bud: You can find x5 at the second floor, on a corpse on the ledge.
Loot the chest on the opposite side for Radagon Icon, then pick up the Golden Rune [4] on the outside balcony.

Radagon Icon: Found inside a treasure chest on the second floor of the Debate Hall Site of Grace. From the gate entrance leading to the courtyard, make a hard right and jump over the fence. Climb up the ladder and head through the broken glass window. The treasure chest is on the east section.

title: Cracked Pot
text: Drop down the east side of the balcony to pick up Living Jar Shard x3 and a Cracked Pot.
Living Jar Shard: You can find x3 Living Shard at the Raya Lucaria Academy in the Debate Hall door.
Cracked Pot: Can be found at the Raya Lucaria Academy near the Debate Hall door.

title: Glintstone Whetblade
text: Head down the stairs, then up the stairs covered in rubble. In the room straight ahead is a corpse with Glintstone Whetblade.

Glintstone Whetblade: Looted off a corpse that is hanging on the fence of an office balcony. From the fountain of the academy's courtyard, go west and head up the slope. The office is in front of the group of kneeling Noble Zombies.

guide.title: Academy Rooftops
text: Sprint across the group of Wandering Nobles, up the stairs, and take out the two sorcerers first. Remember that they react slowly when you close the gap and fight them upfront. Next, kill the Wandering Noble, which has a chance to drop Aristocrat Coat, and kill the rest of the Wandering Nobles. Go back down and head up the steps opposite to it where you'll encounter more Wandering Nobles and another Glintstone Sorcerer. Clear this area and loot the nearby corpse to find x1 Golden Rune (2). Next, go back and head towards the arch doorway that was in front of the group of kneeling Wandering Nobles. You'll find an office where you can loot a body that is hanging on the fence of the window balcony - the body contains x1 Glintstone Whetblade.

Looking up, you will notice a corpse on the roof. To reach it, jump down once more and look to your left. There is another roof with a fair amount of gap but still reachable. Perform a careful running jump to step onto the roof and prepare for an immediate ambush a Avionette Soldier. Head left and follow the spiral path of rooftops, inhabited by several Marionette Soldiers. After a jump over a gap once again, you will see a ladder on your left. Just don't go into the ladder room naively since two Marionette Soldiers are each looking for an ambush from the left and right wall. The ladder leads to the top of a bell tower, in which you can obtain the Full Moon Crossbow. Now jump down to a rooftop, on the left of which you will see the forementioned corpse bearing a Smithing Stone (4).

Jump down from the corpse and you are back to where you were before. Do the hard jump again, but this time, go straight to perform another jump. Go to the tower that you see on your right; an Avionette Soldier will ambush in the middle. Go down through broken wooden floors until you see a Crystallized Crab, which can be looted for the Lazuli Glintstone Crown. Eventually, you will reach a small room with some crabs and a body holding a Somber Smithing Stone (4).

Leaving the room, go around to your left to climb the ladder. On your left, you will see a body that you can loot to find x1 Imbued Sword Key inside a tower. Looking across from the key, and you'll see a nearby narrow platform of another towering building. Jump across and go around the platform to find another body that's sitting by the edge, to pillage and acquire x2 Smithing Stone (3).

Retrace your steps back to the ladder to see two Marionette Soldier enemies roaming the rooftops north of you. Jump across the rooftop in front of the ladder. Move North, and then look to your right, there's a dead-end by the rooftop where you'll see a corpse that can be pillaged to acquire x2 Magic Grease. Just be careful since two Avionette Soldiers will ambush you.

Jump down onto the short bridge from the chandelier and tread carefully since the upper section of the church is guarded by Lazuli Sorcerers and Glintstone Sorcerers. Check the northwest side after killing the enemies to find a corpse that is sitting against a wall, you can pillage the body to find x1 Shattering Crystal. Make sure to kick the ladder down that's at the opposite side of the short bridge, this unlocks a shortcut leading back to the Church of the Cuckoo site of grace (take note that the enemies here respawn). Head east to see an arch doorway and a balcony, each at the end of a bridge.

You can go again to the rooftop area to get a missing item, Golden Rune (4), but probably you will just want to skip it. To reach it, go to the roof where you had to make a hard jump over the big gap. Go straight this time and at the very bottom, you'll encounter another Marionette Soldier on the right side. Kill it and continue west where you'll see another Marionette Soldier roaming the narrow rooftop. Jump across the next rooftop and you'll see another body here that you can loot to pick up x1 Golden Rune (4).

title: Full Moon Crossbow
text: Up the stairs opposite the room, you'll find a Golden Rune [2].
Go up the stairs next to the room, then jump over the west balustrade. Open the shortcut down the stairs, then go back up to grab a Golden Rune [3] at the end.
Jump onto the rooftops below and continue to a ladder. Pick up the Golden Rune [4] on the ledge around it.
Climb the ladder and pick up Crystal Dart x5 from a corpse on the bridge.
Crystal Dart: Consumable Item. Found on a corpse on the rooftop area of Raya Lucaria Academy, when a Sorcerer and three Avionette Soldiers attack.
Behind the structure at the end of the bridge lies a corpse with Meteor Bolt x5.
Meteor Bolt: Consumable Item. Five can be looted from a corpse on the tower after the encounter with three Avionette Soldiers and a Sorcerer

Drop to the rooftop below, then once more to a second rooftop. From there, you're gonna do a long jump, so make sure to hold the sprint button during the entire jump for the longest distance. While facing west-northwest, jump across the long gap to the rooftop ahead.
After jumping the gap, head down the south rooftops until you reach a tower. Climb the ladder inside to a chest with the Full Moon Crossbow.

Full Moon Crossbow: Weapon. From the Debate Parlor Site of Grace, head out into the courtyard and to the left to reach the rooftops. Continue along the rooftops until the tower past the Glintstone Sorcerer and three Avionette Soldiers. Across from the tower on another rooftop, an item will be visible. Drop down to the rooftop below and jump on top of the spike near the right edge. From the spike, turn left and jump onto the gargoyle (architectural, not an enemy) protruding from a corner of the building. Another jump will bring you to the rooftop with the item, a Smithing Stone [4]. Alternatively, you can reach this item by jumping from the tower onto a roof opposite the Full Moon Crossbow's chest in the tower. From that roof, a long jump will be required to reach the rooftops with the patrolling Marionette Soldier with spears. Sprinting before the jump is required, as a normal jump will not cover the distance. Note that there is a delay before sprinting starts (likely to determine whether the player is trying to roll or sprint). Continue along the rooftops to the left, past the four Marionette Soldiers and jump onto a platform connected to a tower. Inside, two Marionette Soldiers will ambush you from either side. Climb up the ladder to find a chest with the Full Moon Crossbow.

title: Lazuli Glintstone Crown
text: Jump over the west balustrade to land on a rooftop. From there, you can drop onto two rooftops, so drop to the one with a Smithing Stone [4] on top.
Smithing Stone [4]: Upgrade Material. Only accessible by dropping down from the tower with the Full Moon Crossbow .

Drop to the rooftop where you made the long jump. Do it once more, then follow the west rooftop to a tower. Drop down twice inside the tower to find a Glintstone Crab that drops the Lazuli Glintstone Crown.
Lazuli Glintstone Crown: Looted from a Crystal Crab . Click Here for a detailed guide on how to get it.

title: Imbued Sword Key
text: Drop to the bottom to pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [4].
Somber Smithing Stone [4]: Looted off a corpse that can be found in a small room with some small crabs. Located at the rooftops section of Raya Lucaria Academy .

Travel to Debate Parlor and return to the rooftop where you made the long jumps. This time, drop down the north rooftops instead to pick up the Golden Rune [4] on a roof past the stretch with two Marionette Soldiers.
Drop to the ledge east below where the first Marionette Soldier was and pick up the Imbued Sword Key in a tower.
Imbued Sword Key: Key Item used to activate a Waygate. It can be looted off a corpse found on the east side of the Raya Lucaria Academy rooftops.

place.title: Raya Lucaria Academy
walk: ## How to Unlock the Academy of Raya Lucaria
## Academy Gate Town

As you take out the enemies in this section, don't forget to grab a Smithing Stone (3) that can be looted from the ground. Continue moving north through the enemies to reach the gate or you can go around it by moving east where you'll find a corpse that you can loot to find 4x Glintstone Fireflies - the end of this path is where you'll find the South Raya Lucaria Gate Site of Grace and the entrance to the academy, when you're ready, go through the sigil of the gate. Important: If you do not see the prompt to pass through the sigil, try standing under the sigil itself rather than against the physical gate.
## Entering the Academy of Raya Lucaria

Go back, and head up the stairs where you'll see two Glintstone Sorcerers at the top, be mindful when you are fighting these enemies since they can use sorcery and bombard you with glintstone sorcery from afar; use your shield, time your dodges right, or even close the gap and attack them with your melee weapon since they react slow towards close-quarter combat. Kill the two Glintstone Sorcerers and open the door to continue onto the next section, the Church of the Cuckoo.

You can easily spot them if you look up and press the auto-lock button. Upon clearing the section, make sure to check behind the altar, there is a wall, and behind it is a corpse that you can loot to find a Somber Smithing Stone (3), while on the right side, resting against a wall, is another corpse that has a Golden Rune (2). Before Moving on there is also a hidden room on the right side as you enter. The first wall segment on the right side is an Illusory Wall. Break the illusion to reveal a small side area filled with stone coffins. On the other end of the area is a corpse with a Rune Arc. Now, there is another room that you can find on the left side that has the Church of the Cuckoo Site of Grace, just turn left as you pass through the arch doorway to find it - activate it and rest if needed.
## Academy Graveyard

While on the left side of the arch doorway, you'll see a path that is lit with a torch, down the slope, you'll find a Teardrop Scarab, kill it to obtain x1 Ash of War: Spectral Lance. If you continue going down the slope, you'll see another corpse that you can loot that is being guarded by another Putrid Corpse. Kill the enemy and loot the corpse at the end of the slope to find x1 Golden Rune (4) - retrace your steps back to the arch doorway and pass through the hall.

By the arch doorway, look to your right and you'll see a slope that goes up, to a corner, there is another Wandering Nobles with a torch here, kill it and walk up a bit, on the right side, there's a body hanging by the ledge, loot it to find a Golden Rune (4) - after grabbing the Golden Rune, go back down and head through the arch doorway where you'll find the Schoolhouse Classroom Site of Grace.

Now go back where you left the rotating lift. Turn left and kill a Wandering Noble at the end to take the lift going down. Take off when you see the ground sticking out. Defeat the group containing 2 Avionette Soldiers and Wandering Nobles to get the Avionette Soldier Ashes.
## The Great Hall

We suggest that you kill both sorcerers first and then shift your attention towards the Lazuli Sorcerer. Upon defeating the enemies on the second floor, walk towards the balcony with large arc-looking statue, look to the left, and you'll see a corpse that's hanging by the balcony's fence, loot it to find x1 Furlcalling Finger Remedy - you've cleared the second floor.

Secret Wall: Upon reaching the top of the stairs (just before the boss room door), the first empty bookshelf on the left of the staircase is an illusionary wall. See picture below. This leads to a chest containing the spell Comet and a corpse behind the altar containing a Stonesword Key. Climb the ladder in this room and make your way to the terrace along the back wall. There is a hole that will drop you into another room containing the Graven-School Talisman. The pots will come alive once you approach the talisman.
## Greater Enemy: Red Wolf of Radagon

During our encounter with this mini-boss, at the start of the battle, we used the Lone Wolf Ashes to summon three wolves to help in combat. They help in attacking the Red Wolf, and most importantly, they can catch its attention, allowing our character to attack it with ranged magical attacks while it is busy fighting the wolves. The wolf has low health and it is slightly weak against Slash Damage and/or Pierce Damage.

This either happens when it uses a lunging bite attack, this move usually has a max of three hits, and after the third lunge, you can counterattack. Another will be after it leaps into the air and lands on the ground with the magical sword in its mouth, there is a chance for you to land one to two hits before it fully recovers. Just don't be greedy and remember to back away after landing your counters - as you defeat this greater enemy, it rewards you with 14000 Runes and x1 Memory Stone, you'll also find the Debate Parlor Site of Grace in this arena.
## Academy of Raya Lucaria
## Courtyard

If you check around as well, there are some materials that you can grab such as Rowa Fruit, Herba, and Trina's Lily. If you check the northwest section of the courtyard, you'll encounter a Giant Crab that will burrow out from the ground. Killing it yields Runes and drops x1 Crab Eggs. Head west of the courtyard and you'll see a glowing sapling that is guarded by three Wandering Nobles. Kill the enemies and check the glowing sapling to find x1 Golden Seed on the ground.

Go back to where the glowing sapling is and check the right-side corner where you'll spot a corpse that you can loot. Tread carefully as you approach it since a Giant Crab will ambush you from the ground. Kill the enemy and loot to the body to find x1 Golden Rune (2). Also near this body, if you go check the ledge of the cliff on the left side of the body, there's another corpse that you can pillage to find x1 Golden Rune (4).
## Academy Rooftops

Sprint across the group of Wandering Nobles, up the stairs, and take out the two sorcerers first. Remember that they react slowly when you close the gap and fight them upfront. Next, kill the Wandering Noble, which has a chance to drop Aristocrat Coat, and kill the rest of the Wandering Nobles. Go back down and head up the steps opposite to it where you'll encounter more Wandering Nobles and another Glintstone Sorcerer. Clear this area and loot the nearby corpse to find x1 Golden Rune (2). Next, go back and head towards the arch doorway that was in front of the group of kneeling Wandering Nobles. You'll find an office where you can loot a body that is hanging on the fence of the window balcony - the body contains x1 Glintstone Whetblade.

Looking up, you will notice a corpse on the roof. To reach it, jump down once more and look to your left. There is another roof with a fair amount of gap but still reachable. Perform a careful running jump to step onto the roof and prepare for an immediate ambush a Avionette Soldier. Head left and follow the spiral path of rooftops, inhabited by several Marionette Soldiers. After a jump over a gap once again, you will see a ladder on your left. Just don't go into the ladder room naively since two Marionette Soldiers are each looking for an ambush from the left and right wall. The ladder leads to the top of a bell tower, in which you can obtain the Full Moon Crossbow. Now jump down to a rooftop, on the left of which you will see the forementioned corpse bearing a Smithing Stone (4).

Jump down from the corpse and you are back to where you were before. Do the hard jump again, but this time, go straight to perform another jump. Go to the tower that you see on your right; an Avionette Soldier will ambush in the middle. Go down through broken wooden floors until you see a Crystallized Crab, which can be looted for the Lazuli Glintstone Crown. Eventually, you will reach a small room with some crabs and a body holding a Somber Smithing Stone (4).

Leaving the room, go around to your left to climb the ladder. On your left, you will see a body that you can loot to find x1 Imbued Sword Key inside a tower. Looking across from the key, and you'll see a nearby narrow platform of another towering building. Jump across and go around the platform to find another body that's sitting by the edge, to pillage and acquire x2 Smithing Stone (3).

Retrace your steps back to the ladder to see two Marionette Soldier enemies roaming the rooftops north of you. Jump across the rooftop in front of the ladder. Move North, and then look to your right, there's a dead-end by the rooftop where you'll see a corpse that can be pillaged to acquire x2 Magic Grease. Just be careful since two Avionette Soldiers will ambush you.

Jump down onto the short bridge from the chandelier and tread carefully since the upper section of the church is guarded by Lazuli Sorcerers and Glintstone Sorcerers. Check the northwest side after killing the enemies to find a corpse that is sitting against a wall, you can pillage the body to find x1 Shattering Crystal. Make sure to kick the ladder down that's at the opposite side of the short bridge, this unlocks a shortcut leading back to the Church of the Cuckoo site of grace (take note that the enemies here respawn). Head east to see an arch doorway and a balcony, each at the end of a bridge.

You can go again to the rooftop area to get a missing item, Golden Rune (4), but probably you will just want to skip it. To reach it, go to the roof where you had to make a hard jump over the big gap. Go straight this time and at the very bottom, you'll encounter another Marionette Soldier on the right side. Kill it and continue west where you'll see another Marionette Soldier roaming the narrow rooftop. Jump across the next rooftop and you'll see another body here that you can loot to pick up x1 Golden Rune (4).
## The Metal Ball Trap
## Grand Library Outskirts

He can also use a flask to recover his health, and he can use a great amount of it. So apart from trying to be careful with fighting this knight, you will need to apply pressure by quickly attacking to stop him from healing. Now, we did discover one tactic that you can exploit. Bait and lead him towards the entrance of the doorway where the iron ball trap is. He will follow you, but not all the way. He will, however, keep walking side to side by the door and back inside, and he will wait for you to approach him.
