Remain at the sides of the stairs as you hug the fence to avoid getting hit by the iron ball and bombard him with ranged attacks when he's within your sight - successfully defeating this hostile NPC drops x1 Carian Knight's Shield.

From the garden where Moongrum was initially standing, straight ahead is a lift that you can ride to reach the upper level leading to the boss, while the left side of the courtyard goes down to a garden. This is guarded by a Glintstone Sorcerer and Wandering Noble. Go straight through the garden and unlock the door that serves as a shortcut back to the courtyard.
Once you are ready, ride the lift to the top where you'll find doors leading to Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.
## Facing Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon

This is why summoning the wolves is a good tactic since they'll just randomly run around attacking the children, and if you're lucky enough, if they spot one that is hiding, it can just attack it once, and you can find the next host. There is also one moment in combat that you will need to be aware of, when she speaks and says something about her children being born anew, get ready to get behind the bookshelves or stack of books since she will use them as projectiles to attack you.

Take note that every time she summons a spirit, white glyphs will appear on the ground that deals damage and can knock you down if you are caught or step on it. Defeating her yields 40000 Runes and rewards you with x1 Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen and x1 Great Rune of the Unborn.
## Where to Use the Academy Glintstone Key
notes: Find the Academy Glintstone Key.
Investigate the two bridges leading to the academy's main gate.
Explore the academy.
Defeat the Monolith Guardian.
Collect the Carian Knight Set
Fight the Red Wolf of Radagon.
Keep an eye out for Crystallized Crabs.
Explore the Rooftops of the academy.
Obtain the Academy Glintstone Key.
Find the Radagon Icon Talisman.
Acquire the Azur's Glintstone Staff.
Successfully pass through the Iron Ball trap.
Fight the hostile NPC Knight.
Face Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.
Give the Academy Glintstone Key to Thops

title: Academy Glintstone Key
text: Go around the ledge of the second tower to find a corpse with Smithing Stone [3] x2.
Head back across until you see the top of a ladder, then jump onto the large rooftop below. At the northwest end of it is a corpse with Magic Grease x2.
Magic Grease: Consumable Item. Looted off a corpse on the rooftops of the Church of Cuckoo, protected by two Avionette Soldiers.
Go through the church windows and pick up the Golden Rune [3] on the rafters.
Golden Rune [3]: Five ( 5 ) found within the sarcophagi in West Liurnia of the Lakes .
Carefully drop to the southernmost chandelier to grab the Academy Glintstone Key.

Academy Glintstone Key: Looted off a corpse that's on the chandelier of Church of the Cuckoo. The only way to reach this is going through the broken glass window of the church via the rooftops of Raya Lucaria Academy .

title: Twinsage Glintstone Crown
text: Drop to the small bridge below and head out the balcony to find a Glintstone Crab in the corner that drops the Twinsage Glintstone Crown.

Twinsage Glintstone Crown: Drops from a Crystallized Crab once killed. You'll find it outside the second-floor balcony, east section of the Church of the Cuckoo in Raya Lucaria Academy . It's hiding by the corner of the scaffolding.

title: Shattering Crystal
text: Go across the small bridge, kick down the shortcut ladder, and pick up Shattering Crystal at the end of the corridor.

Shattering Crystal: Looted off a corpse on the second floor, west side, of the Church of the Cuckoo in Raya Lucaria Academy . The only way to reach this is going through the broken glass window of the church via the rooftops

title: Azur's Glintstone Staff
text: Head through the covered walkway across the other bridge to pick up Azur's Glintstone Staff in front of the graven mass.
Azur's Glintstone Staff: Looted on the ground inside a room that is full of crystals. It's on the east side, the second floor of the Church of the Cuckoo within Raya Lucaria Academy.

title: Boss: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon
text: Travel to Debate Parlor and return to the large curved staircase. At the bottom of it is a Smithing Stone [5].

Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. Obtained as a reward by talking to Bloody Finger Hunter Yura at this location after assisting him in defeating Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin via a red summon sign.
Pick up Crystal Dart x8 from the broken buttress attached to the side of the staircase.
Crystal Dart: Consumable Throwable Item. Found on a corpse just outside the Schoolhouse Classroom site of grace, by some digging aristocrats.
Ride the lift to the boss and defeat Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon for Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen, Great Rune of the Unborn, and 40,000 runes. (This earns an achievement.)
Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen: Remembrance of Rennala, Queen of the Moon. Acquired as a reward for defeating the supreme sorceress. To be given to Enia to draw out the power within.
Great Rune of the Unborn: Great Rune of Rennala, Queen of the Moon. Acquired as a reward for defeating the supreme sorceress.
Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon: One of the demigods. She can be fought at the top of Raya Lucaria Academy .

guide.title: Facing Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon
text: This is why summoning the wolves is a good tactic since they'll just randomly run around attacking the children, and if you're lucky enough, if they spot one that is hiding, it can just attack it once, and you can find the next host. There is also one moment in combat that you will need to be aware of, when she speaks and says something about her children being born anew, get ready to get behind the bookshelves or stack of books since she will use them as projectiles to attack you.

Take note that every time she summons a spirit, white glyphs will appear on the ground that deals damage and can knock you down if you are caught or step on it. Defeating her yields 40000 Runes and rewards you with x1 Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen and x1 Great Rune of the Unborn.

title: Talk to Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon
text: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon: Rennala becomes a merchant in her boss room after defeating her. She provides rebirthing services, allowing you to respec your character.

title: Balled Up
text: Activate the Raya Lucaria Grand Library grace and talk to Rennala. Select "Cosmetics", then "Finish Cosmetics" to learn the Balled Up gesture.

title: Erudition Gesture, Erudition
text: Return to Thops in Church of Irith and give him your second glintstone key to learn the Erudition gesture. Optionally, talk to him about Sellen.
Erudition Gesture: Gesture. Obtained as a reward for giving Thops a Glintstone Academy Key, found in Raya Lucaria Academy.

title: Ash of War: Thops's Barrier
text: Reload the area to find a scarab in the church that drops Ash of War: Thops's Barrier.
Ash of War: Thops's Barrier: Ash of War. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab that spawns inside the church after Thops leaves for the academy.

place.title: Church of Irith
walk: Church of Irith is one of the first locations you can visit once you enter Liurnia of the Lakes after completing Stormveil Castle (or using the alternate route into Liurnia). Of note in this church are the Sacred Tear in front of the Statue of Marika and the NPC Thops sitting on a bench at the side. Thops will sell you some low-level sorcery spells after donating 10 Runes to him. You can also speak to him about an Academy Glintstone Key and he will mention wanting to return to the academy. When you've obtained two such keys, you can donate one to Thops and he will move to the Raya Lucaria Academy. If you return to the church after Thops leaves, there will be a Teardrop Scarab where he used to sit. Killing it awards the Ash of War: Thops's Barrier. If it does not drop the Ash of War, double check that you do not have this specific item already.

title: Thops's Bell Bearing, Academy Glintstone Staff
text: Travel to Schoolhouse Classroom and go outside to find Thops at a table. Loot Thops's Bell Bearing, Academy Glintstone Staff, and Thops's Barrier from his corpse.
Thops's Bell Bearing: Looted from Thops' corpse .
Academy Glintstone Staff: Staff. Can be found on Sorcerer Thops' body near the Schoolhouse Classroom site of grace after giving him the Academy Glintstone Key.
Talk to Enia in Roundtable Hold to receive a Talisman Pouch. Optionally, talk to her about Queen Marika.
Optional: Speak with Corhyn and select "Talk" now that you've obtained two Great Runes.

title: Treespear
text: Travel to Liurnia Lake Shore and head east to a spiritspring. Use it while facing east-northeast, then grab the Liurnia Highway South grace by the road.
Follow the road southeast until you reach a carriage at the end. Loot Treespear from the chest in front.
Treespear: Found on the Caravan left at the edge of the collapsed bridge.

title: Two Fingers Heirloom, Shabriri Grape
text: Return to Liurnia Highway South and pop the two balloons near the grace for 2x Golden Rune [6].
Golden Rune [6]: Dropped from a balloon in the deluged area of Liurnia of the Lakes that has some enemies attached to it. Defeat all of them and destroy the balloon to obtain the Golden Rune (6)
Follow the road to some ruins and pick up Stormhawk Feather x3 from a corpse between them.
Stormhawk Feather: Found on a corpse by the road.
Northwest of the corpse lies Purified Ruins:
Pick up Cuckoo Glintstone x4 from a corpse in the ruined building.
Cuckoo Glintstone: Consumable Item. Four can be found on a dead body, against a wall within Purified Ruins. Beware of the group of Soldiers.
Loot the Shabriri Grape and Two Fingers Heirloom in the cellar covered with breakable planks in the ruined building.

Two Fingers Heirloom: Talisman. Found in a chest inside a hidden cellar in the Purified Ruins . The cellar entrance is concealed by wooden planks and barrels that you can roll onto or attack to destroy.
Shabriri Grape: Can be found in a hidden cellar. The path is blocked by debris and barrels that you can roll onto or attack to destroy. Once downstairs, you can find it on your left.

place.title: Purified Ruins
walk: This ruins can be found by following the eastern side of the lake from Stormveil Castle. There are a handful of hostile knights and spearmen, as well as one dog to defeat in this location, but they are mostly spread apart from each other so you don't need to worry about getting overwhelmed. The particular Soldier-type in this location is the Foot Soldier. These Soldiers have a chance to drop items from the Foot Soldier Set. Knights are found within the ruin walls and become animated once you approach. These can be easily countered by beginning your attack behind them to avoid extending combat.

In the large hall filled with soldiers, search near the middle of the ruins for a set of crates and pots. There is a wooden board covering the entrance to an underground room here. Inside the room is a Shabriri Grape on the corpse on the left and the Two Fingers Heirloom talisman inside the chest. Back outside, search the southwest section for a narrow path with barrels. There is a Golden Rune (3) in front of the barrels.

Check the western side of the ruins, right by the lake shore. If you've given Hyetta a Shabriri Grape in her first location, you will be able to find her here where she will ask for another grape but does not reward anything this time.
In the northeast section of the ruins, you can find a Waygate which will teleport you to the entrance of the Raya Lucaria Academy.

title: Talk to Hyetta
text: Hyetta: Hyetta , Location 2. She is found at the western side of the Purified Ruins . She asks for another Shabriri Grape but does not give any reward this time.

title: Nox Mirrorhelm
text: In front of some barrels west of the cellar, you'll find a Golden Rune [3].
Golden Rune [3]: Found in the Purified Ruins. On a body, against a few barrels in a narrow corridor.
Talk to Hyetta by the ruins near the shore and give her a Shabriri Grape.
Pick up Mushroom x5 from the corner of the ruins north-northeast of Hyetta.
Mushroom: Crafting Material. Four can be looted from a corpse guarded by two zombie dogs north from Purified Ruins.
Return to the road and grab the Liurnia Highway North grace before a battlefield.
On top of the ruin north-northeast of the grace is a corpse with Beast Blood, guarded by wolves.
Head down the slope south-southeast of the ruin until you reach a chair at the end with Somber Smithing Stone [2] x2.
Somber Smithing Stone [2]: Upgrade Material. Two can be found on a corpse sitting on a chair by the cliffs to the southeast of Liurnia of the Lakes.
Go up the slope until you find the entrance to Cliffbottom Catacombs on the left side:
Enter and activate the Cliffbottom Catacombs grace.
Ride the lift down while facing east, then jump to a ledge with Grave Glovewort [2].

Grave Glovewort [2]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. The first is found by facing east while riding down the lift by the entrance and jumping onto a small balcony as the lift passes it by. The second one is found by turning the corner in the corridor to the right of the boss door. The third one is found by heading up the stairs to the right of the door sealed by an Imp Statue and following the path to an alcove in a small room at the end. The final one is found along a corridor leading up to the room with a ladder to the library.
Pick up Root Resin x5 from the first room.
Root Resin: Crafting Material. Five can be looted from a corpse in the first chamber after descending the lift into Cliffbottom Catacombs.
Continue until you reach a corridor with a Grave Glovewort [2].
Go down the stairs and continue to a room with a Grave Glovewort [3] beneath the floor.

Grave Glovewort [3]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. The first one is found in the large room with the Imp Statue seal - Check the area behind the stairs leading up to the Imp Statue. The second one is found in a narrow corridor on the top level of the multi-leveled hall where you can see the boss lever statue. In the same multi-leveled hall, drop down onto the central stair-bridge and then drop further down into the pit below and check the corridors for the third and fourth Grave Glovewort (3).
Unlock the imp seal on the second floor to pick up Nox Mirrorhelm.
Nox Mirrorhelm: Helmet. Found in Cliffbottom Catacombs : In the sealed room, accessible by using a Stonesword Key at the Imp Statue.

guide.title: Cliffbottom Catacombs in Liurnia
text: ## Liurnia of the Lakes: East
Elden Ring Main Quest Guide - Liurnia of the Lakes (East) Points of Interest
Clear out Cliffbottom Catacombs.
Examine the Highway Lookout Tower.
Travel to the Church of Vows.
Visit the Minor Erdtree of Northeast Liurnia.
Complete Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel.
Investigate Ainsel River (Underground).
## Cliffbottom Catacombs in Liurnia

Once you've cleared Raya Lucaria Academy, it's time to explore the east side of the map for Liurnia of the Lakes, we recommend that you start from the Lake-Facing Cliffs Site and work your way up. The Cliffbottom Catacombs can be found a bit northeast of the mentioned site. Cliffbottom Catacombs is a catacomb that is filled with imps and ogres, Walk carefully to not wake or alert the ogres or get jumped on by the imps. The catacombs also have multiple buttons on the floor that trigger traps that shoot projectiles at the player, use them to your advantage by triggering them to hit enemies. The imps in this dungeon will throw a blue pot explosion at players - this location is good to find upgrade materials such as Grave Glovewort [2] and Grave Glovewort [3] that are used to strengthen your Spirit Ashes with the help of Roderika.

Leaving the Site of Grace going down the stairs you will see the elevator room, step on the button to lower yourself down. A lever is present at the top and bottom of the shaft for you to call the elevator if it is not there. The first room after the elevator has 2 imps, one on the wall ahead and one standing on the right of the entrance. Past this room is the pair of locked doors flanked by 2 statues, the door will be unlocked by a lever found deep in the catacombs.

Stepping into the rest of the catacombs you will walk into a square room with a staircase, the stairs lead downwards going over a pit where an ogre can be seen sitting. Going forward into the next tunnel be careful of both the floor trap as well as the imp in the ceiling, there is another imp on the corner ahead that will jump you so be prepared for it.

Through this tunnel, you enter into a room with a high ceiling, and some stairs leading up on the left side, straight ahead there is a sleeping ogre between the pillars, kill it to get to the grave glovewort behind it. Up the stairs are a sealed door and an imp statue but also another ogre, this time awake and patrolling, above them are a pair of imps ready to throw grenades at you if you catch their attention. You could either rush the imps by going up the stairs and ignoring the ogre or kite the ogre down the stairs to separate the imps and the ogre to make for an easier fight.

The room sealed by the Imp statue will require a Stonesword Key to open, you will find 1 imp enemy and the Nox Mirrorhelm. Go up the stairs and carefully deal with the 2 imps in this room, a floor trap is placed right at the entrance to the room which can be used to shoot projectiles into one of the imps. Following the path out of this room, you will find yourself in the space above the initial set of stairs and entrance. There are multiple imps in this area and in the room on the left you can find 3 imps, the body there holds the scythe for you to loot.

To proceed to the lever, you have to drop down into the room under the first set of stairs leading from the locked doors. This part of the catacombs has multiple ogres roaming the halls so tread carefully. Moving around the tunnels here you can find remains with loot on them, one of which is the Prattling Pate "Wonderful".

From the room you dropped down into go east to advance, there you will find a single ogre blocking the way forward, kill them to proceed. At the end of these tunnels is a ladder, climb it to find a room with a carpet and some bookshelves. On the left, you will find an ogre looking at a tomb in front of a stone statue, going right will lead you to the lever and the way back to the start. On the tomb is the Page Ashes.

This fight is against a variant version of the Erdtree Burial Watchdog that uses a staff, spells, and has 3 heads that will do a 3 headed fire breathing attack. The fight is against just the boss without any additional enemies. The boss still uses the same movement pattern as the normal Erdtree Burial Watchdog, in their seated form floating up and towards the player before stomping down and walking towards the player to slam and slamming that down while in their standing form. While seated the Erdtree Burial Watchdog will also cast spells at players, breathing flames at them or casting seeking glintstone sorceries. Defeating this boss will reward you with Kaiden Sellsword Ashes and 3200 Runes.
## The Wandering Maiden... Again.

After clearing the Cliffbottom Catacombs, from this location, head northwest and you should find the Purified Ruins. You can find items such as another Sabriri Grape, a Golden Rune [3], a Cuckoo Glinstone, and the Two Fingers Heirloom talisman. Since you have another Shabriri Grape, you'll find Hyetta on the western side of the Purified Ruins. She asks for another Shabriri Grape but does not give any reward this time. Continue going north and you'll encounter the Purified Ruins Waygate that teleports you to the entrance of Raya Lucaria Academy - next, make sure to discover the Liurnia Highway North Site, found on the side of the main road

title: Scythe
text: In front of some bookshelves beneath the floor is a Rune Arc.
Rune Arc: Consumable. Found on a corpse on a dead-end chamber within Cliffbottom Catacombs, near the Stone Sword Key Imp gate.
Pick up Grave Glovewort [2] from the top floor room, then pick up Scythe from the room at the end.
Scythe: Found in Cliffbottom Catacombs : toward the end of the dungeon, find a staircase to go up into a room with some Imps and a trap.

title: Prattling Pate
text: Before dropping down, loot the Golden Rune [3] and Grave Glovewort [3] in the left passage.
Golden Rune [3]: Consumable Item. Found on a corpse on the higher level of Cliffbottom Catacombs, after an ambush by two Imps and next to a Glovewort (3).
Drop onto the staircase, then once more to the bottom for a Ghost Glovewort [3] in the middle.

Ghost Glovewort [3]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. In the large multi-level hall, drop down to the very bottom via the gaps on either side of the central stair-bridge. Check around the corridors of this bottom pit for several items, one of which is a Ghost Glovewort (3).
Loot the 2x Grave Glovewort [3], Hefty Beast Bone x3, and Prattling Pate "Wonderful" around the room.

Prattling Pate: Found in Cliffbottom Catacombs , in the very bottom level of the large multi-leveled hall. You can drop down to this level via the gap on either side of the central stair-bridge. Check around the corridors here for several items, one of which is the Prattling Pate.

title: Page Ashes
text: Continue ahead to find a Grave Glovewort [2] in the corridor.
Climb the ladder at the end and pick up Page Ashes from the altar on the left.
Page Ashes: Spirit Ashes. Found in Cliffbottom Catacombs, in an altar right before you pull the lever to open the Boss Door.

title: Boss: Erdtree Burial Watchdog (Cliffbottom Catacombs)
text: Pull the boss lever, then turn around to find Old Fang x3 in the corner.
Old Fang: Crafting Material. Found on a corpse by the lever that opens the Boss Room Door in Cliffbottom Catacombs.
Kill the Erdtree Burial Watchdog for Kaiden Sellsword Ashes and 3,200 runes.
Kaiden Sellsword Ashes: Found within Cliffbottom Catacombs . Dropped by Erdtree Burial Watchdog.
Erdtree Burial Watchdog: Optional Boss found at the end of the Cliffbottom Catacombs . Drops the Kaiden Sellsword Ashes upon defeat.

place.title: Cliffbottom Catacombs
walk: Cliffbottom Catacombs is a catacombs that is filled with imps and omens. Walk carefully to not wake or alert the omens or get jumped on by the imps. The catacombs also have multiple buttons on the floor that trigger traps that shoot projectiles at the player; you can use them to your advantage by triggering them to hit enemies. The imps in this dungeon will throw a blue pot explosion at players.

Leaving the Site of Grace going down the stairs you will see the elevator room, step on the button to lower yourself down. A lever is present at the top and bottom of the shaft for you to call the elevator if it is not there. The first room after the elevator has 2 imps, one on the wall ahead and one standing on the right of the entrance. Past this room is the pair of locked doors flanked by 2 statues, the door will be unlocked by a lever found deep in the catacombs.

Stepping into the rest of the catacombs you will walk into a square room with a staircase, the stairs lead downwards going over a pit where an omen can be seen sitting. Going forward into the next tunnel be careful of both the floor trap as well as the imp in the ceiling, there is another imp on the corner ahead that will jump you so be prepared for it.

Through this tunnel you enter into a room with a high ceiling, and some stairs leading up on the left side, straight ahead there is a sleeping ogre between the pillars, kill it to get to the grave glovewort behind it. Up the stairs is a sealed door and an imp statue but also another omen, this time awake and patrolling, above them are a pair of imps ready to throw grenades at you if you catch their attention. You could either rush the imps by going up the stairs and ignoring the omen or kite the omen down the stairs to separate the imps and the omen to make for an easier fight. You can also stealth up the side of the stairs and through the door while the omen is walking the other direction, the imps will not notice.

The room sealed by the Imp statue will require a Stonesword Key to open, inside you will find 1 imp enemy and the Nox Mirrorhelm. Go up the stairs and carefully deal with the two imps in this room, a floor trap is placed right at the entrance to the room which can be used to shoot projectiles into one of the imps. Following the path out of this room you will find yourself in the space above the initial set of stairs and entrance. There are multiple imps in this area and in the room on the left you can find 3 imps, the body there holds the scythe for you to loot.

To proceed to the lever you have to drop down into the room under the first set of stairs leading from the locked doors. This part of the catacombs has multiple omens roaming the halls so tread carefully. Moving around the tunnels here you can find remains with loot on them, one of which is the Prattling Pate "Wonderful".

From the room you dropped down into go east to advance, there you will find a single omen blocking the way forward, kill it to proceed. At the end of these tunnels is a ladder, climb it to find a room with a carpet and some bookshelves. On the left you will find an omen looking at a tomb in front of a stone statue, going right will lead you to the lever and the way back to the start. On the tomb is the Page Ashes.
BOSS BATTLE: Erdtree Burial Watchdog

This fight is against a variant version of the Erdtree Burial Watchdog that uses a staff, spells and has three heads that will do a three-headed fire-breathing attack. The fight is against just the boss without any additional enemies. The boss still uses the same movement pattern as the normal Erdtree Burial Watchdog, in their seated form floating up and towards the player before stomping down and walking towards the player to slam and slamming that down while in their standing form. While seated the Erdtree Burial Watchdog will also cast spells at players, breathing flames at them or casting seeking Glintstone Sorceries. Defeating this boss will reward you with Kaiden Sellsword Ashes and 3,200 Runes.

title: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [3] +1
text: Travel to Liurnia Highway North and head up the northwest slope. Pick up a Golden Rune [4] from the camp outside the tower.
Loot the chest in the tower for Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [3], then pick up the Carian Glintblade Staff at the top.
Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [3]: Cookbook Key Item. Found on a corpse on a wooden walkway in an upper level of the Highway Lookout Tower in Liurnia .
Carian Glintblade Staff: Staff. Found on the top floor of the Highway Lookout Tower in Liurnia .

guide.title: Highway Lookout Tower
text: Just a bit northwest from the Liurnia Highway North Site, stopover the Highway Lookout Tower This tower is situated up a hill and is heavily guarded by specters of Noble Sorcerers and Noble Wanderers, as well as a Twinsage Sorcerer that can be found at the top floor of the tower. We recommend that you traverse the barricades while you are riding your mount since the specters will spawn as soon as you try to push through and the sorcerer at the top of the tower will start shooting sorcery projectiles at you. Climb up the ladder and loot the chest for a Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook (3). Head up two more ladders, kill the sorcerer, and loot the corpse beside the enemy to find the Carian Glintblade Staff.

After clearing the location, climb back down and continue moving a bit northwest as you follow the road which takes you to the site of the Gate Town Bridge. If you spoke to Hyetta earlier, you should find her here as well. Hyetta spawns near the site of grace. She will ask for another Shabriri Grape and will ask what the grapes are. Telling her will make her puke and then thank you for telling her. After sitting down at the grace nearby she will have more dialog. After once again sitting at the grace she will move to her next location.

Now, if you want to challenge yourself and if you want a new Ashes of War, then rest until nightfall by the site and you'll find the Night's Cavalry field boss here. This field boss can be found patrolling near the Gate Town Bridge, again, only appears at night, and it drops the Ash of War: Ice Spear if you defeat it. You can visit our Night's Cavalry page to find a written strategy, as well as a video guide on how to defeat this field boss.

Next, from the Gate Town Bridge site, head east to beat the Tibia Mariner field boss. For (1) Mounted Combat, the strategy here is pretty straightforward. You ride up to the boss and hit him several times, then ride away before he hits you with his attacks. You can ignore his minions entirely as they tend to move slowly and don't hit that hard. It also makes it easy to get back to him when he vanishes and reappears. (2) Melee Combat, clear the minions first if you plan to play on foot so you don't get overwhelmed. Hit the boss a few times and then dodge to the side when he raises and splashes down. Keep repeating this, staying to his side or behind him if you can. If he disappears and reappears track him down and repeat. And (3) Magic and Ranged Users, much like melee, clear the minions first and then proceed to range the boss down with attacks. He moves slowly so you don't need to reposition very often.

Successfully defeating this boss drops a Deathroot and the Skeletal Bandit Ashes. Nearby, you'll notice a location, the Carian Study Hall, ignore that for now since it cannot yet be completed as you are missing a key item you will obtain later from this NPC.

title: Lucerne
text: Return to Liurnia Highway North, pass time until nightfall, then loot the Lucerne, Golden Rune [3], Golden Rune [6], and Crystal Dart x5 around the battlefield.

Lucerne: East of Highland Lookout Tower in East Liurnia of the Lakes, found in the battlefield between phantoms and knights near where the armored giant spawns. Break some carts to reveal the treasure.
Golden Rune [3]: Consumable Item. Held by a corpse near the armored giant spawn.
Golden Rune [6]: Consumable Item. Held by a corpse near the armored giant spawn.
Crystal Dart: Consumable Throwable. Five can be looted off a corpse where a spirit giant spawns and fights regular soldiers.

title: Boss: Night's Cavalry (Liurnia)
text: Kill the Night's Cavalry patrolling the road past the battlefield for Ash of War: Ice Spear and 5,600 runes.
Ash of War: Ice Spear: Ash of War. Dropped by the Night's Cavalry miniboss roaming near the broken bridge upon defeat. Only appears at night.
Night's Cavalry: Night's Cavalry Miniboss found patrolling near the Gate Town Bridge. Only appears at night. Drops Ash of War: Ice Spear

title: Talk to Hyetta
text: Hyetta: Hyetta spawns near the site of grace. She will ask for another Shabriri Grape and will ask what the grapes really are. Telling her will make her puke and then thank you for telling her. After sitting down at the grace nearby she will have more dialog. After once again sitting at the grace she will move to her next location.

title: Land Squirt Ashes
text: Continue following the road until you reach the Gate Town Bridge grace at the end.
Talk to Hyetta near the grace, give her a Shabriri Grape, and answer that they're human eyes. Reload the area, then exhaust her dialogue.
Pick up the Sliver of Meat guarded by a Runebear south of the grace.
Continue south toward a building in the lake and grab the Smithing Stone [2] x3 inside.
Smithing Stone [2]: Upgrade Material. Three can be looted from a gazebo close to the South-East of Academy Gate Town. Beware of a Giant Lobster ambush.
Pop the balloon in the lake north-northwest of the building for a Golden Rune [6].
Golden Rune [6] A: You will spot a ballon, that has some enemies attached to it. Defeat all of them and destroy the ballon to obtain the Golden Rune.
Under the broken bridge east of the balloon is a corpse with Strip of White Flesh x3.
Strip of White Flesh: Crafting Material. Can be found in the back of the bridge. Beware of the Infested pods lurking there.
Just northwest of the bridge, you'll discover a campsite with Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot x3.
Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot: One can be found at the northern side of the broken bridge that leads to Raya Lucaria Academy
From the campsite, head north along the cliff wall until you see a gravestone near several Land Squirts. Pick up the Land Squirt Ashes beside it.

Land Squirt Ashes: Spirit Ashes. Found at a grave with several groups of land squirts nearby on the east shore of Liurnia Lake. To reach it, start at the Gate Town Bridge site of grace, go down to ground level, and simply travel north along the shore.

title: Boss: Tibia Mariner (Liurnia of the Lakes)
text: Return to Gate Town Bridge and head east toward a spiritspring. Just south of it is an exploding scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [2].
Use the spiritspring while facing north to find an astrolabe with Starlight Shards at the edge.
Starlight Shards E: Can be found in front of the half bowl stone statue by the cliff, overlooking the fog covered Academy Gate Town and Gate Town Bridge,
Kill the Tibia Mariner in the pond north of the astrolabe for Deathroot, Skeletal Bandit Ashes, and 4,700 runes.
Skeletal Bandit Ashes: Spirit Ash that drops from the Tibia Mariner
Tibia Mariner: One of the locations where Tibia Mariner Boss appears.
Deathroot: Deathroot dropped by Tibia Mariner located at Liurnia of the Lakes

title: Dragon Cult Prayerbook
text: Optional: D, Hunter of the Dead's summon sign can be found on the slope that leads to the pond.
Loot the Trina's Lily and Smithing Stone [3] in the pond.
Trina's Lily: Crafting Material. One can be found as a treasure on a corpse in the flooded graves near the small forest with a Tibia Mariner boss spawn.
Smithing Stone [3]: Upgrade Material. Found on a gravesite near the Tibia Mariner .
Follow the dirt path past the pond and pick up Great Dragonfly Head x5 from a graveyard on the right.
Great Dragonfly Head: Crafting Material. Five can be looted from a corpse in a graveyard just south-east from the Artists's Shack in Eastern Liurnia of the Lakes.
Kill the Leyndell Knight patrolling the path to obtain Dragon Cult Prayerbook (first time).
Dragon Cult Prayerbook: Dropped by a knight patrolling immediately south of the Liurnia Artist Shack

title: Resurrection Painting
text: Grab the Artist's Shack grace at the top of the slope, then interact with the painting in the shack to get the "Resurrection" Painting.
Resurrection Painting: Key Info Item. Painting found inside the Artist's Shack in Liurnia of the Lakes .

title: Briars of Sin
text: Just northeast of the grace is a chair with a Smithing Stone [4].
Smithing Stone [4]: Found on a dead body sitting on a chair by following the main path.
Cross the rock extending past the cliff near the shack. Kill the lone thorn sorcerer to the left of the camp to obtain Briars of Sin (first time).
Briars of Sin: Liurnia of the Lakes : Dropped by a mob directly north-west from the Artists Shack. Jump across the rocks and they'll be by a group of fire slugs.

title: Flame, Cleanse Me
text: Loot Flame, Cleanse Me and Smoldering Butterfly x8 (behind a tent) from the nearby camp.
Flame, Cleanse Me: Held by one of the corpses at the Fire Monk camp .
Smoldering Butterfly: Crafting Material. There are 8 Smoldering Butterflies scattered among the corpses in the Fire Monk camp .

title: Spiralhorn Shield
text: Behind a tree northeast of the camp, you'll discover the Eastern Tableland grace.
Ride into the woods northwest of the grace to find Immunizing White Cured Meat next to a wagon on the road.
Immunizing White Cured Meat: Temporarily boosts immunity.

Continue along the path until you reach Uld Palace Ruins, where an Ancestral Follower will be shooting at you from a bridge. Make your way onto the bridge by going under it, then cross it to discover the Ruined Labyrinth grace.
At the edge east-southeast of the grace sits a corpse with Frenzyflame Stone.
Frenzyflame Stone: Frenzyflame Stone is a consumable that uses FP to continuously heal chaos followers
Take down the Wandering Mausoleum in the area past the grace by hitting away at the skull formations on its feet. Optionally, mark its location on your map.
On a ledge south of the pond is a corpse holding the Spiralhorn Shield.
Spiralhorn Shield: Found a corpse near Mausoleum Compound. NW of Ruined Labyrinth Site of grace.

title: Stalwart Horn Charm
text: From the ledge, head west until you reach the edge, then drop down to pick up Arteria Leaf x3 from a chair in a patch of flowers.
Arteria Leaf: Can be found on Liurnia of the Lakes around forested areas.
Go up the nearby slope, then once you see the mausoleum, head north to find a scarab, hidden in bushes near the back corner, that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [2].
From the top of the slope, go south until you reach the edge, then look left to find an opening in the tall rock. Go through it to find the Stalwart Horn Charm on the ledge.

Stalwart Horn Charm: Can be found in Eastern Liurnia. Fast travel to Mausoleum Compound, head up the light incline to the left towards the cliff to the West. When you are at the cliff, look South for a hole in the wall. The talisman can be found on a corpse on a cliff through the hole.

title: Boss: Erdtree Avatar (Liurnia Northeast)
text: Drop down from the ledge and go up the slope with statues to grab the Mausoleum Compound grace behind a statue.
Take down the second Wandering Mausoleum by hitting the formations around its feet. Optionally, mark its location on your map.
Kill the Erdtree Avatar east of the mausoleum for Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear, Lightning-Shrouding Cracked Tear, Holy-Shrouding Cracked Tear, and 5,800 runes.
Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear: Crystal Tear for the Flask of Wondrous Physick. Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar.
Lightning-Shrouding Cracked Tear: Crystal Tear for the Flask of Wondrous Physick. Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar.
Holy-Shrouding Cracked Tear: Crystal Tear for the Flask of Wondrous Physick. Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar.
Erdtree Avatar: Field Boss. Drops Holy-Shrouding Cracked Tear, Lightning-Shrouding Cracked Tear and Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear

title: Rosus' Axe
text: Drop down the far-left edge of the cliff past the Erdtree, then head up the slope until you reach the entrance to Black Knife Catacombs:
Go inside and activate the Black Knife Catacombs grace.
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [2] next to the boss door room.
Unlock the imp seal to pick up the Rosus' Axe.
Rosus' Axe: An Axe found in the room sealed by the Imp Statue in the Black Knife Catacombs.

place.title: Frenzy-Flaming Tower
walk: Above the tower is a repeatedly-burning flame of frenzy, which will increase your Madness levels if you're within view of it. You can use rocks as cover during your approach, or use the ravine to the left of the tower to come behind it, and use the Spiritspring to jump up next to it and quickly get inside the tower, which will protect you from increasing madness. There will be a Giant Rat and three rats inside, which can be difficult in the close quarters, so be prepared. The Beast-Repellent Torch can help ward off the rats while you endure the madness buildup. Climb the ladder and you will find a chest containing the incantation Howl of Shabriri. Continue to the top to find a group of Frenzied Villagers, and quickly kill them to put an end to the flame of madness affecting the area. Fire pots can be thrown from below the top level and will kill the frenzied villages through the floor boards beneath them.
notes: This location is likely a nod to Tolkien's Barad-dûr, the tower of Sauron.

title: Black Knifeprint +1
text: Grab the Grave Glovewort [2] in front of some rubble before the cleaver room.
Loot Spellproof Dried Liver from a corpse in front of a cleaver, then ride the cleaver up to a ledge with a Grave Glovewort [4].
Spellproof Dried Liver: Consumable Item. Found on a corpse in the room with the saw traps.-11

Grave Glovewort [4]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. The first one is found in the room with the cleaver traps. Wait for the second-to-last cleaver to fall and then stand on top of it to use it as a lift. Jump onto the tunnel in the wall and the glovewort can be found just to the right of the entrance. The next one is found by continuing along the same tunnel. All the way to the end of the path is an illusory wall hiding the Black Knife Assassin 's mist gate. The glovewort is found just before this gate.
Continue to a dead end and pick up the Grave Glovewort [3] in front of a hole, but don't drop down yet.
Hit the illusory wall at the end to reveal a corridor with a Grave Glovewort [4] and a boss.
Kill the Black Knife Assassin for Assassin's Cerulean Dagger, Black Knifeprint, and 4,200 runes.
Assassin's Cerulean Dagger: Dropped by the Black Knife Assassin found inside Black Knife Catacombs.
Black Knifeprint: Black Knifeprint is a Key Item needed to advance in Sorcerer Rogier's questline. Dropped by Black Knife Assassin upon defeat.
Black Knife Assassin: Miniboss of the Black Knife Catacombs. Drops Assassin's Cerulean Dagger

title: Boss: Cemetery Shade (Black Knife Catacombs)
text: Optional: D, Hunter of the Dead's summon sign can be found at the entrance.
Drop down the earlier hole, pull the boss lever behind you, then pick up the Ghost Glovewort [3].
Pull the second lever and loot the 2x Grave Glovewort [2], Grave Glovewort [3] and Rune Arc in the room.
Rune Arc: Consumable Item. Found on a corpse on the lowest area of the catacombs, where two giant crabs spawn.
Climb the ladder in the room to a Grave Glovewort [3] in front of a coffin.
Kill the Cemetery Shade for Twinsage Sorcerer Ashes and 3,500 runes.
Twinsage Sorcerer Ashes: Dropped by the Cemetery Shade boss of the Black Knife Catacombs

title: Deathroot
text: Open the chest at the end to obtain a Deathroot.
Deathroot: Can be found inside a chest behind the Cemetery Shade in the Black Knife Catacombs .

place.title: Black Knife Catacombs
walk: The Black Knife Catacombs features many skeleton enemies and multiple moving guillotines throughout its chambers. The sewers are infested by crabs, with 2 giant crabs waiting for unsuspecting prey. This catacombs even has 2 bosses found in different rooms and with different loot, the Black Knife Assassin fight is not necessary for the player to advance through to find the lever that opens the doors to the Cemetery Shade fight.

Many of the skeletons that are found in this Catacombs exhibit a strange behavior of rolling at the player, and attack quite rapidly. Players should be careful when fighting these enemies as they can be very fast to close the gap and attack. Some of the skeletons are also special in that they cannot be killed by themselves, instead, one has to defeat the nearby necromancer which kills the skeletons automatically and permanently (until you rest or die). Going down the stairs from the Site of Grace there will be one such skeleton half way down. You can watch how this skeleton moves and attacks to learn what to expect from them later on, move back up the stairs to make the fight more manageable.

Once at the bottom of the stairs you will find the locked doors of the catacombs, flanked by 2 statues. These doors will open when you use the lever found at the end of the catacombs, the doors lead to the final boss fight of the catacombs. On the left is the way forward down a short flight of stairs. At the bottom of these stairs are 2 more skeletons, one at the crossroad and one further down the tunnel who will start rolling towards you rapidly once they spot you. Again, moving up the staircase can help with the fight to bring them into a wider fighting area or help with kiting them.

The first left on this tunnel is the room sealed by an imp statue, use a Stonesword Key here to open the room. Inside you will find 2 skeleton enemies on the left side, on the body leaning against the tombstone in the room you will find the Rosus' Axe.

Heading forward will bring you to the room with multiple guillotines, as well as 2 skeleton archers. Running past this area will lead you to a corner room with another rolling skeleton and a ladder to go down to the sewer level. In the sewer level there are many small crabs that are non-hostile, they will drop crab eggs when killed. From here you can also see the lever below the lit statue kept behind the rusted bars, the way to get behind the bars is elsewhere. Going forward will trigger the Giant Crabs to rise up from the ground, one in front but also one behind the player. A Rune Arc is found at the end of the sewer area.

To advance in this Catacombs, the player has to go to the room with the multiple guillotines and then ride a guillotine blade upwards to land on the platform above. Kill the skeleton archers in the room to stop them interfering. In the tunnel connected to the platform above are 2 enemies in a small space, carefully dispatch them to proceed to a long and large room with many statues of Erdtree Burial Watchdogs and multiple enemies. Keep following the path and the wall at the end of the path will disappear when attacked, revealing the golden veil for the fight with the Black Knife Assassin. There is a Golden Summon Sign before the fight that will allow you to summon D, Hunter of the Dead to cooperate with you for this fight. There are certain conditions for the summon sign to appear: It seems you must be on this stage of Rogier's quest, have completed D's quest and then have spoken with D about Rogier's quest.

On the right side of the room with the vanishing wall is a small shaft behind a Grave Glovewort. Falling down this shaft will put the player at the lever to open the locked catacomb doors. There you will find the Ghost Glovewort as well as two skeleton enemies and the lever to open the rusted gate to lead you out.
BOSS BATTLE: Black Knife Assassin

For this fight, using the Golden Summon Sign and bringing D will greatly ease the fight by having another character tanking and being focused by the boss. The Black Knife Assassin boss is fast moving, dodging many attacks as they move. They have 2 distinct attacks that are easy to predict and dodge. When their arm glows red they will fire out a red projectile at the player, they also occasionally jump up high with a large jumping attack that is easily sidestepped. Defeat this boss to obtain the Assassin's Cerulean Dagger as well as the Black Knifeprint and 3150 Runes.
BOSS BATTLE: Cemetery Shade

The fight with the Cemetery Shade features multiple skeleton enemies that assist the boss. The fight can get very dangerous when surrounded by them and hit with the green projectile from the boss, binding the player in place. The Cemetery Shade boss also has short blinks that allow it to dodge attacks as it approaches the player to attack in melee. Position yourself around the pillars to use them to absorb the binding projectiles as these move quite fast and may be hard to dodge naturally. Defeating this boss will reward you with the Twinsage Sorcerer Ashes as well as 3500 Runes. There is a chest in the room with a Deathroot found inside.

title: Great Mace
text: Travel to the East Raya Lucaria Gate and head up the slope east-northeast of the grace to reach a campsite with Slumbering Egg x2.
Slumbering Egg: Crafting Material. Two can be looted off a corpse defended by two soldiers on the eastern section of Bellum Highway.
Ride down the ruin below the cliff, then head north-northeast to find a chair with a Rune Arc.
Rune Arc E: On a body, found near the gravestones leading down the cliff
At the cliff northwest of the chair, you'll find another Rune Arc.
Rune Arc: Consumable Item. Found on a corpse on the upper walkways of the garden. This is accessible from the chapel in the west.
Enter the camp and pick up the Cuckoo Glintstone x3 next to a spiked barricade near the left-side catapult.
Loot the chest at the other side of the camp to obtain the Great Mace.
Great Mace: Can be found inside a chest, in the bandit camp.

title: Howl of Shabriri
text: Head toward the massive staircase past the camp, then into the small woods on the left to find a scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [3].
Pick up the Dragonwound Grease on the massive staircase, then grab the Grand Lift of Dectus grace inside.
Dragonwound Grease: Found on a body at the stairs.
Optional: Talk to Melina at the Grand Lift of Dectus grace.
Head back down the stairs, then up the south-southeast slope toward a tower that inflicts madness buildup. Loot the Smithing Stone [2] x2, Yellow Ember, and Golden Rune [3] on the slope.
Smithing Stone [2]: Upgrade Material. Looted off a corpse on the slopes leading to Frenzy-Flaming Tower in eastern Bellum Highway.
Yellow Ember: Crafting Material. Looted off a corpse on the slopes leading to Frenzy-Flaming Tower in eastern Bellum Highway.
Golden Rune [3]: Consumable Item. Looted off a corpse on the slopes leading to Frenzy-Flaming Tower in eastern Bellum Highway.
Continue up the slope to find a corpse with Burred Bolt x5 on a long slanted rock.
Climb the tower for a chest containing the Howl of Shabriri, then kill the Frenzied Villagers at the top to extinguish the frenzy flame.
Howl of Shabriri: Incantation . Found in a chest on the second level of the Frenzy-Flaming Tower .

place.title: Grand Lift of Dectus
walk: The Grand Lift of Dectus is a massive platform with its entrance found at the end of the Bellum Highway in northern Liurnia, along the eastern landmass. This colossal structure joins the regions of Liurnia and the Altus Plateau. However, on your first visit, the lift is sealed by four Guardian Statues. It requires a special artifact in order to activate. This artifact is the Dectus Medallion which is made up of two halves found in separate locations:
The Dectus Medallion (Left) can be found in Mistwood, inside a chest atop the tallest tower in Fort Haight to the east. Map Link
The Dectus Medallion (Right) can be found in Dragonbarrow, inside a chest atop the eastern tower in Fort Faroth to the east. Map Link
Once both halves are obtained, approach the platform once more and press the action key when prompt comes up to hoist the whole medallion and raise the lift, taking you to the Altus Plateau.
notes: Collecting both Dectus Medallion halves and taking the Grand Lift of Dectus will trigger the Radahn Festival. If the player explores Redmane Castle before activating the Grand Lift of Dectus, the area will have multiple enemies and an extra double boss fight (Misbegotten Warrior and Crucible Knight) before the main boss of Redmane Castle (Starscourge Radahn).

title: Cannon of Haima, Gavel of Haima
text: From the tower, head south-southeast to discover the Frenzied Flame Village Outskirts grace behind a ledge.

Enter the tower east of the grace, equip any glintstone crown found in the academy, then use the Erudition gesture in front of the statue to unlock the seal. Loot the chest at the top for Cannon of Haima and Gavel of Haima.
Cannon of Haima: Found in the chest at the top of the Converted Fringe Tower .
Gavel of Haima: Found in the chest at the top of the Converted Fringe Tower .

place.title: Converted Fringe Tower
walk: The top of the tower is sealed by a puzzle. Read the message at the foot of the statue is a hint to solve to puzzle:
"May erudition light the way!"
To clear the puzzle, perform the Erudition gesture in front of the statue while wearing a Glintstone Crown that lights up when you perform the gesture.
These crowns are:
Karolos Glintstone Crown
Lazuli Glintstone Crown
Olivinus Glintstone Crown
Twinsage Glintstone Crown
Witch's Glintstone Crown
Note: The Azur, Lusat, Haima and Hierodas Glintstone Crowns do not work for this.

The room at the top of the stairs will summon a School of Graven Mages, this is the only enemy in the tower, run past or defeat it and take the elevator up to get to the chest at the top and retrieve the Gavel of Haima and Cannon of Haima sorceries.

title: Note: The Lord of Frenzied Flame
text: Ride the lift back down and jump over the balcony to access an area behind the tower, where you can pick up Crystal Dart x3.
Crystal Dart: Consumable Throwable. Converted Fringe Tower .
Return to the Frenzied Flame Village Outskirts and enter the village southwest of the grace:
In a corner immediately on the left, you'll find Note: The Lord of Frenzied Flame.
Note: The Lord of Frenzied Flame: Info Item. Found on a corpse in a corner behind a broken shack, soon after entering Frenzied Flame Village from the northeast (Frenzy-Flaming Tower side)

title: Frenzied's Cookbook [1]
text: Pick up Frenzied's Cookbook [1] from the open house in the middle.
Frenzied's Cookbook [1]: Key Item. Found on a body inside one of the first houses found when entering Frenzied Flame Village.

place.title: Frenzied Flame Village
walk: Directly to the north of the Village is a crumbling tower with six Frenzied Villagers at the top. Every few seconds, a ball of fire appears above them and begins to inflict Madness on you if there is nothing solid blocking your line of sight to it. Killing the villagers at the top of the tower will stop this flame from appearing. In order to reach the top of the tower, you can either make your way to the base of the tower and climb the ladders to the top floor, or ride the wind gust that is on a lower cliff directly to the north of the tower. The path leading to this wind is west of the tower, tucked between two small cliffs. Note that Madness will continue to be applied to you while you are on top of the tower as long as any of the villagers are still alive. This can be avoided by taking cover one floor down from the top floor, then climbing the ladder as the flame begins to fade.
Nearby, players can obtain an incantation Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab. Elden Ring Interactive Map Link]

It is possible that Vyke will not invade the player. Currently (March 16, 2022), and the cause is unknown. It is possible that a certain "trigger" is preventing Vyke from invading. This could be killing a certain boss, clearing a certain dungeon, advancing another NPC’s questline beyond a specific point, or having a specific item in the inventory. There have been numerous reports in comments and other forums about what this possible "trigger" is, but they have all been contradicted by other users.

Approaching from the Northern entrance, you'll find a Note: The Lord of the Frenzied Flame around the corner from the crumbling wall. Moving clockwise along the wall, there is a Frenzied's Cookbook (1). On the porch of the house adjacent to the three armor-clad, frenzied soldiers is Shabriri's Woe. Atop the wall at the south is a Stonesword Key.

guide.title: More Smithing Stones for You!
text: At this point, you'll be needing more Smithing Stones to properly upgrade your armaments, lucky for you, there is a nearby cave here where you can gather the materials you need. From the Ruined Labyrinth Site, travel west and you should find the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel. This area is similar to Limgrave Tunnels where you will need to explore the tunnel paths, gather the stones you need, fight the enemies and reach the boss at the end, the Crystalians.

When first entering the mine, you'll find an elevator. Going down it will put you in front of the Site of Grace for this area. On the way down the elevator, you might notice two doorways on the left side of the wall. If you want to reach these, go back up the elevator and destroy the boxes on the left, right before you get on the elevator then jump down. Be careful because if you fall you will die. In the first doorway, you will find x1 Cracked Crystal. Following the ledge left drop-down and enter the next doorway. You'll get 3 Cracked Crystals. Continue following the ledges down. There are lamps to guide you. At the bottom of the elevator, before you head through the doorway, look behind you and grab the x2 Cracked Crystal that are in the corners.

One on a wall to the left and one on a corpse to the right. Going behind the stairs you'll find a corpse with 1 Golden Rune [3]. This room contains a total of sixteen Cracked Crystals and one Smithing Stone [3] excluding the 2 Smithing Stones found earlier. Exiting this room leads you to an elevator with more ledges. Just like last time, stick to the left. You'll find a tunnel that leads to a ledge. On the right grab the Somber Smithing Stone [2] and the x2 Cracked Crystal. Go back to the elevator and stick to the left as you jump down.

Following the tunnel out connects you to a cavern with another support beam and another elevator. Before crossing the beam, kill the Digger on your left and grab the Smithing Stone [2]. After crossing the beam, kill the patrolling Digger but don't go up the stairs. Instead, go to the right of them and grab the Smithing Stone [3]. Go up the stairs and kill the other Digger that is patrolling, then take the elevator up so you have a shortcut if you die. This room holds eight Cracked Crystals, one Smithing Stone [3], and one Smithing Stone [2] minus what I already mentioned.

Going through the other doorway where the two Marionette soldiers dropped down from leads you to another section with two doors. As soon as you pass the doorway on the right look up and you'll see another Marionette soldier wielding bows. They won't drop down until you attack them or the other two Marionette soldiers in the room. The two on the ground both wield daggers and are guarding a chest. Kill them then the archer if you haven't yet. The chest holds a Crystal Knife.

There are also some other locations you may want to visit in the east map for Liurnia.Please note that if you've been following the walkthrough from the beginning, at this point there's not an easy way for you to reach the northern section of the area to access these locations, unless you want to do some fancy wall-climbing with Torrent and it is tedious and best left for later when you get easier access to these areas. But if want to attempt, following the steps below.

Directly northeast of the Erdtree Avatar that you found earlier, there is a short stone spire next to the impassible wall. Your goal here is to use Torrent's double jump and to get to the top of that spire, then jump directly northeast to the small edges of the impassible rock wall and climb up to the northern section.
It's recommended that you kill Erdtree Avatar before attempting this, because it will constantly grief you, making this next to impossible.
After you reach the northern section, go north to reach the Frenzied Flame Village Outskirts site of grace to activate it, avoiding having to do the jump-climb again.
The northern parts of this area will now be accessible to explore the following:

Converted Fringe Tower: A tower that requires a puzzle to be solved in order to unlock it. The top of the tower is sealed by a puzzle. Read the message at the foot of the statue to find out what the puzzle is. To clear the puzzle, perform the Erudition gesture while wearing any Glintstone Crown in front of the door. The Hiama Glintstone Crown does not work for this.
Church of Inhibition: There is an NPC invader her, Festering Fingerprint Vyke. Defeat the hostile NPC to enter the church where you can find the Finger Maiden Set.

Frenzied Flame Village: Just a bit northwest from the Minor Erdtree. You can find items here such as Shabriri's Woe, looted off a body at the edge of the Frenzied Flame Village, and the Frenzied's Cookbook [1], looted off a corpse inside one of the houses in the village.

Black Knife Catacombs: This area is good to gather glovewort flowers used to upgrade your Spirit Ashes. And the boss here drops the Twinsage Sorcerer Ashes if you're looking for a spirit ash item that can use spells and attack long range.

title: Shabriri's Woe
text: On the porch surrounded by a group of frenzied soldiers, you can find Shabriri's Woe.
Shabriri's Woe: Found on a body at the edge of the Frenzied Flame Village

title: Stonesword Key
text: Go up the slope at the end of the village, then jump onto the southwest village rampart to find a Stonesword Key.
Stonesword Key: Key Item. Found atop the Frenzied Flame Village outer walls.

title: Frenzied Burst
text: Drop down the outer side of the rampart to pick up Eye of Yelough x3 from a corpse guarded by rats.

Eye of Yelough: Crafting Material. Three can be looted from a corpse protected by 1 Giant Rat and 3 regular rats. This is on a lower platform accessible by dropping from the higher parts of Frenzied Flame Village, or by following the outer side of the walls.
Follow the outer side of the rampart until you reach the village entrance, then go southeast toward a field with Eye of Yelough and Frenzyflame Stone in some chairs.
Return to the slope at the top of the village, then where the path splits, go downhill for a scarab that drops Frenzied Burst.
Frenzied Burst: Incantation . Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab south of the Church of Inhibition .

title: Invader: Festering Fingerprint Vyke, Fingerprint Grape +1
text: Continue downhill to find a cemetery with Golden Rune [1], Golden Rune [2], 4x Golden Rune [3], Golden Rune [4], and a Golden Rune [7].
Golden Rune [1]: Looted off Liurnia of the Lakes' north-east sarcophagi.
Golden Rune [2]: Looted off Liurnia of the Lakes' north-east sarcophagi.
Golden Rune [3]: Four Golden Runes (3) looted off Liurnia of the Lakes' north-east sarcophagi.
Golden Rune [4]: Looted off Liurnia of the Lakes' north-east sarcophagi.
Golden Rune [7]: Looted off Liurnia of the Lakes' north-east sarcophagi.
Head back up the slope, then continue to the top to be invaded by Festering Fingerprint Vyke. Kill him to obtain a Fingerprint Grape and Vyke's War Spear.
Festering Fingerprint Vyke: Invader using a War Spear of their name.
Fingerprint Grape: Dropped by Festering Fingerprint Vyke .
Vyke's War Spear: Can be dropped from Festering Fingerprint Vyke

title: Finger Maiden Set, Sacred Tear
text: Grab the Church of Inhibition grace at the top, then loot the Sacred Tear and Finger Maiden Set in the church.
Finger Maiden Set: Light Armor Set by the Site of Grace of Church of Inhibition. Includes Finger Maiden Fillet, Finger Maiden Robe and Finger Maiden Shoes
Sacred Tear: Found within the Church of Inhibition

place.title: Church of Inhibition
walk: The church is found at the top of the hill. Upon arriving, the body of a finger maiden can be found on a chair by the statue where you can obtain their armor (Finger Maiden Set) and a Sacred Tear. During your first arrival, be sure to reach the Site of Grace first, as soon after you will be attacked by an invader, Festering Fingerprint Vyke. Defeating Vyke will reward you with his weapon, Vyke's War Spear, and a Fingerprint Grape, which is necessary for advancing Hyetta's questline.
notes: Caution should be taken upon approaching the church's perimeter, Festering Fingerprint Vyke will invade. They're a relatively tough enemy and will inflict madness build-up with ranged, AOE and physical spear attacks. The fight is made worse should the player stray too close to the Frenzy-Flaming Tower east of the church. It's recommended to disable this tower first.

title: Ash of War: Beast's Roar, Bestial Vitality
text: Talk to Hyetta in Bellum Church and give her the Fingerprint Grape.
Travel to Bestial Sanctum and feed Gurranq the two Deathroots to receive Ash of War: Beast's Roar and Bestial Vitality.
Ash of War: Beast's Roar: Reward from Gurranq, Beast Clergyman after giving him the fourth Deathroot
Bestial Vitality: Bestial Sanctum : Reward from Gurranq, Beast Clergyman after giving him the fifth Deathroot .

title: Curtsy
text: After reloading the area, Gurranq will enter a frenzy. Hit him a few times to snap him out of it, then talk to him (or rest at the grace if you can't).
Give Rogier the Black Knifeprint, then talk to him after reloading the area. Optionally, talk to him about Ranni's whereabouts, why he wants a cursemark, and about D.
By now, you should have enough Grave Gloveworts to upgrade any regular spirit ash to +4 with Roderika; afterward, select "Talk" to learn the Curtsy gesture.
Optional: After learning the gesture, talk to Hewg about Roderika.
Let Fia hold you, then talk to her about Rogier to receive a Sacrificial Twig.
miss: Must be obtained before burning the Erdtree at the Forge of the Giants. Becomes unobtainable after entering Ranni's service or giving D the Weathered Dagger.

title: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [6]
text: Enter the manor and pick up the Rimed Crystal Bud x5 guarded by a Fingercreeper in the grass immediately to the left of the stone path.
Return to the stone path pick up the Smithing Stone [2] x3 in front of a fountain.
On the path behind the fountain is a Golden Rune [4].
In the grassy area east of the fountain lies a corpse with Rimed Crystal Bud x2.
Return to the manor entrance, then go east to find a corpse with Rimed Crystal Bud x3 next to a tree.
Go up the nearby stairs and into a small room with Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [6].
Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [6]: Cookbook Key Item. Found on a corpse in a small room southeast of the gardens.

title: Carian Piercer
text: Exit the room and continue to a fork. Follow the path straight ahead to find a Somber Smithing Stone [3] at the end of an alley.
Somber Smithing Stone [3]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse at the end of a narrow path along the eastern walls.
Go back and follow the other path to a hole in the battlement. Drop down and head north-northwest toward a scarab that drops Carian Piercer.
Carian Piercer: Sorcery . Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab behind the gardens near the east.

title: Ice Crest Shield
text: A corpse with the Ice Crest Shield lies on the ledge near the scarab.
Ice Crest Shield: Small Shield. Found on a corpse up on a ledge by a jagged stone pillar. This area is in the gardens, jumping up on the rocks from the Teardrop Scarab nearby.

title: Sword of Night and Flame
text: From the ledge, go around the northwest corner, then turn west to find a corpse with Rimed Crystal Bud x2 in the grassy area to the left of the path.
Rimed Crystal Bud: Crafting Material. Two can be looted from a corpse in the frontal gardens before accessing the higher areas of Caria Manor.
Behind a crystal just south of the corpse, you can find Glintstone Firefly x6, guarded by two large Fingercreepers.
Glintstone Firefly: Crafting Material. Six can be looted from a corpse in the garden. Beware of an ambush by many Giant Hands in this area.
Return to the path and follow it to the manor entrance. Grab the Manor Lower Level grace up the stairs.
Look behind the altar in the room with the grace to find a Smithing Stone [4].
Smithing Stone [4]: Upgrade Material. Found in the chapel with the Manor Lower Level site of grace, on a corpse hidden under the altar.
Head along the bridge, then once the path splits, cross the northeast bridge to find a Rune Arc behind the tower at the end.
Jump onto the rooftops below the tower, then descend a ladder to discover a chest containing the Sword of Night and Flame.

Sword of Night and Flame: Straight Sword. Found in a chest inside a locked room behind the gardens. This is accessible by using the walkways above. You can get onto the walkways from the Chapel building in the west.

title: Urumi
text: Open the shortcut door, then return to the grace and cross the bridges until you reach a set of stairs. Jump onto the wooden ledge below to pick up Rimed Crystal Bud x8.
Rimed Crystal Bud: Crafting Material. Three Rimed Crystal Buds can be found within the garden of the Caria Manor
Below the northeast staircase is a Golden Rune [3].
Golden Rune [3]: Consumable Item. Located at the fortification ramparts, under the stairs. This area is accessed by dropping down from the higher walkway leading to the lift to upper Caria Manor.
Head along the other side of the rampart to find a corpse with Urumi in front of the battlement.
Urumi: Whip. Found on a body on the south-east ramparts, reached by jumping from the higher ramparts leading to the elevator and the Manor Upper Level site of grace.

title: Talk to Hyetta
text: Hyetta: Hyetta moves here if you have given her shabiri grapes at her previous locations.

title: Troll Knight's Sword
text: Drop down the wooden platforms at the end of the rampart to find a Somber Smithing Stone [3] on the broken battlement.

Somber Smithing Stone [3]: Upgrade Material. One can be looted from a corpse on the manor outer walls, above the entrance to the grounds. This area is only reachable by dropping down from the higher level walkway, right before reaching the lift to the Manor Upper Level site of grace.
Return to the Manor Lower Level and the stairs at the end. Take the lift up and activate the Manor Upper Level grace.
Step into the garden for a Golden Seed and a corpse with Rimed Crystal Bud x3 in front of a tree.
Rimed Crystal Bud: Crafting Material. Two can be looted from a corpse near two Giant Hands and several small ones in Caria Manor.
Climb the ladder on the left after going up the stairs to find a corpse with Magic Grease x2 hanging off the edge.
Magic Grease: Consumable. Two found on a corpse on a lower ledge reachable by jumping to the building on the left of the door as you enter and going up the ladder to the higher platform.
Kill the Troll Knight below to receive a guaranteed Troll Knight's Sword (first time).
Troll Knight's Sword: Colossal Sword. Dropped by a Troll Knight guarding the staircase leading up to the boss of Caria Manor.

title: Boss: Royal Knight Loretta
text: Head across the top of the walls next to the troll, then drop down at the end for a Smithing Stone [4].
Pick up the Rimed Crystal Bud x5 guarded by a Page on the left staircase.
Rimed Crystal Bud: Crafting Material. Five can be looted off a corpse on the final staircase leading to the boss of Caria Manor.
Hanging off the midsection between the stairs is a Golden Rune [4].
Golden Rune [4]: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse near the center of the garden.
Kill Royal Knight Loretta for Loretta's Greatbow, Ash of War: Loretta's Slash, and 10,000 runes. (This earns an achievement.)
Royal Knight Loretta: Great Enemy. The guardian of Caria Manor . Drops Loretta's Greatbow and Ash of War: Loretta's Slash upon defeat.
Loretta's Greatbow: Sorcery . Dropped by Royal Knight Loretta upon defeat.
Ash of War: Loretta's Slash: Ash of War. Dropped by Royal Knight Loretta upon defeat.

guide.title: Complete Caria Manor of Liurnia
text: Caria Manor is a major dungeon comprised of a very large estate, overlooking the lakes from the north. Its eternal warden, Royal Knight Loretta fervently guards the manor. The large estate can be found in Liurnia of the Lakes, far to the north. We will include a quick run-through of the paths to take to get to the boss of this location, as well as important landmarks. You can, however, visit the Caria Manor page for a more in-depth guide such as a list of items found in this location and more.

Caria Manor is accessed from its main gate in the south. Before the constant bombardment of glintstone arrows as you approach the gate. The estate's guardian is constantly bombarding the fields outside the manor to deter would-be trespassers. Once you reach the Site of Grace at the main gate, you are safe from these bombardments. When traversing the estate grounds, watch out for Glintstone traps. These are swords buried in the ground which spring a projectile trap that shoots a glintstone projectile upwards when walked on. These traps knock players away which is especially dangerous when on the higher levels of the estate.

The southernmost area of the estate is the Gardens. This is a very large courtyard infested with Spider Hands and their smaller counterparts. Be very careful when walking around the gardens as these Spider Hand enemies can cling to the walls of buildings, dropping down onto unsuspecting targets. They can also burrow into the ground and emerge only when prey is nearby.

The Chapel building is an important landmark found in the west of the Gardens. The upper level contains a Site of Grace and leads to the walkways in the gardens that will allow you to reach many different collectibles as well as progress to the manor's upper level. These walkways are guarded by Knight Spirits who appear as you move around the walkways. Be extra careful of glintstone traps up here as they can knock you back down to the gardens. Follow the walkways towards the east to reach a tower with a lift that will take you up to the Manor Upper Level.

The Manor Upper Level comprises the northern half of the estate. This area is raised high above the gardens and is guarded by Direwolves and Wandering Noble zombies. Past the Direwolves, you will find a large stone archway to the east. Beyond this is a long staircase leading up to the final area and boss. However, it is heavily guarded by Raya Lucarian soldiers and a Troll Knight. If you look to the south, there is a platform with a ladder that you can climb up which will allow you to circumvent all the enemies at the large staircase as you will wind up behind the troll. Consider using this path if you are rushing through or don't want to face a large group of hostiles. Behind the troll are more staircases to the left and right, each with a Page enemy.

At the very top of the staircases, you can look to the south to find a hole in the wall. This leads to an area outside with wooden platforms along the walls which you can jump down from to reach the cliffside graveyards. There are some collectibles to be found along these cliffs and they are guarded by Living Jar enemies.

Back at the staircase, continue on through the stone archway to find a large circular arena-like area surrounded by chairs. Once you step into the center of this area, Royal Knight Loretta will appear before you. She is the guardian of this manor and also the one bombarding the fields outside with arrows. She uses a combination of glintstone sorcery spells and polearm attacks in combat. Defeating her awards the Loretta's Greatbow sorcery spell as well as the Ash of War: Loretta's Slash - defeating Loretta will spawn a Site of Grace in her arena and allow you access to the back of the manor.
## Meeting Renna and her Allies

Upon completing Caria Manor, your next destination will be Ranni's Rise but be wary since you may come across the Glintstone Dragon Adula, you don't have to fight this dragon, it's optional, and up to you. At Ranni's Rise, go all the way to the top and talk to Ranni the Witch to begin her questline: The Hidden Treasure of Nokron. Take her request and she will ask you to talk to three people who are in her service, these Are Seluvis, War Counselor Iji, and Blaidd who will appear in spectral form. These three will then appear in a spectral form on the first floor of her tower - talk to Ranni again after speaking to everyone to leave.

Now, moving forward, we will guide you to complete this quest. Blaidd will be waiting in the Siofra River area and will reveal that he suspects that Seluvis knows more than he lets on. Seluvis will inform you that Sorceress Sellen has some information, and provide you with Seluvis's Introduction. Sorceress Sellen then informs the player that Starscourge Radahn stopped the stars and that defeating him is the key to Nokron's secrets.

Therefore the first step is to visit Siofra and complete it. BE WARNED: if you follow Preceptor Seluvis's questline, you will betray Ranni and fail her quest. We will not do this on this walkthrough but you can read about it on his page: Preceptor Seluvis.

title: Cracked Pot
text: Activate the Royal Moongazing Grounds grace, then from the boss entrance, go south-southwest through a doorway. Jump down the wooden platforms, then pick up the Cracked Pot and Crystal Dart x8 below.
Cracked Pot: Crafting Pot. Found on the cliffs overlooking the gardens below.
Crystal Dart: Offensive Consumable. Found on a gravestone in the western portion of the upper manor. This area is only accessible by dropping down from a ledge near the entrance to the boss room.

place.title: Caria Manor
walk: Caria Manor is accessed from its main gate in the south. Beware of the constant rain of glintstone arrows as you approach the gate. The estate's guardian is constantly bombarding the fields outside the manor to deter would-be trespassers. Once you reach the Site of Grace at the main gate, you are safe from these bombardments. When traversing the estate grounds, watch out for Glintstone traps. These are swords buried in the ground which spring a trap that shoots a glintstone projectile upwards when walked on. These traps knock players away which is especially dangerous when on the higher levels of the estate.
## Gardens

The southernmost area of the estate is the Gardens. This is a very large courtyard infested with Fingercreepers and their smaller counterparts. Be very careful when walking around the gardens as these Fingercreeper enemies can cling to the walls of buildings, dropping down onto unsuspecting targets. They can also burrow into the ground and emerge only when prey is nearby.

On the left side of the gardens, you'll find two corpses, one with five Rimed Crystal Buds and another with six Glintstone Fireflies. Walking up the middle stone pathway, you'll find a Golden Rune (4), two Somber Smithing Stone (2), and a Smithing Stone (2). The right side of the gardens is where the exciting loot is at. In a room within a ruin by the rightmost wall is the Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook (6). Further in the ruin, you'll find the Ice Crest Shield, and as you approach the middle pathway from here, you'll find a Teardrop Scarab that drops the Carian Piercer sorcery. You can also collect a total of five Rimed Crystal Buds from the corpses in the area. Follow the stone path northwest and you'll eventually get to the Chapel.
## Chapel

The Chapel building is an important landmark found in the west of the Gardens. The upper level contains a Site of Grace and leads to the walkways in the gardens that will allow you to reach many different collectibles as well as progress to the manor's upper level. These walkways are guarded by Knight Spirits who appear as you move around the walkways. Be extra careful of glintstone traps up here as they can knock you back down to the gardens. If you want to progress through the dungeon quickly, follow the walkways towards the east to reach a tower with a lift that will take you up to the Manor Upper Level.

Here in the chapel, you can find a corpse behind the altar that has a Smithing Stone (4). Make sure you've grabbed the Manor Lower Level Site of Grace here then exit the chapel and cross the walkways until the path splits. Start by heading down the northern walkway. Follow the path to the end to find a Rune Arc. Look down to the northwest and jump down to the walls below. Jump down again to another section of the wall in the northwest, where you'll find a ladder going down. This ladder takes you to a small room with the Sword of Night and Flame in a chest. Open the door to the west and you'll find yourself in the gardens again.

Make your way back to the Manor Lower Level Site of Grace and follow the walkways again, this time taking the eastern walkway. After turning left at the corner, you'll see a flight of stairs leading to another building. Before jumping down, go straight to head up the stairs and take the lift mentioned earlier to get to the Manor Upper-Level Site of Grace and retrace your steps back. Right at the base of the stairs, look eastward and jump down to the lower section of the wall.
