Loot x8 Rimed Crystal Buds and head north, where you'll find a Golden Rune (3) under the wooden stairs, then run back up the stairs and start heading south. You'll reach a large open part of the walls with a few Fingercreepers. At the far end of this area is the Urumi. Grab it, then continue following the wall southwest. Defeat or run past the Abductor Virgin at the corner, jump down to the next open platform, and grab a Somber Smithing Stone (3) on a body hanging off of the ledge to the right. Head back to the Manor Upper Level Site of Grace.
## Manor Upper Level

The Manor Upper Level comprises the northern half of the estate. Grab the Site of Grace here then head out the western doorway. This will lead you to an area raised high above the gardens guarded by Direwolves and Wandering Noble zombies. You'll find a Golden Seed right in front of you, past the staircase. Follow the path northeast, but before going up the stairs, go around to the right to find a corpse with x3 Rimed Crystal Buds. Go up the stairs, and you will find a large stone archway to the northwest. Beyond this is a long staircase leading up to the final area and boss. However, it is heavily guarded by Lazuli Sorcerers and a Troll Knight. Take a left before going through the archway to find a ladder that will allow you to circumvent all the enemies at the large staircase. Kill the wandering noble at the top of the ladder and collect the x2 Magic Grease on the body around the corner to the right. Continue up the stairs and look out for the Wandering Noble; kill it and continue around the curve to the left. This will bring you out behind the Troll Knight. Consider using this path if you are rushing through or if you don't want to face a large group of hostiles.

If you choose to fight the Troll Knight, however, he drops his weapon, the Troll Knight's Sword. At the top of the middle staircase, turn hard right and follow the side of the wall northeast, jumping around the corner when you get there. If you jump down to the lower ledge, you'll be able to grab a Smithing Stone (4). Continue up the middle set of stairs, where you'll find more staircases to the left and right, each with a Page enemy. Five Rimed Crystal Buds can be found on a corpse on the left set of stairs.

At the very top of the staircases, immediately turn around and pick up the Golden Rune (4) on the corpse off of the ledge in the middle of the two staircases. Go south, past the remaining pages, and go through a hole in the wall. This leads to an area outside with wooden platforms along the walls which you can jump down from safely to reach the cliffside graveyards. At the bottom, sneak East, and grab the Cracked Pot on the ledge. Go west, through the Living Jars, and find x8 Crystal Darts on a corpse against a tombstone on the far side. Go east from this body and jump down to encounter two more Living Pots. Jump down another platform to the east and collect the Erdtree flower. Jump down yet another platform to encounter 2x large Living Jars and 4x small Living Jars. Behind the pair of large ones, on the right side, is a Smithing Stone (3). Jump down to yet another platform, and on the lowest level of the graveyard, look to the southwest and you'll find a ruined section of Caria Manor's walls you can jump down to. On the corpse hanging off of the ledge is the Ash of War: Carian Grandeur.

Back at the top of the staircases the Troll was guarding, continue through the stone archway to find a large circular arena-like area surrounded by chairs. Once you step into the center of this area, Royal Knight Loretta will appear before you. She is the guardian of this manor and also the one bombarding the fields outside with arrows. She uses a combination of glintstone sorcery spells and polearm attacks in combat. Defeating her awards the Loretta's Greatbow sorcery spell as well as the Ash of War: Loretta's Slash.
Defeating Loretta will spawn a Site of Grace in her arena and open up the way to the Three Sisters sub-region.
## Back of the Manor

After exiting out to Three Sisters, keep heading south, following the manor's walls and the cliffs, until you find a Cerulean Teardrop Scarab. From here, look east and drop down to the ruins of a castle wall below you. On the south side of this wall, you'll find wooden platforms leading east that you can safely drop onto. Scale down the ladder here, and you'll find yourself on the upper balcony of the Chapel you were in earlier. Here, you can find and speak to Pidia, as well as pick up a Spellproof Dried Liver.

Head back up the ladder, and climb onto the roof in front of you to find five Old Fangs. Look down to the southwest, and you'll be able to jump down safely to the wall section below you. Head southeast and down and to your left are some more wooden platforms you can jump down to. Grab the three Slumbering Eggs on a corpse here then jump down to another section of a ruined stone wall. If you head all the way southeast and follow the wooden platform, you'll get to a Giant Crab guarding a Stonesword Key.

title: Ash of War: Carian Grandeur
text: Continue down to pick up a Smithing Stone [3] behind a small tree guarded by two Living Jars.
Smithing Stone [3]: Upgrade Material. Found in the cliff graveyard behind the Living Jars.
Jump onto the rooftop below the cliff to reach a corpse with Ash of War: Carian Grandeur.
Ash of War: Carian Grandeur: Ash of War. Found on a corpse on the roof of a tall stone structure. This is accessible by jumping down the cliffside graveyard from the manor's upper level.

title: Frozen Armament
text: Return to Royal Moongazing Grounds, enter the area past the boss, then follow the east path to a scarab that drops Frozen Armament.
Frozen Armament: Sorcery . Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in an area behind Caria Manor. This area is accessible after completing the manor and defeating Royal Knight Loretta .

title: Boss: Onyx Lord
text: Continue along the path to discover the Behind Caria Manor grace just past the woods.
In front of a gravestone east-southeast of the grace is a Grave Glovewort [1].
Grave Glovewort [1]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. 3 Can be found spread throughout the graveyard area close to the 'Behind Caria Manor' Site of Grace. They can be looted behind the gravestones.
Pick up the 2x Grave Glovewort [2] near the group of gravestones southwest of the first.
Grave Glovewort [2]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. 3 Can be found spread throughout the graveyard area close to the 'Behind Caria Manor' Site of Grace. They can be looted behind the gravestones.
Head below the large slanted rock to find a Grave Glovewort [1] near some gravestones on the left.
Climb the slanted rock to pick up Thawfrost Boluses from the edge.
Thawfrost Boluses: Can be found on a corpse ast the top of the massive rock
Enter the evergaol east-northeast of the rock and kill the Onyx Lord for Meteorite and 3,600 runes.
Onyx Lord: Enemy. Found in the Sealed Tunnel blocking the path to the Divine Tower of West Altus .
Onyx Lord's Greatsword: Curved Greatsword . Dropped by the Onyx Lord when defeated.

title: Albinauric Ashes
text: From the evergoal, head south-southwest to pick up a Golden Rune [3] from the pack of wolves.
Behind a tree with yellow leaves west-northwest from the pack of wolves, you'll find a Grave Glovewort [2].
Follow the west-southwest path for a Grave Glovewort [1] on the left, then pick up the Albinauric Ashes at the end of the path.
Albinauric Ashes: Found on a corpse in the graveyard area east of Caria Manor . This area is accessible only after completing the manor and defeating Royal Knight Loretta .

title: Larval Tear, Juvenile Scholar Set
text: Just northeast of the ashes, you'll see an item pickup with the Juvenile Scholar Set and a Larval Tear (painting reward).
Larval Tear: Key Item. Found by touching a ghost at the graveyard. This ghost also gives Juvenile Scholar Cap and Juvenile Scholar Robe . This is the location from the Resurrection Painting .

title: Boss: Alabaster Lord
text: Alabaster Lord: Optional Boss imprisoned within the Royal Grave Evergaol .
Meteorite: Sorcery . Dropped by the Alabaster Lord upon defeat.

title: Ash of War: Chilling Mist
text: Return to Royal Moongazing Grounds, then from the boss exit, head west-southwest toward a ruin with a scarab that drops Ash of War: Chilling Mist.
Ash of War: Chilling Mist: Ash of War. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in the ruins south of Renna's Rise .

title: Spectral Steed Regalia: Carian Silver
text: Optional: Fight Adula southwest of the ruins; it will flee once you deal about half its HP.
Enter the tower past the dragon and grab the Ranni's Rise grace.
If you own the Tarnished Pack DLC, open the nearby chest to obtain Spectral Steed Regalia: Carian Silver.

place.title: Ranni's Rise
walk: Ranni's Rise is found to the west of the Three Sisters sub-region. When first entering the area, you may come across Renna's Rise and Seluvis's Rise but these two are blocked by a magical seal, preventing entry. The only tower accessible initially is Ranni's Rise. Head into the tower and up to the first floor to find its Site of Grace. Look for a lift on this floor which will take you to the top of the tower where you will meet Ranni the Witch.

Ranni will ask for your servitude and will set you off on a quest to find the hidden treasure of Nokron. (If she refuses to give you the quest, try returning to the Roundtable Hold to speak to Rogier once more.) She asks that you speak to three other persons in her service: Blaidd, War Counselor Iji, and Preceptor Seluvis. These three NPCs will then appear on the first floor (in spectral form as their actual locations are elsewhere). A fog wall will surround Ranni's Rise, temporarily turning it into a safe zone. Speak to all three of the aforementioned NPCs. Iji will simply acknowledge that you are both now in service of the Lady, while Blaidd will ask you to meet him in Mistwood at the Siofra River Well. Seluvis will ask that you meet him at his tower in the south. Oblige and return upstairs to speak to Ranni, and she will tell you that she will go into a deep slumber. This will remove the fog wall. Lastly, head to Seluvis's Rise to acquire a task from him.
notes: Ranni's Rise is part of the Trio of locations aptly named as the Three Sisters, with connections towards Ranni the Witch. The other locations are Seluvis's Rise, where Preceptor Seluvis, an ally of Ranni, stays and Renna's Rise. Named after one of Ranni's alias they used. The Snow Witch Set is found on Renna's Rise, and it is speculated that it is the name of the Snow Crone Mentor that Ranni had.

Many of Ranni's loyal retainers, allies, and other characters related to her, like Blaidd, Preceptor Seluvis, and War Counselor Iji, make an appearance in the location, albeit spectrally. Considering this location, functionally the base of operations for Ranni, it only makes sense for her agents to show up here.

Ranni's Rise is the spot of many of the quest events relating to Ranni and the Age of Stars. Swearing fealty to Ranni happens here, for example. As you progress along Ranni's questline, you will most likely have to swing by Ranni's Rise multiple times to not only get the latest objectives on Ranni's plan but also explore the multitude of stories of her allies and their relationship to her. Some encounters with Blaidd, Preceptor Seluvis, and War Counselor Iji, especially on how they change both externally and internally as characters with the progression of Ranni's plan. As Ranni achieves her objectives with the help of the Tarnished, this will affect these three characters greatly, and Ranni's Rise is where you will be able to find out how much those effects really are. Conversely, it would also show the effects of Ranni's actions on her loyal retainers.

title: Talk to Seluvis
text: Exhaust Ranni's dialogue at the top of the tower until she tells you to leave.
Return to Rogier and tell him that Ranni cast off her cursemark.
Talk to Ranni, ask to enter her service, then greet her other vassals in the tower:
Talk to Iji's projection until you've exhausted his dialogue.
Talk to Blaidd's projection.
Talk to Seluvis's projection.
Seluvis: Quest NPC. Appears in spectral form by the entrance after speaking to Ranni for the first time.

title: Black Wolf Mask
text: Optional: Talk to Ranni after greeting her vassals; if you rest at the grace, this dialogue is skipped.
Head toward the tower below the cliff southeast of Ranni's Rise. Climb the walls surrounding the tower to find a corpse with the Black Wolf Mask.
Black Wolf Mask: This mask can be found on the wall behind Seluvis's Rise .

title: Seluvis's Potion, Talk to Seluvis
text: Talk to Seluvis inside the tower and accept his task to receive Seluvis's Potion.
Seluvis's Potion: Key Quest Item. Given by Seluvis after accepting his task.
Seluvis: Quest NPC. Found on the ground floor of his tower after first speaking to his spectral form at Ranni's Rise .

title: Memory Stone
text: Loot the chest at the top of Seluvis's Rise to obtain a Memory Stone.
Memory Stone: Memory Slot Upgrade Material. Found on the top floor of Seluvis's Rise .

title: Carian Inverted Statue, Nepheli Loux Puppet
text: You'll now have to decide who to give the potion to:
Give the potion to Nepheli:
Note: Turns her into a puppet, preventing completion of her, Gostoc's, and Kenneth Haight's questlines.
After receiving the Carian Inverted Statue from Ranni, Pidia will die and drop the Nepheli Loux Puppet.
Carian Inverted Statue: Quest Item. Given by Ranni after giving her the Fingerslayer Blade .
miss: Unobtainable if Seluvis's Potion is not given to Nepheli.

title: Talk to Ranni the Witch
text: Ranni the Witch: You can talk to Ranni at the very top of Ranni's Rise in the Three Sisters, northwestern Liurnia of the Lakes.

title: Omen Set
text: Give the potion to Dung Eater:
Note: Turns him into a puppet, failing his questline and locking you out of the Blessing of Despair ending (not required for all achievements).
Progress Dung Eater's questline up until you can administer the potion, then give it to him. [See quest]
Kill him after giving him the potion to obtain the Omen Set, but do it before reloading the area as that will despawn him.
Omen Set: Drops from Dung Eater if defeated in Subterranean Shunning-Grounds .
miss: Must be done immediately after giving him the potion, as the armor set is not supposed to be obtainable with this outcome of his questline.

title: Dung Eater Puppet
text: Progress Seluvis's questline up until you can buy puppets from him, then buy the Dung Eater Puppet.
miss: Unobtainable if Seluvis's Potion is not given to Dung Eater.

title: Crepus's Black-Key Crossbow
text: Give the potion to Gideon Ofnir:
You can progress everyone's questlines, but you'll miss out on either puppet until your next playthrough.
Talk to Nepheli and either give her Seluvis's Potion or the Stormhawk King that continues her questline.
Unlock the imp seal near Nepheli for a chest with Crepus's Black-Key Crossbow and Black-Key Bolt x20.

title: Assassin's Prayerbook
text: Unlock the second imp seal for a chest with Assassin's Prayerbook.

title: Spellblade's Set
text: Speak with Rogier and select "Talk" to hear that his condition is worsening. Reload the area and talk to him in his unresponsive state, then reload the area three more times to find him dead. Loot Rogier's Bell Bearing and the Spellblade's Set from his corpse.

title: Talk to Dung Eater (Subterranean Shunning-Grounds)
text: Note: He'll also drop Rogier's Letter if you talked to him about D, and Rogier's Rapier+8 if you didn't get it earlier.
If you didn't give the potion to Nepheli, and don't plan to give it to Dung Eater, give it to Gideon Ofnir now to safely progress everyone's questlines.

Dung Eater: Quest NPC. Found in a cell in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds beneath the Royal Capital. To reach his cell, head northeast from the Underground Roadside site of grace and enter a grate in the floor to access the aqueducts. Continue north past the Rats and Giant Poison Flower and climb up the ladder. You can find the cell door in the next room past the ladder. It is unlocked using the Sewer-Gaol Key given by the same NPC but in his non-corporeal form at the Roundtable Hold .

title: Talk to Pidia, Carian Servant
text: Note: Skip the Seluvis steps below if you're giving the potion to Dung Eater. You can't do them until you're rid of the potion, and Seluvis must remain alive until then.
Head down the hidden cellar in the ruins northeast of Ranni's Rise and interact with the message that reads: "Seluvis' Puppet. Do not touch".
Talk to Seluvis about his chambers to receive a puppet for free. Optionally, talk to him about Nepheli if you gave the potion to Gideon Ofnir or Dung Eater.
Quit and reload your game twice to unlock the next dialogue option, then talk to Seluvis and select "I want a new puppet".
Buy one puppet, then talk to Seluvis about the scheme and respond that you're interested.
Drop onto the rooftop below the cliff northeast of Seluvis's Rise and continue down to a ladder. Climb down to find a Spellproof Dried Liver.
Exhaust Pidia's dialogue in the room to access his inventory.
Pidia, Carian Servant: Pidia is a Merchant. Can be found by falling down from the cliff at Three Sisters.
Go back up the ladder to find a corpse with Old Fang x5 on the roof.

Old Fang: Crafting Material. Five can be looted from a corpse on the rooftops of the chapel of Caria Manor, above the Manor Lower Level site of grace. This area is only accessible by dropping down from the cliffs in the Three Sisters area.
Drop down to the rampart below the southwest edge and follow it to a wooden platform with Slumbering Egg x3.
Continue down the ramparts to pick up a Stonesword Key guarded by a Giant Crab at the end.
Optional: Talk to Iji at the Road to the Manor about Nokron and about Blaidd.

title: Serpent-God's Curved Sword
text: Travel to the Ravine-Veiled Village and climb up the ladders to a tunnel with 2x Smithing Stone [4].
Smithing Stone [4]: There are at least 9 Smithing Stones (4) within the cave that goes through Ruin-Strewn Precipice .
Climb the ladder in the tunnel to a room with a Smithing Stone [3] and 2x Smithing Stone [4], but mind the poison traps on the ground.
Smithing Stone [3]: There are at least 3 Smithing Stones (3) within the caves that go through Ruin-Strewn Precipice
Take the lift up while facing south, then jump off midway to a ledge with a Smithing Stone [5].
Smithing Stone [5]: Can be found within the caves that run through the Ruin-Strewn Precipice.
Ride the lift to the top. Pick up a Golden Rune [5], then a Smithing Stone [4] just behind the arch.
Loot the Smithing Stone [4] and Somber Smithing Stone [4] to the left of the stairs, then go up the stairs for a Rune Arc.
Somber Smithing Stone [4]: Can be found in the caves that go through the Ruin-Strewn Precipice.
Rune Arc: Consumable Item. Found inside the Altus Tunnel . In the first cavern past the Site of Grace, head through the door on the right to find the item in a chest.
In the small room down the stairs is a corpse with Lightning Grease x2, but mind the poison traps.
Kill the exploding scarab in a tunnel to obtain a Somber Smithing Stone [4].
Somber Smithing Stone [4]: Upgrade Material. Found at the bottom of the main chamber, on a corpse inside the northern storage shed.
Pick up Soft Cotton from a corpse at the precipice, then grab the Ruin-Strewn Precipice grace.
Take the lift up, then once you reach a second set of stairs, drop down for a Somber Smithing Stone [4].
Climb the ladder ahead, then climb the rocks east of it to find a Somber Smithing Stone [3] at the top of some pillars.
Pick up the Golden Rune [4] guarded by some bats below.
Behind some crates near the ladder at the end, you'll find a Smithing Stone [4].
Go up the ladder up and grab the Golden Rune [5] and Smithing Stone [4] guarded by some bats near the wall.
Pick up the 2x Smithing Stone [4] farther along the wall, and optionally kill the Operatic Bat next to a ladder for a Golden Rune [6] (first time).
Climb the ladder, then jump to the ledge of a pillar and go around it to find a Golden Rune [5].
Continue until you reach another ladder. On the wall behind it is a Smithing Stone [4].
Climb up, then go west-northwest up another ladder to a roof with a Smithing Stone [3] and the Serpent-God's Curved Sword.
Serpent-God's Curved Sword: Can be found at Ruin-Strewn Precipice, after the first singing bat go up two ladders then another one on the left and walk across to where the Land Octopus are

place.title: Ruin-Strewn Precipice
walk: Moving along Ruin-Strewn Precipice is pretty much a straightforward process, as the caves on the inside will help you reach the top and important locations on the way, i.e. Sites of Grace. Serpent-God's Curved Sword can be found a few levels below from backtracking at this location. Elden Ring Map Link. You'll find a giant Land Octopus and some of her kids along with a lootable body containing Smithing Stone (3). You don't have to clear the giant octopus to obtain the weapon. Circle her and loot the corpse to obtain it. If you hear the singing bat, you're passing the right area.

If you make your way towards the Singing Bat song, you can obtain the Lost Ashes of War if you drop off the wooden platform behind it. It'll be on a body at the edge of the cliff. Elden Ring Map here.

After defeating Magma Wyrm Makar, a Site of Grace appears in front of the large opening in the cavern opposite the entrance. Going up the wooden platform and taking the lifts brings you to Altus Plateau.
There are at least 9x Smithing Stones (4), 3x Smithing Stones (3), 2x Smithing Stone (5), and 2x Somber Smithing Stones (4) within the cave that goes through the Ruin-Strewn Precipice.
2x Smithing Stone (4) can be found at the first area of the cave, one is being mined by a Miner.
2x Smithing Stone (4) on the right side of the next area that is accessed through a ladder. It is embedded in the wall.
1x Smithing Stone (3) held by a corpse on the right side of that same cave.
1x Smithing Stone (4) after the platform lift, to the left of the stairs that lead into a Miner's trap and a dead end. Next to it, you'll also find one of the Somber Smithing Stones (4).
1x Smithing Stone (4) hidden behind some barrels, to the right of the stairs, located after the Giant Bats scavenging on a corpse.
1x Somber Smithing Stone [4] can be found at a ledge with one Miner enemy. That's down the ladder located to the left of where the Giant Bats were scavenging the corpse.
3x Smithing Stone (4) against the walls of the area where a winged old woman is praying (one of them is a Giant Bat's drop).
1x Smithing Stone (3) held by a corpse, on the roof with the Giant Land Octopus.
1x Smithing Stone (3) under a tent on your right when coming across the second singing winged-old-lady.

There are also 2x Smithing Stone (5) within the location. The first one is fairly straightforward to get, as it lies on the floor in the cabin beside the Ravine-Vailed Village Site of Grace, before entering the caves ( Map Link). The second one is not that exposed, as it is on a corpse hanging from a stone ledge midway up the large platform inside the caves. To get it, you need to jump down from the platform once it reaches the ledge's height or above. Once you get the stone, you can simply jump your way down through a small series of rock ledges at the side, leading to the ground.

title: Lost Ashes of War
text: Return down the ladder while picking up a Smithing Stone [4] in a corner on the way.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [4] in the wall, then the Smithing Stone [3] under a tent.
Optional: Kill the two Operatic Bats for 2x Golden Rune [6] (first time).
At the cliff edge behind the wooden structure is a corpse with Lost Ashes of War.
Lost Ashes of War: Behind two Chanting Winged Dames within the higher levels of Ruin-Strewn Precipice .

title: Boss: Magma Wyrm Makar
text: Follow the edge to a Rune Arc behind a pillar, then take the lift up to discover the Ruin-Strewn Precipice Overlook grace.
Kill Magma Wyrm Makar for Magma Wyrm's Scalesword, Dragon Heart, and 24,000 runes. (This earns an achievement.)
Magma Wyrm Makar: This Boss fight is accessed through Ruin-Strewn Precipice, upon reaching the Ruin-Strewn Precipice Overlook Site of Grace.
Magma Wyrm's Scalesword: Curved Greatsword dropped by Magma Wyrm Makar

Dragon Heart: Key Consumable. Dropped by Magma Wyrm Makar upon defeat. Dragon Hearts are used to acquire Dragon Communion Incantations at the Church of Dragon Communion and the Cathedral of Dragon Communion .

title: Casual Greeting
text: Summon Great Horned Tragoth to learn the Casual Greeting gesture (you can send him home afterward with the Finger Severer).
Optional: Blackguard's summon sign can be found at the entrance if you bought Rya's Necklace from him.
Activate the Magma Wyrm Makar grace at the end of the room. You should ignore the lift past the grace until the West Altus section.
Optional: Collect all non-respawning crafting materials in Liurnia.
miss: Becomes unobtainable if Tragoth is not summoned for Magma Wyrm Makar, Starscourge Radahn, or the Draconic Tree Sentinel outside Leyndell. It is also missed if not obtained before killing Tragoth for Patches's Volcano Manor request.

links.t: Video: non-respawning crafting materials in Liurnia

title: Talk to Rya (Second Location B)
text: Rya (Second Location B): Rya spawns at the top of the Grand Lift of Dectus if it is taken from the bottom, if the player completed the interaction with her in Liurnia of the Lakes. She will teleport you to the Volcano Manor if you talk to her.

title: Map (Ainsel River)
text: Head toward the well northeast of Eastern Tableland, then go north past the well and a small pond to reach a Stonesword Key at the end.
Use the lift inside the well, then grab the Ainsel River Well Depths grace at the bottom.
Pick up the Golden Rune [3] in a coffin on the river edge.
Golden Rune [3]: Consumable Item. Found inside a coffin after descending into Ainsel River, just north from the first site of grace.
Follow the river north to find a corpse with Magic Grease x3 at the base of a waterfall.
Magic Grease: Consumable Item. Three can be looted off a corpse found by following the stream north from Ainsel River Well descent. The body is found by the impassable waterfall.
Head past the ants at the other side of the river to find Grace Mimic x8 on a coffin.
Grace Mimic: Consumable Item. Eight can be looted from a corpse over a coffin on the first cavern entered by heading downstream and south from the Ainsel River Well descent lift.
Go left once the path splits for a Smithing Stone [3].
Smithing Stone [3]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse in a dead end of the Ainsel River caves.
Take the other path to a room with Silver Firefly x2, Golden Rune [1], and a Smithing Stone [3] guarded by an ant.
Silver Firefly: Crafting Material. Two can be looted off a body found downstream and south from the first site of grace, after exiting the first cave passage into a larger chamber.
Golden Rune [1]: Consumable Item. One can be looted off a body on the first large chamber after heading south and downstream from the first site of grace.
Smithing Stone [3]: Found on a corpse in a mountain of bodies, guarded by giant ants.
Follow the river down the right path and loot the Ghost Glovewort [1], Shattershard Arrow (Fletched) x10, and Smithing Stone [3] in the water.
Ghost Glovewort [1]: Upgrade Material for Spirit Ashes. Found at the base of the central pillar.
Smithing Stone [3]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse at the base of the Sluice Gate.
Go up the slope and grab the Ainsel River Sluice Gate grace in a nook in the wall.
Head back and take the other path. Kill the large-bellied ant for a Golden Rune [10] and a Rune Arc.
Golden Rune [10]: Consumable Item. Received after defeating the giant ant with a big white egg on the southern caverns of Ainsel River Well.
Rune Arc: Consumable Item. Received after defeating the giant ant with a big white egg on the southern caverns of Ainsel River Well.
Drop onto the stone beam below the cliff at the end to reach a Smithing Stone [4].
Smithing Stone [4]: Upgrade Item. Found on a corpse dangling from the top of a tall archway.
On a ledge below the stone beam is a corpse with a Celestial Dew.
Celestial Dew: Consumable. Found on a ledge overlooking the Uhl Palace Ruins .
Drop to the bottom and loot the Smithing Stone [1], Golden Rune [2], and Golden Rune [3] on dry ground.
Smithing Stone [1]: Upgrade Material. Found on the ground level of the area, on a corpse sitting by a standing pillar. This is under the beam that has Smithing Stone (4)
Golden Rune [3]: Consumable Item. Looted off a corpse on the southern wall of the stream leading to Uhl Palace Ruins. -
Pick up the Golden Rune [1] and Ghost Glovewort [1] in the water.
Golden Rune [1]: Consumable Item. Looted off a corpse at the edge of the small waterfall in Ainsel River Sluice Gate.
Ghost Glovewort [1]: Upgrade Material for Spirit Ashes. Found in the water streaming down from the Ainsel River Sluice Gate into Uhl Palace Ruins.
Follow the water up some rocks and through a narrow tunnel, then pick up the Smithing Stone [1] x3 on the left-side edge.
Smithing Stone [1]: Upgrade Material. Found on the corpse hanging on the cliff's edge on the higher section of Uhl Palace Ruins, accessed from the secretive tunnel.
Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [1] in the water.
Ghost Glovewort [1]: Upgrade Material for Spirit Ashes. Found on the water's edge by following the secretive northern stream into the bigger grounds.
Climb the slanted pillars, then turn around to find a corpse with Smithing Stone [3] x2 at the top of a stone beam.
Smithing Stone [3]: Upgrade Material. Two found on a corpse lying on the edge of one of the standing column structures. Can be accessed by climbing up the tipped over pillar next to it.
Make your way toward the Withered Astel and kill it so that you can freely explore the rest of the area.
Drop down the ledge below the south corner of the edge and enter the large building to grab the Map: Ainsel River.
Map (Ainsel River): Found inside a ruin next to the Nomadic Merchant .

title: Talk to Hermit Merchant Ainsel River
text: Talk to the Hermit Merchant (Ainsel River) in the building.
Hermit Merchant Ainsel River: Nomadic Merchant. General Goods vendor found sitting by a campfire inside a ruin in Ainsel River .

guide.title: Investigate Ainsel River (Underground)
text: To reach the underground section, you'll need to ride the lift from the Ainsel River Well that will take you down.. Beware tho that there is a single Golem enemy that is guarding this location. Once the Golem has been defeated simply walk through the entrance of the building to find a lever on the right wall and the elevator in the center of the building. Stepping on the button in the middle of the elevator will lower you down into the Ainsel River underground region.

From the Ainsel River Well Depths Site of Grace, you will see multiple Giant Ants clinging to the wall. Ignore them for a second and go right to pick up x3 Magic Grease. Now face the Ants. You can lure them down by approaching slowly, but you probably won't be able to fight them one by one. Try attacking them from range to achieve that. Go into the tunnel and pick up x8 Grace Mimic.

There is a single ant waiting to the right just past the item to ambush you. Head into the left corridor to find Smithing Stone (3). Along the way, more ants will be crawling out of the ground, or sneak up on you from behind. There is a total of at least 4 ants here, which can be fought individually. Head back to the main path, and this time, two Ants will drop down from above. There is an open cave ahead containing minor items and another Smithing Stone (3), guarded by an Ant in the far left corner.

Go right to find another room with Ghost Glovewort (1), x10 Shattershard Arrow (Fletched), and yet another Smithing Stone (3). Go up the stairs and cross the bridge to find the Ainsel River Sluice Gate Site of Grace. Go back and this time take the left path past the Smithing Stone, jumping up on the two stone ledges. You will enter a room with many ants on the ceiling and a bloated one in the center. It drops a Golden Rune (10) and a Rune Arc. Go straight ahead until you reach the Uhl Palace Ruins.

title: Furlcalling Finger Remedy
text: From the building, follow the south wall to a corpse with Smithing Stone [3] x3.
Smithing Stone [3]: Upgrade Material. Three found on a corpse behind the large stone building, above the Ainsel River Downstream site of grace.
Just past the nearby pillar lies a Golden Rune [2].
Loot the Golden Rune [3], Magic Grease x2, Throwing Dagger x6, and Furlcalling Finger Remedy on the stairs by the river.
Golden Rune [3]: Consumable Item. Looted from one of the bodies on the stairs leading up from the riverbank in Uhl Palace Ruins.
Magic Grease: Consumable Item. Looted from one of the corpses on the stairs leading up from the riverbank in Uhl Palace Ruins.
Throwing Dagger: Consumable Throwing Item. Six can be looted from one of the bodies on the stairs leading up from the riverbank in Uhl Palace Ruins.
Furlcalling Finger Remedy: Multiplayer Item. Found on one of the corpses lying on the stairs.

place.title: Uhl Palace Ruins
walk: See Ainsel River for the southern part and Ainsel River Main for the northern part.

title: Immunizing Horn Charm
text: Behind a broken wall next to the stairs is a corpse with Shield Grease.
Shield Grease: Consumable Item. Looted off a corpse where there are many enemies within the ruins by the riverbank in Uhl Palace Ruins.
Pick up a Golden Rune [3] from the north stairs that goes back to the merchant.
Golden Rune [3]: Consumable Item. One may be looted off a body lying over a fallen pillar on the riverbank in the lower section of Uhl Palace Ruins.
Loot the Ghost Glovewort [2] and Golden Rune [3] near the waterfall.
Ghost Glovewort [2]: Upgrade Material for Spirit Ashes. You can found one by the waterfall on the lower section of Uhl Palace Ruins .
Golden Rune [3]: You can found one near tothe ledge in southern Uhl Palace Ruins .
Follow the river downstream to a Ghost Glovewort [1], then grab the Ainsel River Downstream grace on the ledge next to it.
Ghost Glovewort [1]: Upgrade Material for Spirit Ashes.Found in the water, just beneath ledge housing the Ainsel River Downstream Site of Grace.
Continue to a room with ants and pick up Smithing Stone [2] x3, Immunizing Horn Charm, Formic Rock, and Crystal Dart x5 from the left side of the room.
Immunizing Horn Charm: Talisman. Found on one of the corpses in this ant nest.
Formic Rock: Crafting Material. One can be looted from a corpse in the Ant Nest.
Crystal Dart: Consumable Throwing Item. Five can be looted from a corpse in the gorepile by the ant nest near Ainsel River Downstream.

title: Frozen Lightning Spear +1
text: Go through the southwest tunnel to find a corpse with Somber Smithing Stone [3] overlooking the lake of rot.
Somber Smithing Stone [3]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse sitting at the edge of the cliff overlooking Lake of Rot from Ainsel River side. It is next to some butterflies.
Pick up Soap x4 from an alcove on the left side when heading back.
Soap - 4x Ainsel River Downstream: Consumable Item. Four can be looted from a corpse guarded by a basilisk in the ant nest near Ainsel River Downstream.
Return to the ant room to pick up the remaining Ghost Glovewort [1] and Ghost Glovewort [2].
Ghost Glovewort [1]: Found behind the central pillar in this ant nest.
Ghost Glovewort [2]: Found next to the cave's walls.
Continue downstream, then turn left to pick up Melted Mushroom x3.
Melted Mushroom: Crafting Material. Three can be looted off a corpse on a small cave before reaching the boss arena of Ainsel River.
Pick up a Ghost Glovewort [2] before the tunnel that leads to the boss.
Ghost Glovewort [2]: Upgrade Material for Spirit Ashes. Found in the little eastern cave nook before reaching the boss room for Ainsel River Downstream.
Kill the Dragonkin Soldier of Nokstella for Frozen Lightning Spear and 12,000 runes. (This earns an achievement.)
Frozen Lightning Spear: Incantation . Obtained from defeating the Dragonkin Soldier of Nokstella .
Dragonkin Soldier of Nokstella: Jumps down from the ceiling when first entering the area and approaching the huge throne.
Open the chest underneath the massive throne to obtain a Great Ghost Glovewort.
Great Ghost Glovewort: Can be obtained from a chest in a room underneath the massive skeleton and throne.
Activate the Dragonkin Soldier of Nokstella grace on dry ground near the waterfall.

title: Furlcalling Finger Remedy
text: Starting from Siofra River Well Depths, pick up the Golden Rune [3] in front of a pillar in the water.
Golden Rune [3]: Held by a corpse laying against a column.
At the southeast end of the water, you'll find a Ghost Glovewort [1] and a Furlcalling Finger Remedy.
Ghost Glovewort [1]: Found in the dark area near Siofra River Well Site of Grace
Furlcalling Finger Remedy: Multiplayer Item. Found on a corpse sitting in the water in Siofra River .

title: Oracle Bubbles
text: Go northeast from the end of the water to pick up Silver Firefly x5 behind a tree on the right.
Silver Firefly: Can be found at Nokron, Eternal City on a dead body inside the campsite.
Head back to pick up a Golden Rune [2] in the water near a structure.
Golden Rune [2]: Held by a corpse within the stream.
Follow the water until you reach a Ghost Glovewort [1] at the base of a tall tree.
Ghost Glovewort [1]: Found at the water's edge in Siofra River .
Pick up the Golden Rune [4] and Smithing Stone [4] next to the water, then the Soap x3 below the waterfall.
Golden Rune [4]: Held by a corpse within the stairs.
Smithing Stone [4]: Upgrade Material. Found on one of the corpses at the base of the waterfall by the water's edge in Siofra River .
Grab the Golden Rune [4] hanging on the railing of a staircase.
Golden Rune [4]: Found on a corpse after the undead ambush near the Smithing Stone [4]
In the upper area, south-southwest of the staircase and hanging off the top edge of a structure, you'll find a corpse with Budding Horn x3.
Budding Horn: x3 found on a corpse on a ledge
Walk across the top of the structure to reach a ledge with Throwing Dagger x8.
Descend the hole near the ledge, then jump onto the broken half of a statue for Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot x3 and a scarab that drops Oracle Bubbles.

Oracle Bubbles: Can be found by killing one of the Teardrop Scarab on top of a broken statue in the first structure on the right from the Siofra River Deep Wells site of grace. You have to go through some ruins and jump on top of them and follow them over to another side where there is a Teardrop Scarab down below. Kill he Scarab to get this spell

guide.title: Explore Siofra River (Underground)
text: For this location, we highly recommend checking our interactive Elden Ring Map to check the items that can be found, as well as points of interest for the underground section. Elden Ring Map: Siofra River Starting Point. Head to Mistwood, go down Siofra River Well and make sure to discover the Site of Grace here if you haven't. The underground section is guarded by Ancestral Follower enemies and it is recommended that you take them out or try to take the advantage of dealing enough damage at a distance.

Some foraging for materials can be done here as well. One notable material you can acquire is a Golden Centipede which will be at the corner on some rubble when you approach the large statue. It is quite bright in color and hard to miss. Other materials can be forged around the grass and will have a glow for you to recognize them. Siofra River Well is also abundant in Dewkissed Herba.

On the upper levels, there will be a corpse draped over a wall gap. Loot it to gain Budding Horn x3. If you look at the stone wall of the ruins on the upper level, you'll notice they form stepping blocks that you can traverse the top of the walls. Carefully traverse the walls to get another Golden Centipede, and other items. You will also find two Ancestral Followers in front of a hole on the ground, after grabbing everything you can on the upper section, carefully drop into the hole to find a Teardrop Scarab that will drop the Oracle Bubbles, next to the scarab is a lootable corpse.

Continue onwards till you reach a large flight of stairs next to a waterfall. There will be another body draped over the handrail where you can obtain Golden Rune (4). Directly in the waterfall, you can also obtain Soap.

You can take the next lift to the next section, exit the lift at the top, turn north and run across the bridge walkway. Enter the structure, there will be a body containing Preserving Boluses. Under the bridge area, you can walk into the river, and on one of the bridge arches, you will find Beast Liver x3. Be careful progressing from here as you may encounter a Giant Crab, but nearby you should also be able to loot some Crab Eggs.

As you move forward you will run into an Obelisk where you can light the flame. If you head up on the rocks behind there will be an Ancestral Follower. Nearby, you can loot some remains to obtain Armorer's Cookbook (6) - the last large staircase lined with obelisks will lead to Hallowhorn Grounds.

Now, this area has a mechanic to summon a special boss: you must light altars scattered around the zone. There's a map of their location on the Siofra River page. You will find Blaidd standing near hallowhorn grounds, you can talk to him to advance his quest. You should then proceed to locate and activate the pillars in the area:
First Pillar is by the site of grace Siofra River Bank.
Second Pillar is in a corner west of the first pillar.
Third Pillar is on a small island in a watery area with lightning whisps.
Fourth Pillar is by a cliff on the eastern area of the map.
Fifth Pillar is just south of Worshipper's Woods site of grace.
Sixth Pillar is west of Worshipper's Woods site of grace.
Seventh Pillar is to the right on the path toward "Below the Well" site of grace.
Eight Pillar is on the left on the path toward "Below the Well" site of grace.

When all pillars are lit, you can now enter the arena of the Ancestor Spirit boss. The deer carcass at the back of the temple starts glowing and you can interact with it to teleport to the boss' area. You won't be thrown into battle as soon as you teleport, however, and will have to walk through a mist door to fight the boss. Make sure to visit our Ancestor Spirit page to find our different strategies and also a video guide on how to beat this boss - by defeating it, players are rewarded with 13000 Runes and the Ancestral Follower Ashes.

You can exit the area by interacting with a white teleporter in the middle of the arena you fought the boss in. It might be hard to spot due to the size of the arena, but won't miss it if you start with your back to the boss door and proceed forward. As you explore, you can also take a gateway ( see on map) to access the Dragonkin Soldier boss fight. This Great Enemy drops the Dragon Halberd, and players can loot the Marika's Scarseal talisman from nearby. Dropping down from here and going north will also bring you to a Golden Seed and the "Below the Well" site of grace.

title: Map (Siofra River)
text: Go up the left set of stairs for a Smithing Stone [4] on a ledge.
Smithing Stone [4]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse dangling from the side of the ruins in Siofra River .
Loot the 2x Golden Rune [2], Smithing Stone [2], Immunizing Cured Meat, and Rainbow Stone x5 around the stairs opposite the ledge.
Smithing Stone [2]: Upgrade Material. Three found on a corpse laying just underneath the ledge an Ancestral Follower is standing on in Siofra River .
Use the lift past the staircase from earlier, then go left across a bridge to find a room with Preserving Boluses.
Below the bridge is a corpse with Beast Liver x3.
Head upstream and pick up Crab Eggs x3 from a corpse on the left, next to a Giant Crab.
Continue upstream toward a massive pillar. Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [1] next to it, then climb the bottom of the pillar for a Golden Rune [3].
Golden Rune [3]: Held by a corpse near a tree.
Grab the Siofra River Bank grace near a pillar, then light the brazier just east of the grace (1/8).
East-southeast of the brazier, you can find a Ghost Glovewort [2] and the Map: Siofra River.
Map (Siofra River): Found next to the staircase leading up to Hallowhorn Grounds .
Ghost Glovewort [2]: Found next to the staircase leading up to Hallowhorn Grounds .

title: Inverted Hawk Heater Shield
text: Go up the slope next to the map to find a corpse with Old Fang x2 on the edge overlooking the site of grace.
Old Fang: Can be found at Siofra River Well on a dead body hanging over the edge of the cliff
At the end of the slope lies a campsite with Arteria Leaf x3 and the Inverted Hawk Heater Shield.
Inverted Hawk Heater Shield: Southwest of Siofra River Bank site, up a hill and past 3 enemies on a body.
Arteria Leaf: Can be found at Siofra River Well , on a dead body at a campsite under the bridge

title: Armorer's Cookbook
text: Up on the ledge west of the grace lies a campsite with Armorer's Cookbook [6].
Armorer's Cookbook: Cookbook item. Obtained from a corpse lying by the cliff's edge, next to some Ancestral Followers in Siofra River .

title: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [17]
text: From the campsite, turn back and follow the wall on the left until you reach a second brazier to light (2/8).
On a boulder near the second brazier is a corpse with Lump of Flesh x3.
Lump of Flesh: 3x looted from a corpse near the pillar
From the boulder, head southeast to pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [2] from a small island in the water.
Somber Smithing Stone [2]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on a small island opposite to Hallowhorn Grounds .
Ignore the sending gate and head north toward a ledge with a Golden Rune [4].
Golden Rune [4]: Located at the bridge.
Pick up a Ghost Glovewort [2] next to the second massive pillar southeast of the ledge.
Ghost Glovewort [2]: Found among the Land Octopuses at the base of the waterfall on the ground level of Siofra River .
Loot the Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot in the water east of the pillar, then the Ghost Glovewort [1] next to the path that leads into the woods.
Ghost Glovewort [1]: Found at the base of the large tree next to the waterfall in Siofra River .
Light the brazier on the nearby island in the water (3/8).
Climb the wooden scaffolding past the brazier to reach a corpse with Sliver of Meat.
Drop to the wooden platform below, then make a left turn up two sets of stairs to grab a Golden Rune [3].
Golden Rune [3]: Found on a corpse by pillars in Siofra River Well
Follow the wooden platform into the cliffside, then drop down at the end to find the Abandoned Merchant. Buy the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [17], as it's needed for Alexander's questline.

title: Furlcalling Finger Remedy
text: Grab the Hefty Beast Bone near the merchant, then drop down to pick up a Smithing Stone [4] from the middle of the room.
Smithing Stone [4]: Upgrade Material. Found on the ground level in a room in Siofra River with a Giant Poison Flower .
Exit the building while following the wall on the right until you see a corpse with Furlcalling Finger Remedy in the water.
Furlcalling Finger Remedy: Multiplayer Item. Found on the ground level right next to the wall surrounded by a group of Land Octopuses in Siofra River .

title: Great Oracular Bubble
text: Loot the 2x Golden Rune [4] in the water, among several Land Octopuses.
Golden Rune [4]: Held by a corpse near the Giant Land Octopus .
Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [2] and Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot x2 near a waterfall.
Ghost Glovewort [2]: Found at a corner of of a ruined wall in Siofra River .
Enter the top of a hut southeast of the waterfall to find a corpse with Smithing Stone [3] x2 inside.
Smithing Stone [3]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse within the second floor of a wooden shack in Siofra River .
From the hut, head north to light another brazier (4/8).
Next to a massive pillar south-southeast of the brazier, you can find a Ghost Glovewort [2].
Ghost Glovewort [2]: Upgrade Material. Found under a roofed section of the ruined bridge. This area accessed via Waygate at The Four Belfries .
Grab the Worshippers' Woods grace in the structure northeast of the pillar.
Light the brazier guarded by two lightning orbs just south of the grace (5/8).
Loot the Dwelling Arrow x10 and Dappled Cured Meat at the bottom of a fallen pillar south of the brazier and on the right.
Dwelling Arrow: Ammunition. You need to spirit jump up to the top of this area in Hallowhorn Grounds , then walk to the first gap and you can carefully drop down to the middle layer.
Grab the Somber Smithing Stone [2] on top of the bricks up the pillar, then use the sending gate.
Somber Smithing Stone [2]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse slouched over at the top of the ruins in Siofra River .
After arriving, go southwest to find a corpse with Slumbering Egg x2 at the cliff edge.
Enter the building near the corpse for a Somber Smithing Stone [5] and a scarab that drops Great Oracular Bubble.
Great Oracular Bubble: Sorcery . Obtained by defeating the Teardrop Beetle found inside the large stone ruin at the highest level of the Siofra River .
Somber Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. Found by looting a corpse inside the large stone ruin at the highest level of the Siofra River .

title: Dragon Halberd, Boss: Dragonkin Soldier
text: In the area behind the building, on top of a rock, is a corpse with a Golden Rune [7].
Golden Rune [7]: Behind the wall on the platform.
Go through the narrow passage at the south end to reach a corpse with Dragonwound Grease x3.
Return to the building, then head northwest to find a Ghost Glovewort [5] in the left corner of the water.
Ghost Glovewort [5]: Found behind a large stone building at the highest level of the Siofra River .
Kill the Dragonkin Soldier in the water for Dragon Halberd and 16,000 runes.
Dragon Halberd: Halberd. Obtained when defeating the Dragonkin Soldier in Siofra River .
Dragonkin Soldier: Great Enemy. Found laying dormant in the water close to the waterfall at the highest level of the Siofra River . Take the Siofra River East Waygate to get up to this area.

title: Marika's Scarseal
text: Pick up Marika's Scarseal from the corpse below the waterfall.
Marika's Scarseal: Talisman. Found on a corpse at the base of the waterfall found at the highest level of Siofra River . It is close to where the Dragonkin Soldier is fought.

title: Stonesword Key
text: South of the waterfall is a smaller waterfall with a Golden Rune [7] at its base.
Golden Rune [7]: Held by a corpse near the Mimic Tear Boss . Held by a corpse next to the Stake of Marika
Next to a tree northeast of the second waterfall is a Ghost Glovewort [4].
Ghost Glovewort [4]: Found on the edge of the cliff, guarded by Fallen Hawks in Nokron, Eternal City .
Drop down the north ledge, then cross the flying buttress between two pillars to find a Stonesword Key behind the second pillar.

Stonesword Key: Stonesword Key found on a corpse at the very end of a tall ruined wall in Siofra River . A gust of wind can be found at the edge of the cliff closest to the ruin, boosting you up to the top.

title: Clarifying Horn Charm, Golden Seed +1
text: Go back across and pick up the Golden Seed at the cliff.
From the golden tree, head north-northwest along a ledge to reach a campsite with a Rune Arc.
Rune Arc: Found on a corpse by a fireplace in a cave behind the waterfall.
Go back and cross the rock bridge to light the brazier immediately on the right (6/8).
Head northeast from the brazier to find a Golden Rune [4] on a ledge.
Farther north you'll discover the Below the Well grace.
Just north-northeast of the grace lies a campsite with a Ghost Glovewort [3].
Ghost Glovewort [3]: Found just north of the Below the Well Site of Grace, next to the lift's platform.
Grab the Clarifying Horn Charm on the stairs, but ignore the lift at the top; you'll need the Stonesword Keys for later.
Clarifying Horn Charm: Talisman. Found on a corpse lying on the stairs leading to the lift going up to the Deep Siofra Well .
Golden Seed: Flask Upgrade. Found on a cliffside overlooking the river floor in Siofra River .
Stonesword Key: Stonesword Key found by climbing across the wall's support beams and pillars in Siofra River .

title: Ash of War: Square Off
text: From the grace, head southeast to find a corpse with Sliver of Meat x3 near the edge.
Follow the cliff edge southwest to light the seventh brazier (7/8).
Continue down the path until you reach an open field. Kill the scarab near the waterfall to obtain Ash of War: Square Off.
Ash of War: Square Off: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab found rolling around at the edge of the cliff in Siofra River .

title: Horn Bow
text: Loot the Golden Rune [4] and Smithing Stone [2] x3 in the small woods past the field.
Smithing Stone [2]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse in a corner at the bottom of a ruin in Nokron, Eternal City .
Travel to Worshipper's Woods and head south-southeast toward a ruined structure with a Smithing Stone [3] on top.
Smithing Stone [3]: Upgrade Material. Found in a room locked behind an imp statue in Nokron, Eternal City .
In the woods southwest of the structure lies a corpse with Smithing Stone [2] x3.
Smithing Stone [2]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse dangling from the edge of the upper platform of a ruin in Siofra River .
Light the final brazier at the nearby cliff (8/8).
From the brazier, go west to find a Golden Rune [3] behind a tree.
On the path north of the tree, loot the Shield Grease and Golden Rune [2], which is behind a tree next to the path.
Optional: Head south-southwest from the tree to find Blaidd next to a pillar. Talk to him to unlock dialogue with Seluvis later.
Use the spiritspring behind Blaidd to reach a Ghost Glovewort [3] on the bridge far above.
Ghost Glovewort [3]: Found at the base of a small tree in Nokron, Eternal City .
Jump across the gap to find a Stonesword Key at the end of the bridge.
Descend the gap to a lower part of the bridge, where you'll find Dwelling Arrow x10.
Return to Blaidd, then head west toward a Golden Rune [4] in front of a large tree.
Under the staircase southwest of the tree, you can find a corpse with Horn Bow.
Horn Bow: Bow. Found on a corpse under the stairs leading to Hallowhorn Grounds .

place.title: Hallowhorn Grounds
walk: ## Siofra River

When you first enter the temple in Siofra River, you may find that the temple is mostly empty - it's mostly barren and there's nothing to interact with. There are eight obelisks next to the stairs leading up to Hallowhorn Grounds that are unlit (one might be lit if you've lit the brazier on the way to the temple). You have to find eight braziers scattered around Siofra River and set them aflame to light these obelisks (See our Interactive Map for their location). Once all of them are lit, a message saying "Power gathers somewhere in horned remains" will pop up and the deer carcass further in the temple will start glowing. You can now head back to Hallowhorn Grounds to interact with the carcass to teleport to the Ancestor Spirit boss arena. You can find a map with the locations of these braziers on the Siofra River page.
## Nokron, Eternal City

The Hallowhorn Grounds in Nokron, Eternal City works the same way, except for the fact that there are six obelisks instead. Find each brazier (the ones here are easier to find as most of them have a singing Ancestral Follower by them, see our Interactive Map if you have trouble finding them) and interact with the deer carcass when all obelisks are lit. This carcass teleports you to the Regal Ancestor Spirit boss arena.

title: Talk to Blaidd
text: Blaidd: A warrior with a wolf's head. Found after meeting Ranni the Witch in Liurnia of the Lakes

title: Boss: Ancestor Spirit, Ancestral Follower Ashes
text: Pick up a Golden Rune [6] on a lower ledge opposite the corpse.
Golden Rune [6]: Underneath the staircase leading to Hallowhorn Grounds .
Go up the stairs and touch the horned remains. Kill the Ancestor Spirit for Ancestral Follower Ashes and 13,000 runes. (This earns an achievement.)

Ancestor Spirit: Great Enemy. Found behind a mist door in a special area. This area can only be accessed by touching the horned remains in the Hallowhorn Grounds in Siofra River after lighting up all the obelisks.
Ancestral Follower Ashes: Spirit Ashes. Obtained from defeating the Ancestor Spirit in Siofra River .

title: Mottled Necklace
text: Travel to The Four Belfries and unlock the imp-sealed belfry marked by the message "Night Sky Unceasing":
Descend the rocks to a bridge, then pick up the Ghost Glovewort [2] and Mottled Necklace on the bridge.
Mottled Necklace: Talisman. Found on a corpse at the edge of the ruined bridge. This area is accessed via Waygate from The Four Belfries .

title: Map (Dragonbarrow)
text: From Lenne's Rise, head downhill until you reach the Dragonbarrow Fork grace next to a tree.

Follow the right-side cliff edge past a pond with two dragons and toward the divine tower, where you'll find some chairs with Rune Arc, Somber Smithing Stone [9], Dragonwound Grease, and Arteria Leaf x2.
Rune Arc: Located on the island in the Caelid Swamp
Dragonwound Grease: Weapon Coating. Can be found on one of the 4 bodies sitting, at the base of the tower.
Arteria Leaf: Can be found at the base of Divine Tower of Caelid on a corpse.
Turn back and loot the Sliver of Meat x3, Gravel Stone, and Golden Rune [5] in the pond.
Sliver of Meat: Material. Found on a corpse south of the Deep Siofra Well .
Gravel Stone: Crafting Material, found in the middle of the lake. Before of the lurking Dragons in the area.
Golden Rune [5]: Found at the edge of the lake where the dragons dwell.
Pick up Map: Dragonbarrow from a stele next to the marked road past the pond.
Map (Dragonbarrow): Map Fragment. Reveals the Dragonbarrow region. Found on a monolith along the road east of the Dragonbarrow West Site of Grace.

title: Talk to Isolated Merchant Dragonbarrow +1
text: Follow the road west to discover the Dragonbarrow West grace behind an arched root.
Head toward the road just northeast of the grace and follow it to the top, where you'll find a shack with the Isolated Merchant's Shack grace.
Optional: Buy a Beast-Repellent Torch from the Isolated Merchant (Dragonbarrow) to keep the Giant Dogs at bay when held in either arm.
Isolated Merchant Dragonbarrow: General Goods vendor found sitting outside his shack in western Dragonbarrow .

guide.title: Isolated Merchant's Shack (Weeping Peninsula)
text: Isolated Merchant's Shack (Weeping Peninsula) is a simple hut found to the very west of the Weeping Peninsula. There are no hostiles in the area and this location can be used as a place of rest. There is a Site of Grace right outside the hut.

title: Ash of War: Sky Shot
text: Below a ledge west-northwest of the shack is a scarab that drops Ash of War: Sky Shot.
Ash of War: Sky Shot: Ash of War. Drops from Teardrop Scarab behind Isolated Merchant's Shack

guide.title: Minor Erdtree - Caelid
text: Next, travel north from Gael Tunnel and you should find the Minor Erdtree of Caelid. This area is protected by a field boss, the Erdtree Avatar, and defeating it drops the Greenburst Crystal Tear and the Flame-Shrouding Cracked Tear items for your flask. You can also find a Cracked Pot here; one can be found at the end of a tree branch extending from the northwest cliffs behind the tree.

Since you're already here, you might as well explore the Minor Erdtree Catacombs that are nearby, so that you can gather some upgrade materials for your Spirit Ashes, and you can also acquire a new Spirit Ash. Imps make these catacombs their home, with many of them perched on the walls and the ceilings, awaiting passersby. Bring ranged attacks and spells or craft throwable Consumables to knock them off their perches and prevent unwanted surprises Press the target lock key frequently to easily find these mischievous creatures.

There is another Imp on the ceiling halfway through the hallway and one more in the room at the very end. Pick up the Imp Head (Wolf) helm from the corpse bent over the sarcophagus and then turn right toward another room. This is the upper level of the first room with the scarlet rot fluid. Take the Imps out on the balcony if you haven't done so earlier. Check the corpse ahead for 2 x Sacramental Buds and head to the left for another Grave Glovewort (5). From here, you can head back to the second scarlet rot fluid-drenched room and continue to the western corridor and turn left to find the dungeon's boss door.

Isolated Merchant's Shack: Located East of the Minor Erdtree, there is a merchant here and a site of grace. Resting at nightfall and entering the shack triggers a mini field boss to appear, the Bell Bearing Hunter. Defeating it drops the Gravity Stone Peddler's Bell Bearing. Behind the shack is a Teardrop Scarab as well that drops the Ash of War: Sky Shot upon killing it.
Shack of Rotting: You can find a site of grace here to discover and activate. There are also some materials here and Preserving Boluses that you can loot.

Forsaken Ruins: The area is guarded by two Giant Crows. But you can gather some materials here such as Faded Erdleaf Flower, Trina's Lily, Golden Rune [5], and Smithing Stone [4]. Make sure to also have a Stonesword Key in your inventory so that you can dispel the fog leading to the cellar. The cellar has a chest containing the Sword of St. Trina.

Caelem Ruins: Ruins found on the western portion of Caelid, where the Caelid Highway cuts through. These ruins are filled with burning Putrid Corpses that shamble towards targets and explode kamikaze-style. There are also several Maneuverable Flamethrowers roaming the ruins. The cellar area is guarded by two Mad Pumpkin Head. Defeating these two awards 6,300 Runes and allows access to the treasure room at the back, where you can find a chest containing the Visage Shield.

Abandoned Cave: East of Smoldering Wall Grace on the eastern wall of the canyon, and slightly northwest of the Sellia Evergaol. The location is only reachable by approaching from the west and crossing the canyon using a tree. You can find items here such as the Serpent Bow. the Venomous Fang, and upon defeating the Cleanrot Knights, you can acquire the Golden Scarab talisman and 7000 Runes.

title: Serpent Bow
text: Return to Dragonbarrow West and head southwest across a gap to find a cemetery on the left with Golden Rune [1], Golden Rune [2], and a Golden Rune [6].
Between the two mushroom-covered rocks west-southwest of the cemetery is a corpse with Hefty Beast Bone x3.
Guarded by a Giant Crow at the top of the largest rock is a corpse with Sacramental Bud.
Sacramental Bud: Can be found next to the Raven enemy.
In the cliff edge southeast of the rocks, you'll find a root that leads to Abandoned Cave:
Head inside and grab the Abandoned Cave grace.
Drop into the rot and backstep toward an Abductor Virgin. Just east of it is a corpse with Dragonwound Grease.
Continue to a ledge and jump toward the ground below to pick up Serpent Bow.
Serpent Bow: Found by a pool of rot within Abandoned Cave

place.title: Abandoned Cave
walk: ## Entry

The Abandoned Cave entrance is located on the eastern wall of the canyon in Caelid, slightly northwest of the Sellia Evergaol. It can be reached from the Smoldering Wall Grace by walking across the tree (could be Erdtree roots?) that spans the canyon.

When crossing the canyon on the tree, there is a protrusion which curves diagonally from left to right (relative to the player's direction, when crossing the canyon from west to east). Stick to the left side of the tree during the section where this protrusion moves to the right, as the right side is not walkable and will result in slipping off the tree and falling to death in the canyon (if this happens, the runes will then need to be retrieved from the tree, instead of from the safety of the cliffside).
## Main Dungeon Walkthrough

The dungeon starts with a one-way drop into a deep pool of scarlet rot. Proceeding left after the drop and past the geysers of rot, the player will reach a fork. On the right, past another geyser, is a dead end containing a Dragonwound Grease. The left leads to a dry tunnel, which slopes downward to the next room. The martyr effigy (to enable summoning) is located on the left at the bottom of this slope.

The next room contains, once again, a pool of scarlet rot below and a few geysers. After entering, an item is visible below; the Serpent Bow. To it's right, a Servant of Rot will be standing on some dry land, behind which is the path forward.
The tunnel leads down a few steps, then widens into a room with a Rat and another Servant of Rot. The tunnel then curves right into a small room with two rats and a Fire Grease on a corpse.

Continuing onward, the tunnel opens into a large room with a Giant Miranda Flower (scarlet variant) in the middle with a few shallow pools of scarlet rot on the right edge of the room. Approaching the center of the room causes smaller Miranda Flowers to pop up from the ground. To the left, there is a pile of broken Iron Virgins which can be climbed to reach a ledge with the Venomous Fang. On the opposite side of the room is another ledge with two Servant of Rot. Behind them is a short tunnel that leads to the boss.
## Boss: Cleanrot Knights
A pair of Cleanrot Knights (one of each variant) can be found in a large room containing mostly dry land, with a shallow pool of scarlet rot near the entrance.
Upon defeat, the Cleanrot Knight pair drop the Golden Scarab talisman and 7000 runes.
notes: Preserving Boluses alleviate build up of and cures scarlet rot
Neutralizing Boluses alleviate build up of and cures poison
The Cure Poison incantation alleviates build up of and cures poison
The Flame, Cleanse Me incantation alleviates build up of and cures both poison and scarlet rot
Avoid rolling through the pools of scarlet rot as this accumulates rot on the player's body, resulting in continued buildup for a short period even after moving out of the rot.

title: Boss: Cleanrot Knight Duo
text: Cleanrot Knight Duo: Duo Boss Fight at the end of the Abandoned Cave . Drops the Gold Scarab talisman upon defeat.

Golden Scarab: Dropped by Cleanrot Knight (Sickle) & Cleanrot Knight (Spear) boss found in Abandoned Cave . It can be accessed by going east from Smoldering Wall site of grace and walking across canyon by using tree branches.

title: Venomous Fang
text: Pick up Fire Grease from an alcove in the tunnel.
Fire Grease: Weapon Coating. Found on a corpse inside the Abandoned Cave .
Climb the heap of Abductor Virgins in the large room to reach the Venomous Fang.
Venomous Fang: Claw Weapons. Climb on the Iron Maidens near the end of the Abandoned Cave to acquire them.

title: Boss: Putrid Avatar (Dragonbarrow)
text: Kill the two Cleanrot Knights for Gold Scarab and 7,000 runes.
Travel to Rotview Balcony and head north-northeast toward the cliff edge. Drop down below the dead tree to find a Rune Arc on one of the roots.
Rune Arc: Can be found on one of the roots of the erdtrees. You can reach it by dropping down from the roots above.
Kill the Putrid Avatar below for Greenburst Crystal Tear, Flame-Shrouding Cracked Tear, and 9,600 runes.
Putrid Avatar: Optional boss. It guards the Minor Erdtree in Dragonbarrow , just before the bridge leading to the Bestial Sanctum .
Stonebarb Cracked Tear: Obtained by defeating the Putrid Avatar at the Minor Erdtree in Dragonbarrow .
Opaline Hardtear: Dropped by Putrid Avatar at the Minor Erdtree in Dragonbarrow .

title: Cracked Pot
text: Pick up a Cracked Pot from a root extending past the cliff edge near the Minor Erdtree.
Cracked Pot: Crafting Pot. One found at the end of a tree branch extending from the northwest cliffs behind the tree.

title: Boss: Erdtree Avatar (Caelid)
text: Erdtree Avatar: Field Boss. Drops Greenburst Crystal Tear and Flame-Shrouding Cracked Tear upon defeat.
Greenburst Crystal Tear: Physick Flask material. Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar guarding this tree.
Flame-Shrouding Cracked Tear: Physick Flask material. Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar guarding this tree.

title: Imp Head
text: On the opposite side of the Erdtree lies the entrance to Minor Erdtree Catacombs:
Enter it and grab the Minor Erdtree Catacombs grace.
Ride the lift down and take the west path to a room with a Grave Glovewort [3].

Grave Glovewort [3]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 3 can be found inside the Minor Erdtree Catacombs : After descending the lift by the entrance, head into the western corridor and look behind the central support of the next room to find the first glovewort. The second one is found in the scarlet rot-flooded room east of the lift. The glovewort is to the right of the doorway. The last one can be found by returning to the lift, sending it up and then dropping into the opening below it. Go through the scarlet rot-flooded corridor and enter the small opening on the right. Continue through the next room and look for a ladder on the right. Climb the ladder and you can find the glovewort in the hallway above.
Pull the boss lever in the next room, then return to the lift to pick up a Grave Glovewort [4].

Grave Glovewort [4]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 2 can be found inside the Minor Erdtree Catacombs : The first one is found inside the eastern corridor, after descending the lift by the entrance. Go back to the lift and step on the plate to send it up and immediately jump off. Head into the opening and through the scarlot rot-flooded corridor. Look to the right for a narrow opening and follow it into a room where you can find the glovewort in the back.
Send the lift up to reveal a room below it. Drop down to pick up Ghost Glovewort [4] and Grave Violet x3 from a corridor blanketed with rot.

Ghost Glovewort [4]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One can be found inside the Minor Erdtree Catacombs . After descending the lift, step on its pressure plate again to send it up and immediately jump off. Drop down into the opening and head into the scarlot rot-flooded corridor to find the glovewort, by the narrow opening on the right.
Go up the stairs in the corridor to discover a room with a Grave Glovewort [4] and a Golden Rune [4].

Grave Glovewort [4]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 3 can be found inside the Caelid Catacombs : The first is found on the left side of the scarlet rot-flooded corridor just past the Site of Grace. The second one is found in the room before the boss door, in the corner of the central support. The third one is found in the same room, in the right corner in the back.
Climb the ladder to a room with Imp Head (Wolf), picking up a Grave Glovewort [3] on the way.
Imp Head: Helmet. Found inside Minor Erdtree Catacombs , held by a corpse laying over a sarcophagus.

Grave Glovewort [3]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 2 can be found inside the Caelid Catacombs : The first one is found in the corner of the connecting corridor after the scarlot rot-flooded corridor past the Site of Grace. Continue along the dungeon until you reach a room with a small set of stairs on the left. The second glovewort is on the far wall opposite the stairs.

title: Boss: Erdtree Burial Watchdog (Minor Erdtree Catacombs) +1
text: Pick up Sacramental Bud x2 and a Grave Glovewort [5] from the ledge at the end.

Grave Glovewort [5]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 2 can be found inside the Minor Erdtree Catacombs : The first one is found in the back of the scarlet rot-flooded room, east of the lift. The second glovewort can be found by sending the lift up and dropping into the opening below. Head into the scarlot rot-flooded corridor and go through the narrow opening on the right. Continue on through the next room and climb up the ladder on the right. Follow the linear path and turn right to wind up on the upper balcony of the scarlot rot-flooded room. The glovewort is found by a pillar in the back on the left side.
Loot the Grave Glovewort [3], Aeonian Butterfly, and Grave Glovewort [5] in the room below.
Drop down below the lift again and kill the two Erdtree Burial Watchdogs for Mad Pumpkin Head Ashes and 7,400 runes.
Mad Pumpkin Head Ashes: Spirit Summon Ash. Dropped by the Erdtree Burial Watchdog duo bosses within the Minor Erdtree Catacombs .
Erdtree Burial Watchdog: Duo boss fight against a Watchdog wielding a Sword and another wielding a Scepter. Drops the Mad Pumpkin Head Ashes upon defeat.

Mad Pumpkin Head: Dual Boss Fight against two Mad Pumpkin Heads . They are found in an underground room, the entrance to which is in the eastern side of the ruins. No drops but allows access to a treasure room upon defeat.

place.title: Minor Erdtree Catacombs
walk: Imps make these catacombs their home, with many of them perched on the walls and the ceilings, awaiting passersby. Bring ranged attacks and spells or craft throwable Consumables to knock them off their perches and prevent unwanted surprises Press the target lock key frequently to easily find these mischievous creatures.

From the site of grace, head down the first corridor ahead and hit the Imp on the ceiling from afar. There is a lift leading down around the corner. From the lift, head down the western corridor and defeat the Imp in the corner. The room around the corner has a couple more Imps inside. There is a Grave Violet just before you enter the room and a Grave Glovewort (3) at the back of the room before the next room. In the next room, there is an imp hiding in the right side and one more clinging to the ceiling. After defeating them, pull the lever by the statue and then head back to the lift.

This time, head towards the east corridor and collect the Grave Glovewort (4) on the way. In the next room, hit one of the Imps in the upper level from the corridor and three Skeletal Slimes will drop in from the ceiling. There are several more slimes in the room behind the pillars and a couple more Imps in the upper level. Beware of the floor here which is oozing with water that inflicts rot. There is a Grave Glovewort (3) to the right by the entrance and an Aeonian Butterfly on the corpse in the center. There is another Grave Violet and a Grave Glovewort (5) in the back half of the room.

Head back to the lift once more and step on the switch then get off before it rises. The rest of the dungeon is found in a passageway underneath the lift. Drop down below and take out the Imp patrolling the area. The next room is filled with the same scarlet rot fluid and several slimes will drop down from the ceiling as you approach. You can take them out or just sprint past them. There is a narrow passage to the north with a set of stairs leading to a room with a bunch of crabs. Take them out and pick up the Grave Glovewort (4) and Golden Rune (4) by the wall at the end. On the east side of this room is a ladder leading up to a long hallway. At the top of the ladder there will be an Imp around the corner to your left, and an Imp ahead of you. Take the Imps out and pick up the Grave Glovewort (3) on the way. There is another Imp on the ceiling halfway through the hallway and one more in the room at the very end. Pick up the Imp Head (Wolf) helm from the corpse bent over the sarcophagus and then turn right toward another room. This is the upper level of the first room with the scarlet rot fluid. Take the Imps out on the balcony if you haven't done so earlier. Check the corpse ahead for 2x Sacramental Buds and head to the left for another Grave Glovewort (5).
From here, you can head back to the second scarlet rot fluid-drenched room and continue to the western corridor and turn left to find the dungeon's boss door.
## Boss: Erdtree Burial Watchdog Duo (Scepter & Sword)

This boss fight is a Duo battle against two Erdtree Burial Watchdogs. One has a Sword, similar to the one encountered in Stormfoot Catacombs while the other has a Watchdog's Staff. It is recommended you focus on the Staff one as it uses ranged magical projectiles. Consider using a Spirit summon to distract one Watchdog while you focus on the other, or Crystal Darts to make them fight each other. Aside from that, the strategies are largely the same as previous encounters. Always be on the move. If you are running, their aerial slam attacks should not hit you. Weave in 1 or 2 attacks max between slams and other weapon attacks. Watch out for when a Watchdog stands on its hind legs. It will slowly walk towards you and slam its weapon down very quickly. Be ready to dodge sideways.
Defeating the duo awards the Mad Pumpkin Head Ashes.
notes: Note that phantoms in your world can pull the lever in this dungeon. If they do, the host will not be able to interact with it. Resetting your game seems to fix this.

title: Whirl, O Flame!
text: Travel to Rotview Balcony and follow the nearby road to a scarab that drops Whirl, O Flame!.
Whirl, O Flame!: Dropped from a Teardrop Scarab on the road between Rotview Balcony and Caelem Ruins next to the wagon.

title: Greatsword
text: Open the chest in the back of a carriage to obtain the Greatsword.
Greatsword: Colossal Sword. Looted from the chest in the enemy caravan traveling the Caelid Highway .

title: Visage Shield
text: Grab Explosive Bolt x6 and a Rune Arc from the nearby camp.
Rune Arc: Consumable. Looted from a chest near the enemy caravan traveling Dragonbarrow's Road.
On the cliff northwest of the camp, you'll find a chair with a Somber Smithing Stone [4].
Somber Smithing Stone [4]: Upgrade Material. Found on a dead body sitting on a chair.
Return to the road and follow it toward the ruins to find the Caelem Ruins grace on the left:
In the back of the rightmost building is a corpse with Drawstring Fire Grease x3.
Pick up Smoldering Butterfly x3 from the second building on the left side of the ruins.
Go down the cellar in the third left-side building and kill the two Mad Pumpkin Heads for 6,300 runes.
Open the chest in the cellar to obtain the Visage Shield.
Visage Shield: Greatshield. Found in a chest in a small room behind the Mad Pumpkin Head duo bosses. Accessible after defeating them.

place.title: Caelem Ruins
walk: These ruins are filled with burning Putrid Corpses that shamble towards targets and explode kamikaze-style. There are also several Maneuverable Flamethrowers roaming the ruins. These are incredibly dangerous and should be fought on horseback to more easily dodge their streams of fire. You can aim for their operators riding behind the flamethrowers who are easier to kill than the flamethrowers themselves. Getting rid of the operators also gets rid of the flamethrowers.

On the eastern side of the ruins, near the duo of Maneuverable Flamethrowers, you can find a set of stairs leading underground to the Mad Pumpkin Head duo boss fight. Defeating these two awards 6,300 Runes and allows access to the treasure room at the back, where you can find a chest containing the Visage Shield.

title: Talk to Finger Reader (Caelid)
text: Finger Reader: She can be found near the telescope.

title: Sword of St. Trina
text: Near the cellar entrance, next to a fire, you can find a corpse with Great Dragonfly Head x3.
Follow the road in the middle of the ruins to the Smoldering Wall grace past the smoldering fence.
Climb the mushroom-covered rock west-northwest of the grace for a Golden Rune [9] in front of a Giant Crow.
Golden Rune [9]: Consumable Item. Found as a treasure in Caelid
On top of the mushroom-covered rock farther west is a Smithing Stone [5].
