Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. Looted as a treasure in the open field in Caelid.
Northwest of the second mushroom-covered rock lies Forsaken Ruins:
Pick up the Smithing Stone [4] in the middle of the ruins.
Smithing Stone [4]: Looted at the Forsaken Ruins .
In a window northeast of the middle corpse is a Golden Rune [5].
Golden Rune [5]: Looted at the Forsaken Ruins .
Unlock the imp seal and loot the Sword of St. Trina from the chest in the cellar.
Sword of St. Trina: Found inside a chest in the underground cellar of the Forsaken Ruins .

place.title: Shack of the Rotting
walk: The Shack of the Rotting is an old worn-down shack in Caelid. You'll find slow moving Putrid Corpses and Putrid Flesh wandering the area. The only notable items are the Preserving Boluses found inside the shack on a corpse, but be careful behind you as there is a Putrid Corpse hiding in the corner waiting to ambush you as you loot.

title: Cross-Naginata
text: Hanging onto the back of an arched root south of the ruins is a scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [4].

Somber Smithing Stone [4]: Upgrade Material. One can be found inside Gael Tunnel , in the back of the water-logged cavern crawling with Land Octopi and a single Giant Land Octopus hanging from the ceiling.
From the root, go southwest and follow the banners up a slope to find the entrance to Gael Tunnel:
Drop down the far-left side to pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [2].

Somber Smithing Stone [2]: Upgrade Material. One can be found inside Gael Tunnel . From the entrance, go to the left of the wooden platform and drop down on to the ledge below. Drop down onto the second ledge ahead and enter the small tunnel to find the stone.
Activate the Gael Tunnel grace at the bottom.
Go down a set of stairs for a Golden Rune [5] on a wooden platform.
Loot the 3x Smithing Stone [4] and Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot around the room with the wooden platform.
Head through the northeast tunnel and grab the 2x Smithing Stone [4], Somber Smithing Stone [4], and Cross-Naginata in the room.
Cross-Naginata: Spear. Found on a corpse inside the Gael Tunnel , in the cavern filled with Land Octopi and a single Giant Land Octopus.

title: Boss: Magma Wyrm (Gael Tunnel)
text: Go down the other path for Large Glintstone Scrap x5, Grace Mimic x5, and a Smithing Stone [4] on the wall.
Continue to the boss and pick up the Smithing Stone [4] on the left wall.
Open the shortcut door and talk to Alexander if you didn't earlier. Behind him is a Smithing Stone [4] you might've grabbed already.
Kill the Magma Wyrm for Dragon Heart, Moonveil, and 7,500 runes.
Moonveil: Katana. Dropped by Magma Wyrm inside Gael Tunnel .
Magma Wyrm: Found inside Gael Tunnel . Drops x1 Dragon Heart and Moonveil

Dragon Heart: Key Consumable. Dropped by the Magma Wyrm boss inside Gael Tunnel . Dragon Hearts are used to acquire Dragon Communion Incantations at the Church of Dragon Communion and the Cathedral of Dragon Communion .

place.title: Gael Tunnel
walk: If you have entered from Limgrave (not Caelid), there doesn't seem to be a way to open the wooden door from this side. If you have freed Alexander and not gone extremely deep into Caelid, he should be here.

The Site of Grace for this dungeon is found in a very deep pit ahead of the entrance past two Radahn Soldiers. There is no lift to take you down so you will need to do some platforming along the edges of the pit. There is a small room next to the second ledge you drop down to on the left. There is a corpse here with a Somber Smithing Stone [2]. From the Site of Grace, head north through the tunnel archway to a large cavern with wooden walkways. Kill the Radahn Soldier on the right then head down the steps and clear the Miners and Radahn Soldiers on this floor. There is a corpse on the left with a Golden Rune [5].

Head down the steps for more Miners and Radahn Soldiers congregating by the fire and a few more under the walkway. There is a Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot behind some crates in the very back below the walkway. Look to the east for a tunnel leading to another cavern crawling with Land Octopi and a single Giant Land Octopus hanging from the ceiling in the back. There is a corpse below where the giant octopus was hanging from that contains a Cross-Naginata weapon.

Head back into the main cavern and go west to find a soldier kneeling by a ladder. Take him out and then descend the ladder to find another Radahn Soldier and a Miner. Loot the corpse in the center for 5x Large Glintstone Scraps and the other corpse nearby for a Grace Mimic. Continue along to the tunnel in the south to a room with a large wooden gate to the right which contains the boss arena, as well as a smaller wooden door straight ahead. Go through the small door first which leads to the rear entrance of the tunnel as well as a second Site of Grace which you should activate. Head back to the large gate to challenge the boss of this dungeon.
## Boss: Magma Wyrm

This boss is highly susceptible to magic damage. Use sorcery spells that hit multiple times such as Glintblade Phalanx or Greatblade Phalanx to quickly break its poise and get a critical hit in. Sorcery mains can very easily lock this boss down. If you aren't sorcery focused, however, you will need to watch out for its mad dash attack where it spews lava from its mouth and then dashes around the room, leaving lava trails along the ground that persist for a few seconds. It is also equipped with a very large curved greatsword which it uses to slash in very wide arcs. However, its sword attacks are very slow with a very long wind-up. Take advantage of these animations and get hits in when you can.
Upon defeat, the Magma Wyrm drops a Dragon Heart, the Moonveil katana, as well as 7,500 Runes.

title: Talk to Iron Fist Alexander
text: Iron Fist Alexander: Found inside Gael Tunnel , at the rear entrance. After talking to him, he sets off to Redmane Castle

title: Ash of War: Flame of the Redmanes
text: Follow the slope outside the entrance downhill to an invisible scarab that drops Ash of War: Flame of the Redmanes.
Ash of War: Flame of the Redmanes: Ash of War. Dropped by an invisible Teardrop Scarab near the North Fort Gael Site of Grace

title: Starscourge Heirloom
text: Grab the Fort Gael North grace below a ledge in the area with the scarab.
When approaching the fort, pick up Explosive Greatbolt x5 from a camp on the right side.
Explosive Greatbolt: Ammunition. Looted from a corpse in the middle of a battlefield in Mt. Gelmir .
At the fort entrance, follow the branches around the corner to a ladder that leads inside Fort Gael:
After entering, pick up Warming Stone x2 from a wooden beam.
Go up the stairs and open the chest under a tent to obtain Starscourge Heirloom.
Starscourge Heirloom: Looted from a chest in Fort Gael . It's outside the watchtower on the upper-section of the fort, under a canopy tent.

guide.title: Clear out Fort Gael
text: Follow the guide in the Fort Gael page for up-to-date info. At the end of Fort Gael, still take the waygate teleporter at the top of the watchtower, then head west across the bridge to activate the Impassable Greatbridge shrine, as this will prevent the need of traveling through Fort Gael again when ready to go to Redmane Castle.

title: Katar
text: Hit the railing at the top of the staircase, then jump to the wooden platform below to grab the gate lever and a corpse with Mushroom x10 down the outer platform.
Drop down to the ledge inside the fort to reach a room with the Katar.
Katar: First Weapon. Looted from a treasure chest in Fort Gael . You can find the chest inside a dark room on the elevated platform above the Lion Guardian.

place.title: Fort Gael
walk: You can start off at the Fort Gael North site of grace as you begin to explore Fort Gael. Map Link The outskirts of the fort is heavily guarded by Redmane Knights and Radahn Soldiers. If you can move around to the left of the fort, there is a lootable corpse leaned against one of the walls. Loot the corpse to obtain Flame, Grant me Strength Map Link, found between two Flame Chariots. If you find the chariots too difficult to obtain before dying, keep reading further.

On high ground, as you move towards the south gate of the fort, you'll notice a Redmane Knight wielding a large bow, you'll easily notice it since it's the only one shooting a purple energy arrow at you. Kill it and it may drop the Greatbow.

Move to the south gate that is locked, go around the corner, jump down to the roots below and continue around the corner, and you'll see a ladder that you can climb to formally reach and infiltrate Fort Gael. The ladder is guarded by a Soldier enemy wielding a spear. If you had trouble getting the Flame, Grant me Strength earlier, go past the ladder for now and follow the cliffs around the corner, you'll end up on a cliff above the two Flame Chariots below. One of the chariots should spot you and move out of its position, if not shoot it with a range attack or throwing consumable. Lure one of the chariots away from the corpse then ride Torrent, drop down, pick up the loot and run back around to the ladder and climb up to continue.

At the top, you'll notice that there is a Lion Guardian below and a Redmane Soldier in front. Don't go down yet, save that for last, for now, clear the high ground section of the fort. Kill the soldier in front and loot the body that's hanging on a narrow beam to find x2 Warming Stone.

Continue going northeast towards a watchtower where you'll encounter two more Redmane Soldiers and one Redmane Knight inside the watchtower. Clear the section, and on the the right side, by the distressed canopy tent, there is a chest containing x1 Starscourge Heirloom. Next to it is a ghost NPC, you can speak to it to and it will briefly mention Starsourge Radahn. Killing the Redmane Knight wielding a spear inside the watchtower may drop the Partisan weapon - you don't need to climb the ladder for now since you'll only find a waygate teleporter.

Go back to the wooden stairs and you can jump across from the right side to reach the other end. Check around the scaffolding to find another body next to a pile of sacks to find x10 Mushroom, looted off the corpse. Go back, check the southwest side and pull the lever to unlock the gate.

Now, time to get rid of the Lion Guardian. Instead of jumping straight down to the Lion, if you look down to the northeast, you'll see there's a high platform with a doorway that you can jump down onto, enter the room here to find a chest with a Katar. If you are playing a ranged build, you can stay on this platform, summon your ash spirit, and attack the Lion, while your spirit will run down and melee it. If you are pure melee, you have no choice but drop down and face it directly. Defeating this enemy rewards you with Runes and the Ash of War: Lion's Claw. Near the gate, there is another body that you can loot to find x1 Rune Arc - this area is now clear, go back to the watchtower and use the waygate teleporter to travel to the next location, Redmane Castle.

title: Ash of War: Lion's Claw
text: Kill the Elder Lion at the bottom for Ash of War: Lion's Claw, then grab the Rune Arc by the entrance.
Ash of War: Lion's Claw: Drops from the Lion Guardian in Fort Gael upon defeating it.
Rune Arc: Consumable. Looted off a corpse next to the locked gate of Fort Gael .

title: Flame, Grant me Strength
text: In the area behind the fort, you'll find Flame, Grant Me Strength and Smoldering Butterfly x6 (by the fire).
Flame, Grant me Strength: Found behind Fort Gael , on a body between two Maneuverable Flamethrowers

title: Ash of War: Lifesteal Fist
text: From the fire, head north-northeast down a root in the cliff, then go straight northeast down a slope to find a Somber Smithing Stone [4].
Travel to Smoldering Wall and head southwest toward a campsite with Slumbering Egg x2.
Follow the road past the grace until you see a scarab on the left and kill it for Ash of War: Lifesteal Fist.
Ash of War: Lifesteal Fist: Ash of War Upgrade. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab near the Caelid Highway.

title: Talk to Wandering Merchant Caelid Highway North
text: Grab the Astray from Caelid Highway North grace on the hillside with the scarab, near a sword monument.
East of the grace, you'll find the Nomadic Merchant (North Caelid).
Wandering Merchant Caelid Highway North: Nomadic Merchant. General Goods vendor found sitting by a campfire east of the Astray from Caelid Highway North Site of Grace.

title: Pillory Shield
text: From the grace, head west into the rot swamp to discover the entrance to Gaol Cave:
Unlock the imp seal, then grab the Gaol Cave grace and open the chest for a Rune Arc.
Rune Arc: Consumable. Found in a chest inside the Gaol Cave , next to the Site of Grace.
Pick up a Golden Rune [2] from the first room.
Continue until the floor collapses, then proceed the only way forward until you find a Golden Rune [4] and Turtle Neck Meat x2 guarded by rats.
In the guard room at the end, you'll find a Golden Rune [5], Somber Smithing Stone [5], shortcut door, and a lever that unlocks all jail cells.
Somber Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. 1x Found as a treasure inside a chest in a cell within Gaol Cave.
After unlocking all cells, loot the Old Fang x5 and Pillory Shield from a cell next to the shortcut door.
Pillory Shield: Small Shield. Found inside Gaol Cave .

title: Wakizashi
text: Enter the northeast room and pick up a Golden Rune [2] from the northwest cell.
Drop down the southwest ledge, then grab the Golden Rune [2] in a cell immediately on the right.
Loot the Wakizashi, Stonesword Key, and Golden Rune [4] from a cell on the left.
Wakizashi: Dagger. Found within Gaol Cave

title: Stonesword Key
text: Loot the Wakizashi, Stonesword Key, and Golden Rune [4] from a cell on the left.
Stonesword Key: Stonesword Key . Found on a corpse on a ledge on the outside of the tower. Accessible via careful platforming.

title: Boss: Frenzied Duelist
text: Enter one of the open cells in the room downhill to pick up a Rainbow Stone and Golden Rune [4].
Hit the planks in the room, drop to the bottom, and kill the Frenzied Duelist for Putrid Corpse Ashes and 6,700 runes.
Frenzied Duelist: Boss of Gaol Cave in Caelid. Drops Putrid Corpse Ashes .
Putrid Corpse Ashes: Spirit Ash. Dropped by the boss of Gaol Cave : Frenzied Duelist

place.title: Gaol Cave
walk: Quick walkthrough:
Proceed through the cave until you come to a lever. Pulling the lever will unlock the cells throughout the cave.
Proceed further in, and you will come to a hidden area (behind breakable wooden boards). The boss is at the bottom of a pit behind these boards.
After defeating the boss, DO NOT take the shortcut right away; instead proceed through the tunnel opening on the South-West side of the boss arena to obtain the Regalia of Eochaid sword.

title: Regalia of Eochaid
text: Go through the tunnel past the boss to pick up the Regalia of Eochaid, then turn south for Glowstone x3.
Regalia of Eochaid: Straight Sword. Accessed by dropping down to this area after progressing through Gaol Cave

title: Meteoric Ore Blade
text: Travel to Astray from Caelid Highway North and head southwest toward Caelid Waypoint Ruins:
Pick up Great Dragonfly Head x5 from a corpse guarded by dogs in one of the ruined buildings.
Next to the dead tree in the middle is a corpse with Rot Grease x3.
At the end of the cliff, south of the tree, sits a corpse with Poisonbloom x4.
Poisonbloom: Crafting Material. 4x found on a corpse sitting at the end of the cliffs.
Enter the cellar in the lower part of the ruins to grab the Meteoric Ore Blade.

Meteoric Ore Blade: Katana. Found inside a chest in a small room at the back of an underground hall filled with sarcophagi and Prawn Miners enemies. The entrance is found in the northwest section of the Caelid Waypoint Ruins .

place.title: Caelid Waypoint Ruins
walk: These ruins are crawling with Prawn Miners and Rotten Strays. A notable location is a set of steps in the northwest leading to an underground hall lined with dozens of sarcophagi and filled with a whole bunch of Prawn Miners. There is a small room at the back of this hall with a chest containing the Meteoric Ore Blade katana.

title: Larval Tear
text: Return to the road and follow it until you notice the Caelid Highway South grace behind a root on the right.
An astrolabe with Starlight Shards sits at the cliff west-southwest of the grace.
Starlight Shards: Can be found in front of a stone chalice monument.
Follow the cliff south-southeast toward a cemetery with 2x Golden Rune [1], Golden Rune [2], and a Golden Rune [5].
Golden Rune [5]: Looted from a corpse in Sellia Hideaway
Kill the enemy with a feathered hat and he'll turn into a Troll Knight that drops a Larval Tear.
Larval Tear: Larval Tear dropped by a Troll disguised as a regular enemy.

title: Talk to Kenneth Haight
text: Kenneth Haight: Kenneth Haight will move to this location after you clear our Fort Haight. He can be found up on the battlements where you fought the Beast Crest Heater Knight .

title: Talk to Blaidd
text: Blaidd: Blaidd's Second Encounter. Darriwil can be fought at the Forlorn Hound Evergaol, where Blaidd will become available as a summon. Speak to Blaidd again after the fight. Talking to Blaidd once will yield a Somber Smithing stone [2]. Talk to him a second time and he will mention a blacksmith along the Road to the Manor in Liurnia, and instruct the player to say that "Blaidd sent them". Doing this will unlock the Carian Filigreed Crest in the blacksmith's shop. If the Evergaol fight was completed before meeting Blaidd, he will still be available to speak to here after the player talks to him in the Mistwood Ruins.

title: Boss: Decaying Ekzykes
text: Return to the road and kill Decaying Ekzykes by the roadside for Dragon Heart and 38,000 runes.
Decaying Ekzykes: Optional Boss. Found guarding the Caelid Highway South.
Dragon Heart: Dropped by Decaying Ekzykes in South Caelid . Dragon Hearts are used to acquire Dragon Communion Incantations at the Church of Dragon Communion and the Cathedral of Dragon Communion .

title: Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook [3]
text: Enter the church behind the dragon and pick up the Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook [3] near the altar.
Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook [3]: Cookbook item found at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion . Looted off a corpse tucked under the dragon's chest.

place.title: Cathedral of Dragon Communion
walk: Miquella's Lily can be found west of site of grace, behind a Banished Knight.

Some players may experience a bug preventing them the use of the altar. If that is the case, you only need to rest in the site of Grace just near the altar, pass time and then go back. Do not fight the knight spawning in the entrance, it seems the altar only works if you haven't performed other action before.

title: Boss: Death Rite Bird (Caelid Southeast)
text: Optional: Examine the altar and buy any dragon communion incantations you need.
Activate the Cathedral of Dragon Communion grace inside the church, then pass time until nightfall.
Kill the Night's Cavalry patrolling the road for Ash of War: Poison Moth Flight and 8,500 runes.
Travel to the Southern Aeonia Swamp Bank and kill the Death Rite Bird east-southeast of the grace for Death's Poker and 15,000 runes.
Death's Poker: Greatsword. Dropped by miniboss Death Rite Bird that appears only at night.
Death Rite Bird: Only spawns at night. Southeast from the Southern Aeonia Swamp Bank site of grace, before Sellia Gateway. It drops the Death's Poker Greatsword

title: Windy Crystal Tear
text: Return to the grace and head south toward a Giant Crow. In the area below it is a basin with the Windy Crystal Tear.
Windy Crystal Tear: The item can be found in Caelid in a pit southeast of the Nomadic Merchant Caelid South . One of the birds watches over it, facing south.

title: Arrow's Sting Talisman
text: From the basin, head south to find Fan Daggers x6 next to a wagon on the road.
Head east-northeast from the wagon to find an Elder Lion on the left; kill it for a Somber Smithing Stone [4], Beast Blood, and Old Fang x2.
Somber Smithing Stone [4]: Upgrade Material. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in the southern edges of Caelid .
Beast Blood: Can be found on a dead body guarded by a Lion Guardian .
Loot the two corpses around the lion for Beast Blood x2 and Beast Blood x3.
Return to the road and follow it downhill to a corpse with Smoldering Butterfly x3 in the middle of a battlefield.
Pick up the Mushroom x6 in a tent past the smoldering fence, then grab the Impassable Greatbridge grace behind a wooden tower.
Mushroom: Can be found on a dead body inside a tent.
Climb the wooden tower to discover a chest with the Arrow's Sting Talisman.
Arrow's Sting Talisman: Found in the chest at the top of the tower next to the Impassable Greatbridge.

title: Ash of War: Cragblade
text: Behind a ledge west of the wooden tower, near a sword monument, you'll find a scarab that drops Ash of War: Cragblade.
Ash of War: Cragblade: Can be found at West of Impassable Greatbridge site, on a scarab in the sword monument

title: Miranda Sprout Ashes
text: Follow the path along the cliff until you reach a scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [4], but kill it fast to avoid the Giant Crow ambush.
Somber Smithing Stone [4]: Upgrade Material. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab.
In the cliffside past the scarab lies the entrance to Caelid Catacombs:
Head inside and activate the Caelid Catacombs grace.
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [4] in the first corridor, then a Grave Glovewort [3] in the corner past it.
Hit the illusory wall below the stairs in the next room to reveal 2x Grave Glovewort [5] and the Miranda Sprout Ashes.
Miranda Sprout Ashes: Spirit Ashes. Found behind a hidden wall in Caelid Catacombs . You must attack a wall to the right of the staircase to reveal a path to the ashes.

Grave Glovewort [5]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 2 can be found inside the Caelid Catacombs : Continue along the dungeon until you reach a room with a small set of stairs on the left. Check under the stairs and hit the walls to reveal an alcove with 2 of the gloveworts.

place.title: Caelid Catacombs
walk: The catacombs are very straightforward, without any forks. All you'll need is some way to deal with Scarlet Rot and perhaps some fire or frostbite damage to deal with the Rotten Giant Miranda Sprout.
Two secret areas hidden by walls to be on the lookout for:

After descending the staircase that leads onto a swamp, turn to the right, go under the platform where the Archer Skeleton was, and hit the wall on the right corner. There is a Miranda flower enemy there, as well as the Miranda Sprout Ashes and 2x Grave Glovewort [5].
At the end of the dungeon, there will be a locked door. Once you see it, turn 180 and then attack the wall on the column in the middle of the previous room to reveal a switch.

Heading down the stairs away from the Site of Grace, follow the hallway right into a small room covered in Scarlet Rot. Before you enter, be sure to grab the Grave Violet on the left of the hallway. Once you do actually enter, (3) ">Miranda Sprouts will spawn. Take them out while avoiding the buildup of Rot on yourself. Be sure NOT to roll in the sludge on the ground as it will cause the Rot-meter to continue rising, even after leaving the liquid. Sticking to the dry patches on the sides of this room will allow for easier traversal. Here to loot, there is a Grave Glovewort [4], some Root Resin, and whatever drops may come from the killed Sprouts.

Once ready, continue northeast into the hallway. Take caution when approaching the next turn left, as a Heavy Skeletal Swordsman is waiting around the corner to ambush you. Kill it and dispense with its remains before grabbing the Grave Glovewort [3] in the corner here. Head northwest down the stairs and loot the Grave Violet on the left side of the corridor. In this next room, you are faced with a bit of a conundrum. On the platform the hallway lets you out on, a Skeletal Archer will spawn, but only after you go further down the stairs to the left and enter the swampy area below. Doing this however will also trigger the Giant Miranda Sprout that is waiting for you around the corner to the right. My best advice is to watch the platform while going down the stairs until you see the Skeleton forming, then rushing back up the stairs to deal with it. With any luck, this will then cause the Sprout to come around the corner, allowing you to more safely fight it from the stairs without incurring the Scarlet Rot penalty.

As you have probably seen, there is a Grave Glovewort [3] to loot at the bottom of the stairs. Before continuing on, there is a Illusory Wall here found under the platform the Archer was standing on. Turning directly around from the looted Glovewort, keep left of the stairs on the ground floor until you come to the last section of the wall on the right. Hit it in some way to reveal its illusory nature as well as hopefully injure the Miranda Sprout hiding on the other side. Be careful as exploring this small area will cause 3 more Miranda Sprouts to spawn. Within the hidden area, you are able to find 2x Grave Glovewort [5] and the Miranda Sprout Ashes. At this point, one may want to take a small break on the stairs to allow their Scarlet Rot meter to deplete. When ready to continue, head northeast from the bottom of the stairs to the hallway, being sure to grab the Ghost Glovewort [3] and Ghost Glovewort [4] to the right of the hall's entrance.
The Ghost Glovewort [3] and Ghost Glovewort [4] can be found behind the Giant Miranda Sprout, lure it away or kill it and grab them.

Follow the hall northeast and loot the Grave Glovewort [4] within the sludge of the next room next to the central pillar. Keeping to the right, make your way around the central column while being sure to avoid the Scarlet Rot trap that can be triggered by stepping on the rotten debris. In the eastern corner, you can find another Grave Glovewort [4]. Going into the next hall, still heading northeast, you should see a locked door. Turn immediately around and attack the wall of the central column in the previous room that you are now facing. This should reveal a lever which you can pull to open the locked door. This door leads directly into the final boss of this mini-dungeon. The room directly preceding the now-open door contains Root Resin to pick up.

Your final boss through the fog gates is the Cemetery Shade, which can be back stabbed and when cleared gives you Kindred of Rot Ashes. This fight can be challenging as the Shade's ranged attack can paralyze you, leaving you open to its stunlock combo. Summoning of Spirit Ashes is highly encouraged, as the shade is truly only strong against one target at a time.

title: Boss: Cemetery Shade (Caelid Catacombs)
text: Loot the Grave Glovewort [3], Ghost Glovewort [3], and Ghost Glovewort [4] in the room.

Ghost Glovewort [3]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One can be found inside the Caelid Catacombs . Continue along the dungeon until you reach a room with a small set of stairs on the left. The glovewort can be found further down after turning the corner, just before the next corridor.

Ghost Glovewort [4]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One can be found inside the Caelid Catacombs . Continue along the dungeon until you reach a room with a small set of stairs on the left. The glovewort can be found further down after turning the corner, just before the next corridor.
Pick up the 2x Grave Glovewort [4] in the final room, and hit the illusory wall behind the pillar in the middle to reveal the boss lever.
Kill the Cemetery Shade for Kindred of Rot Ashes and 6,800 runes.
Kindred of Rot Ashes: Spirit Ashes. Dropped by the Cemetery Shade in the Caelid Catacombs .
Cemetery Shade: Boss found inside the Caelid Catacombs . Drops the Kindred of Rot Ashes upon defeat.

title: Invader: Millicent
text: Travel to Inner Aeonia and head southwest past an island with a root to be invaded by Millicent. Defeat her to obtain Sacramental Bud x5, Golden Rune [3], Golden Rune [5], and a Golden Rune [10].
Millicent: Found in the South-East of the Swamp of Aeonia near the geysers. NPC drop: Sacremental Bud, Golden Rune [3], Golden Rune [5], Golden Rune [10]
Sacramental Bud: Many sacramental buds can be found within the Church of the Plague
Golden Rune [3]: Looted from a corpse in Sellia Hideaway , just before the illusory wall
Golden Rune [5]: Looted from a corpse in Sellia Hideaway , at the bottom of a pit.
miss: Must be defeated before you give her the repaired Unalloyed Gold Needle at the Church of the Plague.

title: Boss: Commander O'Neil, Unalloyed Gold Needle
text: Return to the grace and kill Commander O'Neil south-southeast of the grace for Commander's Standard, Unalloyed Gold Needle, and 12,000 runes.
Commander O'Neil: Great Enemy. Drops Commander's Standard and Unalloyed Gold Needle
Commander's Standard: Halberd. Dropped by Commander O'Neil upon defeat.
Unalloyed Gold Needle: Key Quest Item. Required to progress Gowry 's questline. Dropped by Commander O'Neil upon defeat.

guide.title: Travel to Sellia, Town of Sorcery
text: To the east of the Swamp is Sellia, Town of Sorcery. This is an important location with many items to pick up. Notably, you will meet Gowry at his shack just north of Sellia Gateway, who will task you with defeating Commander O'Neil in the swamp to obtain the Unalloyed Gold Needle. Return it to him, and then head further northeast to the Church of the Plague to meet Millicent. Follow the steps outlined in her questline to obtain Prosthesis-Wearer Heirloom and then exhaust her dialogue to move her to Altus Plateau. Make sure to loot the Sacred Tear in the area, then head into Sellia proper.

From the Southern Aeonia Swamp Bank grace site, make your way north past Sellia Gateway. Note that along the way, there will be a troll atop a high cliff to the east that will throw projectiles at you, keep moving until you past the gate to avoid getting hit.

Beyond the gate, you should see a shack on the east side of the road, but along the path to the shack, there's a docile Giant Dog sitting there watching the roads. Don't disturb it and go around it, unless you plan on killing it, because if you run towards the shack with it chasing you, there's a chance it may kill Gowry, a very important NPC in this questline.

Speak with Gowry in his shack and he will ask for a favor. He wants help to heal a young girl, Millicent, found beyond Sellia, who has the Scarlot Rot. To do this he will ask you to seek an Unalloyed Gold Needle dropped by Commander O'Neil located in the deep scarlet Swamp of Aeonia, outside Sellia's bounds. In return, he will share the secrets of the town of Sellia.
Teleport to the Aeonia Swamp Shore grace site, and head northeast towards the brambles in the swamp.

You may get invaded by Millicent along the way, so be careful and not fight her in the swamp, as you will be at a disadvantage due to the rot. Either find a safe ground and lure her in on safe grounds, or have some Preserving Boluses handy.
Be aware that there's a Cleanrot Knight that patrols the area and may attack you.
You can summon your Spirit Ash here as the fight is not instanced.
The ground around the boss can cause rot buildup, so be vigilant.
After beating the commander, make sure to discover the Heart of Aeonia grace site before continuing. Return to Gowry and give him the Unalloyed Gold Needle.
Warp to a nearby point or quit the game then reload and return and he'll give you the repaired needle.

Light the beacons in Sellia, according to the secret Gowry gave you, to open the way to the church. Three need to be lit and this will also unlock treasure chests behind each barrier with the final barrier allowing access to a double boss fight.

Follow the Sellia, Town of Sorcery walkthrough. After that, discover the Chair-Crypt of Sellia site of grace, then warp back to the Sellia Under-Stair grace site, run up the staircases, then head northeast, up the giant staircases where you got the Golden Seed, and go through the gate and discover the Sellia Backstreets grace site. From here, follow the road east then south to the Church of the Plague.

After Millicent uses the needle, rest at the nearby site of grace, then exhaust her dialog. She will gift you the Prosthesis-Wearer Heirloom. Rest again/ quit and reload at the site of grace to move her to Gowry's shack.
Return to Gowry's shack to find him gone, but Millicent is there. Exhaust her dialog. Quit/ reload at the shack, this will move Millicent and have Gowry return. You can now purchase spells from him.

Millicent now will be located just north of the Erdtree-Gazing Hill Grace in Altus Plateau. The player can give her the Valkyrie's Prosthesis item to advance her questline after exhausting her dialogue.
The rest of the questline for Millicent is located in another region. To continue reading about Millicent's questline, please check or Millicent page.

title: Talk to Gowry, Sellia's Secret
text: Optional: Polyanna's summon sign can be found at the entrance near the grace.
Make sure to grab the Heart of Aeonia grace once the boss is dead.
Travel to Southern Aeonia Swamp Bank and follow the road to a Golden Rune [2], Golden Rune [5], and a corpse with Glass Shard x5 farther ahead.
Golden Rune [2]: Found at the sarcophagi located at South-West Caelid .
Golden Rune [5]: Found at the sarcophagi located at South-West Caelid .
Talk to Gowry in the shack past the gate. Hear his request, then talk to him to receive Sellia's Secret. Reload the area to get the Unalloyed Gold Needle back.
Gowry: Quest NPC. A once great Sage living in isolation. Found inside his shack near Sellia, Town of Sorcery .

place.title: Gowry's Shack
walk: Beware of the Giant Dog found a short distance before the shack. Aggroing this dog and then speaking to Gowry may cause it to kill him.

In this location, speak to Gowry, a great sage to begin his questline involving Millicent. In exchange for yourself you can obtain Sellia's Secret. After further progressing through this questionline, the sage will want to pass on some sorcery knowledge by giving you access to some of his spells.
Night Maiden's Mist
Glintstone Stars
Night Shard
Additional Spells such as Pest Threads may also be available here after progressing through Millicent's questline.

title: Redmane Painting
text: Follow the road near Gowry's shack until you see a red painting beneath a balcony on the right. Examine it to receive the "Redmane" Painting.
Redmane Painting: Key Info Item. Found as a large painting under some rubble near the center of town.

title: Rotten Stray Ashes
text: Jump over the railing west of the painting to find Poisonbloom x5 on a rooftop below.
Poisonbloom: Can be found at Sellia, Town of Sorcery , on the roof of a building on the lower leve. Accessible by jumping across the rooftops.
Head around the outskirts of the town to discover the Sellia Under-Stair grace by a staircase.
In a ruined building north-northwest of the grace is a corpse with Rotten Stray Ashes.
Rotten Stray Ashes: Found on a body within a broken building, there is a Rotten Stray nearby.

title: Rock Blaster
text: Travel to Sellia Crystal Tunnel and go up the ladder:
Loot a Golden Rune [5] in the hut straight ahead, then the 3x Smithing Stone [5] around it.
Golden Rune [5]: Golden Rune (5) held by a corpse on top of a broken column on the path East of Sellia Gateway .

Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. A total of 8 can be found inside the Sellia Crystal Tunnel : The first one is found behind the storage shed on the bottom level of the main cavern. The second stone is found on the slope next to the storage shed at the bottom of the main cavern. The third stone is found on the same slope. Continue heading up the slope all the way to the top. The fourth stone is found in the deep indent on the western wall. Jump on top of the central shed in the main cavern and then onto the wooden platform in the east to hop over the barricade blocking a tunnel. Go through the tunnel and pick up the fifth stone on the left. Continuing on from the previous stone, head up the ladder in the next room and head north to find the sixth stone in the cavity in the wall. The seventh stone is found in the same wall cavity. In the same area, climb up the ladder on the side of the shed and continue along the tunnel ahead to find a cavern with a raised wooden platform. Head up to the platform and check the left wall for the final stone.
On top of the hut is a corpse with Glintstone Scrap x6.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [5] and Rune Arc at the top of the room.
Jump onto the middle hut, then across to a wooden beam with Cuckoo Glintstone x5.
Grab a Smithing Stone [5] from the area below the wooden beam, then climb the ladder ahead for a Somber Smithing Stone [4].

Somber Smithing Stone [4]: Upgrade Material. A total of 3 can be found inside the Sellia Crystal Tunnel : In the main chamber, head up the slope until you are able to jump on the roof of the central storage shed. Jump onto the wooden platform in the east and hop over the barricade blocking the tunnel. Go through the tunnel until you end up in a room with a ladder and wooden walkways above. The stone is found on a body on one of the walkways. Continue to the cavern in the north and climb up the ladder on the side of the shed in front of you. Check the cavity in the wall to the right of the entrance to the next tunnel for the second stone. Continue into the tunnel and check the hollow on the left in the next cavern to find the final stone.
Cross the planks to an area with 2x Smithing Stone [5] and a chest containing Rock Blaster.
Rock Blaster: Glintstone Sorcery . Found inside the Sellia Crystal Tunnel , in a chest inside a shed at the top level of the main cavern.

title: Faithful's Canvas Talisman
text: Climb the ladder next to the hut for a Golden Rune [4] and kick down the shortcut ladder next to the corpse.
On a wall near the ladder is a Somber Smithing Stone [4].
Somber Smithing Stone [4]: Looted from a corpse in Sellia Hideaway , in the middle of a small tunnel leading to the top
Continue to a corpse with a Dragonwound Grease, then pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [4] in the room left of it.
Dragonwound Grease: Weapon Coating. Found on a corpse inside the Abandoned Cave .
Somber Smithing Stone [4] A: Found on a body in the swamp next to a Cleanrot Knight
Pick up the Smithing Stone [5] and Faithful's Canvas Talisman on the wooden platform.
Faithful's Canvas Talisman: Located on a corpse guarded by two Prawn Miner inside Sellia Crystal Tunnel

title: Boss: Fallingstar Beast
text: Kill the Fallingstar Beast for Somber Smithing Stone [6], Smithing Stone [7] x5, Gravity Stone Chunk x10, Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [1], and 7,600 runes.
Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [1]: Key Item. Dropped by the Fallingstar Beast at the end of the Sellia Crystal Tunnel upon defeat.

Fallingstar Beast: Optional Boss found at the end of the Sellia Crystal Tunnel . Drops the Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing (1) as well as 1 x Somber Smithing Stone (6) , 5 x Smithing Stone (7) and 4x Gravity Stone Chunk upon defeat.
Somber Smithing Stone [6]: Upgrade Material. One is acquired by defeating the Fallingstar Beast at the end of the Sellia Crystal Tunnel .
Smithing Stone [7]: Upgrade Material. 5 stones are acquired by defeating the Fallingstar Beast at the end of the Sellia Crystal Tunnel .

title: Cerulean Tear Scarab
text: Travel to Sellia Under-Stair, go up the stairs, then turn left toward a large staircase. Jump to the root halfway up and pick up Cerulean Tear Scarab from the nearest rooftop.
Cerulean Tear Scarab: Helmet. Found on a corpse on the roof of a building. Accessible by jumping across the rooftops.

title: Stonesword Key
text: Climb the tower farther south and light the brazier at the top (1/3).
On a lower rooftop northwest of the brazier is a corpse with Toxic Mushroom x5.
Toxic Mushroom: Can be found at Sellia, Town of Sorcery on a body on the rooftops.
Pick up a Stonesword Key on top of an archway between two rooftops.
Stonesword Key: On top of a large rock with bodies and chairs on top.

title: Ash of War: Double Slash
text: Light the brazier at the top of the tower near the archway (2/3).
Kill the teleporting scarab north of the tower to obtain Ash of War: Double Slash.
Ash of War: Double Slash: Ash of War. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab found high up on a very large root. Accessible by jumping across the rooftops.

title: Golden Seed
text: Return to the large staircase and pick up the Golden Seed at the top.
Golden Seed: Flask Upgrade Material. Found under a Phantom Tree at the top of the large stairs in the northern section of town.

title: Staff of Loss, Spelldrake Talisman +1
text: Climb the tower near the golden tree and light the final brazier to unlock all sealed barriers (3/3).
Pick up the Staff of Loss from a balcony near the tower, then open the chest below it for the Spelldrake Talisman +1.
Staff of Loss: Glintstone Staff. Found on a corpse leaning over a building's balcony. Accessible by jumping across the rooftops.

Spelldrake Talisman +1: Upgraded Talisman. Found in a chest in a small room the northwest section of town. Right below where the Staff of Loss is obtained. This room is initially sealed by a barrier that can be dispelled by lighting a brazier atop a tower in the southwest of town.

title: Night Comet
text: At the top of the stairs near the grace, you'll find a chest with Night Comet.

Night Comet: Night Sorcery spell. Found in a chest in the central section of town. This location is initially sealed by a barrier that can be dispelled by lighting a brazier atop a tower in the southwest of town.

place.title: Sellia, Town of Sorcery
walk: Sellia, Town of Sorcery is a massive ghost town on the eastern side of Caelid. These ruins are chock-full of collectibles to find. However, exploring this location can be quite perilous as it is filled with Ghostly versions of Noble Sorcerers, Raya Lucaria Sorcerers, Twinsage Sorcerers and Raya Lucarian Wardens. While they use mostly the same attacks and boast the same behaviors as their physical counterparts, the thing that sets them apart is that they are invisible until you are near them, which prevents you from targeting them until they are seen. Furthermore, they can fire their spell projectiles while remaining invisible. Some of them can even teleport away from you. It is highly recommended that you call on a Spirit Summon while exploring. Your summons can detect invisible enemies and will usually rush towards them and draw their fire.

There are several small rooms on the outsides of the buildings here that are initially sealed by a barrier which can be dispelled by lighting a brazier on a tower. There are three such braziers in this town and your first priority should be to find them. Make a bee-line straight for a very large staircase in the northeast section of town. Halfway through the staircase, you can find a large root jutting out and extending to one of the buildings to the right. This is the easiest way to get onto the rooftops where several collectibles can also be found. You will be jumping from building to building and occasionally some roots to navigate the rooftops. Remember that you can always summon Torrent for his double jump capability should you find the platforming too difficult.
## First & Second Braziers

From the first building connected to the staircase root, get onto the next building in the west using another root extending towards it. Now jump onto the building to the south, you should be able to land the corner of the roof. Look at the building southwest from here and take out the Marionette Soldier sitting on the roof and then jump onto the lower roof of that building. You can get to the higher roof via the root wrapping around the west side of it. Continue on south and jump on the branch of the gigantic root you see ahead of you. Watch out for a Marionette Gargoyle swooping in from the left. Look at the western end of the gigantic root to find a Teardrop Scarab which drops the Ash of War: Double Slash. Now follow the gigantic root east and up on a building and then turn to the south and jump over another root to land on the roof of a long building. Follow the roof west to find a corpse sitting on a ledge. You can loot a Stonesword Key off this corpse. Continue west and you should be on a roof with a ladder leading up to the southwest brazier. Light it up to unlock several barriers in town.

Go back down and across through the long building and climb up the gigantic root here. Follow it northeast to get to another tower with another brazier. This unlocks a barrier at the top of the staircase from earlier. Go around the tower and jump down the roof of the building to the north. Follow this long stretch of roofs to the building at the end which has a corpse on top from which you can loot the Cerulean Tear Scarab helm.
## Third Brazier

Now you can drop down to the ground level and go through the central alleyway. Look to your right to find a large red painting under some rubble. Inspecting it gives you the Redmane Painting. Continue north through the alley and look to your right for a formerly sealed room with a chest containing the Night Comet spell. At the end of the street, just before the large staircase, head southeast up the other stairs here, make the first left and then on the left will be another formerly sealed room with a chest that contains an Imbued Sword Key. Now head back to the large staircase from earlier and follow it all the way up to find a Phantom Tree with a Golden Seed underneath. From the tree, face the southwestern edge of the platform and drop down onto the root below. Follow the root and jump onto the building on your right using the mutated growth as a stepping stone. There should be another ladder here that leads to the third brazier. Lighting it unlocks the boss door in the northwest but before you head there, get back onto the root and stand at the very end of it to jump on the building to the south. Drop down onto the balcony on the right to loot the corpse for a Staff of Loss. Check the room directly under this balcony for a chest containing the Spelldrake Talisman +1. If you head down the steps west of here and follow the walls north, you can find a dilapidated building with some Rotten Strays nearby. There is a corpse with the Rotten Stray Ashes in here.

That covers all the notable loot in the town proper. There are other things to find in the area, but they are mostly consumables/crafting materials. Check our Guide for this town to get a better sense of where everything is located.
When ready, go back up the steps and proceed to the northwest, past the giant staircases, through a very tall stone arch to find the boss door.
## Boss: Nox Swordstress & Nox Priest

This is a Duo Boss fight. There is nothing too notable about these bosses. Using a decently leveled summon will make this quite the trivial encounter. The Swordstress uses a sword with a whip-like function to attack at medium range while the Priest uses spells from afar. Both are highly susceptible to magic damage and are easily staggered out of any combos they can potentially perform. Upon defeating the duo, you are awarded the Nox Flowing Sword which is the same sword the Swordstress uses. Check the building to the north of their chamber for a chest that contains Lusat's Glintstone Staff which is the weapon that the Priest was using.
After defeating the bosses, head back to the large staircase and through the previously sealed archway to find the Sellia Backstreets Site of Grace.

title: Imbued Sword Key
text: Just east of the stairs is another staircase with Poison Grease x2 at the top.
Poison Grease: Weapon Coating. 2x found on a corpse under a dead tree in the eastern section of town.
Destroy the wagon left of the staircase to uncover a path to a chest with an Imbued Sword Key in the back of the town.

Imbued Sword Key: Key Item used to activate a Waygate at The Four Belfries . Found in a chest in the northeast section of town. This location is initially sealed by a barrier that can be dispelled by lighting a brazier atop a tower in the southwest of town.

title: Boss: Nox Swordstress & Nox Priest
text: Return to the large staircase, head northwest toward a tall doorway, and kill the Nox Swordstress & Nox Monk for Nox Flowing Sword and 6,400 runes.

Nox Swordstress & Nox Priest: Duo Boss fight. The entrance to their chamber is initially sealed by a barrier which can be dispelled by lighting a brazier atop a tower in the northwest section of town. Drops Nox Flowing Sword upon defeat.
Nox Flowing Sword: Curved Sword. Dropped by the Nox Swordstress & Nox Priest bosses upon defeat.

title: Lusat's Glintstone Staff
text: Activate the Chair-Crypt of Sellia grace after the fight, and loot the chest in the back for Lusat's Glintstone Staff.
Lusat's Glintstone Staff: Glintstone Staff. Found in a chest in the building north of the Nox Swordstress & Nox Priest bosses' chamber after defeating them.

title: Sacred Tear
text: Go through the doorway at the top of the large staircase to discover the Sellia Backstreets grace.
Head up the slope until you reach a church. Grab the Church of the Plague grace and the Sacred Tear in front of the statue.
Sacred Tear: Flask Upgrade Material. Found on the ground in front of the altar at the Church of the Plague .

place.title: Church of the Plague
walk: The only thing of note at this church is the Sacred Tear found in front of the Statue of Marika.

title: Prosthesis-Wearer Heirloom, Talk to Millicent
text: Talk to Millicent and give her the repaired needle. Reload the area, then talk to her to receive the Prosthesis-Wearer Heirloom.
Prosthesis-Wearer Heirloom: Finish the sidequest given by Gowry in Caelid, then return to Millicent to receive the talisman.
Millicent: Millicent can be found in the Church of the Plague slumped against a wall.

title: Eternal Darkness
text: Note: She won't invade anymore after you give her the needle, so make sure you've dealt with her invasion first.
Exit the church and head down the west slope while tightly hugging the wall on the left until you reach the edge. On a ledge below is a corpse with Drawstring Poison Grease x3.
Optional: Return to the path and kill the five Operatic Bats around the area for 5x Golden Rune [9] (first time).
Pick up a Golden Rune [5] from the fallen pillar.
Follow the path toward the top of a large gate and pick up the Black-Key Bolt x20 and Golden Rune [4] on it.

Golden Rune [4]: Two Golden Runes (4) within Sellia Gateway . First one is on top of the gateway, held by a dead body inside one of the towers. The second one is at ground level, on the path to Church of the Plague , on a broken pillar.
Head toward the lookout tower past the gate and pick up Eternal Darkness from the cell inside, guarded by a Bloodhound Knight.
Eternal Darkness: Night Sorcery . Found in a jail cell inside the Swamp Lookout Tower .

place.title: Swamp Lookout Tower
walk: In order to reach this tower, you will first need to unlock the sealed doorway the very back of Sellia, Town of Sorcery by lighting all three tower braziers. Once this is achieved, you can follow the Sellia Backstreets towards the hills east of the town where many graveyards and the Church of the Plague can be found. Continue along south on these hills until you reach the Sellia Gateway. You can cross through the upper portion of the gateway towards the western hill where the tower can be found.
At the tower, you can find the Eternal Darkness spell on a corpse inside the jail cell. Beware as you approach the tower as there is a Lesser Bloodhound Knight waiting to ambush you.

title: Reed Great Katana
text: Return to Church of the Plague and head east-northeast toward an astrolabe with Starlight Shards by the cliff.
Use the spiritspring north of the church while facing west, and loot the 2x Smithing Stone [7], Stonesword Key, and Smithing Stone [8] on top of the large rock.
Smithing Stone [8]: Found on a dead body over a rock near the cliff.
Head toward the fort east of the rock and grab the Fort Faroth grace behind the smoldering wall.
Optional: Kill the Operatic Bat on a lower ledge behind the fort for a Golden Rune [9] (first time).
Return to the grace and enter Fort Faroth:
Optional: Kill the three Operatic Bats for 3x Golden Rune [9] (first time), or simply run past them and head straight for the ladder.
Climb the ladder and open the chest at the top to obtain Dectus Medallion (Right).
Drop to the rooftop below, then turn right to find a corpse with Neutralizing Boluses x2 behind some breakable crates.
Descend the ladder in the hole at the opposite end of the rooftop for a Golden Rune [12].
Golden Rune [12]: Held by a corpse on top of Fort Faroth .
Jump to the nearby upper ledge and descend the ladder at the end to a corpse with Radagon's Soreseal.
Return to the grace and kill Elder Dragon Greyoll by slaying five of the seven juveniles at half HP around her. Once she dies, you'll receive Dragon Heart x5 and 74,290 runes.

Dragon Heart: Key Consumable. 5 Hearts are dropped by Elder Dragon Greyoll upon her defeat. Dragon Hearts are used to acquire Dragon Communion Incantations at the Church of Dragon Communion and the Cathedral of Dragon Communion .
Note: Hit Greyoll's left hind leg with a weapon that inflicts blood loss for an easier, but lengthier fight.
If you own the Tarnished Pack DLC, climb the mountain near Greyoll to find the Reed Great Katana up top.

title: Boss: Battlemage Hugues
text: Head along the cliff edge west of Fort Faroth until you encounter a sleeping dragon. Bait it into attacking the statue just north of it to obtain Smithing Stone [5] x3.
Continue along the cliff edge where you left off to discover Sellia Evergaol, and kill Battlemage Hugues for Battlemage Hugues and 7,800 runes.
Battlemage Hugues: Boss of Sellia Evergaol , drops Battlemage Hugues Ashes

Battlemage Hugues Ashes: Dropped by Battlemage Hugues (boss) located in the Sellia Evergaol. The best way to reach the evergaol is to travel south east along the cliff from the Dragonbarrow West site of grace. It will be on top of a plateau overlooking Aeonia Swamp.

place.title: Sellia Evergaol
walk: Once you enter and approach the light, the boss will appear. He is quite tanky for a mage, and uses sorcery at close and long range. He often casts Great Glintstone Shard, switching to Cannon of Haima at long range. His Gavel of Haima is fairly telegraphed and easy to avoid. His meager defense will mean only a few swings will take him down.

title: Greyoll's Roar
text: Buy Greyoll's Roar at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion, since it is required for all achievements.

title: Talk to Millicent
text: Return to Gowry's Shack to talk to Millicent.
Millicent: She will appear here, after you give her the Unalloyed Gold Needle
Reload the area and tell Gowry that Millicent paid a visit.

place.title: Sellia Gateway
walk: When treading through this gateway, be wary of the many enemies that lurk in the area. There may even be giant projectile jars that come at you from above. This location is reachable once you reach Sellia, Town of Sorcery.
Since there are bodies strewn across the path in this location, loot the bodies to gain Faded Erdleaf Flower, Glass Shard and Golden Rune (2)

title: Ash of War: Flaming Strike
text: Travel to Impassable Greatbridge and head toward the wooden tower past the bridge. Behind it is a Smithing Stone [3].
Smithing Stone [3] A: Upgrade material. Found on a corpse behind the lookout tower outside of Redmane Castle , at ground level.
Go up the slope to the castle, then drop onto the wooden tower for a Smithing Stone [6] on a ledge down a ladder.

Smithing Stone [6] A: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on a ledge in the middle level of the lookout tower outside of Redmane Castle . To reach this item, head for the cliffs to the south of the castle's main gate and then jump onto the tower's roof. There is a ladder you can descend to reach the middle ledge.
From the top of the tower, jump to a lower ledge and follow the cliff to a graveyard with a scarab that drops Ash of War: Flaming Strike.

Ash of War: Flaming Strike: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in graveyard south of Redmane Castle . You can get here through the backdoor of the southern-most building. Alternatively, you can scale the cliffs outside the castle's western ramparts, past some bats to reach the graveyard.

guide.title: The Radahn Festival in Redmane Castle
text: Redmane Castle is a small castle that is heavily guarded at the castle's outskirts by Radahn Knights and Soldiers. The Redmane Castle serves as the gathering point for warriors alike who are wanting to participate in the Radahn Festival.

NOTE: (App ver. 1.02.3) Either collecting both Dectus Medallion halves and taking the Grand Lift of Dectus OR reaching far enough in Ranni's questline, Blaidd will siege the castle and kill almost every enemy and the duo boss. This will make going through the castle easier but doors will be locked leaving you temporarily out of some loot. After defeating Radahn, speak to Blaidd on the battlefield. Then fast travel to the Chamber Outside The Plaza Grace, speak to the Castellan at the chapel, and rest at the Grace several times. This repopulates the castle and unlocks the doors allowing access to previously unavailable loot including the Red-Hot Whetblade.**

Before you go forward make sure you to read up on Ranni the Witch's questline, and complete it up at least up to the point where you received an introduction from Preceptor Seluvis to Sorceress Sellen, take the introduction to the sorceress (at this point she should be at the Waypoint Ruins) and show it to her before continuing with the following below.

The fastest way to reach Redmane Castle is by using the waygate teleporter found on the watchtower of Fort Gael. When you arrive, you'll find yourself outside the fortified outskirts of the castle. If you haven't already, be sure to first head west across the bridge to activate the Impassable Greatbridge shrine. Next to the shrine, there is a watchtower you could climb to gain loot from. Be careful though as at the top of the first ladders, there are 2x Radahn Soldiers wielding spears and a Radahn Knight also wielding a spear at the top of the second ladder. Work your way back east across the bridge, and around the base of watchtower encountered here to find x1 Smithing Stone [3] on a corpse. Continue up the pathway until you encounter the main gate, which is currently closed. Follow around castle to the southwest until you see the same tower we previously went around to loot a smithing stone. Jumping the gap to its roof, you can then climb down two ladders in order to find a corpse that can then be pillaged to acquire x1 Smithing Stone [6]. Climb back up both ladders and jump off the tower towards the cliffs on the southeast to continue (you might want to summon Torrent to make this jump easier).

Along the path of the cliffs, you'll encounter Giant Bat enemies. Keep moving southeast as you reach the top and around the castle where you'll come across a field full of tombstones and a large tree without its leaves. You'll encounter a few enemies here such as more Giant Bats and a Poisonous Bat by the tree, but more importantly, a Teardrop Scarab, hiding between some tombstones on the left. Make sure to quickly kill the Teardrop Scarab to obtain x1 Ash of War: Flaming Strike - make sure to check behind the tree to find x1 Miquella's Lily and x8 Smoldering Butterfly that is looted off a corpse that is sitting against a tombstone.

From here, use the ladder to climb to the top, you don't need to take the stairs since the door at the top is locked and can only be opened from the other side. At the top of the ladder, make a left and simply follow the path of the rooftop section until you reach another ladder on the west that you'll need to climb down. At the bottom, you'll first encounter a Zombie Dog roaming. Kill it and enter the stable-like room on the left where you'll see multiple Commoner enemies resting (most of them will not attack you unless you do). Inside that room, you can loot two corpses to find Armorer's Cookbook [5] and x1 Smithing Stone [5]. Don't forget to unlock the door here to open the shortcut leading back to the open field with tombstones.

Go back outside, turn left and you'll see another arch doorway. Inside that room, there is a single Executioner-looking enemy that wields a crossbow. You can kill it to acquire some Runes but there isn't anything inside and the door here is locked. Use the bricks and rubble to jump over a low part of the wall and down into the clearing below.

Upon landing, look to your left to find a guardhouse. Go up the stairs and check behind the wooden crates to find x1 Golden Rune [6] that is looted off a corpse. Go back down and head east first towards the entrance of the plaza, there are two Lion Guardian enemies at the north section leading to the main gate that we can ignore for now. Midway up the steps, you'll see a waygate teleporter. Walk past it, continue through the courtyard past the wooden stakes and go inside the room on the right to find the Chamber Outside the Plaza Site of Grace. After discovering the site, go back outside and check the west section. Go up the stairs to another rooftop where you can find a corpse sitting against some wooden crates. Loot it to find x1 Smithing Stone [4].

Go back down towards the west part of the castle where you'll see a hangman's gallows. You'll notice that you are on high ground and you can attack the two Lion Guardian enemies below that are roaming around the castle's main gate. Killing both of the enemies rewards you with Runes along with x2 Somber Smithing Stone [4], x2 Beast Blood, x4 Old Fang. Jump down once the area is clear and loot a corpse that's on a pile of dead bodies and skeletons to find x1 Smithing Stone [4].

Check the tree near the gate to find x1 Arteria Leaf and one Skeletal Slime enemy. Most of the buildings here with the doors are locked, so check the area near the south corner to find a glowing Teardrop Scarab, which will refill your flask if needed. If you haven't discovered the Imapssable Greatbridge site, head back to the waygate teleporter that you passed before, and use it to transport yourself past the heavily-guarded great bridge, near the Impassable Greatbridge site - after touching the grace, use the waygate to transport back to the castle's plaza.

From the waygate, head north through the doorway, past the site of grace, and enter the plaza where you'll encounter a few NPCs gathered for the Radahn Festival. You can find NPCs such as Blaidd, Alexander, and a maiden who gives you the Polite Bow Gesture if you talk to her. Now, go north, up the stairs, then towards the right where you'll see a large sculpture of a chalice. There's a body on the left side of it - loot it to find x1 Somber Smithing Stone [5]. When you are ready to start the festival, turn back in the direction you just came from and speak to the crier on the right side of the stairs. A cutscene will trigger.

After the cutscene, run up the stairs opposite the crier and enter the chapel where you can loot a body for x1 Smithing Stone [6]. Leave the chapel via the eastern door, and you'll see a lift. Ride it down and at the bottom, you'll find a waygate teleporter and a Stake of Marika next to it. The waygate teleporter will transport you to the boss arena at Wailing Dunes, where you will fight Starscourge Radahn - we highly suggest checking our Starscourge Radahn page to find more guides and strategies on how to defeat this boss.
After defeating Radahn, you will receive Radahn's Great Rune, visit the Divine Tower of Caelid to restore it.

title: Armorer's Cookbook [5]
text: Pick up the Smoldering Butterfly x8 next to some gravestones, and optionally kill the Operatic Bat for a Golden Rune [9] (first time).
Climb the ladder in the graveyard to enter the castle. Follow the rampart to another ladder and enter the room below to open a shortcut back to the graveyard.
Loot the Smithing Stone [5] and Armorer's Cookbook [5] in the room with the shortcut.
Armorer's Cookbook [5]: Found on a corpse in the southern-most building of Redmane Castle .
Smithing Stone [5] A: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse inside the southern-most building of the castle.

place.title: Redmane Castle
walk: This walkthrough describes how to traverse the castle during the Radahn Festival. There are additional items, including the Red-Hot Whetblade, available when the festival is not taking place.

The fastest way to reach Redmane Castle is by using the waygate teleporter found on the watchtower of Fort Gael Map Coordinates. When you arrive, you'll find yourself outside the fortified outskirts of the castle. Work your way around the cliffs via southwest since the main gate is locked. By the cliffs, you should see a makeshift tower used to store weapons. Climb down two ladders and you'll find a corpse that can be pillaged to acquire x1 Smithing Stone [6]. Climb back up both ladders and continue along the cliffs of the castle.

Along the path of the cliffs, you'll encounter Giant Bat enemies. Keep moving southeast as you reach the top and around the castle where you'll come across a field full of tombstones and large tree without its leaves. You'll encounter a few enemies here such as more Giant Bats and a Poisonous Bat by the tree, but more importantly, a Teardrop Scarab, hiding between some tombstones on the left. Make sure to quickly kill the Teardrop Scarab to obtain x1 Ash of War: Flaming Strike - make sure to check behind the tree to find x1 Miquella's Lily and x8 Smoldering Butterfly that is looted off a corpse that is sitting against a tombstone.

From here, use the ladder to climb to the top, you don't need to take the stairs since the door at the top is locked and can only be opened from the other side. At the top of the ladder, make a left and simply follow the path of the rooftop section until you reach another ladder on the west that you'll need to climb down. At the bottom, you'll first encounter a Zombie Dog roaming. Kill it and enter the stable-like room on the left where you'll see multiple Commoner enemies resting (most of them will not attack you unless you do). Inside that room you can loot two corpses to find x5 Armorer's Cookbook [5] and x1 Smithing Stone [5]. Don't forget to unlock the door here to open the shortcut leading back to the open field with tombstones.

Go back outside, turn left and you'll see another arch doorway. Inside that room, there is a single Page. You can kill it to acquire some Runes but there isn't anything inside and the door here is locked. Use the bricks and rubble to jump over a low part of the wall and down into the clearing below.

Upon landing, look to your left to find a guardhouse. Go up the stairs and check behind the wooden crates to find x1 Golden Rune [6] that is looted off a corpse. Go back down and head east first towards the entrance of the plaza, there are two Lion Guardian enemies at the north section leading to the main gate that we can ignore for now. Midway up the steps, you'll see a waygate teleporter. Walk past it, and continue through the courtyard past the wooden stakes and go inside the room on the right to find the Chamber Outside the Plaza Site of Grace. After discovering the site, go back outside and check the west section. Go up the stairs to another rooftop where you can find a corpse sitting against some wooden crates. Loot it to find x1 Smithing Stone [4].

Go back down towards the west part of the castle where you'll see a hangman's gallows. You'll notice that you are on high ground and you can attack the two Lion Guardian enemies below that are roaming around the castle's main gate. Killing both of the enemies rewards you with Runes along with x2 Somber Smithing Stone [4], x2 Beast Blood, x4 Old Fang. Jump down once the area is clear and loot a corpse that's on a pile of dead bodies and skeletons to find x1 Smithing Stone [4].

Check the tree near the gate to find x1 Arteria Leaf and a one Skeletal Slime enemy. Most of the buildings here with the doors are locked, so check the area near the south corner to find a glowing Teardrop Scarab, which will refill your flask if needed. If you haven't discovered the Imapssable Greatbridge site, head back to the waygate teleporter that you passed before, and use it to transport yourself past the heavily-guarded greatbridge, near the Impassable Greatbridge site Map Coordinates - after touching the grace, use the waygate to transport back to the castle's plaza.

From the waygate, head north through the doorway, past the site of grace, and enter the plaza where you'll encounter the NPCs gathered for the Radahn Festival. Talk to Therolina to get the Polite Bow gesture, then go north, up the stairs, then towards the right where you'll see a large sculpture of a chalice. There's a body on the left side of it - loot it to find x1 Somber Smithing Stone [5]. When you are ready to start the festival, turn back in the direction you just came from and speak to Jerren on the right side of the stairs. A cutscene will trigger.

After the cutscene, run up the stairs opposite the crier and enter the chapel where you can loot a body for x1 Smithing Stone [6]. Leave the chapel via the eastern door, and you'll see a lift. Ride it down and at the bottom you'll find a waygate teleporter and a Stake of Marika next to it. The waygate teleporter will transport you to the boss arena at Wailing Dunes, where you will fight Starscourge Radahn.

title: Armorer's Cookbook [4]
text: Kill the two Elder Lions in the courtyard for 2x Somber Smithing Stone [4], 2x Beast Blood, and 2x Old Fang x2.
Enter the room in the courtyard to pick up Armorer's Cookbook [4] behind a barrel.
Armorer's Cookbook [4]: Found in Redmane Castle , inside the gate house building east of the main gate, behind a large barrel.

title: Flamberge
text: Loot the Smithing Stone [4] from the pile of corpses in the courtyard, then the Golden Rune [6] in a wooden structure.
Smithing Stone [4] A: Upgrade Material. Found on a pile of corpses to the side of the main road, near the main gate.
Golden Rune [6]: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse inside a guardhouse in the castle's inner grounds.
At the top of the stairs past some spiked barricades, turn right for a room with a ladder that leads to the Flamberge and a Smithing Stone [3].
Flamberge: Greatsword found on a corpse on the roof of the building in the southeast of Redmane Castle .
Smithing Stone [3] B: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on the rooftop of the building in the southeast of Redmane Castle .

title: Red-Hot Whetblade
text: Climb a second ladder to find a Smithing Stone [5] at the top of a tower.

Smithing Stone [5] B: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse at the top of southeast tower of the castle, accessible by climbing ladders inside and on the roof of the southeast building it is attached to.
Head back and grab the Chamber Outside the Plaza grace in a room on the right past the barricades and flamespitters.
Go up the staircase west of the flamespitters to find a Smithing Stone [4].
Smithing Stone [4] B: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse in the open space above the building in the center of the castle.
Enter the room near a dead tree to pick up the Red-Hot Whetblade.
Red-Hot Whetblade: Key Item. Found in Redmane Castle , at the bottom level of the gate house building east of the main gate.

title: Boss: Crucible Knight / Misbegotten Warrior
text: Go up the stairs in the room and follow the rampart to a chest with a Smithing Stone [6].

Smithing Stone [6] B: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on the roof of the eastern-most building south of the plaza. This roof can be reached by starting from the eastern gate house building right next to the main entrance. Head up the stairs and then navigate across the ramparts and some wooden bridges among the rooftops.
Return to the grace and kill the Misbegotten Warrior & Crucible Knight for Ruins Greatsword and 16,000 runes.
Ruins Greatsword: Acquired by defeating the Misbegotten Warrior and Crucible Knight duo bosses at Redmane Castle
Crucible Knight / Misbegotten Warrior: Dual Bossfight against Crucible Knight and Misbegotten Warrior .

title: Boss: Misbegotten Warrior
text: Return to the grace and kill the Misbegotten Warrior & Crucible Knight for Ruins Greatsword and 16,000 runes.
Misbegotten Warrior: Duo boss of Unsightly Catacombs - paired with Perfumer Tricia. Defeating them grants the Perfumer Tricia Ashes spirit ashes.

title: Talk to Witch-Hunter Jerren
text: Grab the Redmane Castle Plaza grace after the fight.
Go up the stairs and pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [5] to the left of a large astrolabe.
Somber Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse by the large monument surrounded by chairs in the north of the castle.
You'll now have three ways to initialize the Radahn festival:
Speak with Jerren and Iji:
Talk to Jerren in the throne room; your answer doesn't matter. Then speak to him about Iji.

Witch-Hunter Jerren: Witch-Hunter Jerren is first spoken to in Castle Redmane just north of the Chamber Outside the Plaza Site of Grace . He is found here after the defeat of Starscourge Radahn . If he is not found in this location, he is likey already at his second location in Witchbane Ruins .

title: Talk to Iron Fist Alexander
text: Iron Fist Alexander: He can be found here waiting for the festival to start.

title: Talk to Blaidd
text: Blaidd: NPC, appears awaiting for the festival after you meet him at Siofra River

title: Seluvis's Introduction
text: Talk to Iji about Jerren to initialize the Radahn festival.
Optional: Return to Blaidd and tell him Iji's story.
Consult Seluvis and Sellen:
Provided you spoke to Blaidd in Siofra River, ask Seluvis about Nokron to receive Seluvis's Introduction.
Seluvis's Introduction: A scroll given by Seluvis . It is addressed to Sorceress Sellen

place.title: Seluvis's Rise
walk: When first arriving at the Three Sisters, the entrance to Seluvis's Rise is blocked by a barrier. It is unlocked only after speaking to Ranni the Witch atop Ranni's Rise in the northwest and subsequently being invited by Preceptor Seluvis.
Once invited, you will find Seluvis at the ground floor who hands you Seluvis's Potion and tasks you with finding a woman named Nepheli.
You can climb the ladder behind Seluvis to reach the top floor of his tower where you will find a chest with a Memory Stone inside.

Outside, in a ruin between Ranni's Rise and Renna's Rise, there is an illusory wall / floor on the ground, that can be opened by attacking or rolling on it. This leads to a bunch of frozen characters and a note that says "Seluvis' Puppet. Do not touch". There is another Illusory Wall just to the left of this that reveals what appears to be a puppet of Sorceress Sellen.

title: Polite Bow
text: Talk to Sellen and show her the letter of introduction.
Optional: Return to Blaidd and tell him Sellen's story.
Simply activating a site of grace in Altus Plateau will also initialize the festival.
Travel to Redmane Castle Plaza and the festival should now have started:
Talk to Therolina to learn the Polite Bow gesture.
miss: You must talk to her before speaking to Jerren after killing Radahn.

title: Heartening Cry
text: Optional: Talk to Blaidd and Alexander.
Talk to Jerren and answer "Ready as I'll ever be". Exhaust his dialogue after the cutscene to learn the Heartening Cry gesture.
miss: Must be obtained before killing Radahn. If you accidentally skipped Jerren's dialogue, try the note below.

title: Remembrance of the Starscourge, Boss: Starscourge Radahn
text: Note: If missed, you can repeat the step by quickly traveling to Roundtable Hold and back.
Head through the throne room to find a Smithing Stone [6] next to an altar.
Take the lift down and kill Starscourge Radahn for Radahn's Great Rune, Remembrance of the Starscourge, and 70,000 runes. (This earns an achievement.)
Radahn's Great Rune: Dropped by Starscourge Radahn
Remembrance of the Starscourge: Dropped Starscourge Radahn
Starscourge Radahn: One of the Shardbearers. Drops Remembrance of the Starscourge , Radahn's Great Rune

guide.title: Starscourge Radahn
text: There are a few ways to take down Starscourge Radahn:

You need to gain access to the fight reaching Redmane Castle while the festival is ongoing. This festival comes alive by interacting and completing personal quests of Ranni the Witch and Blaidd the Half-Wolf (up to the part where you speak with Sorceress Sellen who will inform you that you need to defeat Starscourge Radahn to enter Nokron).
Speak with Witch Hunter Jerren and Blacksmith Iji after starting Ranni's questline and initiate the festival in Redmane Castle.

Alternatively, you can explore the Altus Plateau, rest at any nearby Site of Grace, and head to Redmane Castle. You will find the festival is active and you will be able to fight Starscourge Radahn this way. This path isn't highly recommended because of the difficulty of this fight, but this can be done for players who want to take a shortcut or do a speedrun.
## Mohg, Lord of Blood
To take down Mohg, Lord of Blood (not to be confused with Mohg, the Omen), players need to make their way to The Mohgwyn Palace, which can be done in two ways:
Use the Waygate in West Consecrated Snowfield
Follow White Mask Varre's questline until reaching the point where you will be receiving the Pureblood Knight's Medal and use it to travel to the palace.
After defeating Mohg, you will now be able to see Leda and interact with the cocoon. Doing so will let you travel to the Shadow of Realm and play the DLC expansion for Elden Ring.

title: Talk to Iron Fist Alexander
text: Iron Fist Alexander: NPC. Third location on this questline. He can then be summoned for the boss fight against Starscourge Radahn. If he has not been interacted with prior to this, he will show up at the festival anyway and introduce himself. Before moving to his next location, he can be found scavenging at Starscourge Radahn's Site of Grace.

title: Radahn's Spear
text: This is your second of three chances to summon Great Horned Tragoth for the Casual Greeting gesture.
Talk to Blaidd on a dune and grab the Starscourge Radahn grace next to him.
Exhaust Alexander's dialogue near the grace.
Pick up Radahn's Spear x20 from three corpses scattered around the dunes west of the grace.
miss: Becomes unobtainable if Tragoth is not summoned for Magma Wyrm Makar, Starscourge Radahn, or the Draconic Tree Sentinel outside Leyndell. It is also missed if not obtained before killing Tragoth for Patches's Volcano Manor request.

title: Leontiel's Greatsword, Leontiel's Set
text: If you own the Tarnished Pack DLC, head north from the grace until you get invaded by Knight Leontiel. Kill him for Leontiel's Greatsword and Leontiel's Set.

title: Radahn's Lion Armor
text: Return to Jerren in the throne room and exhaust his dialogue.
Buy Radahn's Lion Armor from Enia (for a gesture later).

title: Weathered Dagger
text: Let Fia hold you and select "May I ask a favor?" to receive the Weathered Dagger.
Give the dagger to D, Hunter of the Dead, then reload the area. Talk to Fia in a new room in the east wing and loot D's Bell Bearing and the Twinned Set from D's corpse.
Note: Do not sell any part of the armor, as the entire set is needed for a questline later.
Optional: Collect all non-respawning crafting materials in Caelid.

links.t: Video: non-respawning crafting materials in Caelid

title: Ghostflame Torch
