text: Optional: Speak to Iji about Jerren and select "Talk".
Optional: Talk to Blaidd in Forlorn Hound Evergoal. You can release him, but it won't change the outcome.
Optional: Return to Iji and ask why Blaidd is in the evergaol.
Descend the crater in Limgrave (marked on your map). Before you enter Nokron, pick up a Golden Rune [5] from a ledge, and Soporific Grease x2 below it.
Jump to a tower on the right to reach a rooftop with the Ghostflame Torch.

Ghostflame Torch: Ghostflame Torch can be found on a body at Nokron, Eternal City. To find it, you must start from the beginning of Nokron, Eternal City, entering from the Meteorite Crater. Once you get to the first set of rooves in Nokron, you will see a derelict tower off to the right of the roof ramp. You will need to jump from the ramp to the tower to reach torch. There is no other way to reach the Ghostflame Torch if you proceed to the lower roof platforms of Nokron. There is no way back up except to start over from the Crater again.

guide.title: Nokron, Eternal City and Ranni's Quest
text: After defeating Rahdahn, you will now have access to Nokron, Eternal City. Follow the walkthrough on that page to procure the Fingerslayer Blade along the way. After finishing with Nokron, give Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade to continue with her quest, refer to Ranni the Witch page for more info. After giving her the blade, Renna's Rise will be opened and you can proceed to the next part of this walkthrough.

title: Furlcalling Finger Remedy
text: From the rooftop, drop down north to pick up Burred Bolt x10.
Head right around the corner and up two roofs to find a Rune Arc.
Pick up a Golden Rune [6] in front of the fallen tower, then the Nascent Butterfly x3 at the opposite end.
Golden Rune [6]: Held by a corpse within the structure before reaching the Nokron Site of Grace . On a dead body near a Teardrop Scarab .
Continue to find a corpse with Furlcalling Finger Remedy on a ledge, then grab the Smithing Stone [5] in a corner behind it.
Furlcalling Finger Remedy: Multiplayer Item. Found on a corpse dangling off of the edge of the ruins in Nokron, Eternal City .
Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse slouched over in a corner in the courtyards of Nokron, Eternal City .

title: Ghost-Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [1]
text: Loot the Golden Rune [6], Clarifying White Cured Meat, and Ghost Glovewort [3] in the room below.
Ghost Glovewort [3]: Found on the edge of the cliff, guarded by Fallen Hawks in Nokron, Eternal City
Grab the Nokron, Eternal City grace just past the room.
Pick up Ghost-Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [1] from the gazebo in the courtyard.
Ghost-Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [1]: Found on a corpse lying at the base of a gazebo in Nokron, Eternal City .

title: Greatshield Soldier Ashes
text: Between the buildings northeast of the gazebo, you'll find a Somber Smithing Stone [4].
Somber Smithing Stone [4]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse behind the stone building in Nokron, Eternal City .
In the garden southeast of the gazebo, pick up 2x Ghost Glovewort [3], Greatshield Soldier Ashes, and a Smithing Stone [5].
Greatshield Soldier Ashes: Spirit Ashes. Found on a corpse in a graveyard in Nokron, Eternal City guarded by a Fallen Hawk .
Ghost Glovewort [3]: Two found next to each other in a graveyard in Nokron, Eternal City .
Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse in a graveyard in Nokron, Eternal City .

title: Larval Tear
text: Pick up a Larval Tear from the open building nearby.
Larval Tear: Key Item. Found on a corpse in the middle of a gazebo in Nokron, Eternal City . When first approaching the corpse, slimes will fall from the ceiling.

title: Boss: Mimic Tear, Larval Tear +1
text: In the area southwest of the building, you can find a Ghost Glovewort [3] and a Ghost Glovewort [4]
Ghost Glovewort [3]: Found on the bridge in Nokron, Eternal City .
Ghost Glovewort [4]: Found at the base of a ledge in Nokron, Eternal City with a corpse on it.
Follow the trail of fireflies along the cliff to a Smithing Stone [3] at the opposite end.
Smithing Stone [3]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse sitting at the top of the stone ruins in Siofra River .
Go through the archway in the courtyard and down some stairs to find a Golden Rune [7].
Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [3] and Golden Rune [7] near the cliff edge, then grab a Larval Tear from the gazebo.
Ghost Glovewort [3]: Found in the middle of of a tall ruined wall in Siofra River . A gust of wind can be found at the edge of the cliff closest to the ruin, boosting you up to the top.
Before taking on the boss, turn around to find a Rune Arc against the rocky ledge.
Kill the Mimic Tear for Larval Tear x2, Silver Tear Mask, and 10,000 runes. (This earns an achievement.)
Silver Tear Mask: Dropped by the Mimic Tear Boss when defeated.

Mimic Tear: Found behind a mist door to a temple ruin in Nokron, Eternal City . Initially spawns in as a Silver Tear , then transforms into your character, having the same equipped armor, weapons and spells to fight.
Larval Tear: Key Item. Dropped by Mimic Tear when defeated.
Larval Tear: Key Item. Dropped by a Silver Tear disguised as a large inanimate ball in Night's Sacred Ground .
Larval Tear: Key Item. Found on a corpse inside a stone building in Nokron, Eternal City .

title: Celestial Dew
text: Activate the Mimic Tear grace after defeating the boss.
Kill the scarab on the bridge to obtain a Somber Smithing Stone [5].
Somber Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. Dropped by a Teardrop Beetle on the bridge in Nokron, Eternal City .
On the left side of the bridge, near the scarab, is a Golden Rune [4].
Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [3] in the archway on the bridge, then grab the Dwelling Arrow x8 behind a brazier southeast of it.
Go down the collapsed part of the bridge to pick up a Nascent Butterfly next to two logs.
Light the brazier by the road (1/6).
Follow the road northwest to pick up Gold-Tinged Excrement x5, Ghost Glovewort [4], Golden Rune [4], and Fireproof Dried Liver near a shaman.
Ghost Glovewort [4]: Upgrade Material. Located near one of the Hallowhorn Grounds Altars in Nokron, Eternal City . It can be picked up from the grassy area just at the side of the ruined path.
Light the brazier behind the shaman (2/6).
Go up the slope southwest of the brazier to discover the Ancestral Woods grace.
Jump to the roof below the cliff and make your way down to a corpse with Rejuvenating Boluses on a ledge.
On top of the nearby staircase, you can find a Rune Arc.
Jump to the ledge northwest of the staircase and go around the building to reach a Celestial Dew.
Celestial Dew: Celestial Dew found within Night's Sacred Ground , behind one of the buildings southwest of the Ancestral Woods Site of Grace .

title: Black Whetblade
text: Return to the staircase and jump across the lower roof for a Golden Rune [7] on the other side.
Cross the broken remains of a bridge and drop through a window opening. Grab the Black Whetblade next to an altar.
Black Whetblade: Key Item. Found on a corpse slumped in front of an altar in Night's Sacred Ground .

title: Mimic Tear Ashes
text: Unlock the imp seal in the narrow passage near the altar, and loot the Mimic Tear Ashes and Smithing Stone [3] in the room.
Mimic Tear Ashes: Spirit Ashes. Found in a chest locked behind an imp statue door in Nokron, Eternal City .
Smithing Stone [3]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on a ledge overlooking the water in Nokron, Eternal City .

title: Nox Flowing Hammer
text: Jump through an open window in the passage, then continue through another opening to reach the Nox Flowing Hammer.

Nox Flowing Hammer: From the Night Sacred Ground Site of Grace in Nokron, go up the stairs to your right. You should find yourself in a room with a Nox Monk and a Silver Tear Ball. Slay these enemies, then ascend a ladder to the back right of the room. Go down the path to the right of the Altar to where you see a Gargoyle Fog Wall. Turn right about halfway down the hallway and you should see a Roof Path out a window with a single Tear Slime. Head to the shingled section of the roof to find a single, unbarred window. Jump through that window to find the Nox Flowing Hammer.

title: Fingerslayer Blade
text: Kill the boulder below to obtain a Larval Tear (first time).
Exit the building and grab the Night's Sacred Ground grace at the cliff.
Loot the Celestial Dew, Golden Rune [7], and Soft Cotton x3 guarded by several Silver Tears past the grace.
Celestial Dew: Key Item. Found on a corpse by the side of the road in Night's Sacred Ground
Open the chest underneath the massive throne to obtain the Fingerslayer Blade and a Great Ghost Glovewort.
Fingerslayer Blade: Quest Item. Found in a chest under the massive skeleton statue in Night's Sacred Ground
Great Ghost Glovewort: Quest Item. Found in a chest under the massive skeleton statue in Night's Sacred Ground .

title: Ash of War: Enchanted Shot
text: Return to Ancestral Woods and hug the left wall until you reach a Somber Smithing Stone [5] in a puddle.
Somber Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse near the cliffs in Nokron, Eternal City .
Head up the hill with the wolves to pick up Smithing Stone [4] and Beast Blood x4 from three corpses near a tall spire.
Light the brazier behind the spire (3/6).
Kill the scarab north-northeast of the spire for Ash of War: Enchanted Shot, then light the nearby brazier (4/6).
Ash of War: Enchanted Shot: Dropped by a Teardrop Beetle hiding behind a rock near a brazier in Nokron, Eternal City .

title: Ancestral Infant's Head
text: Jump to the enclosed structure in the water below the cliff. Pick up a Ghost Glovewort [5] and Golden Rune [12] from the ground inside.
Ghost Glovewort [5]: Found in a submerged ruin in Nokron, Eternal City .
Climb the wall of the structure to reach the second half. Loot the chest guarded by a shaman to obtain Ancestral Infant's Head.
Ancestral Infant's Head: Key Item. Found in a chest in a submerged ruin in Nokron, Eternal City . Guarded by an Ancestral Follower .

title: Shining Horned Headband
text: Return to Ancestral Woods and head north-northeast to a small ritual grounds. Pick up Old Fang x4 from a corpse next to the staircase.
Grab the Ghost Glovewort [4] in front of the shaman, then kill her for a Shining Horned Headband (first time).
Ghost Glovewort [4]: Upgrade Material. Located near the Regal Ancestor Spirit Boss from Hallowhorn Grounds in Nokron, Eternal City .

title: Clarifying Horn Charm +1
text: Light the brazier behind the deer-like carcass (5/6).
From the brazier, head east toward the Hallowhorn Grounds and pick up a Ghost Glovewort [4] from the edge.
Ghost Glovewort [4]: Found at the top of the main waterfall. This cliff is one level lower than the highest level of Siofra River .
Next to a pillar down the stairs that lead to the Hallowhorn Grounds, you'll find a corpse with Hefty Beast Bone x5.
East of the staircase lies a campsite with Kukri x8.
From the campsite, follow the cliff edge to the final brazier and light it (6/6).
Next to the spire west-southwest of the brazier is a Smithing Stone [5].
Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse sitting by the edge of the water flowing down the Siofra Aqueduct .
Drop onto the undersection of the bridge near the brazier. At the southwest end is another Smithing Stone [5].
Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse sitting against a column ruin in Nokron, Eternal City .
Head toward the northeast end of the bridge's undersection, then descend the structure below to find a Smithing Stone [2], Celestial Dew, and Clarifying Horn Charm +1.
Clarifying Horn Charm +1: Upgraded Talisman. Found on a corpse in the middle and at the lowest floor of a ruin in Nokron, Eternal City .
Smithing Stone [2]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse slouched at the base of a tree near the large collapsed pillars in Siofra River .
Celestial Dew: Key Item. Found on a corpse in the corner at the very bottom of a ruin in Nokron, Eternal City .

title: Boss: Regal Ancestor Spirit
text: Exit the room and continue along the bridge to grab a Smithing Stone [5] between the pillars at the end.
Smithing Stone [5]: Found on a corpse on the ruined supporting structures of Nokron, Eternal City . It is located a level below the phantom in the bridge ruin.
Touch the horned remains in the Hallowhorn Grounds and kill the Regal Ancestor Spirit for Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor and 24,000 runes. (This earns an achievement.)

Regal Ancestor Spirit: Found behind a mist door in a special area. This area can only be accessed by touching the horned remains in the Hallowhorn Grounds in Nokron, Eternal City after lighting up all the obelisks.
Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor: Dropped by the Regal Ancestor Spirit upon defeat.

title: Mottled Necklace +1
text: Return to the fifth brazier (at the small ritual grounds). Just north of it is a corpse with Hefty Beast Bone x3.
East of the corpse, walk across the stone beams at the top of the Hallowhorn Grounds to reach the Mottled Necklace +1.
Mottled Necklace +1: Upgraded Talisman. Found on a corpse on top of some ruined arches in Nokron, Eternal City .

title: Stonesword Key
text: Head toward the jellyfish north of the stone beams and pick up the Old Fang next to them.
On a ledge below the cliff near the jellyfish, you'll find a Stonesword Key.

Stonesword Key: Key Item. Found on a corpse laying by a ledge overlooking the ruined temple in Nokron, Eternal City with the deer carcass. This ledge is a level lower than the cliff with the spirit jellyfish.

title: Crucible Hornshield
text: Head down the ledge to grab Silver Tear Husk x2 and the Aqueduct-Facing Cliffs grace.
At the end of the cliff, drop onto the aqueduct and kill the Crucible Knight to receive the Crucible Hornshield.
Crucible Hornshield: Shield. Dropped by the Lesser Crucible Knight patrolling the bridges of the Siofra Aqueduct .

title: Missionary's Cookbook
text: Cross the west-southwest bridge to grab the Missionary's Cookbook [5].
Missionary's Cookbook: Cookbook Item. Found on a corpse in a circular section of the Siofra Aqueduct .

title: Order Healing
text: Take the other path toward the aqueduct channel. Enter the opposite room and kill the scarab down the stairs to obtain Order Healing.
Order Healing: Incantation . Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab found in the middle of a circular section of the Siofra Aqueduct .

title: Inner Order
text: Loot the Golden Rune [7] on the outer ledge, then the Golden Rune [13] on the broken bridge.
Golden Rune [13]: Found at the end of the fractured bridge.
Kill the Crucible Tree Knight in the aqueduct channel for a Somber Smithing Stone [6], then grab the Smithing Stone [5] next to him.
Somber Smithing Stone [6]: Upgrade Material. Dropped by the spear-wielding Lesser Crucible Knight in Siofra Aqueduct .
Pick up a Golden Rune [6] in front of the waterfall farther in, then the Smithing Stone [4] in the room below it.
Enter the west room to pick up a Rune Arc.
Talk to D, Beholder of Death and give him the Twinned Set to learn the Inner Order gesture; you can still get it even if you don't have the set.
Inner Order: Gesture . Given by an NPC in the Siofra Aqueduct sitting on the floor grimacing in exchange for a Twinned Armor set .

place.title: Siofra Aqueduct
walk: Very early on in the area, you will encounter a Lesser Crucible Knight patrolling the corridor below the site of grace. This enemy can be difficult to deal with due to the limited space you're given, although it is possible to cheese him by baiting his flying lunge attack (which he will reliably do upon reaching roughly 50% HP) in a direction which will cause him to fly off the side of the area. Upon his death, he will drop the Crucible Hornshield

After the first Lesser Crucible Knight, there will be another one ahead wielding a spear, gazing out over a sheer drop. It is possible to knock him off the edge using some form of knockback, however he doesn't seem to be hostile and will ignore you unless provoked. Alternatively, you can bait this Knight and make him fly off the edge in the same way as the first one.

After defeating the bosses, Valiant Gargoyle & Vailant Gargoyle (Twinblade), walk to the back of the room and unlock the Great Waterfall Basin site of grace. Rest in the coffin nearby to be transported to Deeproot Depths.
A short cutscene will play upon interacting with the coffin, showing the player character climbing in and the coffin sliding shut.

title: Talk to D's Twin Brother
text: D's Twin Brother: NPC, D's twin brother can be found at Nekron, Eternal City, east of the Great Waterfall Basin grace.

title: Boss: Valiant Gargoyle, Boss: Valiant Gargoyle (Twinblade)
text: Kill the Valiant Gargoyles for Gargoyle's Greatsword, Gargoyle's Twinblade, and 30,000 runes. (This earns an achievement.)
Gargoyle's Greatsword: Dropped by the Valiant Gargoyle when both bosses are defeated
Gargoyle's Twinblade: Dropped by Vailant Gargoyle (Twinblade) when both bosses are defeated
Valiant Gargoyle: Dual Bossfight. Found by heading down to the lowest level of the Siofra Aqueduct . Spawns alongside the Valiant Gargoyle when it reaches half health.
Valiant Gargoyle: Dual Bossfight. Found by heading down to the lowest level of the Siofra Aqueduct . Approaching the waterfall causes it to jump down from the ceiling.

title: Talk to Wandering Merchant Siofra River
text: Optional: D, Beholder of Death's summon sign can be found at the top of the stairs if you gave him the Twinned Set.
Activate the Great Waterfall Basin grace on dry ground near the waterfall.
Optional: Collect all non-respawning crafting materials in Siofra River.

Wandering Merchant Siofra River: Wandering Merchant. General Goods vendor found playing music by an unlit campfire in the ruins of Siofra River . The doorway to this area is high up and only accessible by climbing up and around the nearby wooden scaffolding.

links.t: Video: non-respawning crafting materials in Siofra River

title: Talk to Jar Bairn
text: Travel to the Artist's Shack in Liurnia and follow the southeast cliff edge until you see Alexander. Throw an Oil Pot at him and help him out to receive the Triumphant Delight gesture (if not obtained). Talk to him afterward to receive Exalted Flesh x3.
Descend the gravestones in the cliff near Alexander. Once you reach the lowest gravestone, jump to a roof to pick up Smithing Stone [3] x3.
Drop down and grab the Jarburg grace next to a house.
South of the grace lies a cemetery with Golden Rune [1], 2x Golden Rune [2], 2x Golden Rune [3], and a Golden Rune [6].
Talk to Jar-Bairn on the porch of a house in Jarburg multiple times:
Jar Bairn: Jar Bairn can be found in Jarburg and will ask you to become Potentate, but deems your hands too rough.
miss: You must help him out before entering Mt. Gelmir or accepting Rya's invitation to Volcano Manor; doing either causes him to relocate there.

title: Talk to Iron Fist Alexander
text: Iron Fist Alexander: NPC. Alexander's fifth location on this questline. Found in Liurnia of the Lakes, just south of Carian Study Hall. Follow the path south from the Artist's Shack Site of Grace. Alexander will call out for help as the player gets closer to his location. He will ask you to make him "slippery". Use an Oil Pot to free him.

title: Talk to Diallos (Jarburg)
text: Note: Don't attack any of the Living Jars in the village; it will anger him and cause him to disappear.
Talk to him and answer that you'll be the new Potentate.
Reload the area and talk to him about picking flowers in the village.
Reload the area and exhaust his dialogue about Alexander (after meeting Alexander).
Reload the area and talk to him about poachers (after speaking to Diallos in Roundtable Hold the second time).
Diallos: NPC. If players have completed Volcano Manor, after progressing the Jarburg questline he will appear in one of the shacks, tending to a little jar.

title: Cracked Pot, Ritual Pot
text: Loot the 3x Cracked Pot, 2x Ritual Pot (one is on a rooftop), and Living Jar Shard in the village.

Cracked Pot: Crafting Pot. Three can be found in the village of Jarburg : The first is on a corpse in front of the blocked door of a hut north of where you drop down into the village. The second is in a hut northeast of the first. The last Cracked Pot is found on a large headstone in the south along the main road in the village.

Ritual Pot: Crafting Pot. Two can be found in the village of Jarburg : The first is found on a corpse on the roof of a hut in the north, use the cliffs to get on top of the hut and loot the corpse. The second can be found on top of a large decorative jar in the south. Use the boulders nearby or your horse to get on top of the jar.
Living Jar Shard: Crafting Material. Looted from a body inside one of the shacks in Jarburg.

place.title: Jarburg
walk: From the last stone platform before reaching the village, jump onto the roof of the closest hut to loot 3 x Smithing Stone (3) and then touch the Site of Grace in the southeast. Head back to the first hut and walk along the cliffs behind it. Jump onto the roof of a hut in the north for a Ritual Pot, then drop down and look behind you for a Cracked Pot.

Check the hut in the northeast for another Cracked Pot and a Living Jar Shard. Head south from here and look to the right for a large decorative jar. On top of it is another Ritual Pot. Use the boulders nearby or your horse to get on top of the jar. Continue heading south and look at the large headstone to the left for one last Cracked Pot. Further south past the village proper, you will find a cluster of sarcophagi where you can loot a Golden Rune (1), 2 x Golden Rune (2), 2 x Golden Rune (3) and a single Golden Rune (6).
The village is also rich in plants used for crafting and there is no danger here. See the full list of gatherables above.
Patch 1.03 Update:

Upon loading up into Jarburg, Jar Bairn will be to the left sitting on the steps to a house, upon exhausting all his dialog and resetting the area a few times, Diallos will show up in a hut down the road (the one with the little hostile jar) and will be patching him up explaining how he put everything at Volcano Manor behind him. Upon exhausting both Diallos and Jar Bairn's dialog, the town will be attacked.

Reloading the area, Jar-Bairn can be found where he is found initially and can be given Alexander's Innards. Complete the Diallos Questline to be able to loot a Hoslow's Petal Whip, Diallos's Mask and Numen's Rune at this location. After reloading, the Companion Jar talisman can be found where he was completing those questlines.
notes: After patch 1.03, Jarburg has a new NPC named Jar Bairn. He is the nephew of Alexander and is a continuation of his and Diallos’ questline.

title: Talk to Patches
text: Travel to the Grand Lift of Dectus and hoist your medallion in front of the lift. After arriving, grab the Altus Plateau grace on a rocky ledge just north of the lift.
Optional: Talk to Melina at the Altus Plateau grace.
Talk to Rya at the Grand Lift of Dectus and accept her invitation to Volcano Manor.
Note: If she's not there, you'll find her in the lower Lux Ruins instead.
After arriving, grab the Volcano Manor grace for later. Ignore the manor for now to avoid canceling a step in Patches's questline.
Patches: Appears by the Volcano Manor's entrance after pledging your service to the manor.

place.title: Volcano Manor
walk: ## How to get to Volcano Manor
## Rya's Questline
## Abductor Virgin

Alternate route directly into Volcano Manor Hall: Right after you are captured by the Abductor Virgin, look to your right over the waterfall. The drop is non-lethal; it will take about 665 of your health (ignoring lava damage) instead. Go as far southeast along the cliff edge before jumping down into the lava below, then wade southeast down the lava (healing off any damage) until you reach a wooden platform with a cage lift. Ride this lift up, then look to your right to take a second lift up. Travel up the stairs, past the Blackflame Monk, but before you enter the church ahead (contains a boss fight with the Godskin Noble), look to your left for another flight of stairs going down. Descend it, push the lever to raise a metal bridge, then cross it to reach the Prison Town Church Site of Grace to enable fast travel out of this area. You can travel up the hidden back passage from behind the altar and hit an illusory wall at the end of a dead end which leads into a room in the Volcano Manor, but you'll be behind a locked door that can only be opened with the Drawing-Room Key, received on the other side.

Go back onto the bridge, then carefully hop onto one of the studs on the left side. From that, hop onto the wheel that hoisted up the bridge, and finally make a running (but difficult) jump onto the opposite balcony. You'll pick up a Somber Smithing Stone (7) from the corpse. Run for the door you see, past the Iron Virgin, and from indoors, head down the stairs to a room with a corpse holding a Seedbed Curse. Cross the long large room to pick up an Ash of War: Royal Knight's Resolve, then head up the stairs to open a door that leads into the Volcano Manor main hall.
## From Altus Plateau

Near the Corpse-Stench Shack, rather southeast of it, is a ladder which leads up the mountain. Ascend it and turn left to get to the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite Site of Grace. Dash through the camp full of frenzied soldiers, go past the Mad Pumpkin Head and go northwest along the narrow path. (This is where your route will merge with the other route highlighted in green in the diagram further above.)

Jump down to a ruined campsite, fight off a Grafted Scion and ascend the next ladder you see. Take the next ladder on your left which leads you to another merchant, then keep going up the mountain from his location. You'll reach a plateau with several frenzied Soldiers and a Knight. After you fight them off, look for a ramp that lets you descend to the plateau below. Look west for a bridge that leads you to the Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite Site of Grace. Take either the ladder or Spiritspring Jump to the Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast, go northwest and jump the gap going downhill, then keep descending downhill, making a U-turn and rushing past the Marionettes and Troll guard to reach Volcano Manor.
## Volcano Manor Assassination Quests

Before following her instructions and heading to the drawing-room, turn left and head up the stairs, where you'll find yourself in a grand dining hall. On your way to the far end of the hall, you'll get invaded by Inquisitor Ghiza. Defeat him for his weapon, Ghiza's Wheel, and collect the Smithing Stone [6] on the corpse where he spawned.
If you do not have access to Mountaintops of the Giants yet, keep reading to use the manor's illusory wall to proceed.
From here, you can continue reading on to navigate your way through the Volcano Manor's actual dungeon area, but if you'd rather take up Tanith's offer to skip ahead to the boss click here.
## Going through Volcano Manor's Illusory Wall

Follow the path through a room full of Serpent Snails and you'll end up with a room with two ways forward - one down a flight of steps, another through an open doorway to your left. Head left first, being wary of Serpent Snails that may ambush you and continue until you reach a dead end. The corpse at the end of this passageway has the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook (21) on it, and to the left of it, reveal another hidden door that opens up into a room with the Depraved Perfumer Carmaan Ashes.

Go back to the room where you saw that flight of stairs and descend them to fight a Lesser Bloodhound Knight that drops the Bloodhound Claws. Make sure you pick up the Fireproof Dried Liver here too, it may come in handy. Continue moving forward to get to a church with the Prison Town Church Site of Grace.
## Prison Town Church

Head back out of the building and turn right to cross the bridge where there's a Man-Serpent at the end. The building behind it is inaccessible from the front door, but ther are two ways in. Circle around the left side of the building and jump over the railing to find remains with Albinauric Bloodcot x1 and an open door to the right. Head inside, defeat the Albinaurics in chairs, and loot the Beast Blood. Open the door back to the bridge and circle around to the right. There's a Man-Serpent guarding a Smithing Stone [4] and a ladder. From up the ladder you can jump into an open window and land back in the room, but instead we're going to get a few hidden items. From the top of the ladder to used to reach the roof, run straight to the opposite edge of the roof and look down. You'll see a narrow balcony with a door in it. Jump down and carefully enter the dark room, which has the Albinauric Mask and Albinauric Staff, along with a powerful Lesser Omenkiller. The Lesser Omenkiller should have its back turned to you, allowing for an easy sneak attack. The first time you kill it, it will drop a Great Omenkiller Cleaver. Once you're finished in this room, look to the right of the door you first came through to find a side room that leads to a ladder down. Take the ladder, looting a Golden Rune [10], then continue forward to find yourself back at the entrance to the church. Enter it again and run to the south-eastern end of the church, opposite the bridge entrance, being careful of the fast moving crawling Albunauric on the stairway. Make your way down the stairs to the lower floor, then look behind them for a Golden Rune [9] guarded by four Crawling Albinaurics. Loot the Golden Rune [9], then head down the hallway. Beware the hanging Albinauric, who will summon a Crawling Albinauric, and the patrolling Man-Serpent. Make two rights and you'll find the Guest Hall Site of Grace.
## Guest Hall

Defeat it and take the lift directly to the north up. Turn right to pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [5] from a corpse then turn back around to ascend the flight of stairs. Don't enter the temple just yet! Right before you do, turn left to find the incomplete bridge you saw across the way earlier. On this side, there's a lever you can turn to lift the bridge piece from out of the lava, making a shortcut to this area from the Prison Town Church.
## Taking a Detour for Items

Scale up the roofs again to drop onto a wooden platform on which a Facing back toward the gate, there is a small courtyard to the left guarded by two dogs that leads to a broken staircase along the outer wall. Get a running start & jump across the broken segment to reach a corpse with a Stonesword Key (trying to drop down from the roof above the item is a fatal fall). After collecting the key, drop down & follow the path around the wall until you get to the place where a bunch of gravestones sit in cooled lava and loot the corpses in this area to collect items such as a Golden Rune [9], Smithing Stone [6] and the Smoldering Shield. Be careful of the living jars as several of the small jars will explode upon death causing heavy damage.

Teleport back to the Prison Town Church Site of Grace and cross the shortcut bridge. Head back down the stairs and the cage lift you took previously. Turn left and into the other cage lift in the area. This one takes you back down to lava-level and if you walk forward, a Magma Wyrm will pop out of the lava, which when defeated, will drop a Dragon Heart. In the far end of the cave, you'll be able to spot a corpse with a Smithing Stone [7] on it.

Head back off that small island, and enter the small opening in the wall to the west. Continue forward towards the building ruins, following the Burning Slugs along the way, and you'll find yourself back at the stairs that take you to the cage lifts. Take the northern cage lift back up to the temple and now we can head in.
## Miniboss: Godskin Noble

After reaching about 50% health, the Godskin Noble rises and explodes in a small area around him. He now has attacks that have wide AoEs and an unpredictable roll attack. His skills are still widely telegraphed, so time your dodges well. Defeat him and you'll be rewarded with his weapon, the Godskin Stitcher, and the Noble Presence Incantation.
## Completing the rest of the Dungeon

Head back and go to the balcony. If you look down, you'll be able to see a mountain ledge you can safely jump down to. Follow the Burning Slugs northeast until you get to a corpse sitting on the mountain's edge that has a Furlcalling Finger Remedy. Turn left and you'll see another ledge you can safely jump down to. Follow the path until you see a Abductor Virgin in front of a building with an open window. Fight it or run through the window. At the southern side of the room, you'll find a ladder you can descend. There will be a Drawstring Fire Grease on the corpse here. Follow the stairs down and you'll find the Missionary's Cookbook (6). Backtrack back up the stairs and the ladder. There's a door on the west side of this room that opens up to a bridge.

Jump into the left side to get Crimson Tear Scarab. Jump once more and move counter-clockwise to come back where you were before. Go back to the bridge and head up the stairs but before going into the building, turn right and jump off the stairs, where you'll find a Teardrop Scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [5]. If you have been doing doing Rya's quest, look west and you can find a room where she can be found, you can make your decision on whether or not to kill or spare her here, visit her page to read up on her quest line. Back out of the room, hug the wall and follow the cooled lava further to the north (be careful of enemies along the way), you will then encounter a room rife with Basilisks, five to be exact, kill them quickly, and do not stay in one spot as you can be caught in their breaths and be turned to stone. If needed, kill one or two, run out of the room and back south, wait until your petrification buildup goes away, then return and repeat the process until they're all gone. Grab a Somber Smithing Stone [6] and head back south to the entrance to the room where you found Rya. In front of Rya's room, look southeast and you will find an open window next to the lava waterfall, go through it and grab a Stonesword Key. Head through Rya's room to find a ladder that takes you back up to where you're supposed to go. Head right first to activate the elevator to make a shortcut to Temple of Eiglay site of grace.

You'll come across a Man-Serpent with a fiery whip. Before fighting it, don't forget to get a Commoner's Headband lying on one of protruding stones on your right. Head through the door behind him and then through another set of closed doors on your right. On the altar protected by some enemies is the Man-Serpent Ashes. Head up the first set of stairs and before going up the second set, turn around to go up the flight of stairs behind you.

Through the doorway found on this floor is an imp statue that has to be unlocked with two Stonesword Keys. You'll find cages here you can jump down to, but before doing that, turn right and drop down to the platform below. Follow the path, head up the stairs, and in the next room, you'll find the Dagger Talisman. You will see some cages which you can jump atop, do so and drop further down onto the wooden platform, kill the enemy here, and look down to the northeast to find more cages to drop onto. After dropping down a few cages, you'll be on stable grounds again, look southwest for a room full weak enemies and a Seedbed Curse on a corpse, be careful as they can overwhelm you. After grabbing the item, turn left to ascend a flight of stairs and after defeating the Abductor Virgin here, you can collect a Somber Smithing Stone [7] off of a corpse draped over the broken part of the banister. Head back into the building and continue north-east where you'll a corpse with the Ash of War: Royal Knight's Resolve.

If you continue on this path, you'll eventually make it back to the entrance of the Volcano Manor, unlocking the door in front of Patches. Teleport back to the Temple of Eiglay Site of Grace and retrace your steps back to the room with the Man-Serpent Ashes. Climb up both flights of stairs and you'll find a waygate. This takes you to the Site of Grace right outside the fog door to the God-Devouring Serpent/Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy boss fight, the same place Tanith teleports you to if you complete all three assassination requests. Rest at the Site of Grace and when you're ready, head through the fog door.

If you've been following the walkthrough, and for completion, it's recommended you finish the Royal Capital to get access to the Mountaintops of the Giants to get to the final assassination, the Red Letter, before facing Rykard. The NPCs of Volcano Manor will be forever changed after killing the following boss, so be sure to check their quest lines before doing so.
## Facing Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy

Upon Rykard's defeat, you will receive the Remembrance of the Blasphemous and Rykard's Great Rune. The Eye Surcoat can also be picked up from the right side of the arena and the Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy Site of Grace will be accessible.
## Returning to the Inhabitants of the Volcano Manor

At this point, if you teleport back to Rykard's boss arena, you'll find Tanith feasting upon his remains. You can choose to attack her, and if you do so her knight, Tanith's Knight, will invade you. Upon his defeat, he will drop the Aspect of the Crucible: Breath Incantation, and Tanith's clothing set consisting of the Consort's Mask, Consort's Robe, and Consort's Trousers. Doing this too early prevents you from completing Patches' quest however. With this, the Volcano Manor Legacy Dungeon is complete.

Another through the Abductor Virgin at Raya Lucaria Academy

title: Ash of War: Through and Through
text: Exit the manor and pick up Smoldering Butterfly x6 from the left-side cliff edge.
Smoldering Butterfly: Material. Looted from a corpse sitting near some rocks in Mt. Gelmir , after the Fallingstar Beast
Kill the invisible scarab ahead to obtain Ash of War: Through and Through.

Ash of War: Through and Through: Dropped by an invisible Teardrop Scarab . You will see glowing footprints appearing in a set pattern around the area. Stand in front of its path and attack as it approaches you to reveal the creature.

title: Golden Seed
text: Pick up the Golden Seed near the scarab, then grab the Smoldering Butterfly x4 just east-southeast of the golden tree.
Golden Seed: Found just north of Lux Ruins
Smoldering Butterfly: Within Ravine-Veiled Village, near Site of Grace.

title: Talk to Rya (Second Location A)
text: Rya (Second Location A): Rya spawns here if the player completed the interaction with her in Liurnia of the Lakes but has not obtained both portions of the Dectus Medallion. She will teleport you to the Volcano Manor if you talk to her.

title: Map (Mt. Gelmir)
text: Head down the slope to find a Golden Rune [3] in the middle.
Golden Rune [3]: Consumable. Can be found on a corpse in Wyndham Ruins .
On the left side of the slope, on a ledge, you'll find a corpse with Dragonwound Grease.
Dragonwound Grease: Consumable. Found in a chest in Sage's Cave .
Grab the Map: Mt. Gelmir from the stele below.
Map (Mt. Gelmir): Map of Mt. Gelmir region

title: Stonesword Key
text: Activate the Road of Iniquity grace just past the map stele; you'll start from it later when exploring Mt. Gelmir.
Travel to Roundtable Hold and talk to Corhyn to trigger him to leave.
Optional: Talk to Roderika and select "There's something you should know".
Optional: Talk to Dung Eater in a newly opened room in the north wing.
Travel to the Altus Plateau grace, pass time until nightfall, and head east-southeast toward a camp. Pick up the Stonesword Key in front of a tent.
Stonesword Key: Found on a corpse located on a camp northeast from the Grand Lift of Dectus.

title: Boss: Night's Cavalry (Altus Plateau)
text: On a rocky ledge east-northeast of the camp, you'll find a Golden Rune [4].
Golden Rune [4]: Consumable. Can be found on a corpse at Mt. Gelmir near the Minor Erdtree.
Kill the Night's Cavalry patrolling the road for Ash of War: Shared Order and 10,000 runes.
Ash of War: Shared Order: Dropped by the Night's Cavalry
Night's Cavalry: Found patrolling the road. Only appears at night.

title: Ash of War: Earthshaker
text: Look for a moving cloud of dust on the road and hit it to obtain Ash of War: Earthshaker.
Ash of War: Earthshaker: Ash of War. Found by defeating an invisible Teardrop Scarab in the intersection of the road before Altus Highway Junction site of grace.

title: My Lord
text: Grab the Altus Highway Junction grace on a ledge between the diverging paths.
Talk to Boc at the grace and select "I'm sorry...". Give him the golden needle, then select "I have a favor to ask" and "You may call me lord" to learn the My Lord gesture.

title: Talk to Boc the Seamster
text: Boc the Seamster: Found at the Altus Highway Junction site of grace

title: Golden Seed
text: Optional: After giving Boc the needle and selecting "Surely she'd be happy for you?", talk to Melina at the Altus Highway Junction grace.
Pick up the Golden Seed north of the grace.
Golden Seed: Flask Upgrade Material. Found right next to the road heading north from the Altus Highway Junction site of grace.

title: Map (Altus Plateau)
text: Optional: Follow the road uphill to find Corhyn next to a stele. Talk to him about the noble Goldmask.
Grab the Map: Altus Plateau from the stele next to Corhyn.
Map (Altus Plateau): Can be found near the round, just north of the Altus Highway Junction site of grace

title: Talk to Brother Corhyn
text: Brother Corhyn: Found at the side of the road after he leaves Roundtable Hold .

title: Talk to Nomadic Merchant West Altus Plateau
text: Continue along the road until you reach a bridge. Under a tent just southeast of it, you can find a corpse with a Lump of Flesh.
On the bridge, you'll discover the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge grace and the Nomadic Merchant (Altus Plateau).
Nomadic Merchant West Altus Plateau: Found at the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge.

title: Talk to Finger Reader (Altus Plateau)
text: Finger Reader: Found at the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge.

title: Amber Starlight
text: Return to Altus Highway Junction and pick up Old Fang x3 from the stone platform just east-northeast of the grace.
Go around the ledge east-northeast of the platform and up the left slope to find an Amber Starlight.
Amber Starlight: Key item requested by Seluvis to progress his quest further.

title: Magic Scorpion Charm
text: Give Seluvis the Amber Starlight, then talk to him to receive the Magic Scorpion Charm.
miss: Must be done before giving Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade, which causes Seluvis's death.

title: Seluvis's Bell Bearing, Preceptor's Set
text: Exhaust Ranni's dialogue to receive the Carian Inverted Statue.

Note: Completing this step will end Seluvis's questline. If you plan to give Seluvis's Potion to Dung Eater (which requires Seluvis to be alive), do it now or skip ahead to the West Altus section until you complete the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds.
Reload the area, then activate the Ranni's Chamber grace in her room.
Loot Seluvis's Bell Bearing and the Preceptor's Set from Seluvis's puppet-like corpse.
Seluvis's Bell Bearing: Key Item. Found on a body in Seluvis's Rise after reaching the end of Ranni's questline.
Preceptor's Set: Armor Set. Found on a body in Seluvis's Rise after reaching the end of Ranni's questline.

title: Pidia's Bell Bearing, Dolores the Sleeping Arrow Puppet
text: Make your way down to Pida and loot Pidia's Bell Bearing and Dolores the Sleeping Arrow Puppet from his corpse.
Pidia's Bell Bearing: Key Item. Dropped by Pidia, Carian Servant in Caria Manor upon death.

title: Boss: Glintstone Dragon Adula (Three Sisters)
text: Glintstone Dragon Adula: Great Enemy. Found roaming the sub-region of Three Sisters . The dragon cannot be killed here and will teleport to the Cathedral of Manus Celes in the very south of the region after being brought to about 50% HP.

title: Invader: Preceptor Miriam
text: Note: If you gave Seluvis's Potion to Nepheli, he'll drop the Nepheli Loux Puppet instead.
Optional: Speak to Iji and select "Talk".
Travel to the Study Hall Entrance and ride the lift up to enter Carian Study Hall:
Head right first to pick up a Golden Rune [3].
Ascend the stairs and deal with Preceptor Miriam until she disappears.
Preceptor Miriam: Found at the hall middle way up the stairs.

title: Carian Glintstone Staff
text: Pick up the Carian Glintstone Staff from a shrine before the second lift.
Carian Glintstone Staff: Found at the Carian Study Hall.

title: Magic Downpour
text: Take the lift up and somehow kill Preceptor Miriam to obtain Magic Downpour.
Magic Downpour: Magic Downpour is a Sorcery dropped by Preceptor Miriam in the Carian Study Hall.

title: Cerulean Seed Talisman
text: Pick up a Golden Rune [4] from a corpse on the circular balcony.
Climb the ladder on the balcony and grab the Cerulean Seed Talisman from the top rafters.
Cerulean Seed Talisman: Found at Carian Study Hall . look for it at the rafters, next to a body.

title: Lucidity
text: Return to the Study Hall Entrance and examine the pedestal to turn the building upside down:
Re-enter the study hall and kill Preceptor Miriam again to obtain Lucidity.
Lucidity: Dropped by Preceptor Miriam in the secret area of the Carian Study Hall unlocked using the Carian Inverted Statue .

title: Mask of Confidence
text: Pick up the Mask of Confidence from a ledge near the underside arch of a bridge.
Mask of Confidence: Helm . Found on a corpse laying on the walls of the secret area of the Carian Study Hall unlocked using the Carian Inverted Statue .

title: Boss: Godskin Noble (Divine Tower of Liurnia)
text: Descend the chandeliers below to reach the rafters, then loot Holyproof Dried Liver x2 and Glintstone Firefly x8 from the bottom rafters.
Holyproof Dried Liver: On the sewers, past the Broken Statue , on the room below there are three items to grab, one of those is this one.
Drop onto the lift in the middle and ride it to the bottom (er... top?), then go outside to discover the Liurnia Tower Bridge grace.
Kill the Godskin Noble on the bridge to obtain the Godskin Noble Set.
Godskin Noble Set: Armor Set comprised of the Godskin Noble Hood , Godskin Noble Robe , Godskin Noble Bracelets and the Godskin Noble Trousers . Dropped by Godskin Noble Boss .

Godskin Noble: Field boss guarding the bridge to the Divine Tower of Liurnia . Only accessible after progressing Ranni 's questline and acquiring the Carian Inverted Statue , allowing access to a secret area in Carian Study Hall leading to the bridge.

title: Cursemark of Death, Stargazer Heirloom
text: Enter the Divine Tower of Liurnia and ride the lift inside to grab the Divine Tower of Liurnia grace.
Loot the Cursemark of Death and Stargazer Heirloom from Ranni's corpse at the top.
Cursemark of Death: Key Item. Found on a body lying at the top of the Divine Tower of Liurnia .
Stargazer Heirloom: Talisman . Found on a body lying at the top of the Divine Tower of Liurnia .

place.title: Divine Tower of Liurnia
walk: The Godskin Noble fought at the bridge drops the entire Godskin Noble Set upon defeat. The tower itself is a fairly straightforward affair. Through the main doors, ascend the lift and then follow the path along the balconies, grabbing the Divine Tower Of Liurnia site of grace on the way. At the top of the tower, you can loot the Stargazer Heirloom talisman and Cursemark of Death key item from the corpse on the ground.

title: Boss: Erdtree Avatar
text: Travel to Great Waterfall Basin grace and rest in the coffin below the waterfall. Grab the Great Waterfall Crest grace after arriving.
Kill the nearby Erdtree Avatar to obtain the Staff of the Avatar.

Staff of the Avatar: Drops from the Erdtree Avatar you encounter near the Great Waterfall Crest site of grace. To reach the area, you have to defeat the Valiant Gargoyle duo boss then lie down on the coffin at the back
Erdtree Avatar: Can be found closeby to the west after just arriving in Deeproot Depths .

title: Ash of War: Golden Land
text: Grab the Ghost Glovewort [4] in front of a slope behind the avatar, then kill the scarab at the top for Ash of War: Golden Land.
Ghost Glovewort [4]: Found in some bushes close to the Erdtree Avatar.
Ash of War: Golden Land: Hunt down a rolling ball to obtain it.

title: Elden Stars
text: Head toward the roots and climb onto the far-right one. Just above where it connects to the cliff, you'll find a Smithing Stone [6].
Smithing Stone [6]: Upgrade Material. Found up on a tree on the right.
Follow the middle branch of the far-right root to a cave in the cliffside. Kill the large-bellied ant inside to receive a Numen's Rune and a Rune Arc.
Numen's Rune: Dropped by the Queen Ants, within the small cave you can access by one of the branches.
Kill the four large-bellied ants below to receive 4x Numen's Rune and 4x Rune Arc.
Grab the Somber Smithing Stone [6] in the cave, then pick up Elden Stars from a corpse on the outside ledge.

Elden Stars: Head west from the Great Waterfall Crest grace until you reach some roots. From there look to the north-west to see a root going up to a cave and follow it. Enter the cave and fight through the packs of Giant Ant until the end and you'll find Elden Stars on a body facing the cave exit.
Somber Smithing Stone [6]: Upgrade Material. Found inside the Ants Nest in Deeproot Depths

title: Map (Deeproot Depths)
text: Climb the branch of the root below, then pick up Holy Grease x3 at the bottom of the root.
Follow the root to its base to find a Smithing Stone [4].
Smithing Stone [4]: On a dead body where the Flying Giant Ants are.
From the base of the root, head south to find a Golden Rune [5] on a root extending past the cliff.
Loot the Warming Stone x3, Smithing Stone [4], and Golden Rune [6] guarded by flying ants in the middle.
Warming Stone: Can be found on a dead body around the Giant Ants after crossing a root to the west.
Smithing Stone [4]: Over a couple of gravestones.
Just past the three corpses, next to a small tree, is a Ghost Glovewort [4].
Ghost Glovewort [4]: Around the bushes.
Continue westward to discover the Deeproot Depths grace by the cliff.
Follow the water to a Gargoyle. On the path in front of him lies a corpse with Dragonwound Grease.
Pick up Hefty Beast Bone x5 from a corpse behind the Gargoyle, and grab the Map: Deeproot Depths in the gazebo.
Map (Deeproot Depths): Map for entire Deeproot Depths area. Can be found on a corpse in a gazebo amid the destroyed ruins
Hefty Beast Bone: X5 On the ruins surrounded by waterfalls.

title: Talk to Palm Reader
text: Palm Reader: After finding the "Deeproot Depths" Site of Grace, the Palm Reader can be seen at the edge of the cliff.

title: Ash of War: Vacuum Slice
text: Southeast of the gazebo is a ruined building with a Rune Arc and Smithing Stone [6] x3, guarded by several Basilisks.
Smithing Stone [6]: On a dead body in a ruined structure next to the waterfalls.
Enter the tower north of the building to pick up Ash of War: Vacuum Slice in front of a Gargoyle.
Ash of War: Vacuum Slice: Inside the ruined temple surrounded by waterfalls.

title: Prince of Death's Staff
text: When exiting the tower, turn right through a short passage to find a Ghost Glovewort [5] in a bush between two trees.
Ghost Glovewort [5]: Found hidden in the bushes near a Teardrop Scarab in Deeproot Depths
To the right of the large root west of the bush, you'll find a scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [6].
Somber Smithing Stone [6]: Found in the ruin near the far north edge cliff.
From the large root, head north to find a Ghost Glovewort [5] on dry ground near a waterfall.
Ghost Glovewort [5]: Found near the wall close to the waterfall in Deeproot Depths
Use the spiritspring near the waterfall to reach the Arteria Leaf x5 at the top of the building.
Arteria Leaf: Can be found at Deeproot Depths falling to the ceiling from a large root.
Drop to the lower rooftop next to the corpse for a Smithing Stone [7].
Smithing Stone [7]: Upgrade material. Found on the stairs near the whirlpool in Deeproot Depths
Return to the gazebo, then head west-southwest between two structures to find a Ghost Glovewort [5] in a bush.
Ghost Glovewort [5]: Behind the ruins close to the underground walls.
Climb the root northwest of the bush to pick up a Golden Rune [1] behind a Gargoyle.
Jump to the first root on the left, then follow it to the top to find the Prince of Death's Staff on a tower.
Prince of Death's Staff: Climbing on the roots to reach up the towers, it's in one of them.

title: Stonesword Key
text: At the bottom of the same root, you'll find a Smithing Stone [6].
Smithing Stone [6]: Climb up the root to reach it.
Jump onto the tilted tower below the root and pick up a Smithing Stone [5] from behind its upper right corner.
Smithing Stone [5]: On the rooftop, jump from the root next to it. Deeproot Depths
Grab The Nameless Eternal City grace just south-southwest of the tower.
Loot the Human Bone Shard x5, 2x Smithing Stone [4], Clarifying Boluses, Golden Rune [9], 2x Golden Rune [8], Ghost Glovewort [5], and Nascent Butterfly west of the grace.
Human Bone Shard: X5 Over a couple of gravestones.
Clarifying Boluses: Over a couple of gravestones.
Golden Rune [9]: Over a couple of gravestones.
Golden Rune [8]: In a group of gravestones.
Ghost Glovewort [5]: Around some bushes to the northwest before going down the cliffs.
Nascent Butterfly: In the gravestones.
Drop down the northwest cliff to find a Ghost Glovewort [6] at the cliff edge below.
Ghost Glovewort [6]: At the very edge of the cliff.
Pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [7] in the back of the nearby building.
Somber Smithing Stone [7]: Scavenged from a Corpse inside a building at Deeproot Depths .
Use the spiritspring next to the building while facing east to reach the Stonesword Key on top.
Stonesword Key: At the top of the high building, accessed by jumping on the Spiritspring behind.

title: Boss: Crucible Knight Siluria
text: Use the spiritspring while facing northwest, and kill Crucible Knight Siluria for Siluria's Tree and 25,000 runes.
Crucible Knight Siluria: Guarding the entrance to the inside of the great Erdtree root.
Siluria's Tree: Dropped by Crucible Knight Siluria

title: Crucible Tree Set
text: Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [7] next to the massive tree stump, and open the chest inside it for the Crucible Tree Set.
Crucible Tree Set: The entire set can be found inside a chest guarded by the Crucible Knight Siluria .
Ghost Glovewort [7]: Found near Crucible Knight Siluria in the northwest corner of Deeproot Depths

title: Mausoleum Soldier Ashes
text: Head down the slope and pick up a Ghost Glovewort [6] and Golden Rune [8] in front of the two large roots.
Ghost Glovewort [6]: Upgrade Material. Found in the bushes near a corpse in Deeproot Depths
Golden Rune [8]: In a small cave access from the side next to the Walking Mausoleum.

Follow the root on the right all the way to a Wandering Mausoleum. Jump onto it from the closest branch and destroy the skull formations around it until it collapses. Optionally, mark its location on your map.
North of the mausoleum is a tilted building with a Somber Smithing Stone [6] inside.
Next to a trunk on the cliff behind the building, you'll find the Mausoleum Soldier Ashes.
Mausoleum Soldier Ashes: Found at the far north cliff, by breaking a petrified tree.

title: Prince of Death's Cyst
text: Follow the cliff edge southwest to find a Smithing Stone [5] in front of a rock.
Smithing Stone [5]: Scavenged on the ground in Deeproot Depths
Continue southwest and pick up a Golden Rune [8] at the end of a root stretching out into the depths.
Return to the two large roots and kill the scarab on the left root for a Somber Smithing Stone [6].
Somber Smithing Stone [6]: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab .�� Deeproot Depths
The root on the right stretches into several branches. Follow the left branch first for a Golden Rune [8] past four Basilisks.
From the branch with the item, drop down toward south to find a Somber Smithing Stone [7] on a ledge below.
Somber Smithing Stone [7]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse. Deeproot Depths
Return to the two roots and follow the middle branch to another Golden Rune [8].
Head back and follow the uppermost right branch to the roof of a building, where you can find a Smithing Stone [6].
Smithing Stone [6]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on the rooftop of the ruins. Deeproot Depths
Grab the Somber Smithing Stone [7] inside the building, then head east toward a waterfall with Lightning Greatbolt x6 close by.
Somber Smithing Stone [7]: In a room at the ruins.
Lightning Greatbolt: Ammunition . Found on a dead corpse near the waterfall in Deeproot Depths
Go up the slope near the waterfall and loot the Somber Smithing Stone [7], Golden Rune [8], and Fan Daggers x4 from the Runebear's den.

Somber Smithing Stone [7]: In a small cave access from the side next to the Walking Mausoleum. Located on the small cliff right behind the rune bear that gives the Prince of Death's Cyst ��in Deeproot Depths
Travel to The Nameless Eternal City and head up the east-southeast root from earlier. This time, follow the same root to a Golden Rune [5].
Jump onto the thin root that stretches around the nearby tower to find Nascent Butterfly x3 on the top ledge of the tower.
Drop down the top end of the root to grab the Across the Roots grace.
Follow the root near the grace back around to loot a Golden Rune [8] from the corpse at the end.
Jump to a lower branch southeast of the corpse to reach an area with a Ghost Glovewort [7] near some ants.
Ghost Glovewort [7]: Upgrade Material. It is found close to the sight where you have to jump off inside a hole and pick up Prince of Death's Cyst Talisman within Deeproot Depths
Descend the hole in the area to find a Somber Smithing Stone [7] on a ledge.
Kill the Runebear at the bottom to obtain the Prince of Death's Cyst.
Prince of Death's Cyst: Dropped by a Runebear, fiound in a cave behind a waterfall

title: Boss: Fia's Champions
text: When exiting the cave, turn right to find a Ghost Glovewort [5].
Ghost Glovewort [5]: Laying on the ground.
Return to Across the Roots and kill Fia's Champions for Fia's Mist and 40,000 runes.

Fia's Champions: Multiple Bossfight. Fia's Champions , are a set of NPC invaders located past the "Across the Roots" Site of Grace. Sorcerer Rogier and Lionel the Lionhearted may fought here with Fia's Champions. This is also the location of Lichdragon Fortissax .
Fia's Mist: Obtained by defeating Fia's Champions in Deeproot Depths . After unlocking the Across the Roots Grace, head north and defeat the boss.

title: Radiant Baldachin's Blessing
text: Activate the Prince of Death's Throne grace after the fight.
Speak to Fia and answer that you want to be held. Talk to her in secret twice, then give her the Cursemark of Death to receive the Radiant Baldachin's Blessing (no need to get rid of this one).
miss: Missable if you kill Fia after defeating her champions.

title: Boss: Lichdragon Fortissax
text: Talk to Fia in secret and reload the area. Talk to her again and reload the area a second time. Interact with her afterward to enter the Deathbed Dream, then kill Lichdragon Fortissax for Remembrance of the Lichdragon and 90,000 runes. (This earns an achievement.)

Lichdragon Fortissax: Multiple Bossfight. Massive four-winged black dragon with powerful lightning attack. Defeating it is required to finish Fia's questline and to unlock the " Age of Duskborn " ending. Fought alongside Fia's Champions , Sorcerer Rogier and Lionel the Lionhearted.
Mending Rune of the Death-Prince: Rewarded after defeating Lichdragon Fortissax
Remembrance of the Lichdragon: Rewarded after defeating Lichdragon Fortissax
miss: Fortissax is unreachable if you kill Fia.

title: Inseparable Sword, Twinned Set
text: Loot the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince from Fia's corpse, then reload the area to pick up Fia's Set.
D, Beholder of Death will show up if you gave him the Twinned Set. Talk to him, then reload the area to find the Inseparable Sword and the Twinned Set on the ground.
Inseparable Sword: Prince of Death's Throne, after giving D's brother D's Twinned Set
Twinned Set: It is possible to obtain this set after resting at the Site of Grace and progressing in the D, Hunter of the Dead questline.
Optional: Collect all non-respawning crafting materials in Deeproot Depths.
miss: The Mending Rune is unobtainable if you kill Fia.

links.t: Video: non-respawning crafting materials in Deeproot Depths

title: Snow Witch Set
text: Enter Renna's Rise, northeast of Ranni's Rise, and loot the chest at the top of the ladder to obtain the Snow Witch Set.
Snow Witch Set: Armor Set. Found in a chest on the upper floor of Renna's Rise after reaching the end of Ranni's questline.

place.title: Renna's Rise
walk: This tower can be accessed by progressing through the Ranni the Witch questline. This Tower can be accessed once players reach the Divine Tower of Liurnia as part of Ranni's quest. This occurs after defeating Radahn and giving the Fingerslayer Blade to Ranni. After this, players can make their way and take the ladders to the top of the interior tower. There will be a chest that will contain the Snow Witch Set. Map Link
If the barrier is still there after completing the quest with Ranni, you'll need to visit a Site of Grace to reset the area.

During the questline, you may also gain access to the portal located at a higher part of the tower. Go through the arched doorway out the tower after using the ladders to climb. Take the stairs that wrap around the external part of the tower and there will be a portal that can be used to travel to another location.

title: Miniature Ranni
text: Use the sending gate at the top of the tower to reach Ainsel River Main. After arriving, pick up Miniature Ranni from one of the coffins.
Miniature Ranni: Key Item. Found in an open stone coffin in the waters of Ainsel River Main .

guide.title: Ainsel River Main
text: ## Nosktella, Eternal City & Lake of Rot
Elden Ring Main Quest Guide - Nokstella, Eternal City & Lake of Rot Points of Interest
Explore Ainsel River Main
Acquire Miniature Ranni
Explore Nokstella, Eternal City
Speak to Miniature Ranni
Travel to the Lake of Rot
Defeat Astel, Naturalborn of the Void
Ringleader's Evergaol
## Ainsel River Main

Elden Ring Map: Nokstella Eternal City Starting Point. Begin from North-West Liurnia of the Lakes. Take the stairs to the very top of Renna's Rise and take the waygate there. It will teleport you to Ainsel River Main, that northern part of Ainsel River that was inaccessible last time you were there. Upon entering through the Waygate, pick up the Miniature Ranni from a coffin, then proceed to the Site of Grace.

Go ahead and hide behind the partial walls to approach the Malformed Star. Take it out for a Somber Smithing Stone (7), then turn around and loot two Glove Gravewort (6), two Ghost Glovewort (6) and one (7), two Golden Rune (7), Human Bone Shard x3, and a Smithing Stone (4). Beware of the Clayman. Behind the Giant Poison Flower (which emits clouds inflicting Madness) near the waterfall are the Clayman Ashes and a Stonesword Key. Make your way back to where the Malformed Star was to pick up another Ghost Glovewort (7).

Head down the tunnel where some Giant Ants are waiting for you, as well as Stimulating Boluses. There are two Ants with wings ahead, as well as an Ant with a reinforced head, reducing the damage you deal with it significantly. Pick up Shield Grease x2 and Golden Rune (10) x8, then head to the left. Go ahead to fight some Scythe-wielding gravity mages, then turn right until see a corpse above you. Drop down and climb onto the ruins to loot the Wing of Astel from a chest. Then go back to get a Somber Smithing Stone (6) from the aforementioned corpse. Go back to where the ants were and take the other way, pick up another Ghost Glovewort (6) in front of the wall, then go up to enter Nokstella, Eternal City.

title: Clayman Ashes, Stonesword Key
text: Rest at the Ainsel River Main grace, and talk to the miniature Ranni three times to get a response from her.
Kill the Withered Astel launching rocks at you to receive a Somber Smithing Stone [7].
Somber Smithing Stone [7]: Dropped by the Malformed Star in Uhl Palace Ruins .
Pick up the 2x Ghost Glovewort [6] in the water northeast of the Withered Astel.
Ghost Glovewort [6]: Two found next to each other in the waters of northern Uhl Palace Ruins .
East-northeast of the gloveworts, you'll find a Golden Rune [7] and Human Bone Shard x3 around a staircase.
Golden Rune [7]: Rune Consumable. Picked up from a Corpse in Uhl Palace Ruins , just before a small set of stairs
Human Bone Shard: Can be found nearby to a Giant Poison Flower in northern Uhl Palace Ruins
Next to an unlit brazier south-southwest of the staircase is a Smithing Stone [4].
Smithing Stone [4]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse sitting against a ruined wall in northern Uhl Palace Ruins .
Grab the Stonesword Key next to a Miranda Blossom in the water, then pick up the Ghost Glovewort [6] and Clayman Ashes next to the waterfall.

Clayman Ashes: Located on a corpse in Ainsel River, Lake of Liurnia which is south from the Uhl Palace Ruins. Easiest way to reach these is ashes is while doing Ranni's questline (the portal you enter from Renna's Rise will take you near the ashes). After entering Ainsel River proceed south along the tunnel entering into the next main room with enemies, proceed southwest while hugging the edge until you can find some Clayman walking about, after disposing them look for the corpse near the corner of the area by the top of a waterfall.
Stonesword Key: Key Item. Found on a corpse next to a Giant Poison Flower in northern Uhl Palace Ruins .
Ghost Glovewort [6]: Found by the waterfall, next to a Giant Poison Flower in northern Uhl Palace Ruins .

title: Wing of Astel
text: Northwest of the waterfall, leaning against a ruined wall, you'll find a Golden Rune [7].
From the wall, turn southwest to pick up a Ghost Glovewort [6] and a Ghost Glovewort [7].
Ghost Glovewort [6]: Found behind one of the two statues standing by the entrance of a ruin in northern Uhl Palace Ruins .
Ghost Glovewort [7]: Found behind one of the two statues standing by the entrance of a ruin in northern Uhl Palace Ruins .
Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [7] from a corner of the ruined structure.
Ghost Glovewort [7]: Found in a ruins in northern Uhl Palace Ruins with two large statues at the entrance.
Follow the water downstream to a corpse with Stimulating Boluses.
Stimulating Boluses: Found on a corpse in the tunnel leading to Nokstella, Eternal City .
Pick up the Golden Rune [10] x8 and Shield Grease x2 in the room downstream.
Golden Rune [10]: Found on a corpse in the tunnel leading to Nokstella, Eternal City near two Flying Ants.
Follow the southwest path past a shield-headed ant until you reach a chest with the Wing of Astel on top of a structure.
Wing of Astel: Curved Sword . Found in a small chest at the top of the ruins in southern Uhl Palace Ruins . Inaccessible until entering from the Northern, higher level section.

title: Ant's Skull Plate
text: Go up the slope near the structure to pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [6] hanging from the edge.
Somber Smithing Stone [6]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse hanging off a ledge in southern Uhl Palace Ruins .
Return to the ant room and follow the river to a Ghost Glovewort [6] in the water.
Ghost Glovewort [6]: Found at the base of a dam in Ainsel River Main .
Go through the doorway and drop down to discover the Nokstella, Eternal City grace.
Optional: Talk to Ranni while resting at the Nokstella, Eternal City grace.
Beside the wall behind the grace sits a corpse with Magic Grease x3.
Magic Grease: Consumable Item. Found in a corpse near the Nokstella, Eternal City Site of Grace.
Enter the room on the left up the first set of stairs to find a chest with the Ant's Skull Plate.
Ant's Skull Plate: Greatshield . Found in a chest in a small room in Nokstella, Eternal City .

place.title: Nokstella, Eternal City
walk: From the Site of Grace, there is Magic Grease x3 in the ruins directly to the left. On the right, you will find a Nox Swordstress riding a Giant Ant, and Ghost Glovewort (7). In the ruin ahead there are two Nox Monks, a Smithing Stone (6), and Drawstring Holy Grease x2. You can go to the right around the larger building ahead to pick up Silver Tear Husk x3. Going straight ahead, there are 3 Serpent Snails guarding a Celestial Dew in an alcove to the right. Further down the path, more Serpent Snails await you, four of them drop down onto you when you loot the Smithing Stone (6). To your left are many Silver Tears, some of them will explode into lightning upon death, along with another Giant Ant-riding Nox Swordstress. There are also some tears up on a ledge to the right which will shoot at you. Try taking one of the tears out from range to trigger a chain reaction. There is a Golden Rune (10) on the right side of the river, a Ghost Glovewort (8) on either side. Consider fighting the remaining tears before picking these up, however. Some of them have shields.

Continuing on the right you will find 3 Giant Ants and a Stonesword Key. Take out the remaining Nox Swordstress riders and tears, then pick up another Ghost Glovewort (8). In the far right corner, there are two plated ants which you can simply ignore. The ruin on the left contains a Celestial Dew. Quickly go down the elevator to activate the Nokstella Waterfall Basin Site of Grace, then go back up. The remainder of this walkthrough is dedicated to picking up items, including a Golden Seed at the end. To start, go to a ruin on the left side earlier which contains a Somber Smithing Stone (7) and many tears. There is a single Golden Centipede in another room. Go further back and up the stairs to fight a Nox Swordstress guarding a chest with Ghost Glovewort (9). At this point, you can go back to the first site of grace, or spend some of the upgrade materials. Next, head up the main stairs where a Night Maiden awaits you, along with Fan Daggers on a corpse. Turn left to fight yet another Nox Swordstress who guards a chest containing the Ant's Skull Plate. Note that the chest is not in the center but off to the right. After fighting the tears further up the stairs, head around the building on the left to find the Archer Ashes. Inside the building, more tears await you, a chest contains the Ghost-Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing (2). Now heading right, pick up two Golden Rune (10). Just ahead of the golden rune, look for an open window on the left. Kill the silver tear hiding above it, then go through the window and open the chest for a Somber Smithing Stone (7). Go back outside and around the building to the left again and use a Stonesword Key to find two Nox Monks and a chest with the Nightmaiden & Swordstress Puppets Ashes inside. Now, upon crossing the bridge, a giant Silver Sphere will roll at you. Try sprinting to the right next to the building ahead, the Silver Sphere will get stuck. You will see particle effects once it attacks, then you have a short window to attack for yourself. In the building, there is another Silver Sphere on the ceiling, so try to take it out with ranged attacks from outside. Each Silver Sphere drops a Larval Tear, the chest inside contains a Great Ghost Glovewort. There is a Golden Rune (10) on the bridge and another one on the stairs. Turn right past the stairs and pick up a Smithing Stone (6) and a Golden Centipede. The building on the left contains another Silver Sphere that drips many different types of Silver Tears before dropping itself, and a chest with a Somber Smithing Stone (7). The Silver Sphere drops a Larval Tear upon defeat. On the stairs to the left from here is a Teardrop Scarab carrying a Somber Smithing Stone (6). The building is occupied by two Silver Tears that transform into humans, and a Nox Swordstress. It also contains a chest with the Moon of Nokstella. Leaving the chest alcove, exit to the right of the room, drop down some ledges and take the elevator down to pick up a Golden Seed. You are done now and can warp to the Nokstella Waterfall Basin Site of Grace. Select the option "Talk to Ranni" while resting there, if you want to follow her questline. There is a Ghost Glovewort (9) to to the left of the elevator you came down with, then go through the tunnel. There are three Basilisks here, as well as a Smithing Stone (4) and (5). Defeating the Baleful Shadow here grants you the Discarded Palace Key to be used in the Raya Lucaria Grand Library. Go inside, take the elevator down and touch the Lake of Rot Shoreside Site of Grace. You are now done with Nokstella, see Lake of Rot for details on how to get through there.
notes: The electrified Silver Tears will explode shortly after they die, which will kill other Silver Tears nearby, and can cause a chain reaction in large groups.

title: Ghost-Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [2]
text: Pick up Fan Daggers from a corpse on the stair railing.
At the top of the stairs, enter the south building for a chest with the Ghost-Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [2].
Ghost-Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [2]: Key Item. Found in a chest at the corner of a small room in Nokstella, Eternal City ,

title: Archer Ashes
text: Behind the building you'll find a corpse with the Archer Ashes.
Archer Ashes: Spirit Ashes. Found on a corpse tucked behind a building in Nokstella, Eternal City .

title: Nightmaiden & Swordstress Puppets
text: Return to the stairs and pick up a Golden Rune [10] from the arcade.
Golden Rune [10]: Consumable Item. Found upstairs in Nokstella, Eternal City , on a body lying between two arches.
Go through the opening in the arcade to discover a chest with a Somber Smithing Stone [7].
Somber Smithing Stone [7]: Found at Nokstella, Eternal City one of the window is open with a chest in it.
At the end of the arcade is another Golden Rune [10].
Golden Rune [10]: Consumable Item. Found upstairs in Nokstella, Eternal City , beneath an arch.
Enter the building up the stairs and loot the Nightmaiden & Swordstress Puppets from a chest guarded by two Nox Monks.
Nightmaiden & Swordstress Puppets: Spirit Ashes. Found in a chest locked behind an imp statue in Nokstella, Eternal City protected by two Swordstresses .

title: Larval Tear
text: Kill the boulder on the bridge for a Larval Tear (first time), then grab the Golden Rune [10] at the end.
Larval Tear: Dropped by a Silver Tear disguised as a large inanimate ball on the bridge.
Golden Rune [10]: Consumable Item. Found on a corpse on the bridge in Nokstella, Eternal City .

title: Larval Tear A
text: Enter the building near the bridge. Kill the boulder in the ceiling for a Larval Tear (first time), then loot the chest for a Great Ghost Glovewort.
Larval Tear A: Rolls down the stairs across the bridge and then toward players are they enter this location
Great Ghost Glovewort: Found in a chest at the back of a narrow room in Nokstella, Eternal City . Beware the Silver Tear disguised as a large boulder hanging off of the ceiling waiting to ambush you.

title: Larval Tear B
text: Pick up a Golden Rune [10] from the railing on the stairs past the bridge.
Golden Rune [10]: Consumable Item. Found on a corpse that is hanging from the handrail on the stairs in Nokstella, Eternal City .
In front of the right building up the stairs, you can find a Smithing Stone [6].
Smithing Stone [6]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse at the side of a building in Nokstella, Eternal City .
Enter the left building, kill the boulder in the ceiling for a Larval Tear (first time), then loot the chest for a Somber Smithing Stone [7].
Larval Tear B: Larval tear can be found here
Somber Smithing Stone [7]: Upgrade Material. Found in a chest at the back of a room Nokstella, Eternal City protected by Silver Tears .

title: Moon of Nokstella
text: Kill the scarab in front of the last staircase for a Somber Smithing Stone [6].
Somber Smithing Stone [6]: Upgrade Material. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab at the base of some stairs in Nokstella, Eternal City .
Ascend the stairs and loot the Moon of Nokstella from a chest in the top building.
Moon of Nokstella: Talisman . Found in a chest underneath a massive throne in Nokstella, Eternal City .

title: Golden Seed
text: Head through the south doorway in the building to reach a lift and ride it down to a Golden Seed.
Golden Seed: Take the elevator west from the north part of Nokstella to access this location.

title: Stonesword Key
text: From the golden tree, drop down toward north-northeast to find a Stonesword Key on the cliff edge.
Stonesword Key: Key Item. Found on a corpse laying on a ledge overlooking the waters of Nokstella, Eternal City .

title: Invader: Baleful Shadow, Discarded Palace Key
text: Head southeast toward a ledge and pick up the 2x Ghost Glovewort [8] in the water, guarded by a several electrified Silver Tears.
Ghost Glovewort [8]: Two found on opposite sides of the shallow river flowing through Nokstella, Eternal City .
Beside a rock in the water, near the gloveworts, is a Golden Rune [10].
Golden Rune [10]: Rune Consumable. Found in the river of Nokstella, Eternal City , from a body sitting near some rocks.
Make a sharp turn around the bottom of a bridge for a Smithing Stone [6] in a corner of an arcade.
Smithing Stone [6]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse in the corner of the base of a building in Nokstella, Eternal City . Beware of the snail ambush after you pick the item up.
In front of a closed door, past the opposite end of the arcade, you'll find a Celestial Dew.
Celestial Dew: Found on a corpse sitting under some ruins in Nokstella, Eternal City .
Follow the cliff around the corner north until you reach a corpse with Silver Tear Husk x3.
Head toward the ruined buildings near the cliff to find a Smithing Stone [6] and Drawstring Holy Grease x2.
Drawstring Holy Grease: Weapon Coating. Found on a body near a giant rock.
Pick up a Ghost Glovewort [7] near the waterfalls at the end.

Ghost Glovewort [7]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One can be found inside the Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs : Follow the main path until you reach the first lift. Descend it and then send it back up to reveal a second platform in the lift that will take you to the lowest levels of the catacombs. From here, continue past the room with the Lesser Burial Watchdog to a corridor with a frost breath trap. Continue past this trap to a second corridor with another frost breath trap at the end. Halfway through this second corridor, hit the wall on the right to reveal an alcove where the ghost glovewort can be found.
Follow the river downstream until you see a Ghost Glovewort [7] on the riverbank.
Ascend the stairs on the left riverbank to reach a chest with a Ghost Glovewort [9].
Ghost Glovewort [9]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One found inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave . To left of the locked door that leads to the boss, behind the Troll .
Continue downstream to pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [7] on the cliff edge behind a structure on the left.
Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [8] in the riverbed, then grab the Celestial Dew beneath the structure where the river drops into a waterfall.
Use the lift in the building east of the structure to reach the Nokstella Waterfall Basin grace.
Optional: Talk to Ranni while resting at the Nokstella Waterfall Basin grace.
Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [9] just northeast of the grace.
Ghost Glovewort [9]: Found next to the base of a waterfall in Ainsel River Main .
