Proceed through the short tunnel in the water to find a Smithing Stone [4] and Smithing Stone [5].
Smithing Stone [4]: Found on a corpse in the caves of Ainsel River Main .
Kill the Baleful Shadow past the tunnel to receive the Discarded Palace Key.
Baleful Shadow: Through the cave south of the Nokstella Waterfall Basin Site of Grace.

title: Dark Moon Ring
text: Use the lift at the end of the corridor and activate the Lake of Rot Shoreside grace.
Travel to the Raya Lucaria Grand Library and unlock the chest near the grace to obtain the Dark Moon Ring.
Dark Moon Ring: Quest Item. Found in a locked chest next to the Raya Lucaria Grand Library Site of Grace. Unlocked using the Discarded Palace Key .

title: Immunizing Horn Charm +1
text: Optional: Equip armor with high Immunity, the Spiralhorn Shield or Ant's Skull Plate, the Immunizing Horn Charm and Mottled Necklace +1, and Flame, Cleanse Me or craft some Preserving Boluses.
From the Lake of Rot Shoreside grace, drop down toward east to pick up Aeonian Butterfly next to a rotted tree.
Aeonian Butterfly: Crafting Material. Can be gathered around the Lake of Rot
Quickly continue north for a Somber Smithing Stone [8] on top of some mushrooms.
Somber Smithing Stone [8]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse laying on top of a tipped over ruin in the Lake of Rot .
Head southeast toward some ruins and pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [7] beside a wall.
Somber Smithing Stone [7]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse lying in a ruin in the Lake of Rot .
Continue south toward a ruin sticking out of the rot. Pick up the Golden Rune [9] hanging from the top of it.
Golden Rune [9]: Held by a corpse within the ruins.
Kill the Ancestral Follower in the rot west-northwest of the ruin for the Immunizing Horn Charm +1, then immediately return to the ruin.
Immunizing Horn Charm +1: Found in the Lake of Rot by killing the Ancestral follower SE of the Lake of Rot Shore Grace

title: Dragonscale Blade, Boss: Dragonkin Soldier
text: Head toward the platform with a pillar south-southeast of the ruin. Step on the pressure plate to raise platforms around the boss, then kill the Dragonkin Soldier in the rot for Dragonscale Blade and 58,000 runes.
Dragonscale Blade: Dropped by Dragonkin Soldier
Dragonkin Soldier: Great Enemy. Found sitting dormant in the middle of the Lake of Rot

guide.title: Lake of Rot and the Grand Cloister
text: Just a reminder that the waters of Lake of Rot are treacherous and can quickly apply Scarlet Rot each second that you stand in the water. It is recommended to have many Preserving Boluses on hand to remove the status effect immediately and even equip Talismans and Armor that can help alleviate its build-up.

If you look out into the lake, you may be able to see four pillars standing on their own small island in the distance. These small islands have buttons on them that raise landmasses in the lake, giving you safe platforms to stand on while navigating through the Lake of Rot. The nearest pillar to you right now at the starting island should be to your southwest, and after that, the next one should be south of the first pillar. You may notice a familiar-looking boss in the middle of the lake.

Ignore him for now and find the next two pillars to raise all four landmasses in the lake and make item collection and boss fighting easier and much safer. One of the landmasses lifts the button, with you on it, to a raised level. While you're here, you may as well defeat the Alabaster Lord to receive his sword, the Alabaster Lord's Sword, and loot the Somber Smithing Stone (9). There is a slope that leads to a ladder on the east side of the pillar to help you to get down or go back up.

With all the landmasses raised, we can go deal with the boss. In the middle of the lake, next to three raised islands, sits the Dragonkin Soldier once again. Defeat him, being careful not to get knocked down in the water. From here you can choose to loot bodies scattered all around Lake Rot to obtain items, many of which are Somber Smithing Stone (7) & Somber Smithing Stone (8). Several items of note are the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook (22) obtained from a lone chest in a large ruin in the southwestern section of the map, and the Mushroom Crown on a corpse hanging off a pillar in the ruins in the southeast corner.

After you're done with this area, head over to the southern section, where you'll find a waterfall. Climb down the stairs next to it to reach the Grand Cloister and grab the Grand Cloister Site of Grace. The area here is infested with Lesser Kindreds of Rot and there are a few corpses with Golden Runes. If you head north, you'll come across a waterfall with two corpses under it, one with a Smithing Stone (6) and another with a Smithing Stone (7). Be prepared as you approach this waterfall, however, as an Ulcerated Tree Spirit ambushes you from the water. Once you manage to defeat it, you'll be rewarded with a Golden Seed.

Next, head west, where you'll see a bunch of rot prawns dancing in front of a temple. You can kill them one by one since they don't seem to take notice of their surroundings much. When they're all gone, head inside the temple to grab the Scorpion's Stinger. Head back out of the temple and head south, where you'll find an open coffin at the tip of the waterfall. Interact with the coffin to rest in it and a cutscene will play.

If you open your map now, you will find yourself in an isolated area south of the Lake of Rot. Through the mist door, you'll fight Astel, Naturalborn of the Void, defeating this boss, you'll gain the Remembrance of the Naturalborn. You can check our Astel, Naturalborn of the Void page to find various strategies on how to defeat this boss - with all of the underground areas fully explored, head north past his boss room to find a lift that takes you back to the surface at Deep Ainsel Well. Head northeast and you'll come to the Moonlight Altar grace site, located in Western Liurnia, which if you've been following the walkthrough, were inaccessible until now. Here are the few things we can explore here:

Chelona's Rise: A tower found in the very corner of the upper plateau in Liurnia's southwest. This tower is initially sealed, with an imp statue at the entrance holding a glowing book, instructing you to "seek three great wise beasts". See the tower's page for details. You can find the sorcery spell, Ranni's Dark Moon in a chest at the top of this tower. Nearby is the Altar South Site of Grace as well.
Moonfolk Ruins: A ruins section where you can gather some materials and find x1 Somber Smithing Stone [8].

Lunar Estate Ruins: The ruins of a large estate found in the southern plateau of Liurnia, accessible only after making significant progress in Ranni's questline. Once accessible, you can find a Golden Rune [8] in this ruins location.

Cathedral of Manus Celes Located at Southwest Liurnia of The Lakes. Accessible only after making significant progress in Ranni's questline. However, you can find the Glintstone Dragon Adula roaming around only if you've dealt enough damage to it at its initial location.

Ringleader's Evergaol. Located Northwest from Moonlight Altar site of Grace. This Evergaol does not require a Stonesword Key to unlock as the portal mechanism in the center is active as soon as you enter the area. Within, you can challenge Alecto, Black Knife Ringleader, a remarkably agile and aggressive assassin. Upon defeat, Alecto drops the Black Knife Tiche spirit ashes as well as 80,000 runes.

title: Mushroom Crown
text: Loot the Golden Rune [7], Golden Rune [10], and Lightningproof Dried Liver around the raised platforms.
Golden Rune [7]: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse in the lake southeast of the central isle.
Golden Rune [10]: Beside the Dragonkin Soldier Boss . Held by a corpse within the Lake of Rot . Back of a large structure
Lightningproof Dried Liver: Consumable. Found on a corpse south of the central isle.
Head toward the building southeast of the platforms. To the left of it is a structure protruding from the rot, with a Somber Smithing Stone [8] on top.
Somber Smithing Stone [8]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse dangling off of a small island in the Lake of Rot .
Climb the southwest structure to reach the top of a building. Pick up the Mushroom Crown on a pillar inside.
Mushroom Crown: Helm . Found on a corpse hanging off of a pillar ruin in the south-eastern corner of Lake of Rot . Climb around the outside of the ruin to reach it.

title: Map (Lake of Rot)
text: Return to the Lake of Rot Shoreside and pick up the Map: Lake of Rot down the slope.
Map (Lake of Rot): Found on a corpse by the water's edge at Lake Rot .

title: Alabaster Lord's Sword
text: Step on the pressure plate southwest of the map, then pick up Rot Grease from the corpse next to the raised platform.
Head toward the mushrooms in the rot west of the corpse to pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [7].
Somber Smithing Stone [7]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse at the edge of a tiny landmass in north-western Lake of Rot .
From the mushrooms, head southeast toward a corpse in the rot with Black-Key Bolt x10, then step on the pressure plate farther south-southeast.
Use the raised platforms to reach a corpse in the rot with a Warming Stone.
Warming Stone: Consumable . Found on a corpse floating in the middle of the Lake of Rot .
Step on the pressure plate south of the corpse, then continue south-southwest to reach the final pressure plate.
When stepping on the final plate, the platform will elevate. Kill the Alabaster Lord at the top of the structure for Alabaster Lord's Sword.

Alabaster Lord's Sword: Drops from an enemy in the Underground. You have to raise the platforms to get up to him by stepping on the buttons around the swamp. There are two buttons that are next to small columns or obelisks. Once you get raised on the platform, take on the long and narrow path, after a few meters you will be greeted by this enemy. kill him to obtain the Alabastrer Lord's Sword.

title: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook
text: Pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [9] from the top east corner of the structure.
Somber Smithing Stone [9]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on the raised platform in Lake of Rot where you fight the Lesser Alabaster Lord .
Descend the ladder at the opposite end of the structure, and kill the scarab at the bottom of the slope for a Somber Smithing Stone [6].
Somber Smithing Stone [6]: Upgrade Material. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab chilling in the water in the Lake of Rot .
Return to the ladder, then drop onto the ledge to the right of it. Go around the ledge and pick up the Preserving Boluses behind a large brazier.
Preserving Boluses: Consumable. Found on a corpse hanging off the edge of the western walkway leading to the Grand Cloister .
In the building northwest of the braziers, you'll find a chest with the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [22].
Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook: Cookbook Item. Found in a chest in a ruin in the western section of the Lake of Rot .

title: Golden Seed
text: Return to the braziers and go down the stairs to discover the Grand Cloister grace.
Continue past the grace and pick up a Golden Rune [10] from the top ledge.
Golden Rune [10]: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse at the bottom level, on the southern walkway.
Make your way down the gaps in the ledges to reach the bottom, then pick up the Golden Rune [10] in front of a large brazier.
Golden Rune [10]: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse by navigating the outer ledges on the highest level of the tall structure near the site of grace.
Bait out the Putrid Tree Spirit near the rot waterfall and kill it to receive a Golden Seed.
Golden Seed: Flask Upgrade Material. Dropped by a non-boss Ulcerated Tree Spirit hiding behind the waterfall at the bottom level.

title: Scorpion's Stinger
text: Grab the Smithing Stone [6] and Smithing Stone [7] in front of the rot waterfall.
Smithing Stone [6]: Found on a corpse at the bottom of the waterfall in Grand Cloister . A huge grotesque creature will ambush you when you pick up the item.
Smithing Stone [7]: Found on a corpse at the bottom of the waterfall in Grand Cloister . A huge grotesque creature will ambush you when you pick up the item.
Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [9], Fan Daggers x8, and Smithing Stone [5] near the group of enemies at the opposite side of the cloister.
Ghost Glovewort [9]: Can be found in the inner section of the cloister, surrounded by Lesser Kindreds of Rot .
Fan Daggers: Offensive Consumable. Found on a corpse near the stairs at the end of the main hall.
Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on the staircase at the end of the main hall.
Ascend the stairs and loot the Scorpion's Stinger from the chest at the end.
Scorpion's Stinger: Dagger . Found in a chest to the very west of the Grand Cloister .

title: Boss: Astel, Naturalborn of the Void
text: Rest in the coffin at the end of the rot stream, then kill Astel, Naturalborn of the Void for Remembrance of the Naturalborn and 80,000 runes. (This earns an achievement.)
Remembrance of the Naturalborn: Remembrance Key Item. Dropped by Astel, Naturalborn of the Void upon defeat.
Astel, Naturalborn of the Void: Legend. Found in an isolated part of the map south of the Lake of Rot . Reach this area by resting in the coffin at south-western Grand Cloister
Grab the Astel, Naturalborn of the Void grace, then use the lift north-northeast of the grace.
A few steps from the lift, you'll discover the Moonlight Altar grace.
Optional: Collect all non-respawning crafting materials in Ainsel River.

links.t: Video: non-respawning crafting materials in Ainsel River

title: Cerulean Amber Medallion +2
text: From the Moonlight Altar grace, head east until you reach the first half of Lunar Estate Ruins:
In the first part of the ruins is a corpse with Glintstone Firefly x5.
Optional: Kill the Revenant spawning in the middle for a Ghost Glovewort [2] (first time).
Pick up a Golden Rune [10] from the corpse near the Revenant.
Golden Rune [10]: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse near the central section of the Lunar Estate Ruins .
Head down the hidden cellar next to an imp seal to grab the Cerulean Amber Medallion +2.

Cerulean Amber Medallion +2: Upgraded Talisman. Found in an underground room in the northwest section of the Lunar Estate Ruins . The entrance is sealed by both an Imp Statue that requires 1 Stonesword Key , as well as an illusory floor that can be dispelled with an attack.

place.title: Lunar Estate Ruins
walk: The Lunar Estate Ruins is home to Wraith Callers and Revenants, and conceals a few secrets.

Far in the eastern section, there is a cellar hidden behind an illusory wall in the dilapidated building. Look for the usual rectangular shape on the ground, then roll onto it to dispel the illusion. Beware, because a Revenant spawns in an adjacent room. The chest below contains Smithing Stone (8) x3.

Head towards the central section of the ruins and you will face another Revenant. Search the ruined buildings for a corpse containing a Golden Rune (10). There is another corpse nearby where you can loot Glintstone Firefly x 5. Three Wraith Callers will spawn in as you approach the body.

A short distance west of the Lunar Estate Ruins icon on the map, slightly north of the road on the map, and directly south of the Cathedral of Manus Celes icon on the map, is a ruined building holding an Imp Statue by a wall. Next to the imp status is an illusory floor leading to another cellar. Dispel the floor and then insert a Stonesword Key into the statue to unlock the seal. Another Wraith Caller will spawn as you do. Inside the cellar is a chest containing the upgraded Cerulean Amber Medallion +2

title: Boss: Glintstone Dragon Adula (Cathedral of Manus Celes)
text: From the cellar, head east toward the other half of the ruins. Optionally, kill the Revenant on the left side of the ruins for a Ghost Glovewort [2] (first time).
Roll through the hidden cellar on the far-left side of the ruins. Loot the chest inside for Smithing Stone [8] x3.
Smithing Stone [8]: Upgrade Material. Three can be found in a chest in an underground area concealed by an illusory floor on the eastern side of the ruins. Attack the floor to reveal the path.
From the second cellar, follow the slope north to a cathedral. Grab the Cathedral of Manus Celes grace inside.
Pick up the 11x Starlight Shards around the cathedral (including the one near the astrolabe).
Starlight Shards: Consumable Item. 9 can be found all around the Cathedral of Manus Celes . One more can be found outside the cathedral, in the north by the cliffs.
Kill Glintstone Dragon Adula outside the cathedral for Dragon Heart x3, Adula's Moonblade, and 120,000 runes.
Adula's Moonblade: Dropped by the Glintstone Dragon Adula in the Cathedral of Manus Celes .

Glintstone Dragon Adula: Great Enemy. This dragon is first found roaming the Three Sisters sub-region in the north. After dealing enough damage to it, it will teleport here outside the Cathedral of Manus Celes . Drops 3x Dragon Hearts and the Adula's Moonblade spell upon defeat.

Dragon Heart: Key Consumable. 3 Hearts by Glintstone Dragon Adula upon defeating it at the Cathedral of Manus Celes . Dragon Hearts are used to acquire Dragon Communion Incantations at the Church of Dragon Communion and the Cathedral of Dragon Communion .

place.title: Cathedral of Manus Celes
walk: Regardless of whether the player fought the Glintstone Dragon Adula at the Three Sisters sub-region in the north or not, it will be present at this location. It will be found guarding the fields leading up to the Cathedral of Manus Celes and can finally be killed at this location. Adula drops 3 Dragon Hearts and the Adula's Moonblade sorcery spell upon defeat, as well as 120000 Runes.

Inside the Cathedral, you will find a total of 9 Starlight Shards scattered across the Cathedral proper. One more can be found outside in the north, by the large stone monument. There is a Site of Grace in the center of the Cathedral.
Look towards the south for a cave amongst the rubble.
Drop down into the cave and follow the linear path to find the body of Ranni sitting on the remains of the Fingers.
Approach the body and there will be a prompt for you to place the Dark Moon Ring on her finger, initiating a cutscene.

Afterwards, Ranni, now fully freed will appear before you. She will confirm that you are now her consort, and promises that you will meet again. She awards you the Dark Moon Greatsword before disappearing.
This will give the player the option of completing the "Age of the Stars" ending at the end of the game.
notes: Manus Celes roughly translates to "Celestial Hand" or "Hidden Hand" in Latin. This is most likely a reference towards the Two Finger resting inside it and the ones whom Ranni killed using the Fingerslayer Blade. Which was provided to her in the quest directly before the events that led the Tarnished towards the Cathedral of Manus Celes.

With the many signs of conflict between the Greater Will and Ranni through out her questline. Specifically the line "I stole Death long ago, and search now for the dark path." in her participation in the Night of Black Knives or the Baleful Shadows that the Tarnished fights if they continue to assist Ranni. The events of the Cathedral of Manus Celes is the culmination of that personal rebellion Ranni seeks. The dead body of the Two Finger assigned to her, drenched in its blood with the Fingerslayer Blade used is her personal action and statement of rebellion. Something that isn't her usual plans and manipulations she has been doing through out her quest.

Adula, the dragon whom the Tarnished will fight here in the Cathedral of Manus Celes has long been a main stay in Ranni's retinue. The description of Adula's Moonblade says "Adula, a devourer of sorcerers, was bested by Ranni and subsequently swore a knightly oath to her Dark Moon." Signifying the Adula of today serves Ranni quite faithfully. Though there is no clear explanation why Adula fights the Tarnished in the Cathedral of Manus Celes. One can argue this is the final test Adula has over the tarnished to replace them as Ranni's main protector. Or it could simply be them being overprotective as Ranni has just recently discarded their physical body.

title: Boss: Alecto, Black Knife Ringleader
text: Just west of the cathedral lies Moonfolk Ruins:
Loot the Rune Arc and Golden Rune [9] in the lower part of the ruins.
Golden Rune [9]: Held by a corpse in one of the edges of the structure.
In a hidden cellar in the upper northeast part of the ruins is a chest with a Somber Smithing Stone [8].

Somber Smithing Stone [8]: Upgrade Material. One found in a chest inside an underground treasure room in the northest section of the ruins. The entrance is concealed by an illusory floor. Hit the floor to reveal the stairs.
Pick up Magic Grease from a corpse in the upper southwest part of the ruins.
Head down the slope southwest of the ruins and pick up Gravel Stone x5 from the corpse behind a sleeping dragon.
Kill the three dragons in the area for 3x Dragon Heart.
Dragon Heart: Key Consumable. Dropped by Dragons upon defeat. Dragon Hearts are used to acquire Dragon Communion Incantations at the Church of Dragon Communion and the Cathedral of Dragon Communion .
Follow the path near the sleeping dragon to a small wood. Kill Alecto, Black Knife Ringleader in the evergaol past the woods for Black Knife Tiche and 80,000 runes.
Alecto, Black Knife Ringleader: Field boss imprisoned within the Ringleader's Evergaol . Drops the Black Knife Tiche Spirit Ashes upon defeat.
Black Knife Tiche: Spirit Ashes. Dropped by Alecto, Black Knife Ringleader upon defeat.

place.title: Ringleader's Evergaol
walk: This Evergaol does not require a Stonesword Key to unlock as the portal mechanism in the center is active as soon as you enter the area. Within, you can challenge Alecto, Black Knife Ringleader, a remarkably agile and aggressive assassin. Upon defeat, Alecto drops the Black Knife Tiche spirit ashes as well as 80,000 Runes.

If you have inspected the statue's book outside of Chelona's Rise in the south, one of the three Giant Ghostly Turtles required to unlock the seal can be found flying high above in the east of the Evergaol.

Along the long stretch of land between Ringleader's Evergaol and Chelona's Rise, you will find a path laden with crystals and several non-boss variants of Crystalians guarding the area. Past this pathway is a large open field with three gazebos by the cliffs. There is a Lesser Red Wolf of Radagon to be fought here which drops 4,518 Runes upon death and does not respawn. Check each gazebo to find a total of 6 Smithing Stone (7) and 3 Smithing Stone (8).

title: Ranni's Dark Moon
text: Return to the path and follow it downhill to an area with three gazebos. Loot the 2x Smithing Stone [7] x3 and Smithing Stone [8] x3 from the gazebos.
Smithing Stone [7]: Upgrade Material. 3 more are found in the right-most gazebo by the cliffs in this area.
Smithing Stone [8]: Upgrade Material. 3 are found in the central gazebo by the cliffs in this area.
Continue down the slope and grab the Altar South grace in front of the tower at the bottom.
Examine the book in front of Chelona's Rise to activate the great wise beasts:
Note: The puzzle resets upon reloading, so you'll need to ride to each location.
#1: The first beast can be found below the cliff west of the tower. [Location 1]
#2: On a high-up ledge below the upper cliff far to the east-northeast of the tower. [Location 2]
#3: Use the spiritspring near the evergaol to hit the wise beast above the trees. [Location 3]
Return to Chelona's Rise and loot Ranni's Dark Moon from the chest at the top.
Ranni's Dark Moon: Sorcery Spell. Found in a chest at the top of Chelona's Rise after unlocking the tower's seal.

place.title: Chelona's Rise
walk: Along the long stretch of land between Ringleader's Evergaol and Chelona's Rise, you will find a path laden with crystals and several non-boss variants of Crystalians guarding the area. Past this pathway is a large open field with three gazebos by the cliffs. There is a Lesser Red Wolf of Radagon to be fought here which drops 4518 Runes upon death and does not respawn. Check each gazebo to find a total of 6 Smithing Stone (7) and 3 Smithing Stone (8). Chelona's Rise is found further south from the gazebos.

Chelona's Rise, like most field towers is sealed by a barrier upon initial visit. There is an Imp Statue by the entrance holding a glowing book, asking you to "seek three great wise beasts". The Great Wise Beasts in question are Giant Ghostly Turtles that you will need to search for and attack. Unlike most towers, the locations for these are spread very far apart on this entire plateau.
Important: Do NOT fast travel or rest at a site of grace while looking for the turtles or the turtles you have not destroyed will despawn until you examine the statue again.
## First Location
The first turtle can be found directly west of the tower, hanging by the cliff face.Use a ranged attack or a melee skill with AoE to hit it. Map Link
## Second Location

The second turtle is found far to the east, south of Lunar Estate Ruins. Southeast of Lunar Estate Ruins is a corner curve in the road, south of that is a cliff with ledges that allow you to safely jump lower. Head towards the edge of the plateau and look down to see the turtle sitting on a lower cliff. Map LinkOccasionally this turtle does not spawn and can potentially be skipped.
NOTE: To ensure the turtle spawns, make sure to start at the Altar South Site of Grace then move east. Fast traveling to other Sites of Grace in the area can cause the turtle to not spawn.
NOTE 2: If you can't see the turtle at the cliff, try to throw a AoE spell or item (even an arrow should work) where it should be. Then head to the third turtle.
## Third Location

The final turtle is found southeast of Ringleader's Evergaol, flying high above. There is a Spiritspring nearby that you can jump from with Torrent, flying through the turtle while in the air. It's very obvious to see under the spiritspring, if you don't see the turtle, try going to Altar South, interacting with the imp statue book, then running to the Spiritspring. Map Link

NOTE: If you can't see the turtle midair, try jumping at the Spiritspring anyway. It may take some tries, but if you hit the right place where the turtle should be a message will show up saying that the tower is now open.
Once all three turtles are killed, you will be notified that the seal has unlocked. Make your way up the tower to find a chest with the Ranni's Dark Moon spell.
notes: If you do use a site of grace to reach one of the turtles faster, it will not appear. However, you can make them visible again. To solve the Elden Ring Chelona's Rise turtles not spawning bug:Go back to the tower and read the book again, then return to the location of the turtle without hopping across sites of grace.

title: Dark Moon Greatsword
text: Drop down the hole in Cathedral of Manus Celes and place the ring on Ranni's finger. Talk to her afterward to receive the Dark Moon Greatsword.
Dark Moon Greatsword: Greatsword . Found below the Cathedral of Manus Celes after progressing Ranni 's questline.

title: Talk to Ranni the Witch
text: Ranni the Witch: �� Ranni the Witch can be found in the Cathedral of Manus Celes

title: Royal Greatsword, Blaidd's Set
text: Optional: Talk to the miniature Ranni while resting at the Ranni's Chamber grace.
Kill the hostile Blaidd outside Ranni's Rise to obtain the Royal Greatsword and Blaidd's Set.
Royal Greatsword: Obtainable at the end of Ranni's questline; Blaidd will spawn in front of Ranni's Rise tower. Best him in combat for a final time to obtain this weapon along with his armor set.
Blaidd's Set: Return to Ranni's Rise after giving Ranni the Dark Moon Ring , to find Blaidd who will become hostile. The set is dropped by defeating him, except for the helmet.

title: Iji's Mirrorhelm
text: Inform Iji of Blaidd's death, then reload the area to find Iji's Bell Bearing and Iji's Mirrorhelm on his anvil.

Iji's Mirrorhelm: Need to confront Blaidd during Ranni's questline. War Counselor Iji will have new dialogue available. After that, his corpse can be found near his usual spot at the Road to the Manor Site of Grace . The anvil has Iji's Mirrorhelm as well as Iji's Bell Bearing .

title: Ash of War: Sacred Order
text: Travel to Magma Wyrm Makar and use the lift northwest of the grace. A few steps from the lift, you'll discover the Abandoned Coffin grace.
Follow the dirt path west of the grace to a scarab that drops Ash of War: Sacred Order.
Ash of War: Sacred Order: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in Altus Plateau, just north of the Site Of Grace.

guide.title: Exploring Altus Plateau
text: Elden Ring Map: Altus Plateau Starting Point. The Altus Plateau, northeast of Liurnia, is your next destination. There are two ways to access it: fight your way up through the cliffside dungeon at Ruin-Strewn Precipice (the red-outlined hole on the map, accessed from the northern canyon of Liurnia of the Lakes), or use the left and right halves of the Dectus Medallion at the Grand Lift of Dectus.

Entering from Ruin-Strewn Precipice is better as you can obtain several crafting materials, including a Dragon Heart and Golden Seed within it. You will head up to the plateau from Magma Wyrm Site of grace and can pick up the Ruler's Set shortly after.

You are now at the Abandoned Coffin site of grace ( see it on the map here). Head West from this site of grace and defeat a Teardrop Scarab to loot Ash of War: Sacred Order. Further east, Perfumer's Ruins has the Omenkiller Set, Perfumer's Cookbook (1), and Perfumer's Talisman. Nearby, Unsightly Catacombs has valuable Ghost Glovewort (5) and Grave Glovewort (4) to loot, as well as the Perfumer Tricia spirit ash from the dual boss of the dungeon.

Return to Abandoned Coffin and follow the road north toward Lux Ruins, Ancient Dragon Lansseax will appear and stand in your way but it's an optional fight as you can just run past if you prefer, heading to meet Millicent and collect a Golden Seed before veering slightly south to Erdtree-Gazing Hill and Lux Ruins. Ash of War: Shield Crash can be looted from a teardrop scarab here, and the Greatshield Talisman from a chest further east.

title: Omenkiller Set
text: Farther along the path lies Perfumer's Ruins:
Pick up Budding Cave Moss x4 from a corpse past the far-right entrance to the ruins.
Budding Cave Moss: Material. Found on a corpse surrounded by Miranda Flowers in Perfumer's Ruins .
Kill the Omenkiller in the middle of the ruins to obtain the Omenkiller Set (first time).
Omenkiller Set: The Omenkiller Robe , Long Gloves and Boots drops from Omenkiller after defeating in Perfumer's Ruins .

title: Perfumer's Cookbook [1], Perfume Bottle
text: Loot the Perfume Bottle and Perfumer's Cookbook [1] in the middle, then grab the Golden Rune [5] from a hole in the wall.
Perfumer's Cookbook [1]: Located at a chest west of the table with the candles on it.
Perfume Bottle: One Perfume Bottle is near the chest that holds Perfumer's Cookbook [1] . The other one is in the back section, under the Giant Poison Flower in the ruin's basement cache.
Golden Rune [5]: Located on one of the south facing walls, where the main table with the candles is.

place.title: Perfumer's Ruins
walk: This guide assumes you're entering the ruins from the east, which is where you'll likely come from. Recommended to prepare poison curing items or to be sure you can handle poison. When approaching, you will likely be attacked by Perfumer enemies. They are easy to beat and there are 3 of them in the ruins. They throw explosive bottles at you. In the ruins, there are yellow Poison Flower pretty much everywhere. It can be a good idea to clear them to make sure you have safe terrain to fight the more dangerous enemies.

In the middle of the ruins is an open place with a table, guarded by an Omenkiller (strong enemy using two big weapons). The Omenkiller Set can be looted in this location as wellYou can sneak behind him and stealth attack him. He's pretty dangerous and has a fire breathing attack. Once killed, you can safely loot the Perfume Bottle on the floor near the table, and the Perfumer's Cookbook in the chest.

In another room near the back of the ruins is a yellow Giant Poison Flower. It will easily poison you. Killing it will reveal a passage behind it to find a tiny room with a Nascent Butterfly crafting item. There is another perfume bottle on the ground here and stairs going down to a door, inside of which is a chest containing Perfumer's Talisman.
There is nothing else to do in these ruins, but just south-west/below them are the Unsightly Catacombs locked by an imp statue.

title: Perfumer's Talisman
text: Pick up the Perfume Bottle and Nascent Butterfly around the Miranda Blossom in the upper part of the ruins.
Nascent Butterfly: Material. Looted from a corpse lying in an enclosed space in Perfumer's Ruins .
Head down the cellar covered in planks next to the Miranda Blossom to grab the Perfumer's Talisman.
Perfumer's Talisman: In a chest underground below stairs in the room with the yellow Giant Poison Flower.

title: Winged Misbegotten Ashes
text: In the cliffside below Perfumer's Ruins lies the entrance to Unsightly Catacombs:
Head inside and grab the Unsightly Catacombs grace.
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [5] from the corridor that loops around the stairs.

Grave Glovewort [5]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 3 can be found inside the Unsightly Catacombs . The first is found in the first big hall with multiple levels. Go through the side corridors towards the back to find the glovewort. The second one is found by going down one level and heading to the connecting room in the east, behind the Winged Misbegotten and Rotten Stray. The last one is found in a corner of a pit you drop into from an L-shaped staircase.
In a corridor down the stairs, you can find another Grave Glovewort [5].
Continue to another set of stairs and pick up the Grave Glovewort [4] at the bottom.

Grave Glovewort [4]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 3 are found within the Unsightly Catacombs . The first one is found in the room with the L-shaped staircase. The second one is found by dropping into the pit from the L-shaped staircase and heading through the corridor in the north. The last one is found in the dark hall just before the boss' door.
Drop down next to the stairs, and loot the Winged Misbegotten Ashes and Ghost Glovewort [5] from the floor with Misbegotten corpses.
Winged Misbegotten Ashes: Spirit Ash. Found on a corpse in a pit inside the Unsightly Catacombs .
Ghost Glovewort [5]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Found by the wall in the pit you drop into from the L-shaped staircase.

place.title: Unsightly Catacombs
walk: The Unsightly Catacombs is a small dungeon found beneath the Perfumer's Ruins in Altus Plateau. The entrance is located in the southwest of the cliff face below the ruins and is barred by an Imp Statue Seal, requiring 2 Stonesword Key to gain entry. These Catacombs are a good source of Grave Glovewort upgrade materials for strengthening your Spirit Ashes (provided you have progressed Roderika's questline).

A few steps from the entrance, you will find a Site of Grace to rest and modify your equipment. Be warned, this is the only Site of Grace for this dungeon and there is a fairly difficult boss fight at the end of the catacombs, with plenty of agile Misbegotten enemies along the way that can easily catch you with their very wide, very quick swings. Small pockets and corridors are lit but it is recommended you equip a Torch for the darker zones.

Head down the steps ahead of the Site of Grace to enter the first set of corridors of the dungeon. There is a Misbegotten laying here that you can ambush with ranged attacks before it can act. Straight ahead is a Summoning Pool just before the turn, should you wish to summon for help. The next hall contains two of the wingless, but larger Misbegotten carrying halberds and patrolling the left and right corridors. If you wait, you can sneak up behind them to perform a critical attack and get a decent amount of damage in. Do not be fooled by their large size and lumbering walk animation. These creatures are incredibly agile and like to perform wide swings and attacks with lots of travel. They can also very quickly roll towards you to close the distance. There is nothing special on this floor so you can head down the steps in the middle after either dispatching the Misbegotten or sneaking past them.

Down the next level, be careful of the Misbegotten hiding in the right corner. There is a Grave Violet near where it was sitting. Look for the path leading east. There is a Misbegotten and Winged Misbegotten at the end of this path. Go to where they were to pick up the Grave Glovewort [5] by the wall then look for the corridor heading south to find the stairs to the next level down. A Grave Glovewort [4] can be found in your path as well as a Winged Misbegotten at the end of the corridor. Note that this corridor leads to yet another lower level with a locked door at the end. That is your goal, but first look to the right of the last glovewort for a pit you can jump down to. If you are a ranged or magic user, you can safely target the misbegotten enemies from up here before jumping down. Otherwise, take them out carefully as you land below. There is a total of 4 Misbegotten in this pit that are lying down. When you get down, check the southern wall for a corpse containing the Winged Misbegotten Ashes so you can summon one of these agile warriors for yourself. A Ghost Glovewort [5] lies in the corner as well.

Look for the lit corridor and pick up the Grave Glovewort [4] along the way. At the bend is a set of steps leading up one level. There is a statue at the center here with a lever in front of it, used to unlock the door leading to the boss. Check the corridors around the statue for a Rune Arc and the Prattling Pate "Apologies" reusable item. If you look at the center of this level, you can jump down the middle to reach the pit connecting to the formerly locked door but before you do, look out for the Ogre now roaming the area. Consider using ranged attacks and spells to safely take it out from up here before jumping down.

When ready, proceed through the locked door and the fog gate behind it to challenge this dungeon's Boss Encounter: Perfumer Tricia. This fight is particularly difficult due to the fact that Tricia is accompanied by an extremely aggressive Misbegotten Warrior who has his own boss health bar. It is highly recommended that you bring along a strong and tanky Spirit Ash summon of at least +5 in order to distract the Misbegotten while you take Tricia out. See the Perfumer Tricia page for details on the fight. Defeating the boss duo awards you with Perfumer Tricia Ashes.

title: Prattling Pate
text: Pick up the Grave Glovewort [4] on the way to the boss lever and pull it.
Grab the Rune Arc and Prattling Pate "Apologies" in the looping corridor around the lever, then drop down for a Grave Glovewort [4].
Prattling Pate: Reusable Item. Found on a corpse in the Unsightly Catacombs , along the corridors in the room with the lever that opens the final door.

title: Boss: Perfumer Tricia
text: Kill Perfumer Tricia & Misbegotten Warrior for Perfumer Tricia and 9,400 runes.
Perfumer Tricia: Optional Duo Boss Fight. Perfumer Tricia is found at the end of the Unsightly Catacombs and is accompanied by a Misbegotten Warrior.
Perfumer Tricia Ashes: Dropped from Perfumer Tricia at the Unsightly Catacombs

title: Black Hood, Candletree Wooden Shield
text: From the catacomb entrance, head east-northeast to find a corpse with Gold Firefly in the water, guarded by three Miranda Sprouts.
Just east of the corpse lies the entrance to Sage's Cave:
Enter and activate the Sage's Cave grace.
Hit the illusory wall past the grace, then the illusory wall near some cave moss to reveal a room with Lost Ashes of War and Rejuvenating Boluses x5.
Rejuvenating Boluses: Consumable. Found in a chest behind a illusory wall in Sage's Cave .
Pick up the 2x Golden Rune [5] from the corpses farther in the room.

Golden Rune [5]: Consumable. Found on a body in the Wyndham Catacombs in the room behind the rusted bars in the sewers. Can be reached by going under the raising floor in the room with the spike ceiling.
Hit the illusory wall between two braziers in the room to find chests with Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot x5, Black Hood, Candletree Wooden Shield, and Nascent Butterfly.
Black Hood: In the Sage's Cave , in a treasure chest behind an illusory wall.
Candletree Wooden Shield: In the Sage's Cave , in a chest behind an illusory wall.
Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot: Consumable. Found in a chest behind a illusory wall in Sage's Cave .
Nascent Butterfly: Consumable. Found in a chest behind a illusory wall in Sage's Cave .

title: Stonesword Key
text: Continue to a room with multiple enemies. Hit the illusory wall behind a Skeletal Militiaman to find a chest with a Stonesword Key.
Stonesword Key: Can be found behind an illusory wall, in the same room where you fight an Axe Skeleton, within Sage's Cave

title: Raptor Talons
text: Loot Golden Great Arrow x10, Dragonwound Grease x4, and Raptor Talons from the three chests up ahead.
Golden Great Arrow: Consumable Ammunition. Found in a chest in Sage's Cave .
Raptor Talons: Located at Sage's Cave , in one of the chests, behind several secret walls

title: Raptor's Black Feathers, Skeletal Mask
text: In the room with the waterfall, take the left tunnel to an illusory wall and loot the Raptor's Black Feathers and Skeletal Mask behind it.
Raptor's Black Feathers: Inside Sage's Cave , in a chest behind an illusory wall. Alongside Skeletal Mask .
Skeletal Mask: Inside Sage's Cave , in a chest behind an illusory wall. Alongside Raptor's Black Feathers .

title: Boss: Necromancer Garris
text: Hit the illusory wall near the chests and kill Necromancer Garris for Family Heads and 9,000 runes.
Necromancer Garris: One of the bosses of Sage's Cave . Drops flail: Family Heads
Family Heads: Flail. Dropped from boss of Sage's Cave , Necromancer Garris.

title: Boss: Black Knife Assassin (Sage's Cave)
text: Turn back and follow the other path. Kill the invisible Black Knife Assassin for Concealing Veil and 9,000 runes.
Concealing Veil: Talisman dropped by the Black Knife Assassin boss within Sage's Cave
Black Knife Assassin: Secret boss within Sage's Cave . Drops Concealing Veil talisman.

place.title: Sage's Cave
walk: Past the Site of Grace, make your way forward until you reach an apparent dead end. There is an illusory wall here.
Go past until you encounter a skeleton near a waterfall. Passing another illusory wall to the right, you will find two chests containing Lost Ashes of War and Rejuvenating Boluses x5.
Jump down this waterfall, then pick up two Golden Rune (5). To your left is an illusory wall with four skeletons and four chests behind it.
You can get Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot x5, Black Hood, Candletree Wooden Shield, and a Nascent Butterfly.
Four skeletons await you in the next room, among which is one with a large axe and more health. Another one faces a wall which is illusory, hiding a chest containing a Stonesword Key.

The next room holds three more chests with Golden Greatarrow x10, Raptor Talons, and Dragonwound Grease x4. Proceed until you are in an open cave with a waterfall, jump to the left, then hug the left wall and roll into the apparent dead end to uncover two more chests with Raptor's Black Feathers and Skeletal Mask.
Roll through the illusory wall on the opposite side of the room and get ready to fight Necromancer Garris who drops Family Heads.
Make your way back to the waterfall and stay left to face the other boss, the invisible Black Knife Assassin.

If you buy Sentry's Torch from the Hermit Merchant for 7000 Runes, you can put it in your off-hand to make her visible (even if you two-hand your main-hand weapon). One strategy is to fight her (without buying the item) is to simply stand on the patch of dirt, and watch for her footsteps in the water. You'll have to time your swing to hit her -- a weapon with a horizontal attack spread makes this easier.
After defeat, she drops the Concealing Veil.
notes: This location has several secret walls, the Host of Fingers can dispel them with a single attack, jumping or rolling.

title: Ruler's Set
text: Note: Your spirit summon will know its location at all times.
Travel to Abandoned Coffin and pick up a Smithing Stone [5] between two carriages just northeast of the grace.

Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. A total of 6 can be found in the Old Altus Tunnel : The first is found by the wall to the right of the first storage shed you encounter. In the main chamber with the wooden walkways, head to the right and climb the ladder into a smaller cavern with a storage shed. Check the cavity in the wall concealed by explosive barrels to find the second one. Back on the wooden walkways, take the path to the left of the ladder to find the third stone by the wall. The fourth one is in the bottom of the main chamber, by a wall in the east side. In the same area, check the space between the southern shed and the wall for the fifth stone. In the same area, go behind the northern shed and follow the tunnel to a small cavern to find the sixth stone.
Head up the slope with carriages and pick up Fulgurbloom x5 from the top of one on the right.
Pick up the Ruler's Set from one of the last carriages near the path.
Ruler's Set: Found on a corpse laying face-down on a carriage northeast of the Abandoned Coffin Site of Grace . You'll find it alongside the Ruler's Mask .

title: Boss: Ancient Dragon Lansseax
text: Ancient Dragon Lansseax: A large white 4 winged dragon.

title: Talk to Millicent
text: Optional: You'll be ambushed by Lansseax farther up the slope. After dealing some damage to her, she'll fly away.
In the area southeast of where you're ambushed is a heap of carriages with a Nascent Butterfly on top.
Return to the path on the slope and follow it to the Erdtree-Gazing Hill grace.
Optional: Talk to Millicent on the cliff north-northeast of the grace.
Millicent: Found at the hill.

title: Golden Seed
text: Grab the Golden Seed near the grace, then head toward the large encampment down the slope:
Golden Seed: Found just south of where Poison Pods are located. Found besides a glowing tree.

title: Greatshield Talisman, Troll's Golden Sword
text: Pick up Lightning Grease from a corpse in the middle of the lower camp.
Lightning Grease: Consumable. Looted from a corpse in the middle of a camp in Altus Plateau
Grab the Greatshield Talisman and Troll's Golden Sword from the carriages in the lower camp.
Greatshield Talisman: Found in a chest on a Wagon East of Grace "Erdtree-Gazing Hill" behind Ancient Dragon Lansseax.
Troll's Golden Sword: In a Chest on a Black Carriage, which can be found east of Erdtree-Gazing Hill site of grace.

title: Sacrificial Twig
text: Pick up Warming Stone from a corpse in the middle camp.
In the camp southeast of the middle camp lies a corpse with Fan Daggers x5.
Fan Daggers: Offensive Consumable. Looted from a corpse in a small encampment in Altus Plateau .
In the camp north-northeast of the middle camp sits a chest with a Sacrificial Twig.
Sacrificial Twig: Can be found inside a chest at an enemy camp.

title: Boss: Godefroy the Grafted
text: From the lower camp with the carriages, head south downhill until you reach a tunnel with Hefty Beast Bone x2.
Unlock the evergaol past the tunnel and kill Godefroy the Grafted for Godfrey Icon and 26,000 runes.
Godefroy the Grafted: Optional Boss. Imprisoned within the Golden Lineage Evergaol . Drops the Godfrey Icon upon defeat.
Godfrey Icon: Talisman . Dropped by Godefroy the Grafted when defeated.

place.title: Golden Lineage Evergaol
walk: To get to the Evergaol, start at the Altus Plateau site of grace and head south of the Grand Lift of Dectus. Once at the edge of the cliff behind the lift, head to the far east side of the cliff, where you can jump down along a path that will lead you to the bottom. Upon reaching the arena you can go against Godefroy the Grafted who will share similar movements and attacks as one of the early bosses, Godrick the Grafted without reaching phase 2 and added fire. Defeating Godefroy will reward players with a Godfrey Icon Talisman, which can enhance charged spells and skills, along with 26,000 Runes. Alternate route starts from the Altus Plateau Site of Grace, head northeast into the valley, then switch back south through a tunnel under the main road. On the other side of this tunnel, you'll see the Golden Lineage Evergaol. Activate the evergaol with one Stonesword Key to fight Godefroy.

title: Ash of War: Shield Crash
text: Travel to the Altus Plateau grace and head toward the broken wagon northwest of it to find a Lightningproof Dried Liver.
Lightningproof Dried Liver: Consumable. Found on a wrecked carriage near the Altus Plateau Site of Grace
On a lower ledge east of the wagon lies a corpse with String x5.
String: Material. Looted from the corpse of a Demi Human surrounded by other demi-humans, located in Altus Plateau
Head toward the top of the slope to enter Lux Ruins:
Pick up String x3 and a Golden Rune [3] from the ruined building.
Kill the teleporting scarab in the back of the ruins to obtain Ash of War: Shield Crash.
Ash of War: Shield Crash: Ash of war with no affinity, dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in the Lux Ruins .

place.title: Lux Ruins
walk: To reach Lux Ruins, from the Altus Plateau site of grace or the Grand Lift of Dectus, head north, veering slightly west till you come a cross some ruined structure, which will be the Lux Ruins. The area surrounding the ruins will be teeming with Demi-Human enemies with chances to drop Falchion, String, Rickety Shield and other Materials. Be wary of the bushes and shrubs as you pass. In this area you can obtain Ash of War: Shield Crash dropped by a Teardrop Scarab amongst the ruins. Elden Ring Map here.
If you're ready to face the boss, head down towards the fog gate to face the Demi-Human Queen Gilika. Elden Ring Map

Aim for her legs and it should be an easy boss fight. After her defeat you can go ahead and open the gate to reveal that chest that obtains the Ritual Sword Talisman, Elden Ring Map here which raises attack power when HP is at maximum.

Note that some of Lux Ruins are on the bottom of the cliff, at Erdtree-Gazing Hill site of grace, this part of the ruins has no items and you cannot access Lux Ruins proper from this area on foot -- you must use Torrent to double jump onto the ruins.

title: Boss: Demi-Human Queen Gilika
text: Kill Demi-Human Queen Gilika in the cellar for 8,500 runes.
Demi-Human Queen Gilika: Field boss found inside the Lux Ruins

title: Ritual Sword Talisman
text: Loot the Ritual Sword Talisman from the chest in the cellar.
Ritual Sword Talisman: Located in Lux Ruins , in a chest after defeating Demi-Human Queen Gilika

title: Boss: Tibia Mariner (Limgrave)
text: Drop down the cliff northwest of the cellar to discover a corpse with Lightningproof Dried Liver.
Head up the northeast slope past Millicent to reach Wyndham Ruins:
Kill the Tibia Mariner in the water for Deathroot, Tibia's Summons, and 14,000 runes.
Tibia Mariner: Optional Boss. Found riding its boat in the flooded areas of Summonwater Village . Defeat it to progress D's questline.
Deathroot: Key Item. Obtained upon defeating the Tibia Mariner .

title: Talk to D, Hunter of the Dead Summonwater Village
text: D, Hunter of the Dead Summonwater Village: D may be encountered at the southern entrance of Summonwater Village

title: Pearldrake Talisman +1
text: In the isolated ruin closest to the cliff, you'll find a Smithing Stone [5].
Loot the Human Bone Shard x5 and Golden Rune [3] from the ruins in the water.
Grab the Stormhawk Feather x4 in front of the main entrace to the ruins, then pick up the Golden Rune [7] in the corner behind it.
Go up the stairs past the entrance to find a Golden Rune [4].
Unlock the cellar in a ruined building and loot the Pearldrake Talisman +1 from the chest.
Pearldrake Talisman +1: Upgraded Talisman. Found in an cellar near the top of the Wyndham Ruins . The entrance requires a Stonesword Key to unlock.

place.title: Wyndham Ruins
walk: There are many destroyed buildings and half broken walls left from what used to be a thriving region, with many overgrown by the plants and trees or half submerged in the water. Players will find many skeletons strewn around, waiting to rise up and attack you. Some of these skeletons attack from range with a crossbow, remember to destroy the body to end them.
A Tibia Mariner boss can be encountered in the waterlogged section of the ruins to the south. It drops a Deathroot and the Tibia's Summons spell upon defeat.

Near the top of the Ruins is a small staircase into a underground area overgrown by tree roots, this area is sealed by an imp statue so players will have to use a Stonesword Key to access it. Within you will find 3 skeletons in a small room guarding a metal door, one of them is a Skeleton Mage, behind the door you will find a treasure chest with a Pearldrake Talisman +1.
At the very top of the ruins, you can find the entrance to the Wyndham Catacombs pressed against the side of a cliff.

title: Lightning Scorpion Charm
text: In one of the corners of the uppermost building is a corpse with Dappled White Cured Meat.
Dappled White Cured Meat: Consumable. Found on a corpse sitting on the ground in Wyndham Ruins , on an enclosed space.
At the top of the slope lies the entrance to Wyndham Catacombs:
Head inside and activate the Wyndham Catacombs grace.
Take the lift down while facing west, then walk off to a ledge with a Grave Glovewort [5].

Grave Glovewort [5]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Two are found inside the Wyndham Catacombs : The first one is found as you are descending the lift from the entrance. Face towards the west wall and jump onto a balcony as the lift passes it by to find the glovewort. The second one is found shortly after the room with the cleaver traps, in a pile of rubble in the corner.
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [4] from the room with a cleaver.

Grave Glovewort [4]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Two are found within the Wyndham Catacombs . The first is found in the room with the cleaver traps, at the back. The second one is found in the sewer area, right where the Golden Order Knight is fought.
In the small room up ahead is a Grave Glovewort [5].
Descend the stairs to a sewage room with a Ghost Glovewort [6] and a Grave Glovewort [4].
Ghost Glovewort [6]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Found in the sewer area amongst the Putrid Corpses.
Unlock the imp seal up the ladder to obtain the Lightning Scorpion Charm.
Lightning Scorpion Charm: Found in Wyndham Catacombs in a room sealed by an Imp Statue, requires a Stonesword Key .

place.title: Wyndham Catacombs
walk: Reached by travelling east from the Seethewater River Site of Grace.

Leaving the Wyndham Catacombs Site of Grace the only room at the top of the catacombs is the locked door with the 2 statues, locked by some contraption. Moving past this door is a room with an elevator, beware of the trap button between the rooms as this will fire a row of 3 lightning shots 3 times. The elevator is a simple platform with a button that players can step on to get the elevator to move. At the top and bottom of the elevator shaft are levers that will call the elevator to the player when needed.

Once at the bottom of the elevator shaft hit the button once more to have it rise then roll off onto the ledge above to collect the Grave Glovewort on the ledge above. The first room outside the elevator shaft has 2 imps throwing lightning bombs as well as a large guillotine trap cutting the room in half that raises and drops repeatedly. Past this room around the corner is a room with 2 imps, one on the far wall from where you enter as well as one directly on the right of the entrance. In both rooms, hitting an imp with multiple Crystal Darts will briefly stun them, before sending them into a berserk state. This berserk state will cause the imps to attack the closest target, including other imps, making it ideal for drawing out ambushes and weakening groups.

Following the path down the narrow stairs brings you into the large underground sewer area with watery ground and many Skeletal Slimes and Putrid Corpses. There is a lightning trap hidden in the water in the middle of the room, stepping on the trap will cause lightning to strike down around the trap, enemies do not trigger the trap but the trap rearms quickly so watch out and avoid the damage. Moving forward and around the bend players will find a Leyndell Knight defending the way forward.

At the top of the ladder watch out for the trap on the ground close to the ladder that will fire lightning bolts from behind. There is an imp statue sealing the room ahead and a path leading left, on the crossroad an Imp will attack you so be ready. The sealed room requires a Stonesword Key to open and holds the Lightning Scorpion Charm but otherwise has no enemies or other loot.

The next room in the Catacombs is the room with the spike ceiling and a raising floor platform. If the player is standing on the platform when it is raised to the top, the floor will raise rapidly to stab the player into the ceiling repeating until they are off the platform or dead. This room has 2 imps that throw lightning bombs, one ahead where the player can see is the way forward and one above the entrance. To get across without taking damage from the spikes, step on the platform to make it rise, then turn around and off into the alcove behind you before it reaches the ceiling, taking care not to get staggered by the waiting imp. Kill it and collect the Grave Violet, then quickly jump back on the platform while it's lowering back into place and run straight across to where the lighting pot throwing imp was standing. This gives the player more time to move across the room while the mechanism resets and raises again. In this final room is an imp directly on the right of the entrance holding a large sword, as well as another Leyndell Knight. The lever to open the locked doors are found here. Similar to getting across the first time, to get out, step on the platform to have it raise, jump back off immediately, then jump back on while it's resetting. Use this to reach the hallway you initially entered the room from. Trigger the floor one final time, this time immediately jumping off and waiting for it to rise above you. Jump down to the darkened sewer area below.

From this area a tunnel will lead you to the other side of the barred off area you initially saw while fighting the Putrid Corpses. You will see a body holding the Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook (1), but exercise caution while collecting it, as approaching the body will prompt two Giant Crabs to emerge from below you. The rusted gate can only be opened via a lever to its right, so be prepared to fight the crabs or kite them down the tunnel so you can open gate and escape. Remember that there is a lightning trap hidden in the water where you fought the Putrid Corpses.
BOSS BATTLE: Erdtree Burial Watchdog

The boss for these catacombs can be found past the originally locked doors. This is a variant Erdtree Burial Watchdog that has a lightning tail with additional moves and can shoot lightning at the player. The Boss will charge lightning very visibly then fire it at the player giving the player time to move behind a pillar or prepare to time a dodge or block. While in their seated form the Watchdog will float up and towards the player before slamming their sword down, they will also now spin with their sword when close to the player to do damage. As always, Erdtree Burial Watchdogs are immune to all status, but weak to strike damage. You can also briefly stun it by hitting it with several Crystal Darts in a row, which will cause it to enter a berserk state. You can use this to force it to attack a durable Spirit Ash while you keep your distance, or to force it to attack you while a ranged Spirit Ash deals steady damage. This effect can be reapplied whenever it expires, for an easy boss fight.

title: Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook [1]
text: Head straight across the impaling floor to pull the lever in the room above.
Drop down beneath the floor as it's rising, then loot the Magic Grease x2, Golden Rune [5], and Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook [1] guarded by Giant Crabs.

Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook [1]: Found on a body in the Wyndham Catacombs , in the room behind the rusted bars in the sewers. Can be reached by going under the raising floor in the room with the spike ceiling.
Magic Grease: Found in the room behind the rusted bars in the sewers. Can be reached by going underneath the raising floor in the spiked room.

title: Boss: Erdtree Burial Watchdog (Wyndham Catacombs)
text: Kill the Erdtree Burial Watchdog for Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [1] and 12,000 runes.
Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [1]: Dropped by the Erdtree Burial Watchdog boss of the Wyndham Catacombs
Erdtree Burial Watchdog: Optional boss found at the end of the Wyndham Catacombs . Drops Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing (1) upon defeat.

title: Ash of War: Barrage
text: Return to the entrance, then make your way down the southwest cliff to grab the Seethewater River grace at the bottom.
Kill the large scarab in the river to obtain Ash of War: Barrage.
Ash of War: Barrage: Ash of War. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab found in the narrow channel north of Seethewater River.

title: Golden Seed
text: On a ledge southeast of the scarab is a corpse with Arrow x10.
Follow the river until you reach a Golden Seed on the left.
Golden Seed: Flask Upgrade Material. Found under a Phantom Tree as you exit the narrow channel north of Seethewater River.

title: Ash of War: Blood Blade
text: In front of a rock farther north is a Smithing Stone [5]. Save the rest of this area for later when exploring Mt. Gelmir.
Smithing Stone [5]: Found on a body in the southern section of
Travel to Erdtree-Gazing Hill and follow the dirt path north of the encampment. Kill the scarab floating above the water for Ash of War: Blood Blade.
Ash of War: Blood Blade: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in Altus Plateau, northeast of Erdtree-Gazing Hill, flying above a pond with trees.

title: Boltdrake Talisman +1
text: Continue along the path past the water to find the sealed entrance to Old Altus Tunnel behind a Troll:
Unlock the imp seal and loot Explosive Stone Clump x3 from a corpse on the right.
Take the lift down and grab the Old Altus Tunnel grace.
On the wall beside a hut is a Smithing Stone [5].

Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. A total of 6 can be found inside the Altus Tunnel : In the first cavern past the Site of Grace, head through the door on the right to find the first stone in the far wall. Back in the main path, head east into the next cavern. The second stone can be found just past the entry point, to the right. In the same cavern, check under the wooden walkway for the third stone. Still in the same cavern, check next to the overgrown root in the southeast to find the fourth stone. The fifth stone is found in the cavern with the boss door, to the left just as you enter. The final stone is also in the cavern with the boss door, next to a root on the left, closer to the boss door.
Climb the ladder on the wooden platforms to a room with Boltdrake Talisman +1 and Stanching Boluses.
Boltdrake Talisman +1: An upgraded version of the Boltdrake Talisman. Found in a storage shed inside the Old Altus Tunnel dungeon.
Stanching Boluses: Consumable. Found on a corpse in Old Altus Tunnel , behind some boxes besides a shack.

guide.title: Altus Plateau
text: Elden Ring Main Quest Guide - Altus Plateau Points of Interest
Travel to Altus Plateau
Speak to Millicent
Complete Old Altus Tunnel
Complete The Shaded Castle
Travel to the Golden Lineage Evergaol
Complete the Second Church of Marika and Minor Erdtree
Explore the Eastern Altus Heights
Unlock Mt Gelmir's site of grace

guide.title: The Old Altus Tunnel
text: These tunnels are located southwest of the Bridge of Iniquity in Altus Plateau. The location may be difficult to find due to the large amounts of similarly jagged, rocky hills in the area. The entrance is barred by an Imp Statue which requires 2 Stonesword Key to dispel the fog. The Old Altus Tunnels are a rich source of Cracked Crystals. There are countless amounts of these items found all over the walls and they respawn whenever you rest at a Site of Grace. Be sure to be on the lookout for these if you need them for crafting. Inside, you will predominantly encounter Miners and Zombie Dogs. There are also a couple of Nobles guarding the workers.

From the entrance, check behind the wall on the right for a corpse with 3 Explosive Stone Clumps. Descend the lift to find the Site of Grace. Note that this is the only Site of Grace within these tunnels, but the dungeon isn't particularly long either. When ready, head down the first corridor to find a few barrels and a storage shed on the left. Beware the red barrels marked with a white stripe. These are explosive barrels and can be set off with fire damage. However, you can also use these to your advantage if you have any fire spells. Inside the shed are a Miner and Zombie Dog waiting behind the barrels. Look outside the shed and to the right for a Smithing Stone [5].

Next, you will arrive in a large cave with lots of wooden walkways. Follow the closest one to the right and head up the ladder. This leads to a room with second storage shed on the right and 2 miners chipping away at the crystals while a Noble guards them. Take out the Noble first and two dogs should come rushing out of the shed. After defeating them, check the shed for a Boltdrake Talisman +1, which is an upgrade to the original talisman. Check around the left side of the shed to obtain Somber Smithing Stone [6]. Outside the shed and to its right, you can find Stanching Boluses amongst the crates. In the small alcove right of where the miners were, there is another Smithing Stone [5] behind the barrels. Head back out to where you climbed the ladder and this time, drop down onto the storage shed below to get to the lower level.

Before jumping down, consider taking the enemies below out with ranged attacks from the roof of the storage shed you jumped on. There is a Noble and two enemies here who are quite powerful and tanky but should be rendered helpless with a ranged onslaught from your unreachable location. When you finally drop below, check the shed you were on top of for a Smithing Stone [4]. There is another Smithing Stone [5] in the small space between the shed and the east wall. The shed on the opposite side has a Troll Hammer but watch out for the dogs inside. Check the alcove east of the sheds for yet another Smithing Stone [5]. You can climb up the long ladder here to get to a wooden walkway with two Miners. You will find another Smithing Stone [5] by the walls and a Golden Rune [6] on a corpse in this area. Get back down to the lower level and look for a tunnel on the west side which leads to a small room with a dog and a miner. Defeat them and check the crystals in the room for a Smithing Stone [5] and a Somber Smithing Stone [5].

Finally, go back to the long ladder and head through the tunnel behind it to reach a fog gate that leads to the dungeon's boss: The Stonedigger Troll. This boss is quite simple and is easy to punish at range if you use your Spirit Summons to distract it. Watch out for its roar which can knock you down, allowing the troll to follow up with a devastating smash with its club. Upon defeat, the boss drops the Great Club hammer weapon and 9,600 Runes - exit and continue following the canyon north until you come to a poisonous area, this is the Shaded Castle.

title: Troll's Hammer
text: On the walls around the room, you can pick up a Smithing Stone [5] and a Somber Smithing Stone [6].

Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. A total of 5 can be found inside the Sealed Tunnel : In the hidden chamber past the Site of Grace, drop off the ledge into the lower section and check the alcove in the back for the first stone. In the same chamber, head west to find a chest ( Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing (2) ). Dispel the illusory wall behind the chest to reveal a lift but ride it. Instead, drop down the ledges on the left to find the second stone. At the bottom of the lift chamber, look to the south and dispel two illusory walls to reveal a large cavern with overgrown roots. Navigate the roots to reach the tunnel in the east and drop down an opening on the right to find the third stone in the back. Beware of the exploding Abnormal Stone Clusters . In the same chamber with the exploders, look for a set of wooden stairs. The fourth stone can be found on a wall next to these stairs. Still in the same chamber, check the wall opposite the stairs. Beware the exploder hidden behind crates and barrels. Hit the wall to reveal a deep pit with roots strewn across. Drop down to the second root and check the ledge in the corner for the final stone.

Somber Smithing Stone [6]: Upgrade Material. Two are found inside the Old Altus Tunnel : When entering the main chamber with the wooden walkways, head to the right and climb up the ladder to a small cavern. Check to the left of the storage shed to find the stone. You may need to crouch/roll to get into the opening. The second stone is found in the bottom level of the main chamber, behind the southern shed.
Drop to the wooden platforms to the right of the ladder. Pick up the Golden Rune [6] and Smithing Stone [5] at the end.
Golden Rune [6]: Consumable. Looted from a corpse in Old Altus Tunnel
Smithing Stone [5] A: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse in an alcove in the southern battlements.
Drop onto the roof of the hut below the ladder to reach an elevated Smithing Stone [5] on the wall.
Smithing Stone [5] B: Upgrade Material. Found on a body between a large dead tree and the southern ramparts.
Go through the northwest tunnel behind the hut to find 2x Smithing Stone [5] and a Somber Smithing Stone [5].
Smithing Stone [5] D: Upgrade Material. Found on a body in the corner atop the eastern inner walls. You can access this area by climbing a ladder in the eastern side of the inner courtyard.
Somber Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. One can be found inside the Altus Tunnel . In the second cavern, head up the wooden platform and look along the walls on the right to find the stone.
Head back and loot a Somber Smithing Stone [4] and Troll's Hammer from the corpses in the huts.
Troll's Hammer: Hammer Weapon. Found in a storage shed inside the Old Altus Tunnel dungeon.

place.title: Old Altus Tunnel
walk: These tunnels are located southwest of the Bridge of Iniquity in Altus Plateau. The location may be difficult to find due to the large amounts of similarly jagged, rocky hills in the area. The entrance is barred by an Imp Statue which requires 2 Stonesword Key to dispel the fog. The Old Altus Tunnels are a rich source of Cracked Crystals. There are countless amounts of these items found all over the walls and they respawn whenever you rest at a Site of Grace. Be sure to be on the lookout for these if you need them for crafting. Inside, you will predominantly encounter Miners and Zombie Dogs. There are also a couple of Soldiers guarding the workers.

From the entrance, check behind the wall on the right for a corpse with 3 Explosive Stone Clumps. Descend the lift to find the Site of Grace. Note that this is the only Site of Grace within these tunnels, but the dungeon isn't particularly long either. When ready, head down the first corridor to find a few barrels and a storage shed on the left. Beware the red barrels marked with a white stripe. These are explosive barrels and can be set off with fire damage. However, you can also use these to your advantage if you have any fire spells. Inside the shed is a Miner and Zombie Dog waiting behind the barrels. Look outside the shed and to the right for a Smithing Stone [5].

Continuing on, you will arrive in a large cave with lots of wooden walkways. Follow the closest one to the right and head up the ladder. This leads to a room with a second storage shed on the right and 2 miners chipping away at the crystals while a Soldier guards them. Take out the soldier first and two dogs should come rushing out of the shed. After defeating them, check the shed for a Boltdrake Talisman +1, which is an upgrade to the original talisman. Check around left side of the shed to obtain Somber Smithing Stone [6]. Outside the shed and to its right, you can find Stanching Boluses amongst the crates. In the small alcove right of where the miners were, there is another Smithing Stone [5] behind the barrels. Head back out to where you climbed the ladder and this time, drop down onto the storage shed below to get to the lower level.

Before jumping down, consider taking the enemies below out with ranged attacks from the roof of the storage shed you jumped on. There is a Soldier and two Gold Dragon Cult Knights here who are quite powerful and tanky but can be lured to your location one by one. (Make sure you're standing under the platform above when they jump down, so that they can't do a plunging attack). When you finally drop down, check the shed you were on top of for a Somber Smithing Stone [4]. There is another Smithing Stone [5] between in the small space between the shed and the east wall. The shed on the opposite side has a Troll's Hammer but watch out for the dogs inside. Behind this shed is another Somber Smithing Stone [6]. Check the alcove east of the sheds for yet another Smithing Stone [5]. You can climb up the long ladder here to get to a wooden walkway with two Miners. You will find another Smithing Stone [5] by the walls and a Golden Rune [6] on a corpse in this area. Get back down to the lower level and look for a tunnel in the north side which leads to a small room with a dog and a miner. Defeat them and check the crystals in the room for a Smithing Stone [5] and a Somber Smithing Stone [5]

Finally, go back to the long ladder and head through the tunnel behind it to reach a fog gate that leads to the dungeon's boss: The Stonedigger Troll. This boss is quite simple and is easy to punish at range if you use your Spirit Summons to distract it. Watch out for its roar which can knock you down, allowing the troll to follow up with a devastating smash with its club. Upon defeat, the boss drops the Great Club hammer weapon and 9,600 Runes.

title: Boss: Stonedigger Troll (Altus Plateau)
text: Pick up the 2x Smithing Stone [5] and Somber Smithing Stone [6] on the walls in the room.

Smithing Stone [5] C: Upgrade Material. Found on a body in the corner behind the Large Poison Flower, in the northwest of the outer courtyard. You can access this area by getting up on the western ramparts and following it north past the rock barricade.
Somber Smithing Stone [6]: Found on a body sat on a chair overlooking the edge, there is a wolf sat next to them.
Kill the Stonedigger Troll for Great Club and 9,600 runes.
Great Club: Hammer Weapon. Dropped by the Stonedigger Troll boss inside the Old Altus Tunnel upon defeat.
Stonedigger Troll: Optional Boss encountered in the Old Altus Tunnel dungeon. Drops the Great Club weapon upon defeat.

title: Invader: Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan +1
text: Return to the entrance and head east to pick up a Golden Rune [3] on the tip of a long slanted rock.
Golden Rune [3] C: Found on a body lying at the top of a pillar.
Use the spiritspring east of the rock while facing northwest, then jump across the gap to the northwest ledge to find a Nascent Butterfly.
Drop down from the ledge and follow the path north toward the Shaded Castle. Kill Maleigh Marais in the area left of the castle for Antspur Rapier and Marais Set.
Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan: Non-Invader Hostile NPC. Found in the fields west of The Shaded Castle . Drops Antspur Rapier , Marais Mask and Marais Robe upon defeat.
Antspur Rapier: Thrusting Sword. Dropped by Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan upon defeat.
Near a Golem at the end of the rocky area is a Smithing Stone [5].

Smithing Stone [5] E: Upgrade Material. Found on a body being chewed up by a Rotten Stray on the roof of the northeastern building. This can be accessed by crossing the northern ramparts from the northwestern building and then climbing up the stairs in the northeastern building.
Go behind the castle to find an astrolabe with Starlight Shards near the cliff edge.
Head around the outside of the castle rampart until you see a Golden Rune [3] guarded by four slugs in front of the castle.
Golden Rune [3] D: Found on a body laid by the wall, surrounded by 4 Poison Slugs
In the poison farther east-southeast, you'll find a corpse with Poison Grease.
Poison Grease: Consumable. Can be scavenged from a corpse lying in the poison pool outside the Shaded Castle .
Climb the slanted rocks near the corpse to enter the castle, then pick up Poisonbloom x4 from the left end of the rampart.
Go up the stairs on the left to grab the Shaded Castle Ramparts grace.

title: Champion's Song Painting
text: From the Shaded Castle Ramparts, follow the northeast stretch of the rampart and pick up a Golden Rune [6] from the alcove on the right.
Golden Rune [6] B: Rune Consumable. Found on a body sat in front of a series of tombstones in the inner courtyard.
Loot the Glass Shard and Poisonbone Dart x5 in the poison pond near the alcove.
Poisonbone Dart: Offensive Throwable. 5x found on a body in the middle of the poisoned area by the eastern rampart.
Enter the wooden structure near the pond and interact with the painting to obtain the "Champion's Song" Painting.
Champion's Song Painting: Champion's Song painting found in a small wooden structure on the side of the eastern walls.

title: Valkyrie's Prosthesis
text: Return to the grace and descend the ladder to the swamp. Pick up the Smithing Stone [4] in the wooden structure.
Smithing Stone [4] B: Upgrade Material. Found on a body inside a wooden structure that looks like a stable, pressed against the eastern section of the inner courtyard.
South of the wooden structure is a stone platform. In a secluded area past the stone platform, you'll find a wooden ramp with a Golden Rune [6].
Golden Rune [6] C: Rune Consumable. Found on a body sitting on the eastern battlements.
In the secluded area, loot the Smithing Stone [5] next to a tree, then the Drawstring Fire Grease x2 around a rooftop.
Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse leaning against a rock.
Drawstring Fire Grease: Found on a body in the corner between some rubble and a sunken building.
Climb the rooftop west of the stone platform to reach a rampart with a Smithing Stone [5] at the end.
Return to the rooftop in the poison swamp, then pick up Beast Blood near the building farther north.
Beast Blood: Material. Looted from a corpse on the edge of the second room with a chariot and a lava pool in Gelmir Hero's Grave .
Optional: Kill the Revenant behind the building for a Ghost Glovewort [4] (first time).
Ghost Glovewort [4]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Found on one of the rocks near the dead tree at the western end of the outer courtyard of The Shaded Castle .
Grab the Somber Smithing Stone [5] on the corpse near the Revenant.
