Somber Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. Found on a body by the dead tree on the western end of the outer courtyard, next to the western rampart.
Pick up Neutralizing Boluses x2 from the left end of the rampart, accessible from the top of the building near the Revenant.
Neutralizing Boluses: 2x found on a body on the western ramparts of The Shaded Castle .
At the opposite end of the rampart is a small enclosed area with a putrid Miranda Blossom. Grab the Smithing Stone [5] behind it.
Return to the poison swamp and climb the ladder in the middle. Head left along the rampart to find Glass Shard x2 on the edge.
Glass Shard: Material. Found on the farthest corpse of a trio of corpses outside Seethewater Cave in Mt. Gelmir
Loot the chest at the end to obtain the Valkyrie's Prosthesis.

Valkyrie's Prosthesis: Key Item. Found by climbing up the ladder in the central-western section of the courtyard that leads up to the top of the inner walls. Follow the walls northwest to find a room with a chest surrounded by statues and guarded by a single Cleanrot Knight .

title: Perfume Bottle
text: Head back along the rampart and drop down to the inner poison swamp. Next to the large tree is a Golden Rune [6].
Golden Rune [6] A: Rune Consumable. Found on a body inside the walls, on top of a broken wooden platform jutting out from the ground.
Go up the stairs in the middle, then climb the ladder on the left to find a Golden Rune [4].

Golden Rune [4]: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse laying on the outer edges of the northwestern building. You can reach this area by climbing a ladder along the western walls of the main keep's grounds.
Activate the Shaded Castle Inner Gate grace just past the ladder.
Head back down the ladder and optionally kill the Revenant in the area up the stairs for a Ghost Glovewort [4] (first time).
Pick up Rot Grease x3 from the corpse near the Revenant.
In the wooden structure in the poison swamp, you'll find a Smithing Stone [4].
Smithing Stone [4] A: Upgrade Material. Found on a body hanging off a ledge inside a wooden structure in the central outer courtyard.
Climb the ladder in the poison and pick up a Smithing Stone [5] behind some crates at the left end of the rampart.
Continue along the rampart to find a corpse with a Perfume Bottle at the end.

Perfume Bottle: Key Crafting Item. Found on a body hanging by the edge of the top part of the inner ramparts. You can reach this area by climbing a ladder in the eastern section of the inner courtyard and following the ramparts as it curves to the west.

place.title: The Shaded Castle
walk: The Shaded Castle can be found in the North part of the Altus Plateau between the Mt. Gelmir and the Altus Plateau regions and can be seen while crossing the rope bridge between them near the Bridge of Iniquity Site of Grace. The castle is half-sunken into a poisonous bog with the air tinged yellow by the fumes. The castle can be reached by heading north in between the cliffs between the regions, heading east and north from the Old Altus Tunnel Site of Grace is a good way to get there. The Second Church of Marika is close to this area, though a safe way down to the valley from there may be difficult to find and navigate.

To enter the Castle players can use their steed to jump over low parts of the wall to get on top of the walls. One way in can be found following the wall to the northwest and climbing the rocks into the wall. Another way in can be found on the northeast side, keep close to the wall when the ground raises to find a low wall that can be jumped into. The northeast entrance is recommended as this entrance is close to the Shaded Castle Ramparts Sites of Grace, follow the wall southwards to find this Site of Grace.

Along the top and within the castle walls players will find Putrid Corpses as well as some Depraved Perfumers. A variation of Depraved Perfumers using a shield and throwing fire can also be found on the walls. Many Slugs can be found on the ground but also latch on the walls of the castle. 2 Boss enemies from other areas appear in The Shaded Castle as regular enemies, Revenants show up in 2 different places on the castle grounds while Lesser Cleanrot Knights can be found in a few different areas atop the walls and within the castle.

From the Shaded Castle Ramparts Site of Grace, there is a ladder that leads into the castle area. A large amount of the castle grounds are covered in poison, walk carefully between safe or raised areas to not accumulate poison status while exploring or fighting in this area of The Shaded Castle. Using ranged attacks and abilities can be very effective in this part of the castle as you stand in safe places or use the height and range advantage of being on the walls to easily deal with the enemies. Within the walls of the castle, there are a few large dead trees that can be seen from far away, powerful enemies can be found under them but also many bodies with treasures found on them. A Royal Revenant can be found under the black tree in the northwest around bodies that hold a Ghost Glovewort (4) and a Somber Smithing Stone (5). You can find a Smithing Stone (5) and Drawstring Fire Grease under the tree in the south of the castle.

There are also many rocks that jut out from the ground creating small pockets within the castle grounds where enemies and treasure lie. Within the east side of the outer wall, north from the Shaded Castle Ramparts site of grace, is a small area with the south side walled by rocks. Walking down the stone pillar into the area players will be able to see the "Champion's Song" Painting on the right within a wooden structure, to get to the painting there are a set of stairs at the bottom that players can walk up. Following the outers walls of the castle in the northwest area, there is an area where one can find a Giant Miranda Sprout along with many Putrid Corpses, a Smithing Stone (5) can be found in the corner behind it.

To get further into the castle, there is a ladder leading up to the inner west wall, going over this wall will bring you into the next area of the castle and give you access to the next Site of Grace as well as the ladders up to the main castle areas. Going along the top of this wall, heading to the west, you will find a Lesser Cleanrot Knight at the end defending the entrance to a small room there. Defeat them to get to the chest that has the Valkyrie's Prosthesis within. Going east along the wall you will find Putrid Corpses and one particularly large one on the wooden bridge.

From the inner west wall, you can climb over the roofs of the broken buildings to get across the gap and reach the Shaded Castle Inner Gate Site of Grace. Alternatively, you can go up the stairs in the middle of this courtyard area then head left to the Site of grace all the same. The inner east wall can be reached by a ladder that leads up from the inner part of the wall on the east side of the courtyard. At the top of this wall are some enemies but also the Perfume Bottle and a Smithing Stone (5) for players to loot. Taking a few steps back on the wall, you can kick a ladder that leads to the outer courtyard. On its left, you see a set of stone pillars, leading to a corpse (that you saw on a stone pillar in the outer courtyard but couldn't reach) bearing a Stonesword Key.

Teleport back to the Shaded Castle Inner Gate Site of Grace. In the middle part of the courtyard up the stairs is a small garden area where a Royal Revenant will spawn and attack the player, also in this garden is a Rot Grease on a body.

Heading up into the castle you will start seeing Rotten Strays and other humanoid enemies within the buildings. Be careful of the small spaces in the buildings and walkways and of being swarmed by multiple enemies. The rooms here have many statues and bookshelves, with enemies hiding behind some of them, the rooms do not have great lighting so a torch is a good idea. Within the first room after going up the ladder there is a Wandering Noble wielding a sword waiting on the side of the entrance ready to jump you. Inside this first room are a ladder with a ranged enemy next to it and a Page hiding behind the statues. Taking the ladder up will bring you to an open area with no enemies, the Perfumer's Cookbook (2) can be found here on the body sat on the chair.

Leaving the room leads to an open walkway with a bridge that reaches to the other side and the next tower up. On the right is a Rotten Stray chewing on a body, loot the body for a Hefty Beast Bone. A Lesser Cleanrot Knight can be found on the bridge blocking the way, once across the bridge the next room has many statues but also 2 Page enemies, one behind the statues and one up the stairs. 2 Gold Fireflies can be found on a body at the back of the room.

Going up the stairs leads to the upper courtyard area of the castle, this is the last area with enemies before the boss and also where a ladder can be found that when kicked down will help create a shortcut from the Inner Gate Sites of Grace. Another Lesser Cleanrot Knight can be found defending the central tower, there are also two rotten strays in this area, one larger than the other; be careful with being surrounded by them. Once this area is clear, head to the opposite side of the courtyard from the entrance to find a lit brazier near the edge with a ladder to kick down. There is also a tower with two Aeonian Butterflies on a tower that can only be reached by jumping onto the south wall and walking to the southeast corner, then jumping to the tower.
Once you make it back to the area you just jumped from, the central tower holds an elevator for players to go up, across the bridge at the top is the boss fight for this area.
BOSS BATTLE: Elemer of the Briar

Elemer of the Briar is a humanoid boss that primarily uses one large sword to fight the player that deals a large amount of damage with their attacks. The large greatsword it uses and the shield on its back are both dropped when the boss is defeated. While this boss is a melee fighter, the sword that the boss uses can be thrown and used at a range, the boss can even continue attacking at range before retrieving its sword. Watch out for when its arm or weapon glows red to dodge out of the way of its attacks.

After beating the boss, in the hall where it was defeated, the Castellan's Hall Site of Grace appears and becomes available to use and he drops the Marais Executioner's Sword along with the Briar Greatshield.

title: Stonesword Key
text: Turn back and kick the ladder down the stairs. Do a running jump toward the large rock formation, climb around its east side, then drop down next to a branch sticking out of a rock to reach a Stonesword Key. [See video]
Stonesword Key: Found on a body on a stone ledge, reached by traversing the rocks leading from the eastern wall all the way to the ledge. A set of slugs can be found underneath looking at the body.

title: Perfumer's Cookbook [2]
text: Return to the grace and continue to a dark room with a ladder. Climb it and pick up Perfumer's Cookbook [2] from a chair at the top.
Perfumer's Cookbook [2]: Found on a corpse sitting on a chair on the roof of the northwestern building. You can reach this area by climbing a series of ladders in the Castellan's Hall building.

title: Boss: Elemer of the Briar
text: Head back down and pick up Hefty Beast Bone x4 from the corner outside the room.
Hefty Beast Bone: Found on a body on the walkway up in the castle area, to the right when exiting the first room after the ladder up.
Pick up Gold Firefly x2 from the room across a bridge.

Gold Firefly: 2 Gold fireflies can be found on a body at the end of a room full of statues. There are 2 Page enemies within this room as well, 1 hidden behind the statues and one on top of the stairs.
Grab the Smithing Stone [5] outside the room, then kick the shortcut ladder next to a brazier.
Take the lift up and kill Elemer of the Briar for Marais Executioner's Sword, Briar Greatshield, and 24,000 runes. (This earns an achievement.)
Elemer of the Briar: Found inside The Shaded Castle . Drops Marais Executioner's Sword and Briar Greatshield
Briar Greatshield: Dropped by Elemer of the Briar inside the The Shaded Castle .
Marais Executioner's Sword: Dropped by Elemer of the Briar inside the The Shaded Castle .

title: Desperate Prayer
text: Activate the Castellan's Hall grace after the fight.
Return to Millicent and give her the Valkyrie's Prosthesis.
Tell Gowry that you gave Millicent the prosthesis, then talk to him about Millicent.
Buy Pest Threads from Gowry, then talk to him about Malenia to learn the Desperate Prayer gesture.
Feed Gurranq the Deathroot to receive Beast Claw.
miss: The gesture is missed if not received before completing the final steps in Millicent's questline.

title: Perfume Bottle, Boss: Fallingstar Beast
text: From the Altus Highway Junction, head south-southeast toward a campsite on the left with Beast Blood.
Beast Blood: Material. Found on a corpse lying on the ground in a small abandoned campsite in Altus Plateau
Head up the slope east of the campsite to reach a mining field. In one of the pits lies Gravity Stone Fan x4.
Gravity Stone Fan: Offensive Consumable Item. Found on a corpse by the cliffs.
Pick up Gravity Stone Chunk x2 from a pit farther northeast.
Kill the Fallingstar Beast at the top for Somber Smithing Stone [5], Smithing Stone [6] x5, Gravity Stone Fan x10, Gravity Stone Chunk x10, and 11,000 runes.
Head up the slope east from the Altus Highway Junction. Behind a Miranda Blossom at the top lies the entrance to Perfumer's Grotto:
Head inside and activate the Perfumer's Grotto grace.
Pick up the Living Jar Shard x5 next to a Miranda Blossom in the first room.
Loot Perfume Bottle and Living Jar Shard x10 from the chests behind a branch in the second room.

Perfume Bottle: Crafting Material. One bottle can be looted from a chest inside Perfumer's Grotto . In the second area after encountering the second Giant Poison Flower , turn back towards the corner to find two chests, one of which contains the bottle.
Fallingstar Beast: Optional boss. Found directly south of the large bridge. The map will display a large crater there, which is where it will spawn.

place.title: Perfumer's Grotto
walk: Once you reach the entrance to the grotto, there will be a Site of Grace to take a rest. Continue through and once you reach a fork in the path where it drops down to the left, take the right tunnel so you wouldn't have to drop off to the left. This will take you to the same area. This is where you may encounter some perfumers and gain a chance to obtain some of the Perfumer Set, such as the Perfumer Hood, Perfumer Robe, Perfumer Gloves, Perfumer Sarong. There will also be a Giant Poison Flower in the vicinity.

Check for loot under the platform on which you entered, there is an Altus Bloom there. Proceed to the next room to the right to find more of the same, there are two chests containing Living Jar Shards and a Perfume Bottle. Proceed to find a Malformed Star. Defeat it and continue over the log path to obtain Arteria Leaves and continue across the branches. If you look down, there is an unreachable section of wooden platforms. This is part of the Altus Tunnel dungeon.
This area seen from the log crossing is accessible from the Altus Tunnel. Elden Ring Map Link

There are various items and two Poison Flowers before the boss. Be prepared to fight an Omenkiller and Miranda the Blighted Bloom simultaneously. There will also be another Giant Poison Flower in the arena.
notes: It makes sense to assume that this location is some sort of hideout for the poachers who attack Jarburg, hence the number of living jar shards the tarnished can find inside.

title: Boss: Miranda the Blighted Bloom (Perfumer's Grotto) +1
text: Kill the Withered Astel ahead, then pick up the Arteria Leaf x3 on the root.
Arteria Leaf: Material. Found on a corpse at a dead end in Altus Tunnel
Loot the Miranda Powder x6, Warming Stone, and 2x Golden Rune [5] before the boss.
Miranda Powder: Once you are back inside, roll onto the blocked door, and loot this on your left. You will get x10 Miranda Powder.
Golden Rune [5]: Found within Perfumer's Grotto in the area just outside the fog gates at the end of the tunnel.
Kill the Omenkiller & Miranda the Blighted Bloom for Great Omenkiller Cleaver and 8,400 runes.
Great Omenkiller Cleaver: Greataxe. Dropped by the boss duo of Perfumer's Grotto : Omenkiller and Miranda the Blighted Bloom .
Miranda the Blighted Bloom: Miranda the Blighted Bloom is encountered in a Duo Boss Fight with an Omenkiller inside the Perfumer's Grotto . Defeating them both awards the Great Omenkiller Cleaver .
Omenkiller: An Omenkiller encountered in a Duo Boss Fight with Miranda the Blighted Bloom inside the Perfumer's Grotto . Defeating them both awards the Great Omenkiller Cleaver .

title: Perfume Bottle
text: Return to the Altus Highway Junction and head north-northwest toward an Omen camp. Pick up the Perfume Bottle under a tent.
Perfume Bottle: Located south of the Second Church of Marika . North Altus Highway Junction, in the small camp next to the Erdtree sappling, enemies are guarding a body with the bottle.

title: Sacred Tear
text: Just west of the Omen camp, you'll find a campsite with Turtle Neck Meat.
From the campsite, head north toward a sword monument. Drop down the cliff past it and grab the Sacred Tear in the church.
Sacred Tear: Found inside the Second Church of Marika

title: Nagakiba
text: Talk to Yura inside the church, then loot the Nagakiba from his corpse.
Nagakiba: Can be obtained by completing Bloody Finger Hunter Yura's questline at the Second Church of Marika

title: Ash of War: Piercing Fang
text: Optional: His weapon is equipped with Ash of War: Piercing Fang. Remove it to make it available for compatible weapons.

title: Invader: Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger +2
text: Shortly after, you'll be invaded by Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger. Kill her to obtain the Purifying Crystal Tear and Eleonora's Poleblade.
Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger: After talking to Bloody Finger Hunter Yura at the Second Church of Marika
Purifying Crystal Tear: It can be found at the Second Church of Marika after defeating the invader Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger
Eleonora's Poleblade: Dropped by Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger

title: Mirage Riddle
text: In the graveyard behind the church is a corpse with Human Bone Shard x6.
Human Bone Shard: Crafting Material. Looted from a corpse lying near a grave at the Second Church of Marika .
In the lower graveyard farther north is a corpse with Magic Grease.
Drop down the cliff east of the corpse and touch the blue phantom crest in the corner.
Pick up the Miquella's Lily in front of a gravestone north of the phantom crest.
Miquella's Lily: Crafting Material. Can be grabbed from a gravestone near Mirage Rise in Altus Plateau
Touch the phantom crest east-northeast of the gravestone and examine the book next to it to receive the Mirage Riddle.

place.title: Second Church of Marika
walk: If you get near the Church you get invaded by Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger. Once at the church approach the main statue area to retrieve the Sacred Tear. A Lesser Sanguine Noble will attack if Bloody Finger Hunter Yura did not make it to this location during his questline.

title: Talk to Bloody Finger Hunter Yura
text: Bloody Finger Hunter Yura: Found at the Second Church of Marika.

title: Unseen Blade, Unseen Form
text: Below the ledge south-southeast of the book, you'll find a corpse with a Golden Rune [3].
Golden Rune [3]: Consumable. Can be found at the cemetery near the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite site of grace in Mt. Gelmir .
Kill the scarab surrounded by three Wormfaces east of the corpse to obtain a Somber Smithing Stone [5].
Grab the Bower of Bounty grace northeast of the scarab.
Go up the slope south of the grace, then turn left and hit the fake boulder near the cliff edge to reveal the final phantom crest.
Follow the cliff edge northeast to find Fulgurbloom x4 on a ledge below the broken bridge.
Return to Bower of Bounty and head north-northwest to a ledge at the end with a Nascent Butterfly, guarded by three Wormfaces.
Nascent Butterfly: Material. Can be gathered under the broken bridge in Altus Plateau
From the ledge, head southwest toward the now revealed Mirage Rise. Loot Unseen Blade, Unseen Form, and Slumbering Egg x5 from the top of the tower.
Unseen Blade: Found at the top of Mirage Rise. Can be found alongside Unseen Form
Unseen Form: Found at the top of Mirage Rise. Can be found alongside Unseen Blade
Slumbering Egg: Material. Looted from the body sitting in a chair atop Mirage Rise in Altus Plateau

place.title: Mirage Rise
walk: Talking to its imp statue will reward you with the Info item Mirage Riddle. The corresponding map is tilted 90 degrees clockwise. On it, the locations of all three mirages are shown:
The first is immediately to the right of the Imp Statue.
The second is south-south-west in an alcove.
The third is further east near the broken bridge, hidden underneath an illusory rock with a faint glow that disappears when attacked.

Touching all three will cause the tower to appear. Inside, climb the ladder and reach the top level to find a chest containing the Sorceries Unseen Blade and Unseen Form, as well as remains with a Slumbering Egg.
Below are some spoilers to their exact locations plotted on the map within Mirage Rise. Be careful when running towards the Phantom crest seals as they may spawn some enemy guardians.

The first two of the crests are fairly visible upon arrival in the general location since they glow. When looking for the last crest, shown closest to the Bower of Bounty Site of Grace, just below the ruined bridge on the map, there will be a boulder that will radiate a slight glow. Hit it to reveal the last crest.

title: Boss: Wormface
text: Return to the grace again and pick up Hefty Beast Bone x2 from a corpse below the broken bridge northeast of the grace.
Hefty Beast Bone: Material. Looted from a corpse near the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge site of grace, below the bridge itself.
Continue northeast and kill the giant Wormface for Crimsonspill Crystal Tear, Speckled Hardtear, and 10,000 runes.
Crimsonspill Crystal Tear: Flask Upgrade. Dropped by Wormface upon defeat.
Speckled Hardtear: Flask Upgrade. Dropped by Wormface upon defeat.
Wormface: Boss located at the base of the Minor Erdtree. Drops Speckled Hardtear and Crimsonspill Crystal Tear

guide.title: Other Points of Interest in Altus Plateau
text: Once you've completed this location, there are a few things you may want to check before proceeding to the next area:

Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan: Located on the west side, outside of The Shaded Castle, is a hostile NPC who will chase and attack you when you are seen. Defeating this hostile NPC will drop the House Marais Set and Antspur Rapier.
Golden Lineage Evergaol: Evergaol is located in the south-western Altus Plateau. Godefroy the Grafted is imprisoned within. Defeating the boss drops the Godfrey Icon talisman.

You can follow now follow the main road north and activate the Altus Highway Junction site of grace, nearby you can meet Boc the Seamster and advance his quest. North from here, the road takes you to a Golden Seed and Map (Altus Plateau) to reveal the region.

Slightly north, talk to Brother Corhyn who is looking for the Goldmask. Directly east from the Altus Highway Junction Site of Grace, follow the road until it breaks off north into an open cave, in the cave the Amber Starlight will be sitting below a statue surrounded by octopus ball creatures. - you need this item for Seluvis's quest if you are doing it, but in this playthrough, we have already bypassed his side-quest.

Keep following the road north then go West to visit the Second Church of Marika and loot the Crystal Tear there. Bloody Finger Hunter Yura will be here, and if you talk to him you will trigger an invasion from Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger, who allows for the acquisition of Purifying Crystal Tear alongside Eleonora's Poleblade. This is a VERY useful item for an upcoming Boss fight, and doing Yura's quest is not necessarily required for her to spawn, but the triggers are unclear at this time.

Return to the road and follow it to the valley with the Minor Erdtree. The tree is protected by Wormface, a boss that drops Speckled Hardtear and Crimsonspill Crystal Tear. There's also a Golden Seed slightly north and west of the tree. Within this valley, you will find Mirage Rise to the west, which asks that you find symbols in the valley to unlock the tower and gain the Unseen Form and Unseen Blade spells. To the East, Altus Tunnel has Smithing Stone (5) upgrades and the Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing (2). Woodfolk Ruins has an underground cellar with Wrath of Gold in a chest, another one with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook (19), and a teardrop scarab with Ash of War: Golden Slam in the northern area of the ruins.

Go north of the minor erdtree through a small village area. Take a right on the cobblestone path at the intersection. Continue through the small wooded area, be careful of a ballista/catapult that will be shooting at you. On your left there is a lookout tower. Near it you can find a Golden Seed. From this point East, enemies will shoot at you with deadly ballistae and catapults. Instead of going East toward the capital, go north into Dominula, Windmill Village. Here you can defeat the Godskin Apostle boss that drops the Scouring Black Flame incantation, after which you can talk to Millicent again. The area also has the Goskin Peeler twinblade and Celebrant's Skull warhammer.

If you return to the road, there's the option to head East into Lyndell, Capital City outskirts. We will leave this for later and instead take the lower road southeast. This will bring you to an unnamed ruins where a noble will transform into a Lion Guardian. Defeat it to get a Larval Tear, then continue following the road until you come to an elevation with lightning and Ancient Dragon Lansseax. This is an optional fight, and west from here there's another boss encounter with a Black Knife Assassin just outside the Sainted Hero's Grave. The grave has the Crimson Seed Talisman and Dragoncrest Shield Talisman +1. South from here, Stormcaller Church has a Sacred Tear, as well as the Dragonbolt Blessing incantation.

You have now successfully looted the eastern part of Altus Plains, so backtrack to Dominula, Windmill Village, and head west instead. Following the main road without going up you will arrive to meet Goldmask near the collapsed bridge. The lower area has Radiant Gold Mask helm. After interacting with Goldmask, go back to Brother Corhyn near the Altus Highway Junction site of grace and tell him of your finding. He will move to Goldmask's location.

Travel back to Goldmask and Corhyn will have more incantations to sell, and dialogue that you should exhaust to progress his quest. To the north from here, in the higher areas, the Windmill Pastures (East and West) hold the Noble's Set, Battlemage Set, and Giant Rat Ashes. You can do a quick sweep of this before dropping back to the road and taking the Great Stars Warhammer from the enemy Hearse traveling here. Following this road West leads you directly to Mt. Gelmir, but it's a good idea to follow it until the Bridge of Iniquity site of grace to activate it for teleporting. The road ahead from here is a dead end with difficult enemies leading to an invasion by Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater, and the Golden Vow (Spell).

title: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [19], Ash of War: Golden Slam
text: Enter the ruins north of the boss for Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [19], a scarab that drops Ash of War: Golden Slam, and a corpse with Beast Blood x2.
Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [19]: Can be found on the ground inside of the smaller ruined building at Woodfolk Ruins in Altus Plateau .
Ash of War: Golden Slam: Sacred affinity Ash of War. Obtained by defeating a Teardrop Scarab in the northern section of the Woodfolk Ruins .
Beast Blood: Material. Scavenged from a corpse lying in a crumbled ruin in Altus Plateau .

place.title: Woodfolk Ruins
walk: You will find Woodfolk Ruins just east of the Minor Erdtree in Altus Plateau. Upon reaching the area, there will be several Lesser Wormface roaming the ruins. There's also an underground chamber, and there are usually three Lesser Wormface guarding the entrance so you'll have to take them out. Going down the stairs will lead you to a door, open the door and then you'll see a chest inside, the chest contains the Wrath of Gold.

Run back up the stairs, there's a smaller ruined building within the area, you will find the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [19] just laying on the ground beside a wall. You will also encounter a Teardrop Scarab spawn in the area, kill it to obtain the Ash of War: Golden Slam.
There's also a building nearby, beware of the enemies inside, this is where you can obtain the Icon Shield.
The Soft Cotton can be located near the ruins as well, guarded by snail like enemies.

title: Icon Shield
text: Farther northeast lies the second part of Woodfolk Ruins, where you can find the Icon Shield and Gravel Stone x2.
Icon Shield: Found inside a crumbling building. Beware of the enemies inside.
Gravel Stone: Material. Can be found in the ground at a crumbled ruin, north of Woodfolk Ruins

title: Wrath of Gold
text: South of the second part, behind two Wormfaces, you'll find a corpose with Invigorating White Cured Meat.
Invigorating White Cured Meat: Found on a corpse guarded by two wormface enemies in Woodfolk Ruins .
Pick up Soft Cotton from the corner of the nearby ruin.
Soft Cotton: Consumable. Found against a wall, surrounded by snails.
In the corner of a ruin wall farther south-southeast is a corpse with Poisonbone Dart x5.
Poisonbone Dart: Ammunition. Found on a body lying in the corner in Woodfolk Ruins on Altus Plateau
Southwest of the ruin wall lies the final part of Woodfolk Ruins. Go down the cellar in the middle to pick up Wrath of Gold.
Wrath of Gold: Found at Woodfolk Ruins . Among the enemies, there is a staircase that goes down and leads to a chest that contains this Incantation

title: Arsenal Charm +1
text: In the cliffside southwest of the ruins, you'll find the entrance to Altus Tunnel:
Take the lift down and grab the Altus Tunnel grace.
In the first room on the right is a chest with a Rune Arc and a Smithing Stone [5] on the wall behind some crates.
In the second room is a corpse with Crystal Dart x8.

Crystal Dart: Offensive Throwable. 8 can be looted off a corpse in the Altus Tunnel . In the first cavern after the Site of Grace, head into the second room on the right to find the corpse sitting by some wreckage.
Loot 3x Smithing Stone [5] from the bottom floor walls in the mining room.
Go up the stairs to pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [5] and Arteria Leaf x2.
Somber Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. Dropped from a Teardrop Scarab surrounded by Wormface enemies in Altus Plateau
Follow the south tunnel to a wooden platform with a Golden Rune [7].
Descend the root to find a corpse with Glintstone Scrap x6 on the bottom scaffolding.
Carefully climb the root to the top platform to pick up Arsenal Charm +1.

Arsenal Charm +1: Upgraded Talisman found inside the Altus Tunnel . In the second cavern, head through the tunnel in the south to find a wooden balcony overlooking a pit. Drop down on the left side to an overgrown root below. Follow the root going upwards to reach an upper balcony above where you can loot the talisman from a corpse.

place.title: Altus Tunnel
walk: Take the lift down to the tunnel. There will be a Site of Grace. Leaving the Site of Grace, the first room on the right is a small cavern with 2 enemies within, 1 Sorcerer Miner and 1 Avionette Soldier. The room being small as it is a large AOE attack such as using Cannon of Haima can quickly clear the space safely. The treasure chest within will reward you with a Rune Arc. Moving past this room and following the main tunnel the next space will have a Sorcerer sat on the left side of the room by some sacks. Defeating these enemies will give you a chance to loot a Large Glintstone Scrap. The room connected on the right has multiple Crystal Snail within as well as a body that will drop Crystal Dart with many Cracked Crystal stored further in the back.

After this first area, you will enter the next section of the tunnels. You will walk into the main part of the tunnels where miners are working away at the crystals found in the walls. This room has multiple and different kinds of enemies so take the fight slowly to not get surrounded and swarmed. The Avionettes move fast to attack the enemies while the Sorcerers stand afar and on the wooden platforms above the main floor of the tunnel. This room has multiple Smithing Stones for the player to collect both on the ground floor and on the wooden platforms. Notice the Crystals embedded into the rocks as these are also lootable. Loot them to obtain Smithing Stone (5).

As you exit this area, you will enter an open space. Arteria Leaf can be found on a body at the end of the wooden platforms. From this room there is a small tunnel leading to a stone ledge with a connecting wooden balcony area where a crystal snail sits next to a body that can be looted for a Golden Rune (7). If you look up, there will be a Malformed Star that can hurl rocks in your direction. It hangs over giant logs with some lootable items on it. You can choose to clear this enemy with your ranged attacks, but this area is more easily accessed from Perfumer's Grotto.
The image above shows the view of the Altus Tunnel wooden platforms where you are standing from the Perfumer's Grotto. Elden Ring Map Link

From this area, you can take the largest log up to the higher wooden platform to loot Arsenal Charm +1. Drop back down, move back into the tunnels and take through until you reach the large wooden doors.
The next room of the tunnel is the final room before the boss fight. Many dormant Crystal Snails can be found here before the two large wooden doors that lead to the final room of the tunnel.
## BOSS BATTLE: Crystalian Spear & Crystalian Ringblade

The two bosses are humanoid enemies made of crystal that are not much larger than the player, making the arena quite spacious. The fight can be made much more manageable by using Spirit Ashes to help draw the attention of the bosses as you work on dealing damage to the bosses. A good strategy is to single out and defeat them one at a time.

The Crystalians take reduced damage from all sources until their poise is broken, when they get up you will see that their bodies are visibly cracked and they start to take normal damage. If possible target the Ringblade boss first as they have a more difficult attack pattern to deal with. The Spear user repeatedly hops towards and stabs their spear at the direction of the player ending with a slower large hop giving players lots of time to kite them and an easily timed window to attack them. The Ringblade user is much more mobile and difficult to deal with, attacking from range as well as having a damaging and moving spinning attack. Defeating both bosses will reward the player with the Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing (2) and 1800 Runes.
notes: Perfumer's Grotto is visible across a ravine.

title: Boss: Crystalians (Altus Tunnel)
text: Pick up the 2x Smithing Stone [5] in the room before the boss.
Kill the two Crystalians for Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [2] and 9,000 runes.
Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [2]: Bell Bearing Key Item. Obtained by defeating the Crystalian Duo Bosses inside the Altus Tunnel .
Crystalians: Duo Field Bosses found inside the Altus Tunnel . The Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing (2) is obtained upon their defeat.

title: Golden Seed
text: Travel to the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge and jump down the broken bridge to pick up Golden Arrow x10.
Golden Arrow: Bow Ammunition. Found on the back of the Minor Erdtree in Mt. Gelmir
Continue to the bottom of the bridge, then head north to pick up Lump of Flesh x3 on top of some rubble.
Lump of Flesh: Consumable. Found on a corpse in Seethewater Cave , guarded by some Giant Rats .
From the rubble, head north-northeast to find a Golden Seed on your right as you exit the forest.
Golden Seed: Flask Upgrade Material. One can be found underneath a Phantom Tree.

title: Celebrant's Skull
text: Follow the dirt path near the golden tree uphill to a small village. Pick up Poison Grease from the porch of a windmill at the end.
Poison Grease: Consumable/ Looted from a corpse outside Volcano Cave
Continue uphill until you reach the Windmill Village grace at the entrance to Dominula, Windmill Village:
Follow the cliff edge northeast of the grace to a corpse with the Celebrant's Skull.
Celebrant's Skull: Warhammer. Found on a corpse at the cliff directly north from Windmill village site of grace

place.title: Village Windmill Pasture
walk: There isn't much to do at this location other than collect the 10x Raw Meat Dumplings in the stables on the left. There are several Misbegotten enemies here who have subjugated the local Aristocrats. There are also a couple of Rotten Strays around the stables.

title: Boss: Godskin Apostle (Altus Plateau)
text: Go up the stairs near the grace and pick up a Golden Rune [5] from the stable attached to a building.
Inside an open house in the same area is a Rune Arc.
Rune Arc: Consumable Item. Found on a corpse inside a small shack in Dominula, Windmill Village .
On the ledge east of the house, you'll find a corpse with Holyproof Dried Liver.
Walk around the outside of the house west of the corpse to pick up Stormhawk Feather x3.
Head up stairs and take the first right around a house to grab a Lightning Grease.
From the top of the stairs, drop down the planks around the west building to find Exalted Flesh x2 on a roof below it.
Kill the Godskin Apostle at the top of the village for Godskin Peeler, Scouring Black Flame, and 14,000 runes.
Godskin Peeler: Dropped by the Godskin Apostle fought at the Windmill Village .
Scouring Black Flame: Incantation, dropped by the Godskin Apostle fought at the Windmill Village .
Godskin Apostle: Can be found at Windmill Heights . Drops Godskin Peeler and Scouring Black Flame

guide.title: Windmill Village
text: There is a small group of Celebrants at the start and a larger pack of them at the next flat spot. Most of them are generally not hostile but be prepared, because a group of them may change upon approach. They are brutal in packs so try to take them out either slowly one by one or several at a time if you have slash weapons. There is 1 Rotten Stray in the pack. Check building tops for small paths leading to treasure. Clear these dancers to gain a chance to obtain their garments and equipment. Though Drop rate chances are slim, the Festive Dancers wield the following equipment:
Celebrant's Cleaver
Celebrant's Sickle
Celebrant's Rib-Rake
Celebrant's Skull (they do not drop this)
Blue Festive Hood
Blue Festive Garb
Festive Hood
Festive Garb
Festive Garb (Altered)
## Guaranteed Celebrant's Skull

North of the Village is also a narrow walkable Cliffside. Follow this route to obtain the Celebrant's Skull. A Golden Seed can be found at a phantom tree southwest of Windmill Village Site of Grace (following the road).
## Boss: Godskin Apostle

Follow the path to the top to fight the Godkin Apostle. After the enemy falls, you can obtain Godskin Peeler and Scouring Black Flame from him. Millicent can also be found around this location during her questline. This is known to be her fourth location, and the Godskin Apostle must be defeated for her to appear. In this area, players may also choose to take a rest at the Windmill Heights Site of Grace.
## Fire's Deadly Sin

After having seen the Flightless Bird Painting in Leyndell, Royal Capital, you can return and head south following the village houses along the cliffside. Just behind one of the houses you will find a seated spirit from whom you can obtain the spell, Fire's Deadly Sin.

title: Talk to Millicent
text: Optional: Millicent's summon sign can be found on the slope if you gave her the Valkyrie's Prosthesis.
Millicent: Moves here after Godskin Apostle is defeated.

title: Noble's Set, Twinned Knight Swords
text: Rest at the Windmill Heights grace, then talk to Millicent near the grace.
Pick up a Gold Firefly from the corpse in front of a house south-southeast of the grace.
Travel to Windmill Village and head north-northwest toward a windmill. Pick up Raw Meat Dumpling x10 from the stable behind it.
Raw Meat Dumpling: Consumable. Found on a corpse in the left stables at the Village Windmill Pasture .
Continue toward a windmill farther northwest and grab the Noble's Set and Twinned Knight Swords from the corpses there.

Noble's Set: An Armor Set comprised of the Navy Hood , Noble's Traveling Garb , Noble's Gloves and Noble's Trousers .The entire set can be found within East Windmill Pasture , Altus Plateau , in the fire in the middle of a circle of dancing women.
Twinned Knight Swords: In a burning corpse pile in front of East Windmill Pasture in Altus Plateau .

place.title: East Windmill Pasture
walk: Bost East and West Windmill Pasture areas are found around the outskirts of Windmill Village and are within Altus Plateau. Besides the plains and pastures, players will find a dilapidated shack next to a large windmill in this area. Approach this and you will come across some Celebrants and Burning Putrid Corpses, the former of which will be familiar if coming from Windmill Village. These Burning Putrid Corpses may still be laying together on the ground when you arrive, but will stand up when you approach their location. Be wary of them, as they can explode when you approach them.
Clear them and loot the bodies that they were surrounding to obtain Noble's Traveling Garb, Noble's Gloves, Navy Hood, Noble's Trousers Elden Ring Map Link
There are no further points of interest in this location and players can move on to the West Windmill Pasture just nearby.

title: Giant Rat Ashes
text: Head toward the final windmill past a pond and pick up Giant Rat Ashes from the rat-infested stable.
Giant Rat Ashes: Can be found in a wooden shack located left of the windwill.

place.title: West Windmill Pasture
walk: Coming from East Windmill Pasture, there is a small cliff south of the windmill, players may come across a Battlemage standing atop a rock. Players can deal a hard hit from behind to begin combat or dace the Battlemage completely on horseback. Defeat the Battlemage to potentially gain access to its garments, Battlemage Set. Haima Glintstone Crown, Battlemage Robe, Battlemage Manchettes and Battlemage Legwraps.

When arriving at the Windmill, you'll find it teeming with Rats of both sizes. In the shack with Rats is where players can find Giant Rats Ashes. Pillage the remains to obtain it. From here, players can make their way to the main Windmill Village.

title: Battlemage Set
text: Standing on the ledge east of the windmill is a Battlemage. Kill him to obtain the Battlemage Set (first time).
Battlemage Set: The entire set drops from a particular Battlemage enemy, located east of West Windmill Pasture , on a hill near the northern end of the collapsed bridge.

title: Talk to Goldmask
text: Interact with Goldmask at the end of the broken bridge.
Goldmask: Found around the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge.
Pick up Dragonwound Grease from the corpse next to Goldmask.
Dragonwound Grease -1x Atlus Plateau: Consumable. Found on a corpse hanging from the edge atop of the collapsed bridge in Altus Plateau , near the Goldmask NPC.
Talk to Corhyn and tell him Goldmask's whereabouts.
Return to the end of the bridge and talk to Corhyn next to Goldmask. Optionally, talk to him about the noble Goldmask.

title: Golden Seed
text: Follow the road southeast of Windmill Village to find a Golden Seed on a ledge on the right.
Golden Seed: One can be found at a phantom tree South East of Windmill Village site of grace (following the road).

title: Ash of War: Lightning Slash
text: Continue toward the catapults and pick up a Golden Rune [9] by a tent near the spiked barricades.
Kill the scarab north of the tent to obtain Ash of War: Lightning Slash.
Ash of War: Lightning Slash: Ash of War Upgrade. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in the middle of an enclosed area just outside the Capital Outskirts .

title: Greatbow
text: Head toward the tower past the camp and pick up Golden Arrow x6 from the lower scaffolding around it.
Grab the Hefty Beast Bone x10 halfway up the tower, then loot Greatbow and Great Arrow x20 from the chest at the top.
Greatbow: Found in a chest at the top of the Highway Lookout Tower .

title: Larval Tear
text: Return to Windmill Village and head south-southeast along a dirt path instead of the road. Pick up Four-Toed Fowl Foot x3 next to a wagon.
Follow the dirt path to a ruins site and pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [5] from a chair in the lower ruins.
Kill the Wandering Noble in the upper corner of the ruins and he'll turn into an Elder Lion that drops a Larval Tear.
Larval Tear: Dropped from a Miniboss disguises as a noble inside the ruins.

title: Boss: Ancient Dragon Lansseax (Altus Plateau)
text: Between the catapults past the ruins, you'll find Lightning Greatbolt x3.
On the hillside southwest of the catapults lies a cemetery with a Golden Rune [1], Golden Rune [3], Golden Rune [4], Golden Rune [6], and Golden Rune [8].
Golden Rune [6]: Can be looted from a corpse lying atop a rock pillar connecting Hermit Village to Gelmir Hero's Grave , in Mt. Gelmir .
Golden Rune [8]: Looted from a corpse in Mt. Gelmir , found between two formations of rocks.
Return to the path and follow it toward the Rampartside Path grace.
Head down the slope southeast of the grace to reach a campsite with Land Octopus Ovary.
Land Octopus Ovary: Crafting Material, found against the wall, on a small campsite where two Ghost Jellyfish dwell.
Continue downhill and loot the Golden Rune [6], Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot, and Golden Rune [3] in the graveyard.
Golden Rune [6] B: Found as you enter the cemetery, on the left side on a grave.
Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot: Further in the cemetery, past the Golden Rune (6),
Golden Rune [3]: Located in the cemetery to the right side.
Use the nearby spiritspring and kill Ancient Dragon Lansseax on the hillside for Lansseax's Glaive and 60,000 runes.
Ancient Dragon Lansseax: Southwest of Rampartside path. It will only appear if you defeat it first at its first location. Drops Lansseax's Glaive
Lannseax's Glaive: Dropped by Ancient Dragon Lansseaxt .

title: Lansseax's Glaive
text: Use the nearby spiritspring and kill Ancient Dragon Lansseax on the hillside for Lansseax's Glaive and 60,000 runes.

title: Harp Bow
text: At the north end of the hillside, you'll find the Harp Bow (painting reward).
Harp Bow: Acquired by solving the Champion's Song Painting, found in The Shaded Castle

title: Stonesword Key
text: On a stone platform down the hillside sits a corpse with a Stonesword Key.
Stonesword Key: Held by a Noble's sitting corpse.

title: Ash of War: Lightning Ram
text: Kill the scarab farther downhill to obtain Ash of War: Lightning Ram.
Ash of War: Lightning Ram: Dropped from a Teardrop Scarab .

title: Dragonbolt Blessing, Sacred Tear
text: Enter the church at the bottom and loot the Lightning Greatbolt x10, Sacred Tear, and Dragonbolt Blessing inside.
Dragonbolt Blessing: Found inside a chest at Stormcaller Church
Sacred Tear: Found inside Stormcaller Church

place.title: Stormcaller Church
walk: Once you enter, beware of the two enemies ready to ambush you just past the entrance. They will be at each corner.

There is a Sacred Tear  below the main statue, and x10 Lightning Greatbolt. There is also a chest to be found. Turn back from the statue, looking at the entrance, and you will notice a chest on the left-side wall. Open it to obtain Dragonbolt Blessing. After obtaining these items there are no more points of interest within the church.

title: Boss: Black Knife Assassin (Sainted Hero's Grave)
text: On the hill above the church lies a cemetery with a Golden Rune [3], 2x Golden Rune [4], and 2x Golden Rune [6].
Golden Rune [4]: Found over the sarcophagi directly to the southof Sainted Hero's Grave There are also 2 Golden Rune (6) nearby.
Golden Rune [6]: Found over the sarcophagi directly to the southof Sainted Hero's Grave There are also 2 Golden Rune (4) nearby.
Head toward the Sainted Hero's Grave north-northwest of the cemetery:
Kill the Black Knife Assassin guarding the entrance for Black Knife and 10,800 runes.
Black Knife: Dagger dropped from the Black Knife Assassin
Black Knife Assassin: Optional boss found at the entrance of Sainted Hero's Grave . Drops Black Knife

title: Crimson Seed Talisman
text: Ride the lift down and grab the Sainted Hero's Grave grace.
Unlock the imp seal and pick up the Crimson Seed Talisman.

Crimson Seed Talisman: Talisman. Found in a room inside the Sainted Hero's Grave , locked behind an Imp Statue seal. The room is right in front of the Site of Grace near the entrance and requires a Stonesword Key to unlock.

place.title: Sainted Hero's Grave
walk: Once you arrive at the entrance of the Sainted Hero's Grave, you will find a Black Knife Assassin waiting for you. She drops the Black Knife once defeated.

Down the lift is a Site of Grace and a fog gate that requires a Stonesword Key to open. Through the door is a Wraith Caller guarding the Crimson Seed Talisman. Head back to the main room once you've dealt with this one.

To the East is an exit. On the ground a half-buried tablet shows the message "Shadow bathes in light and knows weakness." Continue down a staircase leading down. The second right/South exit takes you to a room, where two Wraith Callers perch at the top of a set of stairs. A Revenant spawns out of the ground in the space under where the Wraith Callers are. There is a Ghost Glovewort [4] near its back wall.
At the top of the stairs behind a Grave Violet is an illusionary wall that reveals a ledge above a large hall below.
The hallway area is also accessible by taking the first right/East exit you passed earlier. Two imps, one covered in darkness and a second standing in a light circle can be seen from the ledge.

This is your first hint regarding this dungeon's mechanic - you have to lead the dark covered imps (and any other 'dark' enemies) into the light to be able to damage them. They will be staggered upon walking into it.
The hallway takes a turn and down some steps you come to a room with two Shadow imps and a Wraith Caller under the stairs. The light circle is down the steps to the right.
A Grave Violet and a Grave Glovewort [4] can be found in the space under the entry to the room.

Take the eastern exit down some stairs to the next room. You'll notice the floor in the midst of a set of columns is sandy and has a depression in the middle that would collapse when you walk forward. Instead, walk around the outer edge of the room to the opposite corner to grab the Leyndell Soldier Ashes from the corpse.
With no other path forward, you must walk to the center of the room and trigger the floor collapse.

You'll fall into a circle of light, surrounded by four shadow imps. Once you have fought them off, there is a Grave Glovewort [3] in the alcove South of the light circle as you stand facing the wooden gate. Pull the lever next to the gate to the North. The large wooden gate opens in front of you.

Down the stairs on the other side of the gate are three Rotting Corpses and three active Guillotine traps. Note that further down the hall on a bridge on the second level are two more Rotting Corpses that are going to drop down as you walk below the bridge. An additional four Rotting Corpses stood at the far end of the hall where it takes a turn right/East.

If you get on the second blade and ride up you can land on a platform that leads up to a staircase with four Rotting Corpses. Continue through to a room, where are five Rotting Corpses around the bottom of the steps as well as two Wraith Callers at the top of the steps.

It leads you to a room up some steps with four Rotting Corpses. The path up the stairs behind the Wraith Callers will bring you back to the room with the collapsing floor (if you accidentally fell before collecting the Leyndell Soldier Ashes, you can go grab them now).

Under the stairs is a space blocked off by white fog that requires a Stonesword Key door to dispel. Behind it is a Grave Glovewort [5] and the Dragoncrest Shield Talisman +1 guarded by two more Rotting Corpses. Assuming you already have the Leyndell Soldier Ashes, return to the guillotine room. After the second trap is a Ghost Glovewort [4] followed by four additional Rotting Corpses. Two more would drop from a overhead bridge as you approach.
Around the corner will be a mounted Wraith Caller, three more Rotting corpses, and another three guillotine traps. Beyond these is the heavy double door leading to the boss.

Before that, however, turn to your right/South to pick up a Grave Glovewort [3]. Climb the ladder visible in that alcove. You are now standing on ledge above a room guarded by another Revenant - see the yellow and black vapour rising from the spot between the Grave Glovewort and the corpse. Drop down, lure it out by getting close to that spawning point and run back up the ladder to the ledge. From here, you can safely use range or the Night Maiden's Mist to kill it. Casting a healing spell while it is in range also deals damage to it. In this room is a Human Bone Shard and a Grave Glovewort [5]. The revenant itself drops a Ghost Glovewort [4].

Note: this Revenant respawns at the same location after some time has passed even without you resetting at the Site of Grace. It is also possible for another to spawn while one is still in place. Beware as you return to the same room during the fight with the Grave Warden Duelist or returning there to collect items.**

Take a right after you drop down, go west across the bridge above the first room with the guillotines. A corpse there can be looted for 3x Root Resin. Continue up some steps to a long room. A little way ahead is a corpse with the Prattling Pate (Let's get to it). A shadow Grave Warden Duelist stands at the far end guarding a Ghost Glovewort [4] and Ghost Glovewort [5].

You must draw him out and back to the light circle, the closest one being the one you dropped onto through the broken floor. Defeating him is required to unlock the heavy door leading to the boss. You have to be in melee range to bait his attack to make him step forward, otherwise he will retreat back down the steps leading to the illuminated circle of light. Alternatively, equip the Shabriri's Woe talisman to easily draw his aggro and have him step into the light.
Go back past the guillotines and to the now open door - head down the stairs. To your right is a final Rotting Corpse and a Grave Glovewort [3].

Finally, enter the Boss room and you will fight the Ancient Hero of Zamor. The boss drops the Ancient Dragon Knight Kristoff Ashes. After the fight you can collect 2x Root Resins in the back corners of the room. Well done!
notes: You need two Stonesword Keys to get all items in this dungeon.

title: Leyndell Soldier Ashes
text: Enter the room straight ahead and optionally kill the Revenant beneath the stairs for a Ghost Glovewort [4] (first time).
Ghost Glovewort [4]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One can be found inside the Sainted Hero's Grave , in the room with the Grave Warden Duelist .
Pick up the Grave Glovewort [5] beneath the stairs.

Grave Glovewort [5]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 3 can be found inside the Sainted Hero's Grave : From the Site of Grace, head into the corridor towards the east, ignoring the first turn and going all the way to the end. Check behind the stairs in the following room to find the first glovewort. From the room that you fall into after the floor above crumbles, head north into the hall with the falling cleaver traps. Wait for the first cleaver to fall then stand on top of it to use it as a lift and then jump into the opening in the western wall. In the next room, unlock the Imp Statue barrier to find the glovewort. Go back down to the cleaver trap hall and continue along north and then east. Climb the ladder in the opening in the wall to the right near the end of the second set of cleavers and you can find the last glovewort in the corner of the next room.
Hit the illusory wall at the top of the room, then continue to the next room for a Grave Glovewort [4] below the stairs.

Grave Glovewort [4]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 2 can be found inside the Sainted Hero's Grave : From the Site of Grace, head into the corridor in the east and take the first turn to the right. Go through the large hallway ahead and turn left into a large room with a set of stairs on the left. Check behind the stairs to find the first glovewort. From the room that you fall into after the floor above crumbles, head north into a large hall with falling cleaver traps. The second glovewort is found halfway through this hall, on the right side.
Pick up Leyndell Soldier Ashes in the back of a room with a pitfall in the middle.
Leyndell Soldier Ashes: Found inside the Sainted Hero's Grave . After a floor collapsed, make your way back up and retrieve from a corpse.

title: Dragoncrest Shield Talisman +1
text: Drop down the pitfall to grab a Grave Glovewort [3], then pull the lever.
Ride the first cleaver to a room with an imp seal and unlock it for a Grave Glovewort [5] and the Dragoncrest Shield Talisman +1.
Dragoncrest Shield Talisman +1: Can be found in a locked imp's room in Sainted Hero's Grave .

title: Prattling Pate
text: Return to the cleaver room to pick up a Grave Glovewort [4] and a Grave Glovewort [3].
Climb the ladder at the end to a room with a Revenant and optionally kill it for a Ghost Glovewort [4] (first time).
Pick up the Human Bone Shard x5 and Grave Glovewort [5] in the room.
Grab Root Resin x3 from a corpse on the bridge.
Quickly loot Prattling Pate "Let's get to it", Ghost Glovewort [4], and a Ghost Glovewort [5] from the room past the bridge.
Prattling Pate: Found within Sainted Hero's Grave in Altus Plateau . Found by the entrance of the room with the shadow enemy that, when killed, opens the final door.
Ghost Glovewort [5]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One can be found inside the Sainted Hero's Grave , in the back of the room with the Grave Warden Duelist .

title: Boss: Ancient Hero of Zamor (Sainted Hero's Grave)
text: Bait the shadow Duelist into the light zone before the cleaver room. Once he's vulnerable, kill him to unlock the boss door.
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [3] on the way down to the boss.
Kill the Ancient Hero of Zamor for Ancient Dragon Knight Kristoff and 20,000 runes.
Ancient Hero of Zamor: The final boss of the Sainted Hero's Grave . Drops the Ancient Dragon Knight Kristoff Ashes upon defeat.
Ancient Dragon Knight Kristoff Ashes: Spirit Ash Summon. Dropped by the Ancient Hero of Zamor found in the Sainted Hero's Grave .

title: Protection of the Erdtree
text: Travel to Windmill Village and kill the scarab on a stone platform near the broken bridge west of the grace for Protection of the Erdtree.
Protection of the Erdtree: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab . It can be found on top of the stone ruin.

title: Great Stars
text: Grab the Road of Iniquity Side Path grace under the broken bridge.
Rest at the grace to reset the caravan to its starting point near the grace, then loot the chest in the carriage to obtain the Great Stars.
Great Stars: On a guarded wagon in Altus Plateau, traveling on the road SouthWest of the Road of Iniquity Side Path site of grace.

title: Radiant Gold Mask
text: Pick up Stimulating Boluses x2 from a separate part of the broken bridge below the cliff to the left of the caravan.
Continue down the bridge to pick up Radiant Gold Mask from the bottom edge.
Radiant Gold Mask: Part of the Goldmask's Set . Found on a corpse on the collapsed bridge North-East of Writheblood Ruins . Drop down two times heading South to find the body.

title: Talk to Magnus the Beast Claw, Furlcalling Finger Remedy
text: In the area with gravestones to the right of the caravan, kill a Wandering Noble carrying a chest for a Golden Rune [10] (first time).
Below the cliff in the area with gravestones, behind a Pumpkin Head, you'll find a corpse with Gravel Stone x2.
Gravel Stone: Crafting Material. Two obtained by a grave marker overlooking the cliffs. Guarded by a Pumpkin Head .
To the left of the road lies Writheblood Ruins:
Invade Magnus the Beast Claw in the leftmost ruin for a Rune Arc, Furlcalling Finger Remedy, Great Stars, and a Somber Smithing Stone [6].

Magnus the Beast Claw: The red summon sign for this NPC can be found at Writheblood Ruins in Altus Plateau , after accepting Varre's quest in Liurnia of the Lakes . 1x Festering Bloody Finger is needed for each invasion attempt, and counts towards completion of the questline.
Rune Arc: Dropped by Rileigh the Idle after successfully invading his world.
Furlcalling Finger Remedy: Dropped by Rileigh the Idle after successfully invading his world.

place.title: Writheblood Ruins
walk: Writheblood Ruins can be found just north of Sainted Hero's Grave, when you arrive at the location, there will be a couple of Skeletal Slimes in the area, you can completely skip past them and just head down the underground chamber and traverse the mist to fight Sanguine Noble, the boss in the area. Once you traverse the mist, the boss fight will begin. It is recommended that you equip a lantern to get a bit of light, since the area is a bit dark, and it will help you see the blood puddles that the Noble will put on the ground. Every single attack the boss does will stack bleed, so you'll have to watch your meter everytime you get hit. The Noble's attacks are very fast, it has both melee and long-range capabilities. It can throw out its weapon as a projectile, leave blood puddles on the ground, and when it gets in close it will start a flurry of stabs and slashes. When you see his left hand with the dagger up, do not attack with melee, you will get parried, and when you're still a bit low level, it could kill you instantly. Instead, you can use ranged attacks such as sorceries and bows, that cannot be parried. After defeating the boss, you can then open the chest within the room and receive the Bloody Helice.
In the northeastern part of the ruins, Magnus the Beast Claw's invasion sign can be found. He can be defeated to progress White Mask Varré's questline without playing online.

title: Boss: Sanguine Noble (Writheblood Ruins)
text: Head down the cellar in the middle ruin and kill the Sanguine Noble for 8,800 runes.
Sanguine Noble: Boss found inside Writheblood Ruins

title: Bloody Helice
text: Loot the Bloody Helice from the chest in the cellar.
Bloody Helice: Can be found inside a chest, in the same room of the boss in Writheblood Ruins

title: Lord of Blood's Favor
text: In a corner of the third ruin, you'll find a Golden Rune [5].
From the third ruin, head west-northwest to find a Golden Rune [4] at the cliff edge, near several soldiers.
Pick up Blood Grease x2 next to an empty carriage near a bridge at the end of the road.
Head down the slope south of the bridge and kill the Wandering Noble carrying a chest for a Golden Rune [10] (first time).
Grab the Bridge of Iniquity grace on the other side of the bridge.
Talk to Varre at Rose Church and answer "Anoint me" to receive the Lord of Blood's Favor.
Lord of Blood's Favor: Key Item. Obtained from White-Faced Varre after invading other players 3 times and talking to him, then accepting to be knighted.

title: Lord of Blood's Favor
text: Interact with the deceased maiden in the Church of Inhibition to soak the Lord of Blood's Favor in blood.

Lord of Blood's Favor: Key Item. Found on a seated deceased maiden with the Church of Inhibition . Obtained from White-Faced Varre after invading other players 3 times and talking to him, then accepting to be knighted.

title: Pureblood Knight's Medal
text: Return to Varre and offer him your finger to receive a Bloody Finger, then talk to him to obtain the Pureblood Knight's Medal.

Pureblood Knight's Medal: Key Tool Item. Reward for advancing White-Mask Varre questline and giving him the blood-soaked Lord of Blood's Favor item. Gives player early access to Mohgwyn Dynasty underground.
Optional: Collect all non-respawning crafting materials in Altus Plateau.

links.t: Video: non-respawning crafting materials in Altus Plateau

title: Talk to White-Mask Varre
text: White-Mask Varre: White-Faced Varre , Location 2. Found standing outside of the Rose Church. Gives you the Festering Bloody Finger after exhausting his dialogue.

title: Larval Tear, Boss: Wormface (Mt. Gelmir)
text: From the Road of Iniquity grace, head downhill and kill the Putrid Corpse next to some spikes. He'll turn into a giant Wormface that drops a Larval Tear.

Larval Tear: Dropped by Colossal Wormface disguised as charred corpse when defeated. Due East from the Road of Inequities grace, upon entering the ruined camp, and next to the first corpse fire will be the charred remains enemy
Wormface: Boss. Wormface Bosses are usually located within the vicinity of the Minor Erdtree (Mt. Gelmir)

title: Boss: Ulcerated Tree Spirit (Mt. Gelmir)
text: Continue down the slope to find Fan Daggers x5 on a pile of corpses.
Fan Daggers: Offensive Consumable. Can be found on a corpse at Mt. Gelmir near the Minor Erdtree.
Kill the Ulcerated Tree Spirit near the Minor Erdtree for Leaden Hardtear, Cerulean Hidden Tear, and 18,000 runes.
Leaden Hardtear: Dropped by the Ulcerated Tree Spirit
Cerulean Hidden Tear: Flask of Wondrous Physick Upgrade. Dropped by the Ulcerated Tree Spirit .
Ulcerated Tree Spirit: Boss roaming Mt. Gelmir. Drops Leaden Hardtear and Cerulean Hidden Tear

title: Stonesword Key
text: Pick up the Golden Rune [4], Golden Arrow x5, and Drawstring Fire Grease x3 in the area around the Erdtree.
Golden Rune [4]: Can be looted from the open tombs in the gravesite on west Mt. Gelmir .
Drawstring Fire Grease: Consumable. Can be found on a corpse at Mt. Gelmir near the Minor Erdtree and the broken bridge.
At the end of the broken bridge is a corpse with Beast Blood x3.
Beast Blood: Crafting Material. Can be found on a corpse hanging from the upper part of the broken bridge in Mt. Gelmir .
Jump onto the lower part of the bridge to pick up a Stonesword Key.
Stonesword Key: Stonesword Key found on a corpse on a broken bridge near Corpse-Stench Shack .

title: Butchering Knife, Invader: Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater B
text: As you approach the shack, you'll be invaded by Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater. Kill her to obtain a Butchering Knife with the Sacred affinity.
Butchering Knife: Greataxe . Dropped by Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater .
Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater B: NPC Invader. The second time Anastasia invades is as the player approaches the Corpse-Stench Shack .

title: Golden Vow
text: Loot Golden Vow from the corpse in the shack.
Golden Vow: Incantation . Found on a corpse inside the Corpse-Stench Shack .

place.title: Corpse-Stench Shack
walk: The Corpse-Stench Shack is a straightforward location with little of note. Before you actually reach the shack, take a moment and defeat all the Rotten Strays in the surroundings to prevent them from interrupting you in the fight ahead. Look for the corpse of a troll hung upside down near the shack for a good amount of Volcanic Stone, Sacramental Bud and Mushroom crafting materials.

On your first visit to the shack, you will get invaded a second time by Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater. Upon defeating her here, she will drop her weapon, the Butchering Knife, a Furlcalling Finger Remedy as well as 4,377 Runes.
Check the corpse inside the shack for the Golden Vow incantation.

title: Pulley Bow
text: In the battlefield past the shack, you'll find Explosive Greatbolt x5 and a Golden Rune [8].
Behind a spiked barricade in the battlefield lies a corpse with Throwing Dagger x6.
Loot the Arteria Leaf x2 and Bloodrose x3 (between two slanted rocks) in the area past the battlefield.
Arteria Leaf: Material. Looted from a corpse in the middle of a ruined battlefield in Mt. Gelmir
Bloodrose: Material. Looted from a corpse in Mt. Gelmir , found between two formations of rocks
Climb the ladder in the cliff face near the battlefield, then go left to discover the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite grace.
Loot a Golden Rune [2], 2x Golden Rune [3], Golden Rune [4], and a Golden Rune [7] from the cemetery near the grace.
Golden Rune [2]: Consumable. Can be found at the cemetery near the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite site of grace in Mt. Gelmir .
Golden Rune [3]: Found on a body in the middle of the lava pool in west Mt. Gelmir , at a small safe spot.
Golden Rune [4]: Consumable. Can be found on a sprawled out body in Wyndham Ruins , to the left of a huge archway.
Golden Rune [7]: Consumable. Can be found at the furthest grave in the cemetery near the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite site of grace in Mt. Gelmir .
On the cliff past the cemetery is a chair with a Somber Smithing Stone [6].
Head toward the tower past the grace and pick up Beast Blood from a collapsed tent below it.
Beast Blood: Looted from a corpse on the edge of the second room with a Chariot and a lava pool in Gelmir Hero's Grave
Climb the tower to pick up Fire Arrow x10 and the Pulley Bow at the top.
Pulley Bow: Pulley Bow can be found on a sitting corpse (at the top of a siege tower near Mt. Gelmir campsite. The tower is located to the northeast of Gelmir Hero's Grave.
Fire Arrow: Ammunition. Looted from a corpse atop of a siege tower in Mt. Gelmir

title: Talk to Patches
text: Pick up a Golden Rune [6] from a rock near the tower.
Golden Rune [6]: Looted from a body sprawled atop a rock in Mt. Gelmir
Talk to Patches on the other side of the tall rugged ledge next to the rock, then follow the rainbow stones on the cliff edge.
Patches: NPC. Seen hiding behind some bushes. Following the glowing stones to the ledge will trigger a cutscene with an ambush.

title: Mushroom Set
text: Note: If he's not there or you've joined the Volcano Manor, travel to Seethewater River, then follow the river to get to the next step.
After being kicked off the cliff, loot the Nascent Butterfly, Glass Shard, Hefty Beast Bone x2, and Rejuvenating Boluses from the four corpses.
Nascent Butterfly: Crafting Material. Found on a corpse near the edge of a cliff, outside Seethewater Cave in Mt. Gelmir .
Hefty Beast Bone: Material. Found in one corpse of a trio of corpses outside Seethewater Cave in Mt. Gelmir
Rejuvenating Boluses: Consumable. Found on the nearest corpse of a trio of corpses outside Seethewater Cave in Mt. Gelmir
Unlock the nearby imp seal to gain access to Seethewater Cave:
Head inside and grab the Seethewater Cave grace.
After dropping into the poison, pick up Poison Grease x3 from the right side of the room.
Follow the left tunnel to a corpse with Lump of Flesh x4, surrounded by rats.
Lump of Flesh: Material. Looted from a body at the bottom of Volcano Cave
Take the other tunnel while hugging the left side to find an alcove with Preserving Boluses.
Preserving Boluses: Consumable. Found on a corpse in an enclosed space in Seethewater Cave , after a poison pool
Drop down the poison waterfall, then follow the southwest tunnel to a Golden Rune [7] on a ledge.
Golden Rune [7]: Consumable. Can be looted from a corpse hanging from a ledge in Seethewater Cave
Loot the Mushroom Set and Immunizing Cured Meat from the upper room with a Miranda Blossom.

Mushroom Set: Entire armor set excluding Mushroom Crown . Found in a room inside the Seethewater Cave filled with Servants of Rot and a Giant Poison Flower . Includes Mushroom Head , Mushroom Body , Mushroom Arms and Mushroom Legs .
Immunizing Cured Meat: Consumable. Looted from a body on the room with the giant Miranda Sprouts in Seethewater Cave

place.title: Seethewater Cave
walk: From the Site of Grace, drop down a small ledge to find 2 Leyndell Soldiers, one patrolling and one sitting in a room to the right. Continue onwards and drop down a hole to reach the main area of the cave with a poisonous floor and many Servants of Rot. Watch out for Skeletal Slimes that drip from the ceiling.

From the drop down, there is some loot to the right, loot the body draped over the cliff for Golden Rune (7), then turn left . Ahead, there is another side path to the left which contains some Rats and a Giant Rat as well as some Cave Moss. Go back to the main corridor and proceed to find multiple Servants of Rot walking around a tree. Try to lure them out one by one or sneak/sprint past them and drop down a small poison waterfall into a poison-filled chamber below. To the left is the way back up, along with more rats and servants. You can find the Mushroom Set in a room off this path containing a Giant Miranda Sprout and several Servants of Rot. When facing the creatures in this room, try to lure them out to face them individually. You can go ahead and equip the Mushroom Set, since it gives you high immunity. It will help you get around this cave better without worrying as much about the poison effects.

Head back down and to the right, then drop down to reach the last tunnel before the boss. Head upwards to find a rat guarding a Golden Rune (6), then go the other way to find the boss: Two Kindred of Rot which drop the Kindred of Rot's Exultation talisman. Beware that their projectiles apply poison even if you block.

guide.title: Seethwater Cave
text: Once you are done with exploring those, go west and down to the canyon floor, to find Seethewater River site of grace. Begin your ride northward, a teardrop scarab nearby drops Ash of War: Barrage. Continue your way north avoiding the waves of heat until you come to a Golden Seed. Further ahead, you can loot 1x Smithing Stone (5) before arriving to an Imp Gate defended by Basilisks that needs a Stonesword Key - this is Seethewater Cave.

From the Site of Grace, drop down a small ledge to find 2 Leyndell knights, one patrolling and one sitting in a room to the right. Continue onwards and drop down a hole to reach the main area of the cave with a poisonous floor and many Servants of Rot. From the drop down, there is some loot to the right, then turn left. Ahead, there is another side path to the left which contains some Rats and a Giant Rat as well as some Cave Moss. Go back to the main corridor and proceed to find multiple Servants of Rot walking around a tree.

Try to lure them out one by one or sneak/sprint past them and drop down. To the left is the way back up, along with more rats and servants. You can find the Mushroom Set in a room off this path containing a Giant Poison Flower. Head back down and to the right, then drop down to reach the last tunnel before the boss. Head upwards to find a rat guarding a Golden Rune, then go the other way to find the boss: Two Kindred of Rot which drop the Kindred of Rot's Exultation talisman. Beware that their projectiles apply poison even if you block.

title: Boss: Kindred of Rot
text: Follow the other tunnel past the poison waterfall to a hole. Pick up Poisonbone Dart x10 from a ledge with rats about halfway down.
Poisonbone Dart: Ammunition Consumable. Looted from a corpse surrounded by 2 rats in Seethewater Cave
Drop to the bottom, then head up first for a Golden Rune [6].
Golden Rune [6]: Can be looted from the open tombs in the gravesite on west Mt. Gelmir .
Kill the two Kindreds of Rot for Kindred of Rot's Exultation and 10,000 runes.
Kindred of Rot: Optional Boss. Found by falling through holes to reach the lowest floor of Seethewater Cave .
Kindred of Rot's Exultation: Talisman. Dropped by the Kindred of Rot .

title: Stonesword Key
text: Return to the entrance and follow the river west-northwest until you reach a corpse with Herba x3.
Herba: Material. Found on a corpse hanging low from a rock in Seethewater River
Continue along the river to find Fireproof Dried Liver x3 behind a geyser.
Fireproof Dried Liver: Consumable. Found on a sprawled out corpse in Seethewater River, just under a fire geyser
Pick up the Golden Rune [6] at the end of the river, then grab the Seethewater Terminus grace.
Golden Rune [6]: Consumable. Found on a body lying on the ground just before the Seethewater Terminus Site of Grace
In front of a spiked barricade west of the grace, you'll find Mushroom x5.
Mushroom: Material. Looted from a corpse atop a rock, near Seethewater Terminus Site of Grace
Head toward the jellyfish near the cliff and pick up a Stonesword Key behind the dead tree.
Stonesword Key: Key Item. Found under a large burnt tree near the cliffs.

title: Prelate's Inferno Crozier
text: Enter Fort Laiedd near the cliff:
Kill the Fire Prelate to obtain Prelate's Inferno Crozier.
Prelate's Inferno Crozier: Drops from the Prelate wielding it inside Fort Laiedd

title: Armorer's Cookbook [7]
text: Open the door and pick up Armorer's Cookbook [7] from the room.
Armorer's Cookbook [7]: Can be found on the bottom floor once past the wooden door.

title: Fire Scorpion Charm
text: Loot Slumbering Egg x3 and a Golden Rune [8] from the corpses up top.
Slumbering Egg: Material. Looted from a soldier's corpse sprawled on the ground, atop Fort Laeidd in Mt. Gelmir
Golden Rune [8]: Consumable. Looted from a soldier's corpse lying near a wall atop Fort Laeidd in Mt. Gelmir
Jump over a broken merlon near one of the towers to find the Fire Scorpion Charm on a wooden platform outside the battlement.
Fire Scorpion Charm: Raises fire attack, but lowers damage negation. Found next to the talking spirit on the top of the walls.

place.title: Fort Laiedd
walk: Fort Laiedd is found on the western end of Mt. Gelmir close to the Seethewater Terminus Site of Grace. The Fort is surrounded by Fire Monks and Flame Chariots. You can avoid most of the enemies outside the fort around the wooden barricades by quickly riding towards the fort's entrance but there is a single Fire Monk near the steps that you should take out, lest it follow you inside.

Inside the fort's walls is a Fire Prelate, that will drop the Prelate's Inferno Crozier. After defeating him, head for the door in the south. Inside, you can loot the Armorer's Cookbook (7) off a corpse amongst the crates and barrels. Head up the steps to reach the roof where you can loot 3x Slumbering Egg and a Golden Rune (8) from the corpses strewn about. You will also see some dialogue pop up. The source is a ghost that can be found on a wooden platform outside the northwestern walls. You can jump over the walls and onto the platform from this section:
Once you reach the ghost, you can loot the Fire Scorpion Charm talisman next to him. Speak to him once and he will stop talking.
Exit the castle, and head south to the large lava pool, from which a Magma Wyrm will arise.

title: Boss: Magma Wyrm (Mt Gelmir Lava Pool)
text: Pick up Smoldering Butterfly x8 from the burning pile of corpses outside the fort.
Smoldering Butterfly: Material. Found on a body lying near the edge of the lava pool in west Mt. Gelmir .
Kill the Magma Wyrm in the lava past the fort for Dragon Heart and 19,000 runes.
Magma Wyrm: Optional Dragon Boss in the lava pool on the western section of Mt. Gelmir . Drops a Dragon Heart upon defeat.

Dragon Heart: Key Consumable. Dropped by the Magma Wyrm boss found in the lava pool west of Mt. Gelmir . Dragon Hearts are used to acquire Dragon Communion Incantations at the Church of Dragon Communion and the Cathedral of Dragon Communion .

title: Jar
