text: Loot the Smoldering Butterfly x7, Golden Rune [3], and Golden Rune [5] from the four corpses in the lava.
Golden Rune [3]: Looted from a corpse guarded by Fingercreeper in Mt. Gelmir .
Golden Rune [5]: Looted from a corpse lying atop some crumbled stone pillars at the lava lake, in west Mt. Gelmir
Talk to Alexander in the lava to receive the Jar helm.
Jar: Given by Iron Fist Alexander .

title: Talk to Iron Fist Alexander
text: Iron Fist Alexander: NPC. Alexander's Fifth location on this questline. Found near the Seethewater Terminus Site of Grace at a lava lake south of Fort Laiedd in Mt. Gelmir. Alexander is sitting in the lake behind a Magma Wyrm. It is recommended to consider healing before engaging in conversation.

title: Roiling Magma
text: Past the lava, you'll find a cemetery with 2x Golden Rune [2], Golden Rune [4], and a Golden Rune [6].
Golden Rune [2]: Can be looted from the open tombs in the gravesite on west Mt. Gelmir .
Continue uphill until you're ambushed by a Runebear. Bait it into attacking the statue near the cliff to obtain Smithing Stone [6] x3.

Smithing Stone [6]: Located in a breakable statue near the Hermit's Shack , Mt. Gelmir . There is a Runebear in the area you can lure to this location to help you break the statue and retrieve its contents.
Pick up Roiling Magma from the first shack on a ledge.
Roiling Magma: Sorcery . Found on a corpse inside the Hermit's Shack .

place.title: Hermit's Shack
walk: There is little of note at this shack other than the Roiling Magma sorcery found on a corpse inside. There are a couple of Demi-Humans in the shack as well. Heading further west, a Lesser Runebear will descend down the cliffs above to attack. Lure it to attack the shining statue near the shack to loot x3 Smithing Stone (6).

title: Pulley Crossbow
text: On the ledge with the third shack is a corpse with Gravel Stone.
Gravel Stone: Material. Can be looted from a corpse lying at the edge of a rock, at west Mt. Gelmir .
Continue uphill to grab the Craftsman's Shack grace in a shack on the right.
Pick up the Pulley Crossbow from the wooden platform near the grace.
Pulley Crossbow: Can be found on a body at the Craftsman's Shack

place.title: Craftsman's Shack
walk: There is little of note at the Craftsman's Shack. However, there is a Site of Grace here which provides respite from a long trek around the volcano. There is also a Pulley Crossbow on a corpse on a raised platform on the nearby shed.

title: Prattling Pate, Hierodas Glintstone Crown +1
text: Head through the spiked barricades to pick up Sacramental Bud x2 from a corpse past a barricade.
Sacramental Bud: Can be gathered north of Mt. Gelmir , Minor Erdtree (Mt. Gelmir) surrounded by bow wielding Marionette Soldiers
Pick up String x5 from the roof of a house at the entrance to Hermit Village.
String: Material. Can be looted from a corpse lying atop the roof of one of the houses in Hermit Village at Mt. Gelmir .
Loot Prattling Pate "You're beautiful", Hierodas Glintstone Crown, Gold-Tinged Excrement, and the Errant Sorcerer Set from the village.
Prattling Pate: Tool Item. Found by a door just near the Hierodas Glintstone Crown in Hermit Village.
Hierodas Glintstone Crown: Can be looted from a corpse behind a house on the southern end of the village.

Errant Sorcerer Set: The Errant Sorcerer Robe , Errant Sorcerer Manchettes , and Errant Sorcerer Boots can be looted together from a corpse in a house on the northeast corner of the village. Hierodas Glintstone Crown can be looted from a corpse behind a house on the southern end of the village.

place.title: Hermit Village
walk: The Hermit Village southeast of Mt. Gelmir is a medium-sized town that has fallen into ruin. A band of Demi-Humans now roam its dilapidated streets, along with their queen. There are a few items of note in this village.

Check behind the southernmost house for a corpse with the Hierodas Glintstone Crown. Check the side of the house next to it for the Prattling Pate "You're Beautiful" tool. In the house in the northeast corner is a corpse with the entire Errant Sorcerer Set. The Hierodas Glintstone Crown is also part of this set. Continue northeast to fight the Demi-Human Queen Maggie who drops a Memory Stone upon defeat.
Continue heading north and you will find the mysterious Primeval Sorcerer Azur. This NPC does not speak but you can interact with him to receive the powerful Comet Azur spell.

title: Boss: Demi-Human Queen Maggie
text: At the cliff near the village is an astrolabe with Starlight Shards.
Starlight Shards D: Can be found at the edge in front of the stone statue.
Kill Demi-Human Queen Maggie in the area past the village for Memory Stone and 13,000 runes.
Demi-Human Queen Maggie: Optional Boss. Found in the northeast section of Hermit Village . Drops a Memory Stone and Golden Rune (1) upon defeat.
Memory Stone: Memory Slot Upgrade Material. Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Maggie upon defeat.

title: Comet Azur
text: Grab the Primeval Sorcerer Azur grace to the left of the rocky bridge, and interact with Primeval Sorcerer Azur to receive Comet Azur.
Comet Azur: Sorcery . Acquired from Primeval Sorcerer Azur .

title: Sellian Sealbreaker
text: Show Sellen Azur's sorcery, then select "Tell me your story", "Let us journey together", and "I have a favor to ask" to receive the Sellian Sealbreaker.

title: Lost Ashes of War
text: From the Church of the Plague, head north-northeast toward a graveyard near the cliff face. Pick up Beast Blood x2 in front of the large gravestone.
Hit the illusory wall in the cliff behind the gravestone to reveal the entrance to Sellia Hideaway:
Head inside and activate the Sellia Hideaway grace.
In front of some crystals at the end of the tunnel is a Golden Rune [3].
Hit the two illusory walls behind the crystals to reveal a large room. Drop onto a large crystal below the first one and follow it up to a Golden Rune [5] next to a miner.
Descend the same crystal to the bottom and optionally kill the Revenant for a Ghost Glovewort [4] (first time).
Loot the Stimulating Boluses, Golden Rune [5], and Lost Ashes of War near the Revenant.
Stimulating Boluses: Looted from a corpse in Sellia Hideaway , at the bottom of a pit.
Lost Ashes of War: Found on a corpse in Sellia Hideaway , at the bottom of a pit.

place.title: Sellia Hideaway
walk: Upon entering the cave past the site of grace, you will encounter a Glintstone Miner. Past the Golden Rune (3) slightly further in, there is another illusory wall you need to roll through. Another Glintstone Miner and illusory wall await you. Past this, there is a large cave with massive purple crystals. Head right to find another miner, then go across the crystals and to the left towards the next miner guarding a Golden Rune (5). Go back by jumping above the crystals to the right, then go across the large crystal again, this time heading right. Turn right again and drop down onto another shorter crystal, the jump onto a longer one and drop down into the pit. You should be able to see the magic barrier associated to Sellen's quest from here. If you have the key, go through and talk to Lusat who will give you Stars of Ruin. Turn around and walk over the crystal where you encounter a Revenant. Loot the Stimulating Boluses, Golden Rune (5), and Lost Ashes of War. Turn around and towards the Silver Fireflies, along the path back upwards is a Somber Smithing Stone (4). When you drop down from the crystal at the end, there will be three Crystal Snails waiting for you. Turn left, where you will encounter two sorcerer miners, one of them has more health and a charging attack. Loot the Glowstone x4, then jump across or onto the crystal below, then head into the corridor on the right, passing a Stake of Marika (where you can respawn at should you die).

You'll enter into quite a large crystal formation cave. Hug the right wall, climbing up and over the rocks and rubble. You'll pass on your left shoulder, two (2) very large crystal shards growing from the floor with the third one at a gentle angle. Walk onto this third massive crystal shard and continue walking until you're a few feet away from the tip.

Walk off to your right, jump onto a little crystal and then floor to face a Preserving Boluse and an illusory wall leading to a chest containing Crystal Spear. Head back and this time, walk off to your left, which will make a very short drop onto another crystal (short drop to the south). From here, head south and take another very short drop onto yet another crystal shard. Follow this up and until you're on solid ground. There is a pit with some light barely noticeable at the bottom, a campfire, and a room full of several Glintstone Sorcerers (a couple will make use of shields and engage you in melee while the third will casts spells at you). Clear this room and you can claim the Crystalian Ashes, among a few other crafting mats. There is only one exit to take, so head out, make a small drop, and you'll come across a single miner. Once dealt with, you'll be at another short drop with two choices: left, going southwest or right, going northeast. You'll want to turn right, after you drop, heading in a northeast direction. This will take back into the room you did your crystal shard climbing/ dropping to reach the Crystalian Ash summons. Make your way back into the large crystal shard room, dealing with Crystal Snails and you can claim Crystal Dart x10. Nothing more to note in here so, head back into the tunnel, moving southwest towards the fog wall/ boss. Before the boss you will be ambushed by four more snails. Prepare for the boss accordingly: Three (3) Putrid Crystalians who inflict Scarlet Rot on hit. There is a mage, one with a ringblade, and the last one with a lance. Per usual with Crystalians, blunt weapons will crack their shell fast, enabling frontal/ rear backstab and for subsequent better HP damage on them. Your reward is the spell: Crystal Torrent.
## Master Lusat's Location

To get to Master Lusat, you'll first need to have talked to Sorceress Sellen and progressed the questline enough to where you will be asked to search for Master Lusat on her behalf (refer to her questline page for more information).
From the room with the overlapping crystals, fall down to the ground and fight the Royal Revenant. In the northwest side of the room, you'll find two small steps leading to a small cavern.

Follow through the cavern, and eventually you'll find yourself walking atop a crystal, with another ledge and a Crystal miner off in the distance. Hop to the other ledge, then head to the leftmost side of the platform.

Looking down off the ledge, you'll see two crystals, connecting you to where a snail sits. Jump down off the ledge, land on the first crystal, then walk along it and jump over to the second crystal, where you can fight the snail. Your goal is to defeat the snail without falling off, then get to where the snail was standing and go a few paces up.
As you walk towards to the snail, you'll notice on the bottom left corner there is a gate guarded by Sorcery. That is the ultimate location you are trying to get to.
Once you get to around where the snail you killed was, it is safe to drop down, and begin your approach to the door -- but note that it is guarded by a Glinstone Sorcerer.
Lastly, walk up to the door and examine it, and the door will open, revealing a short cave.
Proceed through the end of the cave, and Master Lusat will be there waiting for you.
Approach him, and interact to Talk with him.
After "talking" with him (he won't say anything), you'll receive Stars of Ruin.
notes: Master Lusat

title: Stars of Ruin
text: Go up the tunnel marked by fireflies to pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [4].
Drop down at the end of the tunnel, then follow the ledge to a campsite with Glowstone x4.
Glowstone: Looted from a corpse in Sellia Hideaway guarded by two Sorcerer Miner .
Descend the long crystal below the ledge and unlock the seal at the bottom. Interact with Primeval Sorcerer Lusat to receive Stars of Ruin.

Stars of Ruin: Given by Master Lusat when interacted with inside the Sellia Hideaway behind an arcane ward in the second pit. Requires the Sellian Sealbreaker to get through arcane ward (Acquired during Sorceress Sellen Questline).

title: Crystal Spear
text: Return to the ledge and follow it through a dark tunnel to reach a second crystal room. At the bottom of the room lies a corpse with Crystal Dart x10.
Crystal Dart: Looted from a corpse in Sellia Hideaway at the bottom of the second room with huge crystal formations
Pick up Preserving Boluses x3 from a corpse on an upper ledge in the room.

Preserving Boluses: Can be looted from a corpse located at the right of the entrance of the second room with huge crystal formations in Sellia Hideaway . To the left of the corpse there's also an illusory wall.
Hit the illusory wall next to the corpse to reveal a chest with the Crystal Spear.

Crystal Spear: Can be found inside Sellia Hideaway . It can be found in a chest to the right of the entrance of the second room with huge crystal formations. The hidden wall is on the left side of a corpse

title: Crystalian Ashes
text: Climb the crystals at the top of the room to reach a hole. Drop down and loot the Crystalian Ashes from a chest.

Crystalian Ashes: Located in a chest protected by three masked magic users in a room that is located down a pathway up the purple crystals next to the Trio Putrid Crystallin's (bosses) boss door in�� Sellia Hideaway .

title: Talk to Master Lusat
text: Master Lusat: A Quest NPC found inside the Sellia Hideaway dungeon, by dropping down pits surrounded by crystals. The path to him is sealed by a barrier that requires a key acquired from Sorceress Sellen during her questline.

title: Boss: Crystalians (Trio - Sellia Hideaway)
text: Kill the three Putrid Crystalians for Crystal Torrent and 7,100 runes.
Crystal Torrent: Dropped by Crystalians Trio boss in Sellia Hideaway

Crystalians: Miniboss Trio fight against Putrid Crystalian's. Crystalian (Spear), Crystalian (Ringblade) & Crystalian (Staff). Damage received from all attacks builds Scarlet Rot. Drop Crystal Torrent

title: Witch's Glintstone Crown
text: Return to Sellen, talk about the request, then tell her Lusat's location to receive Starlight Shards.
Talk to her real body in the cellar at Witchbane Ruins and accept her primal glintstone to obtain Sellen's Primal Glintstone.
Optional: Talk to Jerren in the cellar after reloading the area.
Transplant her primal glintstone into her puppet in the hidden cellar northeast of Ranni's Rise.
Outside the Raya Lucaria Grand Library, you'll now find two summon signs:
Challenge Sellen:
Use the red summon sign and kill Sellen for a Rune Arc, Furlcalling Finger Remedy, Sellen's Bell Bearing, and Witch's Glintstone Crown.
Witch's Glintstone Crown: Dropped by Sorceress Sellen , by completing her questline and after defeating her.

title: Eccentric's Set
text: Talk to Jerren outside the library to receive an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Assist Sellen:
Use the gold summon sign and help Sellen kill Jerren for the Eccentric's Set.
miss: Becomes unobtainable if you side with Sellen instead of Jerren. Becomes unobtainable if you side with Jerren and reload the area without killing him.

title: Talk to Sorceress Sellen
text: Sorceress Sellen: Sorceress Sellen alternative location.

title: Talk to Witch-Hunter Jerren
text: Witch-Hunter Jerren: Witch-Hunter Jerren appears here while progressing through the Sorceress Sellen questline. He may be first encountered in Castle Redmane after the defeat of Starscourge Radahn .

title: Glintstone Kris
text: Exhaust Sellen's dialogue in the library to receive the Glintstone Kris.
miss: Becomes unobtainable if you side with Jerren instead of Sellen.

title: Lusat's Set
text: Reload the area to find her turned into a sorcerer ball. Pick up the Witch's Glintstone Crown next to her.
Pick up Lusat's Set in Sellia Hideaway and Azur's Set near Hermit Village.
Lusat's Set: After completing Sorceress Sellen questline, you will find the complete Lusat's Set at Master Lusat 's location.
miss: Becomes unobtainable if you side with Jerren instead of Sellen.

title: Azur's Glintstone Set
text: Pick up Lusat's Set in Sellia Hideaway and Azur's Set near Hermit Village.
Azur's Glintstone Set: After completing Sorceress Sellen's Questline, return to Primeval Sorecerer Azur 's location.to find the complete set there.

title: Talk to Primeval Sorcerer Azur
text: At the tip of the rocky bridge near Primeval Sorcerer Azur, you'll find a Golden Rune [6].
Golden Rune [6]: Looted from a corpse in Gelmir Hero's Grave , on a room guarded by two Wandering Nobles lying in ambush
Primeval Sorcerer Azur: Mysterious NPC. Hands you the Comet Azur spell after interacting with them.

title: Ringed Finger
text: Drop down and enter Gelmir Hero's Grave:
Ride the lift down and grab the Gelmir Hero's Grave grace.
Descend the chariot path downhill until you see an opening with a Grave Glovewort [7] on the left.

Grave Glovewort [7]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 7 can be found inside the Gelmir Hero's Grave : In the first Chariot hallway, head down until just before the central strip of concrete ends and jump into the alcove to the left to find the first glovewort From the first glovewort, continue through the alcove to a large room. The second glovewort can be found by the right wall. In the same room, head to the back and under the stairs to find the third one. Still in the same room, head up the stairs and go past the flamethrower pillar heading east to a second Chariot hall. The glovewort is just directly opposite of where you enter the hall from. Head back to the first Chariot hall and from the top, head down until the point where there is no lava on either side of the central concrete walkway. Drop down into the pit on the left and land on the crossbeams. Drop down to the area below and you can find the fifth glovewort in an alcove along the eastern wall. Beware the Cemetary Shade guarding it. Head back to the first Chariot hallway once more and head all the way down. Look for an alcove on the right at the end of the path, past the lava to get the sixth glovewort From the same alcove, drop down into the hole to find the final glovewort, just outside the boss door
Pick up 2x Grave Glovewort [6], 2x Grave Glovewort [7], and a Ghost Glovewort [7] from the nearby room.

Grave Glovewort [6]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One is found in the Gelmir Hero's Grave . From the first Chariot hallway, head down until just before the central concrete walkway ends and jump into the alcove on the left. Head into the room it connects to where you can find the glovewort just by the left wall.

Ghost Glovewort [7]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One is found in the Gelmir Hero's Grave . From the first Chariot hallway, head down until just before the central concrete walkway ends and jump into the alcove on the left. Head into the room it connects to and walk up the steps in the back to find the glovewort against the back wall.
Deactivate the fire-breathing pillar, then grab a Golden Rune [6] from the south room.
Return to the earlier chariot path and traverse the lava. Turn left at the end to find a chest with the Ringed Finger.

Ringed Finger: Hammer found inside the Gelmir Hero's Grave . From the first Chariot hallway, head all the way down and turn left at the end of the path to find a room with a chest containing the weapon.

place.title: Gelmir Hero's Grave
walk: Equip an Ash of War: Quickstep or Ash of War: Bloodhound's Step on your weapon to be able to move quickly through lava. Several claw items, such as the Bloodhound Claws also have this weapon art.
With the right timing, Ash of War: Raptor of the Mists can be used to evade the chariots
Ash of War: Endure skill will give a medium, but better than nothing, reduction in the damage from the chariot.

Once you enter and descend to the main area you will notice one main slope, be careful when lingering on the center slope since this is the chariot's main route. Anticipate the skeletons posted as the save crevices on the sides too that will pop out as you pass. Wait for the chariot to pass you before you advance to the next section until you dip into the last hollow section on the left.

Once the path narrows, you have two options here. The first is to continue dashing down the slope, and dip your feet into the knee-deep lava. The first chariot cannot chase you this far. Use Quickstep or Bloodhound's Step to dart across the lava without burning too much of your HP. At the end of this lava-filled corridor, turn left to get to a room with a chest containing the Ringed Finger. Going right, instead, will get you a Grave Glovewort [7] and a drop all the way to a ledge in front of the boss door.

The alternate, and more thorough route, sees you drop down the empty space to either side of the narrow path. Aim to hug the corners so that you land on the cross-shaped beams above the second chariot, rather than right into its path (which is a lethal drop instead). While on the beams above the chariot, watch its movements, and wait for an opportunity for the chariot to pause for a few seconds. This is your opening to jump onto the flat surface of the chariot itself, letting you ride over the lava to the ledge at the boss door. There's Beast Blood x3 on the corpse in the lava just next to the ladder leading up to the door.

Otherwise, wait for the chariot to clear out and drop onto the clearing below, where you can kill a Lesser Cemetery Shade and obtain a Mantis Blade from it. Pick up the Grave Glovewort [7] in the alcove. Look to the narrow uphill path, but rather than ascend it, drop to either side. You'll land on a ledge rather than in the lava, and underneath the ramp itself is a remains with Smoldering Butterfly x6. Turn the other way and head into the short arch-topped corridor and before going through all the way, make a right/north into a taller and easily missed corridor. This opens up into a room with a grave violet and 2 exits to the north. Here will be a Lesser Bloodhound Knight who will drop the Bloodhound Knight Set. This is also where you can loot the Gelmir Knight Set off of a corpse. Elden Ring Map here.

When you turn around, there will be a ladder directly behind on the south wall. This leads to a ledge with many pots to break to get to a remains with Root Resin x5. There is are two windows to jump out through and find yourself back on the wooden beams that would let you jump onto the second chariot. Use this path to re-attempt the jump if you miss.

Now, head up the ramp. There is a Stonesword Key at the top of the ramp, and to the side is a fire pillar that needs lowering to grant safe passage. Follow these rooms all the way through, and eventually you'll find yourself near solid footing at the end point of the first chariot. This is a more scenic route that gets you to the Ringed Finger and the shortcut to the boss room without needing to time or dodge around the chariots.

Regardless of how you reach it, the boss room pits you against the Red Wolf of the Champion. Defeating this boss will reward you with Bloodhound Knight Floh Ashes. Loot the remaining chest in the boss chamber to obtain Deathroot.

title: Boss: Red Wolf of the Champion
text: At the opposite end of the lava, you'll find a hole with a Grave Glovewort [7] in front.
Drop down the hole and pick up the Grave Glovewort [7] in front of the boss doors.
Open the doors and kill the Red Wolf of the Champion for Bloodhound Knight Floh and 21,000 runes.
Red Wolf of the Champion: Large wolf enemy found in Gelmir Hero's Grave .
Bloodhound Knight Floh: Dropped by the Red Wolf of the Champion

title: Deathroot
text: Loot the chest in the room to obtain a Deathroot.
Deathroot: Found inside a chest, located in the same room where you fight the Red Wolf of the Champion .

title: Mantis Blade
text: Pick up Beast Blood x3 from the bottom of a ladder outside the boss room.
Jump onto the chariot and ride it across the lava. Jump off at the end for a Grave Glovewort [7] and a Cemetery Shade that drops the Mantis Blade (first time).

Mantis Blade: Dropped by a Cemetary Shade inside the Gelmir Hero's Grave . This enemy can be found by heading down the first Chariot hall until you reach a point where there is a pit on either side of the central concrete walkway instead of lava. Drop into the left pit onto some wooden beams and then drop into the room below. The shade is in an alcove in the eastern wall.

title: Bloodhound Knight Set, Gelmir Knight Set
text: Drop down to the left of the uphill path to discover a corpse with Smoldering Butterfly x6.
Smoldering Butterfly: Material. Found in Gelmir Hero's Grave looted from a corpse near a ledge below a room with a Chariot passing by
Go through the narrow passage to find a Bloodhound Knight that drops the Bloodhound Knight Set (first time) and a corpse with the Gelmir Knight Set.

Bloodhound Knight Set: Dropped by the Bloodhound Knight guarding the Gelmir Knight Set pickup inside the Gelmir Hero's Grave . To find the Bloodhound Knight, head down the first Chariot hallway until you see a pit on either side of the central concrete walkway instead of lava. Drop down into the left pit onto some wooden beams and look around for a window along the walls. Head through this window and down the ladder.

Gelmir Knight Set: You can loot the entire Gelmir Knight Set in the Gelmir Hero's Grave dungeon from a Gelmir Knight corpse. To find the corpse, head down the first Chariot hallway until you see a pit on either side of the central concrete walkway instead of lava. Drop down into the left pit onto some wooden beams and look for a small window along the walls. Head through this window and down the ladder to find a Bloodhound Knight guarding the corpse.

title: Stonesword Key
text: Climb the ladder in the room to find Root Resin x5 surrounded by breakable jars.
Root Resin: Material. Looted from a corpse buried under some jars, atop a ladder in Gelmir Hero's Grave
When the chariot turns to go down, run upward to grab a Grave Glovewort [7] halfway up and a Stonesword Key at the top. Warp out before you get hit.
Stonesword Key: Found at the exit of Rya's room, reachable through the window.

title: Scavenger's Curved Sword, Calm Down Gesture
text: Return to the entrance and pick up Mushroom x6 from the corpse near a sleeping wolf.
Mushroom: Material. Looted from a corpse outside Gelmir's Hero Grave , guarded by a pack of Wolves
Optional: Head north and talk to Patches near the rugged ledge to learn the Calm Down! gesture (if not obtained).
Cross the rocky bridge on the other side of the ledge to pick up Soporific Grease x2 and the Scavenger's Curved Sword from a camp.

Scavenger's Curved Sword: Found in Mt. Gelmir , on a corpse near a Grafted Scion across a stone pillar-bridge northwest of the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite site of grace. The corpse closest to the ladder has the blade.
Soporific Grease: 2 Soporific Grease can be found on one of the bodies in the destroyed camp at the bottom of the cliff here across the stone pillar.
Calm Down Gesture: Gesture. Obtained fromreturning to Patches in Murkwater Cave after his initial attack. Spare him to obtain the gesture.

title: Boss: Grafted Scion
text: Grafted Scion: A Grafted Scion can be found at the destroyed camp across the stone pillar, at the bottom of the cliffs.

guide.title: How to get to Volcano Manor
text: Alternate route directly into Volcano Manor Hall: Right after you are captured by the Abductor Virgin, look to your right over the waterfall. The drop is non-lethal; it will take about 665 of your health (ignoring lava damage) instead. Go as far southeast along the cliff edge before jumping down into the lava below, then wade southeast down the lava (healing off any damage) until you reach a wooden platform with a cage lift. Ride this lift up, then look to your right to take a second lift up. Travel up the stairs, past the Blackflame Monk, but before you enter the church ahead (contains a boss fight with the Godskin Noble), look to your left for another flight of stairs going down. Descend it, push the lever to raise a metal bridge, then cross it to reach the Prison Town Church Site of Grace to enable fast travel out of this area. You can travel up the hidden back passage from behind the altar and hit an illusory wall at the end of a dead end which leads into a room in the Volcano Manor, but you'll be behind a locked door that can only be opened with the Drawing-Room Key, received on the other side.

Go back onto the bridge, then carefully hop onto one of the studs on the left side. From that, hop onto the wheel that hoisted up the bridge, and finally make a running (but difficult) jump onto the opposite balcony. You'll pick up a Somber Smithing Stone (7) from the corpse. Run for the door you see, past the Iron Virgin, and from indoors, head down the stairs to a room with a corpse holding a Seedbed Curse. Cross the long large room to pick up an Ash of War: Royal Knight's Resolve, then head up the stairs to open a door that leads into the Volcano Manor main hall.

Near the Corpse-Stench Shack, rather southeast of it, is a ladder which leads up the mountain. Ascend it and turn left to get to the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite Site of Grace. Dash through the camp full of frenzied soldiers, go past the Mad Pumpkin Head and go northwest along the narrow path. (This is where your route will merge with the other route highlighted in green in the diagram further above.)

Jump down to a ruined campsite, fight off a Grafted Scion and ascend the next ladder you see. Take the next ladder on your left which leads you to another merchant, then keep going up the mountain from his location. You'll reach a plateau with several frenzied Soldiers and a Knight. After you fight them off, look for a ramp that lets you descend to the plateau below. Look west for a bridge that leads you to the Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite Site of Grace. Take either the ladder or Spiritspring Jump to the Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast, go northwest and jump the gap going downhill, then keep descending downhill, making a U-turn and rushing past the Marionettes and Troll guard to reach Volcano Manor.

title: Talk to Nomadic Merchant Mt. Gelmir
text: Climb the ladder in the camp. At the top, you'll see two more ladders: climb the one higher up on the ledge to reach a corpse with Great Arrow x5.
Head back down and climb the other ladder to find the Nomadic Merchant (Mt. Gelmir).
Nomadic Merchant Mt. Gelmir: Nomadic Merchant. General Goods vendor found sitting by a campfire on a ledge halfway up Mt. Gelmir. Sells Stonesword Key and a full set of Confessor armor.

title: Coil Shield
text: Climb the ladder near the merchant, then pick up Eye of Yelough x3 from the camp on the right.
Eye of Yelough: Material. Looted from a corpse behind a cart in Mt. Gelmir
On the slope north of the camp lies a corpse with Poison Grease x2.
Continue up the slope to discover the entrance to Volcano Cave:
Head inside and activate the Volcano Cave grace.
In the first room are three tunnels: go through the one on the right to find a corpse with a Golden Rune [6].
Golden Rune [6]: Looted from a body hanging from a ledge in Volcano Cave
Drop down below the corpse to reach a ledge leading to a room with Arteria Leaf x3, Coil Shield, and Sliver of Meat x6.
Coil Shield: Located on a body in Volcano Cave, northeast of the Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite in Mt. Gelmir. You will need to drop down a hole and then double back.
Arteria Leaf: Material. Can be looted from a corpse in Volcano Cave , in a room guarded by Demi-Human Enemies
Sliver of Meat: Material. Can be looted from a corpse in Volcano Cave , lying in the corner of a room guarded by Demi-Human Enemies

place.title: Volcano Cave
walk: Just past the Site of Grace, you will find a group of Demi-Humans. Defeat them and then head west to find a Golden Rune (6) on a corpse at the edge of the path. Drop down onto the ledge below to another group of Demi-Humans but don't drop into the pit with the Demi-Human Chieftain just yet. Instead, follow the path in the north into a larger cavern, encountering more Demi-Humans along the way. Inside the cavern, you can find Arteria Leaf x3, Sliver of Meat x6 and a Coil Shield among the bodies.

Backtrack to where you saw the Demi-Human Chieftain, drop down and defeat it. You can find Lump of Flesh x5 on a corpse in the corner. The mist gate towards the boss' chamber can be found in the east from here.
## Boss: Demi-Human Queen Margot

Margot is a very straight forward fight. Unlike other Demi-Human Queens, she will not be using any magic attacks as she is gripped by a bestial madness. Instead, she will use her staff to smack you and slam the ground. All her staff attacks are highly telegraphed and are easily dodged. You can also maintain your distance as the cavern is large enough. After a certain point, Margot will toss her staff at you and resort to using her limbs to perform swiping and slamming attacks. She will also perform a leap and attempt to bite her target but overall, her speed remains the same and she has lots of openings in between her slow attacks.
Defeating Margot will award the Jar Cannon as well as 8,250 Runes.

title: Boss: Demi-Human Queen Margot
text: In the room below the ledge is a corpse with Lump of Flesh x5.
Kill Demi-Human Queen Margot for Jar Cannon and 11,000 runes.
Demi-Human Queen Margot: Optional Field Boss. Found in the lowest level of the Volcano Cave .
Jar Cannon: Ballista. Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Margot when defeated.

title: Boss: Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast
text: Return to the camp and cross the nearby bridge to grab the Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite grace.
Take the spiritspring up and kill the Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast for Somber Smithing Stone [6], Smithing Stone [6] x5, Fallingstar Beast Jaw, and 21,000 runes.
Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast: Optional Field Boss found high up in Mt. Gelmir.
Fallingstar Beast Jaw: Colossal Weapon Dropped by Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast
Somber Smithing Stone [6] A: Upgrade Material. Found in an underground room filled with Basiliks next to the large lava lake
Smithing Stone [6] A: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse in the far side of the dining hall in the upper floor of the Volcano Manor .

title: Stone of Gurranq
text: At the edge of the crater is an astrolabe with Starlight Shards.
Head toward the rocky bridge that juts out from the crater's edge. After dropping down, look beneath the bridge to find a Golden Rune [3].
Continue down the bridge and pick up a Golden Rune [7] from the small area east of it.

Note: If you haven't been to the manor yet, you can now grab the grace inside. You can also explore the outside area, which was done after accepting Rya's invitation during Carian Study Hall, looping back to the beginning of this section.
Feed Gurranq the Deathroot to receive Stone of Gurranq.

title: Invader: Inquisitor Ghiza, Ghiza's Wheel
text: On the second floor, you'll be invaded by Inquisitor Ghiza. Kill him to obtain Ghiza's Wheel.
Inquisitor Ghiza: NPC Invader. Appears at the far end of the dining room when going up to the upper floor of Volcano Manor .
Ghiza's Wheel: Colossal Weapon. Dropped by Inquisitor Ghiza in Volcano Manor .

guide.title: Volcano Manor Assassination Quests
text: Before following her instructions and heading to the drawing-room, turn left and head up the stairs, where you'll find yourself in a grand dining hall. On your way to the far end of the hall, you'll get invaded by Inquisitor Ghiza. Defeat him for his weapon, Ghiza's Wheel, and collect the Smithing Stone [6] on the corpse where he spawned.
If you do not have access to Mountaintops of the Giants yet, keep reading to use the manor's illusory wall to proceed.
From here, you can continue reading on to navigate your way through the Volcano Manor's actual dungeon area, but if you'd rather take up Tanith's offer to skip ahead to the boss.

title: Talk to Tanith, Drawing-Room Key
text: Pick up the Smithing Stone [6] at the end of the second floor room.
Smithing Stone [6] B: Upgrade Material. Found on the rooftops of Volcano Manor.
Speak to Tanith and agree to join the Volcano Manor to receive the Drawing-Room Key.
Tanith: Tanith, head of Volcano Manor.
Drawing-Room Key: Key Item. Given by Tanith after pledging your allegiance to the Volcano Manor .

title: Recusant Finger, Letter from Volcano Manor
text: Optional: Reload the area to find Patches in the entrance hallway. Talk to him about himself.
Unlock the two doors on the left side of the main corridor. Pick up the Recusant Finger and Letter from Volcano Manor on the table.
Recusant Finger: Multiplayer Item. Found in a locked room with the Letter from Volcano Manor after pledging your services to the Volcano Manor .
Letter from Volcano Manor: Quest Item. A letter outlining your mission after pledging your services to the Volcano Manor . Found in a room unlocked using the Drawing-Room Key .

guide.title: The Volcano Manor
text: Volcano Manor
Mt. Gelmir
Abductor Virgins ◆ Godskin Noble ◆ God-Devouring Serpent ◆ Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy

Volcano Manor is a Legacy Dungeon in Elden Ring. Volcano Manor is unique in that much of its progression, if you so choose, can be done outside of the manor itself. You will be tasked with assassinating Tarnished from other worlds, rebelling against the Fingers and the Erdtree itself. There is another way to beat the dungeon, however, if this band of dissenters and their tasks do not appeal to you. You'll find guides for both the assassination questline and the dungeon area here for a complete run of this Legacy Dungeon.

title: Talk to Bernahl
text: Talk to Rya in the drawing room.
Talk to Bernahl and answer that you understand.
Bernahl: Bernahl , Location 2. Merchant and Quest NPC. Sells Ashes of War .

title: Talk to Diallos (Volcano Manor)
text: Exhaust Diallos's dialogue in the back of the room.
Diallos: Diallos' second overworld location is in the Volcano Manor drawing room.

title: Invader: Old Knight Istvan, Scaled Set +1
text: Return to Tanith and talk about the letter.
Locate the Volcano Manor target marked on your map and kill Istvan for a Rune Arc, Furlcalling Finger Remedy, and the Scaled Set.
Old Knight Istvan: Assassination target for the Volcano Manor . You can invade their world using a summoning sign after accepting the assassination request.
Scaled Set: Armor Set. Dropped by Old Knight Istvan after successfully invading his world.
Rune Arc: Dropped by Old Knight Istvan after successfully invading his world.
Furlcalling Finger Remedy: Dropped by Old Knight Istvan after successfully invading his world.

title: Talk to Kenneth Haight
text: Kenneth Haight: Kenneth Haight can be located in the Throne Room in Stormveil Castle ��for��his final location.

title: Talk to Nepheli Loux
text: Nepheli Loux: Nepheli Loux can be located in the Throne Room in Stormveil Castle ������������������for������������������her final location.

title: Magma Shot
text: Talk to Tanith afterward to receive Magma Shot.
Magma Shot: Sorcery . Rewarded by Tanith after completing the first letter quest.

title: Letter to Patches
text: Talk to Patches to receive the Letter to Patches.
Letter to Patches: Quest Item. A letter outlining Patches' mission. Given by Patches after completing two quests for the Volcano Manor .
miss: Becomes unobtainable after killing Rykard.

title: Invader: Great Horned Tragoth, Bull-Goat Set +1
text: Kill Tragoth (marked on your map) for a Rune Arc, Furlcalling Finger Remedy, and the Bull-Goat Set.
Great Horned Tragoth: Assassination target for the Volcano Manor . You can invade their world using a summoning sign after accepting the assassination request.
Bull-Goat Set: Armor Set. Dropped by Great Horned Tragoth after successfully invading his world.
Rune Arc: Dropped by Great Horned Tragoth after successfully invading his world.
Furlcalling Finger Remedy: Multiplayer Item. Dropped by Great Horned Tragoth after successfully invading his world.
miss: Letter to Patches must be obtained before killing Rykard.

place.title: Royal Grave Evergaol
walk: The Royal Grave Evergaol does not require a Stonesword Key as the portal mechanism is active as soon as you reach the location. Inside, you will face its prisoner: the Onyx Lord.

Onyx Lord only has a few moves in his repertoire and it is relatively easy to discern his patterns. Consider fighting him on the outer edges of the arena as the center has uneven terrain which can cause his meteorites to impact with the ground near you, dealing splash damage.

Onyx Lord has three main attack patterns: Meteorite, Slice and Dice, and Lightning Orb. He will rarely diverge from these attacks. Meteorite has a very long animation and should be exploited. After he plunges his sword from the ground, you can try and get behind him for one or two hits. The meteors don't track very well at melee range and they are unlikely to hit you this way. His Lightning Orb attack comes out very quickly, has very good tracking and requires precise timing to dodge. His Slice and Dice move begins with a diagonal dash to his left as he slashes upwards followed by a large, sweeping slash in the opposite direction. Dodging through the first slash towards his right side should prevent the second slash from hitting you and will position you behind him for a quick counter.
Defeating the Onyx Lord yields the Meteorite sorcery spell.

title: Magma Whip Candlestick
text: Note: Killing Tragoth will lock you out of obtaining the Casual Greeting gesture. If you haven't gotten it yet, skip this step until you can summon him for it in Capital Outskirts.
Return to Patches and tell him the request is done. Reload the area, then ask about your reward to receive the Magma Whip Candlestick.
Magma Whip Candlestick: Whip . Rewarded by Patches after completing his Volcano Manor quest.
miss: Must be obtained before killing Rykard.

title: Invader: Rileigh the Idle, Crepus's Vial +1
text: Pick up the new Letter from Volcano Manor on the drawing room table.
Talk to Rya about strange sounds beyond the walls.
Talk to Bernahl to unlock his inventory again. Optionally, select "Talk".
Talk to Diallos about needing time for himself. If he's not there, simply reload the area.
Reload the area, then unlock the second room on the right to discover Rya's serpentine form and talk to her.
Optional: Speak to Tanith about Zorayas's form.
Kill Rileigh (marked on your map) for a Rune Arc, Furlcalling Finger Remedy, Crepus's Vial, and Black-Key Bolt x20.
Rileigh the Idle: One of the assassination targets for the Volcano Manor questline. Drops Crepus's Vial , a Rune Arc and a Furlcalling Finger Remedy upon defeat.
Crepus's Vial: Talisman . Dropped by Rileigh the Idle after successfully invading his world.
Furlcalling Finger Remedy: Multiplayer Item. Dropped by Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater .
miss: Magma Shot reward from Tanith must be received before killing Rykard, otherwise the letter never spawns. Magma Shot reward from Tanith must be received before killing Rykard, otherwise Rileigh's assassination letter never spawns.

title: Serpentbone Blade
text: Speak to Tanith afterward to receive the Serpentbone Blade.
Serpentbone Blade: Katana . Rewarded by Tanith after completing the second letter quest.
miss: Magma Shot reward from Tanith must be received before killing Rykard, otherwise Rileigh's assassination letter never spawns. If Tanith is absent, the reward will be on the drawing room table.

title: Red Letter
text: Pick up the Red Letter on the drawing room table.
Red Letter: Quest Item. A letter outlining your final mission after pledging your services to the Volcano Manor . Found in a room unlocked using the Drawing-Room Key .
miss: Serpentbone Blade reward from Tanith must be received before killing Rykard, otherwise the red letter never spawns.

guide.title: Completing the rest of the Dungeon
text: Head back and go to the balcony. If you look down, you'll be able to see a mountain ledge you can safely jump down to. Follow the Burning Slugs northeast until you get to a corpse sitting on the mountain's edge that has a Furlcalling Finger Remedy. Turn left and you'll see another ledge you can safely jump down to. Follow the path until you see a Abductor Virgin in front of a building with an open window. Fight it or run through the window. At the southern side of the room, you'll find a ladder you can descend. There will be a Drawstring Fire Grease on the corpse here. Follow the stairs down and you'll find the Missionary's Cookbook (6). Backtrack back up the stairs and the ladder. There's a door on the west side of this room that opens up to a bridge.

Jump into the left side to get Crimson Tear Scarab. Jump once more and move counter-clockwise to come back where you were before. Go back to the bridge and head up the stairs but before going into the building, turn right and jump off the stairs, where you'll find a Teardrop Scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [5]. If you have been doing doing Rya's quest, look west and you can find a room where she can be found, you can make your decision on whether or not to kill or spare her here, visit her page to read up on her quest line. Back out of the room, hug the wall and follow the cooled lava further to the north (be careful of enemies along the way), you will then encounter a room rife with Basilisks, five to be exact, kill them quickly, and do not stay in one spot as you can be caught in their breaths and be turned to stone. If needed, kill one or two, run out of the room and back south, wait until your petrification buildup goes away, then return and repeat the process until they're all gone. Grab a Somber Smithing Stone [6] and head back south to the entrance to the room where you found Rya. In front of Rya's room, look southeast and you will find an open window next to the lava waterfall, go through it and grab a Stonesword Key. Head through Rya's room to find a ladder that takes you back up to where you're supposed to go. Head right first to activate the elevator to make a shortcut to Temple of Eiglay site of grace.

You'll come across a Man-Serpent with a fiery whip. Before fighting it, don't forget to get a Commoner's Headband lying on one of protruding stones on your right. Head through the door behind him and then through another set of closed doors on your right. On the altar protected by some enemies is the Man-Serpent Ashes. Head up the first set of stairs and before going up the second set, turn around to go up the flight of stairs behind you.

Through the doorway found on this floor is an imp statue that has to be unlocked with two Stonesword Keys. You'll find cages here you can jump down to, but before doing that, turn right and drop down to the platform below. Follow the path, head up the stairs, and in the next room, you'll find the Dagger Talisman. You will see some cages which you can jump atop, do so and drop further down onto the wooden platform, kill the enemy here, and look down to the northeast to find more cages to drop onto. After dropping down a few cages, you'll be on stable grounds again, look southwest for a room full weak enemies and a Seedbed Curse on a corpse, be careful as they can overwhelm you. After grabbing the item, turn left to ascend a flight of stairs and after defeating the Abductor Virgin here, you can collect a Somber Smithing Stone [7] off of a corpse draped over the broken part of the banister. Head back into the building and continue north-east where you'll a corpse with the Ash of War: Royal Knight's Resolve.

If you continue on this path, you'll eventually make it back to the entrance of the Volcano Manor, unlocking the door in front of Patches. Teleport back to the Temple of Eiglay Site of Grace and retrace your steps back to the room with the Man-Serpent Ashes. Climb up both flights of stairs and you'll find a waygate. This takes you to the Site of Grace right outside the fog door to the God-Devouring Serpent/Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy boss fight, the same place Tanith teleports you to if you complete all three assassination requests. Rest at the Site of Grace and when you're ready, head through the fog door.

If you've been following the walkthrough, and for completion, it's recommended you finish the Royal Capital to get access to the Mountaintops of the Giants to get to the final assassination, the Red Letter, before facing Rykard. The NPCs of Volcano Manor will be forever changed after killing the following boss, so be sure to check their quest lines before doing so.

title: Talk to Rya (Second Location)
text: Rya (Second Location): The scout of Volcano Manor .

title: Letter to Bernahl
text: Talk to Bernahl to receive the Letter to Bernahl.
Letter to Bernahl: Quest Item. A letter outlining Bernahl's mission. Given by Bernahl after completing two quests for the Volcano Manor .
miss: Letter to Bernahl must be obtained before killing Rykard, as talking to him after killing Rykard makes him leave the manor.

title: Hoslow's Petal Whip
text: You don't need to talk to Diallos, but you should have heard him berating himself when you entered the room (which means he's about to relocate to Jarburg).
Optional: Talk to Jar-Bairn about the new potentate.
Optional: Talk to Diallos in a shack in Jarburg.
Reload the area five times to trigger the village attack. Talk to Jar-Bairn and the dying Diallos; it doesn't matter how you respond.
Reload the area and talk to Jar-Bairn as he collects Diallos's remains.
Reload the area again and pick up Numen's Rune, Hoslow's Petal Whip, and Diallos's Mask from the ground.
Hoslow's Petal Whip: Whip. Dropped by Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood upon defeat.

title: Diallos's Mask
text: Reload the area again and pick up Numen's Rune, Hoslow's Petal Whip, and Diallos's Mask from the ground.
Diallos's Mask: Dropped by Diallos .

title: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [21]
text: Return to Volcano Manor and talk to Rya about a serpent she saw enter the neighboring room and never come out.
Optional: Speak to Tanith about Zorayas's troubles.
Unlock the room next to Rya's to find a corpse with a Perfume Bottle.
Roll into the illusory wall behind the corpse to reveal a secret path. Follow it to a room with Budding Horn x3.
Go through the southeast corridor to find a corpse with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [21] at the end.

Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [21]: Can be found Inside the Volcano Manor , going upstairs when you enter the hallway from the lobby, enter the first door to the right, the same one with the corpse with a Perfume Bottle. Follow the path through a room full of Snails and you'll end up with a room with two ways forward - one down a flight of steps, another through an open doorway to your left. Head left first, being wary of Snails that may ambush you and continue until you reach a dead end. The corpse at the end of this passageway has the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [21] on it, and to the left of it, reveal another hidden door that opens up into a room with the Depraved Perfumer Carmaan Ashes .

guide.title: Going through Volcano Manor's Illusory Wall
text: Follow the path through a room full of Serpent Snails and you'll end up with a room with two ways forward - one down a flight of steps, another through an open doorway to your left. Head left first, being wary of Serpent Snails that may ambush you and continue until you reach a dead end. The corpse at the end of this passageway has the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook (21) on it, and to the left of it, reveal another hidden door that opens up into a room with the Depraved Perfumer Carmaan Ashes.

Go back to the room where you saw that flight of stairs and descend them to fight a Lesser Bloodhound Knight that drops the Bloodhound Claws. Make sure you pick up the Fireproof Dried Liver here too, it may come in handy. Continue moving forward to get to a church with the Prison Town Church Site of Grace.

title: Bloodhound Claws
text: Hit the illusory wall next to the corpse to reveal a room with Depraved Perfumer Carmaan.
Head back and go down the stairs to find a Bloodhound Knight that drops the Bloodhound Claws (first time) and a corpse with Fireproof Dried Liver.
Bloodhound Claws: Claw. Dropped by the Bloodhound Knight in the secret passage of Volcano Manor .
Fireproof Dried Liver: Consumable. Found on a corpse guarded by the Bloodhound Knight in Volcano Manor's secret passageway.

title: Furlcalling Finger Remedy
text: Continue ahead to discover the Prison Town Church grace.
Follow the street out the door to an alcove on the right with a Furlcalling Finger Remedy.
Furlcalling Finger Remedy: Multiplayer Item. Found on a corpse sitting at the edge of a cliff in the Volcano Manor dungeon.

title: Stonesword Key
text: In the corner of the street, you'll see an Abductor Virgin. Climb the building in the corner to find a Smithing Stone [6] on the rooftop.
Smithing Stone [6] E: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse in the lava-filled cavern of the Volcano Manor .
Head onto the southeast rooftops to pick up a Golden Rune [5] on a small bridge between them.
Go up the thin rooftop path near the bridge to reach a corpse with a Golden Rune [9] on the top ledge.
Drop onto the rooftop beneath the corpse, then again to a lower roof to reach a Smithing Stone [5].
Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse hanging from a low rooftop (you must drop down from the higher rooftops to reach it).
Kill the Omenkiller to obtain the Great Omenkiller Cleaver (first time), then grab the Drawstring Fire Grease x3 behind him.
Follow the passage near the Omenkiller to a cliff. Do a tight running jump at the end of the wooden staircase to reach a Stonesword Key.
Stonesword Key: Held by a corpse lying on the stairs within the Volcano Manor area.

title: Smoldering Shield
text: Beneath the cliff lies a secluded graveyard. Loot the Smithing Stone [6] x2, Golden Rune [9], and Smoldering Shield in the graveyard.
Smoldering Shield: Small Shield. Found on a corpse on the sitting by some tombstones on the same level as the lava in the Volcano Manor dungeon.
Smithing Stone [6] C: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse sitting amongst some tombstone in a tiny island in the lava in the Volcano Manor dungeon.

guide.title: Taking a Detour for Items
text: Scale up the roofs again to drop onto a wooden platform on which a Facing back toward the gate, there is a small courtyard to the left guarded by two dogs that leads to a broken staircase along the outer wall. Get a running start & jump across the broken segment to reach a corpse with a Stonesword Key (trying to drop down from the roof above the item is a fatal fall). After collecting the key, drop down & follow the path around the wall until you get to the place where a bunch of gravestones sit in cooled lava and loot the corpses in this area to collect items such as a Golden Rune [9], Smithing Stone [6] and the Smoldering Shield. Be careful of the living jars as several of the small jars will explode upon death causing heavy damage.

Teleport back to the Prison Town Church Site of Grace and cross the shortcut bridge. Head back down the stairs and the cage lift you took previously. Turn left and into the other cage lift in the area. This one takes you back down to lava-level and if you walk forward, a Magma Wyrm will pop out of the lava, which when defeated, will drop a Dragon Heart. In the far end of the cave, you'll be able to spot a corpse with a Smithing Stone [7] on it.

Head back off that small island, and enter the small opening in the wall to the west. Continue forward towards the building ruins, following the Burning Slugs along the way, and you'll find yourself back at the stairs that take you to the cage lifts. Take the northern cage lift back up to the temple and now we can head in.

title: Erdtree Seal
text: Go up the slope past a coffin and ascend the rooftops to return to the town. Pick up a Golden Rune [6] from the burning pile of corpses.
In an open cell in the town sits a corpse with the Erdtree Seal.
Erdtree Seal: Sacred Seal. Found on a corpse in a building close to the Omenkiller in the Volcano Manor dungeon.

title: Crimson Amber Medallion +1
text: Exit the town and go up the stairs on the right to find a corpse with Fire Arrow x10 below a lamppost.
Next to a chimney east of the lamppost is a scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [5].
Somber Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse hanging off of a ledge in Volcano Manor's dungeon. After going up the cage lift, turn right to find it.
Unlock the imp seal down the stairs to find the Crimson Amber Medallion +1 on a ledge.
Crimson Amber Medallion +1: Talisman. Found at the top of a room locked behind an imp statue in the Volcano Manor dungeon.

title: Albinauric Staff, Albinauric Mask
text: Head around the right side of the building guarded by a Man-Serpent to pick up a Smithing Stone [4].
Smithing Stone [4] A: Upgrade Material. Found on the outer parts of the building.
Climb the ladder outside the building, then drop to the lower ledge near a pit. Kill the Omenkiller inside for a Great Omenkiller Cleaver (first time).
Pick up the Albinauric Staff and Albinauric Mask from the guillotine.

Albinauric Staff: Found in Volcano Manor near the Guest Hall grace. Head left from the bonfire, then left again, taking the stairs to the next floor. Head outside and take the ladder to your left onto the roof. Go to the back of the roof and jump off the right side to be taken to a room with an Omenkiller, the Albinauric Staff, and Albinauric Mask.

Albinauric Mask: Found in Volcano Manor near the Guest Hall grace. Head left from the bonfire, then left again, taking the stairs to the next floor. Head outside and take the ladder to your left onto the roof. Go to the back of the roof and jump off the right side to be taken to a room with an Omenkiller, the Albinauric Staff, and Albinauric Mask.

guide.title: Prison Town Church
text: Head back out of the building and turn right to cross the bridge where there's a Man-Serpent at the end. The building behind it is inaccessible from the front door, but ther are two ways in. Circle around the left side of the building and jump over the railing to find remains with Albinauric Bloodcot x1 and an open door to the right. Head inside, defeat the Albinaurics in chairs, and loot the Beast Blood. Open the door back to the bridge and circle around to the right. There's a Man-Serpent guarding a Smithing Stone [4] and a ladder. From up the ladder you can jump into an open window and land back in the room, but instead we're going to get a few hidden items. From the top of the ladder to used to reach the roof, run straight to the opposite edge of the roof and look down. You'll see a narrow balcony with a door in it. Jump down and carefully enter the dark room, which has the Albinauric Mask and Albinauric Staff, along with a powerful Lesser Omenkiller. The Lesser Omenkiller should have its back turned to you, allowing for an easy sneak attack. The first time you kill it, it will drop a Great Omenkiller Cleaver. Once you're finished in this room, look to the right of the door you first came through to find a side room that leads to a ladder down. Take the ladder, looting a Golden Rune [10], then continue forward to find yourself back at the entrance to the church. Enter it again and run to the south-eastern end of the church, opposite the bridge entrance, being careful of the fast moving crawling Albunauric on the stairway. Make your way down the stairs to the lower floor, then look behind them for a Golden Rune [9] guarded by four Crawling Albinaurics. Loot the Golden Rune [9], then head down the hallway. Beware the hanging Albinauric, who will summon a Crawling Albinauric, and the patrolling Man-Serpent. Make two rights and you'll find the Guest Hall Site of Grace.
## Guest Hall

Defeat it and take the lift directly to the north up. Turn right to pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [5] from a corpse then turn back around to ascend the flight of stairs. Don't enter the temple just yet! Right before you do, turn left to find the incomplete bridge you saw across the way earlier. On this side, there's a lever you can turn to lift the bridge piece from out of the lava, making a shortcut to this area from the Prison Town Church.

title: Talk to Sorceress Sellen
text: Sorceress Sellen: Found standing behind two illusory walls in a room. But she doesn't respond.

title: Boss: Magma Wyrm (Volcano Manor)
text: Climb the ladder ahead to find a Golden Rune [10] on the balcony railing.
Jump to the roof below the balcony and go past the open door to pick up Albinauric Bloodclot from a roof between the balustrades.
Pick up the Beast Blood x2 in the room and open the shortcut door that leads back outside.
Continue inside and pick up a Golden Rune [9] beneath the stairs.
Turn left in the corridor to find a corpse with Explosive Greatbolt x5 on the balcony.
Enter the open room back inside to grab the Guest Hall grace.
Descend the ladder past the closed door, then go around the right corner to find Fireproof Dried Liver x2.
Fireproof Dried Liver: Consumable. Found on a corpse in the outskirts of a building in the Volcano Manor dungeon.
Run up the steep slope east-northeast of the corner for a Somber Smithing Stone [6] on the rooftop.
Somber Smithing Stone [6] B: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse slouched over a fountain in the Volcano Manor dungeon surrounded by Burning Slugs .
Grab a Golden Rune [9] from the structure surrounded by slugs in the lava.
Head toward the roof with a spire northeast of the structure, and follow the thin roof west to reach the Smithing Stone [6] x2 at the end.
Smithing Stone [6] D: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on a rooftop.
Go up the slope in the area to find two caged lifts: take the south one down and grab the Smoldering Butterfly x6 in a cavern.
Kill the Magma Wyrm erupting from the lava for a Dragon Heart.

Dragon Heart: Key Consumable. Dropped by the Magma Wyrm boss in Volcano Manor . Dragon Hearts are used to acquire Dragon Communion Incantations at the Church of Dragon Communion and the Cathedral of Dragon Communion .
Magma Wyrm: Optional Field Boss. Pops out of the lava in the Volcano Manor dungeon after taking the cage lift down.

title: Boss: Godskin Noble (Volcano Manor)
text: Pick up a Smithing Stone [7] from the innermost part of the cavern.
Smithing Stone [7]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse in the back of the cave in Volcano Manor where you fight the Magma Wyrm
Take the other lift up. Notice the item on the right-hand edge; you'll come back for it soon. Turn left at the top of the stairs to grab a shortcut back to the grace.
Kill the Godskin Noble for Godskin Stitcher, Noble Presence, and 50,000 runes. (This earns an achievement.)
Godskin Stitcher: Dropped by Godskin Noble
Noble Presence: Incantation. Dropped by Godskin Noble

Godskin Noble: Can be found at Volcano Manor . From the Guest Hall Site of Grace, head east across the lava and up the rooftops until you reach a stone platform with a cage elevator. Take the elevator up, go up the stairs, and activate the switch to lower the drawbridge back to the Prison Town Church Site of Grace. Then head up the last set of stairs into the church to fight the Noble.

guide.title: Miniboss: Godskin Noble
text: After reaching about 50% health, the Godskin Noble rises and explodes in a small area around him. He now has attacks that have wide AoEs and an unpredictable roll attack. His skills are still widely telegraphed, so time your dodges well. Defeat him and you'll be rewarded with his weapon, the Godskin Stitcher, and the Noble Presence Incantation.

title: Serpent's Amnion
text: Activate the Temple of Eiglay grace and grab the Serpent's Amnion from the altar.
Serpent's Amnion: Found on the altar after defeating the Godskin Noble Boss in Volcano Manor .

title: Boss: Abductor Virgins
text: Head back down the stairs to pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [5] you noticed earlier.
Drop down to a ledge below the corpse and follow it to an area with several bats. Pick up the Smoldering Butterfly x5 next to a cage.
Descend the tunnel in the cliffside to reach a structure deep in the cave, where you'll find the Subterranean Inquisition Chamber grace.
Pick up a Smithing Stone [4] and Smithing Stone [6] from the lava-filled area below the grace.
Smithing Stone [4] B: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse lying on a fallen column in the lava.
Fall through the cracked floor in the cave and kill the two Abductor Virgins for Inquisitor's Girandole and 10,000 runes.
Abductor Virgins: Optional Boss. Found in the cave under Volcano Manor by heading south from the Subterranean Inquisition Chamber Site of Grace and falling through the floor.
Inquisitor's Girandole: Spear . Dropped by the Abductor Virgins .

title: Tonic of Forgetfulness
text: Grab the Abductor Virgin grace in the tunnel past the boss.
Tell Rya about the dark side of Volcano Manor, then give her the Serpent's Amnion.
Optional: Reload the area, then speak to Tanith about Zorayas's absence. Talk to her again to receive the Tonic of Forgetfulness.

title: Missionary's Cookbook [6]
text: Use the lift near the Temple of Eiglay grace and pick up a Golden Rune [9] from the arcaded corridor.
Jump off the balcony past the corridor, then turn around to find a Golden Rune [12] against the manor wall.
Pick up the Smoldering Butterfly x4 surrounded by slugs, then the Furlcalling Finger Remedy at the edge of a cliff.
Continue until you reach an Abductor Virgin and jump through the window nearby. Descend the ladder in the room to find Drawstring Fire Grease x4.
Open the cell at the bottom of the room to pick up Missionary's Cookbook [6].

Missionary's Cookbook [6]: Key Item. Found by going to Temple of Eiglay Grace and up the elevator, then taking a right onto a balcony to access a tower. Go to the bottom of this tower and find the book in a cell.

title: Crimson Tear Scarab
text: Open the door at the top of the room, then take a left up the stairs to discover a shortcut lift. Send it down without riding it.
Return to the door you just opened, then look below the south balustrade to find a ledge with the Crimson Tear Scarab.

Crimson Tear Scarab: Can be found after jumping off the balcony and making it to the building with the broken window/ half the floor missing, the item is to their left (hop the railing) and a silver scarab to their right (can be killed from the mini bridge).

title: Daedicar's Woe
text: Use the shortcut lift at the bottom while facing northwest and roll off mid-ride to reach a room with a Stonesword Key.
Go out the window and kill the scarab around the corner for a Somber Smithing Stone [5].
Somber Smithing Stone [5] B: Upgrade Material. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab rolling on cooled lava in the Volcano Manor dungeon.
Follow the narrow path below the winged-serpent statues to reach a Somber Smithing Stone [6] at the end, guarded by five Basilisks.
Return to the scarab and go through the other window to find Rya. You'll now be faced with three options:
Give Tonic of Forgetfulness:
Optional: Tell Tanith that you gave Rya the potion.
After killing Rykard and all NPCs in the manor have left, talk to Rya in the drawing room.
Reload the area and pick up Daedicar's Woe from the floor.
miss: If you kill Rykard before you give Rya the Serpent's Amnion, she will permanently disappear from the game, making both Zorayas's Letter and Daedicar's Woe unobtainable.

title: Talk to Rya (End of Questline Location)
text: Rya (End of Questline Location): NPC.��Her finally location Volcano Manor at the end of her Questline.

title: Zorayas's Letter
text: Kill her:
Rya turns back into a snake and drops Daedicar's Woe.
Optional: Tell Tanith that Zorayas is dead.
Do nothing:
After killing Rykard, exhaust her dialogue without giving her the tonic.
Reload the area to find Zorayas's Letter and Daedicar's Woe at her spot.

title: Commoner's Headband
text: Climb the ladder past Rya and pick up the Commoner's Headband on a winged-serpent statue.
Commoner's Headband: Head Armor. On the head of one of the big statues facing the large lava lake.

title: Man-Serpent Ashes
text: Open the door ahead and pick up Man-Serpent Ashes from the altar.
Man-Serpent Ashes: Spirit Ash. Found on an altar protected by some enemies in Volcano Manor's dungeon.

title: Dagger Talisman
text: Note: At the east end of the room is a sending gate to Rykard. Avoid it for now, as killing him will end all manor questlines and lock you out of several rewards.
Unlock the imp seal at the opposite side. Drop onto a lower ledge to the right of the door, then go up the stairs to reach the Dagger Talisman.

Dagger Talisman: Talisman . Found in a room locked by an imp statue in the Volcano Manor dungeon. The room is opposite the balcony where you find the Volcano Manor Waygate. Once inside, drop down two cages, then look for a red candle behind you that shows an obscure pathway to the talisman.

title: Ash of War: Royal Knight's Resolve
text: Drop down below the talisman to reach a Rune Arc.
At the bottom, pick up Ash of War: Royal Knight's Resolve in front of a fireplace at the northeast end of the room, then open the shortcut back to the manor.
Ash of War: Royal Knight's Resolve: Ash of War. Found on a corpse in the hallways of Volcano Manor . Accessible from the imp statue locked room in the dungeon of the manor.

title: Seedbed Curse
text: Pick up a Seedbed Curse from the chair at the southwest end of the room.
Seedbed Curse: Key Item. Found on a corpse at the bottom of a room locked behind an imp statue in Volcano Manor's dungeon.

title: Sewer-Gaol Key
text: Go up the nearby stairs and grab the Somber Smithing Stone [7] on the broken balustrade, behind an Abductor Virgin.
Somber Smithing Stone [7]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse hanging from the balcony.
Talk to Dung Eater to receive the Sewer-Gaol Key.

title: Map (Leyndell, Royal Capital), Golden Seed
text: Ascend the massive staircase near the Altus Highway Junction and run past the duo boss to grab the Outer Wall Phantom Tree grace.
Pick up the 2x Golden Seed around the tree and the Map: Leyndell, Royal Capital from the stele in the back.
Map (Leyndell, Royal Capital): Map Fragment. Reveals the Leyndell region. Found on a monolith near the Outer Wall Phantom Tree Site of Grace.
Golden Seed: Flask Upgrade Material. 2 can be found underneath the Phantom Tree at the Capital Outskirts .

title: Boss: Tree Sentinel (Leyndell, Royal Capital)
text: Kill the two Tree Sentinels you ran past for Erdtree Greatshield, Hero's Rune [1] and 20,000 runes.
Erdtree Greatshield: Dropped by the Tree Sentinel duo
Tree Sentinel: Field Bossfight. Two Tree Sentinels guarding the western gate to Leyndell.

title: Golden Seed, Boss: Ulcerated Tree Spirit
text: At the fork southeast of the grace, follow the right path to a camp and kill the Ulcerated Tree Spirit there for a Golden Seed.

Golden Seed: The first one is found by the by defeating the Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit NW of the Avenue Balcony Site of grace. The second one is found on a balcony to the SW of West Capital Rampart site of grace.
Ulcerated Tree Spirit: Can be found in the 2nd Lower Floor, in Leyndell Royal Capital.

title: Giant-Crusher
text: Loot the chest in the carriage to obtain the Giant-Crusher.
Giant-Crusher: Colossal Weapon. Can be found in a chest inside an unmarked military camp directly to the south of Outer Wall Phantom Tree site of grace.

title: Missionary's Cookbook [4]
text: Return to the fork and pick up Holy Grease x2 from the stone platform guarded by wolves.
Holy Grease 2x D: Consumable. Found on a body lying atop the small stone platform near the Outer Wall Phantom Tree Site of Grace
Follow the uphill path to a church and pick up the Missionary's Cookbook [4] next to a large pot.
Missionary's Cookbook [4]: Can be found on Minor Erdtree Church , Capital area.

title: Golden Order Seal
text: Grab the Minor Erdtree Church grace and the Golden Order Seal at the base of the tree.
Golden Order Seal: Found right at the base of the Minor Erdtree surrounded by the remains of the Church.

place.title: Minor Erdtree Church
walk: Upon entry, just in front of the jar, lies a Missionary's Cookbook (4). Continue towards the tree to reach the Site of Grace. A dialogue prompt with Melina here will reward you with the Outer Order gesture. Just at the tree you can find Golden Centipedes to loot along with a Golden Order Seal Elden Ring Map at the body, sitting below the tree. After obtaining the Seal, there will be no more points of interest in the area. There are no bosses or enemies in this location, however there will be a guardian just outside the route towards the church. This enemy can be easily avoided or defeated.

title: Outer Order
text: Talk to Melina at the Minor Erdtree Church grace to learn the Outer Order gesture.
miss: Must be obtained before burning the Erdtree at the Forge of the Giants or inheriting the frenzied flame.

title: Ash of War: Prayerful Strike
text: Note: If you rested at a grace in the capital and she left, you won't be able to complete this step until you reunite with her at the end of Leyndell.
Down the slope northeast of the church, you'll find a corpse with Smoldering Butterfly x3.
Smoldering Butterfly: Found at the base of a Stonegrave.
Return to the Outer Wall Phantom Tree and head down to the moat east of the grace. Kill the invisible scarab in the moat for Ash of War: Prayerful Strike.
Ash of War: Prayerful Strike: On the lake under the short rocky tunnel, dropped by the invisible mob that leaves paw prints on its path.

title: Furlcalling Finger Remedy
text: At the south end of the moat lies the entrance to Sealed Tunnel:
Head inside and grab the Sealed Tunnel grace.
Hit the illusory wall next to the campfire, then pick up a Golden Rune [5] from the wooden platform in the middle.

Golden Rune [5]: Rune Consumable. A total of 2 can be found inside the Sealed Tunnel : From the Site of Grace, look at the west wall for a section that looks slightly off. Attack or roll towards it to dispel the illusory wall revealing a hidden path. In the next chamber, look for a set of wooden stairs leading to a platform where a corpse with the first rune can be found. At the bottom of the chamber with the lift, dispel an illusory wall in the south to find a corpse with the second rune.
Pick up a Smithing Stone [5] from the northeast corner, then loot the chest at the opposite side for the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [2].
Hit the illusory wall behind the chest, then do a running jump to the left of the lift to reach a Smithing Stone [5].
Hit the illusory wall at the bottom to reveal a Golden Rune [5].
Past a third illusory wall, descend the ladder to the bottom and bait the Abductor Virgin into destroying the statue to obtain Smithing Stone [6] x3.

Smithing Stone [6]: Upgrade Material. A total of 3 can be found inside the Sealed Tunnel : At the bottom of the lift found halfway through the dungeon, dispel two illusory walls to the south to reveal a large cavern with an Iron Virgin roaming the very bottom level. Lure it to the east end where a statue with a glowing crack can be found. Its attacks can destroy the statue, revealing a set of 3 of the stones.
Loot the Furlcalling Finger Remedy x3, Golden Rune [1], and Rune Arc in the middle, then grab a Somber Smithing Stone [5] from the wall.
Furlcalling Finger Remedy: Found on a body in the room with the fire.
Golden Rune [1]: Rune Consumable. Found inside the Sealed Tunnel , on a corpse at the bottom of the chamber with the Iron Virgin .
Rune Arc: Consumable. Found on a corpse in the Sealed Tunnel , at the bottom section of the chamber with the Iron Virgin .

Somber Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. One can be found inside the Sealed Tunnel : At the bottom of the chamber with the lift, dispel two illusory walls to the south to reveal a large cavern with overgrown roots and an Iron Virgin roaming the lower section. Make your way to the lower section of this cavern and check the northwest wall to find the stone.

title: Stonesword Key
text: Head back up the ladder and drop onto the wooden platform below a root for a side tunnel with a Stonesword Key at the end.

Stonesword Key: Stonesword Key. One found in the Sealed Tunnel . At the bottom of the chamber with the lift, dispel two illusory walls to the south. In the next chamber, walk on the overgrown root and jump to the right onto the wooden platform below, right in front of a tunnel. Follow the tunnel to find the key on a corpse.

title: Boss: Valiant Gargoyle (Capital Outskirts)
text: Pick up a Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot when crossing the lower root.

Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot: Consumable. Found inside the Sealed Tunnel . At the bottom of the chamber with the lift, dispel two illusory walls to the south and walk on the overgrown root in the next chamber. Drop down onto another root below and loot the corpse hanging off of it for the item.
After dropping down in the next room, turn around to pick up a Smithing Stone [5] from the wall.
Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse sitting by the cliff looking toward the Erdtree
Grab the Grace Mimic x5 beneath the staircase, then the Smithing Stone [5] on the ground next to it.
Grace Mimic: Consumable. Found on a dead body on the path to the Minor Erdtree .
Pick up Large Glintstone Scrap x3 and Old Fang x2 from the upper part of the room.
Hit the illusory wall in the room and drop down two roots to reach a Smithing Stone [5].
At the top of the large root, do a running jump to reach a ledge with Lightning Grease x4.
Grab the Golden Rune [9] at the bottom, but be wary of the explosive sentry stones.
Kill the Onyx Lord for Onyx Lord's Greatsword and 16,000 runes.
Continue past the boss to discover the Divine Tower of West Altus: Gate grace.
Travel to the Outer Wall Phantom Tree and head up the stairs until you're ambushed by a Valiant Gargoyle that drops the Gargoyle's Great Axe.
Gargoyle's Great Axe: Dropped by Gargoyle . From the Outer Wall Phantom Tree .Site of Grace go northeast the Slope/long Stairs up until it spawns.
Valiant Gargoyle: Optional Boss. Located around the Capital Outskirts

place.title: Sealed Tunnel
walk: Even though it looks like a "Sealed" Tunnel as its name says, there's a cavity that will open a secret path if you attack it.
There are many Miners that can be easily surprised as they are working. The mine keeps hiding paths, the second one is behind the chest that contains Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing (2).

You will find an elevator right after that and you will notice when you go down, that there are some areas to discover middle way down. It's very safe to jump of those areas, as you can jump your way down whenever you need to return to the main way, as there are some platforms and wooden structures that will ease the fall.
Once down, at the end of the path, there's another illusory wall, followed by another one with a Golden Rune (5) in front of it.

This next area is much bigger. Try to stay up on the wooden platforms and take out the enemies there, in the pit below there is an Abductor Virgin waiting. There is a path to the right (south) containing a Stonesword Key. On the roots going across there is a Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot. In the pit below, try to lure out the abductor virgin to break the statue which contains three Smithing Stones (6). There is also a Rune Arc, Golden Rune (1), three Furlcalling Finger Remedy, and a Somber Smithing Stone (5) on the wall.

After collecting the items in the pit, return up the ladder & proceed across the roots to the far wall.
