Following the the hidden path, there are stairs down and will lead to collapsed rafters that you can cross; you can cross the path and follow the stairs down for a safer route, or drop directly below on second set of collapsed rafters. On the second set of rafters, you will need to drop down to the lowest set of them, and you will find Frenzied's Cookbook [2] on a sitting corpse

title: Inescapable Frenzy
text: Pick up Hefty Beast Bone x3 from the corpse next a coffin.
Descend the coffins in the wall below the Nomad playing music to reach a coffin with Inescapable Frenzy. [See video]

Inescapable Frenzy: After making your way past Subterranean Shunning-Grounds and defeating Mohg, the Omen , attack the altar at the front of the boss room. It should lower revealing a new area. Continue through here until you are forced to parkour downwards using stone coffins as platforms. Near the bottom you will see a corpse that has Inescapable Frenzy on it.

title: Fingerprint Stone Shield, Note: Miquella's Needle
text: Grab the Fingerprint Stone Shield around the corner and pick up Note: Miquella's Needle from the breakable tent.

Fingerprint Stone Shield: Subterranean shunning grounds. Past the Altar you Fight mini boss version of Mohg. After defeating him you can roll/attack the altar behind the chest and it will move down out of the way revealing a path. If you have not defeated Morgott, the Omen King a seal will be blocking further progress. Following this path will lead you to the hardest part which is jumping from coffin to coffin to make your way down to the area. NOTE it is slightly above the bottom floor so do not jump off even if you will survive. If you miss that coffin, you will have to start from the beginning of the coffin descend all over to obtain the shield.

title: Iron Ball, Blackguard's Iron Mask
text: Head down the stairs, then drop to the bottom to discover the Frenzied Flame Proscription grace.
Note: Don't interact with anything here, as doing so can lock you into a bad ending. It's better to return when choosing an ending after beating the game.
Optional: Talk to Melina at the Frenzied Flame Proscription grace.
Roll through the illusory wall near Hyetta to reveal a chest with a Rune Arc.
Rune Arc: Held by a burnt corpse sitting against one of the ruined structures.
Behind the chest is another illusory wall, which leads to the Root-Facing Cliffs grace.
Kill the large-bellied ant on a lower cliff past the grace for a Numen's Rune and a Rune Arc.
On a lower root below the grace sits a corpse with a Smithing Stone [6].
Make your way down the roots to pick up Formic Rock from a corpse next to an ant.
On a lower root northwest of the corpse is a Golden Rune [8].
Continue down the roots, then double jump to a higher up root with a Golden Rune [8] at the tip.
On the ground below the three ants to the south lies a Golden Rune [5].
Drop onto the large root and pick up Golden Arrow x10 from the second branch on the left.
Optional: Talk to Roderika about the spirit's voices.
Optional: Read the message at Dung Eater's location in the library.
Talk to Blackguard near the outer moat about the Dung Eater.
Reload the area and exhaust Blackguards dialogue to obtain a Seedbed Curse, Blackguard's Bell Bearing, Iron Ball and Blackguard's Iron Mask.
Iron Ball: Dropped by Blackguard Big Boggart .
Blackguard's Iron Mask: Dropped by Blackguard Big Boggart ..
miss: Blackguard's Seedbed Curse cannot be obtained if you join Volcano Manor before hearing Rya's request.

title: Talk to Blackguard Big Boggart
text: Blackguard Big Boggart: Merchant who sells an item for Rya's quest and can also be summoned for the Magma Wyrm boss fight.

title: Ash of War: Braggart's Roar
text: Optional: His weapon is equipped with Ash of War: Braggart's Roar. Remove it to make it available for compatible weapons.
Kill Dung Eater after he invades to obtain the Sword of Milos.
Optional: Return to Roderika and select "Please take care".
Exhaust Dung Eater's dialogue in the library.
Optional: Reload the area and talk to Roderika about the spirits' voices.

title: Flamedrake Talisman +1, Perfume Bottle
text: Open the large door at the northeast end of the main street in Leyndell. Explore the area covered in ash to find Beast Blood x3.
Behind a building in the ash-covered area lies a Golden Rune [9].
Pick up Lightningproof Dried Liver from the corpse behind a carriage.
At the end of the ash-covered area, you'll find a Perfume Bottle.
Take a left when going up the stairs to find a corpse with Soporific Grease x2.
Behind a statue down the slope is a Somber Smithing Stone [6].
Pick up Exalted Flesh and Nascent Butterfly x3 from the corpses by the stairs.
Take the lift up and grab the Flamedrake Talisman +1 in front of the left brazier.
Flamedrake Talisman +1: Found on the ground, against a column. The path is a blocked by a magic barrier if Morgott has not been defeated. You can still reach it by going slightly
Perfume Bottle: Found guarded by a lesser Leonine Misbegotten on the east side of the eastern pond.
miss: Must be picked up before killing Maliketh. Must be picked up before killing Maliketh. Must be picked up before killing Maliketh. Must be picked up before killing Maliketh.

title: Boss: Fell Twins
text: Pick up Invigorating White Cured Meat from the corpse on the bridge.
Invigorating White Cured Meat 2x: Found on a body in the middle of the bridge.
Kill the scarab behind a broken statue to obtain a Somber Smithing Stone [6].
Instead of using the lift at the end, explore the southeast bridge. When the area turns dark, grab the Golden Rune [9] in front.
Kill the Fell Twins for Omenkiller Rollo and 29,000 runes.
Fell Twins: Field Boss encounter. A couple of bulky ogre-like beasts wielding flaming armaments. Drops the Omenkiller Rollo spirit ashes upon defeat.
Omenkiller Rollo: Spirit Ashes. Dropped by the Fell Twins bosses.
miss: Can only be picked up during the Fell Twins boss fight, as there is no way to return to the arena afterward.

guide.title: Beyond the Barrier
text: Continue along the path and enter the tower on the other side. You then have two possible exits. Through the southern door of this tower, you will go on a bridge that leads to the Divine Tower of East Altus - however, be aware that the Fell Twins will ambush you on the way. Take this route to unlock the power of Morgott's Great Rune. If you ride the lift down, you'll formally arrive at the Forbidden Lands and the next Site of Grace.

Before you continue, ride the lift back up again, face southwest, and keep an eye out for a passageway in the elevator shaft. You can jump into that passageway mid-ride, and find the Official's Attire on a body in a chair right before a door where you will find the Blade of Calling in the room at the end.
## Notes for Leyndell, Royal Capital (Legacy Dungeon)
Explore the Capital.
Clear out the sewer section.
Defeat the Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit to obtain a Golden Seed.
Investigate the former Roundtable Hold.
Invade and defeat the Errant Sorcerer and Vargram.
Defeat the Specter of Godfrey.
Defeat Morgott the Omen King.
Examine the Erdtree.
Acquire the Rold Medallion from Melina.
Proceed to the Mountaintop of the Giants.
## Notes & Tips for Leyndell, Royal Capital (Legacy Dungeon)

Something to note about about the Location of Leyndell Royal Capital is that unlike most locations in any other part of Lands Between which will continue to remain available. Leyndell is unique in that when you defeat Maliketh, The Black Blade during the end of Crumbling Farum Azula. Leyndell will change to become Leyndell, Ashen Capital. Which is beyond the cosmetic changes will completely alter Leyndell into a completely different Map altogether.

Because of the described note above, every and any NPC questlines, items, or interactions remaining in the city will be permanently wiped from the world state. One example of an important item that can be affected by this change is the Bolt of Gransax. Which would then be ungainable. Beyond that, the final stages of the Goldmask and Brother Corhyn questlines. Another thing affected is the final stages of the Goldmask and Brother Corhyn questlines.

Because the city is a dense, multi-layered vertical labyrinth, players should be exceptionally thorough when searching its hidden rooms and rooftop pathways. Many unique items and obscure triggers are tucked away in areas that are easily bypassed. Neglecting these complex, elevated routes during your initial exploration will necessitate entering New Game Plus to recover them for this save.

title: Official's Attire
text: Activate the Divine Tower of East Altus: Gate grace outside the tower, then grab the Divine Tower of East Altus grace at the top.
Interact with the rune at the top of the tower to restore the power of Morgott's Great Rune.
Return to the lift between the bridges and use it while facing southwest, then jump to a ledge with the Official's Attire.

Official's Attire: From the Forbidden Lands Site of Grace , turn back and head towards the elevator. Face southwest before activating the elevator, and then watch for an opening to jump off into. The Official's Attire is on the corpse in this hidden hallway alongside Blade of Calling .

place.title: Divine Tower of East Altus
notes: There is a Two Fingers on a mound of earth at the top of this tower, in the centre of eight meteorite fragments.

The door entering this divine tower faces south-southeast and the entrance to the top faces east-northeast, an angle of 90 degrees off entering the tower. The tower is covered with what appears to be molten rock on its east-northeast face (to the left as you enter it).

title: Blade of Calling
text: Pick up the Blade of Calling from a table behind the door.

Blade of Calling: From the Forbidden Lands site of grace, turn back and head towards the elevator. Face southwest before activating the elevator, and then watch for an opening to jump off into. The Blade of Calling is on the table in the room at the end of this hall

title: Boss: Night's Cavalry (Forbidden Lands)
text: Drop down and head outside to grab the Forbidden Lands grace, then pass time until nightfall.
In the corner west of the grace sits a corpse with Drawstring Fire Grease x2.
Drawstring Fire Grease: Turn back from the Forbidden Lands site of grace, head to the body to obtain x2 Drawstring Fire Grease
Follow the cliff edge on the right to find a Golden Rune [7] on top of a fallen pillar.
Climb the nearby rock wall with a giant skull to find Dragonwound Grease on a pillar.
Kill the Night's Cavalry for Ash of War: Phantom Slash and 36,000 runes.
Ash of War: Phantom Slash: Ash of War. Dropped by the Night's Cavalry boss that roams the path towards the Grand Lift of Rold at night.
Night's Cavalry: Roams the Forbidden Lands at night time, along the path to the Grand Lift of Rold . Drops the Ash of War: Phantom Slash upon defeat.

guide.title: Explore the Forbidden Lands
text: ## Mountaintops of the Giants
Elden Ring Main Quest Guide - Mountaintops of the Giants Points of Interest
Explore the Forbidden Lands
Explore the Mountaintop of Giants
Obtain Area Map
Explore Zamor Ruins
Access Ancient Snowvalley
Complete Shack of the Lofty
Complete Minor Erdtree
Unlock Heretical Rise
Complete Frozen Lake Objectives
Complete Guardian's Garrison
Obtain second Map Fragment
Unlock Foot of the Forge
Complete Castle Sol
Explore the Consecrated Snowfield
Complete Miquella's Haligtree
Defeat the Fire Giant
## Explore the Forbidden Lands

You've now finished Leyndell, Royal Capital and your initial thought would be to explore the Mountaintop of Giants region. Before doing so, we recommend exploring the Forbidden Lands. Elden Ring Map: Forbidden Lands starting point. The Forbidden Lands is a small stretch that connects Leyndell Royal Capital with Mountaintops of the Giants. There isn't much to do in this area, but there are two boss encounters to take on.

The first one happens only at night, you can encounter a Night's Cavalry that drops Ash of War: Phantom Slash. Further north, there's a Golden Seed to be looted. Before you gain access to the lift, you will face Black Blade Kindred which drops Gargoyle's Black Axe and Gargoyle's Black Blades. Talk to the Palm Reader near the lift from some lore, and then ride it to reach the Mountaintops of the Giants.

title: Golden Seed
text: Continue until you see a golden tree in the distance, then turn right to find a Somber Smithing Stone [7] in the mouth of a giant skull.
Somber Smithing Stone [7]: Upgrade Material. Found in the Forbidden Lands on a corpse inside the giant skull on the hill before the encounter with Black Blade Kindred.
Pick up the Golden Seed next to the golden tree.
Golden Seed: From the Forbidden Lands Site of grace, move towards the Grand Lift of Rold . You'll eventually come across the Golden Seed.

title: Boss: Black Blade Kindred (Forbidden Lands)
text: Kill the Black Blade Kindred for Gargoyle's Black Blades, Gargoyle's Black Axe, and 60,000 runes.
Gargoyle's Black Blades: Twinblades. Dropped by the Black Blade Kindred guarding the path to the Grand Lift of Rold .
Gargoyle's Black Axe: Greataxe. Dropped by the Black Blade Kindred guarding the path to the Grand Lift of Rold .
Black Blade Kindred: Field Boss guarding the path to the Grand Lift of Rold . Drops the Gargoyle's Black Axe and Gargoyle's Black Blades upon defeat.

title: Talk to Finger Reader (Grand Lift of Rold)
text: Finger Reader: Finger Reader found at the base of the Grand Lift of Rold.

title: Map Mountaintops of the Giants, West
text: Optional: Millicent can be summoned if you gave her the Valkyrie's Prosthesis.
Pick up Freezing Grease from the area to the left of the large staircase.
Head up the stairs and grab the Grand Lift of Rold grace.
Hoist the medallion at the grand lift, then turn around after arriving to find Beast Blood x2 behind the lift.
Follow the path down and pick up Map: Mountaintops of the Giants, West from the stele.
Map Mountaintops of the Giants, West: As you leave the Grand Lift of Rold, take the path forward until you reach a stone monument on your right, interact with it to obtain the map Fragment.

place.title: Grand Lift of Rold
walk: The Grand Lift of Rold is found by heading East from Leyndell, Royal Capital, past the Forbidden Lands. The closest site of grace is the Avenue Balcony site of grace. From the site of grace, head up the stairs and take a left down the road. Follow the road until you reach a large door. After opening the door, you can continue up the road where there is a lift on your left near the end. This lift brings you to the Rold Route, but it will be blocked by golden light until Morgott is defeated. See in the interactive map. Once you arrive, you will find a Site of grace on your right side and the Finger Reader Crone on your left side. Head to the lift and use the Rold Medallion given by Melina after defeating Morgott the Omen King. You won't be able to activate it without the Rold Medallion, should you, somehow, manage to reach the lift before facing Morgott.

This lift takes you to two different locations depending on the Medallion you've selected. This could take you to the Mountaintops of the Giants or the Consecrated Snowfield, an alternate secret location for which you will need Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left) and Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right).

The Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left) is found in Castle Sol. Castle Solis found in Mountaintops of the Giants in the northeast. Players can reach this location by crossing the northern bridge from Stargazer's Ruins or from the Minor Erdtree (Mountaintops East). The Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left) is found on the roof of the tower in the northeast, accessible after defeating Commander Niall.

Commander Niall is a tall and built knight with a peg leg, clad in heavy armor, wielding a halberd that doubles as a battle standard. He is accompanied by two Spectral Banished Knights, one equipped with dual swords and the other equipped with a sword and shield. Success in this battle hinges on your ability to manage the two very dangerous knights. Niall himself doesn't get too dangerous until the knights are defeated.

He will lumber around the arena, making no real effort to close the distance, so focus on the knights at the beginning. Of the two, the dual sword knight is the most aggressive and dangerous. It is highly recommended that you summon a tanky spirit to more easily manage both knights at once. They are also susceptible to Magic Damage so Sorcery mains should have a slight advantage damage-wise.

For the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right), you will need to head near the Village of the Albinaurics. Hit Albus, who is disguised as a pot past the Perfumer guarding the path up from the Village of the Albinaurics Site of Grace in the swamp caves west of Liurnia of the Lakes. Map Location here. Latenna, south of this location hints at Albus's whereabouts.
You must hit the pot located past the Depraved Perfumer to get him to show up. Then talk to him twice. Map Link
To use the secondary medallion rather than the default Rold Medallion on the lift, use left or right keys to select which Medallion you want to use when you see the switch action prompt.

Do note once you get up the Grand lift and before you hit the Consecrated Snowfield, one of the first rooms on your way to progress. You will be greeted by a group of Vulgar Militiamen and a Giant Land Octopus. The area will be a narrow corridor with fall area around it. So a couple of wrong moves can lead to a fall. Do note the high dex of this group of enemies.
notes: You won't be able to activate it without the Rold Medallion, should you, somehow, manage to reach the lift before facing Morgott

title: Ronin's Set, Talk to Shabriri
text: Grab the Zamor Ruins grace on the ledge just ahead.
Exhaust Shabriri's dialogue near the grace (appearing as Yura), then kill him to obtain the Ronin's Set.
Ronin's Set: Dropped by Shabriri .
Shabriri: Npc that looks exactly like Bloody Finger Hunter Yura. He tells you about "a righteous path to ascension"
Optional: Talk to Melina at any grace after exhausting Shabriri's dialogue.

title: Zamor Ice Storm
text: Start by following the path through Zamor Ruins:
Pick up Invigorating Cured Meat from the lower end corner of the ruins.
Invigorating Cured Meat: Consumable. Found on a corpse on the eastern side of the ruins.
At the upper end of the ruins is a corpse with Zamor Ice Storm.
Zamor Ice Storm: Snow Witch Sorcery . Found on a corpse in the southern section of the Zamor Ruins , by a stone archway.

place.title: Zamor Ruins
walk: The Zamor Ruins is a fairly large location but with little to do. The place is crawling with Knights of Zamor who are very formidable and powerful opponents. Try to sneak past them and only ever engage one at a time, lest you get overwhelmed. Of note in these ruins is the Zamor Ice Storm sorcery spell found in the southernmost section of the ruins, on a corpse by a stone archway, as well as the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing (3) found in an underground room, the entrance to which is found in the southwest section of the ruins.
notes: Was once called the Glaiis Ruins in the 1.00 version of the game

title: Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [3]
text: Open the chest in the nearby cellar to obtain Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [3].
Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [3]: Key Item. Found in an underground area beneath the Zamor Ruins . The entrance is in the southwest section of the ruins.

title: Briars of Punishment
text: Climb the rocky wall next to the cellar and follow the downhill path to a corpse with Sliver of Meat x2.
Next to a tree on the cliff overlooking the grand lift, you'll find a Golden Rune [10].
Return to the path and kill the scarab hanging behind a thorn totem on the left to obtain a Somber Smithing Stone [7].
Somber Smithing Stone [7]: Upgrade Material. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab sitting by a tree near Zamor Ruins .
Continue ahead until you reach a corpse with Smoldering Butterfly x4 next to a tree.
Pick up Arteria Leaf x3 from the ledge next to a Fire Prelate.
Farther along the ledge lies a corpse with Briars of Punishment.

Briars of Punishment: Sorcery. Found at the leftmost dead tree next to three Lesser Fire Monks just before the long stone bridge with the Golem Archer at the end in the Mountaintops of the Giants region

title: Fire Monk Ashes
text: Before you cross the bridge, turn right to find the entrance to Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs:
Head inside and grab the Giants' Mountaintop Catacomb grace.
Enter the room straight ahead for a Grave Glovewort [7].

Grave Glovewort [7]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 3 can be found inside the Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs : The first one is found by heading straight west from the Site of Grace, in the back wall of the room at the end. Back in the main path from the first lift, head left from the Boss Doors and descend the dungeon's second lift. Continue along the path and then turn right in the room with the statue. Proceed through the hall with the guillotine traps and then take the first left in the next corridor to a room with several Land Squirts . Keep moving forward until you reach a small room at the end of the path with a large Living Jar . The second glovewort can be found pressed against the right wall here. From the last glovewort, backtrack into the previous hall and look for an opening in the alcove in the right. Drop down this opening and you will end up in a balcony overlooking a room with a statue that looks identical to the one you previously passed. Head west from the statue and follow the identical pathway through another set of guillotine traps, another room with Land Squirts and another small room at the end with a Living Jar . The final glovewort is found behind the door frame of this room, on the right.
Continue to a lift and ride it down, then send it back up to reveal a secret lift:
After taking the new lift down, pick up a Grave Glovewort [8] below the stairs.

Grave Glovewort [8]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 3 can be found inside the Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs : Descend the first lift you find and then step on the plate again to send it back up. When fully raised, there is a second platform on the lift that will take you to the lowest levels of the catacombs. From here, continue east to a room with a set of stairs on the right and a Lesser Burial Watchdog . Check underneath the stairs for the first glovewort. Continue north from the first glovewort to a narrow corridor with a frost breath trap at the end. Turn left halfway through the corridor and pick up the second glovewort at the end of this path. Get back on the first lift and ascend back onto the main path. Head left from the Boss Doors and descend the dungeon's second lift. Turn right in the room with the statue and you will wind up in a hall with guillotine traps. Past the guillotines, turn left in the next corridor and go through the room with several Land Squirts . In the next hall, you will see a small room in the back with a Living Jar guarding it. Ignore that room and instead, look for an alcove on the left that you can drop down through. You will end up on a balcony overlooking a room with a statue that looks identical to the one you have previously passed but this is an entirely different floor. Head west from the statue and you will end up in another identical hall filled with guillotine traps, except this time, you can see another statue in a room in the distance. The final glovewort is found next to this statue.
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [8] from the room in the corridor with a frostbite pillar.

Grave Glovewort [8]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 3 can be found inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave . One found in the large hall locked behind an Imp Statue barrier. This is directly above the flamethrower pillar and there is a hole in the ground where a section of the pillar can rise through. Upon reaching the lift, take it to the lower level and then step on the plate again to send it back up. When it's fully raised, you can find an opening in the lift column. Pull the lever in the nearby alcove and go inside the opening in the lift column to descend further down. At the bottom level, sprint past the Lesser Burial Watchdog and turn right to find the second glovewort behind a second Lesser Burial Watchdog . Directly after picking up the second glovewort, climb the long ladder in the alcove to the right to reach an otherwise inaccessible area far west of the Troll hall. You can find the third glovewort on the north wall up here.
Hit the illusory wall on the right side of the corridor past the first pillar to reveal a Ghost Glovewort [7].
Open the chest at the end to obtain the Fire Monk Ashes.

Fire Monk Ashes: Spirit Ash. Found inside the Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs : Descend the first lift you find and then step on the plate again to send it back up. When fully raised, there is a second platform on the lift that will take you to the lowest levels of the catacombs. Continue through this path past two frost breath traps. The spell is found in a chest behind the second trap.

place.title: Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs
walk: This dungeon can be disorienting due to traversing very similar sets of rooms more than once. Similar rooms will be numbered to help.

From the Site of Grace go down two flights of stairs, an Imp will be hanging off the far wall to jump onto you. The room straight ahead will have another imp on the wall, a second one will ambush you from the right once you enter. Pick up the Grave Glovewort (7), then turn around and to the left.
After fighting past two more imps, you will reach an elevator (Elevator 1) which you should take down.

Optional Route 1 (Reward: Spirit Ashes): Send Elevator1 back up but stay on the lower level. The elevator has another platform which will be accessible to you now. Take it down to reach the lowest level of the catacombs. There is an imp here and a Lesser Burial Watchdog, the magical variant. You can cheese it slightly using the stairs. Pick up the Grave Glovewort (8) below the stairs, then proceed, but be careful since a statue will spit frostbite-inflicting dust at you. Duck into the corridor on the left, but avoid stepping on the pressure plate there. Take the statue out by hitting it, then go back to the corridor on the left to pick up Grave Glovewort (8) while being ambushed by two imps. Ahead, there is another statue, this time you have to turn right to avoid it. However, the corridor is behind an illusory wall (identifyable by being "flat" without the usual rims) and an imp hides inside. In the room with the second statue is another Lesser Burial Watchdog (physical variant). Consider using the statue by luring the watchdog into the corridor to take it out. Afterwards, pick up the Fire Monk Ashes from a chest behind the statue. This route is a dead-end to make your way back up Elevator 1.
On the main route, past Elevator 1, take a left past the locked doors to the boss. Fight past some imps until you reach another elevator with ropes attaching it to the ceiling (Elevator 2).
Take this elevator down, and proceed forward, you will find a square room with a green statue (Statue Room 1)

Here you will then encounter a Giant Living Jar, defeat it -- if you look up, you will see a corpse with loot hanging off, and a smaller statue facing the wall. This is the location of the lever that opens the boss doors, which we'll reach later.

From here, turn right, proceeding up the stairs. Be careful with the pressure plated dart trap. Once you reach the edge of the hallway, turn left, and you'll see another set of steps taking you into a room with multiple guillotine blades.
This contains multiple guillotines and exploding living jars.
Make your way through to the living jar, defeat it, and then on your way out, turn right and proceed up the stairs.
You'll find many more enemies in the next corridor -- 6 Land Squirts to be exact. Defeat them, then turn left and go up the stairs.

Avoid the pressure plate in front of you, then continue a few paces forward to fight another giant living jar in the last and pick up a Grave Glovewort (7) (you can also use the dart trap that is activated by the pressure plate to take out the living jar). Between the squirts room and the room with the jar (the room with the pressure plate), look for an alcove on the side (it's on your left if you're approaching the room, or on your right if you're exiting it) and drop down there -- but before you fall, grab the Stimulating Boluses from the corpse to the left.
When you land, you'll be on a rectangular platform -- to your left, you should immediately see a corpse holding a Nascent Butterfly.

Below you is different square room with the same statue that you saw before -- this room shall be referred as (Statue Room 2). This room has multiple Exploding Living Jars, so if you have ranged weapons, it's recommended to take them out from the safety of the platform.

Optional Route 2: Take the path to the right when facing the statue, then pass the guillotines to find another giant living jar, guarding a Grave Glovewort (8). Make your way up again past more land squirts, including a giant variety, watch out for the pressure plate, take out another living jar and pick up Grave Glovewort (7). Again, between the squirts and the jar, there is an alcove to drop down, this time dropping down multiple ledges. You have gone in a small circle and are back to Statue Room 2.
From Statue Room 2, take the path which the statue is facing. You will find an elevator which looks identical to Elevator 2 (it has the same chain design), this is Elevator 3.

Optional Route 3: Go up Elevator 3. Take out the three imps in the following room before engaging the upcoming burial watchdog (frostbite variant). Pick up Root Resin x5 and Grave Glovewort (9), then make your way back to the elevator and take it down.

Send the Elevator 3 up and look down into the "hole" in the floor where the elevator's platform was. There is another Giant Living Jar here, as well as holes which are easy to fall into. However if you fall into them you will end up in Statue Room 1 and will have to traverse the entire loop again.

Fall down the hold and either fight the pot without falling or you can turn around and run for the opposite side of the room. There, next to a corpse holding Golden Rune (10), you will find the lever which opens the boss doors.

After pulling the lever, drop down into Statue Room 1, take the path the statue is facing and after a ride up Elevator 2, you should be ready to fight the boss, an Ulcerated Tree Spirit. He drops a Golden Seed and Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing (2). A chest in the boss room contains a Deathroot.

guide.title: Continuing through the Mountaintop of Giants
text: You will now travel south and down the eastern slopes to the Frozen lake, which is engulfed in a snowstorm and will remain that way until you defeat Borealis the Freezing Fog. The very southeast of the lake has a site of grace and the First Church of Marika, so it's advisable to visit there first to get a Sacred Tear and Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing (3). You can take on the dragon or not, and if you explore the mid-west section of the lake you can enter Spiritcaller's Cave for a rather annoying Boss Fight with Godskin Apostle & Godskin Noble that yields the Black Flame Ritual incantation. The cave also has the White Reed Set and Godskin Swaddling Cloth.

Once you are done with the lake, head south on the upper portions to unlock the Whiteridge Road site of grace. You can opt to do the Lord Contender's Evergaol nearby, or press on to complete Guardian's Garrison to loot the Giant's Prayerbook. From this point, you will cross a frozen chain to the south-eastern area of the region, by Giant's Gravepoint and loot Map (Mountaintops of The Giants, East). The area that follows has some challenging enemies with high reach, so feel free to ride by to expedite your progress.

Your first step will be to follow the cliff edge and go west until you spot an opportunity for a narrow jump across a gap that lands you above the starting point of Zamor Ruins. Here you can complete Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs (get Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [2] from the boss as well as the Fire Monk Ashes). Nearby, Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave has a true wealth of high-level ash materials (Grave Glovewort 7, 8, and 9!), as well as Giant's Seal and Flame, Protect Me. Come with 2 Stone Sword Key to unlock everything. The boss is the Ancient Hero of Zamor and will drop the Zamor Set and Zamor Curved Sword.

title: Ritual Pot
text: Return to the lift and proceed forward until you reach a room with a Ritual Pot and a Grave Glovewort [7].

Ritual Pot: Crafting Pot. One found inside the Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs : Head left from the Boss Doors and descend the dungeon's second lift. Continue along the path and then turn right in the room with the statue. Proceed through the hall with the guillotine traps and then take the first left in the next corridor to a room with several Land Squirts . Keep moving forward until you reach a small room at the end of the path with a large Living Jar . There is a corpse by the back wall holding the Ritual Pot .

Grave Glovewort [7]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 2 can be found inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave . By a set of steps opposite the first Lesser Burial Watchdog encountered. Upon reaching the lift, take it to the lower level and then step on the plate again to send it back up. When it's fully raised, you can find an opening in the lift column. Pull the lever in the nearby alcove and go inside the opening in the lift column to descend further down. At the bottom level, sprint past the Lesser Burial Watchdog and turn right. Climb the long ladder to the right of a second Lesser Burial Watchdog to reach an otherwise inaccessible area far west of the Troll hall. You can find the second glovewort on the west wall up here.

title: Boss: Ulcerated Tree Spirit (Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs)
text: Grab the Stimulating Boluses in the previous room, then drop down the shaft to pick up a Nascent Butterfly from the ledge.
Nascent Butterfly: Material. Found atop a crumbled wall in Zamor Ruins
Drop down and follow the west path to a room with a Grave Glovewort [8] behind a Living Jar.
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [7] from the room at the end.
Drop down the shaft and follow the north path to a lift. Ride it up to a room with Root Resin x5 and a Grave Glovewort [9].
Root Resin: Consumable item. 4x Found on a corpse on the first trap room.

Grave Glovewort [9]: Upgrade material. 6 in total. First is found within the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs, in a room filled with imps. Another one is found in the room before taking the stairs to the second floor of the frost trap. Third is on second floor by the trap. A fourth is guarded by two Cleanrot Knights in a room in the second floor by the trap. A fifth one can be looted on the third floor by the lever to open the boss door. Final one is in a room in the second floor, guarded by a Burial Tree Watchdog.
Take the lift back down, then send it up to reveal an area below that leads to a Golden Rune [10] and the boss lever.
Kill the Ulcerated Tree Spirit for a Golden Seed, Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [2], and 48,000 runes.
Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [2]: Bell Bearing. Dropped by the Ulcerated Tree Spirit Boss fought inside the Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs .
Ulcerated Tree Spirit: Found within the Giant's Mountaintop Catacombs located in the Mountaintops of the Giants region. Droprs Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [2] ,

title: Lost Ashes of War
text: Open the chest in the room to obtain a Deathroot.
Make your way across the bridge and pick up the Lost Ashes of War along the way.
Lost Ashes of War: Key Item. Found on a corpse sitting on a chair in the narrow stretch heading north in Mountaintops of the Giants.

title: Talk to Millicent
text: Pick up Golden Rune [7], Rainbow Stone x4, and Drawstring Holy Grease x2 from a lower ledge farther along the bridge.
Grab the Golden Rune [13] on a ledge next to the Archer Golem, then kill the large scarab up ahead for a Somber Smithing Stone [8].
Golden Rune [13]: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse behind a Golem .
Somber Smithing Stone [8] B: Upgrade Material. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab found in the lower valley.
Pick up Soft Cotton x6 from a corpse against a broken pillar stone.
Soft Cotton: Consumable. Found on a corpse sitting on a chair south of the Ancient Snow Valley Ruins.
Head up the short bridge, then turn right to find a corpse with Formic Rock x2 on the cliff edge.
Formic Rock: Crafting Material. Found on a corpse at the edge of the cliffs east of the Ancient Snow Valley Ruins Site of Grace.
Turn back to discover the Ancient Snow Valley Ruins grace next to a bridge pillar.
Exhaust Millicent's dialogue next to the grace.
Millicent: NPC. Millicent will move to the Ancient Snow Valley Ruins Site of Grace at�� Mountaintops of the Giants ��after her encounter at the��Windmill Heights Grace.

title: Talk to Hermit Merchant Mountaintops East
text: Hermit Merchant Mountaintops East: Nomadic Merchant . General Goods vendor found south of Stargazer's Ruins , beneath the cliffs.

title: Talk to Brother Corhyn
text: Brother Corhyn: NPC, found at the south of Stargazer's Ruins

title: Invader: Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood, Hoslow's Set +2
text: Invade Juno Hoslow (marked on your map). Let him finish his gesture first to learn the Hoslow's Oath gesture, then kill him for a Rune Arc, Furlcalling Finger Remedy, Hoslow's Petal Whip, and Hoslow's Set.
Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood: A hostile NPC that you can invade as part of the final contract for the Volcano Manor questline. Drops Hoslow's Petal Whip along with Hoslow's Set upon defeat.
Hoslow's Set: Armor Set comprised of Hoslow's Helm , Hoslow's Armor , Hoslow's Gauntlets and Hoslow's Greaves . Dropped by Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood upon defeat.

Rune Arc: Consumable. Found on a corpse by a campfire atop the building in the south of the courtyard. This area is accessed by climbing a ladder behind the church in the southeast and following the path along the outer walls. Rune Arcs are also frequently dropped by Rat enemies in the castle.
Furlcalling Finger Remedy I: Multiplayer Item. Found under a wooden walkway in the eastern section of the castle.
miss: Serpentbone Blade reward from Tanith must be received before killing Rykard, otherwise Juno's assassination letter never spawns. Additionally, the gesture is missable if Juno is interrupted and then killed before he can do his gesture at the start of the fight.

place.title: Shack of the Lofty
walk: There are some enemies surrounding the area. These should be easy to clear. Once at the shack loot the area.
A simple shack with a single corpse, from which the entire Traveling Maiden Set can be looted.

title: Traveling Maiden Set
text: Inside the shack is a corpse with the Traveling Maiden Set.
Traveling Maiden Set: Armor set comprised of the Traveling Maiden Hood , Traveling Maiden Robe , Traveling Maiden Gloves and the Traveling Maiden Boots . Found inside the Shack of the Lofty .

title: Taker's Cameo
text: Pick up Smithing Stone [7], Warming Stone x3, and Invigorating White Cured Meat from the pile of Golem remains.

Smithing Stone [7]: Upgrade Material. 3x found on a corpse inside a building full of Rats. This room is accessed by climbing the ladder behind the church and following the path along the outer walls. The building has an opening on the roof that you can jump to.
Use the nearby spiritspring while facing southeast and head down the slope to find the Hermit Merchant (Mountaintops of the Giants).
Speak to Tanith to obtain the Taker's Cameo and accept her offer to see the lord.
Taker's Cameo: Talisman . Awarded by Tanith after completing the third letter quest.
miss: Serpentbone Blade reward from Tanith must be received before killing Rykard, otherwise Juno's assassination letter never spawns. If Tanith is absent, the reward will be on the drawing room table.

title: Serpent-Hunter
text: Activate the Audience Pathway grace after arriving, then go through the fog gate to pick up the Serpent-Hunter (can be upgraded for an easier fight).

Serpent-Hunter: Great Spear . Held by a corpse on the left as you enter the boss chamber of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy . This weapon has a special interaction when fighting Rykard in both his first phase as the God-Devouring Serpent and second phase as Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.

title: Boss: Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy
text: Kill Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy for Rykard's Great Rune, Remembrance of the Blasphemous, and 130,000 runes. (This earns an achievement.)
Rykard's Great Rune: Great Rune Key Item. Dropped by Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy upon defeat.
Remembrance of the Blasphemous: Remembrance Key Item. Dropped by Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy upon defeat.

Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy: Demi God opponent found in Volcano Manor . Initially encountered in his first phase as the God-Devouring Serpent . Drops Rykard's Great Rune and Remembrance of the Blasphemous upon defeat.

guide.title: Facing Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy
text: Upon Rykard's defeat, you will receive the Remembrance of the Blasphemous and Rykard's Great Rune. The Eye Surcoat can also be picked up from the right side of the arena and the Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy Site of Grace will be accessible.

guide.title: Returning to the Inhabitants of the Volcano Manor
text: At this point, if you teleport back to Rykard's boss arena, you'll find Tanith feasting upon his remains. You can choose to attack her, and if you do so her knight, Tanith's Knight, will invade you. Upon his defeat, he will drop the Aspect of the Crucible: Breath Incantation, and Tanith's clothing set consisting of the Consort's Mask, Consort's Robe, and Consort's Trousers. Doing this too early prevents you from completing Patches' quest however. With this, the Volcano Manor Legacy Dungeon is complete.

title: Eye Surcoat
text: Activate the Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy grace in the middle and grab the Eye Surcoat near it.
Eye Surcoat: Chest Armor. Found on the ground after defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy .

title: My Thanks
text: Return to Tanith and exhaust her dialogue.
Talk to Patches and Bernahl so that they both leave the manor.
Pick up the My Thanks gesture in the corridor.

title: Dancer's Castanets, Talk to Patches
text: If you gave Rya the Tonic of Forgetfulness, reload the area and she'll be in the drawing room. If you chose to spare her, you'll have to return to her room past the Temple of Eiglay. Refer to the multiple choice at the end of the Volcano Manor section.
Travel to Castellan's Hall and talk to Patches in the covered walkway to receive the Dancer's Castanets.
Dancer's Castanets: Key Item. Given by Patches in Shaded Castle , before the boss room, after killing Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy and talking to him in Volcano Manor .
Patches: NPC. You can then find him at the Shaded Castle before the boss and he gives you Dancer's Castanets .

title: Aspects of the Crucible: Breath
text: Optional: Speak to Tanith in Rykard's arena. You can give her the castanets, but it has no effect except losing the item.
Kill Tanith to be invaded by her knight, then kill him to obtain Aspects of the Crucible: Breath.

title: Consort's Set
text: Loot the Consort's Set from Tanith's corpse.

Consort's Set: Armor Set. Dropped by Tanith's Knight. After defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy , speak with Tanith then go back to Rykard's body. If you attack her here in his boss area, her knight will invade.

title: Golden Seed
text: Open Patches's chest in Murkwater Cave for Glass Shard x3. Upon recognizing you, he'll surrender and give the Patches' Crouch gesture.
Travel to the Divine Tower of West Altus: Gate and grab the Divine Tower of West Altus grace on the way to the top.
Restore Rykard's Great Rune at the top of the tower.
Return to Ancient Snow Valley Ruins. Follow the frozen river northeast, then turn right to find a Golden Seed.
Golden Seed: Flask Upgrade Material. Found under a Phantom Tree in the lower valley northeast of the Minor Erdtree.
miss: Unobtainable if Patches is killed before he can surrender.

place.title: Divine Tower of West Altus
walk: Reach this tower after defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy at the Volcano Manor and obtaining Rykard's Great Rune Elden Ring Map Link to restore its power. Choose to reach this location before this event and you will instead be greeted with its tightly blocked shut doors.

The entrance to the Divine Tower is hidden and can only be found by going through a series of illusory walls and defeat Onyx Lord in the Sealed Tunnel. (Follow the Sealed Tunnel Guide to reach this area.)

Once you reach the tower, step to the center of the tower platform to ascend. Take the stairs all the way up wrapping around the exterior of the tower to eventually reach. Here, you can restore the power of the Great Rune.
notes: The Divine Tower of Limgrave (left) and the Divine Tower of Liurnia (right) as seen from the Divine Tower of West Altus.

guide.title: Exploring the Consecrated Snowfield
text: The Consecrated Snowfield region is a secret area on the lower plains of the Mountaintops of the Giants, that can only be accessed by those that collect both parts of the Haligtree Secret Medallion. Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right) is found in Liurnia of the Lakes. Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left) is found in Mountaintops of the Giants. Once you have both pieces of the medallion, go to the Grand Lift of Rold and select "Hoist secret Medallion" (make sure your action is "Hoist Secret Medallion" and not "Hoist Medallion") to brandish your secret one ( Elden Ring Map: Consecrated Snowfield starting point).

This area is optional and it is up to you if you want to continue the main route which is Crumbling Farum Azula, but we do recommend that you explore this section and complete some of the Legacy Dungeons located in this section. You can also find items such as Grave Glovewort (9) in the area as well as the Deathroot, Blackflame Monk Ashes and Silver Scarab, and Spelldrake Talisman +2 loot before moving on. Upon arriving, you will be in an area overcome by a snowstorm and with very poor visibility. You should head due north to unlock the first site of grace of the area ( Consecrated Snowfield Site) and continue on that same path along the barely visible road to collect the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook (23) and a Golden Seed.

If you opt to stick to your right (east) and go north as you come out of the hidden path catacombs, you will find a teardrop scarab that drops Somber Smithing Stone (8) somewhere near the cookbook location. Continue hugging this cliff and proceed further into the storm until you arrive at the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs.

title: Founding Rain of Stars
text: Bait a Golem into attacking the statue near some icicles to obtain Smithing Stone [7] x3.
Smithing Stone [7]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse in the upper ramparts of Guardian's Garrison . A Flame Guardian is protecting it.
Go up the slope at the end of the river to discover the Freezing Lake grace next to a tree.
Head through the graveyard north of the grace until you reach the Snow Valley Ruins Overlook grace near a bridge.
On top of a broken pillar northeast of the grace is a corpse with Stimulating Boluses x3.
Cross the invisible bridge to enter Heretical Rise (look for the mist) and open the chest at the top to obtain Founding Rain of Stars. (This earns an achievement.)
Founding Rain of Stars: Glinstone Sorcery. Found inside a chest at the top of Heretical Rise . You must access the tower by crossing an invisible bridge from the other side of the ravine.

place.title: Heretical Rise
walk: Heretical Rise Puzzle solution:

You must head over to the other side of the ravine in the north and find the invisible bridge that takes you across. The invisible bridge starts northeast of the Snow Valley Ruins Overlook grace. From here, make your way across the ravine and as you reach the tower look to your left. You should see very faint mist that guides you on a winding path up to enter the tower from a balcony above (the mist is significantly easier to see at night). Tip: You can use Rainbow Stones or shoot arrows with a bow to mark safe spots to walk on. Better yet, the Icerind Hatchet or another weapon with a ground-effect Ash of War will easily reveal the safe path.
Once you reach the balcony, you'll see two Avionette Soldiers: one close to your left, and another farther on the right. It's easiest to fight them one at a time.
After defeating them, take the stairs on your left (going up) -- the stairs lead to a lift.
Take the lift up, then step forward and turn right to go up winding stairs, but be weary of a final marionette soldier waiting for you as you ascend.
The stairs end at a room with a chest in the middle containing your reward -- Founding Rain of Stars

title: Boss: Erdtree Avatar (Liurnia Southwest)
text: Exit through the bottom entrance and head left around the tower to find Old Fang x5.
Pick up Thawfrost Boluses x2 from a lower ledge on the other side of the tower.
Thawfrost Boluses: Consumable. Found on a corpse at the edge of the cliffs behind and below Heretical Rise .
Pop the three balloons in the area south of the tower for 3x Golden Rune [12].
Return to Snow Valley Ruins Overlook and cross the bridge near the grace. Kill the Erdtree Avatar for Cerulean Crystal Tear, Crimson Bubbletear, and 70,000 runes.
Erdtree Avatar: Field Boss. Drops Cerulean Crystal Tear and Ruptured Crystal Tear
Cerulean Crystal Tear A: Dropped by Erdtree Avatar .
Ruptured Crystal Tear: Dropped by Erdtree Avatar .

title: Fancy Spin
text: Pick up a Rune Arc from the branch of the Minor Erdtree that extends past the cliff edge.
On the ledge of a pillar past the cliff southwest of the Minor Erdtree, you'll find a Golden Rune [10].
Continue across a second bridge to find a Somber Smithing Stone [9] in a chair.
Optional: Talk to Corhyn and exhaust his dialogue about the noble Goldmask.
Note: You can offer him the tonic if you still have it. He'll refuse but remain on the bridge instead of moving to Leyndell later; it has no other effect.
Continue past the bridge and enter Stargazers' Ruins:
Approach the Spirit Jellyfish in the middle and summon the Spirit Jellyfish Ashes to learn the Fancy Spin gesture.
miss: The Spirit Jellyfish Ashes must be obtained from Roderika before burning the Erdtree at the Forge of the Giants.

title: Talk to Sorceress Sellen
text: Sorceress Sellen: Summon signs to either help or betray Sorceress Sellen at the end of her quest can be found right by the entrance to the Library. She will also be here to provide your reward should you choose to side with her.

title: Talk to Witch-Hunter Jerren
text: Witch-Hunter Jerren: Witch-Hunter Jerren can be found here at the Raya Lucaria Academy Library after progressing towards the end of the Sorceress Sellen questline. Choose to side with Sellen to face him in combat in this location, or choose to side with Jerren to face Sellen instead. He will also be here provide your reward should you choose to side with him.

title: Primal Glintstone Blade
text: After summoning the ashes, loot the chest in the cellar to obtain the Primal Glintstone Blade.

Primal Glintstone Blade: Talisman. Found in an underground area of the Stargazer's Ruins . The entrance is sealed by a barrier and there is a talking jellyfish atop the steps. Summon the Spirit Jellyfish next to her to unlock the seal.
miss: The Spirit Jellyfish Ashes must be obtained from Roderika before burning the Erdtree at the Forge of the Giants.

place.title: Stargazers' Ruins
walk: As you enter the main building of the ruins, you will hear a girl's voice whispering "Sister... Where did you go?" The Voice is coming from a Spirit Jellyfish in the area. Assuming you already have the Spirit Jellyfish Ashes, use it to summon her sister, Aurelia. Upon summoning the spirit ash, the sisters will have a conversation with each other, then both will disappear afterward. You don't have to worry about your spirit summon as it will remain your equipment. Remember: You cannot have a Furlcalling Finger Remedy active to summon spirits. Nullify its effects by selecting it again in your inventory, and you can proceed with unsealing the ruins.

After that, head down into the underground chamber of the ruins and open the chest located within the room. This chest contains the Primal Glintstone Blade. Note that you must summon your Spirit Jellyfish Ashes beforehand in order to unseal the door. On the eastern part of the ruins, there's a corpse holding a Freezing Grease.

You can also find the graves of the sisters nearby. Stand in front of the stairs leading downwards, head left out of the ruins and follow the slope downwards. You will find the graves near three giant bats.
notes: North-east of the Stargazers' Ruins, where the sisters' graves can be found.

title: Deathroot +1
text: In the back of the ruins is a corpse with Freezing Grease x2.
Freezing Grease: Consumable Item. Found on a corpse in the eastern section of the ruins.
Return to Snow Valley Ruins Overlook and pick up the 2x Golden Rune [10] on the path west of the grace.
Golden Rune [10] A: Rune Consumable. Found on a grave to the south as soon as you enter the main gate. Beware as there is a sleeping Lion Guardian right next to it.
Kill the Tibia Mariner on the cliff near the second Golden Rune to obtain Helphen's Steeple and a Deathroot.
Helphen's Steeple: Greatsword. Dropped by the Tibia Mariner boss found up on a ridge south of Castle Sol .
Deathroot: Obtained when defeating the Tibia Mariner on a ledge between Castle Sol Main Gate and Snow Valley Ruins Overlook.
Tibia Mariner: Optional Boss found up on a ridge south of Castle Sol . Drops a Deathroot and Helphen's Steeple upon defeat.

title: Boss: Death Rite Bird (Central Mountaintops of the Giants)
text: Return to the path to pick up Human Bone Shard x5 and a Golden Rune [11] from the corpses on either side.
Kill the Death Rite Bird farther downhill for Death Ritual Spear and 77,000 runes.
Death Ritual Spear: Spear. Dropped by the Death Rite Bird boss upon defeat.
Death Rite Bird: Optional Boss. A large Skeletal Bird found north of Stargazer's Ruins . Drops the Death Ritual Spear upon defeat.

title: Gurranq's Beast Claw, Beastclaw Greathammer +1
text: In the area with the boss is an astrolabe with Starlight Shards.
Head toward the Wandering Mausoleum and grab the Castle Sol Main Gate grace in front of the entrance.
Take down the Mausoleum by hitting the skull formations around its feet. Optionally, mark its location on your map.
Behind the castle lies a cemetery with a Golden Rune [4], Golden Rune [5], and a Golden Rune [10].
Continue around the castle to find a Somber Smithing Stone [8] on a ledge.
Somber Smithing Stone [8]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse siting on a ledge outside Castle Sol .
Feed Gurranq the two Deathroots to receive Gurranq's Beast Claw and Beastclaw Greathammer.
Gurranq's Beast Claw: Bestial Sanctum : Reward from Gurranq, Beast Clergyman after giving him the eighth Deathroot .
Beastclaw Greathammer: Given by Gurranq after turning in their 7th Deathroot.
Beast Claw: Bestial Sanctum : Reward from Gurranq, Beast Clergyman after giving him the fifth Deathroot .

title: Sorcerer Painting
text: Kill the two Elder Lions in the castle for 2x Somber Smithing Stone [7], 2x Beast Blood, and 2x Old Fang x2.
Pick up a Golden Rune [10] from the corner immediately on the right, then grab the Smithing Stone [5] below the wooden platform.
Go up the wooden stairs, then head around the left corner to find Freezing Grease x5 on the edge.
Drop down and follow the lower stairs to a Furlcalling Finger Remedy in the outside corridor.
Enter the nearby room to pick up a Nascent Butterfly, then climb the ladder to find Fan Daggers x5 between the battlement.
Follow the battlements to a Golden Rune [10], then continue past the ballistas to pick up a Smithing Stone [6] under a tent.
Descend the ladder and grab the "Sorcerer" Painting, as well as a shortcut door to the lower section.

Sorcerer Painting: Key Info Item. Found inside the central building of the courtyard. This can be accessed through the roof by walking along the top of the northwest walls and finding a walkway connecting to the building.

title: Stormhawk Axe
text: Climb back up the ladder, then jump onto the smaller tent and over the east railing to reach a corpse with the Stormhawk Axe.
Stormhawk Axe: Found on an awning at the center of the Castle, that can be accessed by dropping from above.

title: Stonesword Key
text: Drop down and pick up the Thawfrost Boluses x3 under a tent.
Thawfrost Boluses: Consumable. 3x found on a corpse in an area between two buildings accessed via the wooden walkways in the courtyard.
Continue through the next room, then up the stairs on the left to find a Golden Rune [10].
Golden Rune [10] C: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse on top of a building north of the church. Beware the spectral Exiles that appear as you approach.
Go up the other stairs and into the church to grab the Church of the Eclipse grace in the left room.
Head back out and pick up Thawfrost Boluses from a crenel next to the wooden platform.
Thawfrost Boluses: Consumable. 1x found on a corpse hanging by a wall outside the Church.
Climb the nearby ladder and cross the short stone bridge to find a Golden Rune [9].
Golden Rune [9]: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse in the middle level of the eastern section of the castle. Accessible via ladder outside the church's main entrance.
Pick up a Stonesword Key from the top battlement past a wooden bridge.
Stonesword Key: Stonesword Key held by a corpse located on the rooftop in the northern section.

title: Eclipse Shotel
text: Head back across to pick up a Smithing Stone [5] from the edge at the end.
Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. One found under the wooden platform directly opposite the main gate.
Enter the church room and pick up the Eclipse Shotel in front of the altar.
Eclipse Shotel: Curved Sword. Found at the altar of the Church in the southeast section of the castle.

title: Cerulean Amber Medallion +1
text: Head down the outside corridor until you reach a ladder. Jump onto the railing and run along the narrow ledge to a reach a Somber Smithing Stone [8].

Somber Smithing Stone [8]: Upgrade Material. Found in Castle Sol next to the Church of the Eclipse Grace. Going outside the church (to the south) around the church and up the wall till you reach the church roof. You will have to platform onto the broken wall and hug the wall of the church to reach it. It will be on a corpse hanging off the edge. Killing the crossbowmen makes this easier to do.
Run back across the ledge and drop to the area with a Rune Arc next to a campfire.
Pick up Smithing Stone [7] x3 from the corner of a room with multiple rats.
Climb the ladder in the room, then jump onto the rampart with an elite Banished Knight to pick up the Cerulean Amber Medallion +1.

Cerulean Amber Medallion +1: Upgraded Talisman. Found on a corpse hanging by a wooden ledge above the southern walls of the castle. This area is accessed by climbing a ladder behind the church in the southeast and following the walls west. Beware the very powerful dual sword knight guarding the area. He can teleport behind you and perform very long combos.

title: Boss: Commander Niall
text: Return to Church of the Eclipse and enter the other room in the outside corridor to find a Smithing Stone [6] up the stairs.
Smithing Stone [6] B: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse in the upper level of a building east of the church.
Optional: Activate the shortcut lift past the room.
Kill Commander Niall for Veteran's Prosthesis and 90,000 runes. (This earns an achievement.)
Commander Niall: Great Enemy. Found in the northeast of the castle, accessible by using the eastern exit of the church and going through the building there.
Veteran's Prosthesis: Fist Weapon. Dropped by Commander Niall upon defeat.

title: Haligtree Secret Medallion
text: Activate the Castle Sol Rooftop grace after the fight.
Use the lift past the boss and pick up the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left) at the end.
Haligtree Secret Medallion: Key Item. Found in the castle's northeast tower after defeating Commander Niall .

title: Greathood
text: Travel to Snow Valley Ruins Overlook and head toward the bridge at the end of the graveyard to pick up Greathood (painting reward).
Greathood: Helm . Reward for finding the painter of the Sorcerer Painting .
Optional: Tell Gideon Ofnir that the secret medallions are reunited.

title: Ash of War: Seppuku
text: Travel to Freezing Lake and kill the invisible scarab roaming the left side of the lake to obtain Ash of War: Seppuku.

Ash of War: Seppuku: On the frozen lake next to the "Freezing Lake" site of grace, dropped by an invisible Teardrop Scarab . The Scarab can be heard on the edge of the lake. Stand on his trail and wait for it to come back around and greet it with attacks.

title: Boss: Borealis the Freezing Fog
text: Pick up a Golden Rune [11] from a rocky outcrop on the left-side edge of the lake.
Kill Borealis the Freezing Fog in the lake for Dragon Heart and 100,000 runes.
Borealis the Freezing Fog: Optional Boss. Drops a Dragon Heart upon defeat.

Dragon Heart: Key Consumable. Dropped by Borealis, The Freezing Fog upon defeat. Dragon Hearts are used to acquire Dragon Communion Incantations at the Church of Dragon Communion and the Cathedral of Dragon Communion .

title: White Reed Set
text: Return to the grace and head along the right side of the lake to discover the entrance to Spiritcaller Cave:
Unlock the imp seal and grab the Spiritcaller Cave grace inside.
In the first room is a corpse with Arteria Leaf x5 (mind the cracks in the floor as you enter).
Continue ahead and take the first left to pick up a Rune Arc, Golden Rune [10], and Hero's Rune [1].
Rune Arc: Consumable Item. Found inside the Spiritcaller's Cave , in a small cavern with three corpses.
Hero's Rune [1]: Rune Consumable. Found inside the Spiritcaller Cave , in a small cavern with three corpses.
Drop down in the next room to find Freezing Grease x2 and a Golden Rune [12].
Grab the Invigorating White Cured Meat, White Reed Set, and a Golden Rune [6] from the room with two Spiritcaller Snails.
White Reed Set: White Reed Armor Set excluding the Helm . Found on a corpse inside the Spiritcaller's Cave , in a long cavern filled with spirit wolves.

place.title: Spiritcaller Cave
walk: This dungeon is almost completely dark in most places. It is highly recommended you equip a Torch or Lantern while traversing the cave. The cave is filled with Lesser Spirit-Caller Snails. Similar to the boss found at Road's End Catacombs, these spectral snails summon Spirit Ashes to attack their opponents. These particular snails typically summon Direwolves to defend themselves. Defeating the snails will kill their summons as well. If you hold up the Beast-Repellent Torch, the wolves will not attack you unless you attack them first, making it easy to take out the snails. Watch out for the remaining summoned enemies.

From the Site of Grace, follow the narrow tunnel to the next area and go through the tunnel in the south. Avoid the center of the room as stepping on it will form a sinkhole sending you to the level below. The next room has a tree trunk that you can use to descend. There is a snail hiding in the bushes in the southeast. Take it out and check the corpse nearby for 5x Arteria Leaf. Continue along to the west and in the next cavern, check for a small opening in the south where three corpses can be found. You can loot a Hero's Rune (1), Golden Rune (10) and a Rune Arc from them. Head back out and continue along west.

After the narrow tunnel, you arrive in another mid-sized cavern. Three different snails will summon one "Inaba, Disciple of Okina" each. The Inaba are strong enough that you should kill the snails immediately so you don't have to deal with them. Check the two corpses for a Golden Rune (12) and 2x Freezing Grease. Head south from here and kill or sneak past the wolves using the bushes. You can find their snail in the bushes further south. Check the corpse by the tree next to the snail for the White Reed Armor, White Reed Gauntlets and White Reed Greaves. There should still be several wolves in the cavern which means there is another snail. You can find it in the southeast of the caverns. Sneak up to the snail and kill it to destroy all the wolves. Now you can backtrack through the caverns to collect a Golden Rune (6) and an Invigorating White Cured Meat. When ready, proceed south through a narrow tunnel to the dungeon's boss arena.
## Boss: Godskin Apostle and Godskin Noble
Godskin Apostle and Godskin Noble are found in spirit form here and you must defeat each one-at-a-time.

Godskin Apostle appears first. The Godskin Apostle is not as aggressive as the Godskin Noble, but will still follow you around the arena. Staggering him gives you plenty of chances to perform comfortable melee attacks without worrying about his AoE spells. As he reaches lower health, he starts casting lots of area spells, and it's convenient to have a good spirit ash ally tanking him out so you can keep your distance.

Godskin Noble appears after defeating the Apostle, and also appears in spirit form. During its first stage, The Noble is not very good at ranged attacks, but it can be very awkward to fight him at melee distance. He will constantly walk towards you very aggressively. You can use the trees around the arena to pivot and create distance between you and him. Like the Apostle, the Noble can be staggered, which again gives you a safe chance to perform a critical attack on him. When low enough health, he will start rolling around (before which he will pump his chest and jump into the air), which can be very difficult to avoid. You are recommended to utilize the trees to out-maneuver him during his rolls. The trees will not stop him or get him caught, but each one he rolls over must break, and this gives you a small amount of additional time to maneuver away. He will also use Black Flame magic attacks, but they are very predictable and can be easily avoided by staying on the move and dodging.
After defeating both, the Spirit-Caller Snail (which summoned both of the Godskins) will appear. Once the snail makes itself visible, you can quickly eliminate it due to its low health.

title: Boss: Godskin Apostle and Godskin Noble
text: Kill the Spiritcaller Snail for Godskin Swaddling Cloth, Black Flame Ritual, and 70,000 runes.
Godskin Swaddling Cloth: Talisman. Dropped by the Godskin Apostle and Godskin Noble upon their defeat in the Spiritcaller's Cave .
Black Flame Ritual: Godskin Apostle Incantation . Dropped by the Godskin Apostle and Godskin Noble upon their defeat in the Spiritcaller's Cave .

Godskin Apostle and Godskin Noble: Consecutive boss fight at the end of the Spiritcaller's Cave , first against a Godskin Apostle and then a Godskin Noble . Defeating them awards the Godskin Swaddling Cloth talisman.

title: Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [3]
text: Exit the cave and continue along the right side until you reach a Somber Smithing Stone [8] next to a burrowed Crayfish.
At the end of the lake lies the First Church of Marika. Pick up the Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [3] in front of it.
Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [3]: Bell Bearing Key Item. Found on a corpse just outside the First Church of Marika .

title: Sacred Tear
text: Grab the First Church of Marika grace and the Sacred Tear in front of the statue.
Sacred Tear: A flask upgrade found within the First Church of Marika

place.title: First Church of Marika
walk: When make your way to the church, you can ride on horseback southeast, following the direction of the lake on your map. You may encounter Borealis the Freezing Fog, who lingers at the outskirts towards the entrance of the church, but despite the encounter, you can choose to not engage in combat. He is an optional boss though, and defeating him will reward players with additional Runes and a Dragon Heart.

If you continue in the same direction, you will eventually come across the small ruins of the church. It will be surrounded by Spirit Jellyfish. Go ahead and active the Site of Grace, then head to the centerpiece statue and obtain the Sacred Tear. At the short cliff overlooking the church, left of the entrance, head up the tip to obtain x3 Smithing Stone (7) Elden Ring Map Link. In this area, players can also obtain a Key Item, Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing (3) Elden Ring Map Link, which unlocks Somberstone (5) and (6) upgrade materials sale at the Twin Maiden Husks in the Roundtable Hold. Found in a corpse just outside the First Church of Marika. There are no other points of interest in this location.
notes: The church sits in the Mountaintops of the Giants and survives only as ruins — there is no interior to explore.
It is the marker most players use to find the Weeping Evergaol, which lies just down the hill to the northeast and holds the Ancient Hero of Zamor.
Despite the name it is unrelated to the Fourth Church of Marika in the Weeping Peninsula, which is a separate site entirely.

title: Boss: Roundtable Knight Vyke
text: Optional: Talk to Melina twice at the First Church of Marika grace.
Pick up Smithing Stone [7] x3 from a rocky outcrop next to the church.
Smithing Stone [7]: Upgrade Material. Three can be obtained from a corpse sitting on a chair atop the cliffs east overlooking the First Church of Marika .
Follow the path near the church to a cemetery with 2x Golden Rune [7] and a Golden Rune [10].
Use the spiritspring near the cemetery and kill Roundtable Knight Vyke in the evergaol for Vyke's Dragonbolt, Fingerprint Set, and 75,000 runes.
Roundtable Knight Vyke: Optional Boss. Located in Contender's Evergaol . Drops Fingerprint Set Vyke's Dragonbolt upon defeat.
Vyke's Dragonbolt: Dragon Cult Incantation . Received after defeating Vyke, Knight of the Roundtable at Lord Contender's Evergaol .

Fingerprint Set: Armor Set comprised of the Fingerprint Helm , Fingerprint Armor , Fingerprint Gauntlets , and the Fingerprint Greaves . drops from Lord Contender's Evergaol Boss Fight: Roundtable Knight Vyke .

place.title: Lord Contender's Evergaol
walk: Like most Evergaols in Elden Ring, the area is also surrounded by Abnormal Stone Clusters. Upon activating the Evergaol, Roundtable Knight Vyke will spawn in the area.

This is a boss fight, and Vyke is also considered as an NPC, so he will be able to use a single flask to heal. His attacks mostly deal lightning damage. Most of his combo strings are also interruptible, so try to bait him into attacking you and when he whiffs, try going in within range to attack. But do not strike him when you see him leap into the air and perform a plunge to the ground, you cannot interrupt him during this attack. Doing so may cost you your life, as it deals a lot of damage, and it will also stun you due to the whirlwind effect, and one more hit could immediately kill you. Best way to fight him is to stay on your right and keep dodging right, since he will keep his spear on his right hand and never two-hand the weapon.

He has two long range spells that he can utilize, the first one is called Fortissax’s Lightning Spear, where he summons two red lightning spears and throws them to the ground, that then spread in four different directions from where he is standing. The other one is Lightning Strike, you would need to pay attention to his hand, it will light up before he performs the attack, bolts of lightning will start striking in your direction. The best way to avoid this is to just run in one direction continuously until he stops the spell. He will also buff with Vyke's Dragonbolt, giving him lightning damage on his weapon, at the cost of lowering his Lightning Damage negstion.
Upon defeating Vyke, you will receive Vyke's Dragonbolt, as well as the Fingerprint Set.

title: Stonesword Key
text: Follow the snow-covered path down to find Explosive Greatbolt x5 next to a campfire past some spiked barricades.
Continue past the barricades to discover the Whiteridge Road grace.
Pick up the Stonesword Key next to a Fire Prelate up ahead.
Stonesword Key: Stonesword Key. Held by a corpse in front of the fort's entrance.

title: Invader: Chief Guardian Arghanthy, One-Eyed Shield
text: Head up the nearby stairs to enter Guardians' Garrison:
Behind some crates on the outside ledge is a Golden Rune [10].
Golden Rune [10]: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse on the ledge past some barrels near the entrance to Guardian's Garrison.
Go up the stairs to find a corpse with Smoldering Butterfly x6.
Smoldering Butterfly: Crafting Material. 6 are found on a corpse by an active fire inside Guardian's Garrison.
Climb the ladder in a corner on the ground floor, then pick up the Smithing Stone [7] at the end.
Break some crates to reveal a gap in the battlement. Head up the scaffolding and kill Chief Guardian Arghanthy to obtain the One-Eyed Shield.
Chief Guardian Arghanthy: NPC Mini-Boss, attacks with quick Fire spells. Drops One-Eyed Shield when defeated.
One-Eyed Shield: Shield. Dropped by mini-boss NPC Chief Guardian Arghanthy inside Guardian's Garrison .

place.title: Guardians' Garrison
walk: From the White Ridge Road Site of Grace, you can make your way towards the Garrison, weaving through the wooden barricades. You can ignore most of the enemies here as they do not aggro unless very close. However, there is a Flame Monk guarding the main staircase into the garrison. You can run past him and fight him from atop the stairs where you have the higher ground. Inside the fort, head out the balcony and kill the Rotten Stray on the right. Check behind the crates on the opposite side for a corpse with a Golden Rune (10). Head back inside and take out the Rotten Stray near the camp and then engage the Flame Guardian. These guardians aren't overly difficult and they are highly susceptible to sorcery spells.

Go up the steps ahead and check the corpse by the brazier for 6x Smolderin' Butterfly. There are a couple of Rats in this area as well. Jump down the ledge opposite the corpse with the brazier and climb the ladder behind you to reach the upper floor. Follow the wooden walkway and head up the steps at the end to find another Flame Guardian. There is another one at the very end of this walkway. Check the corpse at the end for a Smithing Stone (7). Backtrack a bit and look for a broken section of the Garrison's walls where you can jump through onto a wooden platform outside. Follow this platform around the tower to reach the top floor of the garrison where you will find Chief Guardian Arghanthy waiting. In the tower to the left of the entrance to this platform, there is a pair of Strays. Deal with these before fighting the boss, or find a way to avoid them entirely.

Arghanthy is a very difficult opponent that uses some very advanced fire spells. His most dangerous one is a flame burst that he uses when players get too near, dealing massive damage at close range. He also has a long flamethrower spell that has decent tracking but can be sidestepped. Finally, when he plunges his hands into the ground, stay clear of the immediate area as flame pillars will burst forth from below. Consider using fire protective gear and consumables when fighting this opponent, as well as powerful Spirit Summons to distract him. Upon defeat, he will drop his One-Eyed Shield.
After defeating Arghanthy, head inside the tower he came out of in the southwest and climb up the ladder. At the top is a chest containing the Giant's Prayerbook.

Go down to the stairs before the Strays and jump up the inward wall, follow it until reaching a lower wall and jumping down on to it. Proceed by jumping on the wooden roof and then on the battlements. Follow the path you reach a corpse with 2x Gravel Stone
notes: Outside the Garrison:
While climbing the tower you can hear a metal scarab, it has the Prelate's Charge Ash of War and is located right outside the Garrison, in a white, elongated twisted tree.
Opposite the entry stairs there is a Stonesword Key on a corpse right behind a Big Fire Monk

title: Giant's Prayerbook
text: Open the chest at the top of a tower to obtain the Giant's Prayerbook.
Giant's Prayerbook: Key Item. Give to a Cleric to unlock Incantations: Giantsflame Take Thee and Flame, Fall Upon Them for purchase.

title: Ash of War: Prelate's Charge
text: Follow the wooden platforms below a hole in the battlement to reach a corpse with Smoldering Butterfly x5.
Drop down from the wooden platform and pick up the Golden Rune [8] next to a thorn totem.
Kill the scarab hanging from a totem to obtain Ash of War: Prelate's Charge.
Ash of War: Prelate's Charge: In Mountaintops of the Giants . South of Whiteridge Road Grace. Inside a Fire Monk campsite, look for the scarab hanging on a tree.

title: Map (Mountaintops of The Giants, East)
text: Cross the chain bridge at the end to grab the Giants' Gravepost grace and Map: Mountaintops of the Giants, East.
Map (Mountaintops of The Giants, East): Found at the altar. You can arrive by walking on the chain from the enemy encampment.

title: Flame, Protect Me
text: Follow the cliff edge on the right until the area evens out. Against some trees on the left sits a corpse with Invigorating White Cured Meat x3.
Invigorating White Cured Meat: Consumable. Found at the bottom of a tree.
Pick up Drawstring Holy Grease x2 in front of a burrowed Fingercreeper down the slope.
At the bottom of the slope, you'll find a corpse with a Somber Smithing Stone [7].
Jump across the gap between the cliffs and enter Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave:
Ride the lift down and grab the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave grace.
Unlock the imp seal near the grace to pick up Flame, Protect Me.
Flame, Protect Me: Fire Monk Incantation . Found in a room at the beginning of the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave , just in front of the Site of Grace. Requires 2 Stonesword Keys to unlock.

title: Cranial Vessel Candlestand
text: Hit the illusory wall to the right of the Fire Monk to reveal a corridor, then pick up a Golden Rune [11] from one of the windows.
Golden Rune [11]: Found north of the Consecrated Snowfield Site of Grace
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [7] in the room below, then grab the Grave Glovewort [9] down the stairs.

Grave Glovewort [9]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 3 can be found inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave . One is found behind the first Lesser Burial Watchdog encountered, in a room under the circle of light. When you reach the lift, take it down and then step on the plate again to send it up back up but jump off immediately. Once it's fully raised, you will see an opening in the column. Pull the lever in the nearby alcove and enter the opening in the lift. It will take you further down. At the bottom, check behind the lift column for the second glovewort.
Deactivate the fire-breathing pillar ahead, then pick up the Freezing Grease up the stairs in the next room.
Unlock the imp seal and fall down the hole to reactivate the pillar and create a light zone. Pick up the Grave Glovewort [8] and Cranial Vessel Candlestand at the end.

Cranial Vessel Candlestand: Warhammer. Found inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave on a corpse at the end of the large hall locked behind an Imp Statue barrier. This is directly above the room with the flamethrower pillar.
