Grave Glovewort [8]: Upgrade material. One is found in the first room with a frost trap.

title: Giant's Seal
text: Use the lift ahead, then send it up to reveal a secret lift. Pull the lever to ride the secret one down, then look behind it to find a Grave Glovewort [9].

Grave Glovewort [9]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One can be found inside the Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs : From the Boss Doors, head left and descend the dungeon's second lift. Turn right in the room with the statue and you will wind up in a hall with guillotine traps. Past the guillotines, turn left in the next corridor and go through the room with several Land Squirts . In the next hall, you will see a small room in the back with a Living Jar guarding it. Ignore that room and instead, look for an alcove on the left that you can drop down through. You will end up on a balcony overlooking a room with a statue that looks identical to the one you have previously passed but this is an entirely different floor. Head for the corridor the statue is facing to find a third lift. Ascend the lift and get past the hallway with Imps to find a small room with the glovewort, guarded by a Lesser Burial Watchdog .
Climb the ladder at the east end of the corridor and grab the Giant's Seal and a Great Grave Glovewort from the room with a Fire Prelate.

Giant's Seal: Sacred Seal found inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave : In the large hall with the Troll, drop down from either side of the platform into a room with a Prelate . Defeat it and check the right side of the room for a corpse holding the seal. Alternatively, you can reach this room by descending the lift and sending it back up. Pull the lever in the alcove to the right and then enter the small space in the raised lift to descend further down. In the next hall, sprint past the Lesser Burial Watchdog and turn left. Climb the ladder at the end of this path.

Great Grave Glovewort: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One found inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave . In the large hall with the Troll, drop down from either side of the platform into a room with a Prelate . Defeat it and check the very back of the room for the glovewort. Alternatively, you can reach this room by descending the lift and sending it back up. Pull the lever in the alcove to the right and then enter the small space in the raised lift to descend further down. In the next hall, sprint past the Lesser Burial Watchdog and turn left. Climb the ladder at the end of this path.

place.title: Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave
walk: ## How to Reach

The Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave is found just northeast of the Zamor Ruins. However, it is high atop a plateau and reaching it will require some legwork and circling around most of the region's northeastern sections. Ride past the ruins and around the lower cliffs of the plateau towards the east until you reach a very narrow pathway/bridge heading northeast. Cross this treacherous path and continue heading northeast through the valley between Stargazers' Ruins and the Minor Erdtree. You should reach the narrow river section of the Freezing Lake shortly.

Continue northeast until you reach the Freezing Lake site of grace and then head southeast, keeping close to the western edge of the lake. Once you are able to get up the hill in the west, follow it down to the Guardians' Garrison in the southwest. From here, head south and cross the giant chain bridge to find the Giants' Gravepost site of grace. From here, ride southwest, keeping close to the cliff edges and watching out for Fingercreepers littering the area. At the end of the path, there should be a small gap you can jump across to finally get to the plateau where the Hero's Grave can be accessed. Watch out for the large Fingercreeper that pops out from the gap as you approach.
## Walkthrough

Note: This Dungeon is similar to others in that enemies (Several Imps, as well as a few Lesser Burial Watchdogs) will appear in dark, ghost forms. They cannot be damaged, staggered, or affected until they step on the golden floor seal ('the light'). The Imps and Watchdog will be staggered as they touch the Seal and lose their invulnerability.

Stepping down from the elevator inside the Catacombs, players will immediately find a Site of Grace to use. Heading into the catacombs from the Site of Grace players will see a room sealed by an imp statue. You can choose to use a Stonesword Key here to open the seal for the Flame, Protect me incantation (Faith requirement: 24) within. On the left (coming from the site of grace) is a pathway to another area.
Proceed down this route, and your pathway will intersect with a perpendicular pathway where a Fire Monk is patrolling back and forth.
Kill the Fire Monk, and turn right. You'll see two archways, the one on the right has some pottery in front of it, but the one on the left (closest to the windows) is an illusory wall.

Opening the illusory wall reveals a long corridor. Proceed to the end of it, picking up a Golden Rune [11] about 3/4 of the way through, and when you reach the end, turn left and jump out of the window.
When you land, turn left. You'll see the floor seal discussed earlier in front of you, and on your right will be a small archway to walk through.
Enter it, but note that the perpendicular corridor will have a trap statue in it that spews flame.

The statue spewing the flame is too far to reach from here, but what you can do is quickly run straight, then turn right, then turn again (basically making a U-shape) into a small alcove to take cover from the flame. A Fire Monk will be waiting in this alcove for you.
This alcove is close enough that you can then time your run to make it to the statue and hit it before the next flame cycle.
After turning off the flame-sprinkler, proceed up the stairs on your left.
You'll encounter your 3rd flame monk here.

Around where the Flame Monk was standing is a set of stairs on your right, which lead in the direction opposite of you. Take these stairs up, and you'll find another room guarded by a Stonesword Key Imp statue. Regardless of whether or not you choose to enter, make sure to grab the Freezing Grease hanging off the ledge.
(Looking through the door, you can see some loot at the very back -- this is the Cranial Vessel Candlestand warhammer.)

In the room is a deactivated floor seal. Activate it by using a ranged attack on the trap pillar near the fire monk who ambushed you (one level below), to raise it and activate the seal. Past the seal are three invulnerable Imps guarding a corpse with the Cranial Vessel Candlestand warhammer. Alternatively, if you're fast and lazy, you can simply run in, grab the loot, and run back out.
Once you're done in this room, come back out the way you came in, and proceed back down the stairs and take the lift in the room in front of you.

When that lift gets to the bottom, step on the button again to send it back up, but get off. This will activate the seal in front of the lift and reveal an alcove in the lift bottom (but not get into it yet).
(This alcove is what you'll use to access the optional basement section later -- for now we will ignore it).
Stepping off the lift, you'll see a floor seal in front of you.

To the right will be a partially demolished staircase. Since the lower half of the stairset is missing, you can't go up it, so the only way you can go is left -- where there is a large vertical door with a lever on the right side of it.
Once you open the door, you'll see a darkened Troll.

Lure the troll to the seal and fight it. Remember that since enemies in their darkened state are immune to damage, you cannot simply shoot an arrow to aggravate him, you must manually get close enough. This fight is not optional -- you must defeat the Troll to open the boss door.
After defeating the Troll, you'll get the message saying Somewhere, a heavy door has opened which lets you know that the door to the boss is now open.
The door to the boss is just in front of where the troll you defeated was originally standing.
Inside the boss room, you'll find 2x Root Resin.
## Boss Fight

The Ancient Hero of Zamor is the boss of the dungeon. He is susceptible to bleed, and is slow moving. A spirit summon is allowed in this boss fight. Defeating him yields the Zamor Curved Sword and the entire Zamor Armor Set.
## The Basement Section

The basement section is optional. Before you go down go back to the elevator and activate it with the lever, in order to go down moving the seal statue to the basement (otherwise you won't be able to fight the two Watchdogs). Now you have three options to go to the basement:

In the room where the Troll was initially, jump down to the basement, but beware of the Prelate. Afterwards you can go down a ladder or jump down a shaft. Both ways bring you to the hallway with the two Lesser Burial Watchdogs.

When activating the elevator with the level so it moves down, quickly get into the alcove to ride down as well. You can now fight the two Lesser Burial Watchdogs.easier and one by one. Then go up the ladder to the left (when you enter the hallway from the elevator) to face the Prelate.

As an alternative, though not recommended: In the room that you lured to the Troll to, it is possible to jump onto the candlestick on the right side of the collapsed stairs. This can only be tried once as the candlestick will break if you fail (jump from the heap of rubble in front of the stairs). You can then jump onto the collapsed staircase, allowing you to get up to the upper floor. You can proceed down the ladder to the double Lesser Burial Watchdog hallway. You will have to run past both watchdogs to lure them to the seal on the left side.
The Prelate is guarding a Great Grave Glovewort, and the Giant's Seal.

The two Lesser Burial Watchdogs are also invulnerable and can only be fought if you lowered the elevator (see above). The elevator and the seal is behind the watchdog on the right (when you enter the hallway from the Prelate). Note: You do not have to kill them. If you choose to, they can be baited into striking each other for massive damage. You can also run past both of them and quickly take the ladder back up.
To go back up, use the ladder besides one of the watchdogs (the one at the end of the hallway). You will end up above the broken stairs.

title: Boss: Ancient Hero of Zamor (Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave)
text: Return to the previous room and pick up the Grave Glovewort [8] at the west end of the corridor.
Climb the other ladder to a room with a Grave Glovewort [7] and a Grave Glovewort [8].
Drop down and send the lift up to create a light zone. Open the gate and kill the giant inside the zone to unlock the boss door.
Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [9] in front of the boss door.
Ghost Glovewort [9]: Ghost Glovewort found in a room with 2 Cleanrot Knights.
Kill the Ancient Hero of Zamor for Zamor Curved Sword, Zamor Set, and 83,000 runes.
Zamor Curved Sword: Curved Greatsword. Dropped by the Ancient Hero of Zamor inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave upon defeat.
Zamor Set: Armor Set comprised of Zamor Mask , Zamor Armor , Zamor Bracelets and Zamor Legwraps . Dropped by the Ancient Hero of Zamor Boss inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave upon defeat.
Ancient Hero of Zamor: Optional Boss. Found at the end of the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave . Drops the Zamor Curved Sword and the entire Zamor Armor Set upon defeat.

title: Invader: Bloody Finger Okina, Rivers of Blood +1
text: Travel to Giants' Gravepost and head uphill to find Fan Daggers x5 and Warming Stone x2 on the slope.
Warming Stone: Consumable. 2 Warming Stones found on a body in the Mountaintops of the Giants.
Approach the church at the top right side of the slope to be invaded by Bloody Finger Okina. Kill him to obtain the Rivers of Blood and Okina Mask.
Bloody Finger Okina: NPC Invader. Deals powerful blows with his Katana. Drops Rivers of Blood upon defeat.
Rivers of Blood: Katana dropped by NPC invader Bloody Finger Okina . Spawns near the Church of Repose in the later areas of the game.
Okina Mask: Dropped by NPC Invader Bloody Finger Okina alongside his trusted katana, Rivers of Blood

place.title: Flame Peak
walk: Flame Peak has a boss fight area. Enter through the fog gates to face the Fire Giant Elden Ring Map. This location is easily found after visiting the Church of Repose. From this location head east and cross the narrow stone bridge to enter the fog gate. Defeat the Fire Giant to obtain 180,000 Runes and Remembrance of the Fire Giant.

title: Sacred Tear
text: Grab the Church of Repose grace and the Sacred Tear in front of the statue.
Sacred Tear: Flask upgrade, found inside the Church of Ripose , below the main statue.

title: Ash of War: Troll's Roar
text: Use the spiritspring behind the giant skull south of the church to reach a corpse with Ash of War: Troll's Roar on top.
Ash of War: Troll's Roar: Can be found on the top of the big rock just southeast of the Church of Repose .

place.title: Church of Repose
walk: A pretty straightforward church. It possesses a Sacred Tear before the main statue, as well as a Site of Grace. Once you reach the entrance, beware of the one enemy you may encounter Bloody Finger Okina. Clear her and head to the statue to obtain the Sacred Tear. There are no other points of interest in this location.

title: Golden Seed
text: In the mouth of the skull is an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone: Upgrade Material. Found in the skull of a dead giant southeast of the Church of Repose .
On top of the crag northeast of the skull is a teleporting scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [8].
Somber Smithing Stone [8]: Dropped from a Teardrop Scarab found at the top of a small mountain. Will vanish if it spots you or you get too close.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [7] guarded by a Giant Crow below the crag, but be wary of the very large Fingercreeper...
Grab the Foot of the Forge grace behind the corpse of a giant close by.
Pick up a Golden Rune [10] from a recess in the cliff north of the grace.
Golden Rune [10] A: Rune Consumable. Found inside a small cave. Beware of enemies guarding it.
Head up the northeast slope until you reach a Golden Seed.
Golden Seed: Flask Upgrade Material. Found under a Phantom Tree before a frozen giant.

title: Crimsonwhorl Bubbletear
text: An astrolabe with Starlight Shards sits at the edge of the cliff farther northeast.
Starlight Shards: Found in front of a crescent bowl-shaped stone statue by the cliffs.
Follow the curved cliff edge west to find a Golden Rune [10] partway along it.
Golden Rune [10] B: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse below the frozen body of a giant.
At the center of the curved cliff formation, in front of the giant corpse, you'll find Grace Mimic x3.
Continue downhill and pick up the Golden Rune [10] below a giant corpse.
Follow the slope down a narrow pathway to reach a basin with the Crimsonwhorl Bubbletear.

Crimsonwhorl Bubbletear: On a cliff ledge south of Giants' Gravepost (above the grace point, the ledge is accessed by going north-east from the Foot of the Forge grace point, Just follow the edge of the cliff until you see the path going above Giant's Gravepost).

title: Boss: Fire Giant
text: Cross either chain bridge near the grace and kill the Fire Giant for Remembrance of the Fire Giant and 180,000 runes. (This earns an achievement.)
Remembrance of the Fire Giant: Drops from Fire Giant upon defeat.
Fire Giant: Main Boss. Found at Flame Peak . Drops Remembrance of the Fire Giant

place.title: Forge of the Giants
walk: There's nothing to loot or explore in the Forge of the Giants other than reach the Site of Grace at the end of the left edge. (Except for a single smoldering butterfly partway around the edge to the right.) Once you reached the edge, don't attempt to explore the center of the forge as it will result in instant death. The only relevant thing to do here, is to talk to Melina in that Site of Grace. She will ask you if you are ready to commit to a sin, in which if you accept, after a few cinematics you will be teleported to Crumbling Farum Azula. Before accepting, it is recommended that your character is around Lvl 100+ otherwise this area might be a bit heavy for you.

If you've inherited the Frenzied Flame, then Melina won't show up at this stage, instead there will be an option to "Listen to the sounds of flame" at the site of grace. After which you'll be teleported to Crumbling Farum Azula all the same.

Be sure to finish or skip the cutscene. Quitting during the cutscene will interrupt the telportation process and you might not be able to progress to NG+. If the cutscene is interrupted, attempt to rest at the Forge of the Giants site of grace again. It should re-trigger the cutscene and teleportation process.
notes: Elden Ring Forge of the Giant Notes and Tips go here.

Do not attempt to explore the center down below, as it will result in Instant Death. There's a site of grace that can be found rounding the left edge of the forge at the end of it right before you reach the crack.
Brother Corhyn / Goldmask questline;
Nepheli Loux questline.
The Roundtable Hold interior will visually burn for the remainder of the game. Blacksmith and spirit tuning services remain available.
The Erdtree's appearance will include partially burning red colors instead of the previous yellow.

These changes are not to be confused with the more significant burning red embers that cover the game world, and the ashen transformation of Leyndell, which only occur after the player defeats Maliketh.

title: Silver Scarab
text: Optional: Alexander can be summoned if you spoke to him at Mt. Gelmir.
Grab the Fire Giant grace at the top of the slope for later.
Travel to the Grand Lift of Rold and hoist the secret medallion to reach the Hidden Path to the Haligtree:
Go straight ahead to pick up Warming Stone x2 in front of an altar.
There's a gap in the balustrade up the stairs, but you'll want the grace first, so grab the Freezing Grease x5 at the top of the room.
Pick up the Grave Glovewort [9] around the corner and grab the Hidden Path to the Haligtree grace just up the stairs.

Grave Glovewort [9]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. 3 can be found in the Hidden Path to the Haligtree . The first is guarded by two Land Octopuses and a Vulgar Militiaman near the exit to the Consecrated Snowfield . The next two are found in the secret catacombs below. One is in the first alcove that you can access after jumping down onto the invisible walkways under the staircase. The last one can be found in a third alcove across to the west from the second alcove guarded by two Vulgar Militants .
Drop onto an invisible bridge below the gap in the balustrade, then go through the south doorway to reach a Grave Glovewort [9].
Hit the illusory wall past the glovewort to reveal a chest with the Silver Scarab.

Silver Scarab: Found in a chest in Hidden Path to the Haligtree . The chest is found past an illusory wall, behind a Grave Glovewort (9) inside the first alcove that you can access by jumping down onto the invisible walkways under the staircase in the main hall.

title: Spelldrake Talisman +2
text: Walk across the invisible bridge and through the north doorway to pick up Sacramental Bud x3.
Follow the invisible bridge down to a room with a Grave Glovewort [9].
Drop to the stone platform below to pick up a Hero's Rune [1].

Hero's Rune [1]: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse on a balcony before the room with the boss door's lever. This is in the secret catacombs underneath the large staircase, accessed by navigating a series of invisible walkways.
Jump through either window to land in a room with Old Fang x6 and the boss lever.
Old Fang: Crafting Material. Looted from a body in the middle of a bout between Wandering Nobles and Wolf enemies.
Below the stairs is a corpse with Root Resin x4, guarded by four Vulgar Militia.
Turn right before the boss room and ride the lift up to a corpse with Spelldrake Talisman +2.

Spelldrake Talisman +2: Upgraded Talisman. Found in the secret catacombs underneath the Hidden Path to the Haligtree by turning right just before the Stray Mimic Tear 's boss door, following the corridor and taking the lift up. The talisman is found on a corpse in an alcove at the top.

title: Boss: Stray Mimic Tear
text: Kill the Stray Mimic Tear for Blackflame Monk Amon and 50,000 runes.

Stray Mimic Tear: Optional Boss. Found in the secret underground catacombs underneath the Hidden Path to the Haligtree found by navigating a series of invisible walkways underneath the large staircase in the main hall. See the location page for details on how to reach the boss. Drops the Black Flame Monk Ashes upon defeat.
Blackflame Monk Amon Ashes: Spirit Ash. Dropped by the Stray Mimic Tear boss found in the secret catacombs underneath the Hidden Path to the Haligtree .
Loot the chest in the room to obtain the final Deathroot.

place.title: Hidden Path to the Haligtree
walk: Inside the Hidden Path to the Haligtree, there are two paths you can take. The main path which leads you to the Consecrated Snowfield which is your main goal, and a second path that leads underneath, deeper into the catacombs to some treasure and an optional boss.
## To the Consecrated Snowfield

After opening the gates, you'll arrive in a large hall with a large staircase to your left and a small chapel straight ahead in front of you. In this chapel, there's a body holding a Warming Stone by the altar. Beware, however, of the two Land Octopuses and a single Giant Land Octopus that will drop down from above the chapel.

Back in the main hall, make your way up the stairs while fighting off a couple of Vulgar Militants. Note the broken section of railing to your left at the midpoint of the staircase. There is an invisible walkway below that you can reach by dropping down from here. Ignore it for now and continue along the staircase.

At the top of the steps, another Giant Land Octopus will drop down from below. Past that, head up another set of steps and you'll come across two Land Octopuses on your left guarding a Grave Glovewort [9]. On your right is another set of stairs leading up to the Site of Grace, followed by the exit that leads you to Consecrated Snowfield.
## To the Secret Catacombs

From the Site of Grace, make your way back down the staircase in the main hall and stand where the broken section of railing is, it will be on your right hand side if you're coming down the stairs (from the site of grace), or on your left hand side if you are coming up from the original entrance. See image below.

Looking down, you should be able to see an alcove along the walls across the pit. Walk to the ledge and drop a Rainbow Stone or Glowstone, etc., to ensure solid landing. Walk forward to drop to the invisible floor. Once on the invisible floor, you can move straight ahead into the alcove. Again, refer to the image below.

Those finding themselves gripped with paranoia, you can continue to use Rainbow Stones, Glowstones, Rainbow Stone Arrows, Wave of Gold and/ or Hoarfrost Stomp to ensure proper footing. (-Sidenote: If you can spare the FP, Hoarfrost Stomp will only populate the ground with visual icicles on level/ solid surfaces and, as such, this Ash of War is extremely useful here, further in, and in navigating any invisible floor/ entry into the Heretical Rise.- end side note). Now that you've entered the alcove, turn right, there's a Grave Glovewort (9) to pick up and behind it, an illusory wall.

Dispel the wall to find a chest with the Silver Scarab talisman. After taking the loot, look through the alcove's doorway and you should see another alcove straight across. You can walk along the invisible pathway to get to it but note that the pathway is not completely straight so adjust slightly to the left as you approach the central pillars so that you are right in the middle of them.

If you are having trouble finding your way, consider using Rainbow Stones or shoot arrows and bolts to mark safe sections to walk on. If playing online, there is likely a lot of player messages and bloodstains that would serve the same purpose. Through the alcove is a small room with a couple of Vulgar Militants and a corpse with 3x Sacramental Bud. Carefully exit the room and look towards the west where you'll see another doorway in the distance.

Align yourself with it and walk straight ahead. The path slants downwards slightly. This alcove contains two more Vulgar Militants, with one hiding behind the door frame to the right, waiting to ambush as you pass by. There is another Grave Glovewort (9) by the wall at the end.
Exiting the room, look to your right and you should see a balcony below with a corpse.

You can simply jump down here from the invisible walkway. Loot the corpse for a Hero's Rune (1). Behind the corpse are two window sills, jump onto one of them, and if you have ranged attacks, you can safely take out the Giant Land Octopus hovering above the next room, as well as the Vulgar Militants below it. On the north side of the wall, underneath a statue, is a lever. Pull it to open a boss door.

Then, turn around and head south down to the stairs. There are five Land Octopuses at the foot of the steps. There is a room behind the steps with five Vulgar Militants as well.. Leave the room and head through the narrow hallway opposite to find the boss room. There is a Stakes of Marika here, so you are fairly safe. Before entering the boss room, turn right and follow the corridor up to find a lift. Take it all the way up and check the corpse in the alcove for the upgraded Spelldrake Talisman +2. Head back down the lift and back to the boss door.
## Boss: Stray Mimic Tear

The boss is the Stray Mimic Tear which shouldn't pose too much trouble, especially if you are using sorcery or incantations. It drops Blackflame Monk Amon spirit ashes. There is also a chest in the back with a Deathroot inside.. Either use the teleporter or exit the room and take the elevator on your left to leave the area and enter the Consecrated Snowfield.

title: Boss: Black Blade Kindred (Bestial Sanctum)
text: Feed Gurranq the last Deathroot to receive an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Kill the Black Blade Kindred outside the sanctum for Gargoyle's Blackblade, Gargoyle's Black Halberd, and 88,000 runes.
Gargoyle's Blackblade: Greatsword dropped by the Black Blade Kindred guarding the entrance to the Bestial Sanctum .
Gargoyle's Black Halberd: Halberd dropped by the Black Blade Kindred guarding the entrance to the Bestial Sanctum .
Black Blade Kindred: Boss found at the entrance of the Bestial Sanctum. Drops Gargoyle's Blackblade and Gargoyle's Black Halberd

place.title: Bestial Sanctum
walk: This area is guarded by a Black Blade Kindred, but its defeat is not required to access. Circle around the boss and sneak near the wall up to the door. There is a Site of Grace upon entry to the right-hand side, while the only NPC to be found is Gurranq, Beast Clergyman in the back of the room. The purpose of this area is to turn in Deathroots to redeem the items listed above.

title: Cinquedea, Dragoncrest Shield Talisman
text: Descend the roots in the cliff west of the sanctum, then make your way down to the second level to pick up Soft Cotton x3 from a corpse in the middle.
Carefully drop to the bottom level to grab the Cinquedea and Dragoncrest Shield Talisman.
Cinquedea: Dagger. Found outside the bestial sanctum, after a long series of platforms starting on the west side to drop down onto the external structure's base.
Dragoncrest Shield Talisman: Talisman found on one of the edges of Bestial Sanctum

title: Boss: Flying Dragon Greyll
text: Follow the downhill path outside the sanctum until you reach the Farum Greatbridge grace.
Behind four gravestones west of the grace is a scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [9].
Kill Flying Dragon Greyll on the bridge for Dragon Heart and 80,000 runes.
Flying Dragon Greyll: Optional Dragon Boss guarding the bridge to the Bestial Sanctum . Drops a Dragon Heart upon defeat.

Dragon Heart: Key Consumable. Dropped by Flying Dragon Greyll upon defeat. Dragon Hearts are used to acquire Dragon Communion Incantations at the Church of Dragon Communion and the Cathedral of Dragon Communion .

title: Bestial Constitution
text: At the far end of the bridge, turn right to find a lower ledge with a scarab that drops Bestial Constitution.
Bestial Constitution: Bestial Incantation . Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab along the cliffside northeast of the Minor Erdtree in Dragonbarrow .

title: Ash of War: Rain of Arrows
text: Kill the Putrid Avatar in front of the Minor Erdtree for Opaline Hardtear, Stonebarb Cracked Tear, and 91,000 runes.
Descend the roots in the cliff south of the Minor Erdtree, then pick up Ash of War: Rain of Arrows from the cliff edge (painting reward).

Ash of War: Rain of Arrows: Appears at edge of a cliff after you've looted the "Redmane" Painting in Sellia, Town of Sorcery . You'll find it down the cliff on a plateau south east of the Eastern Minor Erdtree in Caelid. The Erdtree is located in the Caelid subregion called Dragonbarrow. Once you've made your way down, walk to the edge and you'll briefly see the spirit of a painter, he'll vanish and the Ash of War will appear in his place

title: Boss: Night's Cavalry (Dragonbarrow East)
text: Quickly grab the Rune Arc next to a Golem with sorcery-based attacks.
Pass time until nightfall and kill the Night's Cavalry on the bridge near Lenne's Rise for Ash of War: Bloodhound's Step and 42,000 runes.
Ash of War: Bloodhound's Step: Dropped by a Night's Cavalry at the bridge in front of the Lenne's Rise tower,
Night's Cavalry: Boss that spawns only at night. Drops Ash of War: Bloodhound's Step.

title: Bull-Goat's Talisman
text: Head downhill from Lenne's Rise until you notice the entrance to Dragonbarrow Cave in the cliffside:
Enter to grab the Dragonbarrow Cave grace.
Pick up a Golden Rune [12] and Warming Stone from the first room.
Golden Rune [12]: Within Dragonbarrow Cave , held by a corpse near a Lesser Runebear .
Follow the tunnel at the southeast end of the room to grab the Bull-Goat's Talisman.
Bull-Goat's Talisman: Talisman. Found on a corpse inside Dragonbarrow Cave .

title: Boss: Beastman of Farum Azula (Dragonbarrow Cave)
text: Turn back and head down the north room. Pick up the Golden Rune [8] and Beast Blood x3 guarded by wolves.
Kill the two Beastmen of Farum Azula for Flamedrake Talisman +2 and 65,000 runes.
Flamedrake Talisman +2: Talisman. Dropped by the Beastman of Farum Azula duo bosses in Dragonbarrow Cave .

Beastman of Farum Azula: Duo Boss encounter against two beastmen at the end of Dragonbarrow Cave . One wielding a Greatsword and one wielding Throwing Knives. Drops the Flamedrake Talisman +2 upon defeat.

place.title: Dragonbarrow Cave
walk: From the Site of Grace, following the narrow tunnels ahead will lead you to the den of a Lesser Runebear. This beast can be difficult to deal with especially with the very tight space you are allotted. Consider sneaking past the bear when it has its back turned, or killing it with ranged attacks or status effect ammunition from the safety of the narrow passageway you enter through -- though note that it does respawn. If you do manage to kill it or sneak there, there is a Warming Stone and a Golden Rune (12) on the corpses in the corner. Head to the south and follow the tunnels to a cavern with a Deer and several Springhares in it. You can find a Bull-Goat's Talisman on a corpse here.

Head back to the bear's den and look for a tunnel in the north side. This leads to a pit with a couple of ledges you can drop down to. Before dropping down all the way, you can use ranged attacks to take the Wolves at the bottom level out. There is a Golden Rune (8) on the corpse in the middle of the wolves and 3x Beast Blood on another corpse nearby.
Go through the tunnels east, heading south to find another pit to drop down from. This leads to the boss encounter of this small dungeon.
## Boss: Beastman of Farum Azula Duo (Throwing Knife & Greatsword)

This battle is against two Beastmen of Farum Azula. The one with the Throwing Knife will remain at a distance and shouldn't prove too troublesome, but try to take him out as soon as possible. Be warned that his knives have decent tracking and you should consider bringing a shield along to block them instead of dodging. This beastman is particularly easy to kill with a barrage of magic.

The Beastman with the Greatsword isn't much different from previous Beastman encounters, but he is extremely powerful and can one-shot you if you are underleveled. Consider using a tanky summon to distract this Beastman while you are working on the other. Watch out for his large, sweeping strikes and long dashes.
Defeating the Beastman duo awards the Flamedrake Talisman +2 variant as well as 65,000 Runes.

title: Collapsing Stars
text: Travel to Starscourge Radahn and head north to find War-Dead Catacombs at the end of the shoreline:
Head inside and activate the War-Dead Catacombs grace.
Pick up Magic Grease x3 and a Grave Glovewort [6] from the room with endlessly spawning enemies.
Magic Grease: Weapon Coating. Found inside the War-Dead Catacombs , on a corpse right in the center of the large chamber with the 4 staircases.

Grave Glovewort [6]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 5 can be found inside the War-Dead Catacombs : Right in the center of the main chamber with the 4 staircases, you can find the glovewort under a torch on the left wall. In the same chamber, take the first staircase on the left, closest to the entrance and follow the ledge west to find the second glovewort. Get back into the center of the main chamber and take the stairs in the back on the right this time and head down the corridor on the left. Continue all the way to the end and then turn right to find the third glovewort on the left side in the next corridor. Continue on from the previous glovewort and you will find the fourth one in a small room at the very end of the path. Backpedal a bit from the previous glovewort and you will find a window in the west side of the hallway. Jump through and then head up the stairs on the left in the next room. Turn right to find another window, through which you can find the final glovewort.
Go up the south stairs to find another Grave Glovewort [6].
Drop down the gap in the staircase and loot the chest on the bottom floor to obtain Collapsing Stars.

Collapsing Stars: Gravity Sorcery . Looted from a chest inside the War-Dead Catacombs . In the main chamber with 4 staircases, drop into the lower level from the left side to find the chest amongst the ghostly knights fighting each other.

guide.title: The War-Dead Catacombs
text: Entering into the War-Dead catacombs you'll find a staircase down immediately leading to the site of grace. From the grace, head down the stairs and you’ll emerge in a room full of spirits fighting each other. They can still aggro onto you if you get too close so be careful.

Continue forward into the middle of the room to pick up 3 Magic Grease, and go to the left to also loot a Grave Glovewort [6]. Go up the stairs to the left and follow it around the room to pick up another Grave Glovewort [6], and then fall down to the lower level. This lower level is filled with a Scarlet Rot pool, so it’s recommended to do this part fast, or bring something that can alleviate the Scarlet Rot build up, such as Preserving Boluses or Flame, Cleanse Me. Grab the chest you see in front of you to get the Collapsing Stars Sorcery, and then turn around, going in the direction the chest is facing and slightly left. Go to the corpse sitting by the wall to get a Golden Rune [6]. Then, continue south-east to the corpse you see sitting against the wall to pick up a Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot. Then, head directly North into the next room, and head to the far eastern wall of the room to pick up a Ghost Glovewort [4].

From here, head back into the Scarlet Rot room, heading south-west towards the staircase. The bottom of the staircase should be illuminated for you. Head up this staircase and left twice to find yourself back in the main area of the catacombs. You want to head up the last set of stairs to your right and follow the path into the next room. Be careful, as a Redmane Knight Spirit will attempt to snipe you with a bow as you climb. Once you turn the corner into the next area, there will be a Radahn Soldier Spirit and a Redmane Knight Spirit waiting for you. Defeat them and turn the corner to enter a room with 2 more spirits awaiting you. Kill them and pick up the Grave Glovewort [6], and continue down the hallway where a Radahn Soldier Spirit will appear. Defeat it and continue.

In the next room, a Radahn Soldier Spirit will be waiting on the right side of the door to ambush you. Continue through this room and defeat the Redmane Knight Spirit sitting at the end of the hallway. Grab the Grave Glovewort [6] and Grave Violet from this room and turn around. Exit this room and look to your left. You’ll see a window with a Grave Violet next to it. Jump through the window and you’ll land on a balcony overlooking a room with a statue in the middle. From here, walk up the stairs to your left. There are four Imps up here, as well as the Redmane Knight Spirit through the window that was shooting at you when you first walked up the stairs. Take out the Imps and then defeat the Lesser Cleanrot Knight Spirit in the room. This room has Scarlet Rot on the floor, so be careful about fighting in here for too long. Head into that room and loot the corpse off the floor to receive the Radahn Soldier Ashes.

Now, exit the room and turn left, jumping through the window where the Redmane Knight Spirit is. Defeat it, then loot the Grave Glovewort [6] on the ground, and head left to pull the dungeon lever here, opening the boss door. You’ll notice the balcony you are on overlooks the main room of the catacombs. Jump down and head straight through the room (west), and down the stairs to arrive at the boss doors. Head down the stairs and through the fog gate to fight the Putrid Tree Spirit.
BOSS BATTLE: Putrid Tree Spirit

For this fight, be careful of the arena size, as a lot of attacks from this boss have very big, sweeping hitboxes. Do your best to dodge these, and then punish its relatively long cooldowns in between attacks. Defeat this boss to receive 64,000 Runes, a Golden Seed, and the Redmane Knight Ogha Ashes.

title: Radahn Soldier Ashes
text: Pick up a Golden Rune [6] and Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot from the corpses on the bottom floor.

Golden Rune [6]: Rune Consumable. Found inside the War-Dead Catacombs . In the main chamber with the 4 staircases, drop down into the lower level from the left and loot the corpse by the support structure in the northeast.

Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot: Consumable. Found inside the War-Dead Catacombs . In the main chamber with the 4 staircases, drop down into the lower level from the left and check the southeast corner to find a corpse with the item.
Head through the doorway at the bottom, which leads to a Ghost Glovewort [4].

Ghost Glovewort [4]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One can be found inside the War-Dead Catacombs . In the main chamber with the 4 staircases, drop into the lower level and search the northeast corner for a corridor that leads to another room. Check the back of this room past the arches to find the glovewort.
Return to the main room and go up the north stairs until you reach a corridor with a Grave Glovewort [6].
Continue to a room at the end with a Grave Glovewort [6].
Drop down the window in the previous corridor, then pick up Radahn Soldier Ashes from the room up the stairs.

Radahn Soldier Ashes: Spirit Ashes found within War-Dead Catacombs Go up the stairs to the back right of the first room and go left. Past the archer at the end of the hall turn right, turning right again at the end of that hall past the greatsword knight. Jump through the window to the right near the end of this hall. Go left up the stairs and the ashes will be in a room in front of you behind a knight.

title: Boss: Putrid Tree Spirit
text: Jump through the window outside the room to reach a Grave Glovewort [6] and the boss lever.
Kill the Putrid Tree Spirit for Redmane Knight Ogha, Golden Seed, and 64,000 runes.
Putrid Tree Spirit: Boss of the War-Dead Catacombs in eastern Caelid. Drops Redmane Knight Ogha Spirit Ashes and a Golden Seed
Golden Seed: Obtained by defeating the Putrid Tree Spirit inside the War-Dead Catacombs

Redmane Knight Ogha Ashes: Dropped by the Putrid Tree Spirit in the War-Dead Catacombs located in eastern Caelid. To find the entrance of the catacombs, travel to the site of grace that appears after defeating Starcourge Radahn and proceed to head north until you have reached the upper most corner of the area, you'll be able to see the small door along the cliffside.

title: Stonesword Key
text: Travel to Below the Well and unlock the lift up the stairs to reach the Deep Siofra Well grace.
Follow the south path past a Runebear to grab a Stonesword Key from the cliff edge.
Stonesword Key: Stonesword Key. Found on a body in the ravine south of the Deep Siofra Well , near the cliff.

place.title: Deep Siofra Well
walk: This River Well can be accessed from the Siofra River. Make your way to the other side where Hallowhorn Grounds can be accessed and there is a platform with another lift that leads to Dragonbarrow rather than Limgrave. This requires 2 Stonesword Keys to activate.
From torch pillar-lined stairs leading up to Hallowhorn Grounds, move past it on its left and go all the way to the end of Siofra River to reach this raised platform.

title: Spiked Palisade Shield
text: Follow the other path and pick up the Spiked Palisade Shield next to an Archer Golem.
Spiked Palisade Shield: On dead body under a Golem, west of Deep Siofra Well, Caelid

title: Great-Jar's Arsenal, Talk to The Great-Jar
text: Talk to the Great Jar and he'll present three summon signs. Talk to him again after defeating all three summons without dying to receive the Great-Jar's Arsenal.

Great-Jar's Arsenal: Reward for completing the 3 duelist NPC invasions in Dragonbarrow (Caelid North) for The Great-Jar. You will only be able to access this area by coming up from Siofra Deep River Well in the underground.
The Great-Jar: Interact with the Great-Jar to fight three invading Npcs. If you beat all three of them, you will receive the Great-Jar's Arsenal

title: Ritual Thrusting Shield
text: Note: If you're playing online, the summons will use randomized builds from other players who have completed the challenge.
Optional: Enter the colosseum behind the Great Jar to access it from the Marika statue in Roundtable Hold.
If you own the Tarnished Pack DLC, pick up Ritual Thrusting Shield from the corpse inside the colosseum.

title: Boss: Godskin Apostle (Caelid)
text: Travel to Dragonbarrow West and kill the exploding scarab on a branch in front of the divine tower to obtain a Somber Smithing Stone [8].
Somber Smithing Stone [8]: Upgrade Material. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab found sitting on a fallen tree in western Dragonbarrow . Warning: This scarab explodes upon death, dealing massive damage!
Drop onto the tall root near the tower, then double jump to the ledge with a soldier. Cross the southeast arch to find a Stonesword Key.
Head back across and climb the ladder, then cross three consecutive arches along the left side to reach a Numen's Rune.
Numen's Rune: Found on the backside of the Divine Tower of Caelid . This requires some jumping and ladder puzzles.
Go back one arch and climb the ladder to grab the Divine Tower of Caelid: Center grace.
Take the west path first to reach the top of the tower and activate Radahn's Great Rune.
Return to the grace and make your way down the tower:
After landing on a fragile platform, drop down below it to find a Golden Rune [12].
Golden Rune [12]: Held by a corpse under a broken pillar.
Use the caged lift below, then climb a ladder to open a shortcut back to the grace.
Climb back down and grab the Rune Arc at the end of the corridor.
Walk around the narrow ledge, then drop onto the fragile platform to reach the Divine Tower of Caelid: Basement grace down a lift.
Kill the Godskin Apostle for the Godskin Apostle Set and 94,000 runes.

Godskin Apostle Set: Armor set comprised of the Godskin Apostle Hood , Godskin Apostle Robe , Godskin Apostle Bracers and Godskin Apostle Trousers . Dropped by the Godskin Apostle boss at the bottom of the Divine Tower of Caelid upon his defeat.
Godskin Apostle: Great Enemy. Found at the basement of the Divine Tower of Caelid (See page for how to reach). Drops the Godskin Apostle Set upon defeat.

title: Godslayer's Greatsword
text: Open the chest at the end to obtain the Godslayer's Greatsword.
Godslayer's Greatsword: Greatsword found in a chest in a room behind the Godskin Apostle's arena at the Divine Tower of Caelid after defeating him.

place.title: Divine Tower of Caelid
walk: ## Restoring Radahn's Great Rune
This tower is best visited after defeating Starscourge Radahn and acquiring his Great Rune.

To get into the tower, summon Torrent and ride off towards the tower in the northeast from the Dragonbarrow West Site of Grace. On the way, you can find a Teardrop Scarab on a dead tree root protruding out of the ground, kill it to get a Somber Smithing Stone [8]; be mindful that this scarab will explode on death, so dodge out of the way after. Continue northeast.

At the edge of the plateau, you will see a large root protruding from the cliffs towards the tower. Jump onto this root and follow it high enough till you can safely jump towards one of the tower's ledges to the left. Beware of the soldier on this ledge and take him out carefully. Note there are a couple of paths to choose & items that can be collected ahead. You can still summon Torrent, whose double jump you can use to aid in the platforming.
Traverse right from the bottom of the first ladder: Climb over one curved ledge and kill one soldier to pick up a Stonesword Key.

Traverse left from the bottom of the first ladder: Climb over one curved ledge. Beware the crack at the left end of it. You are now between two ladders. Climbing up is a dead end. With some careful double jumping, you can probably get around the statues, but there aren't items to obtain. Head down to the bottom of the bottom ladder and kill the foot soldier. Around to the left and right are both dead ends with no items.

Take the ladder up and traverse right: Pass over two triangular ledges. There's a crack at the end of both of them you must jump over. You can jump down towards the Stonesword Key mentioned above, or go back the way you came.

Take the ladder up and traverse left: This is the way forward. Jump over the two cracks on the triangular ledge. You are now on the ledge above the pair of ladders. Go around the corner and kill the foot soldier. Jump across the next triangular ledge, avoiding the two cracks on the right and third on the left. Go past the ladder to find a corpse with a Numen's Rune. Return to the previous ladder and climb up to find the Divine Tower of Caelid: Center grace site. Or proceed directly to the site of grace, and get the Numen's Rune later.

Head west from the Site of Grace and up the steps to find the door towards the main tower lift. Note that the door is on the left side of the corridor and can easily be mistaken by the engravings on the center wall. Step on the platform in the middle to ascend the lift and then follow the steps around the balconies to reach the top floor and restore power to Radahn's Great Rune.
## Tower Basement & The Godskin Apostle

There is a boss to be found at the base of the tower. To reach this location, head east from the Center Site of Grace and down the steps. You will encounter two Radahn Soldiers here and a locked door at the end. Look down below to the right to find a long concrete platform you can jump down to. Look behind you and you will find narrow ledges along the walls that you can walk on. Walk towards a second concrete platform on the left and jump on it. It will break and come crashing down a few levels below but don't worry, you will not suffer fall damage from this.

Walk over to the thinner portion that the platform crashed on and carefully drop down to the wider platform below. There is a corpse here with a Golden Rune (12). Walk towards the center of the platform and look down at the right (north) side to find an unlit lamp sticking out the tower's center. Carefully jump onto this lamp and then onto the concrete platform below. Jump onto the half-beam next to you and then down the two half-beams ahead and below that one. You should now be closer to the tower's center with a soldier to your left. Take him out with ranged attacks if possible and then head to where he was and ride the cage elevator up.

You will arrive on a balcony with a long ladder to the right. This ladder leads up to a room where you can unlock the door from earlier to gain a shortcut in case you die in the next section. Head back down the ladder and continue along the corridor to find a Blackflame Monk patrolling the hallway. Be careful as his spells are very powerful and he is quite nimble with his blade as well. After defeating the monk, check the corpse at the end of the corridor for a Rune Arc. Do not jump down to the beam that leads towards the centre, as that will loop you back to the elevator you just took.

At the corpse looking at the main column, look to the right of the inner tower and note the concrete platform that has cracks in it like the previous one you rode in on, albeit nervously. Get up on the ledge by the corpse and run along the outer wall. Follow it to the placement of the concrete platform below that you can jump on. This one will come crashing down as well but again, you will not suffer fall damage despite the very long fall. There is another cage elevator here that will take you to the basement. You can find the Basement Site of Grace after descending the lift. From here, head down the steps to fight another monk and you will have arrived at the boss door.
## Boss: Godskin Apostle

The Godskin Apostle is a powerful boss equipped with a twinblade that has a sickle-end for slashing and a blade-end for thrusting and stabbing. He utilizes Black Flame spells similar to the monks earlier in the tower. When fighting this boss, you want to maintain a medium distance to avoid many of his attacks and only close in during openings. His melee attacks have a bit of weight to them and he does short wind-ups before attacking, similar to but not to the same extent as Margit at Stormveil.

Some notable attack windows are when he performs his Stab & Slash; he has a moderate recovery time after the second attack in which you can safely get one or two hits in. Another one is his Jumping Overhead Slash which has a slightly longer recovery than other attacks and can guarantee 2 hits for you. These two attacks are relatively easy to dodge. The attacks you should watch out for are his Black Flame as it travels quite quickly, you should dodge as soon as you see the casting rune; and his Stab & Pull which hits twice for massive damage. Another move he may use is the Spinning Weapon in which he twirls his blade in front of him as he advances forward. Maintain your distance or dodge through and behind him.

When his HP is lowered to 60%, he will float upwards briefly and then slam down, creating a shockwave around him, signifying his second phase. Get away from him when you see him float. From this point, he can unlatch the skin of his upper torso from the rest of his body and fling it around to greatly extend his reach as well as unlock new abilities. His notable attack windows during this phase is when he uses the Flight variant of Spinning Weapon, in which he flings his upper torso outwards while spinning his weapon. His lower body remains stationary and if you can dodge through his weapon, he will be vulnerable to attack from his elongated abdomen to his legs for the duration of the attack as his torso is locked in the animation.

He will also frequently use a Plunging Blade & Sweep move where he flings his torso upwards and then slams down with his weapon, followed by a very wide sweeping slash. Both hits are easy to read and can be outranged or dodged and he is vulnerable for a couple of seconds after the sweep. Lastly, he can perform a Black Flame Whirlwind attack where he twirls his weapon in place, creating a whirlwind extending outwards all around him. The attack culminates with him plunging his blade into the ground and causing the whirlwind to burst and extend outwards a short distance from its initial edge. Do not stand too close to the edge even when the whirlwind has stopped moving. The Godskin Apostle seems susceptible to magic damage and his poise can be broken rather easily by using multi-hit spells such as Glintblade Phalanx or Glintstone Stars, allowing you to get a critical attack in.

Defeating this Godskin Apostle awards his armor set, comprised of the Godskin Apostle Hood, Godskin Apostle Robe, Godskin Apostle Bracelets, and Godskin Apostle Trousers. The room behind him is also unlocked and you can find a chest inside containing the Godslayer's Greatsword Colossal Weapon.
notes: Picture of the Caelid Divine Tower, as seen from Dragonbarrow Fork, showing the molten rock on its east side.

title: Boss: Bell Bearing Hunter (Isolated Merchant Dragonbarrow)
text: Pass time until nightfall and kill the Bell Bearing Hunter at the Isolated Merchant's Shack for Gravity Stone Peddler's Bell Bearing and 50,000 runes.
Gravity Stone Peddler's Bell Bearing: Key Item. Dropped by the Bell Bearing Hunter that spawns at this location at night time.
Bell Bearing Hunter: Field Boss. Found outside the shack at night time, where the merchant usually sits. Drops the Gravity Stone Peddler's Bell Bearing upon defeat.

title: Rotten Battle Hammer, Rotten Duelist Helm
text: Just north of the Hidden Path to the Haligtree, you'll discover the Consecrated Snowfield grace.
Head directly east from the grace, then go up the slope on the right to find a Golden Rune [11].
Golden Rune [11]: Found in a Rune graveyard south Consecrated Snowfield
Drop down toward west to find a Golden Rune [13] on the ledge below.
Golden Rune [13]: A Golden Rune [13] is located Southwest Consecrated Snowfield
Return to the grace and head west-northwest to a cemetery. Kill the Rotten Duelist nearby for Rotten Battle Hammer and Rotten Duelist Helm.
Rotten Battle Hammer: Warhammer. Guaranteed drop from the Rotten Duelist enemy in the area
Rotten Duelist Helm: Guaranteed Drop from the Rotten Duelist enemy in the area

title: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [23]
text: Loot the Golden Rune [1], Golden Rune [3], Golden Rune [6], Golden Rune [9], and Golden Rune [11] in the cemetery.
Golden Rune [1]: Found in a Rune graveyard south Consecrated Snowfield
Golden Rune [3]: Found in a Rune graveyard south Consecrated Snowfield
Golden Rune [6]: Found in a Rune graveyard south Consecrated Snowfield
Golden Rune [9]: Found in a Rune graveyard south Consecrated Snowfield
Return to the grace and head north-northeast to find a corpse with the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [23] past three Wandering Nobles.
Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [23]: On a corpse lying by the road soon after the first Site of Grace of the area.

title: Stalwart Horn Charm +1
text: From the corpse, head directly west-northwest until you hear a singing voice. Pick up the Stalwart Horn Charm +1 next to a Shaman.
Stalwart Horn Charm +1: Found to the east of Yelough Anix Tunnel

title: Boss: Astel, Stars of Darkness
text: On the opposite (north) side of the large spire is a Golden Rune [13].
Head toward the ruins, then turn left toward the cliff to find a Smithing Stone [7].
Smithing Stone [7]: There's a breakable statue with Smithing Stone [7] x3 and Smithing Stone [8] inside. There's a bear uphill to the east that can be used to break it
Continue downhill near the cliff to find the entrance to Yelough Anix Tunnel:
Take the lift down and grab the Yelough Anix Tunnel grace.
After dropping down ahead, pick up Freezing Grease x3 from the frozen lift and a Smithing Stone [8] from the wall behind it.
Smithing Stone [8]: Upgrade Material. Multiple found in the Yelough Anix Tunnel .
Drop down in the next room and kill the Alabaster Lord to obtain the Alabaster Lord's Sword.
Loot the Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone, Rune Arc, and 3x Smithing Stone [8] around the lower level.

Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone: Upgrade Material. In the room with the wooden walkways, there is a lower area you can drop down to in the center. Defeat the Alabaster Lord found here and you can loot the stone off of the body in the back.

Smithing Stone [8]: Upgrade Material. Looted from a statue close to the Cave of the Forlorn . Lure a Giant Crab or Giant Land Octopus from the area to help you destroy the statue and loot its contents.
Climb the ladder and pick up the Golden Rune [10] near a gap.
Golden Rune [10]: Found on a body on the floor of Ordina, Liturgical Town
Pick up the Explosive Stone Clump x6 and Somber Smithing Stone [8] in the next room.
Somber Smithing Stone [8]: Upgrade Material. From the top of Albinauric Rise jump south onto some rocks and further up until you are on top of the rocks. It is located next to a large gravestone.
Climb the ladder in the room to find a Smithing Stone [8] on the wall.

Smithing Stone [8]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse laying inside a gazebo connecting 3 bridges in Miquella's Haligtree . This area is guarded by two sorcerers. -Another one can be found on the river, south to the Minor Erdtree. On a statue. Need to be broken by an enemy.
Grab the Hero's Rune [5], 2x Smithing Stone [8], Somber Smithing Stone [8], and Somber Smithing Stone [9] from the room with an Onyx Lord.
Hero's Rune [5]: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse under a large tree in the eastern graveyard.
Smithing Stone [8]: There's a breakable statue with Smithing Stone [7] x3 and Smithing Stone [8] inside. There's a bear uphill to the east that can be used to break it
Somber Smithing Stone [8]: Upgrade Material. Defeat a Teardrop Scarab to obtain it.
Somber Smithing Stone [9]: Upgrade Material. Found with a invisible Teardrop Scarab atop a rock formation west of the Minor Erdtree (Consecrated Snowfield) .
Pick up a Smithing Stone [8] from the wall next to the shortcut door.
Smithing Stone [8]: Upgrade Material. Looted from a body behind the big tree where you get the map piece.
Kill Astel, Stars of Darkness for Meteorite of Astel and 120,000 runes.
Astel, Stars of Darkness: Boss of Yelough Anix Tunnel in Consecrated Snowfield. Drops the Meteorite of Astel spell upon defeat.
Meteorite of Astel: Gravity Sorcery. Dropped by Astel, Stars of Darkness , the boss of Yelough Anix Tunnel.

place.title: Yelough Anix Tunnel
walk: Upon entering the dungeon and descending the lift, activate the Site of Grace and then head down the tunnel ahead. You will see several dead Miners along the way. When you reach the cavern at the end, look to the left for a hole. The door in the north does not open from this side so drop down into the hole. Defeat the two Miners in the room and pick up the 3x Freezing Grease on the corpse in the middle of the frozen lift. There is 1x Smithing Stone (8) behind the frozen elevator.

Follow the path east to reach a cavern with wooden walkways. Defeat the Miners on this floor and check the corpse on the ice platform in the middle for a Golden Rune (10). Drop down into the gap in the center or use the ladder on the side. Look for a small opening on the right with two Miners and a corpse with a Rune Arc. Coming back out of that opening, head left for another Smithing Stone (8). Head to the other path where there is a gravity portal. An Alabaster Lord will emerge from it as you approach. After defeating him, check the cavity in the wall on the left for 2x Smithing Stone (8). Finally, check the back of the room for a corpse next to wooden planks on the wall for an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

Head back up the ladder and using the ice platform in the center, jump the gap onto the opposite side and head through the opening in the wall. Kill the Miner sitting by the campfire and collect 6x Explosive Stone Clump from the corpse nearby as well as a Somber Smithing Stone (8) on the left side. Climb up the ladder and defeat the two Miners in the middle platform, then collect the Smithing Stone (8) to the right of the ladder. Head up the second ladder and through the tunnel above.

In the next room is a gravity portal in the north. Before approaching it, check the cavity in the wall on the right for a Somber Smithing Stone (9). There is also a Smithing Stone (8) on the other side of the room in another cavity. The corpse in the center of the room also has a Hero's Rune (5). Upon approaching the portal, a Lesser Onyx Lord will emerge and begin attacking. Be careful of his meteorite spell as the room has very little space for you to maneuver in. Once he's defeated, collect one Smithing Stone (8) and one Somber Smithing Stone (8) along the wall to the right of where he spawned. Continue to the west and find the small door on the left of the next room. This is the locked door from the beginning of the dungeon and serves as a shortcut for the boss ahead. Directly to the right of the shortcut door is another Smithing Stone (8). Head through the large wooden gate to engage the dungeon's boss.
## Boss Fight: Astel, Stars of Darkness

This boss has an extremely powerful Heavy Tail Whip that can one-shot even high level players. It has a distinct animation from his standard tail whip where he swings his tail from side to side before striking. It is important to time a dodge perfectly against this move even if you are very far away. The boss also has a railgun-like beam move that hits over a very long range but has a narrow hitbox. Periodically, he will teleport into a different location in the cavern but it's easy to tell where he is going to appear. Another dangerous move in his arsenal is his meteor swarm, which calls plenty of meteorites to rain destruction in the arena. You can run towards and under the boss to avoid getting hit by these. Despite his powerful moveset, the boss' poise is quite easily broken, especially by multi-hit magic spells and skills. When he is knocked down, get to his head for a critical hit on his forehead.
Upon defeat, Astel will drop the Meteorite of Astel spell.
notes: Other player notes go here.

title: Unendurable Frenzy
text: Return to the entrance and explore the ruins above the tunnel:
Pick up a Golden Rune [13] next to a sleeping Troll in a ruined building.
A corpse with Rimed Rowa x8 sits in the alley next to the building.
Double jump (or have a Troll destroy the walls) to get inside the ruin next to the corpse. Open the chest in the cellar to obtain Unendurable Frenzy.
Unendurable Frenzy: Incantation . Found in a chest in an underground treasure room in the central section of the Yelough Anix Ruins .

place.title: Yelough Anix Ruins
walk: Of note in these ruins is the Unendurable Frenzy spell found in a chest in the underground treasure room. The entrance to the room is found west of the central section of the ruins, surrounded by walls from all sides. The maddened Giants can destroy the walls using Unendurable Frenzy (the cascading orange lights that emerge from their eyes), allowing you jump the wall using Torrent. Alternatively, the larger structure to the east of the basement has on its western side a sloped broken pillar that can be used to Torrent double-jump. There is also a Stonesword Key far in the north inside a small open structure.

title: Stonesword Key
text: Pick up a Stonesword Key guarded by four rats in a tower at the end of the ruins.
Stonesword Key: Stonesword Key. Found inside a small open structure in the northern section of the ruins.

title: Invader: Sanguine Noble

Sanguine Noble: Invading NPC. Drops Sanguine Set

title: Stonesword Key
text: A corpse with a Smithing Stone [8] sits behind a thinner spire, east of the large one.
Smithing Stone [8]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse resting against a pillar in the northern section of Yelough Anix Ruins .
Continue north to pick up Thawfrost Boluses x2 from the tip of a rock guarded by a Runebear.
Thawfrost Boluses: Found on a body atop one of the pillars in the Consecrated Snowfield.
Head southeast from the rock to find two dogs feasting on a corpse with Crystal Dart x4.
Crystal Dart 4x: Found on a body being devoured by Rotten Strays in the Consecrated Snowfield
Continue east-southeast toward the cliff to pick up a Stonesword Key near two lightning orbs.
Stonesword Key: Held by a corpse sitting on a chair, near the edge of the cliff.

title: Invader: Anastasia Tarnished-Eater
text: Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater should invade as you grab the key. Kill her to obtain a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Anastasia Tarnished-Eater: Post patch you can find Anastasia in the Consecrated Snowfield on the frozen river southwest of Ordina Liturgical Town .
Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone: Dropped by Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater after her third invasion, in the Consecrated Snowfield on the frozen river southwest of Ordina, Liturgical Town .

title: Ash of War: White Shadow's Lure
text: Kill the invisible scarab chased by wolves on the opposite side of the river to obtain Ash of War: White Shadow's Lure.

Ash of War: White Shadow's Lure: Dropped by an invisible Teardrop Scarab in the Consecrated Snowfield , northwest of the Inner Consecrated Snowfield site of grace between the grace and Ordina, Liturgical Town .

title: Map (Consecrated Snowfield)
text: Head toward the large spire nearby to pick up Map: Consecrated Snowfield.
Map (Consecrated Snowfield): Map for all of Consecrated Snowfield: follow the road north past the snowstorm until you go down and cross a frozen river, then you will spot the map pillar ahead.

text: On a ledge behind the sprire, you'll find a Smithing Stone [8].
From the spire, head south to grab the Inner Consecrated Snowfield grace on a ledge across the frozen river.

Rest to reset the caravan and pass time until nightfall, then head southwest toward a caravan. Kill the two Night's Cavalries guarding it for Night's Cavalry Set, Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone, and 84,000 runes.
Night's Cavalry Set: Full Set dropped by one of the two mini-boss Night's Cavalry guarding a Consecrated Fields caravan at night.
Night's Cavalry: Two Night's Cavalry mini-bosses guard the wagon in the Consecrated Snowfield. Spawn at night only. Drops Night Cavalry's Set and Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone
Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone: Dropped by one of the two mini-boss Night's Cavalry guarding a Consecrated Fields caravan at night, alongside the Night's Cavalry Set

title: Flowing Curved Sword
