Flowing Curved Sword: Curved Sword. Found within the chest of the Enemy Caravan traveling the Consecrated Snowfield south-western area.

title: Larval Tear
text: Head up the slope where the caravan started and pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [9] on a fallen spire, guarded by two lightning orbs.
Somber Smithing Stone [9]: Can be looted on top of a rock formation in Consecrated Snowfield North of the Hidden Path to the Haligtree
Note: Each item in the blizzard is linked to its MapGenie location if you'd rather mark them on your own map.
You should now have enough upgrade materials to upgrade any weapon to max level. (This earns an achievement.)
Return to the Inner Consecrated Snowfield grace and head southeast toward some nobles. Kill the one half-buried in snow and he'll become a Runebear that drops a Larval Tear.

Larval Tear: Dropped by a Runebear disguised as a pilgrim in the Consecrated Snowfield . The disguised pilgrim is half-buried in snow with two other pilgrims, one carrying a torch, standing around it. They are located southeast of the Inner Consecrated Snowfield site of grace, nearly on the straight-line path between the grace and the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs .

title: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [8]
text: Head northeast from the nobles to find a corpse with Miquella's Lily x3 next to a cluster of gravestones.
Guarded by three sorcerer balls farther north-northeast, you'll find the Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [8].
Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [8]: Can be found in the Consecrated Snowfield , southwest of Albinauric's Rise . There are 3 Schools of Graven Mages encircling a corpse with the Cookbook.

title: Graven-Mass Talisman
text: Continue northeast to find Albinauric Rise and summon your Fanged Imp Ashes to defeat the spectral ones around the tower. Alternatively, you can use Crystal Darts or Bewitching Branches to make them fight each other. When the seal breaks, loot the Graven-Mass Talisman at the top of the tower.
Graven-Mass Talisman: Talisman found in a chest atop the Albinauric Rise tower.

place.title: Albinauric Rise
walk: The entrance to Albinauric Rise is initially sealed upon your first visit. There is a statue of two Imps fighting each other right outside the tower. This is a clue as to how to unlock the seal. There are two ways you can go about solving this puzzle. Choose the one which is more convenient for you:
Puzzle Solution #1 - Requires killing an Imp while you have the Fanged Imp Ashes summon out. This can be purchased from the Isolated Merchant found at the Raya Lucaria Academy for 2,000 Runes.
Puzzle Solution #2 - Requires using a Bewitching Branch or a few Crystal Darts on one of the two imps patrolling the tower to make them kill each other.
When successful, you are notified of the seal being broken. Head into the tower and get to the top floor to find the Graven-Mass Talisman sitting on a bed of crystal.

title: Golden Seed
text: Jump to a lower ledge south from the tower stairs to reach a chest with a Rune Arc.
Descend the gravestones in the cliff near the tower to land on a ledge with Old Fang x3.
Travel to the Consecrated Snowfield grace and head northeast to find a scarab hanging onto a rock, which drops a Somber Smithing Stone [8].
Return to the grace to reset the nearby caravan, then head north-northeast to a large spire. Go around its right side to find a Golden Seed and a coffin with a Golden Rune [11].
Golden Seed: Flask Upgrade Material. Found by a pillar within the snowstorm, near a cookbook north from Consecrated Snowfield site of grace.

title: St Trina's Torch
text: Simply wait by the coffin and a caravan with St. Trina's Torch should walk right on by.
St Trina's Torch: Special Torch. Looted from the treasure chest in the caravan wagon carted in the southern portion of Consecrated Ground in the northern lands.

title: Imp Head
text: Just east of the coffin and to the left of a fallen spire, you'll encounter two Wandering Nobles. Kill the one carrying a chest for a Golden Rune [13] (first time).
Continue southeast to come across some nobles fighting wolves. Pick up Old Fang x2 from the ground.
Head northeast from the enemies, then go up the slope appearing on your right to find Lump of Flesh x4.
Lump of Flesh: Crafting Material. Found on a corpse on the field.
Continue uphill to discover the entrance to Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs:
Head inside and grab the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs grace.
Make your way past the first frostbite pillar and ride it up to a corpse with Rejuvenating Boluses.
Rejuvenating Boluses: Consumable Item. Found on a corpse by jumping on a trap to access a higher area of the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs.
Follow the path before the pillar to a room with Root Resin x4.
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [8] from the east corridor, which also leads to a Grave Glovewort [9].
Follow the west corridor up some stairs to a room with Imp Head (Elder), Grave Glovewort [9], and Human Bone Shard x8.
Imp Head: Found as a treasure inside Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs . Inside a room on the second floor, guarded by a Burial Tree Watchdog .

place.title: Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs
walk: Note: The Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs are swarmed with Imps and patrolled by Lesser Cleanrot Knights ready to stop enemies from venturing within their halls. Beware of the Erdtree Burial Watchdogs ready and watching for trespassers to jump on. Players should also walk carefully when moving up stairways so as not to stumble into a face full of icy breath being shot down the corridors by the frost traps. To access the boss room of this area you must hit the lever found far inside the catacombs. Gain access to the second floor near the tall frost trap and hit it so it goes down, then get on top and hit it again to rise up to the third floor and activate the lever.
## Walkthrough Instructions
Heading up the stairs from the Site of Grace the first room is more stairs, with a 90 degree right turn and a large pit on the side, players will die if they fall into the pit.
There is 1 imp at the turn of the stairs that can be a surprise, make sure not to fall off during this fight.
The corridor at the top of the stairs has a frost trap at the end of it breathing icy-breath that will do damage and apply Frostbite if it connects.

Time your step and move between the safe pockets on the sides of the corridor. Once at the frost trap hit it once to have it lower into the ground and stop firing the breath. On the way down the corridor there is one safe pocket on the right side and then another one further on to the left side.

As you hop into the left "pocket", you'll find imp waiting to jump and attack the player, get behind the imp to stay away from the icy breath while fighting. Going down this path will lead to the locked boss doors of the catacombs and further into the catacombs, but we have to first unlock the boss door.

The room with this first frost trap is a dead end room, jump onto the frost trap to be raised up to the ledge above where an imp is waiting to attack. A corpse sat in front of the tomb at the top holds a Rejuvenating Boluses.

Having retrieved the only "loot" form this room, head back out, and proceed back to where the locked boss doors were. When you get to where the boss doors are, turn right, but walk carefully when going up the next set of stairs as there will be another frost trap breathing down the doorway at the top.

This room is a large hall with a tall ceiling and a tall frost trap. There are 3 floors that can be seen in this room with the lever for the locked door found on the third floor. On the right close to the entrance is an imp, as well as an Erdtree Burial Watchdog with a staff on the 2nd floor that will jump down to attack you. There is also an Imp on the left side of the second floor. It's recommended to lure him out if you have a ranged attack, so that he won't be able to ambush you when you get to the second floor.
A body with 4 Root Resin can also be found in this room.

Hitting the frost trap will lower it but instead of turning off the breath, the now lowered statue will breathe the icy breath in the other directions, down the tunnels leading out of the room. The icy breathe can be used to help deal with the Watchdogs as you can make them follow you into the tunnels then use a ranged attack to lower the frost trap, round the corner to have the watchdog stop chasing and keep taking damage from the frost trap.
The passageway on the left leads to a dead end room with 4 imps in it with a Grave Glovewort (9) inside, a Grave Glovewort (8) is found in the tunnel between.
The passageway on the right leads to a larger room with stairs. This room has 2 imps in it, one found close on the right of the entrance and one up the stairs.

Going up the stairs will bring you to a dead end room with an Erdtree Burial Watchdog with a sword sitting over a body that has the Imp Head (Elder) as well as a Grave Glovewort (9), a Grave Violet, and 8 Human Bone Shard.

Instead of going up the stairs, there is a pathway under the stairs leading to the next room of the catacombs. A Lesser Cleanrot Knight is found inside, patrolling the room, as well as a Grave Glovewort (8). (The good news is that the understair corridor is too narrow for the Erdtree Burial Watchdog to follow you through, so you can avoid fighting it.)

As you enter the room, on the left there'll be a set of stairs, walk up them, but carefully; if the tall frost trap is raised up it will wait for the player to peek out before spraying the ice breath, at the top of the stairs is an imp that is waiting to attack unless you lured him out earlier. These stairs lead to the second floor in the large hall (that you saw the Erdtree Burial Watchdog standing on earlier), and on the left side is a Grave Glovewort (9) as well as a room with 2 Lesser Cleanrot Knights within and the Ghost Glovewort (9).
With the second floor done, we're ready to go up to the 3rd floor and finally open the boss lever.

Hit the frost trap to lower it if it isn't already lowered then, exit the room with the 2 Lesser Cleanrot Knights, and safely jump on top of the frost trap, then hit it to raise it up to the third floor of the room to find the lever.
A Grave Glovewort (9) and a Golden Rune (12) can be found here on this third floor on either side of the lever.
With the boss door open, simply exit this large room in the way that you came to get to the boss door.
BOSS BATTLE: Putrid Grave Warden Duelist

The fight with this boss is without any additional enemies. This boss wields a large axe with two hands, running at their target and spinning their axe. Many of their attacks are slow spinning attacks that players can roll away from to easily get out of range. The boss will occasionally throw their axe at players.
Using Spirit Ashes can make this boss easy to deal with as the additional attacks from the ashes can interrupt the boss' slow attacks making the fight much safer and easier.

title: Boss: Putrid Grave Warden Duelist
text: Below the staircase is a corridor with a Grave Glovewort [8].
Disable the pillar upstairs and grab the Grave Glovewort [9] near the edge.
Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [9] guarded by two Cleanrot Knights in the room close by.
Ride the pillar up to the boss lever, where you'll also find a Grave Glovewort [9] and a Golden Rune [12].
Golden Rune [12]: Consumable Item. Looted from a corpse on the third floor, by the lever that opens the boss door.
Kill the Putrid Grave Warden Duelist for Great Grave Glovewort x2, Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak, and 78,000 runes.
Putrid Grave Warden Duelist: Boss of the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs . Drops Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak and Great Grave Glovewort
Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak: Dropped by the Boss of Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs in Consecrated Snowfield, Putrid Grave Warden Duelist .
Great Grave Glovewort: Upgrade Material. Dropped by the boss of Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs, Putrid Grave Warden Duelist.

title: Boss: Putrid Avatar
text: From the catacomb entrance, head north-northwest until you see a corpse with Fire Blossom x6 on your left.
Continue east-northeast uphill to discover two corpses with Hefty Beast Bone x2 and Golden Rune [9].
Climb the large cluster of gravestones northwest of the corpses to reach a Somber Smithing Stone [8] at the top.
Go back down and run northeast for the sending gate at the end of the cliff. After arriving, head toward a dead tree with Tarnished Golden Sunflower x3 under it.
Pick up Warming Stone x4 from the corpse hanging on a root of the Minor Erdtree.
Kill the Putrid Avatar uphill from the Erdtree for Thorny Cracked Tear, Ruptured Crystal Tear, and 160,000 runes.
Thorny Cracked Tear: Dropped by the Putrid Avatar under the Minor Erdtree in Consecrated Snowfield
Putrid Avatar: A Putrid Avatar is found at the bottom of the Minor Erdtree here in the Consecrated Snowfield.
Ruptured Crystal Tear: Dropped by the Putrid Avatar under the Minor Erdtree in Consecrated Snowfield

title: Boss: Misbegotten Crusader
text: Go downhill from the Erdtree and head around the cliff on the left to reach a campsite with Dragonwound Grease x2.
Kill the invisible scarab on top of a gravestone cluster near the campsite for a Somber Smithing Stone [9].
Somber Smithing Stone [9] A: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse sitting in a chair on the bridge south of Stargazer's Ruins .
Kill the two scarabs on the clusters below for a Somber Smithing Stone [7] and a Somber Smithing Stone [8].
Somber Smithing Stone [7]: Found with a visible Teardrop Scarab atop a rock around Consecrated Snowfield .
On a lower ledge southeast of the scarabs is a corpse with Nascent Butterfly x3.
Nascent Butterfly: Nascent Butterfly found under the stairs in Ordina, Liturgical Town
Take the first left when continuing downhill to find a corpse with Albinauric Bloodclot x2 at the end.
Descend the gravestones in the nearby cliff, then pick up the Strip of White Flesh x2 surrounded by crabs in the frozen river.
Bait a Giant Crab into attacking the statue on the side of the river to obtain Smithing Stone [8] x3.
Continue along the left crag to find the entrance to Cave of the Forlorn behind a Giant Land Octopus:
Unlock the imp seal and grab the Cave of the Forlorn grace.
Pick up a Golden Rune [7] and Freezing Grease x4 from the ice in the first room.
Golden Rune [7]: Inside Cave of the Forlorn . Just jump down from the site of grace.
Freezing Grease: Can be found inside Cave of the Forlorn . just pass the Golden Rune (7) - Another one inside the cave, on a body against a wall on a small room.
Follow the north path to grab another Freezing Grease.
Take the other path to pick up a Nascent Butterfly and Golden Rune [10] from either side of the room.
Continue ahead and grab the Hero's Rune [2] on top of an icy outcrop.
Proceed through the north tunnel, which leads to a room with a Rune Arc and Spiritflame Arrow x10.

Spiritflame Arrow: Ammunition. 15x found on a corpse sitting on a chair inside a building in the northeast. This building can be reached by following the eastern walkway all the way to the northeast and walking along a concrete beam connecting to the building.
Head back and descend the slope reached from an icy outcrop with a lily on top to find Miquella's Lily x3, Crystal Dart x8, and Thawfrost Boluses x2.
Just around the corner sits a corpse with Thawfrost Boluses x3.
Descend the hole and pick up the Freezing Grease x6 on the way to the bottom.
Kill the Misbegotten Crusader for Golden Order Greatsword and 93,000 runes.
Golden Order Greatsword: Found inside Cave of the Forlorn . Dropped by Misbegotten Crusader
Misbegotten Crusader: Boss found at the end of the Cave of the Forlorn . Drops Golden Order Greatsword

title: Boss: Great Wyrm Theodorix
text: Exit the cave and kill Great Wyrm Theodorix at the end of the river for Dragon Heart x3 and 180,000 runes.
Great Wyrm Theodorix: Optional Dragon Boss found outside of the Cave of the Forlorn . Drops 3 Dragon Hearts upon defeat.

Dragon Heart: Key Consumable. 3 Hearts are dropped by Great Wyrm Theodorix upon his defeat. Dragon Hearts are used to acquire Dragon Communion Incantations at the Church of Dragon Communion and the Cathedral of Dragon Communion .

place.title: Cave of the Forlorn
walk: Enter the cave and you will find the Site of grace, near the entrance. Activate it. Head down to find a Golden Rune (7). continue long the way to find x4 Freezing Grease. Take the left path, roll to break the stalactites. You will find a few enemies there. There is another Freezing Grease to be found, on a body inside a small room.

Return to the entrance room and now take the right path, once there, you can take a small alley on the left, where there are a few misbegotten. Behind it you will find x1 Nascent Butterfly and on the other side of the room you can find x1 Golden Rune (10).

Head to the next room where you will find a Miquella's Lily on either side, as well as a few more scattered through the room, then use the snowy columns to reach the top and obtain x1 Hero's Rune (2). Head to the next room up the ramp to be greeted by another Misbegotten, head through the narrow path. You will find more Misbegottens here. You will find x10 Spiritflame Arrow and x1 Rune Arc on two bodies on a small room, again guarded by a Misbegotten.
Return to the previous room and by climbing again, you will reach a new area. Fall platform by platform, until you reach the lowest floor. Get ready to fight some Jellyfish.

Once you have cleared the room, enter through the hole on the ground. falling platform by platform again. You will obtain x6 Freezing Grease on one of the platforms. Once you are at the lowest level, you will be able to fight the boss, Misbegotten Crusader.
Defeat it to receive the Golden Order Greatsword.

title: Black Knife Set
text: Pick up the Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone below the frozen waterfall.
Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone: On the waterfall.
Travel to Inner Consecrated Snowfield and follow the north-northwest path across the lake to reach Ordina, Liturgical Town:
Grab the Ordina, Liturgical Town grace next to the path.
Pick up the Golden Rune [10] in front of a shrine up the first set of stairs.
Jump onto the rooftops south of the shrine, then onto the flat-roofed building to reach a corpse with Cuckoo Glintstone x8.
From the rooftops, turn east and double jump onto either balcony at the far end. Pick up a Rune Arc from the third balcony facing away from town.
Break the wooden crates below the balcony to reveal a corpse with Hefty Beast Bone x3.
Interact with the imp seal up the second set of stairs from the shrine, then enter the evergaol:
Note: Equip the Sentry's Torch in your left hand to reveal the invisible enemies.
Kill the Black Knife Assassin below the staircase near the evergaol for a Ghost Glovewort [9].
Ghost Glovewort [9]: It is dropped by an invisible warrior found by entering first the evergaol, you can defeat him by paying attention to the footprints on the ground.
Head around the town and kill the Black Knife Assassin southeast of the grace for a Ghost Glovewort [9].
Kill the Black Knife Assassin near the shrine for a Ghost Glovewort [9], then light the first candle (1/4).
Go around the building west of the shrine to find Crystal Dart x5.
Jump over the fence to pick up Freezing Grease x2 from a corpse in the middle.
Freezing Grease: Found on a body lying in the middle of the snow on the west side of Ordina, Liturgical Town
Kill the Black Knife Assassin below the arch near the corpse for the final Ghost Glovewort [9].
Climb the ladder behind the building farthest from town and light the candle at the top (2/4).
Pick up a Golden Rune [12] from the roof below the candle.
Golden Rune [12]: Found on a body at the edge of the cliffs in the Consecrated Snowfield. There is a jumping path up from here to the Apostate Derelict in the West.
Make your way across the rooftops and grab the Golden Rune [13] next to the first archer.
Drop down to find a corpse with Old Fang x3 directly below, then pick up a Golden Rune [13] from the opposite side of the building.
Climb the ladder on the southwest side of the stairs and light the candle at the top (3/4).
Pick up Slumbering Egg x3 from the snow-covered corner of a rooftop.
Continue across and light the final candle, kicking you out of the evergaol (4/4).
Pick up Invigorating Cured Meat from the corpse on the staircase near the evergaol, then grab the Black Knife Set under the stairs.
Black Knife Set: Full Set found under an arch. Includes Black Knife Hood , Black Knife Armor , Black Knife Gauntlets and Black Knife Greaves .
Invigorating Cured Meat: Found on a body on top of the stairs in Ordina, Liturgical Town
miss: Must be killed before lighting all candles inside the evergaol. Must be killed before lighting all candles inside the evergaol. Must be killed before lighting all candles inside the evergaol. Must be killed before lighting all candles inside the evergaol.

place.title: Ordina Liturgical Town
walk: To get to the Evergoal, start at the Ordina, Liturgical Town site of grace. Map Link Head north up both staircases, then turn right.
After turning right, turn left and follow around the circumference of the building.
When you reach the corner of the building, look straight ahead (there should be a staircase on your right). The Evergaol will be on your left at the end of the building, past the large staircase.
Upon reaching the Evergaol and interacting with the Imp Statue for the first time, you'll be informed of the puzzle: Light the four figures in the evergaol
Go up to the Evergaol itself, and interact to enter it.
After a loading screen, you'll find yourself still at the evergaol, but now the torches are accessible.

Below are the instructions on how to complete the puzzle. The candles below are numbered only for convenience --you do not need to light the candles in any particular order. I recommend starting with Candle #3 since it's the closest one to you.
Starting at the evergaol, run back like you're going to where the Site of Grace was, except after coming the first set of stairs, turn left, and the statue will be there.

Note that you will most certainly be attacked by an invisible Lesser Black Knife Assassin, and there will be several of them in the area. You can track them either by watching their footsteps in the snow, or reveal them with the Sentry's Torch (can be purchased from the Hermit Merchant ). If you have used Ash of War: Assassin's Gambit you can sneak to the candle without drawing the Assassin's attention.

Located at the far west edge of the town, and there's a ladder up to it blending in with the stones. From the starting point turn right and jump over the balcony, turn left and go around the town until you reach the ladder.
Beware of a nearby Lesser Black Knife Assassin - but you can run for the ladder without needing to engage her.
Map Location:
This is the first torch visible when you first enter the evergaol. You can see it directly in front of you, atop a roof. Notice that there are two ladders leading up to it. (See image below)
From the starting point, jump over the balcony to the south. Continue south and at the stairs, jump on the upper railing and onto the balcony on the left side of the stairs.
There is a ladder to your direct left, next to a door. (This is the lower ladder that was shown in the image earlier.)
Climb the next ladder right in front of you and you will reach candle 3.
This candle is located just east of where the Evergaol is. Standing at the Evergaol, take a few steps West, then face due East, and look up a bit to see the statue.

You'll notice that there are 2 ladders leading up to it, but these 2 ladders are not accessible from ground level. Instead, you'll need to access it via the archway connecting the building where the statue is to the nearby building (see image above for reference).

To access this candle, follow the instructions like you were for #3, but after reaching the first ladder, rather than going up the second ladder (like you did in the third candle step), turn left at the ladder and jump down onto the connecting archway.

At this point, you'll start to be heavily bombarded with arrows from 2 archers. One is going to be in front of you, near the first ladder that you see, and another will be off to the right. You'll have to make a tough jump onto the roof in front of you from the archway, and after that, head towards the two ladders in front of you with your shield raised, take out the first archer, and use the wall where the first ladder is as cover from the second archer. You should be able to safely climb to the top and light the fourth candle.

If you don't have a long range weapon/spell, use any shield with 100% physical reduction for protection to get into melee range of the archers as they can't move and are nearly helpless up close. Take out the single archer in your tracks and climb the ladders to victory, since the second archer will be blocked by the tower you're climbing anyway.
## After completing the puzzle...
Once all 4 candles/statues are lit, you'll receive the A seal was broken in town message:
A loading screen will show, and you will be teleported back to the evergaol starting location. Face east, walk forward, and turn left to go up the tall stairs -- these were previously locked.
At the top, you'll find a Waygate. Interact with it to be transported to the next area, Miquella's Haligtree.

text: Kill the Rotten Duelist on the cliff west-northwest of the stairs for Rotten Duelist Greaves and Rotten Greataxe.
Rotten Duelist Greaves: Leggings dropped by the large rotten duelist enemy guarding the rear of Ordina, Liturgical Town.
Rotten Greataxe: Colossal Weapon. Dropped by the duelist enemy guarding the rear of Ordina, Liturgical Town

title: Silver Mirrorshield
text: Approach the Wandering Mausoleum from the area northwest of the golden tree, then bring it down (don't approach from the ledge near the river; you will die). Optionally, mark its location on your map.
After taking down the Mausoleum, you can safely loot the Golden Rune [12] and Golden Rune [7] on the ledge near the river.
Grab the Apostate Derelict grace in the church near the Mausoleum and pick up the Silver Mirrorshield in front of Phillia, Towering Little Sister.
Silver Mirrorshield: Shield found in the Apostate Derelict church.

place.title: Apostate Derelict
walk: There's not much to do at this location, but it serves as the end-point for Latenna's questline. There is a shield on the ground to pick up which provides the players with good absorption for both physical and magical defense. The nearby Wandering Mausoleum can quickly be accessed by the site of grace here.
Some other items can be obtained in the nearby vicinity.
Somber Smithing Stone [9]: Found on a corpse sitting on a chair overlooking the edge east of the Apostate Derelict.
Golden Rune (12): Found on a corpse draped over the cliffs overlooking frozen lake southeast of this location Elden Ring Map Link
12x Trina's Lily: Found immediately NE outside the building around the tree with the jellyfish.
Boss Fight
Death Rite Bird: Found at the head of the frozen river, just southeast of the Apostate Derelict at night. Elden Ring Map here
notes: Picture of the "young yet towering" Albinauric woman, presumably called Phillia (see Latenna's monologue upon defeat).

title: Boss: Death Rite Bird (Consecrated Snowfield)
text: Look for the prompt to summon Latenna, then talk to her to receive a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Pass time until nightfall, then head toward the cliff east-northeast of the church to find a Somber Smithing Stone [9].
Somber Smithing Stone [9]: Consecrated Snowfield : Found on a corpse sitting on a chair overlooking the edge east of the Apostate Derelict .
Drop down to the lower ledge farther south to pick up a Golden Rune [13].
Kill the Death Rite Bird at the end of the river for Explosive Ghostflame and 220,000 runes.
Explosive Ghostflame: Drops from a Death Rite Bird southeast Apostate Derelict (late game area). It's a clearing in the frozen river, and you must go there at night.
Death Rite Bird: Found at the head of the frozen river, just southeast of the Apostate Derelict at night
Return to the Apostate Derelict and follow the southwest cliff edge until you reach a statue. A corpse with Golden Rune [1] x6 sits on top of the cliff to the left it.
Bait the sleeping Runebear into attacking the statue to obtain Smithing Stone [7] x3 and a Smithing Stone [8].
Continue along the cliff edge and pick up a Hero's Rune [2] from the tip of a fallen spire extending past the cliff.
Use the sending gate on the lower cliff south of the spire to reach Mohgwyn Palace.
miss: Unobtainable if you didn't exhaust Latenna's dialogue at the Slumbering Wolf's Shack before picking up the left half of the Haligtree Secret Medallion in Castle Sol.

title: Ash of War: Blood Tax
text: After arriving from Consecrated Snowfield, exit the tunnel and drop down from the cliff to find a Golden Rune [11] next to a tree.
Activate the Palace Approach Ledge-Road grace just downhill.
Pick up a Golden Rune [11] from the slope with multiple Albinaurics.
Golden Rune [11]: Consumable. Found on a body resting against the rock walls
Grab the Smithing Stone [6] and Bloodrose x5 farther down the slope.

Beside the westernmost spire is a corpse with a Smithing Stone [8].

Pick up Blood-Tainted Excrement x8 from a corpse beside the spire near two campfires.
Loot the Hero's Rune [3], Blood-Tainted Excrement x8, and Drawstring Blood Grease x4 around the middle spire.
Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [8] outside a cave near the middle spire and grab Swarm of Flies from a corpse inside.

Ghost Glovewort [8]: Found at the near the entrance to a small cave on the eastern wall.

title: Invader: Nameless White Mask

Smithing Stone [6]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse inside a small cave in the northern section of the blood marsh. Guarded by Albinaurics.
Golden Rune [13]: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse inside a cave in the northern section of the blood marsh. Guarded by Albinaurics.

place.title: Mohgwyn Dynasty Mausoleum
walk: There will be a site of grace upon entry. As you progress through the area you'll come across some Putrid Corpse enemies that you can clear to ignore since there will be a large hoard of them. Within the grassy areas there will be some collectable items. Once you climb the stairs to the open area with more corpses, there will be Numen's Rune in the body to your left hanging off the edge.

On the wall side cliff (right) from the main path, there will be a body just in front of a pile of crooked stone tablets. This will contain Smithing Stone (7). Continue ascending the path and clear the Blood Mass in your way. You'll obtain Beast Blood and Stanching Boluses. When you reach the area where a number of putrid corpses have their hands raised, loot the boulder on the corner towards the cliff edge to obtain a Stonesword Key. Make your way into the indoor area of the Mausoleum. You'll be facing a Sanguine Noble. Clear him and continue to encounter the Imprisoned Merchant. There are several Sanguine Noble throughout. Approach the large, tall pillar in the center of the Mausoleum to obtain the Lord's Rune. Smithing Stone (8) and Ghost Glovewort (9) can also be looted off corpses and corners when you continue. Once you exit, there is a pathway that leads to the Dynasty Mausoleum Midpoint site of grace. In the tunnel before this site of grace is a red sign to invade White Mask Varré's world. This suggested to be done before defeating Mohg. Then, you can make your way towards the line of pillars. Just over it, jump over to the narrow cliff edge to loot the Golden Rune (13). If you come across a small flight of stairs that lead up to a statue surrounded by Albinauricsand a Sanguine Noble, loot the chest at the base of the large figure to obtain Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone. Before ascending the lift, make sure you sit at the Site of Grace on this level. It will be north of the statue. Then walk to the platform perpendicular to the state to take the lift to the next section. Crossing the fog wall, you will trigger a cutscene before you face Mohg, Lord of Blood.Defeat him to gain:
Mohg's Great Rune
Remembrance of the Blood Lord

text: Note: You can get a second Varre's Bouquet if you quit out instead of picking up his loot. You should then see an additional pickup. Grab that one first, then pick up Varre's usual loot. [See video]

Mohg, Lord of Blood: Demi-Human Boss. Found at the upper mausoleum proper by taking the lift just past the midpoint site of grace. Drops Mohg's Great Rune and Remembrance of the Blood Lord upon defeat.
Mohg's Great Rune: Great Rune dropped by Mohg, Lord of Blood upon defeat.
Remembrance of the Blood Lord: Remembrance Item. Dropped by Mohg, Lord of Blood upon defeat.

guide.title: Unveiling Shadow of the Erdtree
text: The story expansion of Elden Ring continues in the forgotten land dubbed the Shadow of the Erdtree. After defeating Mohg, Lord of Blood in the base game, you will find a new character donning a white robe next to the cocoon in the Mohgwyn Dynasty Mausoleum. Interact with her to preface your journey to the Realm of Shadow. She introduces herself as Leda and invites you to join her, and other followers of Miquella the Kind to trace his path. To start your search, approach the cocoon and touch the withered arm. You will then be transported to a familiar, yet new region.
## How to Enter the Shadow Realm
This section only applies to players who haven't finished the Elden Ring base game.
Please see the next tab "Gravesite Plain" if you can access Realm of the Shadow immediately.

To begin your journey to the Shadow Realm, players need to defeat 2 Bosses in the base game: Starscourge Radahn and Mohg, Lord of Blood. Mohg is one of the challenging bosses that players will come across in the base game, and he can be defeated after you find your way to Mohgwyn Palace, a location that is found beneath Caelid but access is limited to a transporter in Consecrated Snowfield, or sufficiently progressing Varre's quest line.

title: Fevor's Cookbook [3], Law of Causality
text: Note: You can equip the Purifying Crystal Tear to your Physick and drink it before the fight to greatly reduce the damage taken from his "nihil" attack.
Activate the Cocoon of the Empyrean grace after the fight.
Note: You should now be able to access the realm of shadow if you own the DLC. If so, Leda should appear next to the grace.
Restore the power of Mohg's Great Rune at the Divine Tower of East Altus.
Talk to Gideon Ofnir about Mohgwyn Palace, then about the Lord of Blood's cocoon to receive Fevor's Cookbook [3] and Law of Causality.

title: Stonesword Key

title: Envoy Crown

Drop onto the main branch with ants patrolling it, then go up the upper rightmost branch to find Dappled Cured Meat and a Smithing Stone [8] at the end.

Head up the middle branch to find a Golden Rune [10] and the Envoy Crown at the end.
Envoy Crown: Helmet. Looted from the very edge of the branches.

title: Stonesword Key

place.title: Miquella's Haligtree
walk: ## How to get to Miquella's Haligtree
## Miquella's Haligtree Canopy

Starting at the site of grace, face North. On the right, you'll see a ladder with a enclosed gazebo on the left of it. The next site of grace is in that gazebo, so your goal is to proceed through the treetops until you reach the ladder and climb down. (See first image below)

After jumping down, sneaking will no longer help you as the Oracle Envoy should have spotted you. Turn left at the juncture and follow the path of the branch, rolling past the Poison Flowers and dodging the incoming bubbles, until you get to the Oracle Envoy. Because of how the branches are formed and sloped, you can angle yourself to where he shoots his bubbles at the floor and attack him during his downtime. If you're walking up at him to deal melee attacks, be particularly careful of when he jumps up and slams the ground as this move can potentially knock you off of the tree.
## Miquella's Haligtree Town
Note that from the ladder, if you look off to the West, you can see the next site of grace.

If you're finding this to be difficult and far away from a site of grace; while dodging enemies, you can run out the building, into the next building to the west/southwest, run straight out of this building, turn south to find a wooden bridge, run across the bridge to the Haligtree Town Plaza Site site of grace. Backtrack to gather the following items.

Enter the doorway into the building in the west/southwest. In this building, you can go either straight ahead or to the left. To the left, you'll find a corpse (guarded by enemies) hanging off the ledge with a Somber Smithing Stone [8] on it, be mindful of the ambushing zombies and a misbegotten enemy. Straight ahead, you'll cross a bridge that takes you to the Haligtree Town Plaza Site of Grace and a Golden Rune [12].

After activating that, and resting at the Site of Grace if needed, head back to the gazebo through the shortcut and you'll be able to sneak past the Battlemages this time if they're back. Cross the northeastern bridge to get to a large, open courtyard.
notes: Do the puzzle at Ordina, Liturgical Town to reach the Haligtree
Be careful of the Oracle Envoys up in the canopy
There are two Stonesword Keys here to collect if you fancy
