Pearldrake Talisman +2: Talisman . Down the steps and up the ladder from the Haligtree Town Site of Grace, there is a Rot Grease. The platform behind that has the Pearldrake Talisman.

place.title: Elphael Brace of the Haligtree
walk: ## How to get to Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
## Navigating Elphael's Outer Wall

From here, you can attack the Erdtree Avatar from behind. Keep in mind it is flanked by 2 Haligtree Knights. All 3 enemies can follow you into the building, but the Avatar can't follow you into the narrow tunnel south of the site of grace. You can use this or the ladder up to separate the enemies and take them on one at a time. The Avatar drops 27090 Runes and a Lord's Rune. With these enemies and all the ballistae dealt with, you can safely loot the corpses on the bridge for a Golden Rune (11) and an Arteria Leaf.
## Taking a detour for more loot
## Elphael Inner Wall
## Malenia, Blade of Miquella

Bleed is your best friend here. It is easy to apply on Malenia and the damage it deals somewhat offsets her healing. She can be staggered, allowing you to perform a critical hit on her, but due to how quickly she recovers unless you're right next to her when it happens, it's unlikely that you will be able to perform the critical hit. If you're having difficulties with this boss fight, consider bringing Black Knife Tiche with you. They're a top-tier Spirit Ash who has access to a long-range Bleed and whose quick unpredictable movements prevent Malenia from healing off of them. Deplete Malenia's health bar completely and another cutscene will play, marking the beginning of the second phase.

Defeating Malenia nets you 480000 Runes, the Remembrance of the Rot Goddess and Malenia's Great Rune. The Malenia, Goddess of Rot Site of Grace also spawns in the boss room and with that, Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree is complete.
notes: Reach Elphael by beating Loretta in Miquella's Haligtree
One has the Triple Rings of Light incantation
Another has Marika's Soreseal
Grab the Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone from behind a Putrid Avatar
Reach Elphael's Inner Wall
Reach Elphael's Drainage Channel
Complete Millicent's questline
Grab the Dragoncrest Greatshield Talisman
Reach and defeat Malenia, Blade of Miquella

title: Viridian Amber Medallion +2
text: Head back down and enter the top floor of a building to find a Smithing Stone [8].
Smithing Stone [8]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse inside a building in Miquella's Haligtree . Be careful of the Misbegotten just around the corner.
Loot the corpse down the stairs for Hefty Beast Bone x6, then grab the Golden Rune [13] on the balcony behind the stairs.
Golden Rune [13]: Rune Consumable. Found in a small room along with Haligtree Knights sitting on chairs. This room is found along the walkway after the Prayer Room.
On a small bridge above two putrid Miranda Blossoms is a corpse with Fire Grease x5.
Continue ahead and pick up the Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone in front of a statue.
Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone: Found in a chest, at the top of a tower, no traps or tricks.
Pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [8] from the left balcony, but watch for the enemies that may push you off the edge.
Somber Smithing Stone [8]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse draped over the balcony of a building in Miquella's Haligtree .
Cross the nearby bridge to grab a Golden Rune [12] and the Haligtree Town Plaza grace.
Golden Rune [12]: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse next to an Imp Statue seal in the lower levels.
Drop onto the rooftop near the grace to pick up a Smithing Stone [6].
Smithing Stone [6]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on the roof of a small building in Miquella's Haligtree .
A Spiritcaller Snail hides below the south corner of the roof. Kill it, then grab the Somber Smithing Stone [9] inside the building.
Somber Smithing Stone [9]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse inside a small building in Miquella's Haligtree .
On the branch with ants patrolling it lies a corpse with Aeonian Butterfly x4.
Pick up the Golden Rune [10] next to a second Spiritcaller Snail. The last snail is on a ledge just southwest of the second one.
Golden Rune [10]: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse leaning over the balcony of the room with many braziers.
Jump onto the rooftop across the gap, then back over to enter the building's interior and find a Golden Rune [12] inside.
Farther inside is a chest with the Viridian Amber Medallion +2.

Viridian Amber Medallion +2: The closest site of grace is the Haligtree Town Plaza. Run to the roof with the Summoning Snail, jump to the building on the right (it's lower), immediately turn around and jump inside the building. There will be a chest with the medallion and some mushroom people

title: Boss: Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree
text: Jumb back across and climb the ladder to a Smithing Stone [6] near some Putrid Corpses.
Smithing Stone [6]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on a platform in Miquella's Haligtree filled with scarlet rot zombies.
Drop down ahead and enter the west building. In the first room is a corpse with a Sacramental Bud.
Run across the bridge past the opposite building for a Smithing Stone [7] and Smithing Stone [8], guarded by a Battlemage.
Smithing Stone [7]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse in front of a gazebo connecting 3 bridges in Miquella's Haligtree . This area is guarded by two sorcerers.
Smithing Stone [8]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on a balcony. You can reach this corpse by going into the building on the left and heading up the stairs.
In the other circular building, you'll find a Hero's Rune [4].
Optional: Head across the third bridge to activate a shortcut lift to the Haligtree Town grace.
Kill Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree for Loretta's Mastery, Loretta's War Sickle, and 200,000 runes. (This earns an achievement.)
Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree: Great Enemy. Found in the large courtyard of a temple in Miquella's Haligtree .
Loretta's War Sickle: Halberd. Dropped by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree .
Loretta's Mastery: Sorcery. Dropped by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree

guide.title: Miniboss: Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree
text: Loretta's defeat nets you 200,000 Runes, Loretta's Mastery, and her weapon, Loretta's War Sickle. The Haligtree Promenade Site of Grace is also now available where she spawned.

title: Talk to Millicent
text: Activate the Haligtree Promenade grace after the fight.
After descending a long ladder, head around the side of the tower for a chest containing an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse in front of a statue in in Miquella's Haligtree . Guarded by an axe-wielding Misbegotten.
Ride the lift down and pick up Holy Grease x3 from the corpse on the bridge.
Holy Grease: Consumable. 3 are found on a corpse on the bridge towards the Prayer Room at the base of Elphael.
Continue past the bridge to discover the Prayer Room grace.
Talk to Millicent near the grace and exhaust her dialogue.

Millicent: NPC. Millicent will be available at the Prayer Room Grace at�� Elphael Brace of the Haligtree . She will not move from this spot until the player has defeated a�� Ulcerated Tree Spirit ��mini-boss just before the Drainage Channel Grace. Go up the slope, up the stairs, up the hill, and then across the branch to reach the boss arena.��

title: Black Flame's Protection
text: Optional: Tell Gowry what Millicent said.
Talk to Gideon Ofnir about using the secret medallions to receive Black Flame's Protection.

title: Miquellan Knight's Sword
text: From the Prayer Room, take the first left to find a Golden Rune [12] in front of a chalice.
Head up the second room on the left to reach a Smithing Stone [8] on a ledge.
Smithing Stone [8]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse under a tree at the bottom level in the north of the city.
Follow the branch near the ledge up to a corpse with the Miquellan Knight's Sword in a bell tower.

Miquellan Knight's Sword: Straight Sword . Found atop a belltower. You can reach this belltower by entering the second alcove on the left of the eastern walkway, heading up the stairs and then jumping onto the tree branch on the balcony. Follow the tree branch up and across to reach the tower.

title: Rotten Staff
text: Descend the tower and kill the Erdtree Avatar patrolling the rampart to obtain the Rotten Staff.
Rotten Staff: Colossal Weapon . Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar patrolling the ring walkway in the east.

title: Seedbed Curse
text: Pick up a Numen's Rune from the middle, then grab the Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone at the south end on the rampart.
Numen's Rune: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse in the southwest end of the graveyard in the northwest of the city.

Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone: Located in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree . Found in a chest hidden between columns near a roof with a corpse carrying an item, after the Prayer Room site of Grace in the Haligtree.
Go up the opposite side of the rampart to find a Somber Smithing Stone [9] next to a Crystalian.
Somber Smithing Stone [9]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse in a dark building in the northeast guarded by 3 Crystalians. This building is in the bottom level of the area.
Jump to the ledge outside the room with the Crystalian to reach a Golden Rune [10].
Pick up a Smithing Stone [7] from the corner of the room with two Cleanrot Knights.
Smithing Stone [7]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse in a large room with many braziers and two Cleanrot Knights.
A corpse with Immunizing White Cured Meat sits just outside the room's southeast exit.
Immunizing White Cured Meat: Consumable. Found on a corpse at the end of the eastern walkway, on the bottom level.
Jump onto the flying buttress next to the corpse, then drop to a ledge below it. Head down the room to find a Seedbed Curse.
Seedbed Curse: Key Item. Found on a body sitting in a chair looking down the ballistae and the Putrid Avatar within Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree .

title: Triple Rings of Light
text: Return to the grace and drop to the right after exiting the room. Drop down again and unlock the imp seal for a chest with Triple Rings of Light.
Triple Rings of Light: Incantation . Found in a chest locked behind an Imp Statue barrier. Requires 2 Stonesword Keys to unlock.

title: Haligtree Soldier Ashes
text: Enter the room on the left for a Smithing Stone [7] behind some wooden crates.
Smithing Stone [7]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse inside a wine cellar/storage room.
Go up the left staircase to find Lightning Greatbolt x5 on the broken section of the balustrade.
Jump onto the buttress below the balustrade and then toward the gazebo. Loot Cleanrot Knight Finlay from the chest in the nearby room. (This earns an achievement.)
Climb the buttress on the other side of the gazebo to reach a room with a chest containing a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse in the southern end of the ring walkway in the east.
Continue along the outside ledge to pick up the final Seedbed Curse.
Follow the branch below the ledge down to a corpse with Old Fang x5.
Descend either buttress below, then drop onto the lower ledge to reach the rampart's interior with Warming Stone x2 and Spiritflame Arrow x15.

Warming Stone: Consumable. 2 are found on a corpse sitting by a desk inside a building in the northeast. This building can be reached by following the eastern walkway all the way to the northeast and walking along a concrete beam connecting to the building.
Continue up the stairs to pick up a Smithing Stone [8] next to the ballistas, and Haligtree Soldier Ashes in front of a chalice.
Haligtree Soldier Ashes: Spirit Ashes. Found under a large decorative chalice in the northern edge of the main city proper.
Smithing Stone [8]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse in between two ballistae in the north of the city.

title: Haligtree Knight Helm
text: Head up the flying buttress next to the ballistas, then jump to the upper ledge to reach a corpse with the Haligtree Knight Helm.
Haligtree Knight Helm: Helmet. Found on a corpse in an upper level room next to the Elphael Inner Wall site of grace. There is a ladder adjacent to the grace which leads to the room.

title: Marika's Soreseal
text: Drop down and grab the Elphael Inner Wall grace and the Smithing Stone [6] close by.
Smithing Stone [6]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse by the wall directly north of the Elphael Inner Wall site of grace.
Kill the Erdtree Avatar outside the gate to obtain a Lord's Rune.
Pick up Sacramental Bud from a bush outside the gate, then grab the Arteria Leaf and Golden Rune [11] in front of the ballistas.
Descend the ladder in the corner to find a Smithing Stone [8] in front of a tree.
Note: Along the road you'll encounter five Revenants, each dropping a Ghost Glovewort [9] (first time).
Enter a small room on the side of the road side to pick up a Lord's Rune.
In a dark room with three Crystalians, you'll find a Somber Smithing Stone [9] and a Pickled Turtle Neck.
Somber Smithing Stone [9]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse inside a room at the northern end of the ring walkway in the east. Guarded by a Crystalian .
Pickled Turtle Neck: Consumable. Found on a corpse in a dark building in the northeast, guarded by 3 Crystalians. This room is in the bottom level of the area.
Pick up Beast Blood x3 from a room on the side of the road.
Pick up the Aeonian Butterfly x4 behind a tower and the Golden Rune [12] in front of an imp seal.
Unlock the imp seal and loot Marika's Soreseal from the chalice.
Marika's Soreseal: Talisman . Found on an altar in a room requiring 2 Stonesword Keys to unlock. This room is in the southeast, on the lower levels.

title: Rotten Crystal Sword
text: Return to Elphael Inner Wall and head left around the corner for a chest with the Rotten Crystal Sword, guarded by three Crystalians.

Rotten Crystal Sword: Straight Sword . Found in a chest guarded by 3 Crystalians . From the Elphael Inner Wall site of grace, head down the steps and jump over the rubble on the left. You can engage the Crystalians one by one by luring them to the hallway.

title: Golden Seed
text: A corpse with a Hero's Rune [5] sits behind a chalice at the opposite end of the hallway.
Hero's Rune [5]: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse behind a large decorative chalice at the end of the hallway after the Elphael Inner Wall site of grace.
Head up the root and turn left where the rot begins to find a corpse with Rot Grease.
Follow the roots past the rot, then go through the doorway for a Golden Rune [10].
Descend the ladder and grab the Drainage Channel grace just ahead.
Head back up and follow the top branch to a rot pond. Grab the Great Grave Glovewort and kill the Putrid Tree Spirit for a Golden Seed.

Great Grave Glovewort: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Found in the center of the second lake of rot, past a second set of branches inside the inner walls. Beware the Ulcerated Tree Spirit lurking beneath.
Golden Seed: Flask Upgrade Material. Dropped by the Ulcerated Tree Spirit lurking beneath the second lake of rot, past a second set of branches within the inner walls.

title: Millicent's Prosthesis
text: Optional: Ask Gowry why he's crying, then select "Become a flower?".
You'll now see two summon signs on the ledge near the pond:
Challenge Millicent:
Note: By choosing this option, you lock yourself out of being able to remove the frenzied flame.
Use the red summon sign and kill Millicent for a Rune Arc, Furlcalling Finger Remedy, and Millicent's Prosthesis.
Millicent's Prosthesis: When you are given the choice between assisting Millicent and challenging her, choose to challenge her. When you kill her, you will automatically receive this talisman.

title: Flock's Canvas Talisman
text: Loot the Flock's Canvas Talisman and Gowry's Bell Bearing from Gowry's corpse.

title: Rotten Winged Sword Insignia
text: Assist Millicent:
Use the gold summon sign and help Millicent kill her sisters to receive the Rotten Winged Sword Insignia.
Rotten Winged Sword Insignia: Earned after choosing to assist Millicent and successfully defeat her sisters.

title: Dragoncrest Greatshield Talisman
text: Exhaust Millicent's dialogue next to the pond. Reload the area and loot the Unalloyed Gold Needle from her corpse.
Kill Gowry for the Flock's Canvas Talisman and Gowry's Bell Bearing.

From the Drainage Channel, follow the branches and buttresses to a rooftop. Drop down the hole with rafters below it and loot the chest on the upper floor to obtain the Dragoncrest Greatshield Talisman.

Dragoncrest Greatshield Talisman: Talisman. Found in a chest on an elevated platform inside the large building in the northeast, guarded by several Pests. This platform can be reached by heading through the eastern exit from the Drainage Channel site of grace and then navigating across the branches and concrete beams to reach the roof of the building. While there are many branches and beams to traverse, the path is fairly linear. Once on the roof, drop through one of the holes onto the wooden beams below and then carefully make your way onto the platform after killing the Pests from range.

title: Ghost-Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [3]
text: Drop to the lower ledge on the east side to pick up a Nascent Butterfly from the top balcony.
Pick up Aeonian Butterfly from a corpse on the bottom floor balcony.
Head out the northeast exit and explore the northwest side first to find a Ghost Glovewort [7] in front of a grave.
Ghost Glovewort [7]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Found in a cluster of graves far to the northeast.
Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [8] and Numen's Rune near the Kindreds of Rot in the middle.
Ghost Glovewort [8]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Found on a grave in the southwest end of the graveyard in the northeast of the city.
Grab the Ghost Glovewort [7] behind a tree and the Ghost-Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [3] and Ghost Glovewort [9] down the slope.
Ghost-Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [3]: Key Item. Found on a corpse in the western section of the graveyard in the northeast of the city.
Ghost Glovewort [7]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Found on a grave in the western section of the graveyard northeast of the city.
Ghost Glovewort [9]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Found on a grave in the western section of the graveyard in the northwest of the building.

title: Traveler's Set
text: Head back and explore the graveyard on the opposite side to find a corpse with Arteria Leaf x3.
Next to a tree farther down lies a Hero's Rune [5].
Return to the building and ride the lift down to discover the Haligtree Roots grace.
Pick up the Traveler's Set from a scarlet bloom in the room near the grace.

Traveler's Set: Armor Set comprised of Traveler's Clothes , Traveler's Manchettes and Traveler's Boots . All three pieces are found deep underground in a side room with a large orange flower, adjacent to the Haligtree Roots site of grace. This area can be reached by taking the lift from the large building in the northeast.

title: Boss: Malenia, Blade of Miquella
text: Optional: Grab the shortcut lift back to the rampart with an Erdtree Avatar.
Kill Malenia, Blade of Miquella for Malenia's Great Rune, Remembrance of the Rot Goddess, and 480,000 runes. (This earns an achievement.)
Malenia, Blade of Miquella: Demigod. Found past a fog door southwest of the Haligtree Roots Site of Grace.
Malenia's Great Rune: Great Rune. Dropped by Malenia, Blade of Miquella upon defeat.
Remembrance of the Rot Goddess: Key Item. Dropped by Malenia, Blade of Miquella upon defeat.

guide.title: Malenia, Blade of Miquella
text: Bleed is your best friend here. It is easy to apply on Malenia and the damage it deals somewhat offsets her healing. She can be staggered, allowing you to perform a critical hit on her, but due to how quickly she recovers unless you're right next to her when it happens, it's unlikely that you will be able to perform the critical hit. If you're having difficulties with this boss fight, consider bringing Black Knife Tiche with you. They're a top-tier Spirit Ash who has access to a long-range Bleed and whose quick unpredictable movements prevent Malenia from healing off of them. Deplete Malenia's health bar completely and another cutscene will play, marking the beginning of the second phase.

Defeating Malenia nets you 480000 Runes, the Remembrance of the Rot Goddess and Malenia's Great Rune. The Malenia, Goddess of Rot Site of Grace also spawns in the boss room and with that, Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree is complete.

title: Mending Rune of the Fell Curse
text: Activate the Malenia, Goddess of Rot grace and rest at it to reload the area.
If you assisted Millicent, return the needle to Malenia's scarlet bloom to receive Miquella's Needle and a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Use the sending gate at the Divine Bridge in Leyndell, then ascend the tower to grab the Isolated Divine Tower grace.
Restore the power of Malenia's Great Rune at the top of the tower.
Return to Dung Eater in his cell and use the five Seedbed Curses to receive the Mending Rune of the Fell Curse.
miss: Unobtainable if you join Volcano Manor before hearing Rya's request AND don't loot the Seedbed Curse in the collapsed-roof building in Leyndell before killing Maliketh.

place.title: Isolated Divine Tower
walk: Ascend the tower to restore Malenia's Great Rune.
Like all Divine Towers, the respective shardbearer, Malenia, must be killed before the doors can be opened.
notes: This is one of the few areas where Farum Azula is visible from far away.
The Isolated Divine Tower as seen from the Bestial Sanctum.

title: Lord's Divine Fortification
text: Reload the area and loot the Omen Set from Dung Eater's corpse.
Talk to Gideon Ofnir about the Haligtree roots to receive Lord's Divine Fortification.

title: Pearldrake Talisman
text: At the Four Belfries, unlock the imp-sealed belfry marked by the message "Crumbling Lands". Use the sending gate, then grab the Pearldrake Talisman on the bottom platform.

title: Ancient Dragon Prayerbook
text: Travel to Fire Giant and cross the chain to the forge. Activate the Forge of the Giants grace at the north end of the forge.
Talk to Melina at the Forge of the Giants grace and tell her that you're ready. If you bear the frenzied flame, listen to the sounds of flame. (This earns an achievement.)
Grab the Smithing Stone [8] at the end of the bridge and a Golden Rune [9] from a platform below it.
Smithing Stone [8] J: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on a floating section of the plaza with the fallen dragon statue, near the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace.
Golden Rune [9] B: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse behind a stone column after dropping down the floating platforms north of the Tempest-Facing Balcony .
Pick up the Old Fang x3 near an unlit brazier in the room with several Azula Beastmen.
Old Fang: Crafting Material. A set of 5 can be found on a corpse hanging off the crumbled floor of a ruined building north of the Dragon Temple .
A corpse with Lightningproof Dried Liver lies in the corner of the next room.
Lightningproof Dried Liver: Consumable. On a corpse in front of a hole in the wall on the right, guarded by Beastmen .
Head left in the corridor to grab the Crumbling Beast Grave grace.
Kill the Ancient Dragon on the long platform for an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone: Upgrade Material. Dropped by the Farum Azula Dragon that swoops in to attack as you make your way along the curved platform.
Grab the Smithing Stone [6], Smithing Stone [8], and Dragonwound Grease along the platform.
Smithing Stone [6] A: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse along the middle of the curved bridge/platform.
Smithing Stone [8] B: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse along the curved bridge/platform. Before reaching it, a Farum Azula Dragon will swoop in and attack.
Dragonwound Grease: Weapon Coating. On a corpse hanging off the edge of the curved platform.
Pick up a Smithing Stone [8] from the arcade and activate the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths grace just past it.

Smithing Stone [8] C: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse under a roofed section on the left as you reach the end of the curved platform. Directly opposite the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace.
On a coffin in the room ahead lies a Smithing Stone [7].
Smithing Stone [7] A: Upgrade Material. Found on a sarcophagus closest to the balcony in the next room after the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace.
Jump to the roof out the balcony to reach the upper floor, where you can find Gravel Stone x3, Smithing Stone [6], and a Great Grave Glovewort.

Gravel Stone: Crafting Material. A set of 3 found on a sarcophagus in the upper level of the large building. To reach this area, head out of the balcony of the room after the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace and jump up onto the roof right next to it. You can enter the building's upper level from here.

Smithing Stone [6] B: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse hanging off a crumbled section of the upper floor of the large building northwest from the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace. To reach this upper level, head out of the balcony of the next room from the site of grace and jump up onto the red roof right next to it. You can enter the building's upper level from here.

Great Grave Glovewort: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Found in a recess in the northeastern-most wall of the upper level of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths . To reach this upper area, head out of the balcony of the room next to the site of grace and jump up onto the red roof right next to it. You can head into the building's upper level from here.
Pick up Lightning Greatbolt x14 from a set of stairs on the floor below.

Lightning Greatbolt: Ammunition. A set of 5 can be found on a corpse on a small upper balcony connected to the rotunda structure northeast of the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. To get up here, drop down the large roof south of the gazebo and then down to the walkway in the east. Check the northeast edge of this walkway to find a platform you can jump onto to reach the rotunda's lower balcony where you can ride the lift to the top level. The corpse is guarded by a Beastman .
Go up the opposite set of stairs to find a Golden Rune [12] hanging off a ledge.

Golden Rune [12] E: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse at the edge of some floating debris in the northern section of the region. From the Dragon Temple Lift site of grace, take the lift back down and then head east and down the spiral staircase. Around halfway down the steps where you see some broken railings, jump off the edge to a series of floating debris below. Look for one of the chunks facing southward to find the corpse holding the rune.
Pick up the Ancient Dragon Prayerbook on the bottom floor, then head out the northeast exit to grab the Tempest-Facing Balcony grace.
Ancient Dragon Prayerbook: Incantation Tome. Found at ground level in the middle of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace.

guide.title: Crumbling Beast Grave
text: Backtrack to the room that had two Beastmen right after the site of grace, and go onto the balcony of this room. On the right side of the balcony, you can hop onto the roof and enter back into the building on a higher level. On the left side of the room are three Gravel Stones on an altar. You can find a Smithing Stone (6) on a corpse in the middle of the room, and in the far end you'll find a Great Grave Glovewort on an altar guarded by an Azula Beastman Mage flanked by two melee Beastmen. Head back into the hall and down the main stairs, where you'll find more Azula Beastmen and the Ancient Dragon Prayerbook. Immediately out the door to the northeast is the Temple-Facing Balcony Site of Grace and the Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing (4).

Facing the lift now, look to the left and a side path leading to a large circular platform with an item is visible. Jump from rock to rock avoiding the sloped rock on the right to get to the larger platform, but be aware that a Farum Azula Dragon will engage you after a brief delay. The corpse on the far edge holds a Smithing Stone (8), which can be grabbed quickly before the dragon attacks. Defeating the dragon only awards runes, so you may choose to fight it here or attempt to disengage. Follow the same path back, again avoiding the sloped rock that is now on the left, then take the lift back up and return to the Tempest-Facing Balcony Site of Grace through the doorway to the northeast.

title: Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [3]
text: Head back through the southwest exit to find a Hero's Rune [2] between two columns.
Hero's Rune [2]: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse sitting by the wall next to the staircase to the terrace southwest of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace.
Take the lift down and jump across the platforms on the right for a Smithing Stone [8], guarded by an Ancient Dragon.

Smithing Stone [8] F: Found on a corpse at the edge of the large stone platform behind the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace. To reach this platform, head into the terrace southwest of the building and take the lift to the cliffs below. Navigate the floating debris north of the lift. Beware as a Farum Azula Dragon will swoop in and ambush you from behind as you pick up the item.
Jump back across and follow the upper left path to a corpse with Fulgurbloom x4 around the corner.

Fulgurbloom: Crafting Material. A set of 4 can be found on a corpse by a tree behind the western-most broken bridge along the southern cliffs. This area can be reached by taking the lift in the terrace southwest of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace and then navigating the slopes and pathways by the cliffs.
Behind the tree below, with Wormfaces around it, lies a Somber Smithing Stone [9].

Somber Smithing Stone [9] A: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse under a tree by the cliffside south of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace. You can reach this area by taking the lift in the terrace southwest of the building.
Climb the ladder behind the nearby bridge pillar to reach a Smithing Stone [8] on top of the broken bridge.

Smithing Stone [8] D: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse sitting at the edge of the broken bridge atop the arch ruins, guarded by a Lesser Wormface . This area can be reached by taking the lift in the terrace southwest of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace and then navigating the slopes and pathways by the cliffs. There is a ladder that you can climb on the back side of the arch to get on top.
Descend the platforms below the bridge. Pick up Rejuvenating Boluses and Smithing Stone [8] from the water and the Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [3] in the gazebo.

Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [3]: Key Item. Found inside a gazebo by the shallow pond infested by Lesser Wormfaces . You can reach this area by taking the lift in the terrace southwest of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace and then navigating the slopes and pathways by the southern cliffs.

Rejuvenating Boluses: Consumable. Found on a corpse in the center of the shallow pond infested with Lesser Wormfaces . This area can be reached by taking the lift in the terrace southwest of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace and then navigating the slopes and pathways by the southern cliffs.

Smithing Stone [8] E: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on the eastern edge of the shallow pond infested by Lesser Wormfaces . You can reach this area by taking the lift in the terrace southwest of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace and then navigating the slopes and pathways by the southern cliffs.

title: Boss: Wormface (Crumbling Farum Azula)
text: Wormface: Boss. Located in Crumbling Farum Azula

title: Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [4]
text: Head down the slope below a broken bridge to find Gravel Stone x5 around the end corner.

Gravel Stone: Crafting Material. A set of 5 can be found on a corpse far to the east of the southern cliffs. You can reach this area by taking the lift in the terrace southwest of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace and then navigating the slopes and pathways by the cliffs.
Return to the Tempest-Facing Balcony and pick up the Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [4] beyond the broken balustrade.
Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [4]: Key Item. Found on a corpse at the edge of the cliffs by the Tempest-Facing Balcony .

title: Stonesword Key
text: Descend the cliff to a floating platform. Grab the Golden Rune [9] behind the arcade and the Somber Smithing Stone [7] on a separate platform.
Golden Rune [9] A: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse on some floating debris to the right and below the walkway, leading to the balcony.

Somber Smithing Stone [7] B: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse by the cliffs underneath a section of the Great Bridge , accessible by circling around the plaza southeast of the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace.
Pick up Golden Arrow x14 from the tip of a platform on the way down, then drop into the hole in the bottom platform to find a Golden Rune [10] behind you.

Golden Arrow: Bow Ammunition. A set of 14 found on a corpse at the edge of a floating platform adjoined to a long chunk of debris as you traverse the heavily-ruined section leading to the Dragon Temple .

Golden Rune [10]: Rune Consumable. Found by dropping into a pit in the heavily-ruined section leading to the Dragon Temple . This pit leads to a narrow hallway below. Turn around as you drop into the hallway to find a corpse sitting along the edge which contains the rune.
After dropping down the hole, take the second left for a Golden Rune [12] at the edge.

Golden Rune [12] F: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse in the upper crumbled segment west of the Dragon Temple , right next to where Alexander is standing if you followed his questline. To get up here, you need to ascend the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple and then head south from the fountain plaza until you reach the Phantom Tree surrounded by pillars. From here, head west and use the top of another group of pillars to make your way to the start of the upper crumbled section.
Follow the other path to a ladder that leads to a Great Grave Glovewort on a coffin.

Great Grave Glovewort: Upgrade Material. After dropping down the pit into a narrow hallway in the heavily-ruined section leading to the Dragon Temple , head into the first archway on the left and up the stairs heading northwest to a ruined balcony where you can navigate across a series of floating debris to reach a second balcony with a ladder. Head up the ladder to reach a hidden tomb with the glovewort sitting on the main sarcophagus in the back.
Drop back down to the platform with a hole. Pick up Gravel Stone x3 from the arcade and a Somber Smithing Stone [9] next to a beast-entwined pillar.
Gravel Stone: Crafting Material. A set of 3 found on a corpse in the roofed hallway in the heavily-ruined section leading to the Dragon Temple .
Somber Smithing Stone [9] B: Upgrade Material. Found under a leaning pillar in the heavily-ruined section just before jumping towards the Dragon Temple .
Continue across the gap to grab the Dragon Temple grace.
Follow the left path past the grace to a Golden Rune [11], then take the other path to a Smithing Stone [6] at the edge.
Golden Rune [11] A: Rune Consumable. From the Dragon Temple site of grace, go through the archway ahead and immediately turn left to collect the rune on a corpse by a collapsed pillar.
Smithing Stone [6] C: Upgrade Material. From the Dragon Temple site of grace, take the path on the right to find the rune on a corpse hanging off the edge of the broken passage.
Go down the first set of stairs and through a long hallway to find a Stonesword Key.

Stonesword Key: Key Item. Found on a corpse in a semi-open area in the back of the temple to the east. From the Dragon Temple site of grace, head inside the temple and turn right then down the stairs on the left. Take another right when you can and then another left into a long hallway. The said area is to the left at the end of this hallway and the corpse can be found in the crumbled edge past the pillars.

title: Azula Beastman Ashes
text: Pick up Dragonwound Grease x2 from a corpse hanging off the ledge at the end.

Dragonwound Grease: Weapon Coating. A set of 2 on a corpse near the center of the Dragon Temple which can only be accessed by circling around the back of the temple in the east. From the site of grace, head inside the archway and turn right then down the stairs on the left. Take another right and another left into a very long hallway. At the end of this hallway is a semi-outdoors area with pillars and a set of stairs on the left. Head up the stairs and follow the hallway to find a corpse holding the item on a ledge on the left in the crumbled section at the end.
Drop down and grab the Golden Rune [12] on top of the broken staircase.

Golden Rune [12] C: Rune Consumable. Found on the broken spiral staircase in the center of the Dragon Temple . Requires circling around the back of the temple in the east to reach it. From the Dragon Temple site of grace, head inside the archway and turn right then down the stairs on the left. Take another right and then a left into a long hallway that leads to a semi-open area with pillars and a set of stairs on the left. Head up the stairs and follow the hallway to a crumbled section where you can jump onto the aforementioned spiral staircase. The rune is found on a corpse on the top end of it.
From the Dragon Temple grace, jump onto the stairs below the cliff, then drop to the area below the grace. Go left after dropping to pick up a Rune Arc.

Rune Arc: Consumable. Found on the northeastern edge of the Dragon Temple , at the bottom level. To reach this, turn around from the Dragon Temple site of grace and face west. Drop down by using the crumbled ledges below and then head north to find the corpse holding the item by one of the crumbled pillars.
Follow the other path to a coffin with the Azula Beastman Ashes.

Azula Beastman Ashes: Spirit Ashes. Found at the bottom level of the Dragon Temple accessed by turning around to face west from the Site of Grace and then jumping down the crumbled ledges below. From here, head into the central archway and then turn right to find a crypt with several sarcophagi. The ashes can be found on the sarcophagus in the back.

guide.title: Dragon Temple
text: Head down the floating rocks and ruins west, where you'll get to a makeshift bridge occupied by Skeletons. The skeletons here in Crumbling Farum Azula look to have similar features and wield the same weapons as Azula Beastmen but have the same respawn mechanic as regular in-game skeletons. At the top of this first large chunk of ruin, you'll find a Golden Rune (9) on a corpse behind one of the pillars. Continue jumping across the floating ruins north, being sure to pick up the Somber Smithing Stone (7) and fourteen Golden Arrows, and jump into the hole in the corner of the next large chunk of ruin, right beside where you land.

Down the hole, to the southwest is a corpse with a Golden Rune (10). Head forwards to the northeast and before going through the first doorway to your left, go through the second one for an item protected by a Skeleton. At the end of the hallway through the first doorway, you'll emerge out onto a balcony. Turn left and you'll see you can jump up some ruins, but beware as the broken banister can trip you as you try to jump. Scale the ruins up, and then head up the ladder you find at the end. On the altar up ahead is another Great Grave Glovewort. Three skeletal beastmen spawn after you pick it up. When you're done dealing with them, head out of the room and look down to your left to find a safe path back down to the large chunk of ruin with the hole you went down earlier. Following the path, pick up three Gravel Stones and a Somber Smithing Stone (9) on the way, and you'll eventually find the Dragon Temple Site of Grace.

From this Site of Grace, turn around back towards the ruins you came from and look down. There are floating stair ruins that you can jump down. At the base of these stairs, turn back around again and jump down to the lowest platform here. On the left is a corpse with a Rune Arc on it. If you head into the building and turn right at the corner, you'll find the Azula Beastman Ashes right ahead on an altar, guarded by several Banished Knights. Look to the right of the altar with the ashes and pass through the doorway to find a corpse with a Somber Smithing Stone (9). Head back into the building and jump off onto the lower ruin to the east. Here, you'll find the Dragon Temple Transept Site of Grace. Don't head into the room to your left yet - that's a boss fight we'll come back to. After you're done with all that, teleport back to the Dragon Temple Site of Grace.

title: Boss: Godskin Duo
text: On the edge past the west doorway lies a Somber Smithing Stone [9].

Somber Smithing Stone [9] C: Upgrade Material. Found in the southwest at the bottom level of the Dragon Temple accessed by turning around to face west from the Site of Grace and then jumping down the crumbled ledges below. From here, head into the central archway and then turn right to find a crypt with several sarcophagi. Go through the archway in the west to an outdoor area where you can find a corpse holding the stone between two pillars.
Head through the east corridor to discover the Dragon Temple Transept grace.
Kill the Godskin Duo for Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [4], Ash of War: Black Flame Tornado, and 170,000 runes. (This earns an achievement.)

Godskin Duo: The Godskin Apostle and Godskin Noble are encountered once again in a simultaneous boss encounter in the center of the Dragon Temple . Drops Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing (4) and Ashes of War: Black Flame Tornado upon defeat.
Ash of War: Black Flame Tornado: Ash of War. Dropped by the Godskin Duo upon defeat.
Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [4]: Key Item. Dropped by the Godskin Duo upon defeat.

guide.title: Miniboss: Godskin Duo
text: After defeating them, you will be rewarded with 170,000 Runes, the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing (4), and the Ash of War: Black Flame Tornado. Interact with the Dragon Temple Altar Site of Site of Grace that spawns after their defeat and now we can move forward.

title: Golden Seed
text: Optional: Bernahl's summon sign can be found at the entrance near the grace.
Activate the Dragon Temple Altar grace after the fight.
From the grace, head out the north exit and continue until you reach a Golden Rune [11] below an arcade.
Jump through the arcade and pick up Old Fang x5 from a corpse hanging off the gap.
Old Fang: Crafting Material. 3 found on a corpse in a room where the Beastmen are roaming around.
Go around the outside of the ruined structure to find a Hero's Rune [5] (mind the gap in the ledge).
Hero's Rune [5] B: Rune Consumable. One found on a corpse by an outer ledge behind a wall. You can get to the ledge by carefully walking on the broken section while hugging the wall.
Continue down to a corridor and pick up the Smithing Stone [7] behind a fallen pillar straight ahead.

Smithing Stone [7] C: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on an upper cliff east of the fountain plaza. This is in an upper area accessed after ascending the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple. From the lift, head east and down the stairs past a tree. Climb up the ledges to reach the top of the cliff and collect the stone.
Go around the outside ledge to find a corpse with Lightning Grease x5 at the end.

Lightning Grease: Weapon Coating. A set of 5 can be found behind the narrow path laden with dragon statues. Traverse the length of the path and then turn left at the end to get to the backside, behind the wall. The items are found on a corpse near the southern end of this area.
Ascend the earlier stairs, then go up the slanted pillar on the left to grab an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on a floating platform north of the Dragon Temple , guarded by a Beastman . From the north end of the temple, navigate your way through the floating debris to a narrow path laden with dragon statues, at the end of which you will find a spiral staircase on the right. Head up these stairs and then turn towards the south to find a floating pillar adjoining the aforementioned floating platform. Use the pillar to get up to the platform and collect the stone.
Head back across and explore the area on the left. Behind a fallen pillar lies a Somber Smithing Stone [9].

Somber Smithing Stone [9] D: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on an upper level balcony in the northern section past the Dragon Temple . From the north end of the temple, navigate your way across the floating debris to a narrow path laden with dragon statues, at the end of which you will find a spiral staircase on the right side. Head up these stairs and continue west to a balcony with a sealed Imp Statue barrier and several fallen pillars. The corpse holding the stone can be found behind one of these pillars.
Unlock the imp seal and take the lift up to reach the Dragon Temple Lift grace.
Pick up a Lord's Rune from the large basin in the area past the grace.
Lord's Rune: Rune Consumable. Found atop the fountain located just outside the Dragon Temple Lift , after ascending the lift into the plaza.
Next to a tree down the left side of a building sits a corpse with Nascent Butterfly x2.
Nascent Butterfly: Crafting Materia. A set of 2 found on a corpse under a tree east of the fountain plaza. This area is accessed after ascending the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple.
Continue up the rocky slope to grab a Smithing Stone [7] behind the building and a Golden Rune [12] behind the tree.
Smithing Stone [7] B: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse behind a fallen pillar in the northern section past a narrow path laden with dragon statues.

Golden Rune [12] D: Rune Consumable. Found on an upper level east of the fountain plaza. This is in an upper area accessed after ascending the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple. From the lift, head east and down the stairs past a tree. Climb up the ledges at the end of the path to reach the upper level and head south. The rune is found on a corpse under a tree in this area.
Go up the nearby stairs and loot the Smithing Stone [8] hanging off the edge past a tree.

Smithing Stone [8] H: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse at the edge of the cliffs southeast of the fountain plaza, past a gazebo and a tree. This is in an upper area accessed after ascending the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple.
Pick up the Rune Arc and Golden Seed past the gazebo.

Rune Arc: Consumable. Found on a corpse near a Phantom Tree by some pillars south of the fountain plaza. This is in an upper area accessed after ascending the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple.

Golden Seed: Flask Upgrade Material. Found under a Phantom Tree by some pillars south of the fountain plaza. This is in an upper area accessed after ascending the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple.

title: Golden Lightning Fortification
text: Head past the arches to find a scarab that drops Golden Lightning Fortification.

Golden Lightning Fortification: Incantation . Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab by the cliffs south of the fountain plaza. This is in an upper area accessed after ascending the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple.

title: Shard of Alexander
text: Pick up the Smithing Stone [8] in front of a sleeping dragon.

Smithing Stone [8] G: Upgrade Material. One found on a corpse in front of a sleeping dragon, far south of the fountain plaza. This is in an upper area accessed after ascending the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple.
Go below the arches opposite the dragon to find a slope near the edge that leads to Dragonwound Grease x2.

Dragonwound Grease: Weapon Coating. A set of 2 can be found on a corpse by the very edge of the cliffs southwest of the fountain plaza. This is in an upper area accessed after ascending the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple.
Run across the top of the arches and past a fallen tower to find Alexander. Pick up the Golden Rune [12] next to him.

Golden Rune [12] B: Rune Consumable. After dropping down the pit into a narrow hallway in the heavily-ruined section leading to the Dragon Temple , ignore the first archway on the left and enter the second one instead. The rune is on a corpse at the edge of the crumbled section here.
Note: If you haven't progressed his questline, you'll see a sleeping dragon instead of Alexander.
Exhaust Alexander's dialogue to duel him. Talk to him after beating him to receive Shard of Alexander and Alexander's Innards.
Shard of Alexander: Drops from Iron Fist Alexander after completing his questline.

title: Talk to Iron Fist Alexander
text: Iron Fist Alexander: Found in Crumbling Farum Azula. From the Dragon Temple Lift grace (can be accessed by using two Stonesword Keys), go past the plaza full of undead up the flight of stairs, turn right and you'll see two square bracket shaped archways. Jump on the archway on the left (closest to the dragon) to get over to the other side. Alexander can be found directly on the flat arena after crossing the crumbling tower. He will challenge you to a warrior's duel, and if you win, he will reward you with Alexander's Innards and Shard of Alexander. If you lose, he will continue letting you challenge him until you win.

title: Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook [4]
text: Pick up a Smithing Stone [7] from the large platform past Alexander.

Smithing Stone [7] D: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse in the second large segment of the upper crumbled section west of the Dragon Temple . To get up here, you need to ascend the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple and then head south from the fountain plaza until you reach the Phantom Tree surrounded by pillars. From here, head west and use the top of another group of pillars to make your way to the start of the upper crumbled section.
Continue uphill and grab the Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook [4] from the slanted tower at the top.

Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook [4]: Cookbook found in a gazebo-like structure high above in the heavily-crumbled section in the northwest. To get up here, you will first need to ascend the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple and then head south from the fountain plaza until you reach the Phantom Tree surrounded by pillars. From here, head west and use the top of another group of pillars to make your way to the start of the upper crumbled section. You will need to traverse the massive floating chunks of debris, heading further west. Once you get to the second large chunk, look in the northwest section of it for a series of makeshift stone bridges that will lead you to the gazebo where the cookbook can be looted off a corpse.

title: Companion Jar
text: Pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [8] from the platform next to the tower, then drop down below it to grab a Smithing Stone [8].

Somber Smithing Stone [8] A: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse hanging off a ledge in the upper crumbled segment west of the Dragon Temple . To get up here, you will first need to ascend the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple and then head south from the fountain plaza until you reach the Phantom Tree surrounded by pillars. From here, head west and use the top of another group of pillars to make your way to the start of the upper crumbled section. You will need to traverse the massive floating chunks of debris, heading further west. Once you get to the second large chunk, look in the northwest section of it for a series of makeshift stone bridges that will lead you to a gazebo-like structure. Head slightly north from the gazebo to find the corpse that holds the stone, hanging off the right edge.

Smithing Stone [8] I: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse hanging off a ledge in the upper crumbled segment west of the Dragon Temple . To get up here, you will first need to ascend the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple and then head south from the fountain plaza until you reach the Phantom Tree surrounded by pillars. From here, head west and use the top of another group of pillars to make your way to the start of the upper crumbled section. You will need to traverse the massive floating chunks of debris, heading further west. Once you get to the second large chunk, look in the northwest section of it for a series of makeshift stone bridges that will lead you to a gazebo-like structure. Head slightly north from the gazebo to find a corpse holding a Somber Smithing Stone [8] and then drop off the edge onto a small floating platform below to pick up the Smithing Stone [8] .
Talk to Jar-Bairn and give him Alexander's Insides. Exhaust his dialogue, then reload the area to find the Companion Jar on the porch.
miss: Becomes unobtainable if you kill Alexander before dueling him in Farum Azula.

title: Dragoncrest Shield Talisman +2
text: Optional: Talk to Enia now that you've burned the Erdtree.
Optional: Talk to Roderika in front of the fireplace.
Optional: Exhaust Hewg's dialogue about the god-slaying weapon and ask him why he's still making weapons.
Optional: Talk to Roderika about Hewg.
Optional: Return to Hewg and ask him what happened to her.
Optional: Talk to Gideon Ofnir and exhaust his dialogue option.
Return to Dragon Temple Lift and take the lift back down. Follow the platforms below the staircase to a Golden Rune [12] hanging off the edge.

Golden Rune [12] A: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse hanging off a crumbled ledge outside of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace. This can be reached through an exit in the northwest section of the building.
Jump to the platform on the opposite side to grab the Dragoncrest Shield Talisman +2.

Dragoncrest Shield Talisman +2: Upgraded Talisman. Found on a corpse on a chunk of floating debris in the north of the region. From the Dragon Temple Lift site of grace, take the lift back down and then head east and down the spiral staircase. Around halfway down the steps where you see some broken railings, jump off the edge to a series of floating debris below. Once you reach the lowest platforms, turn around and look for a small platform underneath one of the upper ones to find the corpse with the talisman.

title: Drake Knight Set
text: Turn right up the stairs to find a corpse with Dappled Cured Meat.
Pick up a Smithing Stone [8] from a floating platform past the Crucible Knight ahead.
Smithing Stone [8] A: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse sitting at the end of the walkway that you begin on when first visiting the region.
Grab the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace on the rooftop below.
Pick up a Smithing Stone [6] from the corpse guarded by two Stormhawks.
Smithing Stone [6] D: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse northeast of the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace, in front of a large rotunda building in the rooftop gardens.
Descend the ladder and drop down the platform below the edge. Head around the side of the tower for a chest with the Drake Knight Set.

Drake Knight Set: Armor Set comprised of the Drake Knight Helm , Drake Knight Armor , Drake Knight Gauntlets and the Drake Knight Greaves . This set can be acquired once you reach the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. Use the red roof below the grace to reach the rooftop garden-like area in the northeast which has a rotunda structure with a lift inside. The lift can't be used initially so drop down onto the large red roof to the south, then down the walkway to the east. Check along the northeast edge of this walkway for a platform you can jump onto to reach the rotunda building's lower balcony. The armor set can be found in a chest at the northeast end of this balcony.

guide.title: Completing the dungeon
text: Continue ascending the floating rubble, and pick up the Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook (4) inside an enclosed area at the end. Two large undead beastmen are hiding here - one in the shadows around the outside of the tower, and one in pieces on the ground behind a block of rubble. They will attack you when you pick up the cookbook, so it is better to take out the one behind the tower first, then goad the second one into attacking before defeating it in single combat.

(Optional side path to Drake Knight Set): Go down the ladder to the south and immediately turn left to find a floating platform behind the corner, hop on it and then jump down to a circular lift area. Run around it to the other end to find Drake Knight Set in a chest. Then take the elevator up to encounter an Azula Beastman across the small bridge. Loot the Lightning Greatbolt here and safely drop back down to grace.

After going back to the ladder where you encountered two eagles, looking to the south, you'll see a hostile pale Dragon casting red lightning bolts all over the rooftops. Keep in mind that before hitting the ground, bright red flames mark the areas the lightning is about to strike. By staying away from these flames, you can avoid being hit by these attacks.

(Optional side path to Boltdrake Talisman +2 & Dragon Towershield): Left of the gazebo, in the eastward direction, if you look down, you'll see platforms down below. Keep dropping down and then drop down to another platform by the right side, next to the building. Drop below, left again to find a doorway. Enter it and to your left, you'll fight through a Banished Knight. Continue to find an Eagle and a ladder. Be careful as you ascend the ladder as there is another knight with a spear patrolling above and another soldier with two swords standing on the left. The Dragon Towershield can be found in the chest directly left from the ladder. Right across the ladder, there is an elevator. Take it up to find a path going west which takes you into the building right below the birds that you fought earlier on your way to the Dragon. Enter this set of ruins and you should encounter a Crucible Knight fighting Beastmen. If you are quick enough, you can run past them and take the ladder up at the end, otherwise, you can choose to defeat the Crucible Knight. After ascending the ladder, to your right, you can finally pick up Boltdrake Talisman +2 from the corpse. Drop down to find yourself back at the area with Eagles where the Dragon was using his lightning and make your way back to the Dragon's location where this side path started.

Once you've dealt with or escaped from the foes, move forward through the stairs located to the right of the chapel's altar. The path will take you to an elevator, after which, you'll reach the Beside the Great Bridge Site of Grace. Moving further up the stairs you will then reach the Great Bridge. You'll be situated now at the middle of the bridge, and facing the choice to either go right (South) or left (North). The Bossfight takes place at the coliseum-like structure located upwards, so if you want to enter the last stage of your journey at Crumbling Farum Azula you can head this way. Please note that there is also another optional boss fight (Dragonlord Placidusax) that can be accessed by going back down the elevator from Beside the Great Bridge Site of Grace. If you'd like to fight the boss now. However, this section of the guide will first cover what lies at your left, that is, heading north.

Recusant Bernahl wields a Devourer's Scepter Warhammer and his fight style consists mostly of melee attacks. However, the skill on his weapon, Devourer of Worlds, allows him to charge it with magic and strike it against the ground to steal your HPs. Once defeated, Recusant Bernahl drops the entire Beast Champion Set as well as the Devourer's Scepter Warhammer and x1 Blasphemous Claw.

Once the area is cleared, you may loot the coffer inside the rounded tower. This chest contains the Old Lord's Talisman, which extends the duration of effects caused by sorceries and incantations. Now that this area has been exhausted, return to the Beside the Great Bridge Site of Grace to refill your health and flasks, and go back onto the Great Bridge and head for the boss fight.
Fighting this Sentinel is duly compensated as it rewards you with the Malformed Dragon Set. Head up towards the fog door, grabbing the Somber Smithing Stone (7) on the way.
## Beast Clergyman/Maliketh, the Black Blade

NOTE: Upon defeating the following boss, much of Leyndell, Royal Capital will become unavailable, as will many of the weapons, items, spells, and armor located there. Plan to collect any items you want from Leyndell before completing the fight, in particular the legendary armament the Bolt of Gransax.

Once you've reached the coliseum-shaped structure, you'll begin fighting Beast Clergyman. His attacks mainly consist of close-range swipes and various rock throws. Since his quicker and more deadly attacks are done in melee range, magic and ranged users will have an easier time dealing with him as they can fight back while keeping their distance. Melee users should look for opportunities where the Beast Clergyman is vulnerable before committing to any attacks. One such attack that is safer to punish is one of the rock throws where he plunges his knife into the ground. You can find more details and strategies on his boss page.

After taking the Beast Clergyman's HP to about half, it will reveal itself to be Maliketh, the Black Blade. Maliketh has a different skill set than the Beast Clergyman but has the same 'quick and hard to punish' characteristic. If you've finished Bernahl's questline and have defeated Recusant Bernahl, be sure to make use of the Blasphemous Claw that he drops. You can use the item to counter Maliketh's attacks that make his weapon briefly glow yellow. You can find more details and strategies on his boss page and the Blasphemous Claw page.

After you have defeated Maliketh, you will be teleported to the Leyndell, Capital of Ash Site of Grace. After activating that grace you can teleport back to Beside the Great Bridge Site of Grace and return to the boss fight arena to touch Maliketh, the Black Blade Site of Grace if you wish to do so. However, the main point of focus here is to go to the optional boss fight.

title: Golden Seed
text: Ride the lift to the top to find Lightning Greatbolt x5 next to the balustrade.
Drop off during the ride back down and pick up Arteria Leaf x3 from a patch of flowers down the ladder.
Rush toward the Ancient Dragon and kill it for an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone: Upgrade Material. Dropped by the stationary Farum Azula Dragon sitting at the back of the plaza southeast of the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. The dragon is constantly raining red lightning around the area.
Pick up the Fulgurbloom x8 and Golden Rune [12] around the dragon, then grab the Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone in the gazebo.

Fulgurbloom: Crafting Material. A set of 8 found on a corpse in front of a stationary Farum Azula Dragon sitting at the back of the plaza southeast of the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. The dragon is constantly raining red lightning around the area.

Golden Rune [12] G: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse in front of a stationary Farum Azula Dragon sitting at the back of the plaza southeast of the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. The dragon is constantly raining red lightning around the area.

Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone: Upgrade Material. Found in a gazebo behind the stationary Farum Azula Dragon sitting at the back of the plaza southeast of the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. The dragon is constantly raining red lightning around the area.
Among the arches north of the gazebo lies a Golden Seed and a Smithing Stone [7].

Golden Seed: Flask Upgrade Material. Found under a Phantom Tree amongst several sets of pillar structures up on a hill in the plaza southeast from the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. Beware the Warhawks guarding the area.

Smithing Stone [7] E: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse near a Phantom Tree amongst several sets of pillar structures up on a hill in the plaza southeast from the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. Beware the Warhawks guarding the area.

title: Dragon Towershield
text: Descend the floating platforms below the cliff near the gazebo to reach a building, then pick up a Golden Rune [12] next to a ladder.

Golden Rune [12] H: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse inside a building far to the bottom of the plaza southeast from the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. This building can be reached by dropping down a series of cliffs east of the plaza.
Climb the ladder and open the chest near the balustrade to obtain the Dragon Towershield.

Dragon Towershield: Greatshield. Found in a chest in the terrace section of a building far to the bottom of the plaza southeast from the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. This building can be reached by dropping down a series of cliffs east of the plaza until you see the archway leading into the building. Follow the linear path from here to a lower balcony with a ladder. Climb up the ladder to the terrace and look to the east to find the chest by the railings.

title: Boltdrake Talisman +2
text: Take the lift up to reach a ladder past a Crucible Knight. Pick up the Boltdrake Talisman +2 from the edge of a window.

Boltdrake Talisman +2: Talisman. Found on a corpse hanging off an opening in a tall tower south of the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. Reaching this area is a bit complex: You will first need to head southeast to the large plaza guarded by a stationary Farum Azula Dragon which is constantly raining red lightning all around the area. From here, drop down a series of cliffs to the east to reach the opening at the bottom of a large building. Follow the linear path here to a balcony with a ladder leading up to a terrace. Directly in front of the ladder is a lift building. Take the lift up to a series of slopes leading to a hallway underneath the same bridge you crossed to get to the southeast plaza. Fight your way through the hallway to reach a ladder at the end. Climb up the ladder to reach the opening where the corpse holding the talisman can be found.

title: Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [5]
text: Return to where you fought the dragon, then follow the southwest path to a Somber Smithing Stone [7] hanging off a lower ledge on the right.

Somber Smithing Stone [7] A: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on a chunk of floating debris, on the eastern edge of the heavily-ruined section between the Tempest-Facing Balcony and the Dragon Temple .
Cross the fallen remains of a tower and enter the church to find the Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [5] in front of an altar.
Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [5]: Key Item. Found on a corpse sitting in front of an altar right at the entrance to the building with the Beside the Great Bridge site of grace.

title: Boss: Dragonlord Placidusax
text: Continue up the lift to grab the Beside the Great Bridge grace.

Head back down and descend the platforms below the cliff outside the church until you reach the bottom. Lie down in front of the tempest, then kill Dragonlord Placidusax for Remembrance of the Dragonlord and 280,000 runes. (This earns an achievement.)
Remembrance of the Dragonlord: Key Item. Dropped by Dragonlord Placidusax upon defeat.

Dragonlord Placidusax: Optional Boss found near the tempest. Drops the Remembrance of the Dragonlord upon defeat. To reach this boss: From the Beside the Great Bridge site of grace, take the lift back down and head back towards the entrance of the building. From the entrance, head for cliffs directly west and look down at the edge for a series of ledges you can drop down onto. Follow the floating platforms towards the tempest where you will find a large chunk of building debris with decorative frames containing skeletal remains. Look for the empty frame which will have a prompt for you to Lie Down . Doing so will teleport you to the boss' arena.

place.title: Crumbling Farum Azula
walk: ## Getting to Crumbling Farum Azula
## Crumbling Beast Grave

Backtrack to the room that had two Beastmen right after the site of grace, and go onto the balcony of this room. On the right side of the balcony, you can hop onto the roof and enter back into the building on a higher level. On the left side of the room are three Gravel Stones on an altar. You can find a Smithing Stone (6) on a corpse in the middle of the room, and in the far end you'll find a Great Grave Glovewort on an altar guarded by an Azula Beastman Mage flanked by two melee Beastmen. Head back into the hall and down the main stairs, where you'll find more Azula Beastmen and the Ancient Dragon Prayerbook. Immediately out the door to the northeast is the Temple-Facing Balcony Site of Grace and the Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing (4).

Facing the lift now, look to the left and a side path leading to a large circular platform with an item is visible. Jump from rock to rock avoiding the sloped rock on the right to get to the larger platform, but be aware that a Farum Azula Dragon will engage you after a brief delay. The corpse on the far edge holds a Smithing Stone (8), which can be grabbed quickly before the dragon attacks. Defeating the dragon only awards runes, so you may choose to fight it here or attempt to disengage. Follow the same path back, again avoiding the sloped rock that is now on the left, then take the lift back up and return to the Tempest-Facing Balcony Site of Grace through the doorway to the northeast.
## Dragon Temple

Head down the floating rocks and ruins west, where you'll get to a makeshift bridge occupied by Skeletons. The skeletons here in Crumbling Farum Azula look to have similar features and wield the same weapons as Azula Beastmen but have the same respawn mechanic as regular in-game skeletons. At the top of this first large chunk of ruin, you'll find a Golden Rune (9) on a corpse behind one of the pillars. Continue jumping across the floating ruins north, being sure to pick up the Somber Smithing Stone (7) and fourteen Golden Arrows, and jump into the hole in the corner of the next large chunk of ruin, right beside where you land.

Down the hole, to the southwest is a corpse with a Golden Rune (10). Head forwards to the northeast and before going through the first doorway to your left, go through the second one for an item protected by a Skeleton. At the end of the hallway through the first doorway, you'll emerge out onto a balcony. Turn left and you'll see you can jump up some ruins, but beware as the broken banister can trip you as you try to jump. Scale the ruins up, and then head up the ladder you find at the end. On the altar up ahead is another Great Grave Glovewort. Three skeletal beastmen spawn after you pick it up. When you're done dealing with them, head out of the room and look down to your left to find a safe path back down to the large chunk of ruin with the hole you went down earlier. Following the path, pick up three Gravel Stones and a Somber Smithing Stone (9) on the way, and you'll eventually find the Dragon Temple Site of Grace.

From this Site of Grace, turn around back towards the ruins you came from and look down. There are floating stair ruins that you can jump down. At the base of these stairs, turn back around again and jump down to the lowest platform here. On the left is a corpse with a Rune Arc on it. If you head into the building and turn right at the corner, you'll find the Azula Beastman Ashes right ahead on an altar, guarded by several Banished Knights. Look to the right of the altar with the ashes and pass through the doorway to find a corpse with a Somber Smithing Stone (9). Head back into the building and jump off onto the lower ruin to the east. Here, you'll find the Dragon Temple Transept Site of Grace. Don't head into the room to your left yet - that's a boss fight we'll come back to. After you're done with all that, teleport back to the Dragon Temple Site of Grace.
## Miniboss: Godskin Duo

After defeating them, you will be rewarded with 170,000 Runes, the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing (4), and the Ash of War: Black Flame Tornado. Interact with the Dragon Temple Altar Site of Site of Grace that spawns after their defeat and now we can move forward.
## Completing the dungeon

Continue ascending the floating rubble, and pick up the Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook (4) inside an enclosed area at the end. Two large undead beastmen are hiding here - one in the shadows around the outside of the tower, and one in pieces on the ground behind a block of rubble. They will attack you when you pick up the cookbook, so it is better to take out the one behind the tower first, then goad the second one into attacking before defeating it in single combat.

(Optional side path to Drake Knight Set): Go down the ladder to the south and immediately turn left to find a floating platform behind the corner, hop on it and then jump down to a circular lift area. Run around it to the other end to find Drake Knight Set in a chest. Then take the elevator up to encounter an Azula Beastman across the small bridge. Loot the Lightning Greatbolt here and safely drop back down to grace.

After going back to the ladder where you encountered two eagles, looking to the south, you'll see a hostile pale Dragon casting red lightning bolts all over the rooftops. Keep in mind that before hitting the ground, bright red flames mark the areas the lightning is about to strike. By staying away from these flames, you can avoid being hit by these attacks.

(Optional side path to Boltdrake Talisman +2 & Dragon Towershield): Left of the gazebo, in the eastward direction, if you look down, you'll see platforms down below. Keep dropping down and then drop down to another platform by the right side, next to the building. Drop below, left again to find a doorway. Enter it and to your left, you'll fight through a Banished Knight. Continue to find an Eagle and a ladder. Be careful as you ascend the ladder as there is another knight with a spear patrolling above and another soldier with two swords standing on the left. The Dragon Towershield can be found in the chest directly left from the ladder. Right across the ladder, there is an elevator. Take it up to find a path going west which takes you into the building right below the birds that you fought earlier on your way to the Dragon. Enter this set of ruins and you should encounter a Crucible Knight fighting Beastmen. If you are quick enough, you can run past them and take the ladder up at the end, otherwise, you can choose to defeat the Crucible Knight. After ascending the ladder, to your right, you can finally pick up Boltdrake Talisman +2 from the corpse. Drop down to find yourself back at the area with Eagles where the Dragon was using his lightning and make your way back to the Dragon's location where this side path started.

Once you've dealt with or escaped from the foes, move forward through the stairs located to the right of the chapel's altar. The path will take you to an elevator, after which, you'll reach the Beside the Great Bridge Site of Grace. Moving further up the stairs you will then reach the Great Bridge. You'll be situated now at the middle of the bridge, and facing the choice to either go right (South) or left (North). The Bossfight takes place at the coliseum-like structure located upwards, so if you want to enter the last stage of your journey at Crumbling Farum Azula you can head this way. Please note that there is also another optional boss fight (Dragonlord Placidusax) that can be accessed by going back down the elevator from Beside the Great Bridge Site of Grace. If you'd like to fight the boss now, click here. However, this section of the guide will first cover what lies at your left, that is, heading north.

Recusant Bernahl wields a Devourer's Scepter Warhammer and his fight style consists mostly of melee attacks. However, the skill on his weapon, Devourer of Worlds, allows him to charge it with magic and strike it against the ground to steal your HPs. Once defeated, Recusant Bernahl drops the entire Beast Champion Set as well as the Devourer's Scepter Warhammer and x1 Blasphemous Claw.

Once the area is cleared, you may loot the coffer inside the rounded tower. This chest contains the Old Lord's Talisman, which extends the duration of effects caused by sorceries and incantations. Now that this area has been exhausted, return to the Beside the Great Bridge Site of Grace to refill your health and flasks, and go back onto the Great Bridge and head for the boss fight.
Fighting this Sentinel is duly compensated as it rewards you with the Malformed Dragon Set. Head up towards the fog door, grabbing the Somber Smithing Stone (7) on the way.
## Beast Clergyman/Maliketh, the Black Blade

NOTE: Upon defeating the following boss, much of Leyndell, Royal Capital will become unavailable, as will many of the weapons, items, spells, and armor located there. Plan to collect any items you want from Leyndell before completing the fight, in particular the legendary armament the Bolt of Gransax.

Once you've reached the coliseum-shaped structure, you'll begin fighting Beast Clergyman. His attacks mainly consist of close-range swipes and various rock throws. Since his quicker and more deadly attacks are done in melee range, magic and ranged users will have an easier time dealing with him as they can fight back while keeping their distance. Melee users should look for opportunities where the Beast Clergyman is vulnerable before committing to any attacks. One such attack that is safer to punish is one of the rock throws where he plunges his knife into the ground. You can find more details and strategies on his boss page.

After taking the Beast Clergyman's HP to about half, it will reveal itself to be Maliketh, the Black Blade. Maliketh has a different skill set than the Beast Clergyman but has the same 'quick and hard to punish' characteristic. If you've finished Bernahl's questline and have defeated Recusant Bernahl, be sure to make use of the Blasphemous Claw that he drops. You can use the item to counter Maliketh's attacks that make his weapon briefly glow yellow. You can find more details and strategies on his boss page and the Blasphemous Claw page.

After you have defeated Maliketh, you will be teleported to the Leyndell, Capital of Ash Site of Grace. After activating that grace you can teleport back to Beside the Great Bridge Site of Grace and return to the boss fight arena to touch Maliketh, the Black Blade Site of Grace if you wish to do so. However, the main point of focus here is to go to the optional boss fight.
## Dragonlord Placidusax
Upon defeat, this boss drops 280,000 Runes and the Remembrance of the Dragonlord. Interact with the Dragonlord Placidusax Site of Grace that spawns here, and you're done with the area.

If you have Miquella's Needle and have come into contact with the Three Fingers, you can use the Needle while in the arena to cure yourself of the Fingers' influence. You do not need to defeat Placidusax; you just need to be in its arena to do this.
