text: Upon defeat, this boss drops 280,000 Runes and the Remembrance of the Dragonlord. Interact with the Dragonlord Placidusax Site of Grace that spawns here, and you're done with the area.

If you have Miquella's Needle and have come into contact with the Three Fingers, you can use the Needle while in the arena to cure yourself of the Fingers' influence. You do not need to defeat Placidusax; you just need to be in its arena to do this.

title: Devourer's Scepter, Beast Champion Set
text: Activate the Dragonlord Placidusax grace after the fight.
Return to Beside the Great Bridge and cross the north side of the bridge to reach a Somber Smithing Stone [8] on a balcony.

Somber Smithing Stone [8] B: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on a balcony south of the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. To reach this balcony, you will need to head north from the Great Bridge , through the archway and exit to the balcony on the right.
Bernahl invades you on the bridge below the ladder. Kill him for Blasphemous Claw, Devourer's Scepter, and the Beast Champion Set. (This earns an achievement.)
Blasphemous Claw: Reusable Tool. Dropped by the invader Recusant Bernahl upon defeat.
Devourer's Scepter: Great Hammer. Dropped by the invader Recusant Bernahl upon defeat.

Beast Champion Set: Armor Set comprised of the Beast Champion Helm , Beast Champion Armor (Altered) , Beast Champion Gauntlets and Beast Champion Greaves . Reusable Tool. Dropped by the invader Recusant Bernahl upon defeat.
miss: Unlocks the Legendary Armaments achievement if this is the last weapon you need. Make sure to pick up the Bolt of Gransax before you kill Maliketh or this achievement becomes unobtainable.

title: Old Lord's Talisman
text: Loot the chest at the end of the bridge to obtain the Old Lord's Talisman.

Old Lord's Talisman: Talisman. Found in a chest inside a rotunda on the east edge of the Dragon Temple Rooftop area. This area is accessed by heading north from the Great Bridge and entering the building there. Exit onto the balcony on the right and take the ladder nearby down to the walkway leading to the rotunda. Beware as the chest is surrounded by Beastmen and, if you've killed Rykard in the Volcano Manor , you will be invaded by Recusant Bernahl on the walkway.

title: Invader: Recusant Bernahl
text: Recusant Bernahl: If you've killed Rykard in the Volcano Manor , you will be invaded by Recusant Bernahl on the walkway leading to the rotunda with a chest containing the . This area is accessed by heading north from the Great Bridge and entering the building there. Exit onto the balcony on the right and take the ladder nearby down to the walkway leading to the rotunda. Berhnal drops the following items upon defeat: Bernahl's Bell Bearing Beast Champion Set Blasphemous Claw Devourer's Scepter

title: Boss: Draconic Tree Sentinel
text: Return to Beside the Great Bridge and kill the Draconic Tree Sentinel on the bridge to obtain the Malformed Dragon Set.

Malformed Dragon Set: Armor Set comprised of the Malformed Dragon Helm , Malformed Dragon Armor , Malformed Dragon Gauntlets and the Malformed Dragon Greaves . Dropped by the Draconic Tree Sentinel at the end of the Great Bridge , guarding the final area of Crumbling Farum Azula .

Draconic Tree Sentinel: Non-Boss variant of the Draconic Tree Sentinel found at the end of the Great Bridge , guarding the final area of Crumbling Farum Azula . Drops the Malformed Dragon Set upon defeat.
Pick up the Golden Rune [12] and Somber Smithing Stone [7] on the bridge.
Kill Maliketh, the Black Blade for Remembrance of the Black Blade and 220,000 runes. (This earns an achievement.)

Note: This is the game's biggest point of no return. Killing Maliketh will cover the entire capital in ash, locking you out of several quests and items. Make sure you've at least completed the missable steps in Capital Outskirts, Leyndell, and Forbidden Lands before proceeding.
After the cutscene, grab the Leyndell, Capital of Ash grace just ahead.
Optional: Talk to Hewg about himself.
Optional: Talk to Roderika about what's happened to Hewg, then exhaust her dialogue option.

title: Boss: Beast Clergyman / Maliketh, The Black Blade
text: Beast Clergyman / Maliketh, The Black Blade: This Bossfight constitutes the final stage of the Crumbling Farum Azula zone. The fight starts against Beast Clergyman but it is revealed mid-fight whis was Maliketh, The Black Blade .
Remembrance of the Black Blade: Key Item. Dropped by Maliketh, the Black Blade upon defeat.

title: Erdtree's Favor +2, Boss: Ulcerated Tree Spirit
text: Optional: After Leyndell changes, several sites of grace become unavailable. However, the following can be reactivated:
The East Capital Rampart grace can be found again in Boc's room.
The Divine Bridge grace can be reached via the trap chest at the Tower of Return in Weeping Peninsula.
Enter the capital from the Forbidden Lands grace and pick up Erdtree's Favor +2 from a root in the ash-covered area with three Ulcerated Tree Spirits. (This earns an achievement.)

Erdtree's Favor +2: Upgraded Talisman . This Talisman may only be accessed near endgame/post-game. Found on top of a branch jutting out of the ground in a large courtyard, guarded by three Ulcerated Tree Spirits .
Ulcerated Tree Spirit: 3 Ulcerated Tree Spirits can be found romaing around this deserted sand area, it's convinient to try to encouter them one at a time.

title: Crimson Amber Medallion +2
text: Return to Leyndell, Capital of Ash and head south-southwest to find a manhole. Drop through it to land on a rafter with the Crimson Amber Medallion +2.
Crimson Amber Medallion +2: By falling down the sewers gate, on the beam below, just before fully entering the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds

title: Crimson Amber Medallion
text: Return to Leyndell, Capital of Ash and head south-southwest to find a manhole. Drop through it to land on a rafter with the Crimson Amber Medallion +2.
Crimson Amber Medallion: Crimson Amber Medallion +2 . Held by a corpse hanging over one of the wooden beams on your way down.

title: Goldmask's Set, Mending Rune of Perfect Order
text: Head back to the manhole and pick up the Tarnished Golden Sunflower through the doorway on the right.
Climb the ladder in the wall below Gransax to reach the West Capital Rampart. In front of Fortified Manor lies a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone: From the main Leyndell, Capital of Ash Site of Grace , go west, along the dragon. Enter the building past it and climb the ladder. Over the railing to the right is an enemy gargoyle, guarding a corpse with the stone.
Return to the grace and head straight south to find a Rune Arc.
Continue past the giant spear to find a Golden Sunflower at the base of a statue's spear.
Golden Sunflower: Held by a burnt corpse laying against one of the ruined buildings.

Next to the staircase farther south, a narrow path leads to a bridge. Cross it to find Goldmask's corpse holding the Mending Rune of Perfect Order. Reload the area and pick up Goldmask's Set from the corpse.

Goldmask's Set: After the completion of Brother Corhyn 's questline. Head south from the Capital of Ash site of grace and go down the small path in the direction of the colosseum. Go past the plant enemies and stick to the left and you will find Goldmask. Look the rune from him, and reset the area and return to find the rest of his set on his body.
miss: Goldmask disappears from the game if you burn the Erdtree at the Forge of the Giants before telling him that Radagon is Marika.

title: Corhyn's Robe
text: Head back to find Corhyn at the base of the giant spear. After talking to him, reload the area to pick up Corhyn's Bell Bearing, Flail, and Corhyn's Robe.

title: Boss: Sir Gideon Ofnir, The All-Knowing
text: Note: If you gave him the Tonic of Forgetfulness, he'll be on the bridge in Mountaintops of the Giants instead.
On one of the rooftops southeast of the giant spear sits a corpse with a Hero's Rune [4].
Go up the staircase and kill Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing for Scepter of the All-Knowing, All-Knowing Set, and 150,000 runes.

Sir Gideon Ofnir, The All-Knowing: Great Enemy Boss Sir Gideon Ofnir, The All-Knowing Bossfight takes place at the Erdtree Sanctuary building . Once leader of Roundtable Hold , Sir Gideon Ofnir masters a wide range of powerful sorceries and incantations.

All-Knowing Set: Dropped together with Scepter of the All-Knowing upon defeating Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing in Leyndell, Ashen Capital . Comprised of: All-Knowing Helm All-Knowing Armor All-Knowing Gauntlets All-Knowing Greaves
Scepter of the All-Knowing: Dropped together with the All-Knowing Set upon defeating Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing in Leyndell, Ashen Capital .

place.title: Leyndell, Ashen Capital
walk: To get to the Ashen Capital, defeat Maliketh, the Black Blade at Crumbling Farum Azula, and after a cutscene plays, you'll get teleported right to the Leyndell, Capital of Ash Site of Grace. Most of the progression in the Ashen Capital involves beating various Bosses, and after defeating the final boss of this area, you can reach the ending of the game. Leyndell, Ashen Capital replaces Leyndell, Royal Capital, and so you will lose access to all enemies and unclaimed treasure from that area before you begin the endgame.
## Exploring Ashen Leyndell

Take your first steps in the area by traveling southwest towards the dragon corpse, and follow the mounds of ash downhill. At the bottom you can find an open sewer hole that leads down to the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds. If you jump down from here, you can access a wooden beam with a corpse holding the Crimson Amber Medallion +2 hanging off of it. From this sewer hole, the open gate to your right contains a corpse with a Tarnished Golden Sunflower. Continue southwest from the hole, going back uphill and navigating to the base of the giant spear and you can find Brother Corhyn at its base, rambling about Goldmask. You must be at the end of the Goldmask questline to find him here, but if you offered him the Tonic of Forgetfulness at the Stargazer Ruins, Corhyn will be there instead.

From Corhyn's location, head directly south and jump over the buried balcony. You'll come across a curved set of stairs; don't ascend them, but look to the right and follow the ash downhill. Cross the bridge, picking up a Smithing Stone (6), head up the stairs to your left, and you'll find Goldmask at the base of the cliff. You can get the Mending Rune of Perfect Order from him. Reload the area. Where Corhyn once was, you can get a Flail, Corhyn's Bell Bearing, and Corhyn's Robe. Where Goldmask once was, you can get Goldmask's Set (sans mask).

From the open sewer hole, look northwest, then travel past the rubble until you can climb onto the dragon corpse's wing. Instead of needing to climb up the wing like before, you can go under the wing and then jump straight into the broken wall. Climb up the ladder and follow the path southeast until you come to the golden tree and can see a drop with a staircase going down in the opposite direction. Descend these stairs northward. Look to your left, and you can find a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone at the doors to where the Fortified Manor used to be. Beware the Valiant Gargoyle patrolling this area.

You can also enter the Ashen Capital from the Forbidden Lands. Go back up the elevator, travel west along the path, and fight through the Knights and Soldiers as usual. Descend the elevator to reach an otherwise inaccessible part of the Ashen Capital. The pond in this area can now be traversed over, because it is completely filled with ash. Walk down the stairs, then hug the left wall to not draw the attention of the Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirits that patrol the area, and emerge from the ground. You'll find an item on a half-buried piece of rubble, which is the legendary talisman Erdtree's Favor +2.

You can also re-discover the Divine Bridge site of grace by opening the teleporter trap chest at the top of the Tower of Return. The Divine Bridge Golem will respawn even if it was already killed, but will not drop any new items. Access to the Fortified Manor is not possible, as the lift will be at the bottom of its shaft and the lever to raise it will become non-interactable. Access to the Isolated Divine Tower remains open via the sending gate southeast of the Golem.

You can also re-discover the East Capital Rampart site of grace by starting at Capital Rampart and taking the linear path into the Ashen Capital. Boc the Seamster will be there if you're properly progressed his quest.
## The Endgame

To head forward and progress the plot, head directly south from the Site of Grace until you reach the walls of the buildings. Follow them around, jumping over the buried pieces of the Erdtree branches, until you reach a curved staircase that isn't covered in ash. Climb the stairs and ride the lift up, entering the Erdtree Sanctuary again. Here, you'll find Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing, who is adamant about stopping you from becoming Elden Lord. Defeat him and you'll be rewarded with the All-Knowing Set and the Scepter of All-Knowing.

Interact with the Erdtree Sanctuary Site of Grace that spawns after Gideon's defeat, and head east onto the balcony. Turn left and scale the tree root here, up and to the west. When you get up to another balcony, you'll see an item on a hanging chair to your south, if you haven't already gotten it from Leyndell, Royal Capital. Head outside, and instead of following the path, immediately turn left. Jump down onto the roof around the corner and head into the open window. Run across the large tree root here to be able to grab the Golden Order Principia, then head back down to that balcony where you first saw the item. This time, follow the path north and you'll get to the Queen's Bedchambers. In this room, you may have collected the Blessing of the Erdtree spell in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Here, in the Ashen Capital, you'll find the Erdtree Heal incantation in its place instead.

Continue out the door east and up the stairs, and you'll encounter a fog door. Beyond this door is Godfrey, First Elden Lord, in his physical form rather than the golden spectral form you encountered earlier in the game. Two possible NPC Summons are available for this fight: Nepheli Loux is available if she's been crowned ruler of Limgrave at the end of her questline, and Shabriri can be summoned if you've met the Three Fingers. After reducing Godfrey to about 50% health, he turns into Hoarah Loux, Warrior, and defeating him nets you the Remembrance of Hoarah Loux.

Interact with the Elden Throne Site of Grace that spawned, and head up the stairs to the southeast. Touching the golden light at the top teleports you to the final two bosses of the game, the first of which is Radagon of the Golden Order. Defeat him, and the next phase against the Elden Beast starts immediately after the transitional cutscene. Defeat them both to be rewarded the Elden Remembrance. After the dust has settled, activate the Fractured Marika Site of Grace so that you can return later.

Provided Ranni's quest line has been completed, after defeating the Elden Beast, a blue summon sign will appear on the ground near Marika's broken remains. The player can interact with this summon sign (instead of interacting with Marika's remains) to acquire the "Age of the Stars" ending. Doing so will also unlock a related game achievement/trophy. Otherwise, interact with the fractured remains of Marika to commence other possible endings. If the player has been branded by Three Fingers, no endings other than Lord of Frenzied Flame will be possible unless the player has permanently removed the frenzy by using the Miquella's Needle while standing in the boss arena of Dragonlord Placidusax. (See Endings page for more information)

After the credits roll, you have the option to immediately begin New Game Plus. You can decline this and the game will place you in the Roundtable Hold, where you can proceed to explore the rest of the world, and initiate your next Journey at will.
notes: You will not be able to access Leyndell, Royal Capital until NG+ after getting to this point. In order to be summoned into Leyndell, Royal Capital after your own world is made ashen, you need to put your sign down by the Capital Rampart grace in the hallway before the elevator. In order to summon for Morgott the Omen King the summoned person must use their Small Golden Effigy and they must have interacted with the effigy near Morgott's fog wall before the capital was made ashen.

You lose access to everything that would have been obtained in Leyndell, with exception to the items you can find around the Erdtree Sanctuary building. You can still obtain the Golden Order Principia, Erdtree Bow, and the Celestial Dew, if you haven't already gotten them. The Subterranean Shunning-Grounds, and everything below it, remains unchanged.
You lose access to the legendary weapon Bolt of Gransax. If it is not collected you will lose the opportunity to get the Legendary Armaments achievement for this playthrough.
You can no longer obtain the Duelist Set and Guardian Garb (Full Bloom) since the Duelists and Full Bloom Guardians no longer appear in the Ashen Capital.
All Sites of Grace disappear from the Capital, as it is replaced with a new area.

Gideon Ofnir leaves the Roundtable Hold. Any unclaimed rewards that you would have gotten from speaking to him after discovering Mohgwyn Palace and Miquella's Haligtree, or from defeating Mohgwyn, Lord of Blood and Malenia, Blade of Miquella, can be purchased at the Twin Maiden Husks in the Roundtable Hold.
The sending gate in the Deeproot Depths that would normally transport you to the entrance to Leyndell becomes inactive.

If you need to access the Isolated Divine Tower, the transporter trap at the Tower of Return will warp you to the Divine Bridge Site of Grace that gives you access to the sending gate. You cannot descend to the Fortified Manor from here, as the lever to call the lift becomes inactive.
The Capital Outskirts and everything beyond will not change. You can enter Leyndell, Ashen Capital from the Capital Rampart Site of Grace.
Boc the Seamster will remain in his usual spot, provided his quest has progressed correctly. If he is not there, try reloading the area.

title: Boss: Valiant Gargoyle
text: Valiant Gargoyle: Endgame Boss . Leyndell, Royal Capital .

title: Talk to Brother Corhyn
text: Brother Corhyn: At the end of his Questline , Brother Corhyn is found on his knees in sorrow, near the base of the giant spiral spear. After reloading the area, you can find Corhyn's Bell Bearing and Corhyn's Robe where he was sitting.

title: Erdtree Heal
text: Reactivate the Erdtree Sanctuary grace after the fight.
Continue toward the throne to reactivate the Queen's Bedchamber grace and grab the Erdtree Heal on the bed.
Erdtree Heal: Found on the large covered furniture within Queen's Bedchamber , next to the Site of Grace .

title: Boss: Godfrey, First Elden Lord
text: Kill Godfrey, First Elden Lord for Remembrance of Hoarah Loux and 300,000 runes. (This earns an achievement.)
Remembrance of Hoarah Loux: Dropped by Godfrey, First Elden Lord ( Hoarah Loux, Warrior ) when defeated.

Godfrey, First Elden Lord: Legend Type Boss Located in the chamber atop the long set of stairs southeast of the Queen's Bedchamber Site of Grace where Morgott was previously fought. Mid-battle, Godfrey assumes the role of Hoarah Loux, Warrior .

title: Boss: Radagon of the Golden Order
text: Optional: Nepheli can be summoned if you completed her questline.
Optional: Shabriri can be summoned if you bear the frenzied flame.
Reactivate the Elden Throne grace and prepare to fight the final boss.
When you're ready, enter the Erdtree to kill Radagon of the Golden Order and Elden Beast for Elden Remembrance and 500,000 runes.
Radagon of the Golden Order: God Type Boss Final Boss . Once Radagon of the Golden Order is defeated, Elden Beast , the true form of the Elden Ring , must be fought.
Elden Remembrance: Dropped by the Elden Beast upon defeat.
After beating the final boss, turn around to activate the Fractured Marika grace.

title: Frenzied Flame Seal
text: You'll have a few options to finish the game:
Ending 1: Touch the fractured Marika and select one of the four options: (This earns an achievement.)
A: Mend the Elden Ring to achieve the Age of Fracture ending.
B: Use Mending Rune of Perfect Order to achieve the Age of Order ending.
C: Use Mending Rune of the Death-Prince to achieve the Age of the Duskborn ending.
D: Use Mending Rune of the Fell Curse to achieve the Blessing of Despair ending.
Ending 2: Summon Ranni to achieve the Age of the Stars ending. (This earns an achievement.)
Ending 3: Touch the fractured Marika while bearing the frenzied flame to achieve the Lord of Frenzied Flame ending. (This earns an achievement.)
To get all three endings in one playthrough, it's required to make backups of your save file:

Note: Look up how to create backups on your specific platform, as blindly messing with save files can result in losing all your progress. If you don't have Miquella's Needle, you must pick the Lord of Frenzied Flame ending last. Otherwise, it will lock the other endings. This means you'll have to grab the other endings first using backups in between before finishing Hyetta's questline. The following steps assume that you pick the Frenzied Flame ending first and tame it afterward.
Optional: Talk to Hyetta at the Frenzied Flame Proscription.
Unequip your armor, then open the charred door to inherit the frenzied flame.
Touch Hyetta with the flame and exhaust her dialogue until she catches fire, dropping the Frenzied Flame Seal and Frenzyflame Stone x5.

Frenzied Flame Seal: Weapon. Reward from completing Hyetta's Questline. Hyetta can be finally found at Frenzied Flame Proscription, Leyndell, Royal Capital. Upon accepting the Three Fingers flame, return to Hyetta and talk to her once more. Exhaust her dialogue, and she will give you the Frenzied Flame Seal, completing her questline.
Before choosing an ending, quit the game and make a copy of your save file.
With your copied file ready, touch the fractured Marika to become the Lord of Frenzied Flame.
Replace your save file with the copied one, then use Miquella's Needle (Inventory -> Tools) in Dragonlord Placidusax's arena to tame the flame of frenzy.
Make a new copy of the save file, then go with either of the two remaining endings.
Replace your save with the new copy and complete the game with the last ending. (This earns an achievement.)
Choose NO when asked to begin the next journey. This lets you finish any remaining content before NG+.
Congratulations, you've completed the game! Now go do the DLC or prepare for NG+.

title: Warrior Jar Shard
text: After selecting an ending, it's safe to finish Hyetta's questline for the Frenzied Flame Seal.
Complete any unfinished steps in the Walkthrough and DLC Walkthrough.
Decide who to give Seluvis's Potion to in NG+.
Decide whether to kill Alexander in NG+ for the Warrior Jar Shard.

region: New Game Plus Preparation · meeting 5 of 5
title: Talk to Hyetta
text: Hyetta: NPC. Hyetta will move to this location if her questline has been followed.

title: Boss: Patches
text: Note: You can kill him at any point during his questline, as long as you do it before triggering his duel when talking to him twice in Farum Azula.
Decide whether to assist or challenge Sellen in NG+.
Decide whether to assist or challenge Millicent in NG+.
Decide whether to assist Hornsent or assist Leda against both Hornsent and Ansbach in NG+.SOTE
Decide whether to use Thiollier's Concoction on Florissax in NG+.SOTE
Decide whether to use an Iris of Grace or Occultation on Queelign in NG+.SOTE
Decide whether to use an Iris of Grace or Occultation on Jolan in NG+.SOTE
Decide whether to combine Jolan's Spirit Ash with Anna or keep them separate. Your choice becomes permanent once you start NG+, and you'll need a new Jolan to combine them again.SOTE
Decide whether to keep the Stone-Sheathed Sword or transform it into the Sword of Light or Darkness. Your choice becomes permanent once you start NG+, as you'll simply find a new one.SOTE
Optional: Respec if you want to change or optimize your build before Rennala has to be defeated again.
Optional: Farm runes to finalize your build or to afford stocking up on items.
Buy anything you want from Patches, then kill him for the Leather Set.
Leather Set: Dropped by Patches if the player decides to defeat him.
Patches: Found within Murkwater Cave . After defeating him, he sets up a shop in the Cave.
Use the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate your remembrances (old ones cannot be duplicated in NG+).
Exchange your remembrances for any Boss Equipment, or use them for extra runes.
Note: Remembrance items can only be obtained once per playthrough. For example, if you want two Marika's Hammers, you'll need to get the first one now and the second in NG+.
Buy any remaining Boss Armor from Enia before her inventory resets.
Give Miriel all scrolls and prayerbooks, then buy any remaining Spells before his inventory resets.
Buy any remaining Dragon Communion Incantations from the Cathedral (and Grand Altar in the DLC).
Offer your Bell Bearings to the Twin Maiden Husks. Their unlocked items carry over if turned in.
Stock up on items from the Twin Maiden Husks' NPC-specific inventories, as those don't carry over.
Buy any items you need from all other Merchants.
Confirm that you have 14 Flasks of Crimson/Cerulean Tears, upgraded to max level (+12).
If not, collect the required Sacred Tears and Golden Seeds.
Optional: Collect items with limited availability each playthrough:
Collect all Ancient Dragon Smithing Stones.
Collect all Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stones.
Collect all Great Grave Gloveworts.
Collect all Great Ghost Gloveworts.
Collect all Lost Ashes of War.
Collect all Celestial Dews.
Collect all Larval Tears.
Collect all non-respawning crafting materials. [See playlist]
Over the course of three playthroughs, also complete the following sheets to achieve true 100%:
Complete the Achievements sheet.
Complete the Weapons sheet.
Complete the Armor sheet.
Complete the Ashes sheet.
Complete the Spells sheet.
Complete the Talismans sheet.
Complete the Miscellaneous Items sheet.
Complete the New Game Plus sheet.
Optional: Place any map markers you want to carry over into NG+ (105 total).
When you're done preparing, rest at the Table of Lost Grace and begin the next journey. To reset your Walkthrough progress, go to the Settings page and use the NG+ button.

place.title: Murkwater Cave
walk: It is recommended to use a Torch to be able to see. Keep moving, until you reach the first room, in which you will find two people. One is running around, while the second one is sitting on the other corner of the room. There are two traps near the entrance of the room and a third one in its centre : walking through them will ring the alarm and more enemies will come. Deal with the two enemies.

Two more enemies will come from the corridor as soon as you approach it, be ready to dodge. There are three more enemies sitting in the next room. If you are playing a caster, opening with Glintstone Arc is a good idea to strike first and deal massive damage to all. You will find some Cave Moss in the room. Open the chest too loot x5 Mushroom.

Return to the first room and head the other way to find a fog gate Boss room. Traverse it once ready. As you enter, you will notice that there is no boss. Head to the chest and open it. You will hear a voice, unhappy by your actions and demanding revenge. Patches, a veteran FromSoftware character, makes his grandiose entrance. He will then first initiate a boss fight with you. You will eventually be prompted to forgive him during combat.

Once his health reaches about, he will surrender. The sequence won't stop until you cease attacking him. At this point he will be cowering behind his shield and cease his attacks. Do not kill him, and wait for the 'Enemy Felled' notice. You will still receive Golden Rune (1) and the Grovel for Mercy Gesture. Forgive him to return to him here and interact with him again as a merchant. He may be found at another location and his new coordinates are found here: Elden Ring Map

Loot the chest in the room if you haven't already- to obtain Cloth Garb and Cloth Trousers. Opening the other chest in the room will have you ensnared in a transporter trap that sends you to Mistwood surrounded by Lesser Runebears, near Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook[4]. Map Link.
Come back to engage in combat again and during the fight he may drop another Gesture, Extreme Repentance. If you choose to kill him off and he will drop:
Patches' Bell Bearing
Spear +7
Leather Armor
Leather Gloves
Leather Boots

title: Map: Gravesite Plain
text: Note: To access the DLC, you need to have killed both Starscourge Radahn and Mohg, Lord of Blood.
Optional: Talk to Leda at the Cocoon of the Empyrean.
Touch Miquella's withered arm to enter the realm of shadow. The Gravesite Plain grace lies just outside the cave where you spawn.
From the grace, head northeast to a stele with Map: Gravesite Plain by the road.
Map: Gravesite Plain: To find this Map Fragment, travel directly northeast from when you first entered the Shadow Realm.

title: Talk to Ghost
text: Ghost: Just south of the Scorched Ruins, before the pillar that contains the zone map.

title: Hefty Cracked Pot
text: Just north of the stele lies the Scorched Ruins:
Pick up a Hefty Cracked Pot from the lower east side of the ruins.

Hefty Cracked Pot: Special Tool Key Item. From the location of the Ghost NPC, south of the Scorched Ruins. Head north and take the first right to the higher ground. Alongside a group of Shadows, you will find a body containing this item.

guide.title: To Scorched Ruins and Defeating a Side Boss
text: When you're done here, continue exploring Gravesite Plain by sticking to the edge on your right while facing north. You will come across a small gravesite west of the previous small altar. Make sure to eliminate the glimmering Shadowpot. This enemy will drop a Scadutree Fragment and other crafting materials. You can pick up a Spiritgrave Stone from one of the stone heads and x3 Black Pyrefly on the ground.

After that, head west to reach the Scorched Ruins. This is a small area where you can fight some enemies and pick up important items and the first thing you will do is to activate the Site of Grace found north of the building. If you have been following this Walkthrough, make sure to take the time to use the collected Revered Spirit Ash and Scadutree Fragment on the Site of Grace you have collected so far.

From the Scorched Ruins - Site of Grace, walk under the building and go over to the other side. Turn around and climb the stairs to your left, and take the Hefty Cracked Pot from the corpse. This is a material that can be used for crafting cracked pot items. You can also loot other crafting items on the ground here. From here, go to your right and take the stairs to your left. Then, pick up the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [1] from a corpse on the stairs here. Next, go inside the broken building and look for the corpse hidden within jars. Destroy the jars here and pick up the Shadow Realm Rune. Go up the stairs and walk towards the enemies attacking you from the opposite building. Cross the roof to the other side and pick up Black Pyrefly behind this room. Then, go back to the front of this room and open the door to reveal a chest containing the Blade of Mercy. After that, walk directly in front of this room and drop down to the balcony below it. Jump to the next platform and pick up the Bone Dart from a corpse.

The next location is an optional boss you can defeat for a reward. Head west where you will see white trees in the distance and as you get near a tall gravestone, 2 Gravebirds will swoop down to attack you. These enemies have a chance of dropping Smithing Stones so make sure to defeat them when you see one. Continue traveling west and go past the glowing worm-like creatures. These are not hostile unless you start attacking them. Continue riding Torrent until you reach the Western Nameless Mausoleum. You can go inside this building to defeat the Blackgaol Knight and earn the Greatsword of Solitude and Solitude Set as a reward.

After fighting the Blackgaol Knight, return to Scorched Ruins - Site of Grace and then continue exploring the northeastern side while scaling the edge of the plain. Keep an eye out for a cave here with a glowing light. Go inside it and interact with The Sacred Tower Painting. See the location on Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Map.

As you head back outside, you will come across Inquisitor enemies who use Fire and Magic. Go toward the small altar with 4 pillars located behind this pack of enemies to pick up the Backhand Blade. Continue heading east toward the cliff and take the Grave Glovewort from the corpse on the stone. You might come across a Gravebird here once again.

Back to the dirt path along Scorched Ruins, you will see a tall flaming enemy. This is the Furnace Golem, an elite enemy that drops runes, Deflecting Hardtear, and Furnace Visage upon death. You will also see more of this enemy in other locations, but each of them has a unique tear drop. This enemy will also start throwing projectiles at you if you get too close. The Furnace Golem can be tough to beat because of the wide AoE attacks that it can do. It will take some time to get used to, but the movement is slow and can be dodged by timing it with a jump before its foot hits the ground. If you're having a hard time, you can ride Torrent while fighting this boss and then focus on attacking the legs. You can take advantage of Torrent's double jump so you can have more airtime.

title: Greater Potentate's Cookbook [1]
text: Continue up the east side to find the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [1] on a broken staircase.
Greater Potentate's Cookbook [1]: From the Hefty Cracked Pot, just head right until a set of stairs is on your left. Take them and continue forward to find the cookbook.

place.title: Scorched Ruins
walk: The Scorched Ruins is a location that can be found north of the Gravesite Plain, along the main road. Before reaching the entrance, you can find a monolith that has the map fragment of the Gravesite Plain region. Make sure to check that out to acquire the Map: Gravesite Plain See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. As you follow the main road and approach remnants of the main entrance, you'll encounter Shadow Undead enemies that are hostile.

Walk to the right to find a corpse that you can loot to acquire x1 Hefty Cracked Pot. Investigate the right side of the ruins to find some steps, go up and you'll see another corpse sitting by the crumbling steps of a building. Loot the body to find x1 Greater Potentate's Cookbook (1), See Shadow of the Erdtree Map.

Now check the left side of the ruins and be ready to dodge or block an ambush attack from a Hound Spirit. The enemy will attack you as you approach the steps. Check the backside and you should see some stairs and some vases and pots on the right. Behind the vases and pots, there is a body sitting against the wall that can be looted to acquire x1 Shadow Realm Rune (2), See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. Walk up the stairs, and at the top, you'll see a building on the left that has an opening. Inside the building, a Shadow Undead will throw rocks at you, quickly run towards the opening, and kill the enemies.

Turn around, and look to the left, and you'll spot another body lying on a roof. Investigate the body to loot x2 Furlcalling Finger Remedy. Go back to the opening, walk up the stairs, and exit to a balcony. Turn right, jump across to land on the roof that is covered in a cloth-like material, and walk straight to reach a small room that has a treasure chest. Open the chest to find the Blade of Mercy talisman. Also, you can check behind to find some Black Pyrefly.

title: Furlcalling Finger Remedy
text: On a higher up ledge next to the staircase sits a corpse with Redflesh Mushroom x5.
From the ledge, jump onto the west balcony, then toward the covered bridge connecting both sides of the ruins to reach a corpse with Black Pyrefly x3.
Black Pyrefly: Left side of the big arch, in the hallway past the shadow soldiers.
On the lower west side of the ruins, behind some breakable jars, lies a Shadow Realm Rune [2].
Shadow Realm Rune [2]: Before the stairs, between the jars there is a body that contains this item.
Go up the stairs near the jars and pick up Furlcalling Finger Remedy x2 from the roof around the right corner.

Furlcalling Finger Remedy: Multiplayer Item. Two can be looted here. Take the stairs up, and once you are outside again, turn back and on the rooftop of the building you just came for a dead body contains this item. Beware of the ranged shadow enemies on the other building.

title: Blade of Mercy
text: Head across the covered bridge and grab the Blade of Mercy from the tower at the end.

Blade of Mercy: Once you head up on the left side of the building, cross to the other side using the cloth-like material as a bridge, and enter the door on the left. Open the chest inside to find the item.

title: Talk to Ghost
text: Ghost: East of the Scorched Ruins site of grace.

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Grab the Scorched Ruins grace just north past the ruins and pass time until nightfall.
Kill the pot-carrying Shadow Commoner in the graveyard to the east of the grace for a Scadutree Fragment and Silver Horn Tender (first time).
Scadutree Fragment: From the Shadow Keep, Back Gate Site of Grace, enter the room to your right to find x1 Scadutree Fragment that can be looted on the ground, by the foot of the statue of Marika.

title: Revered Spirit Ash
text: Pick up Black Pyrefly x3 from the corpse in the graveyard.
Follow the cliff near the graveyeard southeast to reach a statue holding a Revered Spirit Ash.
Revered Spirit Ash: On a small altar. North-east of the Gravesite plain site of grace. Past the white tree filled with hanging bodies.

guide.title: Church of Consolation: First Scadutree Fragment
text: The church is located at the edge of the map and inside, an elite enemy is patrolling the aisle. It's up to you if you want to kill it or you can go around the church, stay crouched, and sneak behind the altar to pick up x2 Scadutree Fragment. However, if you opt to defeat the Black Knight, you can obtain Black Steel Greathammer, Black Knight Helm, and Smithing Stone [6] as a reward. Then, you can pick up x2 Scadutree Fragment in front of the statue. This is an important item exclusive to the Shadow of the Erdtree that boosts your damage inflicted on enemies while boosting your damage reduction. You can use this to level up your Scadutree Blessing while resting on a Site of Grace.

Outside the church, there's a small camp of Messmer Soldiers to the east. You can eliminate these soldiers for a chance to loot a piece of their armor and then pick up x2 Fire Coil from a corpse inside the round tent. On your way back, travel to the edge of the plain, on the west side. You will find a Lump of Flesh on a corpse behind one of the stone heads.

Return to the dirt path and go towards the white tree with hanged bodies to the northeast. Continue riding Torrent and proceed to the eastern cliff where you see the waterfall. This is the other side of a ravine separating the Church of Consolation from the plains. Walk up to the small altar and pick up the Revered Spirit Ash. This is also a new item that lets you boost Spirit Ashes beyond +10 and increase the durability and damage dealt by Torrent within the realm of shadow.

title: Larval Tear
text: Continue along the cliff edge to find a Larval Tear surrounded by blue spiritgraves (that only appear at night).
Larval Tear: Can be found southeast of Scorched Ruins. This can only be found at night as it's surrounded by glowing gravestones.

guide.title: Gravesite Plain (Central)
text: Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree - Navigating Gravesite Plain (Central)
Get the Map for Gravesite Plain
Visit Church of Consolation
Fight Logur, the Beast Claw who drops the Beast Claw (Southeast of the first Site of Grace)
New Items for Level Scaling Mechanic: Get Scadutree Fragment and Revered Spirit Ash
Scorched Ruins: Pick up the Larval Tear in the illuminated gravesite (nighttime only)
Defeat Side Boss: Blackgaol Knight in Western Nameless Mausoleum
Get the Sacred Tower Painting
Defeat the Furnace Golem
Meeting Allies in Realm of Shadow: Go to Three-Path Cross Site of Grace
Optional: Discover Abandoned Ailing Village and defeat the field boss: Ghostflame Dragon
Take the Larval Tear south of Abandoned AIling Village in an illuminated gravesite
Explore Belurat Gaol and Defeat the Side Boss: Demi-Human Swordmaster Onze

title: Invader: Logur, the Beast Claw, Beast Claw
text: From the blue spiritgraves, head southwest to find Lump of Flesh x2 behind a stone arch near the cliff edge.
Lump of Flesh: Lump of Flesh x2. On a dead body, behind an archway. South to the Church of Consolation.
Explore the woods east of the arch to encounter Logur, the Beast Claw. Kill him to obtain the Beast Claw.
Logur, the Beast Claw: A hostile NPC that can be found in Gravesite plains in the forest, southeast of the Gravesite Plain Site of Grace. Drops the Beast Claw Weapon upon defeat.
Beast Claw: Drops from killing this hostile NPC in Gravesite plains in the forest, southeast of the Gravesite Plain Site of Grace.

title: Ash of War: Savage Claws
text: Optional: His weapon is equipped with Ash of War: Savage Claws. Remove it to make it available for compatible weapons.

title: Black Steel Greathammer, Scadutree Fragment +1
text: Follow the road near the woods down to a wagon with a Glass Shard, Black Pyrefly, and Arrow x10 close by.
Glass Shard: On a dead body near the broken cart.
Black Pyrefly: On a dead body, near the broken cart.
Kill the Black Knight in the church down the road for the Black Steel Greathammer, then grab the Scadutree Fragment x2 in front of the statue.
Black Steel Greathammer: Greathammer dropped by the heavy armored guard of the Church of Consolation. This is a guaranteed drop when you first kill him.
Scadutree Fragment: 2 Scadutree Fragments can be found at the Church of Consolation's by the statue of Marika.
Scadutree Fragment: x1 Scadutree Fragment is dropped by a pot-bearing Shadow enemy that sparkles and runs away. Kill it quickly to get the drop.

place.title: Church of Consolation
walk: The Church of Consolation can be located northeast of the map See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. Inside, you can find x2 Scadutree Fragment by the statue of Marika. The church is guarded by a Black Knight enemy that wields a hammer and a shield. Near the church, you can also find a small campsite where you'll encounter a couple of Messmer Soldiers and a Burning Hound. Investigate the campsite and check the small tent to find a corpse that has an item. Loot the body to find x2 Fire Coil. If you also check behind the large tent, by the rocks and a tree, you can find x1 Golden Rune [1].
notes: For some players, the Black Knight drops Black Steel Greatshield.

guide.title: Gravesite Plain
text: Upon entering the Realm of Shadow, you will see a faint light glowing before you. Walk towards this and follow the steps leading to a view of the vast land you are now in. Use the Gravesite Plain - Site of Grace to get a checkpoint here. Walk toward the northeast and look for the dirt path. Follow this path leading north and pick up the Map: Gravesite Plain in one of the stone slab to your right, similar to the base game. This unlocks the Gravesite Plain on your map and will help you navigate more easily.

While in this area, be on the lookout for a Curseblade, as this is an enemy with two blades that will attack you. After defeating it, head south and follow the dirt path. You can ride Torrent here so you can cover more distance. You can also pick up items along the way to help with crafting like Redflesh Mushroom, Whiteflesh Mushroom, and Rada Fruit on the ground. You will also encounter Shadow Undead here that can attack you while riding your mount.

Continue riding southeast and stray from the dirt path for a bit. You will come across a hostile NPC called Logur the beast Claw in the middle of the woods. Listen and follow the bird sound near the middle of the woods. This NPC drops the Beast Claw (Weapon) upon defeating it. Return to the dirt path and continue going northeast until you see a broken cart and dead bodies. Take a moment here to pick up some items like Glass Shard, Black Pyrefly, Rada Fruit, and x10 Arrow. Follow the path until you reach the area outside of the Church of Consolation. You can pick up Dewgem on top of the stones surrounding the church and in the area close to the nearby waterfall. You can follow the cliffwall going north, and you will find three Messmer Soldiers in an area along with a corpse that you can loot for x1 Blessing of Marika. Go back to the church, and you'll find a Black Pyrefly behind it.

title: "The Sacred Tower" Painting
text: In a cave opening near the cliff behind the church, you'll find a Blessing of Marika.
Blessing of Marika: Can be found in a small cave behind the Church of Consolation, guarded by 3 soldiers.
On the other side of the church lies a small encampment. Pick up Fire Coil x2 from one of the tents.
Fire Coil: x2 found Inside one of the right tent in the Messmer Soldiers Camp, near the Church of Consolation.
Return to the Scorched Ruins and head northeast to an opening in the cliff and grab "The Sacred Tower" Painting inside.
"The Sacred Tower" Painting: Can be found in a small cave just northeast of Scorched Ruins. The solution to this painting is here and rewards you the Spiraltree Seal.

title: Backhand Blade
text: Pick up the Backhand Blade beside a coffin in the middle of some spiral pillars.
Backhand Blade: Besides a coffin, in the Inquisitor enemies area.

title: Ash of War: Blind Spot
text: Optional: This weapon is equipped with Ash of War: Blind Spot. Remove it to make it available for compatible weapons.

title: Cross Map, Talk to Hornsent
text: From the coffin, continue north-northwest to a stone arch with a Grave Glovewort [5] next to it.
Grave Glovewort [5]: Behind a lonely lookout Messmer Soldier near the edge.
Head toward the Miquella's Cross near the road and exhaust Hornsent's dialogue to receive the Cross Map.
Cross Map: A Map item drafted by Hornsent. Speak to Hornsent when you first meet him and exhaust his dialogue lines to obtain the item.
Hornsent: Horsent's first location is near the Three-Path Cross Site of Grace. Speak to him and exhaust his dialogue line to obtain the Cross Map item.

title: Miquella's Cross
text: Miquella's Cross: "I abandon here the flesh of my body"

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Pick up the Scadutree Fragment next to the cross and grab the Three-Path Cross grace.
Scadutree Fragment: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be found by the Miquella's Cross of the Three-Path Cross Site of Grace.

title: Talk to Freyja
text: Optional: Exhaust Freyja's dialogue next to the grace.

Freyja: Freyja's first location is near the Three-Path Cross Site of Grace. Make sure to speak to her and exhaust her dialogue lines when you first meet her. She can be summoned later to help you in battle against the Divine Beast Dancing Lion in Belurat Tower. Return to her in this location and speak to her after you fight the Divine Beast Dancing Lion .

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Follow the road west to discover another cross. Pick up the Scadutree Fragment next to it and grab the Main Gate Cross grace.
Scadutree Fragment: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be found by Miquella's Cross of the Main Gate Cross Site of Grace near NPCs Sir Ansbach and Moore.

title: Talk to Sir Ansbach (Belurat Tower Settlement)
text: Optional: Exhaust Ansbach's dialogue, then reload the area and ask him about the person in verdigris armor.
Sir Ansbach: Found by the side of a Miquella's cross. Talk to him twice to receive his request of finding six Miquella's Crosses.

title: Talk to Moore (Belurat Tower Settlement)
text: Optional: Talk to Moore and buy an item from him to unlock some additional dialogue.

Moore: Just behind Ansbach , in the same Miquella's Cross. More Shop Rune Arc 8000 Runes Spellproof Pickled Liver 4000 Runes Fireproof Pickled Liver 4000 Runes Lightningproof Pickled Liver 4000 Runes Lightningproof Pickled Liver 4000 Runes Holygproof Pickled Liver 4000 Runes Well-Pickled Turtle Neck 2000 Runes Black Pyrefly 1800 Runes Rada Fruit 800 Runes Redflesh Mushroom 1500 Runes Whiteflesh Mushroom 2000 Runes Sanguine Amaryllis 1800 Runes Knot Resin 1500 Runes Arrow 20 Runes Great Arrow 300 Runes Bolt 40 Runes Ballista Bolt 300 Runes Note: Sealed Spiritsprings 1000 Runes

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: From the grace, head southeast to a path in the cliffside and pick up Smithing Stone [5] x4 from the ledge.
Continue up the cliffside path to reach the Cliffroad Terminus grace.
In the graveyard southwest of the grace, kill the pot-carrying Shadow Commoner for a Scadutree Fragment and Silver Horn Tender (first time).

Scadutree Fragment: Item drops from a pot-bearing Shadow enemy. Grants 707 Runes upon defeat. Drops x1 Scadutree Fragment and x1 Silver Horn Tender. In a gravesite area, southwest of Cliffroad Terminus Site of Grace. Surrounded by other shadow enemies and a dog.

title: String-Seller's Bell Bearing
text: Pick up a Ghost Glovewort [5] from the corpse in the graveyard.
Look for a pot hanging from the cliff east of the corpse. Shoot it down with a ranged weapon and pick up the String-Seller's Bell Bearing.
String-Seller's Bell Bearing: Hanging from a wall in a ravine in Prospect Town in the Shadow Lands. Shoot and break the hanging pot with a bow.

place.title: Prospect Town
walk: Prospect Town is a small location where players can find valuable items, it is situated on the west area of the map within the Gravesite Plain region See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. The area is easy to investigate since most of the houses and buildings are destroyed and left the town an open area filled with rubble and remnants of the town. The location is also a good spot to gather materials such as Rada Fruit and Sanguine Amaryllis.

It is highly recommended to use a mount when exploring the area, so that you can more easily jump and reach high grounds. Investigate the south section of the town where you should find remnants of what seems to be the plaza area of the town. There are 2 Bloodfiends here. In this area, there is a small room near a set of stairs where you can spot a corpse, looting it yields x2 Beast Blood. Walk up the stairs to reach the upper area where you'll face 6 more Bloodfiends.
Next, just head up to the small church-like building to find a treasure chest. Open the chest and pick up the item to receive the Outer God Heirloom talisman Map Link.

Be sure to explore to the east of Prospect Town. At nighttime, there is a patch of illuminated tombstones with a Larval Tear Map Link. Next to that is a friendly Kindred of Rot who will give you the Forager Brood Cookbook [2] if you interact with it. Also nearby, if you continue moving east towards the area with trees and deer, you will spot a corpse that has an item. Pillage the body to find x1 Greater Potentate's Cookbook (5).

title: Bloodfiend's Arm
text: In the ruins near the cliff, climb the wall covered in fabric to enter Prospect Town:
Pick up Beast Blood x2 from the open building.
Go up the stairs to find a corpse with Whiteflesh Mushroom x3 on the ground.
Whiteflesh Mushroom: 3x Crafting Material. Enter Prospect Town, pass the small church-like building, on a body laying on the middle of the area.
Head up the slanted pillar to reach the upper section, then kill one of the Bloodfiends for the Bloodfiend's Arm (first time).
Bloodfiend's Arm: Colossal Weapon. Guaranteed drop from the chief Bloodfiend at the top of Prospect Town. One time only.

title: Outer God Heirloom
text: Pick up Sanguine Amaryllis x2 from the arcade and grab the Somber Smithing Stone [6] down the stairs north of it.
Sanguine Amaryllis: West side of the Prospect Town
Loot the Outer God Heirloom from a chest in the top building.
Outer God Heirloom: Found inside a chest, at the top of Prospect Town. Inside a small building.

title: Revered Spirit Ash
text: Return to the grace, pass time until nightfall, then follow the east cliff edge to a statue holding a Revered Spirit Ash.
Revered Spirit Ash: Found at an altar located to the east of the Cliffroad Terminus Site of Grace. In the vicinity of the pond inhabited by small turtles.

title: Larval Tear
text: Head up the hill southwest of the statue to find a Larval Tear surrounded by blue spiritgraves.
Larval Tear: On an area of illuminated graves. Near a servant of Rot that gives you the Forager Brood Cookbook [2] .

guide.title: Gravesite Plain (Western)
text: Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Belurat Tower Settlement - Navigating Western Area of Gravesite Plain
Reach Cliffroad Terminus
Head to the gravesite to get Larval Tear and Scadutree Fragment
Go to Prospect Town: Get String-Seller's Bell Bearing and Outer God Heirloom

Look for the Forager Brood who will give you the Forager Brood Cookbook (2). This NPC can be found next to the illuminated gravesite at night, which surrounds a Larval Tear at night. NOTE: Harming any of the Forager Broods will cause Moore to appear and invade your world. If Moore dies, this will also cause the Forager Broods to permanently disappear and end his questline.
Get the Incursion Painting in Artist's Shack,
Go to the Church of Benediction

After exploring the northern area of Gravesite Plain, return to the Three-Path Cross to continue your journey. Go toward the tall archway that Freyja is facing in the west. You will come across Shadow Undead here that you can eliminate for a chance to get Rada Fruit from them. Go to the left after exiting the archway and navigate the stone steps here. Stay along the ledge and continue heading south. You will encounter hounds and giant bats in this area. At the end, turn left and you can activate the Cliffroad Terminus Site of Grace right after you turn.

title: Forager Brood Cookbook
text: Interact with the friendly Kindred of Rot (Forager Brood) on the hill to receive Forager Brood Cookbook [2] and Black Pyrefly x3.
Forager Brood Cookbook: Given by a Non-hostile Servant of Rot east from Prospect Town. DO NOT attack this creature
miss: Missed if you kill the Forager Brood before interacting with it or fail Moore's questline. If you tell Moore to 'Remain sad forever' after Miquella's charm breaks, the Forager Brood disappear and their cookbooks become unobtainable.

title: Greater Potentate's Cookbook [5]
text: Note: Do not attack any of the Forager Brood. They are non-hostile, and killing them will end Moore's questline early.
Pick up Great Arrow x10, Sacred Bloody Flesh x2, and Smithing Stone [5] x4 from a small campsite with two corpses just below the hill.

Sacred Bloody Flesh: Consumable found inside Rivermouth Cave. Looted from a corpse guarded by a white wolf and a normal wolf. Find this area by going right (south) and then right and up (west) after the collapsible floor.
Follow the path near the campsite into the woods to find the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [5] on some rocks next to a large sheep.
Greater Potentate's Cookbook [5]: Found in the forest area, there are two thunder cows in the area. From Prospect Town, just follow the cliff south to find it.

guide.title: Exploring Cliffroad Terminus
text: From here, follow the dirt path and head south. This will lead you to a gravesite with more Shadow Undead. Go near the edge and look for an item on the ground near the gravestone heads to obtain the following items:
Scadutree Fragment
Silver Horn Tender
Rada Fruit
Make sure to eliminate the Shadowpot enemy standing here with other Shadow Undead. This enemy drops a Scadutree Fragment upon eliminating it.

There's also a Grave Glovewort that you can collect from one of the corpses here. After this area, head to the opposite side of the cliff and go toward the pond. You will encounter Hounds and Bloodfiend enemies here along the way. At the edge of the pond, you will see a small altar where you can pick up a Revered Spirit Ash. Then, head south of the pond where a hound and Bloodfiends are gathered. You can pick up a Great Arrow and a Smithing Stone from their gathering spot.

Continue exploring until you reach the edge south of the pond. You will find a non-hostile servant here who will give you the Forager Brood Cookbook [2] when interacted with. There's also a nearby illuminated grave where you can pick up a Larval Tear from the center. (This area may only be spotted at night.)

As you approach the town, look for an item hanging from a wall in a ravine. Shoot and break the hanging pot with a bow to obtain the String-Seller's Bell Bearing. See Shadow of the Erdtree Map, you can use this item to offer to the Twin Maiden Husks to unlock the option to buy String. Head west this time and enter Prospect Town or what remains of it. This area is infested with Bloodfiends and Hounds in every corner. Inside the building to the west, you can pick up Beast Blood from the corpse next to breakable jars. Go towards the southern area of Prospect Town where you see 3 Bloodfiends gathered in the open area. Eliminate them and look around the pillars to pick up Sanguine Amaryllis from a corpse. Continue walking up two sets of wide steps and enter the building to your left. Inside, you can obtain an Outer God Heirloom from a chest.

Exit the town to continue exploring the southeast and go past the servant who gave you the cookbook. You will encounter creatures here with lightning elements, and lightning can also strike occasionally. You may also pick up Yellow Fulgurbloom and other items from slain creatures. You will see a corpse in the distance and you can go up to it to take the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [5].

title: "Incursion" Painting
text: At the end of the woods are two paths. Climb the rocky slope first to grab the "Incursion" Painting from the shack at the top.
"Incursion" Painting: Found inside the Artist's Shack. The solution to this painting is here and rewards you the Serpent Crest Shield.

title: Blessed Blue Dew Talisman
text: Head back and follow the cliffside path down to a church. Pick up the Blessed Blue Dew Talisman in front of the statue.
Blessed Blue Dew Talisman: Talisman, at the altar of the Church of Benediction .

guide.title: The Artist's Shack and Church of Benediction
text: Continue navigating this area and go toward the cave where you will encounter a Giant Rat and another Curseblade. You're heading toward where you interacted with the first Site of Grace in the Shadow of Realm but in the area above it.

For clarity, we recommend returning to the Cliffroad Terminus, then head southeast and follow the dirt path where you will come across lightning rams. Once the dirt path ends, face south and go towards the south by jumping up the mountain through the stones. Face southeast and proceed to the edge of the cliff. You will see the "Incursion" Painting inside the Artist's Shack. See the location on Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Map

After going here, explore the southern area to reach the Church of Benediction. Carefully jump down to reach the ground and go toward the center and pick up the Blessed Blue Dew Talisman from the altar. Then, face north and exit the tall and slim archway toward the cliff. Pick up Pata and the Oathseeker Knight Set here from a corpse near the ledge.
You can go down here and scale the wall while riding Torrent. This gives you access back to the Gravesite Plain without going back to the Site of Grace in Crossroad Terminus.
See the next tab for the Belurat Tower Settlement Walkthrough.to return to the tab selection.

title: Oathseeker Knight Set, Pata
text: Grab the Oathseeker Knight Set and Pata from a corpse hanging off the cliff behind the church.

Oathseeker Knight Set: Found inside a hanging body, just outside the Church of Benediction. It contains the whole set: Oathseeker Knight Greaves , Oathseeker Knight Gauntlets , Oathseeker Knight Armor , and Oathseeker Knight Helm . It also contains Pata weapon.
Pata: Fist Weapon looted from a corpse hanging on the cliff just north from the Church of Benediction . This same corpse has the Oathseeker Set

place.title: Church of Benediction
walk: The Church of Benediction is a small location that can be found south of the Gravesite Plain region See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. There are no hostile characters and NPCs found in the Church of Benediction, however, there is some loot you can find inside and near the church. Head inside the church and investigate the statue of Marika to find the Blessed Blue Dew Talisman. And if you check the edge of a cliff, near its doorway, you'll spot a corpse hanging. Loot the body to find the Oathseeker Knight Set which contains the following pieces:
Oathseeker Knight Greaves
Oathseeker Knight Gauntlets
Oathseeker Knight Armor
Oathseeker Knight Helm
including the Pata weapon.
There is also a glowing skull on the ground near the doorway of the church, breaking it will drop a Golden Rune (1).

title: Boss: Knight of the Solitary Gaol
text: Travel to the Scorched Ruins and head west to a mausoleum. Kill the Knight of the Solitary Gaol inside for Greatsword of Solitude, Solitude Set, and 70,000 runes.
Knight of the Solitary Gaol: Blackgaol Knight is a secondary boss found inside the Western Nameless Mausoleum. Drops the Greatsword of Solitude and Armor Set on death.
Greatsword of Solitude: This item is obtained after defeating the Blackgaol Knight . This boss is located inside the Western Nameless Mausoleum.

Solitude Set: The following armor pieces of the Solitude Set can be obtained after defeating the Blackgaol Knight found inside Northern Nameless Mausoleum . Helm of Solitude Armor of Solitude Gauntlets of Solitude Greaves of Solitude

place.title: Western Nameless Mausoleum
walk: The Western Nameless Mausoleum is a location that can be found northwest of the Gravesite Plain See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. The mausoleum is an arena where you'll encounter a mini-boss upon entering the undercroft. The boss you'll fight here is the Blackgaol Knight, and defeating it rewards the player with the Solitude Set. The set comes with the following pieces:
Helm of Solitude
Armor of Solitude
Gauntlets of Solitude
Greaves of Solitude
including the Greatsword of Solitude

By the entrance of the Western Nameless Mausoleum, there is a Stake of Marika and a Summoning Pool. The summoning pool can be used to summon other players that can help you and the Stake of Marika allows the player to respawn by the entrance in case you die while fighting the Blackgaol Knight. Outside the mausoleum, you can find some gatherable items and encounter a few enemies such as Gravebirds.

title: Boss: Furnace Golem (Scorched Ruins)
text: Kill the Furnace Golem near the Scorched Ruins for the Deflecting Hardtear and a Furnace Visage.
Deflecting Hardtear: The item drops from the Furnace Golem located along the main road near the Scorched Ruins.
Furnace Golem: A Furnace Golem can be located roaming near the Scorched Ruins. Defeating it drops the following item/s: x1 Deflecting Hardtear x1 Furnace Visage

title: Ash of War: Savage Lion's Claw
text: From the Three-Path Cross, head northwest along the cliff to reach a campsite with Ash of War: Savage Lion's Claw.

Ash of War: Savage Lion's Claw: From the Three-Path Cross site of grace, stick to the wall on the left side, and follow the path north. You will eventually come across a small camp where you can find the Ash of War.

guide.title: Miquella's Followers at the Three-Path Cross
text: When you're done in this area, head north again where you see a faint light glowing from the ground, and some figures are gathered near it. Head towards them and make sure to activate the Three-Path Cross Site of Grace here. Talk to the NPCs, who you will come to know as followers of Miquella. Just like Needle Knight Leda said, these followers will offer help in your journey in tracing Miquella's footsteps. Interact with the NPCs here and make sure to exhaust the dialogues of Hornsent to receive the Cross Map from him.

You can pick up an Empyrean-Blood Burgeon and a Scadutree Fragment on the ground next to the cross. The other NPC is Redmane Freyja who you can speak with to get more info about Hornsent. Exhaust her dialogues before you continue exploring the northernmost area.

From the Three-Path Cross Site of Grace, navigate the wall to your left while facing north. Carefully stick to the wall and take the Ash of War: Savage Lion's Claw from a small camp here. Then, face the east direction toward the bridge to find a way to the lower area here. If you go down here during nighttime, you can find a Larval Tear glowing. The Run-Down Traveler's Rest is directly below the bridge, and you can pick up the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [2] inside. This allows the player to craft Hefty Furnace Pots.

When you're done here, you can travel north to reach your next destination, which is the Abandoned Ailing Village. To reach the next location, stick to the edge of the cliff here and travel north. Continue until you reach a dead-end where you will find a small altar with the Revered Spirit Ash. Eliminate the nearby giant moths so you can safely take this item. Then, head back to the ramp so you can activate the Greatbridge, North - Site of Grace.

You will see a ghost facedown on the ground ahead of you. Interact with it before you proceed to Abandoned Ailing Village. Go to the edge of the cliff behind the ghost and pick up the Human Bone Shard and x2 Black Pyrefly from a corpse. Continue walking at the edge and you will find another corpse on the wooden platform where you can obtain the Ailment Talisman. Before leaving this area, go to the other side of the houses (across the ghost) and you will find a Broken Rune from a corpse.

You can now travel west toward the lake, and you will see a Ghostflame Dragon in the distance. There's a summoning pool that you can activate if you want to use it. Defeating this boss will reward you with x1 Dragon Heart and x1 Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone. See the Ghostflame Dragon for information and strategies to defeating this boss. You can also pick up a Great Katana from a corpse next to the dragon. After this fight, continue exploring north where you will find a small shack below the Abandoned Ailing Village. There's a corpse outside at roof level where you can pick up Fly Mold, then, you can jump inside the house through the hole in the roof to pick up the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [10].

Next, head southwest into an area in Gravebird statues. You can pick up the Gravebird Armor from the altar in the middle here. Then, follow the body of water leading to metal barricades scattered on the ground. This will lead to an entrance to Belurat Gaol where you can defeat an optional boss called Demi-Human Swordmaster Onze to earn Demi-Human Swordsman Yosh (Spirit Ash) as a reward.

title: Serpent Crest Shield
text: In the lower field northwest of the campsite, next to a stone arch by the cliff, lies a Shadow Realm Rune [1].
Shadow Realm Rune [1]: A Shadow Realm Rune [1] can be looted by an archway near the cliff, southeast of the cave entrance of the Belurat Gaol, near the southern edge.
On the small hill just northeast of the stone arch, you'll find the Serpent Crest Shield (painting reward).
Serpent Crest Shield: Obtained by completing the "Incursion" Painting Puzzle.

title: Boss: Ghostflame Dragon (Cerulean Coast)
text: Kill the Ghostflame Dragon in the lake for Dragon Heart, Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone, and 100,000 runes.

Ghostflame Dragon: The Ghostflame Dragon is a boss located South of Cerulean Cross, Site of Grace. It can be found patrolling the blue field of flowers. Drops Dragon Heart and Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Dragon Heart: Dropped by the Ghostflame Dragon in Cerulean Coast.
Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone: Dropped by the Ghostflame Dragon at Cerulean Coast.

guide.title: Cerulean Coast/Southern Shore
text: Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree - Southern Shore (First Entrance)
Travel from Ellac River Downstream - Site of Grace in Gravesite Plain and navigate the path to Cerulean Coast
Look for the Forager Brood to receive the Cookbook. This one is located Northeast of the Cerulean Coast - Site of Grace
Reach Cerulean Coast
Fight Ghostflame Dragon
Reach Southern Shore
Pick up Map: Southern Shore
Explore Stone Coffin Fissure
Summon Thiollier to fight the Putrescent Knight
Defeat Putrescent Knight
Reach Garden of Deep Purple
Progress Thiollier and St. Trina's Questline
Reach Southern Nameless Mausoleum and defeat Dancer of Ranah
Make your way to Finger Ruins of Rhia by following the path in Eastern Coast
Progress Count Ymir and Jolan's Questline (Please see the Finger Ruins Walkthrough Tab)

title: Great Katana
text: Grab the Great Katana from a corpse in front of the dragon.
Great Katana: The Great Katana can be found next to the sleeping Ghostflame Dragon on the lake, west of the Abandoned Ailing Village site of grace.

title: Boss: Ghostflame Dragon (Greatbridge, North)
text: Ghostflame Dragon: The Ghostflame Dragon is a boss located at Greatbridge, North .

title: Ash of War: Overhead Stance
text: Optional: This weapon is equipped with Ash of War: Overhead Stance. Remove it to make it available for compatible weapons.

title: Hefty Cracked Pot
text: At the west end of the lake lies the entrance to Belurat Gaol:
Head inside and grab the Belurat Gaol grace down the stairs.
Enter the first cell on the left to pick up Frozen Maggot x6.

Frozen Maggot: A total of 17 Frozen Maggots can be looted in the Belurat Gaol location. As you formally set foot in the location, head down the steps on the left and be ready to block or dodge, a Revered Spirit will ambush you as soon as you approach a doorway along the steps. Head inside the room on the left and you'll find a body you can loot to find x6 Frozen Maggot As you progress from the main entrance, you'll fall below as you step on the stairs that collapses. Across the narrow path, you'll find a body hanging by the ledge. Looting it yields x4 Frozen Maggot The rest of the Frozen Maggots are looted from the ground in the Belurat Gaol. The ones looted from the ground only yield 1 Frozen Maggot.
After the stairs collapse, enter the nearby cell for a Silver Horn Tender next to some crates.
Silver Horn Tender: x1 Silver Horn Tender can be looted from a corpse in the room to the left after you fall from the stairs that collapses, near the entrance.
Cross the narrow passage to find Frozen Maggot x4 on a corpse hanging off the ledge.
Jump through the hole in the next room, then continue to a Broken Rune between two tables.
Broken Rune: x1 Broken Rune can be looted from a corpse lying on the ground, in between two tables. The body is located inside a storage room after you jump through an opening on the wall.
Pick up Thawfrost Boluses from the ledge just outside the table room.
Thawfrost Boluses: x1 Thawfrost Boluses can be looted from a body that is hanging by the edge of a cliff. The body can be found by the exit of a storage room.
Continue to a circular room. Before dropping down, enter the cell to pick up a Shadow Realm Rune [3].
Shadow Realm Rune [3]: x1 can be looted from a corpse located in a room full of jars and crates. Inside the room, you'll also encounter a single Mutated Prisoner enemy.
Descend the pots in the circular room and pick up Glass Shard from the corpse on top of a pot halfway down.

Glass Shard: x1 Glass Shard can be looted from a corpse lying on top of a hanging jar. You'll find this body when you begin descending the location by using the hanging jars as platforms to reach the bottom of Belurat Gaol.
From the corpse, drop onto the west pot to reach a wooden ledge. Grab a Hefty Cracked Pot from the chest on the ledge.

Hefty Cracked Pot: There are three Hefty Cracked Pot items that can be found in Belurat Gaol. One can be looted inside a treasure chest when you start to descend the jail area by dropping onto the hanging jars. The treasure chest is on a wooden platform. Two can be found by looting bodies that are on top of a jar in the jar labyrinth area.

place.title: Belurat Gaol
walk: Belurat Gaol Walkthrough Video

The Belurat Gaol is a location situated under the Belurat Tower Settlement, to find the entrance of the prison area, head west from the Abandoned Ailing Village or the Greatbridge, North Site of Grace. You'll easily identify when you're near the entrance when you arrive at the area that is surrounded with water and prison cages. As you enter the depths of the prison, you will find the Belurat Gaol Site of Grace and a Summoning Pool on the right side of the Site of Grace.

This area has enemies such as Shadow Undead enemies, large and small variations of the Living Jar, and Jar Innards. This area is also a good place to farm or find Frozen Maggots The objective is to reach the bottom-most section of the gaol where a mini-boss is waiting.

guide.title: Clearing Belurat Gaol
text: As you enter the depths of the prison, you will find the Belurat Gaol - Site of Grace and a Summoning Pool on the right side of the Site of Grace.

This area has enemies such as Revered Spirits, large and small variations of the Living Jar, and Mutated Prisoners. This area is also a good place to farm or find Frozen Maggots The objective is to reach the bottom-most section of the gaol where a mini-boss is waiting.
## BELURAT GAOL UPPER AREA

As you formally set foot in the location, head down the steps on the left and be ready to block or dodge, a Shadow Undead will ambush you as soon as you approach a doorway along the steps. Head inside the room on the left and you'll find a body you can loot to find x6 Frozen Maggot. Go back outside and continue going down the steps until you reach the end where the ground collapses. Kill more of the Shadow Undead enemies, and if you look to your left, you'll find another doorway. Be ready again for another spirit who will try to ambush you, kill the enemies, and loot the body lying on the ground to find x1 Silver Horn Tender.

Go back outside and cross the narrow path to reach the other end. But tread carefully since enemies are roaming around and blocking your path. Kill the two spirits and before you go through the doorway ahead, there is another body you can loot by the edge of the cliff. Loot it to find x4 Frozen Maggot. Go through the doorway and look to your right to see a hole that you can jump through. Proceed to this path, and then jump through the hole on the left side to continue your descent.

Enter the room that looks like a storeroom that is filled with crates, cages, and tables. Kill the enemies and loot the body next to the shelf with barrels on the left side to find x1 Broken Rune. Exit the room, but before you enter the next room on the left, break the crates on the right to find another corpse lying by the edge of a cliff to find x1 Thawfrost Boluses. As you pass through the connecting room, you'll see a Ghost Prisoner NPC that you can speak to who begs for forgiveness and fears the jar.

guide.title: DESCENDING THE GAOL
text: Upon exiting, you'll come across a section of the prison where you'll see large jars chained together and onto the ceiling. Before you make your descent by using the jars as platforms, look ahead to find another doorway that leads to a room with jars and crates. There is a body here that you can loot to find x1 Shadow Realm Rune [3], but at the same time, you'll fight against a Mutated Prisoner, humanoids that have mutated and erupted from their jars. Once you've cleared the room, return to the hanging jars to start descending to the bottom area (there's a body on top of the hanging jar that has x1 Glass Shard). As indicated in the image above, you'll want to try and make your way down towards the side of the room that has a wooden platform. There is a chest there that contains x1 Hefty Cracked Pot.

After getting the item, continue to the bottom and proceed west. Clear the enemies along the way and pass through the doorway where you'll enter a shrine-looking section of the gaol. Drop onto the bridge and fight your way against more enemies. When you reach the opposite end, as you approach the altar, the ground beneath you will collapse and you'll fall into a mini-labyrinth that's filled with small and large jars. Take caution here as both Living Jar and Mutated Prisoners are hiding in corners, waiting to ambush you.

Take the time here to explore the section with pots since there are some items that you can loot: x1 Lost Ashes of War, x2 Smithing Stone [6], x1 Greater Potentate's Cookbook (11). There are also x1 Hefty Cracked Pot, and x1 Innard Meat looted off the bodies that are on top of the large jars. Once you're done clearing the room, proceed east to find the exit leading to the next section. Kill the Living Jar and loot the body sitting on a prison cage to find x2 Smithing Stone [3].

Before advancing the dungeon further, head west on your compass, and you will find a jar that is slightly at a lower level than your position. Jump on it and it will take you up high. Once it stops, jump towards the following platforms and continue forward. You will find Greatjar on a pedestal. Move forward and drop down to find yourself again in the Jar Labyrinth. Resume your previous way, to continue advancing in the dungeon.

Next, jump across to reach the opposite side of the area to find a golden mist door, and fight the Mutated Prisoners. Position your compass towards the South, and you'll see a chained jar that you can jump on. Use it as a platform to jump across a broken pillar, and continue jumping down until you reach the end, where you'll find a gold mist door. Before you enter, make preparations, as you'll fight against the Demi-Human Swordmaster Onze upon passing through the mist.
## BELURAT GAOL BOSS: DEMI-HUMAN SWORDMASTER ONZE

The Demi-Human Swordmaster Onze boss is an agile boss capable of leaping into the air, using lunge attacks, and executing deadly combos similar to a samurai. In our playthrough, our character's build focuses on melee and we had a shield equipped to mitigate attacks as much as possible. As soon as you enter prepare to dodge or block as the boss will teleport to you and follow up with a swinging attack. Since we were facing the boss without the help of other players, we decided to summon the Black Knife Tiche to keep things in check.

The Black Knife Tiche in our opinion is good against this boss since it also moves fast and is capable of attacking its target in close or mid-range. As soon as the boss switched its attention towards our summoned spirit, we took the opportunity to land some attacks before it switched its attention to the character. Play it safe and keep an eye out for its movements since the boss moves quickly. Defeating it rewards the spirit ash Demi-Human Swordsman Yosh. To return to the entrance, use the pool of energy at the center of the boss arena to teleport to the entrance of this dungeon.
See the next tab for the Second Path: Western Gravesite Plain Navigation.to return to the tab selection.

title: Lost Ashes of War
text: Continue until the floor collapses, then follow the only path forward in the maze to find Lost Ashes of War in front of some boxes.
