Lost Ashes of War: x1 can be looted from a corpse located in the jar labyrinth area of Belurat Gaol

title: Greater Potentate's Cookbook
text: Follow either southwest path to a corpse with Smithing Stone [6] x3. The nearby gate is the exit, so remember it for later.
Climb the slanted pots near the corpse to enter another maze, then climb the pots in the back to reach the Innard Meat and Hefty Cracked Pot on top of the pots.
Innard Meat: x1 Innard Meat can be looted from a corpse lying on the top of a jar in the jar labyrinth area of the Belurat Gaol.
Next to another set of slanted pots lies a corpse with the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [11].
Greater Potentate's Cookbook: x1 is looted from a corpse located at the jar labyrinth area of Belurat Gaol.

title: Greatjar
text: Climb the second set of slanted pots, then follow either path to a Hefty Cracked Pot on top of some pots at the end.
Drop down to return to the exit gate, then pick up Smithing Stone [6] x4 from a cage on the right.
Instead of dropping down to the boss, drop onto the west pot lift below the cliff and continue to an altar with the Greatjar on top.

Greatjar: Belurat Gaol : After leaving the jar labyrinth, you will pass a small bridge and fight 3 Mutated Prisoners, on quite a large platform. In order to advance the dungeon, you have to step on the jar at the end of the area, but don't do that. Instead, turn right to find another jar on a slightly lower level. Step on it, and it will take you high. Once there, jump from platform to platform, and once the area, opens up, the item is on a pedestal, beware of the enemies.

title: Boss: Demi-Human Swordmaster Onze
text: Descend the pots below the east-side corner to return, then kill Demi-Human Swordmaster Onze for Demi-Human Swordsman Yosh and 80,000 runes.
Demi-Human Swordmaster Onze: The Demi-Human Swordmaster Onze boss is located at the depths of Belurat Gaol .
Demi-Human Swordsman Yosh: This spirit ash drops from the Demi-Human Swordmaster Onze boss located within the depths of the Belurat Gaol .

title: Gravebird Armor
text: From the gaol entrance, head north to find the Gravebird Armor in front of a stone arch.

Gravebird Armor: In the area, there are four statues of Gravebirds, and at the end is where you'll find the Armor. Once you approach the statues, at least 3 of them will turn into enemies. This location is situated to the far west of the Abandoned Ailing Village, nearly reaching the outer walls of Belurat, Tower Settlement.

title: Greater Potentate's Cookbook [10]
text: Head east-northeast from the arch to find a corpse with Whiteflesh Mushroom x3, guarded by two dogs.
Just past the corpse lies a shack with the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [10].

Greater Potentate's Cookbook [10]: The item is looted from a body that is inside a dilapidated building. You can use your mount to jump onto the roof where you'll find a hole that you can jump through.

title: Larval Tear
text: On the ledge above the shack lies a corpse with Fly Mold x3.
Fly Mold: 4x of this material can looted from a corpse by the cliff, guarded by several man-fly enemies.
Head around the ledge to discover the Greatbridge, North grace outside the Abandoned Ailing Village:
Pass time until nightfall, then grab the Larval Tear surrounded by blue spiritgraves near the cliff.
Larval Tear: Larval Tear looted from a spot of glowing graves available at night only, just south from Abandoned Ailing Village.

place.title: Abandoned Ailing Village
walk: The Abandoned Ailing Village is a location that has been inhabited by Man-Fly enemies. The village can be found northwest of the Ellac Greatbridge in the Gravesite Plain region See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. From the entrance of the village, investigate the east section towards the cliffside where you'll spot a statue that has an item, kill the Man-Fly enemies that are around the statue, and then pick up the item to acquire x1 Revered Spirit Ash.

Return to the entrance of the village to find the Greatbridge, North Site of Grace nearby See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. As mentioned, the village is now inhabited by Man-Fly enemies, so tread carefully and avoid aggravating them in a group, since you can potentially die from being outnumbered. To identify which is the entrance of the village, it's where you'll see a Spirit NPC. If you head to the east past the NPC at night, you will find an illuminated gravesite where you can pick up a Larval Tear.

From the entrance, check the west section of the village to find a house that you can enter. Inside, you can find a body that holds x1 Broken Rune. Go to the center of the village and head up the hill where you'll find some scaffolding. If you walk a bit to the east, towards the edge of a cliff, you can spot a glowing skull that has x1 Golden Rune (1), and there's also a body near it that you can loot to acquire x1 Human Bone Shard. Next, walk up to the scaffolding to find another corpse hanging by the edge. Loot it to obtain the Ailment Talisman See Shadow of the Erdtree Map.

Now ride your mount and head to the northwest corner of the village where you'll spot a single house. Enter through the doorway, kill the Man-Fly, and loot the corpse to obtain Greater Potentate's Cookbook (10), See Shadow of the Erdtree Map.

title: Revered Spirit Ash
text: Follow the cliff edge up to a corpse with Black Pyrefly x2 and a statue holding a Revered Spirit Ash just past it.
Black Pyrefly: x2 Black Pyrefly can be looted from a body that's lying by the edge of a cliff.
Revered Spirit Ash: In Bonny Village: Fall down from the broken bridge, and follow the path north, past the dog, you will find a statue containing the revered spirit ash at the end of the road.

title: Ailment Talisman
text: A corpse with Human Bone Shard lies on the upper ledge near the statue.
Human Bone Shard: Looted from a corpse at the bottom of the ravine, guarded by several slime.
In a house west of the corpse, you'll find a Broken Rune.
Broken Rune: On top of one of the big jars, past the site of grace.
Pick up the Ailment Talisman from a wooden platform at the top of the village.
Ailment Talisman: The Ailment Talisman can be looted from a corpse. The body can be found lying at the edge of an unfinished wooden bridge of the Abandoned Ailing Village.

title: Greater Potentate's Cookbook [2]
text: Return to the grace and head below the greatbridge to find a shack with 2x Furnace Visage and Greater Potentate's Cookbook [2].
Greater Potentate's Cookbook [2]: Looted from a body that's inside the Run-Down Traveler's Rest location.

place.title: Run-Down Traveler's Rest
walk: The Run-Down Traveler's Rest is a dilapidated cabin that can be located north of the Three-Path Cross Site of Grace See Shadow of the Erdtree Map and near the Ellac Greatbridge. There are no enemies around the location and there are no NPCs or merchants. However, you can find a body inside the cabin and you can loot it to obtain Greater Potentate's Cookbook (2) and 2x Furnace Visage.

title: Lost Ashes of War
text: From the Three-Path Cross, follow the north-northeast road and loot the Ballista Bolt x5, Lost Ashes of War, and Shadow Realm Rune [1] on the greatbridge.
Lost Ashes of War: A Lost Ashes of War can be found in the middle of the Ellac Greatbridge.
Shadow Realm Rune [1]: Found on a corpse hanging off the edge of Ellac Great Bridge, near the Ballista.

place.title: Ellac Greatbridge
walk: The Ellac Greatbridge is located southeast of Castle Ensis, adjacent to the Run-Down Traveler's Rest. This wartorn bridge is littered with barricades and rubble, making it a straightforward path to navigate. Head straight through the bridge until you reach a section occupied by Messmer Soldiers and impaled corpses on each side. Here, you can find and loot two corpses for Ballista Bolt and Lost Ashes of War. At the end of the bridge, you will encounter a stationary crossbow that fires at you. To deal with this threat, charge at the crossbow while dodging the arrows it fires, and take out the Messmer Soldier controlling it. Once the crossbow is neutralized, return to the middle of the bridge to loot the corpses you encountered earlier.

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Pick up the Scadutree Fragment in front of a statue at the fork in the road, then grab the Castle Front grace next to the castle bridge.
Scadutree Fragment: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be found next to the statue of Marika, located at a Messmer Soldier encampment.

title: Spelldrake Talisman +3
text: Drop down to the left of the castle bridge, then follow the slope down to a castle room with the Spelldrake Talisman +3.
Spelldrake Talisman +3: A +3 variant of the Spelldrake Talisman can be looted off a corpse. The body is located inside a storeroom underneath the castle front bridge of Castle Ensis.

title: Ancient Dragon Knight's Cookbook [1]
text: Head toward the top of the slope, then go north past some spiked barricades and pick up the Black Pyrefly x5 under a canopy.
On a higher up ledge past the canopy sits a corpse with Messmerfire Grease and Smithing Stone [7] x3.
Messmerfire Grease: Looted from a corpse in the lower area of Fog Rift Fort, beware of ambush by enemies with flamethrowers
Continue north until you reach the entrance to Fog Rift Catacombs:
Take the lift down and grab the Fog Rift Catacombs grace.
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [5] from the corpse in the first corridor.
Reach the room with a Bigmouth Imp firing at you from a ledge, then grab the Ancient Dragon Knight's Cookbook [1] from the east corridor.
Ancient Dragon Knight's Cookbook [1]: Fog Rift Catacombs . After the room with the sorcerer, the path opens up. Take the right side first, fight the two goblins and grab this item from the ground.

title: Boss: Golden Hippopotamus
text: Golden Hippopotamus: From here, face the southwest direction and exit through the small hole. Go to the right side and go past the bloodfiend. There's a corpse near the edge and you can pick up 8x Thin Beast Bones from it. Now look behind you; you should be facing southeast here and go towards the edge and jump down on the steps below you. Look to your right and fight the lesser Golden Hippopotamus.

title: Black Knight Commander Andreas
text: Trigger the impaling mechanism down the opposite room without dropping, then jump onto it to reach a ledge with Knot Resin x3.
Knot Resin: Fog Rift Catacombs . Once you reach the room with the spikes that falls from the ceiling. Wait until it drops and jump on it. Move to the upper platform to find this item on a dead body
Go through the corridor on top of the mechanism to reach a room with a Great Ghost Glovewort.
Great Ghost Glovewort: Fog Rift Catacombs . In the room with the Black Knight, on the middle of the ground. Beware on the right, there is a hidden Messmer Soldier
Approach the closest arch outside the room without dropping to trigger the impaling mechanism, then jump across it to reach a coffin with Black Knight Commander Andreas.

Black Knight Commander Andreas: It's located by following the Fog Rift Catacombs past a black knight guarded by 3 Messmer Soldiers and then jumping on to the top of the spike trap the falls from the ceiling and then crossing it into a corridor. The Spirit Ashes is lying in a coffin.

guide.title: Clear Fog Rift Catacombs
text: Fog Rift Catacombs is located west of the Church of Crusade and north of Fog Rift Fort. The entrance of the catacombs leads to an elevator that goes down. You'll immediately find the Fog Rift Catacombs Site of Grace and a tunnel path straight ahead. Head through the tunnel entrance and prepare yourself for an Imp that will ambush you. At the upper right side of the room is a corpse holding a Grave Glovewort [1].

After retrieving that item, turn left through another tunnel entrance which leads to a large open room. Upon exiting the tunnel, immediately turn left towards a safe spot because half of the room is rigged with a spike trap that descends from above. Wait for it to come down, and once it goes up, immediately run to the other side where a Lion Head Goblin is waiting for you. Take out the Goblin and head straight to the next tunnel entrance leading to a large hallway. Turn right and head straight towards the stairs going down, but before heading down, pick up the Yellow Fulgurbloom to your left.

After collecting the plant, head down the stairs and turn right into another tunnel in the catacombs. You'll see two corpses that give you the Ancient Dragon Knight's Cookbook [1] and a Lizard Greatsword, along with a Yellow Fulgurbloom plant. Head back to where you turned right earlier, and this time, turn left down another set of stairs. This will lead you to what looks like a dead-end ledge, but wait a few seconds for the spike trap from earlier to fall down. Once it falls, hop on top of it, and it will lead you to a secret platform with a Lion Head Goblin, a corpse that gives you x3 Knot Resin, and a Yellow Fulgurbloom plant.

After looting the platform, hop on the spike trap again, but don't go back yet. Instead, wait for the spike trap to take you back up again, and this time, look for a tunnel entrance to the left that you can drop onto. Once you enter the tunnel and the room, turn left again until you cross a bridge and a set of stairs going up. Here, you'll encounter Messmer Soldiers guarding a room. Head inside the room after defeating the Messmer Soldiers, and you'll face a Black Knight. Defeat the Black Knight, then pick up the Great Ghost Glovewort. Go outside the room, then turn left to jump on top of a spiked platform, then go through a hallway. Follow the pathway and you will find the Black Knight Commander Andreas summon at the end.

Make your way back to where you first saw the spike area from a ledge. Instead of hopping back on, wait for it to drop and go up. Then immediately drop down and enter the tunnel entrance behind you. The small room here contains a Yellow Fulgurbloom. Inside the room on the left side is a ladder going up. Head up the ladder and follow the tunnel path with three Yellow Fulgurblooms.

After looting the plants, walk to the right and drop down to the area from earlier where you saw the spike trap. Drop down again and stand at the tunnel entrance behind you from earlier. Wait for the spike trap to drop, then immediately run to the other side where a set of stairs goes down. Here, you'll find a corpse that gives you x2 Dragonbolt Grease.

Head down the stairs to find another elevator that goes further down. Upon reaching the ground, head straight towards a room with two Lion Head Goblins and loot the corpse and plant under the stairs to get x4 Rada Fruit and a Yellow Fulgurbloom. From under the stairs, head straight towards the tunnel entrance on the other side of the room, but loot two more Yellow Fulgurblooms to the left.

Inside the small room, clear out the two enemies and loot the corpse on the upper right for a Grave Glovewort [2]. After looting the corpse, head out of the room and turn right towards another tunnel entrance with stairs going further down. This leads to an open hallway with spike traps covering half of the hallway. Just as before, run to the left towards a safe space and wait for the spike trap to drop. Once it drops, hug the wall and run straight until you see a hole to the left where you can drop down into what appears to be a sewage area. Once you land in the sewage, head straight for the tunnel entrance ahead and loot the corpse for a Ghost Glovewort [4].

On the left side of the first sewage room is an entrance to another room. Enter and turn left towards another room containing three Yellow Fulgurblooms and a corpse that drops an Electrocharge. Exit that room, turn left towards a ladder going up. Climb the ladder and drop down from the platform to find yourself near the hallway spike trap from earlier. Wait for the spike trap to drop, and once it does, run towards the other end of the hallway. Get to the second safe spot to the left, past the hole you dropped into earlier, and loot the corpse there to get a Glass Shard. Wait for the spike trap to drop again, then run towards the stairs leading to a casket above that you can loot for a Shadow Realm Rune [3].

Once you're done looting, stay on the ledge of the platform you're standing on in front. Wait for the spike trap to drop, and you'll see a small square space on the side of the spike trap that you can hop onto. Hop onto the square platform and let the spike trap raise you to a secret platform above with a chest containing the Ash of War: Blinkbolt. After looting, hop on top of the spike trap again and run to the other side until you see a small platform to the right to drop onto. You'll see an altar that changes the Stone-Sheathed Sword to the Sword of Darkness.

To the left is a ladder going down. This ladder leads to a secret room with a corpse that gives you a Ghost Glovewort [5]. Loot it, then immediately look to the left to see another hole to drop into. This hole will drop you back to a safe spot from the hallway spike trap from earlier. Wait for the spike trap to drop, and once it does, run to the other side this time instead of the platform from earlier. Be careful in the safe area here as it connects to another spike trap area.

Wait for the spike trap on the other side to drop, then cross towards a tunnel entrance. Loot the corpse in the middle first for a Broken Rune. Head through the tunnel entrance to find another elevator that goes down. Drop here and head straight until you reach the yellow mist that leads to the Death Knight boss. For a comprehensive boss guide on the Death Knight, you may go to this page.

title: Electrocharge
text: Return to the room with the Bigmouth Imp on a ledge, then pick up Dragonbolt Grease x2 from the west room floor.
Dragonbolt Grease: Keep following the path after the first Lionface warrior. You can pick up x1 Dragonbolt Grease on the ground, but there will be a magic attack which seems to be coming from above.
Take the lift down, then pick up Rada Fruit x4 from the corpse below the staircase.
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [6] from the corpse in the west room.
In the large room, drop down the hole in the second alcove on the left. After landing, grab the Ghost Glovewort [5] at the east end.
Pick up Electrocharge from the corpse in the west room near the ladder.

Electrocharge: Incancation. Looted from the sewer basement of Fog Rift Catacombs. After descending the second lift, find the room with the caster and the spiked roof, then drop on the hollow floor to a lower area and fight a group of slimes and casters to loot it.

title: Ash of War: Blinkbolt
text: Climb the ladder and return to the large room, then pick up Glass Shard from the third alcove on the left.

Glass Shard: Fog Rift Catacombs . In the room in which the sorcerer attacks you from the other side, and the falling spikes strike from the celiing, take the third alcove from the left side to find this item.
Pick up a Shadow Realm Rune [3] from the coffin at the south end of the room.
Shadow Realm Rune [3]: Fog Rift Catacombs . Found inside a coffin located at the end of the room with the sorcerer and the falling spike ceiling. Beware the Imps at both sides of the coffin.
Stand near the balustrade to trigger the impaling mechanism, then jump inside it to reach a chest with Ash of War: Blinkbolt.

Ash of War: Blinkbolt: UNDERGROUND. Found in a chest within the Fog Rift Catacombs . The room of the third spike dropper with a sorcerer sniping from the back, stand where the sorcerer you defeated was and bait the spike trap down to jump into a notch. Ride the notch up to a room with a chest that holds the ash of war.

title: Stone-Sheathed Sword
text: Run along the top of the mechanism to reach a stele with the Stone-Sheathed Sword.

Stone-Sheathed Sword: Altar for the Stone-Sheathed Sword or to convert it to Sword of Darkness and Sword of Light. Found inside Fog Rift Catacombs, by walking on top of the three spiked ceilings that drop in the large room before the lift to the catacombs boss.

title: Boss: Death Knight (Fog Rift Catacombs)
text: Descend the ladder near the stele to enter a small room with a Ghost Glovewort [6].

Ghost Glovewort [6]: Found on a corpse inside Scorpion River Catacombs. After the section with the Black Knight and Black Knight Captain Huw ashes, use the ladder to get up and jump onto the spikes behind you, ride them up and reach a platform with the item.
Drop down to the large room, then enter the room on the west side for a Broken Rune below another impaling mechanism.
Broken Rune: Consumable found inside Scorpion River Catacombs. Looted from a corpse near a fulgurbloom, by the death eyes spawn point, after the chest with Dragon Knight's Cookbook.
Take the lift down and kill the Death Knight for Death Knight's Twin Axes, Crimson Amber Medallion +3, and 110,000 runes.
Death Knight's Twin Axes: The weapon is obtained as a reward for defeating the Death Knight boss located at the Fog Rift Catacombs .
Crimson Amber Medallion +3: A +3 variant of the Crimson Amber Medallion drops as a reward upon defeating the Death Knight boss located at the Fog Rift Catacombs .
Death Knight: The Death Knight is a boss located at the Fog Rift Catacombs .

place.title: Fog Rift Catacombs

notes: There are no illusory walls in this dungeon.

title: Fire Knight's Cookbook [2]
text: Travel to Castle Front and pick up Fire Knight's Cookbook [2] from a tent in the west-southwest part of the encampment.
Fire Knight's Cookbook [2]: In the soldier camp past Ellac Greatbridge, found inside one of the tents. Beware of the black knight in the area.

title: Firespark Perfume Bottle
text: In the encampment opposite the road sits a chest with the Firespark Perfume Bottle.
Firespark Perfume Bottle: Weapon. Found in a chest guarded by both Perfumers and Messmer Soldiers.

title: Spread Crossbow
text: Drop down the ledges in the cliff southeast of the chest. Near the lower far-right cliff, in front of a tent, lies the Spread Crossbow.

Spread Crossbow: A Spread Crossbow can be found on a body by the riverside and the Ellac Greatbridge. Past the Ellac Greatbridge turn right and head to the lower level. There is a smaller camp with three Messmer Soldiers. There you will find the Spread Crossbow.

guide.title: Clearing the Ruined Forge Lava Intake
text: After clearing Fog Rift Catacombs, proceed to the riverside of Ellac Greatbridge by riding Torrent to the southern area. Eliminate the soldiers here for a chance to get Smithing Stone from them. Then, look for the corpse outside a tent to obtain a Spread Crossbow, a modified crossbow that can load multiple bolts and fire them simultaneously to create a spread of arrow bolts. From here, head east towards a gravesite where you will see Bloodfiends fighting Messmer soldiers. Continue riding ahead until you see the toppled pillars with lanterns. You will see a small entrance that will lead to Ruined Forge Lava Intake.

By the entrance is where you'll find the Ruined Lava Forge Intake Site of Grace. Head down the stairs, turn right, and then climb down the ladder (or jump down). Go forward and turn left into a dead-end room where you'll encounter a Stone Golem enemy. Kill the enemy and then check the floor of this room to find items such as x1 Gas Stone, x1 Smithing Stone [4], and x1 Smithing Stone [1]. There is also a corpse in this room, sitting against the wall from where the Golem was standing. You can loot the body to obtain x4 Smithing Stone [5]. Proceed to the opposite side where you'll encounter a Fire Blob.

Continue going straight until you enter another room where you'll spot a body lying on the ground, near the railings. Loot the body to find x7 Smithing Stone [2] and also x1 Smithing Stone [1], x1 Smithing Stone [3] on the floor, near the corpse. Proceed to the next section on the left side of the body, then walk to the end, and climb down the ladder. On this floor, you'll encounter more enemies, some smithing stones, and x2 Gas Stone that you can pick up. From the ladder, if you look to your right, you'll see some shabby stairs. If you check below, you'll find a corpse that can be looted to obtain x1 Somber Smithing Stone [2].

Head up the stairs and you'll find more smithing stones that you can pick up on the ground, including another body that you can loot to acquire Greater Potentate's Cookbook (13). Around the cookbook item, you can also pick up x1 Smithing Stone [3] on the ground. If you look behind, you'll find a broken pillar that you can use to walk on. Reach the other side and walk around the narrow pathway where you should find x3 Smithing Stone [7] that you can pick up from the floor.
Turn around, and jump across to reach the narrow sides of the platform. You should spot another corpse sitting by the edge of the narrow sides. Loot it to acquire x2 Smithing Stone [4].

Go back to the narrow platform and approach the broken pillar that you used to cross, you should find a path that leads to a ladder that you can climb down. On this section, you'll find more smithing stones you can loot, x1 Glass Shard from a body, and a lever that you can pull. Pulling the lever will bring down a large pillar that you can use to cross and reach an upper section of the forge. Next, climb back up the ladder to go back to the previous room, jump down, and proceed west towards a doorway. But before you go through that doorway, look to the left and you'll find another path leading to a dead end. You should find another Golem sitting in front of a corpse that can be looted. This body holds x1 Somber Smithing Stone [6]. Retrace your steps and head to the doorway, towards the next section.

As you enter the next section, you'll spot another body ahead, next to another Golem, and on the right, is another ladder you can climb down. Before climbing down the ladder, kill the Golem enemy and pillage the body nearby to acquire the Smithscript Dagger and a Smithing Stone [4] near it.

Now jump onto the large pipe and walk to the end. Be wary of the Fire Blob that will drop from the ceiling when you're about midway to the top. Look to your right and you'll find a small room with an altar inside. Jump across and interact with the altar to receive x1 Anvil Hammer and x1 Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone. You can fast travel to the entrance by interacting with the white teleporter that appears next to the altar on the right. Then, teleport to the Castle Front so you can continue exploring the east side of Castle Ensis, leading to Pillar Path Cross - Site of Grace and the Dragon's Pit.

walk: The Elder's Hovel is a shabby cabin located southeast of the Castle Front Site of Grace of Castle Ensis. Inside the run-down shack, players can find a corpse that can be looted to acquire the Talisman of the Dread. Just next to the body is a Spirit NPC sitting on a chair. If spoken to, the spirit responds with:
"O Bayle, tyrant drake, do your wounds yet ache?"
"Is your fury still yet to crest its zenith?"
"Hurry, hurry, and lay it all to waste!"
"Lay waste to the proud, the conceited, each, every last one of that arrogant lot."

NOTE: If you have been following this walkthrough, you would have unlocked Dragon's Pit - Site of Grace. All you need to do is teleport there and skip the bullet guide on how to reach Dragon's Pit. If you haven't unlocked Dragon's Pit, read below:
Teleport to Castle Front - Site of Grace

Continue following this path and you will see Dragon's Pit Entrance on the left side
## The Entrance from Dragon's Pit (The other side of Southern Shore)

Its entrance is a tight cave marked by torches outside. Once you enter the cave, you will eventually encounter the Dragon's Pit Site of Grace. Continuing through the cave, you will enter a more spacious part that resembles a ritual room. There are skeleton enemies here that you need to take out. Afterward, loot the corpse at the back of the ritual area inside a mini cave to obtain a Smithing Stone [1].

Exit the mini cave and turn left, following another tight path until you reach a cliff with a ledge path to the left. Follow the ledge and drop onto the platform below where a skeleton enemy is waiting. After defeating the enemy, go to the altar on the left and loot the corpse to find the Shadow Realm Rune [2].

Turn left from the altar and navigate another tight part of the cave until you enter a room with multiple skeleton enemies and a staircase leading up. Clear the area, then head up the staircase to find a corpse on the left holding Knot Resin. On the right, you will encounter a Lesser Magma Wyrm. After slaying the dragon, loot the corpse near a hole to obtain a Smithing Stone [5].

Return to the staircase and head downstairs until you see another tight part of the cave. After passing through, you will enter a larger section with small structures and torches. Proceed straight ahead and drop down the cliff. Though it’s a long fall, it won't kill you. Upon landing, you will immediately see a yellow mist indicating a boss ahead. Before proceeding through the mist, look back to find a corpse holding a Smithing Stone [4]. The boss in this area is the Ancient Dragon-Man. For a detailed guide on how to defeat this boss, refer to the Ancient Dragon-Man page. This boss drops the Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana.

After defeating the Ancient Dragon-Man, look to the other side where you'll find a large double door. Loot the boss and proceed through this door to reach the Dragon's Pit Terminus Site of Grace, which is also the path leading to the Jagged Peak Region where all the dragons reside. This indicates that defeating the Ancient Dragon-Man unlocks the path to the Jagged Peak Region.

place.title: Suppressing Pillar
walk: The Suppressing Pillar is a tall structure where players can find a single item at the top. It can be found in the east part of the Gravesite Plain region See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. Upon arriving, simply enter the pillar to find a lift, ride it to the top, and you'll spot a treasure chest that contains x1 Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone. There's nothing much else to do here but you can also find a headstone to read a message that says:
"The very center of the Lands Between.
All manners of Death wash up here, only to be suppressed."
On clear weather, the top of the Suppressing Pillar provides the best preview of all of the regions of the Realm of Shadow.

guide.title: Heading to Dragon's Pit
text: NOTE: This section only tells you how to get to Dragon's Pit and where to find important NPCs along the way. We recommend clearing this dungeon later on after you have cleared Cerulean Coast and you're headed to Charo's Hidden Grave.

When you're done exploring Ruined Forge Lava Intake, you will head back outside, then take the path leading south, or teleport to Castle Front - Site of Grace and follow the path. On the way, you will encounter some soldiers gathered at a small camp. Eliminate this small group and then pick up the Swift Spear from a corpse next to the wooden barricade.

After this area, stick to the left side and scale the cliff. There's a Site of Grace that you need to activate so you can come back to it later. This is the Pillar Path Cross that overlooks the area below you. You can also pick up a Scadutree Fragment, 2x Empyrean-Blood Burgeon here next to the cross. You will find Thiollier here seated near the ledge. Speak with him and exhaust his dialogues.

The Rivermouth Cave may also be accessed by going through the path behind Thiollier, however, it is recommended to access this area later by traveling from Scadu Altus, head to Rauh Base, and after Temple Town Ruins. This eliminates backtracking and minimizes the long travel time going there; unless you really want to get the rewards of the dungeon early in your playthrough.

ALTERNATE: From the Pillar-Path Cross - Site of Grace, jump down the rocks behind Thiollier's initial location. Head towards the river and then follow the river going north. This will take you to Ellac River Cave - Site of Grace. Then, continue traveling north to reach the entrance to Rivermouth Cave. This alternate path is recommended if you haven't reached Scadu Altus yet and want to get your hands on Bloodfiend Hexer's Ashes, a unique ash dropped by the dungeon boss. (See the Scadu Altus tab for the Rivermouth Cave exploration).

Whether or not you choose to clear Rivermouth Cave, you will return to the Pillar Path Waypoint and then return to the dirt path. Continue south until you hear a screaming man. This is Igon, a Drake warrior who is screaming in pain. Make sure to talk to him until you exhaust his dialogues and you will find out that the cause of his pain is a powerful boss. NOTE: Do not kill this NPC. It is important to keep him alive because he will play an important role against this boss later on.

For now, head south and stay on the path. Players have reported that a hostile NPC version of Ancient Dragon-Man appeared here. Keep going until you see the hole to your right with a lit lantern on the ground. Go inside and activate the Dragon's Pit - Site of Grace at the bottom of this section. For now, we don't recommend exploring this dungeon yet. Instead, come back here much later after exploring Cerulean Coast, which is when you're going to Charo's Hidden Grave from the Dragon's Pit.

Dragon's Pit serves as the connector that will let players access Jagged Peak, Grand Altar of the Dragon Communion, and Charo's Hidden Grave. At this point, we don't recommend exploring this area yet so you can progress the story, meet important NPCs, and advance their questlines.
This refers to all NPCs that will be affected when Miquella's charm breaks later on.

Silver Horn Tender: Past the bridge, turn left to enter what seems to be a kitchen or a bazaar. Found between some vases on the left side. Roll over the vases to pick up a Silver Horn Tender.
Go back to the bridge, then cross the rooftops on the other side of the street to reach a corpse with Silver Horn Tender x2, Golden Horn Tender x2, and a Somber Smithing Stone [7].
Golden Horn Tender: After picking up the Horned Warrior Ashes, climb up the ladder in the other room and head outside, you'll find a corpse hanging at the edge of the broken rails with this item.
Return to the grace and take the other path up the stairs. Follow the street down to a plaza, where you'll be invaded by Fire Knight Queelign. Defeat him to obtain the Crusade Insignia.

Fire Knight Queelign: As you enter the main plaza, you will be invaded by Fire Knight Queelign. From the Small Private Altar Site of Grace, take the stairs up, and turn to the right past the crumbled area, take the small hallway to reach the main plaza. Beware, there are many shadow enemies in the area and will aggro you easily during this fight. Fire Knight Queelign drops the Crusade Insignia talisman upon defeat.

text: Return to the top of the stairs, then go left twice and ride the lift down the stairs. Pull the lever to unlock the door to the first grace.

Messmerfire Grease: From the second fountain, turn back and move forward. Enemies will attack you from a bridge, turn right as soon as you can. You will find two shadow enemies. You will then find another Messmerfire Grease nearby.
Unlock the well depths door and head southwest toward two fallen towers. Pick up Smithing Stone [6] x4 from the roof of a building near the towers.
Kill the Ulcerated Tree Spirit in the area past the fallen towers for the Immunizing Horn Charm +2.

guide.title: Rivermouth Cave Exploration
text: The Rivermouth Cave is an optional dungeon that can be accessed from Temple Town Ruins. This is still part of Gravesite Plain but this is our recommended path after defeating Rellana and unlocking a gate to Scadu Altus. This is the optimal path that minimizes backtracking. To get here, you need to reach Temple Town Ruins and teleport to the Site of Grace. Then, head south and follow the river to your left. Go past the ruins until you see the waterfall and walk over to the cliff. Carefully look down and locate the platforms that you can jump down on to reach the river below. As you reach the bottom, face the north and you will see a waterfall. Walk through the waterfall to reveal a small cave guarded by three hostile spirit eels. In the center of the cave resides the Two-Headed Turtle Talisman.
Continue navigating southwest and stick to the wall on your right side. You will see the entrance to the Rivermouth Cave a few meters from the platform.

ALTERNATE: From the Pillar-Path Cross - Site of Grace, jump down the rocks behind Thiollier's initial location. Head towards the river and then follow the river going north. This will take you to Ellac River Cave and continue traveling north to reach the entrance to Rivermouth Cave. This is an alternate path recommended if you haven't reached Scadu Altus yet.

As you enter Rivermouth Cave, you will immediately discover the Rivermouth Cave Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. If you go to the cavern going east, you will encounter 4 wolves in an area. In the northeast side of the room, you can pillage a body for x2 Hefty Beast Bone.

As you head deeper, the path will fork. The path on the right will have two hostile wolves along with a dead body that you can loot for x3 Sliver of Meat. This leads to a dead-end, so return to the path and follow the other path. This path will lead you to an area with an upper level and three wolves.

If you climb up the opening on the east side of the area, you will find a body containing loot. When you get closer to loot the body, the ground will collapse, making you fall. You can then loot the body to pick up a Shadow Realm Rune [1]. The path going northwest will be a dead-end, so go down the path east. As you are traversing the eastern path, you can gather x1 Sanguine Amaryllis along the way.

The path will lead you to an area full of Bloodfiends. If you want to go back up, go to the path on your right, and you will encounter a Bloodfiend. After disposing of the enemy, follow the path west going up, in which you will encounter two wolves. Keep following the path, encountering two more wolves along with a dead body that you can loot for x1 Sacred Bloody Flesh. Keep following the path, which is going north, and you will be back in the area before you fell.

If you wish to continue, you can clear the area by sneaking up on the ogres and backstabbing them. They are also easy to deal with, as you can kill them in around two hits. If you aggro them all at the same time, you can fight one of them at a time by dragging the enemies away from the area. After clearing them, you can gather a few Sanguine Amaryllis around the edges of the blood pool. On the altar, you can pick up x3 Sacred Bloody Flesh. In the northern corner of the area, near the ramp where you came from, you can pick up x6 Sanguine Amaryllis. There will be a boss fog nearby.

When you enter the boss room, you will be facing the Chief Bloodfiend. It is a more aggressive version of the Bloodfiends that you encountered earlier. It can jump towards you from afar, while also using its club more effectively than the ones you encountered earlier. For a more in-depth guide on how to defeat the Chief Bloodfiend, you can go refer to this page. Once you have defeated the Chief Bloodfiend, it will drop x1 Bloodfiend Hexer's Ashes. You can find the exit on the southeastern side of the room.

title: Mushroom-Seller's Bell Bearing

Mushroom-Seller's Bell Bearing: From the Temple Town Ruins Site of Grace in the Rauh Ruins, head south east along the water, which will terminate in a waterfall. To the south west of the waterfall there will be several large gravestones along the cliffside, navigate down the gravestones to the pond at the bottom. Head west following the base of the cliff and look for a black pot hanging by a rope on the side of the cliff wall. Destroy the pot to make it drop the Bell Bearing.

Pick up the Hefty Beast Bone x2 guarded by some wolves in the first room.
Past the first room, go right for an alcove with Sliver of Meat x3.
Step on the crack in the floor up the rocks in the next room. Pick up the Shadow Realm Rune [1] after landing.
Shadow Realm Rune [1]: Consumable found inside Rivermouth Cave. Looted from a corpse on collapsible ground shortly after a wolf ambush.
Continue to a cavern, then follow the right path to a corpse with Sacred Bloody Flesh.

Sacred Bloody Flesh: x1. In the underground Ruins, the area can be accessed via the Square shaped elevator south of the location and it will go down. It will be close to the Rune arc. It will be close to the Sacred Bloody Flesh.
Return to the cavern. Pick up Sanguine Amaryllis x6 from the corpse in the alcove and Sacred Bloody Flesh x3 from the altar.
Sanguine Amaryllis: x5 On the pond west of Taylew's Ruined Forge Site of Grace. Protected by various Bloodfiends and dogs
Kill the Chief Bloodfiend for Bloodfiend Hexer's Ashes and 80,000 runes.
Chief Bloodfiend: Found inside Rivermouth Cave. Drops 80,000 Runes and Bloodfiend Hexer's Ashes.
Bloodfiend Hexer's Ashes: Dropped by the Chief Bloodfiend at Rivermouth Cave.

text: Travel to Ellac River Cave and head downstream. Pick up the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [12] on a rocky platform past the waterfall.
Greater Potentate's Cookbook [12]: To find the book, descend from the top of the waterfall using the rocks as steps. The book can be looted from a corpse leaning on one of the elevated rocks.

Drop down the third waterfall to find a corpse with Thin Beast Bones x6 next to a tall rock in the water.
Grab the Ellac River Downstream grace on dry land near the tall rock.
Shoot down the pot hanging in front of the last waterfall to obtain Mushroom-Seller's Bell Bearing [2].

Mushroom-Seller's Bell Bearing [2]: Ellac River Downstream: Obtain this key item by shooting down a pot hanging from the side of the waterfall south from Ellac River Downstream site of grace. You can see the pot when traversing the large rock to descend from above across the river.

place.title: Dragon's Pit
walk: Dragon's Pit is found by following the path southwest nearby Igon, from the Pillar Path Waypoint Site of Grace. Its entrance is a tight cave marked by torches outside. Once you enter the cave, you will eventually encounter the Dragon's Pit Site of Grace. Continuing through the cave, you will enter a more spacious part that resembles a ritual room. There are skeleton enemies here. Afterward, loot the corpse at the back of the ritual area inside a mini cave to obtain a Smithing Stone [1].

Exit the mini cave and turn left, following another tight path until you reach a cliff with a ledge path to the left. Follow the ledge and drop onto the platform below where a skeleton enemy is waiting. After defeating the enemy, go to the altar on the left and loot the corpse to find the Shadow Realm Rune [2].

Turn left from the altar and navigate another tight part of the cave until you enter a room with multiple skeleton enemies and a staircase leading up. Clear the area, then head up the staircase to find a corpse on the left holding Knot Resin. On the right, you will encounter a Lesser Magma Wyrm. After slaying the dragon, loot the corpse near a hole to obtain a Smithing Stone [5].

Return to the staircase and head downstairs until you see another tight part of the cave. After passing through, you will enter a larger section with small structures and torches. Proceed straight ahead and drop down the cliff. Though it’s a long fall, it won't kill you. Upon landing, you will immediately see a yellow mist indicating a boss ahead. Before proceeding through the mist, look back to find a corpse holding a Smithing Stone [4]. The boss in this area is the Ancient Dragon-Man. For a detailed guide on how to defeat this boss, refer to the Ancient Dragon-Man page. This boss drops the Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana.

After defeating the Ancient Dragon-Man, look to the other side where you'll find a large double door. Loot the boss and proceed through this door to reach the Dragon's Pit Terminus Site of Grace, which is also the path leading to the Jagged Peak Region where all the dragons reside.
