guide.title: Exploring Cerulean Coast
text: Teleport to Castle Front - Site of Grace (this is in front of Castle Ensis). Face south, then turn left on the first dirt path. Stay on this path until a small encampment near the river comes into view. Head towards them and remain on this new dirt path. As you see the Bloodfiends and Messmer soldiers fighting, turn left again, to head towards the river. Continue down here until you get to the toxic swamp and then remain on the left side. Watch out for the Miranda Sprout of varying sizes here.

Go past the swamp and keep heading west. Keep to the left side and then jump down on the river where you see the giant Miranda Sprout. Go through the narrow entryway next to it. Once you are inside the cave, turn left, and another left until you see the site of grace. Activate the Ellac River Cave - Site of Grace before proceeding so you have a checkpoint. Next, jump down the rocks while facing south. Be careful on your way down here because you can fall off and result in an instant death. Follow the stream of the waterfall here and take your time jumping down between the stone pillars.

Once you reach the lower level, you will find gravebirds on top of pillars as you're heading south. Go through them and ride as fast as you can while sprinting with Torrent. After this area, you will jump between stone pillars again, so you need to be careful here. As you reach another lower area, you can activate another Site of Grace, the Ellac River Downstream.

Continue heading south and jump down the rocks on the right side. As you reach the lower level, you will see a giant stone pillar on your left. Cross to the other side using it as a bridge. This will take you to the ground level and you're now close to reaching Cerulean Coast. Continue riding south and go past the creatures here. As the Furnace Golem comes into view, switch to the area on the right side and remain there. It's up to you if you want this Furnace Golem, but we recommend on getting the Site of Grace first, then backtrack here to fight it later.

Continue riding south and hug this area on your right until you come across a big gap in the wall. Go through it and you will enter an area of blue flowers. You can now activate the Cerulean Coast - Site of Grace directly ahead of you. Then, you can backtrack to the area where you saw the Furnace Golem. You can also locate the Forager Brood near the forest of lightning rams here. You will receive the Forager Brood Cookbook [3] from it.

Return to the Cerulean Coast - Site of Grace. Your first stop here is obtaining the Map: Southern Shore. Head south and go past the 3 small patches of land. A Ghostflame Dragon will come swooping down here but you can just outrun it if you don't want to fight it. If you want to defeat it, you can obtain a Dragon Heart and a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone upon killing it. Head south and go past the glowing worm creatures. You will spot the map to your right as you climb a flowery slope cut between jagged rock.

After obtaining the map, continue up the slope then make a left to travel southeast. You will reach Miquella's Cross here next to a Site of Grace. Pick up the Scadutree Fragment and interact with the Cerulean Coast - Site of Grace. This time, travel west and stick to the cliff on your left. As you're passing through the glowing worm-like creatures, and heap up the slope. Watch out for the giant that will throw boulders at you here. You can kill it for a Hefty Cracked Pot. Continue traveling south until you see a large hole in the ground. Carefully navigate to the bottom by jumping down.
You can minimize fall damage by riding Torrent as you go down and at the bottom, you will reach The Fissure - Site of Grace.

The St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook [2] can found in a cliff within the area. From Cerulean Coast Cross follow the path south until the very end to the highest cliff of the mountain. It is nearby the hole but not in the hole.

title: Boss: Demi-Human Queen Marigga
text: Continue to the beach and kill Demi-Human Queen Marigga for the Star-Lined Sword and 100,000 runes.
Demi-Human Queen Marigga: The Demi-Human Queen Marigga is located in Cerulean Coast
Star-Lined Sword: Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Marigga, who can be found in Cerulean Coast's Demi-Human Valley.

title: Perfumed Oil of Ranah
text: Pick up a Great Grave Glovewort from the stone coffin on the beach.
Great Grave Glovewort: Cerulean Coast: Can be found on a corpse atop the broken structure near the area where you fought Demi-Human Queen Marigga.
Return to Cerulean Coast West and head southeast back to the large dead tree. Descend the cave below the tree, then follow the tunnel east to a Somber Smithing Stone [6].
Continue up the tunnel to reach a stone coffin with a Great Grave Glovewort.

Great Grave Glovewort: Looted from the bow of a large stone coffin, accessed only by following the underground path from the cave found alongside the shore just south of the Cerulean Coast West site of grace
Go back down the tunnel and follow it to a corpse with Crab Eggs x2, guarded by a Crayfish.
Crab Eggs: 2x Looted from the ground in the underground cave connecting the Southern Nameless Mausoleum to the mainland, by a Giant Lobster.
Head through the rest of the tunnel, then grab the Perfumed Oil of Ranah from the top of the cave exit.
Perfumed Oil of Ranah: Tool looted from a corpse atop the island where you emerge from the cave connecting to the mainland.

title: Boss: Dancer of Ranah
text: Enter the mausoleum on the other side of the island and kill the Dancer of Ranah for Dancing Blade of Ranah, Dancer's Set and 80,000 runes.
Dancer of Ranah: Found at the Southern Nameless Mausoleum Drops: Dancing Blade of Ranah , Dancer's Hood , Dancer's Dress , Dancer's Bracer , and Dancer's Trousers

Dancer's Set: The following armor pieces of the Dancer's Set can be obtained after defeating the Dancer of Ranah found inside Southern Nameless Mausoleum . Dancer's Hood Dancer's Dress Dancer's Bracer Dancer's Trousers
Dancing Blade of Ranah: Dropped by defeating Dancer of Ranah at the Southern Nameless Mausoleum

place.title: Southern Nameless Mausoleum
walk: The Southern Nameless Mausoleum is located within the Cerulean Coast region, the southern section of the map. The location is an arena where you can fight against a mini-boss, the Dancer of Ranah. As indicated in the image below, head to the location that's marked in the Cerulean Coast, which is towards the edge of a cliff and near a withered tree. From there, check the left to find a narrow path (below the tree) that leads to a hole that you can drop to enter a cave.

When you reach the bottom, face the compass towards the west and go straight until you exit the cave. You can ride your mount here and avoid fighting the Giant Crab inside the cave. As you exit, you should find yourself on the small island if you open the map. As soon as you reach the surface on the little island, go on top of the rock on the entrance and there's a reusable item "Perfumed Oil of Ranah" held by a corpse. Make a right towards the shore, then up the hill on the left where you'll find a field of blue glowing flowers and the mausoleum. By the entrance, there is a Summoning Pool or effigy for players to use for co-op. There is also a Stake of Marika that you can use to respawn by the entrance of the mausoleum in case you die. As mentioned, the location is where you'll fight against a mini-boss, so make preparations before you pass through the mist. For guides and strategies on how to defeat the boss, please visit the Dancer of Ranah page or view the video guide above.
Defeating this mini-boss rewards the player with the following items:
Dancer's Set
Dancing Blade of Ranah

title: Map: Southern Shore
text: Kill the Ghostflame Dragon south of the Cerulean Coast grace for Dragon Heart, Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone, and 120,000 runes.
Loot the Human Bone Shard, Smithing Stone [7] x4, and Grave Cricket x6 on the outer edge of one of the islands.
Grab another Grave Cricket x6 from the corpse in front of a large gravestone on the last island.
Go up the slope past the last island to find a stele with Map: Southern Shore.
Map: Southern Shore: From the Cerulean Coast Cross Site of Grace, follow the path northwest and you'll find this map.

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: From the stele, head south-southeast and up the hillside with the cross to discover the Cerulean Coast Cross grace.
Grab the Scadutree Fragment, then touch the cross to unlock dialogue with Ansbach about the cross at the coast.
Scadutree Fragment: Located in a cave guarded by a Demi-Human Chief. x1 Scadutree Fragment is looted from a dead body inside the cave.

title: Hefty Cracked Pot
text: Head northwest and climb the stone coffin above the map stele for a Grave Glovewort [9].
Grave Glovewort [9]: Charro's Hidden Grave: Can be found con a corpse surrounded by broken tombstones past the Death Rite Bird boss battle.
Follow the road near the coffin southwest to find a corpse with Whiteflesh Mushroom x4.
Take out the Troll throwing pots at you to obtain a Hefty Cracked Pot.
Hefty Cracked Pot: Lamenter's Gaol. Can be found on a corpse in an area full of Living Jar enemies. Near a treasure chest.

title: St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook [2], Talk to St. Trina
text: Pick up a Grave Glovewort [8] from the large stone coffin past the road.
Head through the left side of the meadow past the coffin to find St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook [2] at the top.
St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook [2]: Cerulean Coast: Can be found on a corpse at the edge of a cliff near the entrance to Stone Coffin Fissure

St. Trina: NPC is located at the end of the Stone Coffin Fissure. You will need to defeat the Putrescent Knight boss first to reach the very end of the Stone Coffin Fissure. From the Garden of Purple Site of Grace, go straight and follow the path until you enter the room filled with purple-glowing flowers.

title: St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook [1]
text: Find a way down the massive hole, then grab the Shadow Realm Rune [1] on a lower ledge.
Shadow Realm Rune [1]: Slowly descend down the area and you'll find a corpse with this item.
Continue down the hole to reach a corpse with Deep-Purple Lily x3, then activate The Fissure grace at the bottom for later.
Return to Cerulean Coast Cross and head north to reach the top of a coffin with a Grave Glovewort [9].
Grave Glovewort [9]: Lying in front of a bull statue at the top of a Stone Coffin north of Cerulean Coast Cross Site of Grace.
Drop down from the east end of the coffin, then drop down the cliff below it to reach a stone coffin with a Great Grave Glovewort.
Great Grave Glovewort: Lying in front of a bull statue at the top of a Stone Coffin northeast of Cerulean Coast Cross Site of Grace.
Return to the previous coffin, then from its edge, jump toward an area with a dead tree. Pick up St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook [1] next to it.

St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook [1]: From the Cerulean Coast Cross site of grace, head north to a hill with a large wilted tree being guarded by a Cemetery Shade. There will be a sitting corpse under the tree, which holds the Cookbook.

title: Finger-Weaver's Cookbook [1]
text: Pick up a Great Grave Glovewort from the stone coffin north-northeast of the dead tree.

Great Grave Glovewort: From Charo's Hidden Grave Site of Grace, continue down south and follow the path sticking to the cliff's edge, drop down to the stone coffin below and you'll find this material in front of a bull statue.
Head east-southeast toward the beach until you see a corpse with Arrow x10 in the shallow water.
Go up the zigzag slope with cerulean flowers to find Smithing Stone [6] x3 next to two large gravestones.
Head back down and pick up the Shadow Realm Rune [2] at the end of the beach.
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [9] from the large stone coffin to the northwest.
Grave Glovewort [9]: Can be found at the end of the broken-down stone coffin.
Follow the path from the stone coffin to discover the Finger Ruins of Rhia grace.
Optional: Going down the slope, you'll come to a fork. The upward path leads to a coffin that can duplicate any remembrance. Optionally, mark it on your map for later use.
Head to the bottom, then go west toward the slope with cerulean flowers. Follow it until you reach a shack with Finger-Weaver's Cookbook [1].

Finger-Weaver's Cookbook [1]: Can be found at Finger-Weaver's Hovel. Accessible via Finger Ruins of Rhia following the path to the left and heading straight underneath the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion.
Optional: Talk to Ansbach about the cross at the coast.

place.title: Finger Ruins of Rhia
walk: Meet Count Ymir at the Cathedral of Manus Metyr and speak to him, he will give you the Ruins Map and the Hole-Laden Necklace. Follow his instructions with the map and head to Finger Ruin of Rhia.

Fast travel to the Finger Ruins of Rhia Site of Grace and make your way down, be careful of the Fingercreepers and Lamprey there. Once you reach the bell, interact with it and you will be granted the Crimson Seed Talisman +1.
Return to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr and speak with Count Ymir again and he will grant you the Ruins Map (2nd) and Beloved Stardust. It is time to head to Finger Ruins of Dheo for the next bell.
notes: You can get to the Southern Shore from the Gravesite Plain following the Ellac River downstream. Cross the Ellac Greatbridge, then head down the slope to the right and stick to the left wall until you reach Ellac River Cave. From here, you can follow the river downstream to reach Cerulean Coast.

The plateau on top of the large ramp leading into the Ruins has a Remembrance Duplication Coffin that can be used to duplicate Remembrances in the same manner as a Walking Mausoleum. Elden Ring Map Link

title: Boss: Jagged Peak Drake
text: Travel to the Dragon's Pit Terminus grace and exit east-southeast. At the edge of the cliff overlooking the drake, you can find a message left by Igon.
Kill the Jagged Peak Drake for Dragon Heart, Dragonscale Flesh, and 90,000 runes.
Jagged Peak Drake: The Jagged Peak Drake is located in an empty plain between the Suppressing Pillar and Finger Ruins of Rhia .
Dragon Heart: Dropped by the Jagged Peak Drake .
Dragonscale Flesh: Dropped by the Jagged Peak Drake .

guide.title: Into the Dragon Area
text: From the Dragon's Pit Terminus - Site of Grace, head towards the east where you will encounter Jagged Peak Drake, this is a dragon resting in the middle of the open ground. It's up to you if you want to fight this dragon but you can just skip it and head west so you can avoid it. If you decide to fight it, the Jagged Peak Drake can breathe fire and stomp you with its massive legs and wings. When defeated, it drops a Dragon Heart and Dragonscale Flesh. Then, head towards the south where the path narrows. You will encounter skeletons and some fire-breathing enemies here. After a while, you will find a new location called Grant Altar of Dragon Communion.

Speak to the NPC named Dragon Communion Priestess to receive Ancient Dragon's Blessing. There's also a nearby Site of Grace that you can activate here. This is your last stop before heading to Charo's Hidden Grave.

title: Igon's Cookbook [1]
text: Go through the ravine south of the dragon and pick up Red Fulgurbloom x3 from the upper east ledge near the end.
Pick up Igon's Cookbook [1] from the remains of a tower past the ravine.
Igon's Cookbook [1]: Can be found on a corpse in the broken tower just before the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion.

title: Talk to Dragon Communion Priestess
text: Approach the massive dragon corpse and grab the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion grace next to it.
Talk to Florissax and agree to devour draconic essence to receive an Ancient Dragon's Blessing.
Dragon Communion Priestess: Can be found near the exit of the Dragon's Pit towards the south, standing next to the Dragon Communion altar.
Ancient Dragon's Blessing: Given by Dragon Communion Priestess located near the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion.

place.title: Grand Altar of Dragon Communion
walk: From the Dragon's Pit Terminus Site of Grace at the end of Dragon's Pit, head east until you reach a body of water where a sleeping Jagged Peak Drake lies. Be careful not to disturb the Drake unless you are ready for a fight. The path will split into two at this point; take the southern path to reach the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion. The Dragon Communion Priestess will be standing next to the altar (see that page for more info on her questline).

title: Grave Keeper's Cookbook [2]
text: Optional: Talk to Florissax again and ask her about Bayle.
Optional: Examine the altar behind her and buy any dragon communion incantations you need.
Pick up the 3x Dragon Communion Harpoon on the dragon's wing (the third is on the lowest part of the wing).
Dragon Communion Harpoon: Consumable looted atop the wing of the giant dead dragon.
Grab the Dragon Communion Grease in front of a smaller dragon corpse on the other side of the massive dragon.
Dragon Communion Grease: Can be found on one of the dragon corpses in the area.
Enter the area with crimson flowers near the tail, then grab the Grave Keeper's Cookbook [2] behind some rocks in the water.
Grave Keeper's Cookbook [2]: Charo's Hidden Grave: Can be found on a corpse in the sourthern area

place.title: Finger-Weaver's Hovel
walk: The Finger-Weaver's Hovel See Elden Ring Map is located at the Cerulean Coast, southwest of the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion. You can get to the Cerulean Coast from the Pillar Path Cross Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map directly south of Castle Ensis. Head north of the Site of Grace, wherein you will follow the cliff until you see a part of it that you can jump on. Make your way to the bottom using the rocks, then head south to a cave opening leading to the Ellac River Cave Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. Keep heading south until you get to the waterfalls, then carefully jump across the rock formations. Head south, and you can activate the Ellac River Downstream Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. From here until you see glowing blue flowers around the area, which means that you are in the Cerulean Coast. You will then have to traverse through cliffs and rock formations to cross to a graveyard area. Keep heading straight, passing through the naturally formed archway, and you'll end up in the Cerulean Coast.

Finger-Weaver's Hovel can be found northwest of the Finger Ruins of Rhia Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. You can head down the naturally forming ramp down from there and head west until you find a dilapidated shack with a Spirit NPC sitting in the middle of the shack. You can pick up the Finger-Weaver's Cookbook [1] on the southeastern corner of the hovel. There are bears located nearby the Finger-Weaver's Hovel, so be prepared to face them in combat as you are exploring.

guide.title: Charo's Hidden Grave
text: Head up the dragon's body by facing southwest. Climb it to the top then face south until the red flowers come into view. Then,turn right to formally enter Charo's Hidden Grave. Head southwest until you make it to Charo's Hidden Grave. This area is filled with various gravesite locations and are guarded by mostly skeleton enemies. This is a location filled with red flowers on the ground and is the area above Cerulean Coast.

Jump down into the water and then pick up the Grave Keeper's Cookbook [2] Continue riding northwest and you will see a Tibia Mariner here on the water. Defeat this enemy to obtain Tibia's Cookbook. After defeating the Tibia Mariner, you can head east to find a Grave Keeper's Brainpan which is surrounded by trees and rocks on a drop. Then, continue riding northwest to activate the Charo's Hidden Grave Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map before a small archway and near the cliff edge. From here, you can even see the Cerulean Coast at the lower area. Northeast of the Site of Grace, you can find a Deathbird statue surrounded by Gravebirds, in which you'll find the Rings of Spectral Light sorcery at the base of the statue.

Beyond this area, you will fight a Death Rite Bird. This is an optional boss found in the middle of the body of the lake here. If you defeat the Death Rite Bird in this place, you will obtain the Ash of War: Ghostflame Call. Now, return to the Site of Grace, then head north to obtain the Spirit Glaive halberd. Afterwards, you can head southwest until you encounter a Hippopotamus. Defeat it, and you will obtain a Scadutree Fragment from it as a drop.

Head west and go past the Blue Worms. You will start to see metal barricades and broken prison cages. Stick to the wall on your right and you will find the entrance to Lamenter's Gaol with red flowers leading to it. Head inside until you find the Lamenter's Gaol Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map

title: Boss: Tibia Mariner
text: Kill the Tibia Mariner in the water to obtain Tibia's Cookbook.
Tibia's Cookbook: Dropped by Tibia Mariner upon defeat, located west of Finger-Weaver's Hovel.
Tibia Mariner: Drops Tibia's Cookbook upon defeat.

title: Rings of Spectral Light
text: Head up the rightmost slope and grab the Grave Glovewort [9] amidst some gravestones at the top.
Grave Glovewort: Cerulean Coast: Lying in front of a bull statue at the top of a wrecked Stone Coffin along the coast line.
Continue up the northwest slope to reach a corpse with Rings of Spectral Light below a large Gravebird statue.
Rings of Spectral Light: Looted from the altar by the giant bird statue after defeating several birds

title: Boss: Death Rite Bird (Charo's Hidden Grave)
text: Pick up the Call of Tibia next to some gravestones northeast of the statue.
Call of Tibia: Looted from a grave by a skeleton ambush
Head back down and grab the Charo's Hidden Grave grace past the water.
Follow the cliff edge southeast until you see a stone coffin below the cliff. Drop onto it for a Great Grave Glovewort.
Return to the grace and kill the Death Rite Bird in the water past the arch for Ash of War: Ghostflame Call and 230,000 runes.
Ash of War: Ghostflame Call: Dropped by the Death Rite Bird .
Death Rite Bird: The Death Rite Bird Boss is located in Charo's Hidden Grave

title: Greater Potentate's Cookbook [14]
text: Follow the water southwest and grab the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [14] behind a Miranda Blossom.
Greater Potentate's Cookbook [14]: Can be found on a corpse on top of a dilapidated structure behind a Giant Miranda Sprout.

title: Scadutree Fragment, Boss: Hippopotamus
text: Head up the slope behind the Miranda Blossom and kill the Hippopotamus in the water for a Scadutree Fragment.
Scadutree Fragment: x1 Fragment dropped by the Undead Hippo found in this area of Charon's Hidden Grave.
Hippopotamus: A miniboss Hippopotamus is found here. Drops 1x Scadutree Fragment

title: Spirit Glaive
text: Pick up Ghostflame Bloom x4 from the corpse in the water.
Return to the grace and follow the right path after the arch to find the Spirit Glaive next to some gravestones up the middle slope.
Spirit Glaive: Charro's Hidden Grave: This Halberd Can be found on a corpse surrounded by gravestones in the northeastern edges of the area.

title: Gaol Upper Level Key
text: If you didn't kill the Furnace Golem in Ellac River, you can do it now by throwing Hefty Furnace or Fire Pots into its basket from the ledge below.
Pick up the Grave Glovewort [9] at the edge of the water after dropping down south-southwest of the Spirit Glaive.
Follow the water down to an area with multiple cages, then continue along the trail to find a Ghost Glovewort [8] guarded by Spirit Eels.
Return along the trail to the cages outside the entrance to Lamenter's Gaol:
Head inside and grab the Lamenter's Gaol grace.
Loot the Gaol Upper Level Key from a chest in the room just before the stone bridge.

Gaol Upper Level Key: Can be found within Lamenter's Gaol. When you enter, proceed until you reach a fork in the path. Take the left turn, and after a short walk, enter the room on your right. Inside, you'll find a chest containing the Gaol Upper Level Key.

title: Prattling Pate "Lamentation"
text: Go across the stone bridge and pick up the Prattling Pate "Lamentation" at the end.
Prattling Pate "Lamentation": Lamenter's Gaol. Climb up the long ladder, cross the connecting stone bridge, and enter the room on the left, you'll find this key item on a corpse.

title: Chilling Perfume Bottle
text: Unlock the door at the start and descend the ladder inside. Grab the Chilling Perfume Bottle from the first room on the right.
Chilling Perfume Bottle: Can be found within Lamenter's Gaol. In a small room at the lower floor area, the first room to the right after exiting the ladder room.

title: Clarifying Horn Charm +2
text: Drop down the hole opposite the first room, then turn around to pick up Innard Meat x2.

Innard Meat: Bonny Gaol: Continue following the stream of water until you see an opening at the end. Watch out for hiding enemies here and make sure that you are ready for them. They will come out as soon as you step near an item. Take the Innard Meat on the ground here.
Follow the tunnel to a fork, then enter the room straight ahead to find the Clarifying Horn Charm +2.

Clarifying Horn Charm +2: Lamenter's Gaol. After dropping down the small cave infested with rats, continue following the path and go straight. You'll find this talisman on a corpse on the right side once you enter the area.

place.title: Lamenter's Gaol
walk: ER Shadow of the Erdtree Lamenter's Gaol Video Walkthrough

The entrance to Lamenter's Gaol is just southeast of the Gravesite Plain site of grace on the map, and directly east of the Artist's Shack. Head northwest behind the huge dead dragon at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion site of grace. Keep going above the Cerulean Coast and you'll eventually find the entrance to Lamenter's Gaol. Look for fences and metal cages outside the cave entrance. At the Lamenter's Gaol Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map, keep following the path going southeast until you arrive near a locked gate. Before the locked gate, there will be an opening on the left side of the wall. Go through the path on your left, then keep following the path.

You'll find two rooms with an open gate on the right side as you are traversing the path. The first room will only contain a Putrid Corpse. In the second room, you will encounter two Putrid Corpses. After dealing with the enemies in this room, open the chest to receive x1 Gaol Upper Level Key, which will be used to open the locked gate that you encountered earlier. Return to the path then keep following it until you cross a bridge. Enter the room across the bridge, in which you will encounter a Living Jar along with a Putrid Corpse. The room will be filled with numerous cages. On the northern side of the room, you'll find another room with three cages. On a dead body by the middle cage, you can pick up x1 Prattling Pate Lamentation.

title: Gaol Lower Level Key
text: Climb the ladder in the other room, then explore until the floor collapses. Enter the first cell up the stairs to find a Call of Tibia.

Call of Tibia: Can be found within Lamenter's Gaol. After dropping down the destructible path, exit the room and head up the stairs. Take the path on the right and you'll find a small room with a corpse with this item.
Hit the illusory wall outside the room to reveal another cell, but you don't have the key for it yet.
Go through the second cell up the stairs to reach a large room. Pick up the Hefty Cracked Pot on a mountain of corpses.
Loot the Gaol Lower Level Key from a chest farther in and pick up Living Jar Shard x6 from the nearby corpse.
Gaol Lower Level Key: Lamenter's Gaol. Can be found on a chest in an area full of Living Jar enemies.

title: Lamenting Visage
text: Unlock the cell behind the illusory wall to reach a room with a Shadow Realm Rune [4] and the Lamenting Visage.
Lamenting Visage: Inside a room on the lower level of the Lamenter's Gaol , you'll need to obtain the Gaol Lower Level Key to gain access.

Shadow Realm Rune [4]: Inside a room on the lower level of the Lamenter's Gaol, hidden behind an illusory wall. In the area you fall through the floor, go up the stairs and into the the first doorway. Roll into the end of the passageway, and use the Gaol Lower Level Key to open the door.

title: Boss: Lamenter
text: Head through the top cell and unlock the door in the room below. Kill the Lamenter for Lamenter's Mask and 160,000 runes.
Lamenter: Can be found inside Lamenter's Gaol. Drops Lamenter's Mask and 160,000 Runes.
Lamenter's Mask: A stone mask twisted into an expression of rapturous grief. Use while disrobed to transform into a lamenter. Dropped by Lamenter at Lamenter's Gaol.

title: Boss: Furnace Golem (Charo's Grave)
text: Go up the slope south-southeast of the entrance, then follow the west-northwest cliff edge to a Ghost Glovewort [9].
Ghost Glovewort [9]: Can be found on a corpse surrounded by Gravebird statues, at least two of them are enemies.
Continue up the hillside and grab the Fireproof Pickled Liver at the upper end of the water.
Fireproof Pickled Liver: Can be found on a corpse near at the wall.
Take the spiritspring at the top, then kill the Furnace Golem for the Glovewort Crystal Tear and a Furnace Visage.
Glovewort Crystal Tear: The item drops from the Furnace Golem located around Charo's Grave.
Furnace Golem: The Furnace Golem is located around Charo's Grave. Defeating it drops the following item/s: x1 Glovewort Crystal Tear x1 Furnace Visage

title: Gravebird Ashes
text: Note: This one has armored legs, which means you'll have to throw Hefty Furnace or Fire Pots into its basket to kill it.
After taking out the Furnace Golem, you can safely loot the Gravebird Ashes near the top.
Gravebird Ashes: Use the spiritspring to reach the area, you'll find this item surrounded by gravestones.

title: Milady
text: Travel to Castle Front and grab the Black Pyrefly x3 on the bridge to the castle bridge.
Kill the Troll Knight past the bridge for a Somber Smithing Stone [9] and Royal Magic Grease x3.
Royal Magic Grease: 3x Dropped by the nonrespawning troll guarding the main bridge entrance of Castle Ensis
Somber Smithing Stone [9]: Dropped by the nonrespawning troll guarding the main bridge entrance of Castle Ensis
Pick up a Shadow Realm Rune [4] from the building on the right.
Shadow Realm Rune [4]: x1 Shadow Realm Rune [4] can be looted off a body inside an armory room.
Go around the building to find a Somber Smithing Stone [6] on the lower roof.
Somber Smithing Stone [6]: x1 Somber Smithing Stone [6] can be looted off a corpse. The body is found on a broken watchtower that is guarded by a Page enemy.
A Somber Smithing Stone [5] lies on the cliff edge opposite the building.
Somber Smithing Stone [5]: x1 Somber Smithing Stone [5] can be looted off a corpse. The body can be found lying on the floor of a watchpoint of the bridge. The area is guarded by soldiers and hounds.
Walk around the ledge halfway up the stairs to reach a corpse with a Broken Rune.
Broken Rune: Consumable. Looted from a corpse hanging from a grassy ledge near the entrance to Castle Ensis Bridge
Go left at the top of the slope, then climb the ladder to a chest with the Milady.
Milady: The Milady Light Greatsword weapon can be found inside a chest. The chest is located at the top of a watchtower.

guide.title: Castle Ensis Entrance
text: After clearing the building, follow the path leading to a staircase heading up. Before heading up the stairs, you can loot a corpse on a cliff on the west side for a Somber Smithing Stone [1]. Then, climb the stairs going up. In the middle of the stairs, you can find a cliff that you can get to, which you can loot a corpse for a Broken Rune. Keep following the stiars going up, and you will encounter a Messmer Soldier along with a Rotten Stray on the right side. On the left side, another Messmer Soldier and a Rotten Stray will be heading down the stairs. Defeat the enemies, then climb up the stairs to get on top of the wall structure. Climb up the ladder in the area, then open the chest to obtain the Milady light greatsword. Afterwards, head back down the stairs then follow the cavern opposite of the stairs.

At the end of the cavern, you will be near the entrance to Castle Ensis. Right at the exit of the cavern, you can loot a corpse for x2 Flight Pinion. Follow the ramp heading up, and you will find two Messmer Soldiers gathering around a fire. Defeat the enemies, then jump down the ledge near the area. You can find a corpse containing x10 Bolt here. Head inside the cavern, and you can loot a dead body hanging by a ledge for x3 Glintslab Firefly. Drop down, and you'll find yourself in the short cavern you were in earlier. Go back outside, then go up the first small ramp.

On the first level of the ramp, you can find the Loyal Knight's Cookbook inside a chest in a room on the left side. Head back outside, then go up the second ramp. You will encounter a Black Knight here, so be prepared for combat. After defeating the Black Knight, head up the second ramp. In the middle of the second ramp, you can find a small opening which leads to a corpse. By the corpse, a Rotten Stray will be waiting around the corner to attack you. Defeat the Rotten Stray, then loot the corpse for a Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot. Go up the third ramp, and you'll find a closed gate. On the left side, you can find a Scadutree Fragment and a Castle Cross Message. Nearby, you can activate the Castle Ensis Checkpoint Site of Grace. You can pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [1] on a corpse west of the Site of Grace.

title: Loyal Knight's Cookbook
text: Pick up Flight Pinion x2 from the corpse on the ground past the short tunnel.
Loot the Loyal Knight's Cookbook from a chest in the building halfway up the slope.
Loyal Knight's Cookbook: The Loyal Knight's Cookbook can be found inside a chest. The chest is located inside an armory room.

title: Boss: Ghost Troll
text: Ghost Troll: A Ghost Troll elite enemy can be found here. It drops x9 Somber Smithing Stone [8] upon defeat.

title: Castle Cross Message, Scadutree Fragment
text: Drop down the cliff west of the building to reach a corpse with Bolt x10 on a lower ledge.
Go through the short tunnel behind the corpse to reach a ledge with Glintslab Firefly x3.
Glintslab Firefly: 3x Glintslab Firefly can be looted from a body.
Return to the slope and grab the Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot in a dead end on the right.
Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot: x1 can be looted off a body. The body can be found in a dark alleyway.
Pick up the Castle Cross Message and Scadutree Fragment by the cross.
Castle Cross Message: The letter can be found next to a Miquella's Cross and the Castle Ensis site of grace.
Scadutree Fragment: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be found beside Miquella's Cross of the Castle Ensis Checkpoint Site of Grace.

title: Invader: Moonrithyll, Carian Knight +1
text: Activate the Castle Ensis Checkpoint grace and grab the Somber Smithing Stone [5] behind it.
Pick up Knot Resin x3 from a lower ledge opposite the cross.
Knot Resin: x3 Knot Resin can be looted off a body.
Drop to the bottom and pick up Arrow x10 from the corpse guarded by three dogs.
Continue to a cliff, then go right to reach a rooftop with Starlight Shards.
Starlight Shards: Consumable found only by dropping down into the castle from the Scadu Altus side and platforming to the higher area above the bridge entrance.
Follow the cliff up the waterfall, then continue upstream to find Drawstring Royal Magic Grease x3 below the waterfall at the end.
A corpse with Knot Resin x4 sits in the cave behind the waterfall.
Knot Resin: x4 Knot Resin can be looted off a corpse. The body is found inside a cave near the waterfall.
Climb the ladder near the waterfall and push the lever to open the gate back to the grace.
Cross the bridge past the gate and pick up String x3 from the cliff on the left.
String: X3 Can be lootedd off a body. The body is found passing the bridge protected by soldiers.
A corpse with a Glintslab Firefly lies on the cliff edge up ahead.
Glintslab Firefly: Can be looted off a corpse. The body is found lying by the edge of a cliff.
Climb the ladder in the grassy area beside the stairs to reach a Somber Smithing Stone [7].
Somber Smithing Stone [7]: x1 Somber Smithing Stone [7] can be found in the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past location. Loot from a corpse at a dead end after opening the first gate
Go up the stairs and kill Moonrithyll, Carian Knight to obtain Moonrithyll's Knight Sword.
Moonrithyll, Carian Knight: This hostile NPC Invader can be found by the chapel's entrance.
Moonrithyll's Knight Sword: The weapon drops from defeating the hostile NPC Invader, Moonrithyll, Carian Knight.

guide.title: Opening the Closed Gate
text: After clearing the right path, follow the path on the left side. Jump on the rocks of the waterfall. After arriving at the top of the waterfall, you'll find a ladder on the left side and a cavern on the right. Go to the right path, then loot the corpse by the entrance of the cavern to get x3 Drawstring Royal Magic Grease. Go inside the cavern, which will be short, and you can loot a corpse for x4 Knot Resin. Head outside the cavern, then go up the ladder. As you enter the room, two Messmer Soldiers will attack you. Defeat the soldiers, then head out the room through the doorway.

The area outside will lead you to the other side of the locked gate you found earlier. Go inside the room across, then push the lever to open the gate. After that, you can head up the stairs to get to a bridge with four Messmer Soldiers. The first three soldiers will use melee, while the one farthest from you will use a heavy crossbow. Clear the bridge, then you can loot a corpse near the bridge for x3 String. Follow the path going south, being careful of a Rotten Stray hiding behind the bush right as the path gets tighter. At the end, you will be on a cliffside path.

Follow the path on the right, and you will face two Noble Sorcerers. On the left, you can loot a corpse for x2 Glintslab Firefly. After defeating the two enemies, you can defeat the third sorcerer by going on the path just right before the staircase which leads to a ladder going up a rampart. Climb the ladder, then defeat the Page you will encounter. Loot a corpse nearby for a Somber Smithing Stone [6]. Afterwards, you can jump on the cliff to defeat the third Noble Sorcerer. Head down to where you came from, then go up the stairs.

At the top of the stairs, you'll be right outside of a structure guarded by an NPC Invader, Moonrithyll, Carian Knight. Moonrithyll drops the Moonrithyll's Knight Sword after defeating her. You can then head inside the chapel. Inside the chapel, you can find a Spirit NPC in front. In front of the spirit, you can pick up Rellana's Cameo. Afterwards, you can head to the hallway near the entrance to the chapel. A Lazuli Sorcerer will attack you as you walk through the hallway. You can obtain a Shadow Realm Rune [2] from a corpse along the hall. You can also find a room containing a Lazuli Sorcerer, which would be a good choice to defeat now so you won't be surrounded by enemies later.

Head out the room, then go around the corner. You will be attacked by another Lazuli Sorcerer hiding by the corner. After defeating the enemy, follow the hallway until you get outside of the structure. Be careful here, as a Noble Sorcerer will be attacking you from the top of a structure. Head up the stairs, picking up the Glintslab Firefly from a corpse on the way, then open the gate on the south side.

title: Rellana's Cameo
text: Pick up Rellana's Cameo from the altar past Moonrithyll and grab the Shadow Realm Rune [2] in the corridor.
Rellana's Cameo: The talisman can be looted on top of an altar inside a chapel.
Shadow Realm Rune [2]: x1 Shadow Realm Rune [2] can be looted off a corpse. The body is located in a corridor, lying on the floor.

title: Glintblade Trio
text: On the staircase up ahead lies a corpse with a Glintslab Firefly.
Open the spiked gate, then drop down to the left to reach a corpse with Dewgem x3.
Dewgem: x3 Dewgem can be pillaged from a corpse. The body can be found sitting by the edge of a cliff.
Climb the two ladders, then grab the Somber Smithing Stone [8] at the end of the rooftop.
Somber Smithing Stone [8]: Looted from a Teardrop Scarab clinging to a pillar in this area. It will run towards many Misbegotten so be prepared for a fight.
Drop down from the northeast side of the rooftop to reach a corpse with Glintblade Trio.

Glintblade Trio: The Glintblade Trio spell is found by looting it off a corpse. After passing through the iron gate just beyond the chapel in the midpoint of the castle, then dropping off the side of the bridge and climbing up the ladders to the rooftop of the chapel. You can then drop down on the north side of the roof to get to the corpse hanging over a ledge that has the spell.

title: Wolf Crest Shield
text: Drop down again and loot the Wolf Crest Shield from the chest in the room.

Wolf Crest Shield: Located inside a storeroom you'll find a treasure chest that has the Wolf Crest Shield. The storeroom is found by following the staircase down instead of heading into the chapel to fight Moonrythil

title: Imbued Sword Key
text: Return to the spiked gate and grab the Somber Smithing Stone [6] and Somber Smithing Stone [7] on the rampart.
Somber Smithing Stone [6]: x1 Somber Smithing Stone [6] can be looted off a corpse. The body can be found lying on the floor of a watchpoint of the bridge. The area is guarded by soldiers and hounds.
Go up the stairs at the end of the rampart and loot an Imbued Sword Key from the chest in the tower.
Imbued Sword Key: The Imbued Sword Key item can be found inside a treasure chest. The chest is located inside a tower's armor room.

title: Ash of War: Wing Stance
text: Take the lift up and activate the Castle-Lord's Chamber grace.
Pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [7] on the balcony near the grace.
Jump over the balcony, drop down to the tower below, then climb it to a chest with Ash of War: Wing Stance at the top.

Ash of War: Wing Stance: Inside a chest in the tower that you can reach by jumping over the edge just outside Castle Lord's Chamber Site of Grace, and following the cliffside down to the tower before climbing up two ladders to reach it

title: Boss: Rellana, Twin Moon Knight
text: Return to Castle-Lord's Chamber and kill Rellana, Twin Moon Knight for Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight and 240,000 runes.
Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight: This Remembrance Item is acquired upon defeating the boss, Rellana, Twin Moon Knight .
Optional: Leda's summon sign can be found next to the entrance.
Grab the Ensis Moongazing Grounds grace after the fight.

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Head toward the cross past the Ensis Moongazing Grounds. Grab the Scadutree Fragment and Highroad Cross grace.
Scadutree Fragment: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be found by Miquella's Cross of the Highroad Cross Site of Grace.

title: Talk to Needle Knight Leda
text: Needle Knight Leda: Needle Knight Leda can be located next to the Highroad Cross Site of Grace.

title: Monk's Missive, May the Best Win
text: Pick up the Monk's Missive and May the Best Win gesture on the broken stone fence.
Monk's Missive: Looted off the ground just behind where Hornsent is standing. You'll also acquire the May the Best Win gesture alongside this key item.
May the Best Win: Gesture. Laying on the ground near the Highroad Cross Site of grace. Obtained once you pick up the Monk's Missive

title: New Cross Map, Talk to Hornsent
text: Talk to Hornsent to receive the New Cross Map.
New Cross Map: This item is acquired by speaking to Hornsent. You must pass through Castle Ensis right after defeating Rellana, Twin Moon Knight .
Hornsent: Hornsent can be located next to the Highroad Cross Site of Grace.

guide.title: Scadu Altus
text: Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree - Navigating Scadu Altus
Activate Site of Grace after eliminating Rellana, Twin Moon Knight, and exit through the newly-opened gate
Head North and follow the dirt path to activate Highroad Cross - Site of Grace

Exhaust dialogue of nearby NPCs: Leda and Hornsent. Pick up Monk's Missive and Cross Map. (NOTE: You need to return to Three-Path Cross Site of Grace to speak with Redmane Freyja after this interaction)
Pick up Map: Scadu Altus to reveal nearby locations
Defeat Furnace Golem
Take the Larval Tear east of the army camp in front of the Shadow Keep Main Gate. This is located east of the camp in the illuminated gravesite (nighttime only)
Head to Church of the Crusade: Defeat Fire Knight Queelign and obtain the Prayer Room Key

Look for the injured Forager Brood north of the Church of the Crusade. Help the pest by dropping a Warming Stone or Sunwarmth Stone next to it. (NOTE: The Forager Broods are important to Moore and if you harm one of them, Moore will appear as an invader. If Moore dies, all Forager Brood will permanently disappear from your current world and prevents you from collecting the rest of the Cookbooks)
Locate and explore Fog Rift Fort
Reach Moorth Ruins and do Dryleaf Dane's quest there.

Locate the 2 Forager Brood: The first one can be found northwest of the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past while the other one is at the northern section of Moorth Highway (the path on the way to Rauh Base)
Explore Moorth Ruins to reach the well that leads to Bonny Village and Bonny Gaol
Discover the Spiritspring near Fort Reprimand and reach Scaduview Cross - Site of Grace
Clear Fort of Reprimand
Complete Ruined Forge of Starfall Past
Explore southeast of Scadu Altus
Visit Whipping Hut

Cross the Bridge to Eastern Scadu Altus: Take note that you will receive a loud notification here about a rune breaking. NOTE: You may have received this notification earlier if you traveled close to the Main Gate of Shadow Keep. It is important to speak with all NPCs before you formally enter Shadow Keep to progress their individual questlines.
Go to Rabbath's Rise and get the Larval Tear west of Rabbath's Rise, you can see the illuminated gravesite (nighttime only) before you formally enter the Cathedral of Manus Metyr
Reach the Cathedral of Manus Metyr and initiate the questlines of Count Ymir and Jolan

After defeating Rellana in Castle Ensis, exit through the newly opened gate. This new area here takes you to Scadu Altus, the second region in the Realm of Shadow. You will meet Needle Knight Leda and Hornsent in this location. While in this area, make sure to activate the Highroad Cross - Site of Grace and pick up the Scadutree Fragment and an Empyrean-Blood Burgeon. Talk to both of them and exhaust their dialogues. Ask Leda about Hornsent and she will tell you about the order that Marika gave to Messmer to cleanse the townsfolk by fire. Then, interacting with Hornsent will give you a Monk's Missive and a Gesture: May the Best Win. He will also give you a New Cross Map which shows additional Miquella's Cross locations drawn.

Head north to pick up the Map: Scadu Altus to navigate easily. Eliminate the Furnace Golem that you will come across outside the Shadow Keep, which is the large building that you can see nearby. The Furnace Golem mostly roams the army campsite found in front of the Shadow Keep's main entrance. It drops x1 Crimsonburst Dried Tear and x1 Furnace Visage, but you can also skip fighting this elite enemy and just continue roaming if you find it too difficult.

Look for the Marika Statue within the encampment outside of Shadow Keep Main Entrance. You will see the statue on the right side of the stonewall while facing north (and the Furnace Golem if it's still alive). You can pick up a Scadutree Fragment here.

title: Carian Sorcery Sword
text: Optional: Talk to Leda and ask her about the hornsent.
Kill the Troll Knight patrolling the water west of the grace for Smithing Stone [8] x9.
Smithing Stone [8]: Dropped by the Ghost Troll elite enemy upon defeat.
Head toward the south end of the water, then pick up a Shadow Realm Rune [2] from the tower near the right edge of the cliff.
Shadow Realm Rune [2]: Looted from the top of a small tower atop Castle Ensis Cross. This is only accessible by coming down the river from Scadu Altus area.
Drop onto the castle section below the cliff to reach a chest with the Carian Sorcery Sword.
Carian Sorcery Sword: In a chest after dropping down into Castle Ensis from Scadu Altus.

notes: Notes go here

title: Verdigris Discus
text: Jump onto the battlement behind the chest, then drop down on the southwest side to reach an astrolabe with Starlight Shards.

Starlight Shards: x1 Starlight Shards can be looted off a corpse. The body can be found on the roof of the first building seen to the right when entering from the bridge. Access this roof by progressing past the cross and dropping down then going right before the waterfall.
Head west-northwest from the Highroad Cross to the wooded area across the water to find the Scadu Altus, West grace near the cliff.
Unlock the imp-sealed belfry on the island southeast of the grace. Take the sending gate to the Ancient Ruins of Rauh.
After arriving at the Ancient Ruins of Rauh, pick up Beast Horn x2 from a ledge on the left side of the water.
Beast Horn: From the middle area, take the set of stairs to the next floor. Move to the west and you will find a Fire Knight, and behind it you will find the item.
Head along the water to find the Verdigris Discus in front of a statue below the arcade.

Verdigris Discus: Ancient Rauh Ruins: Can be found in front of a giant statue in a lower area only accessible by jumping down from the second Divine Beast Lion encounter, or by teleporting to this platform from the waygate in Scadu Altus

guide.title: The Grand Stairway Section
text: While facing the chest, exit through the square hole to your right. Use the elevator to go up, and you can already see the Ancient Ruins, Grand Stairway - Site of Grace from the top. Walk towards it and activate it.

Face the northwest direction, jump down the stairs, and then turn right to get loot. Stick to the wall to your right and then go to the very edge here to pick up a Spirit Calculus from a corpse. Then, return to the grand stairway where you see the archer version of the Golem Warrior. You can go up the ramp behind it and take it out. This enemy is weak to heavy attacks so make sure to take full advantage of its weakness.

Go down the broken bridge here and cross towards the northeast. Near the end of this bridge, you will find a corpse in the middle and you can take a Shadow Realm Rune (7) from it. If you look down to the right, there's a Divine Beast Dancing Lion field boss here - please read ahead before jumping down! It's up to you if you want to fight it head-on but if you ended up jumping down to its level, you can run away from it by jumping down yet again on the northeastern platform. This disables the fight and the boss will not chase you. Oddly enough, this field boss can also be sniped from the bridge you're on from above. Fair warning, it will spawn basilisks onto the bridge but this is the biggest threat you'll encounter and it is easily defeated using this method. After defeat it drops the Divine Beast Tornado Incantation.

After the Dancing Lion fight head northeast and jump down off the platform. There's an elite enemy in the middle of the pool. This one wields dual curved swords and has a chance to drop pieces of the Divine Bird Set upon defeating it. Go up the ramp on the left side to pick up 2x Beast Bones. Then, go to the area behind the boss to pick up Verdigris Discus. Continue exploring the southern area here to pick up a Redflesh Mushroom from a corpse next to a pillar. This is your last stop in the Grand Stairway section and you will now return to the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West - Site of Grace.

title: Greater Potentate's Cookbook [3]
text: Behind one of the pillars south of the statue lies a corpse with Redflesh Mushroom.
Return to Scadu Altus, West and drop down the ledges near the waterfall to find a gravestone with a Grave Glovewort [8].
Head back to the grace again and descend the ledges west of it to reach Fog Rift Fort:
Pick up the Fire Arrow x10 in front of some explosive barrels.
A corpse with Redflesh Mushroom x8 sits in the first tower.
Go down the scaffolding around the tower and pick up Greater Potentate's Cookbook [3] from the other side of the bridge.
Greater Potentate's Cookbook [3]: Past the first small tower, turn right and defeat the soldiers that are on the bridge, cross to the other side to find the cookbook on a body.

title: Serpent Flail
text: Descend the ladder at the end of the rampart and grab the Messmerfire Grease in front of two flamespitters.
Open the chest at the end to obtain the Serpent Flail.

Serpent Flail: Head down using the ladder past the first tower, and defeat the enemies. Beware of the flamethrowers. Use spells or arrows if you have them. Reach the end of the area to find a chest that contains this item

place.title: Fog Rift Fort
walk: ER Shadow of the Erdtree Fog Rift Fort Video Walkthrough

Fog Rift Fort can be accessed from the Scadu Altus West Grace See Elden Ring Map by dropping down the rocky platforms and landing on one of the fort's towers. Drop down from the tower by jumping or using the ladder, and you'll encounter Messmer Soldiers on top of the fort's walls. Once you take them out, look to your left and you'll see a corpse that you can loot, which has x10 Fire Arrow.

Afterward, follow the path until you reach the second wall tower of the fort. You can find a corpse containing x8 Redflesh Mushroom by the barrels in this room. Head out, and you'll encounter a wooden bridge to your right guarded by six Messmer Soldiers. The wooden bridge leads to a rocky platform with another corpse that you can loot for the Greater Potentate's Cookbook (3).

After looting the corpse on the rocky platform, head back to the wall of the fort by crossing the bridge again and continuing on the path. Turn left to another bridge that leads to a small stone house on the other side, where you'll encounter a boss. For a complete guide on how to beat the boss, check out Black Knight Garrew. This boss drops the Black Steel Greatshield. After slaying the boss, head inside the stone house he emerged from and open the chest, which contains eight Smithing Stone [7].

Next, head towards the small opening between the cliff and the left side of the stone house. Drop down on a ledge. Follow the stairs, and climb two sets of ladders to reach the top of a tower with a treasure chest containing the Arrow's Soaring Sting Talisman. Drop back down the ladder and jump on the cliff in front of it, then jump down to return to where the boss was. Now, head to the right of the stone house and access a small part of the wall path. You'll encounter two more Messmer Soldiers and find another corpse holding x1 Somber Smithing Stone [2]. Once you've cleared out the walls of the fort, head back to the bridge that connected the wall path and the boss area, then turn left to a wooden platform with a ladder going down. This will lead you to the grounds of the fort where more Messmer Soldiers await you. The first three soldiers you'll encounter are stationed to the left of the ladder near a spike barricade. After taking them out, you'll find a corpse in the middle of the barricade that holds the Messmerfire Grease.

After looting the corpse, be careful when combatting the rest of the soldiers on the ground. Luckily, they are spread out and in the open, so you can take them out one by one using a ranged weapon. These soldiers are also stationed next to fire turrets. There are two fire turrets in front, two on the opposite side of where you are, and one on the right.
Once you've cleared out the ground, head to the opposite side of the ground where you'll find some tents. One of these tents contains a chest with the Serpent Flail.

title: Boss: Black Knight Garrew
text: Head back up and kill Black Knight Garrew for Black Steel Greatshield and 80,000 runes.
Black Knight Garrew: The Black Knight Garrew Boss is located at the Fog Rift Fort location.
Black Steel Greatshield: This shield item drops as a reward upon defeating the boss Black Knight Garrew .

title: Arrow's Soaring Sting Talisman
text: Loot the chest in the building to obtain Blessed Bone Shard x3 and Smithing Stone [8] x6.
Pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [7] on the rampart southwest of the building.
Drop down at the other side of the building, then climb to the top for a chest with the Arrow's Soaring Sting Talisman.

Arrow's Soaring Sting Talisman: Found on top of a tower at Fog Rift Fort . From within the door of the tower where Black Knight Garrew was, go through a gap between the tower and the rock wall to the right of the door. Take the stairs going up around the cliff, then at the top take the ladder to the right going up the upper level of the tower. On reaching the top turn left to take another latter leading to the uppermost level of the tower, where a treasure chest resides that holds the Talisman.

title: Map: Scadu Altus
text: Travel to Highroad Cross and pass time until nightfall. Follow the road until you see a stele with Map: Scadu Altus.
Map: Scadu Altus: The Map Fragment for Scadu Altus can be looted next to a monolith. When you pass the Highroad Cross Site of Grace through Castle Ensis, simply follow the road northeast.

title: Larval Tear
text: Head west from the stele to find a Larval Tear surrounded by blue spiritgraves to the left of the church.
Larval Tear: East of Messmer's Army Encampment. Found between the glowing gravestones. (only at night)

title: Ash of War: Flame Skewer, Prayer Room Key +1
text: Fire Knight Queelign invades inside the church. Defeat him to obtain Ash of War: Flame Skewer and the Prayer Room Key.
Ash of War: Flame Skewer: Acquired as a drop upon defeating the NPC Invader Fire Knight Queelign for the second time.
Prayer Room Key: Acquired as a drop upon defeating the NPC Invader Fire Knight Queelign for the second time.
Fire Knight Queelign: NPC Invader Fire Knight Queelign will appear upon entering the church.

guide.title: Small Private Altar Site of Grace
text: NOTE: If this is your first time encountering the NPC Invader, Fire Knight Queelign, defeating him drops the Crusade Insignia talisman. However, if it's your second encounter, he drops the Prayer Room Key and Ash of War: Flame Skewer. For added information, the other location where Fire Knight Queelign appears as an NPC Invader is at the Church of the Crusade.

Proceed through the doorway on the right to find a storeroom. Climb up the ladder and you'll see a body sitting against a wall next to another arched doorway. Loot it to find the Storeroom Key. The Storeroom Key can be used to unlock the door near the Small Private Altar Site of Grace. Inside that room, you can find an NPC Hornsent Grandam.
## The Toxic Depths

You can also find the following items at the sewer level, so make sure not to leave this section until you find the following items we've listed. These items are looted from dead bodies. x4 Whiteflesh Mushroom near the section leading to the shortcut, x5 Knot Resin on the ruins where you'll find a group of Man-Fly enemies, x3 Beast Liver on the island where you fight the dual sword-wielding Horned Warrior. x1 Poisoned Hand is located east, next to a church. x8 Serpent Arrow on top of the roof of a sunken building. x1 Neutralizing Boluses behind one of the buildings in the south section, as well as x2 Smithing Stone from a corpse hanging by the edge of a building roof.
## Belurat Tower Settlement: Stagefront

Next, head up the steps, and you'll find a group of Revered Spirits gathered around a large tree. Kill the enemies and on the left side of the tree, you'll find a broken statue that has an item. Loot the item to acquire x1 Revered Spirit Ash. Continue west and head inside a tower building.
## Down, Down, Down

Keep following it, and you will acquire x10 Lordsworn's Bolt from a dead body at the end of it. After looting the body, follow the ledge to the other direction going down, and you'll be at a broken section of the ledge. Drop down it, and you will land near a hostile Shadow Undead. Kill it, then pick up x1 Somber Smithing Stone [5] nearby. Go down the stairs, and you'll find x1 Fireproof Pickled Liver from a dead body.
## Belurat Tower Settlement Section
To progress further, sprint jump down the window south of the dead body containing x1 Fireproof Pickled Liver.

title: Scadutree Fragment, Scadutree Fragment
text: Pick up the Scadutree Fragment x2 and Rune Arc in the church.
Scadutree Fragment: x2 Scadutree Fragment can looted off the ground. The item is found inside the Church of the Crusade, just by the foot of the statue of Marika.
Rune Arc: x1 Rune Arc can be looted off a corpse. The body is located in the Church of the Crusade.
Scadutree Fragment: Defeat the Lesser Golden Hippopotamus to obtain the fragment. The enemy drops 11960 Runes and x1 Scadutree Fragment .

place.title: Church of the Crusade
walk: You can reach this area by going west after the army encampment in front of the Shadow Keep - Main Gate in Scadu Altus. Go inside and walk down the aisle here and you will be invaded by the Fire Knight Queelign. If this is your 2nd encounter with Queelign, you will receive the Ash of War: Flame Skewer and a Prayer Room Key upon defeating him.
You will encounter the same NPC invader in the following areas:
Belurat Tower Settlement
Shadow Keep

Going back to the Church of the Crusade, walk over to the altar behind the burning pot, and make sure to pick up the x2 Scadutree Fragment in front of the tall statue of Marika. On your way out, look to your right and pick up Rune Arc next to the toppled pillars.

Outside the church, head northeast and go to the very edge. You will find an injured Forager Brood here who is unable to move. To help it, drop a Warming Stone next to it then wait for it to get up. Rest at a nearby Site of Grace, come back to the location to receive Forager Brood Cookbook (4) and x3 Shadow Sunflower from it.

guide.title: Exploring the Southern Area
text: The southern area of the Ancient Ruins of Rauh covers exploring the parts near the Site of Grace. This includes the area below you that is accessible via the elevator in the small pond.

Go through the archway and go to the right side. Stick to the wall and go ride past the thick greenery here. You will go around this building and at the back, you can pick up the Golden Horn Tender. Go back the same way you came from, return to the entrance side, and head southeast past the small pond. You can see some boar creatures hanging out here and go behind this tree. Look for the corpse lying on top of a stone slab and pick up the Spirit Calculus. Then, use the elevator to go down to the lower level.

As you go down, face the southwest direction so you are ready for the Bloodfiend waiting here. Then, follow the path behind it where a group of Bloodfiends is gathered. This can be difficult since you are outnumbered, but if you have a magic build, you can use Adula's Moonblade to effectively take out the group. After fighting them, you can pick up Somber Smithing Stone [8] from the corpse behind the group. From here, face the southwest direction and exit through the small hole. Go to the right side and go past the bloodfiend. There's a corpse near the edge and you can pick up 8x Thin Beast Bones from it.

Now look behind you; you should be facing southeast here and go towards the edge and jump down on the steps below you. Look to your right and fight the Hippopotamus. This looks just like the boss at the Main Entrance of Shadow Keep but this one has a smaller health pool. It can also pull off the same moves just like the boss version. Upon defeating it, it will drop a Scadutree Fragment. You are now done with this section. Return to the Site of Grace and continue exploring the eastern area through the felled tree.

title: Forager Brood Cookbook, Forager Brood Cookbook
text: A wounded Forager Brood lies on the cliff next to the church. Use a Warming Stone to heal it, then after reloading the area, interact with it to receive Forager Brood Cookbook [4] and Shadow Sunflower x3.

Forager Brood Cookbook: Acquired by interacting with a pest found north of Church of the Crusade . The pest will be found shivering and unresponsive. Use a Warming Stone or Sunwarmth Stone to warm it up, and reload the area by teleporting or logging out. It can now be interacted with and will grant the cookbook.
Shadow Sunflower: x2 Shadow Sunflower. Found on a body in the middle of the Perfumer's small camp.

Forager Brood Cookbook: Acquired by interacting with the pest found along the right cliff edge in the Deathbird-infested poisonous swamp north of Moorth ruins. The swamp can be reached by going through the cave with the Miranda flowers and Perfumers.
miss: Missed if you kill the Forager Brood before interacting with it or fail Moore's questline. If you tell Moore to 'Remain sad forever' after Miquella's charm breaks, the Forager Brood disappear and their cookbooks become unobtainable.

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Head back to the map stele by the road, then pick up Black Pyrefly x3 from the corpse at the entrance to the encampment.
Quickly grab the Scadutree Fragment on the stone fence to the right, just past the entrance, then return to the map stele.

Scadutree Fragment: Located at the Church District of the Shadow Keep . x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted on the hand of the statue of Marika. Time your jump to grab it. NOTE: Drain the water so you can jump onto the statue's hand.

guide.title: THE FLOODED CHURCH DISTRICT: DRAINING THE FLOOD
text: Exit the prayer room and proceed to the northwest doorway, but before proceeding further, be sure to enter the armory room on the left to find a body sitting against the wall. Loot the body to find x1 Rune of an Unsung Hero. Enter the hallway and kill the first Fire Knight enemy that you see, on the left side of the hallway, loot the body resting against the wall to find x2 Furlcalling Finger Remedy, and continue straight down the hallway where you'll encounter another Fire Knight. The room ahead is not accessible at the moment and the doorway to the right where you'll notice Marika's statue that has a glowing item in its hand is unreachable, so exit through the first doorway on the left side of the hallway.

NOTE: In the same hallway, there are two doorways on the left, the far most or second doorway will lead you to a lift that takes you to the Specimen Storehouse section of the Shadow Keep. You're free to roam here, but we highly recommend returning to the Specimen Storehouse after clearing the Main Plaza and Church District of the Shadow Keep. What you can do is enter the Specimen Storehouse, and activate the nearby Site of Grace (Storehouse, Back Section) so you can just fast travel here after exploring the Church District.

Cross the pathway where you'll encounter two Giant Bat enemies, then walk up to the short steps where you'll encounter another Giant Bat ahead. Jump over the gap, and kill the creature. Now before going straight, walk up a bit and you'll find a corner on the right. It's a dead end but there's a body that you can loot that's being protected by another Giant Bat hanging from the ceiling. Kill the enemy and loot the body to acquire x3 Hefty Beast Bone [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]]. Next, climb the ladder next to a doorway to find the mechanism that drains the water.

You can also return to the hallway to get the item sitting on the hand of Marika's statue. You can get the item by jumping on the hand, it may require a few tries as the platform that you need to stand on is quite narrow. Loot the item to acquire x1 Scadutree Fragment, then prepare to fight a group of Ignited Putrid Corpse as you jump down. Behind the same statue, you can find the Fire Knight's Seal weapon [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]]

title: Larval Tear
text: From the stele, head east-northeast to find a Larval Tear surrounded by blue spiritgraves on the left.
Larval Tear: West of Rabbath's Rise . Found between the glowing gravestones. (only at night)

title: Boss: Ralva the Great Red Bear
text: Head southeast into the woods to find a corpse with the Highland Warrior Set near a pond.
Kill Ralva the Great Red Bear in the pond for Pelt of Ralva and 180,000 runes
Ralva the Great Red Bear: A ferocious bear with long, red hair. This boss can be found on a lake in Scadu Altus and it drops the Pelt of Ralva upon death.
Pelt of Ralva: This is a helmet type of armor that can be obtained after defeating Ralva the Great Red Bear . It is known to enhance incantations of what is jokingly called "Bear Communion."

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Back at the map stele, follow the southeast road to a cross on the left. Grab the Moorth Ruins grace and Scadutree Fragment next to it.

Scadutree Fragment: BEWARE of a Deathblade nearby. South of Moorth Ruins, you'll find a pot-bearing Shadow towards the giant fissure at the center of the location. Instead of dropping down, wrap around the south side of the fissure to find the enemy. Kill the pot-bearing Shadow enemy to acquire x1 Scadutree Fragment.

place.title: Moorth Ruins
walk: Return to Scadu Altus Site of Grace and read the Monk's Missive. From here, head to the path leading to the southwest to Moorth Ruins. You will find Dryleaf Dane here who you will challenge to a fight. He is standing near the Site of Grace and next to Miquella's Cross. To prompt this, use the Gesture: May the Best Win while facing him. He will drop Dryleaf Arts and Dane's Hat upon his death. Walk toward the area behind him and you will arrive at Moorth Ruins. You will be fighting phantom enemies here and this enemy type can be difficult to see at night. There are two holes in the area which will lead you through an underground path.
The first hole can be entered through the door of a collapsed building to the southeast. You will find a broken roof, where you can pick up a Shattered Stone Talisman from a corpse.

From the roof you can see the bottom of the ruins, which can be accessed through the second hole. To reach it, return to the building's entrance and walk forward a bit, you should spot an L-shaped building in the distance, which contains another underground path.

In this area you will fight two shadow dogs and find 3x Whiteflesh Mushroom and 2x String. Jumping further down and heading towards the back of the tunnel you will find a Golden Horn Tender, then towards the front of the tunnel you will jump down a ledge where you will se a chest containing Golden Arcs, guarded by 3 Mage enemies who cast Golden Arcs. You will then jump down into a balcony and to the ground. You can pick up a Shadow Sunflower from a corpse below the balcony. Then, head to the small cave opening here with a faint ghostflame. At the end of this cave, use the ladder to reach Bonny Village.

guide.title: To Moorth Ruins
text: Return to Highroad Cross - Site of Grace and read the Monk's Missive. From here, head to the path leading to the southeast to Moorth Ruins. You will find Dryleaf Dane here who you will challenge to a fight. He is standing near the Site of Grace and next to Miquella's Cross. To prompt this, use the Gesture: May the Best Win while facing him. He will drop Dryleaf Arts and Dane's Hat upon defeating him. After this encounter, continue exploring Moorth Ruins by going to the west of Moorth Ruins to locate a camp. Look for the Marika statue and take the Scadutree Fragment in front of it.

Return to Moorth Ruins where you will be fighting phantom enemies and this enemy type can be difficult to see at night. The Moorth Ruins are explored vertically, it will lead to an area deeper into the ground as you jump from one platform to another. Before entering the area below, look for the Shadowpot on the outskirts of Moorth ruins. You will find it near a collapsed building close to a withered tree. Eliminate this enemy to obtain a Scadutree Fragment.

Next, locate the entrance of a collapsed building to the southeast. Then, exit towards the broken roof. You can pick up a Shattered Stone Talisman from a corpse here. See it on the SOTE Elden Ring Map

Continue navigating to the area below you by jumping near the wall. You can summon Torrent here to negate some of the fall damage. At the bottom, you will be fighting 3 Mage enemies and you can take the Golden Arcs from the chest inside the small building. Walk towards the northwest where you see a slanted piece of structure. Jump down the balcony near it and to the ground. You can pick up a Shadow Sunflower from a corpse below the balcony. Then, head to the small cave opening here with a faint ghostflame. At the end of this cave, use the ladder to reach Bonny Village.

title: Boss: Dryleaf Dane
text: Use the May the Best Win gesture near Dryleaf Dane to challenge him. After you beat him, pick up the Dryleaf Arts and Dane's Hat next to the cross.
Dryleaf Arts: This weapon is obtained as a drop upon defeating Dryleaf Dane.
Dane's Hat: This armor piece is obtained as a drop upon defeating Dryleaf Dane.

Dryleaf Dane: Dryleaf Dane is located east of the Scadu Atlas region, at the Moorth Ruins. After acquiring the Monk's Missive note, head to this location and speak to the NPC to trigger a mini-boss fight. Defeating him drops the following items: x1 Dryleaf Arts x1 Dane's Hat
miss: Both items must be obtained before you fight Leda and her allies in Enir-Ilim.

title: Ash of War: Palm Blast
text: His weapon is equipped with Ash of War: Palm Blast. Remove it to make it available for compatible weapons.
Ash of War: Palm Blast: Found at the Moorth Ruins Site of Grace by using the "May The Best Win" emote in front of DryLeaf Dane, you will then begin a battle and winning will grant you the Ash of War.
miss: Becomes unobtainable if you don't beat Dane before fighting Leda and her allies in Enir-Ilim.

title: Talk to Dryleaf Dane
text: Dryleaf Dane: Dryleaf Dane is located east of the Scadu Atlas region, at the Moorth Ruins. After acquiring the Monk's Missive note, head to this location and speak to the NPC to trigger a mini-boss fight.

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Enter the camp across the road from Moorth Ruins and grab the Scadutree Fragment in front of the statue.
Scadutree Fragment: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted from the ground by Miquella's Cross of the Moorth Ruins Site of Grace.

title: Fire Knight's Cookbook [1]
text: Inside one of the tents lies a corpse with the Fire Knight's Cookbook [1].
Fire Knight's Cookbook [1]: East of the Highroad Cross Site of Grace, there is a messmer soldiers encampment. On one of the tents you can find this item.

title: Ash of War: Piercing Throw
text: Pick up the Hefty Beast Bone x4, Shadow Realm Rune [2], and Lump of Flesh x2 in the pond southwest of the camp.
Shadow Realm Rune: South of the Messmer soldier encampment, guarded by a Giant Lobster.
On the other side of the hill southeast of the pond, between two pillars, is a scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [8].
Somber Smithing Stone [8]: x3 Somber Smithing Stone [8] can be found in the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past location.
Amidst the ruins southeast of the scarab sits a corpse with Smithing Stone [7] x2.
Between two fallen pillars just west of the corpse, you'll find an exploding scarab that drops Ash of War: Piercing Throw.
Ash of War: Piercing Throw: Dropped by a teardrop scarab found a group of several Misbegotten enemies just east from Ruined Forge of Starfall Past.

title: Forager Brood Cookbook
text: Shoot down the scarab hanging from a pillar to the left of the forge for another Somber Smithing Stone [8].
Head northwest past the forge and toward the cliff to find a Forager Brood and a corpse with a Ghost Glovewort [7].
Ghost Glovewort [7]: Can be looted from a body on the plains under Castle Ensis, accessed from Scadu Altus site, near the friendly Kindred of Rot.
Interact with the Forager Brood to receive Forager Brood Cookbook [1] and Glintslab Firefly x3.
Forager Brood Cookbook: Acquired from a pest who hands it to you if you interact with him just west of Ruined Forge of Starfall Past along the cliffside
miss: Missed if you kill the Forager Brood before interacting with it or fail Moore's questline. If you tell Moore to 'Remain sad forever' after Miquella's charm breaks, the Forager Brood disappear and their cookbooks become unobtainable.

title: Smithscript Spear
text: Head back and enter the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past:
Descend the ladder and grab the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past grace.
Pick up Smithing Stone [6], Smithing Stone [6] x5, and Smithing Stone [5] from the first half of the room.
Smithing Stone [5]: A total of 3 Smithing Stone [5] can be found in the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past location.
Grab the Smithscript Spear and 2x Smithing Stone [2] in the other half of the room, and pull the lever.
Smithscript Spear: The weapon is looted from a body located on the main floor of the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past.
Smithing Stone [2]: A total of 5 Smithing Stone [2] can be found in the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past location.

place.title: Ruined Forge of Starfall Past
walk: ER Shadow of the Erdtree Ruined Forge of Starfall Past Video Walkthrough

The Ruined Forge of Starfall is located southeast of Castle Ensis. Its entrance is a broken-down structure with a small tunnel entrance on the west side. Enter the tunnel and follow it until you reach a ladder that descends further underground. Climb down the ladder to find an abandoned shelter, where the Ruined Forge of Starfall Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map is located.

After setting up the Site of Grace, head immediately to the doorway and you'll find a Smithing Stone [6], Smithing Stone [5], and x5 Smithing Stone [3] on the ground. In the first area, you'll encounter two Misbegotten enemies. One is below the small bridge that connects to the other side of the room, and the other is on the far side of the bridge. Eliminate these enemies and pull the lever on the other side of the bridge, which will open an iron door below the bridge on the left side. Near the lever, you can pick up a Smithing Stone [2]. Before heading down to the iron door, go to the opposite side of the lever to find x1 Smithing Stone [2] and a Smithscript Spear. Drop down from the bridge to take out the Misbegotten below. There's another Smithing Stone [3] and Smithing Stone [2] opposite the iron door. Just beside the iron door on the left, you'll find another Smithing Stone [2] and Smithing Stone [3]. Enter the iron door and immediately hide in a small space to the right. You'll need to take cover here for a few seconds because a Fire Blob will shoot fire projectiles from the other side of the passage.

You can pull the lever in your hiding spot to close the iron door again. Once another projectile crosses, run toward the Fire Blob and take it out. In the next area, there are two levels and another passage to the right leading to another area. From the entrance of the iron passage, go left to grab the Smithing Stone [6] and Smithing Stone [3] on the ground. A Golem Smith is lurking behind some rubble, so be alert and take it out. To the left of the golem are x2 Smithing Stone [2].

Once you've looted the first level of the second area, go to the other passage on the right. As before, another Fire Blob will be shooting projectiles from the far side. Run to the nearest cover on the right, but be ready to fight, as another Fire Blob will be waiting to ambush you there. Take out the hiding Fire Blob and wait in cover.
