Left of the Fire Blob, you can find a Smithing Stone [5] and Smithing Stone [6]. There's also a Smithing Stone [3] in the cover area. Wait for a projectile to cross, then run toward the Fire Blob and take it out. Through the second passage, you'll come across a ladder going up to the right. You can find Smithing Stone [2] and Smithing Stone [5] as you traverse through the path. Before heading up, go straight a bit to a small dead-end area and prepare to fight a Golem Smith hiding on the left. This small room contains a Somber Smithing Stone [7] by a skeleton and a Smithing Stone [3].

Afterward, head up the ladder to reach the second level of this area. Follow the path to a room filled with three Fire Blobs and a Golem Smith. There's a Somber Smithing Stone [8] by a corpse on the ground, so pick it up. Head up the broken-down rubble to the left to reach the third level and enter the passage to the right. This will lead you back to the second area you encountered earlier, and you can drop to the second level. Before jumping to the second level, look to the left to see a small dead-end room with a corpse holding the Smithing Talisman. Enter this dead-end room, and a group of Fire Blobs will drop from the ceiling, which you need to take out.

There's a Golem Smith on the right side of the area near the bridge and a Fire Blob on a small platform once you drop down. Once you take out the golem, you can loot the second level of the second area. There's a Smithing Stone [8] by a sitting corpse on the small platform. Crossing the bridge to the other side, you can pick up a Smithing Stone [6] and a Gas Stone. Once you've looted the second level, pull the lever to open another iron door on the left side. Enter the iron door and follow the path to a mid-sized room with two Golem Smiths ready to ambush you—one to the right and one to the left. Once you clear the room, you can loot it to find a Smithing Stone [6] and a Smithscript Cirque by a corpse next to the sewage waterfall.

Do not drop down the sewage waterfall as it will kill you. Instead, head back to the passage that connects the second area and the room with the sewage waterfall. Pull the lever to the left to activate the iron door. Before the iron door rises to close, immediately jump above the iron door. Once it stops, go to the platform on the right to find an entrance to a small room. This room contains an altar that you can interact with to receive the Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword and an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
notes: The last door opened by lever, pull the lever and ride the door up.

title: Smithing Talisman
text: Drop down and loot the 3x Smithing Stone [3] and Smithing Stone [2] on the floor.

Smithing Stone [3]: A total of 12 Smithing Stone [3] can be found in the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past location. x5 can be looted from a body near the site of grace. Turn left as you enter the doorway to find the body by the pots. The rest of the upgrade materials are looted from the ground.
Smithing Stone [2]: This upgrade material is found in the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past location. They are looted from the ground.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [5], Smithing Stone [6], Smithing Stone [3], and 2x Smithing Stone [2] in the second room.

Smithing Stone [2]: x4 Bonny Gaol. After you jump down the hole, head to the area where you fight the rats, and stick to the right side of the wall. You'll eventually find the entrance to the small passageway and find the item on a corpse.
Grab the Smithing Stone [5] in an alcove in the corridor.
At the end of the corridor is a small room with a Somber Smithing Stone [8] and a Smithing Stone [3].
Climb the ladder in the corridor and pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [8] in the back of the room.
Go up the stairs and across the raised platform to enter a room with Smithing Stone [3], 2x Smithing Stone [6], and the Smithing Talisman.
Smithing Talisman: The talisman is looted from a corpse. The body is inside a room filled with Fire Blob enemies, on the upper-most level of the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past.

title: Smithscript Cirque
text: Drop onto the bridge below the raised platform, then turn around to pick up Smithing Stone [8] x3.
Smithing Stone [8]: A total of 2 Smithing Stone [8] can be found in the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past location.
Grab the Smithing Stone [6] and Glass Shard on the other side, and pull the lever.
Glass Shard: x1 Glass Shard can be found in the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past location.
Head through the lowered gate to reach a room with a Smithing Stone [5], Smithscript Cirque, and Smithing Stone [6].
Smithscript Cirque: The weapon is looted from a body in the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past. The body is located by the edge of the sewage waterfall.

title: Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword
text: Pull the lever in the corridor, then stand on the gate as it rises. Examine the altar to obtain the Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword and an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword: The weapon is acquired after examining the altar of the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past. The altar is found on the second level. To reach the altar, you must pull the lever to make the iron door rise, and use it as a platform to jump across to the second level where the altar is.

Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone: The upgrade material is acquired after examining the altar of the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past. The altar is found on the second level. To reach the altar, you must pull the lever to make the iron door rise, and use it as a platform to jump across to the second level where the altar is.

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Follow the road near Moorth Ruins to a dragon fighting soldiers. To the left of the dragon is a sealed spiritspring. Unseal it by hitting the stacked stones at the east end of the cliff.
Take the spiritspring up, then make your way to the top to discover the Scaduview Cross grace.
Pick up the Scadutree Fragment and touch the cross to unlock dialogue with Ansbach about the cross where the eye was abandoned.
Scadutree Fragment: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted from the ground by Miquella's Cross of the Scaduview Cross Site of Grace.

guide.title: Path to Fort of Reprimand
text: The entrance to Fort of Reprimand will be near the Moorth Highway, South Site of Grace. See Elden Ring Map. Before going through the main entrance of Fort of Reprimand, explore the outer walls on the east side. You will encounter Abductor Virgins in this area. After defeating the two Abductor Virgins, you can find a corpse on the eastern cliff that you can loot for x8 Smithing Stone [6]. Follow the southern wall of the fort, and you can find a Blessing of Marika on a corpse near the cliff. Go back near the main entrance, then head west to the cliff. Traverse through the cliff by going northwest, and you'll find a corpse with a Rune Arc at the end of the cliff.

You will find a sealed Spiritspring here but you can't use it right away. You need to look for the stack of stones by going to the edge of the cliff here. Then, summon Torrent to ride up the plain above you. From there, head southeast to reach the edge and you will find the Scaduview Cross - Site of Grace. You can pick up x1 Scadutree Fragment here next to Miquella's Cross. When you're done here, you can either jump down the Spiritspring, or teleport back to Moorth Ruins to continue exploring Fort of Reprimand.

When you enter through the main entrance of the Fort of Reprimand, you will be in the courtyard where the execution platform is located. There will be an Omenkiller patrolling the courtyard, so be prepared for combat. After defeating the Omenkiller, you are free to explore and loot the area. You can pick up numerous items in the courtyard, such as x8 Throwing Dagger, x2 Broken Rune, x1 Ghost Glovewort [1], x5 Redflesh Mushroom, and x1 Blessed Bone Shard. In the northeastern part of the courtyard, you will find a spot you can jump on to access its basement.

When you drop down, you will find loot such as x1 Shadow Realm Rune (4), x6 Knot Resin, x1 Broken Rune, and x1 Marika's Rune. An Omenkiller will be waiting around the corner near the pile of loot. Defeat the Omenkiller, and it will drop the Iris of Occultation. As you head deeper into the basement, you will find an exit leading to a section behind the fort. You'll find x1 Messmer Soldier Ashes by a gravestone. You'll also find a ladder going up the fort, so use that to go back inside the fort.

After climbing the ladder, you will end up on top of the fort walls. Follow the path to the right, then head left, looting a dead body by the stairs containing x3 Dewgem. To the northwest of the body, you can activate the Fort of Reprimand Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. An Omenkiller will be on top of the wall on your right, so be prepared to fight it. After defeating the Omenkiller, you can explore the western side of the Site of Grace, finding x1 Blessed Bone Shard on a dead body on a scaffolding.

Go back to the staircase near the Site of Grace, then go right after the staircase. You will find a dead body with x1 Broken Rune. Go back up the stairs, then to the spot where you dropped earlier. You'll find a room in which you will encounter Black Knight Edreed, who uses a twinblade in combat. He can also use flying attacks to close the distance to you, so be cautious of those attacks. After you have defeated Black Knight Edreed, he will drop the Ash of War: Aspects of the Crucible: Wings.

Head up the stairs, then climb up the ladder, which leads to the outside. On the southwestern part of the area, climb up the stairs. On top of the tower, you can open a chest to acquire x1 Battlefield Priest's Cookbook [2]. Backtrack your way to the Fort of Reprimand Site of Grace.

You will find a path going down near where you dropped. Go down the stairs and keep following the path. You will encounter numerous Common Soldiers in this area, which you can easily kill in a few attacks. In the room as you enter the area, you can pick up x2 Festive Grease from a dead body right beside where two soldiers are. Go through the cages east of the dead body, leading you to a chest that contains x1 Flamedrake Talisman +3. Head west, then southwest to explore the area, entering another room.

In this room, you will find a ladder going down right across the door you just entered. When you go down, you will find four Common Soldiers gathering at the southwestern corner of the room. You can find pick up 7x Smithing Stone [5] on a dead body at the corner where the soldiers were gathering. There will be a chest containing x8 Smithing Stone [6]. On the southeastern part of the room, you can pick up x3 Spiritgrave Stone from a dead body.
Climb back up the stairs, then go through the doorway on the southwest. In this room, you can find x1 Fireproof Pickled Liver near the path going to the execution platform in the middle of the fort.

If you want to find the Behind the Fort of Reprimand Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map, you can access it by heading west of Bonny Gaol See Elden Ring Map and using a Spiritspring to jump over to the fort. The area contains the Site of Grace and a ladder leading to a mere Smithing Stone (8).NOTE: It is possible to access this area by standing on a pillar and doing a running jump towards the crumbled portion of the wall from where an Omenkiller enemy drops down on you.

title: Revered Spirit Ash
text: Return to the bottom of the spiritspring, then head north-northeast toward a statue on the cliff holding a Revered Spirit Ash.
Revered Spirit Ash: Found East from Moorth Ruins, on a statue by the cliff overlooking Bonny Village. Beware of a Deathblade nearby.

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Kill the pot-carrying Shadow Commoner below the ledge west-southwest of the statue for a Scadutree Fragment and Golden Horn Tender (first time).

Scadutree Fragment: Head north from Moorth Ruins to find an area with a pond and a cave entrance that leads to Rauh Ruins. Cross the pond, and just before the entrance to the cave, you'll find x1 Scadutree Fragment that can be looted by the statue of Marika.
Golden Horn Tender: From the area where you fight the dogs as you get underground, drop down and turn left to access a small cave. Follow it until the end to find the item.

title: Shattered Stone Talisman
text: On a ledge of a ruined building down the nearby hole lies a corpse with the Shattered Stone Talisman.
Shattered Stone Talisman: Moorth Ruins. Fall on the first rooftop visible from the gap on the ground, turn left, and walk on the ledge to find the Talisman.

title: Boss: Ghostflame Dragon
text: Return to the road and kill the Ghostflame Dragon for Dragon Heart, Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone, and 120,000 runes.
Ghostflame Dragon: Found currently fighting with Messmer Soldiers. The Ghostflame Dragon is a boss located north of Moorth Highway, South Site of Grace.
Dragon Heart: A Ghostflame Dragon Boss can be found currently fighting with Messmer Soldiers. It yields 120,000 Runes upon defeat. Drops a Dragon Heart and a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone: Dropped by Ghostflame Dragon Boss

title: Repeating Crossbow
text: Loot the Repeating Crossbow from a corpse next to the road where the enemies were fighting.
Repeating Crossbow: along the road next to the Ghostflame Dragon north of the Moorth Highway, South site of Grace

title: Flamedrake Talisman +3
text: Follow the road to a fort and grab the Moorth Highway, South grace on a ledge to the right.
At the end of the cliff southwest of the grace sits a corpse with a Rune Arc.
Rune Arc: Can be found on a body, away from the path near the cliff
Head back and enter the Fort of Reprimand:
Optional: Kill the Omenkiller near the entrance for Blessed Bone Shard x3 (first time).
Blessed Bone Shard: On the hanging row, in the middle of the Fort, lower level.
Grab the 2x Broken Rune, Throwing Dagger x8, Ghost Glovewort [6], Blessed Bone Shard, and Redflesh Mushroom x5 in the area.
Broken Rune: It can be found in the center of the main hall.
Blessed Bone Shard: Past the Fort Reprimand Site of Grace, take the small walkway to the side, you will find it on a body hanging from a scaffolding. Beware the enemy on the other side.
Go down the stairs to find a Fireproof Pickled Liver on the left.

Fireproof Pickled Liver: Past the soldiers protecting the festive grease. Get past the torture room, and once you see a set of stairs on your right, don't take them, turn right again, to find this item on a corpse.
Descend the ladder in the middle room for a corpse with Spiritgrave Stone x3 outside the cell.
Spiritgrave Stone: To the west of temple town ruins, in a cemetery area. Behind a grave.
Inside the cell is a corpse with Smithing Stone [6] x6 and a chest with Sunwarmth Stone x3 and Smithing Stone [7] x6.
Climb back up and grab the Festive Grease x2 next to the stairs.
Festive Grease: Past the Ghost Npc, take the stairs up and find in near the edge, besides a couple of Messmer Soldiers.
Before going up the stairs, climb the cages near the corpse to reach a chest with the Flamedrake Talisman +3.

Flamedrake Talisman +3: A +3 variation of the Flamedrake Talisman can be found inside a chest. You'll have to go over the cages and on the right side, you'll find the chest that contains the talisman.

title: Iris of Occultation
text: Go up the stairs, then grab the Broken Rune on the left, guarded by an Omenkiller that drops Blessed Bone Shard x4 (first time).
Broken Rune: Fort of Reprimand. Past the Horned Warrior beyond the Behind the Fort Reprimand Site of Grace, in the hallway belowto the left.
Continue up the stairs and pick up Dewgem x3 from the corpse slumped over a crenel.
Activate the Fort of Reprimand grace up the last set of stairs.
West of the grace, on a wooden platform extending past the rampart, lies a Blessed Bone Shard.
Drop down into the hole west-southwest of the grace to find a Shadow Realm Rune [4].
Shadow Realm Rune: In the hanging area, at the entrance, there is a gap on the ground to the left side. Fall on it, to find this item on the platform you land on.
Kill the Omenkiller around the corner to obtain an Iris of Occultation (first time).
Iris of Occultation: This item drops from a Lesser Omenkiller. Drop down the well in the main arena. The enemy will ambush you there among some items.

place.title: Fort of Reprimand
walk: Shadow of the Erdtree Fort of Reprimand Video Walkthrough

The entrance to Fort of Reprimand will be near the Moorth Highway, South Site of Grace. See Elden Ring Map. Before going through the main entrance of Fort of Reprimand, explore the outer walls on the east side. You will encounter Abductor Virgins in this area. After defeating the two Abductor Virgins, you can find a corpse on the eastern cliff that you can loot for x8 Smithing Stone [6]. Follow the southern wall of the fort, and you can find a Blessing of Marika on a corpse near the cliff. Go back near the main entrance, then head west to the cliff. Traverse through the cliff by going northwest, and you'll find a corpse with a Rune Arc at the end of the cliff.

When you enter through the main entrance of the Fort of Reprimand, you will be in the courtyard where the execution platform is located. There will be an Omenkiller patrolling the courtyard, so be prepared for combat. After defeating the Omenkiller, you are free to explore and loot the area. You can pick up numerous items in the courtyard, such as x8 Throwing Dagger, x2 Broken Rune, x1 Ghost Glovewort [1], x5 Redflesh Mushroom, and x1 Blessed Bone Shard. In the northeastern part of the courtyard, you will find a spot you can jump on to access its basement.

When you drop down, you will find loot such as x1 Shadow Realm Rune (4), x6 Knot Resin, x1 Broken Rune, and x1 Marika's Rune. An Omenkiller will be waiting around the corner near the pile of loot. Defeat the Omenkiller, and it will drop the Iris of Occultation. As you head deeper into the basement, you will find an exit leading to a section behind the fort. You'll find x1 Messmer Soldier Ashes by a gravestone. You'll also find a ladder going up the fort, so use that to go back inside the fort.

After climbing the ladder, you will end up on top of the fort walls. Follow the path to the right, then head left, looting a dead body by the stairs containing x3 Dewgem. To the northwest of the body, you can activate the Fort of Reprimand Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. An Omenkiller will be on top of the wall on your right, so be prepared to fight it. After defeating the Omenkiller, you can explore the western side of the Site of Grace, finding x1 Blessed Bone Shard on a dead body on a scaffolding.

Go back to the staircase near the Site of Grace, then go right after the staircase. You will find a dead body with x1 Broken Rune. Go back up the stairs, then to the spot where you dropped earlier. You'll find a room in which you will encounter Black Knight Edreed, who uses a twinblade in combat. He can also use flying attacks to close the distance to you, so be cautious of those attacks. After you have defeated Black Knight Edreed, he will drop the Ash of War: Aspects of the Crucible: Wings.

Head up the stairs, then climb up the ladder, which leads to the outside. On the southwestern part of the area, climb up the stairs. On top of the tower, you can open a chest to acquire x1 Battlefield Priest's Cookbook [2]. Backtrack your way to the Fort of Reprimand Site of Grace.

You will find a path going down near where you dropped. Go down the stairs and keep following the path. You will encounter numerous Common Soldiers in this area, which you can easily kill in a few attacks. In the room as you enter the area, you can pick up x2 Festive Grease from a dead body right beside where two soldiers are. Go through the cages east of the dead body, leading you to a chest that contains x1 Flamedrake Talisman +3. Head west, then southwest to explore the area, entering another room.

In this room, you will find a ladder going down right across the door you just entered. When you go down, you will find four Common Soldiers gathering at the southwestern corner of the room. You can find pick up 7x Smithing Stone [5] on a dead body at the corner where the soldiers were gathering. There will be a chest containing x8 Smithing Stone [6]. On the southeastern part of the room, you can pick up x3 Spiritgrave Stone from a dead body.
Climb back up the stairs, then go through the doorway on the southwest. In this room, you can find x1 Fireproof Pickled Liver near the path going to the execution platform in the middle of the fort.

If you want to find the Behind the Fort of Reprimand Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map, you can access it by heading west of Bonny Gaol See Elden Ring Map and using a Spiritspring to jump over to the fort. The area contains the Site of Grace and a ladder leading to a mere Smithing Stone (8).NOTE : It is possible to access this area by standing on a pillar and doing a running jump towards the crumbled portion of the wall from where an Omenkiller enemy drops down on you.

title: Messmer Soldier Ashes
text: Pick up the Knot Resin x6, Broken Rune, and Marika's Rune from the pile of corpses.
Knot Resin: x6. In the lower area, where you fight the Omenkiller.
Broken Rune: x1 In the lower area, where you fight the Omenkiller.
Marika's Rune: In the lower area, where you fight the Omenkiller.
Continue outside to find the Messmer Soldier Ashes in front of some gravestones.
Messmer Soldier Ashes: From the area where you fight the Omenkiller, cross the whole room to the other side, it will lead outside, You will find the spirit ashes near a grave.

title: Boss: Black Knight Edreed
text: Head up the ladder and kill Black Knight Edredd for Ash of War: Aspects of the Crucible: Wings and 80,000 runes.
Ash of War: Aspects of the Crucible: Wings: Black Knight Edreed drops this Ash of War upon defeat.
Black Knight Edreed: Drops Ash of War: Aspects of the Crucible: Wings. Drops 4446 runes and the Ash of War: Aspects of the Crucible: Wings.

title: Battlefield Priest's Cookbook [2]
text: Climb your way to the top for a chest with the Battlefield Priest's Cookbook [2].
Battlefield Priest's Cookbook [2]: Fort Reprimand. Take the stairs up after defeating Black Knight Edreed. It is inside the chest at the top.

title: Forager Brood Cookbook
text: Optional: Kill the first Abductor Virgin outside the fort for Broken Rune x5, Shadow Realm Rune [2], and a Shadow Realm Rune [3] (first time).
Broken Rune: Can be found behind a cart, in the hanging row area.
Shadow Realm Rune: Found southeast to the Moorth Ruins Site of grace, on the roof of a crumbled house.
Optional: Kill the malfunctioned Abductor Virgin for Broken Rune x4, Shadow Realm Rune [1] x2, and a Shadow Realm Rune [4] (first time).

Broken Rune: Bonny Gaol: Return to the sewer area where you jumped down. You will see an unreachable item in the western area because of the grills blocking the way. Look for the narrow area here and watch out for the slug-like enemies down here. They can be difficult to spot because of their color so listen closely to their sounds. This path will lead to a Broken Rune that you can pick up from a corpse.
Shadow Realm Rune [4]: Consumable. 1x can be looted from a corpse in Village of the Flies, on the higher area by two shadow casters and many man-fly enemies.
On a ledge near the Abductor Virgins lies a corpse with Smithing Stone [6] x8.
Pick up the Blessing of Marika on the cliff near the fort wall.
Blessing of Marika: Can be found on a body outside the Fort.
Jump down the spiritspring below the cliff using Torrent, then take it back up to discover the Behind the Fort of Reprimand grace.
Climb the ladder past the grace to reach a chest containing an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Travel to the Main Gate Cross and talk to Moore to receive Forager Brood Cookbook [7].
Forager Brood Cookbook: Acquired by selecting the option "Talk to Moore" when speaking with Moore. Requires having healed the Kindred of Rot found north from the Church of the Crusade here
Optional: Talk to Ansbach about the cross where the eye was abandoned, then talk to him again to hear his conclusion.
Optional: Talk to Leda and ask her about the silent monk.
miss: Becomes unobtainable if any Forager Brood are killed. I recommend getting this cookbook before Miquella's charm breaks. If the charm has already broken, you must get it immediately after telling him to 'Put it behind you' or 'Remain sad forever', as reloading the area will cause Moore to leave.

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: On the edge of the pond northeast of the Moorth Ruins grace lies a Four-Toed Fowl Foot.
Four-Toed Fowl Foot: Below Ralva the Great Red Bear area, in the small pond filled with worms.
Pick up the Scadutree Fragment below the statue at the north end of the water.

Scadutree Fragment: x1 Scadutree Fragment found in a coffin at the bottom of the waterfall. To reach this area, you must follow the cliffs along the top and then find a place to drop by a graveyard with gravebirds, then explore upriver.

title: Heal from Afar
text: Head through the cave near the statue to pick up a Shadow Realm Rune [3], Shadow Sunflower x2, and Heal from Afar.

Heal from Afar: This spell can be looted on the ground by the foot of an underground golden tree. It is located in a cave path to the base of the Rauh Ruins, north-northeast of the Moorth Ruins in Scadu Atlus. Guarded by 3 Perfumers
Shadow Realm Rune [3]: Looted from a corpse near a giant Mirandla Blossom
Shadow Sunflower: A Shadow Sunflower can be found near the edge of a cliff, southwest of the Ruins of Unte.

title: Forager Brood Cookbook
text: After exiting the cave, stick to the right side to find a Forager Brood by the cliff. Interact with it to receive Forager Brood Cookbook [5] and Pearlescent Scale.
Pearlescent Scale: Gifted to you by the non-aggro Kindred of Rot in the area upon first interacting.

Forager Brood Cookbook: Acquired by interacting with the pest found east outside of the Shadow Keep. It can be accessed from the Church District Highroad site of grace and traveling West up the cliff above the tunnel road, then continuing West to the outer wall of the keep.
miss: Missed if you kill the Forager Brood before interacting with it or fail Moore's questline. If you tell Moore to 'Remain sad forever' after Miquella's charm breaks, the Forager Brood disappear and their cookbooks become unobtainable.

title: Gravebird Anklets
text: Pick up the Gravebird Anklets by the stone arch near the Forager Brood.
Gravebird Anklets: Found in a swamp infested with Gravebirds, below a big archway.

title: Ash of War: Scattershot Throw
text: Head west to find a corpse with Smithing Stone [7] x2 near another arch.
Continue past the arch to reach a ruin-strewn clearing with the Ancient Ruins Base grace.
Follow the road northeast of the grace to a scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [7].
Somber Smithing Stone [7]: A Scarab can be found northeast of the Ancient Ruins Base Site of Grace. Between a group of Messmer Soldiers and Demi-Humans. Drops Somber Smithing Stone [7].
Shoot down the scarab hanging from a pillar on the side of the road to obtain Ash of War: Scattershot Throw.
Ash of War: Scattershot Throw: Can be found by killing a scarab. Just south of Taylew's Ruined Forge entrance, near a bridge. It's hanging high on a pillar with some mobs underneath it.

title: Smithscript Axe
text: Follow the road to a forge, then kill the scarab up on the right-side ledge for a Somber Smithing Stone [9].
Somber Smithing Stone [9]: Can be found by killing a teardrop scarab. The scarab is located at the edge of the roof just outside Taylew's Ruined Forge.
Go back and enter Taylew's Ruined Forge:
Head inside and activate the Taylew's Ruined Forge grace.
Pick up a Shadow Realm Rune [3] from the first area.
Shadow Realm Rune [3]: Taylew's Ruined Forge: From the site of grace, head down east and you will immediately find a this rune on a corpse.
Continue across the short bridge for a Smithing Stone [5] beside a brazier.

Smithing Stone [5]: x5 From the Main Gate Plaza Site of Grace, turn right and head up the stairs. Take the path on the left and go through the burning boats. Take another left and drop down from the bridge, you'll find a corpse on the ground with this item.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [1] at the bottom of a ladder.

Smithing Stone [1]: x4 Leave the golden tree area through the Northeastern gate, fight both enemies, and turn to the back side of the room to find the item on the corpse next to a rack of spears and shields.
Go down the stairs and enter the room across the gap for a Smithing Stone [4], Smithing Stone [1], and Smithscript Axe.

Smithscript Axe: Location: Taylew's Ruined Forge . From the initial site of grace, continue following the path, get past the enemy, and take the ladder down then jump across the other platforms and turn left. You will find a Golem there. Behind it, at the back of the room, you will find the Smithscript Axe.

title: Smithscript Greathammer
text: Head below the gap to find a Smithing Stone [1] and a Smithing Stone [4].
Jump to the area on the other side of the pipe to pick up Smithing Stone [5], Smithing Stone [1], and Smithscript Greathammer.

Smithscript Greathammer: Use the giant platform in the middle to jump to the other side. Once there, keep moving forward and on the left side there will be a fire blob enemy protecting the item. Defeat the enemy and loot the corpse behind it to obtain the weapon.

title: Smithscript Shield
text: Go up the pipe, then jump to the area on the left to find Smithing Stone [8] x2, Smithing Stone [6] (below), Smithing Stone [4], Smithing Stone [1], and an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Smithing Stone [8]: x5 Can be found in the west area of the library. Beware of the Fire Knight in the vicinity.
Smithing Stone [6]: x2 As you reach the fifth floor from the outside ladder, turn left and you will find this item on a corpse against a wall.

Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone: Return to the platform in the middle that you have moved with the lever, and head up. Jump to the left once you are near the top. Take the stairs up in the area, and interact with the furnace to receive an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone along with the Taylew the Golem Smith Spirit Ashes.
Jump back to the pipe and onto the area on the right. Go through the south-southwest corridor and up to the second floor for a Smithing Stone [4], 2x Smithing Stone [6], and the Smithscript Shield.

Smithscript Shield: Jump from the opening left to the Lever, and instead of heading forward turn left. There are two Smithing Golems there, one that uses fire. Once defeated, stick to the right and go up to the upper platform using the crumbled column. You will find the item at the end of the hallway. Beware of the fire blob that falls from the ceiling.

title: Taylew the Golem Smith
text: Loot the 2x Smithing Stone [5], Smithing Stone [4], and Smithing Stone [1] on the ground floor.
Jump over the nearby balustrade to reach a corridor with Smithing Stone [8] x3.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [4] at the end of the corridor.
Climb the ladder in the corridor, then jump over the gap to a Smithing Stone [5] and a Somber Smithing Stone [9].
Somber Smithing Stone [9]: Shadow Keep . Take the lift from the Church District up to the Specimen Storehouse, and turn right as you exit it.
Hop back across and go up the stairs to reach a Smithing Stone [4], Smithing Stone [6], and the pipe lever.
Pull the lever, then drop down the raised platform and take the west-northwest corridor to a Smithing Stone [4], Smithing Stone [6], and Somber Smithing Stone [8].

Somber Smithing Stone [8]: Shadow Keep - accessed from the Church District Side. From the gear in which you found Wrath from Afar, jump towards the next platform and head to the ladder on the left. Climb it up. Once at the top, take the wooden beam on your left all the way to the end, deal with the bat, and use the nearby ladder to descend. The item can be found on a corpse right around the corner.
Make your way to the top of the pipe, then jump to the area on the left for a Smithing Stone [6].
Climb the ladder and examine the altar to obtain Taylew the Golem Smith and an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

Taylew the Golem Smith: Return to the platform in the middle that you have moved with the lever, and head up. Jump to the left once you are near the top. Take the stairs up in the area, and interact with the furnace to receive the Spirit Ashes along with an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone: Use the giant platform in the middle, but don't jump to the other side. Climb all the way up and jump to the platform on the left. There are 2 Smithing Golems there. Head to the small balcony at the back of the area, where the second golem lurks and you'll find the item on a corpse.

place.title: Taylew's Ruined Forge
walk: Taylew's Ruined Forge Full Walkthrough Video

Taylew's Ruined Forge is one of the latest optional dungeons in Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree. Just like the other optional dungeons, it is crawling with interesting items to collect. Starting from the entrance of Taylew's Ruined Forge where the Site of Grace is located. Players can progress in the dungeon by heading through the inner section of it. However, if you haven't found the dungeon yet, click the link here so the interactive map will be able to guide you and find the location of the dungeon.

To proceed, head to the next area by heading through the nearest tunnel. You will eventually see a balcony where you can see stored lava underneath the ruins. Near your location, there's a dead body and upon looting it, receive a Shadow Realm Rune (3). Follow the hallway and eventually, you will come across a ladder and use it to reach the lower part of the area. Follow the hallway and you will eventually come across debris and broken stone floorings that should be able to cross by jumping. You will also notice that this dungeon is part of Scadu Altus.

To proceed, follow the hallway and find a Golem Smith. Note that this enemy is resilient to physical attacks and has a lot of health. However, it is rather slow so plan your attacks and stance and break the said golem until it dies. After beating the Golem Smith, get the nearest loot which is the Smithscript Axe. Continue progressing in the dungeon by exiting back from where you came from and this time, access the lower parts by jumping into the broken part of the hallway.

Follow the hallway and you will eventually reach a long stone pillar that extends to the lava area underneath you and also extends to the upper part of the area. But first, access the adjacent area from where you are. You will come across another lava slime. Defeat and behind it, there is loot near the broken statue which contains the Smithscript Greathammer. Proceed by heading back to the stone pillar and this time head to the upper area by accessing the upper part of the stone pillar.

You will eventually notice that there are two platforms that you can jump off to. Access the one on the left and you will come across two Golem Smith enemies. This encounter will be challenging as both so proceed with caution. One thing to note is, that there's a red stone located at the back of these golems and these are the weak spots of these entities.

After defeating both of the golems, head to the nearest balcony where a dead body lies. Loot the body and get an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone. Head back to the area where you fought the two Golem Smith, loot another dead body, and receive x5 Smithing Stone [4].

To proceed, head back to the stone pillar and use it to get across to the adjacent platform. There are three directions that you can head from here. However, we suggest heading to the lower area by jumping from the platform you are in right now.

You are in the correct area if you landed in Lava Slimes. Follow the hallway and there's a nearby dead body that you can loot. It contains a x3 Smithing Stone [8]. Proceed by heading to the other hallway near the location where a ladder that you can access. Use the ladder to proceed.

After the ladder, you will be greeted with Lava Slimes. Take them out and notice that there's another area or platform where you can jump off too. However, a Lava Slime and another Golem Smith are waiting on the other side.

Take these enemies out and there is another dead body which you can loot. Loot it and get a x1 Somber Smithing Stone [3]. Head to the other hallway near the ladder and find yourself on another balcony. There's a nearby lever that you can interact with. Pull the lever and notice that the stone pillar will change its position so you can access the other side of the area.

To proceed, notice that there's another chained ironed platform that you can jump off to be able to return and access the pillar. But before heading to the stone pillar, notice that there's another hallway near which leads to a dead end.

There's another dead body that you can loot which contains x1 Somber Smithing Stone [8]. Head back to the previous hallway and this time, head to the other hallway which leads to a room filled with Golem Smiths and Lava Slimes. You are in the right area if you notice the Elite Golem Smith that has some kind of burning ember on its head.

Deal with this enemy first and try to lure it from the pack. Be careful though as it can throw lavas at you by using the said ember. After dealing with all the enemies around this area, notice that there is debris that you can use to reach the upper area. Once you reach the upper area, notice that there's an important item to loot.

Loot the said item and receive an x1 Smithscript Shield. We are about to reach the end of this dungeon and proceed by heading back to the Stone Pillar and you will notice there's another area that you can reach on the left while climbing the stone pillar.
Reach the said area and notice that there's a ladder that you can take to proceed. Do so and you will find an altar near your location.

Interact with this Altar and you will receive the following, x1 Taylew the Golem Smith and x1 Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone. This is the end of the dungeon and access the teleporter so you can exit the dungeon.

title: Bloodfiend's Sacred Spear
text: Kill the Bloodfiend Hexer in the pond west-southwest of the forge for the Bloodfiend's Sacred Spear (first time).
Bloodfiend's Sacred Spear: The Bloodfiend west of Taylew's Ruined Forge drops this when killed.

title: Pearl Shield Talisman
text: Pick up Sacred Bloody Flesh x3, Smithing Stone [7] x4, and Sanguine Amaryllis x5 from the two corpses in the water.
Smithing Stone [7]: Upgrade material looted from the pond west of Taylew's Ruined Forge. Protected by various Bloodfiends and dogs.
A Shadow Realm Rune [3] lies on a ledge between the cliff and a pillar, southwest of the pond.
Shadow Realm Rune [3]: Consumable looted from a corpse hanging from a ledge near the small burrow cave in Rauh Base northern area.
Kill the Chief Bloodfiend for Sacred Bloody Flesh x5 (first time), then pick up another Sacred Bloody Flesh x5 from the cave.
A small campsite lies just south of the cave. Loot the Pearl Shield Talisman from a chest under the canopy.
Pearl Shield Talisman: Found inside a chest in a small camp of Messmer soldiers in the woods. Southwestern of Taylew's Ruined Forge Site of Grace.

title: Larval Tear
text: Return to Ancient Ruins Base and pass time until nightfall. Head west-southwest to find Rauh Burrow on top of a fallen stone structure.
Rauh Burrow: Between the golem archer and the Ancient Ruins Base Site of Grace on a body. Near the giant columns.
Continue southwest to find another corpse with Rauh Burrow in the middle of the ravine.
Follow the right side of the ravine up a slope to reach a corpse with Smithing Stone [8] x4
On the other side of the ravine, near the cliff, is a Larval Tear surrounded by blue spiritgraves.
Larval Tear: West of the Ravine North Site of Grace . Found between the glowing gravestones. (only at night)

title: Boss: Red Bear
text: West-southwest of the spiritgraves is a sealed spiritspring. Hit the stacked stones at the top of the ledge to unseal it.
Take the spiritsprings up, then enter the mausoleum and kill Red Bear for Red Bear's Claw, Iron Rivet Set, and 80,000 runes.
Red Bear: The Red Bear boss is located within the Northern Nameless Mausoleum .
Fang Helm: Armor piece drops upon defeating the Red Bear located at the Northern Nameless Mausoleum .

Iron Rivet Set: Drops the following armor pieces of the Iron Rivet Set upon defeating the Red Bear located at the Northern Nameless Mausoleum . Iron Rivet Armor Iron Rivet Gauntlets Iron Rivet Greaves
Red Bear's Claw: Weapon drops upon defeating the Red Bear located at the Northern Nameless Mausoleum .

place.title: Northern Nameless Mausoleum
walk: Just like any other mausoleum in the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC, the location is an arena for a mini-boss encounter against the Red Bear. By the entrance, there is a Summoning Pool or effigy for players to use for co-op. There is also a Stake of Marika that you can use to respawn by the entrance of the mausoleum in case you die. As mentioned, the location is where you'll fight against a mini-boss, so make preparations before you pass through the mist. For guides and strategies on how to defeat the boss, please visit the Red Bear page.
Defeating this mini-boss rewards the player with the following items:
Iron Rivet Set
Red Bear's Claw

guide.title: Rauh Base
text: Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Rauh Base
Travel to Rauh Base from the lake north of Moorth Ruins
Obtain the Map: Rauh Ruins
Go to Northern Nameless Mausoleum and defeat Red Bear
Go to Temple Town Ruins
Find the way to Rivermouth Cave (This dungeon is part of Gravesite Plain but can be accessed from Rauh Base)to see alternate route below.
Complete Scorpion River Catacombs
Explore Taylew's Ruined Forge
Explore the vast plain in the northwest
Take the Larval Tear found northwest of the Ravine North Site of Grace. Found between the glowing gravestones (nighttime only)
Defeat Rugalea the Great Red Bear (optional)

title: Map: Rauh Ruins
text: Jump back down the spiritsprings, then follow the road to a stele with Map: Rauh Ruins.

Map: Rauh Ruins: The Map: Rauh Ruins map fragment can be looted by the foot of a monolith. To reach this location, make your way into the Scadu Atlus region. Starting from the Moorth Ruins Site of Grace located in Scadu Atlus, head northeast towards the hidden cave and follow the tunnel leading to the Ancient Ruins Base. Next, follow the canyon along and you'll find it just outside of the Temple Town Ruins.

title: Revered Spirit Ash
text: Continue until you reach the water, then head south toward a slanted ruin with Smithing Stone [5] x6 on top of it.
Pick up the Spiritgrave Stone x3 behind the ruined wall northwest of the slanted ruin.
Head north-northwest from the ruined wall to discover the Temple Town Ruins grace.
From the grace, head south-southwest and follow the right wall to a Grave Glovewort [8] near some gravestones by the cliff.
Follow the cliff edge until you reach a statue holding a Revered Spirit Ash.
Revered Spirit Ash: South of Temple Town Ruins, you will see the altar near the edge.

place.title: Rivermouth Cave
walk: ER Shadow of the Erdtree Rivermouth Cave Video Walkthrough

As you enter Rivermouth Cave, you will immediately discover the Rivermouth Cave Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. If you go to the cavern going east, you will encounter 4 wolves in an area. In the northeast side of the room, you can pillage a body for x2 Hefty Beast Bone.

As you head deeper, the path will fork. The path on the right will have two hostile wolves along with a dead body that you can loot for x3 Sliver of Meat. This leads to a dead-end, so return to the path and follow the other path. This path will lead you to an area with an upper level and three wolves.

If you climb up the opening on the east side of the area, you will find a body containing loot. When you get closer to loot the body, the ground will collapse, making you fall. You can then loot the body to pick up a Shadow Realm Rune [1]. The path going northwest will be a dead-end, so go down the path east. As you are traversing the eastern path, you can gather x1 Sanguine Amaryllis along the way.

The path will lead you to an area full of Bloodfiends. If you want to go back up, go to the path on your right, and you will encounter a Bloodfiend. After disposing of the enemy, follow the path west going up, in which you will encounter two wolves. Keep following the path, encountering two more wolves along with a dead body that you can loot for x1 Sacred Bloody Flesh. Keep following the path, which is going north, and you will be back in the area before you fell.

If you wish to continue, you can clear the area by sneaking up on the ogres and backstabbing them. They are also easy to deal with, as you can kill them in around two hits. If you aggro them all at the same time, you can fight one of them at a time by dragging the enemies away from the area. After clearing them, you can gather a few Sanguine Amaryllis around the edges of the blood pool. On the altar, you can pick up x3 Sacred Bloody Flesh. In the northern corner of the area, near the ramp where you came from, you can pick up x6 Sanguine Amaryllis. There will be a boss fog nearby.

When you enter the boss room, you will be facing the Chief Bloodfiend. It is a more aggressive version of the Bloodfiends that you encountered earlier. It can jump towards you from afar, while also using its club more effectively than the ones you encountered earlier. For a more in-depth guide on how to defeat the Chief Bloodfiend, you can go refer to this page. Once you have defeated the Chief Bloodfiend, it will drop x1 Bloodfiend Hexer's Ashes. You can find the exit on the southeastern side of the room.

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Look for a hole in the wall north of the statue to find the way inside Temple Town Ruins:
Pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [6] from the corpse in the back corner.
Turn back to find Beast Blood x3 on some roof tiles next to the entrance hole.
Go up the stairs, then turn around and kill the pot-carrying Shadow Commoner for Rauh Burrow x4 and Silver Horn Tender (first time).

Rauh Burrow: From the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West Site of Grace, head towards the building and climb up the stairs. Beware of enemies in the area. Go through the path on the left, and you'll find a corpse with this item.
Silver Horn Tender: Dropped by the Shadow Pothead in the area, along with x1 Revered Spirit Ash, x1 Dewgem, and x1 Rauh Burrow.
Pick up a Scadutree Fragment from the corpse slumped over the covered bridge.

Scadutree Fragment: Temple Town Ruins . From the entrance through the gap in the wall, take the stairs on the right and climb up until you reach the cloth-like part of the structure at the top. Before heading down, check on the right side to see a small opening that will lead to the middle platform. Fall there and defeat the two enemies, In the middle of the bridge you will find a body that has x1 Scadutree Fragment.

place.title: Temple Town Ruins
walk: The Temple Town Ruins is located near the Gravesite Plain, southeast of the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. Start at Moorth Ruins and head north. Then go east past a pool of water and through a tunnel. The tunnel has a beheaded Snake of Marika at its entrance. You'll come out in a swamp. Keep going northwest to reach Rauh Base and the Ancient Ruins Base Site of Grace. From there, head southwest through a woody crevasse. You'll arrive at the remains of a village with shadows everywhere. The Temple Town Ruins Site of Grace is on the northwest edge of the old town.

After activating the Temple Town Ruins Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map, follow the river going east. You will be by the ruins area with Shadow Pothead enemies scattered around the ruins. Explore the ruins area, and you'll find x4 Rada Fruit on a dead body on top of a collapsed roof. You can also find x1 Revered Spirit Ash on the southern part of the ruins. Afterwards, you can head west through the archway to find the graveyard section of the ruins. You can pick up x1 Grave Glovewort [8] on a dead body. A Spiritgrave Stone can also be picked up on the western side of the graveyard, by the gravestones on the corner.

To get inside the ruins' structure, you can find a small opening on the southern part of the wall of the enclosed structure. You will encounter numerous Shadow Undead, Shadow Pothead and Rotten Strays, so be prepared to face numerous enemies. On the southeastern corner of the ruins, you can find x3 Beast Blood by a collapsed roof, along with x1 Golden Rune [1]. Continue heading north, and you can pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [3] by a wall on the west side beside a Shadow Undead.

Head up the stairs on the east side, then go south to find a Shadow Pothead. Continue heading up the stairs covered by tattered cloth. Go on the northwestern edge of the collapsed roof, then drop down carefully to get to the area under the roof. Once you have successfully dropped down, you'll be in a small room with pots and a Shadow Undead. Go past the archway, and you'll encounter another Shadow Pothead. In this area, you can loot the dead body to obtain a Scadutree Fragment. Exit the structure through where you dropped earlier, then head northwest.

Traverse through the bridge on the northwestern side, picking up x2 Furlcalling Finger Remedy along the way. You will encounter a Horned Warrior going down the stairs. After defeating the Horned Warrior, go up the stairs where it was coming down from. A structure will be at the top of the stairs containing a chest. Open the chest to find the Two-Handed Sword Talisman.

guide.title: How to Reach Rauh Base from Moorth Ruins
text: This section covers how you can reach Rauh Base by traveling north of Moorth Ruins. There is a lake with glowing worm-like creatures and you need to go through it. You can also pick up Four-Toed Fowl Foot from a nearby corpse here.

As you reach the entrance, make sure to pick up the Scadutree Fragment from the tall Statue of Marika here. There are some enemies inside, a mix of Miranda Sprout and white-cloaked enemies here. It's up to you if you want to fight them or just run through them.

Exit to the right as you reach the small Golden Tree here, and then head outside. Once you reach the poisonous swamp past the golden tree, look for the Forager Brood (pest) along the right cliff edge. You will find it near the Deathbird-infested swamp. Interact with it to receive the Forager Brood Cookbook [5]. Then, exit the west until you get the Rauh Base flash on your screen.

Activate the Ancient Ruins Base Site of Grace as you formally enter this new location. Taylew's Ruined Forge is just northeast of this Site of Grace, but the first thing you need to do is to get the Map: Rauh Ruins so you can navigate easily. You can come back to this location later on.

To get the map, travel southwest where you see 2 Golem Warriors ahead. One is using a bow, while the other one is using an axe. It is recommended to eliminate them before you take the map since they can still attack you from a very long distance. Get rid of the archer first as it's easier to deal with them in close combat. Then, you can take on the other golem warrior. The map is just ahead, next to stone heads past the golem warriors. After acquiring the map, head southwest to locate the access to the Northern Nameless Mausoleum.

title: Two-Handed Sword Talisman
text: Head across the second bridge for a corpse with Arrow x10 on the left.
Loot the Two-Handed Sword Talisman from the chest at the end.
Two-Handed Sword Talisman: Temple Town Ruins . After the fight with the Horned Warrior, just continue up to the next room to find a chest with this item inside.

title: Divine Bird Warrior Ornis
text: Head up the slope north of the Temple Town Ruins grace to find Whiteflesh Mushroom x5 on a ledge.
Use the spiritspring near the corpse while facing south to reach a chest with Beast Horn x2.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [7] x3 on the wall behind the chest.
Jump over the gap below the wall and follow the tunnel to a building with Divine Bird Warrior Ornis.

Divine Bird Warrior Ornis: Spirit Ashes. Climb the crumbled structure of the building in Temple Town Ruins which can only be reachbed by jumping on the Spiritspring. Once on top, turn right and jump to the platform. Move forward inside the cave, turn left and enter the room with a chest containing this item.

title: Gravebird's Blackquill Armor
text: Return to the grace and head north-northwest up the slope on the left side to find Gravebird's Blackquill Armor at the top.

Gravebird's Blackquill Armor: From the Temple Town Ruins site of grace head north, past the Red Pests servants of rot, and stick to the left. The path will start to head upwards and you will find several Gravebirds. Continue upwards and you will eventually reach an area where there are gravebird statues at the side, in the middle, against the wall, you will find the armor.

title: Fire Spritestone, Antiquity Scholar's Cookbook [1] +1
text: Pick up Preserving Boluses x2 from the island with a giant pillar in the middle of the river.
Kill the pot-carrying Shadow Commoner in the alcove east of the island for Fire Spritestone x3 and the Antiquity Scholar's Cookbook [1] (first time).
Fire Spritestone: Past the door opened with the lever, turn to the right at the first forked path and past the shadow enemies, you will find the item on a body hanging on the edge.

Antiquity Scholar's Cookbook [1]: North of the temple town ruins site of grace, past the red servants of rot, there is a cave, inside it you will find a Shadowpothead enemy. Beware of the poison traps littered around. Drops x3 Fire Spritestone , and Antiquity Scholar's Cookbook [1] .
Antiquity Scholar's Cookbook: From the entrance of the Ancient Ruins of Rauh , head north towards the edge, and head west, you will find an area with an item below in which you can jump.

title: Ash of War The Poison Flower Blooms Twice
text: West of the alcove and on the other side of the river is a scarab that drops Ash of War: The Poison Flower Blooms Twice.

Ash of War The Poison Flower Blooms Twice: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab. From where you found the shadowpothead, move north a bit and turn left, you will see it on the other side of the river. Kill it to obtain a new ash of war. Ash of War The Poison Flower Blooms Twice .

title: Boss: Rugalea the Great Red Bear
text: Activate the Ravine North grace across the river and pass time until nightfall.
Head northwest from the grace and up a slanted pillar in the woods to reach an area with two sleeping Runebears. Pick up Lump of Flesh x3, Beast Blood x2, and Throwing Dagger x5 from the rock pile.

Throwing Dagger: x5 Below a statue. In the Far end of the room with a large opening that overlooks the ruins. It would be inside the underground cavern that is accessible in the far north of this location with a many sided like shaped hole.
On a ledge south-southwest of the rock pile is a corpse with the Gloried variant of the Highland Warrior Set.
Kill Rugalea the Great Red Bear for Roar of Rugalea and 210,000 runes.
Roar of Rugalea: Dropped by Rugalea the Great Red Bear, northwest of the Ravine North Site of Grace, in the wooded area where there are many large bears.

title: Greater Potentate's Cookbook [8]
text: Optional: Freyja's summon sign can be found nearby if she hasn't moved to the Shadow Keep. If you didn't summon her in Belurat, you can summon her now to get the additional dialogue from defeating a boss with her.
Head south down the hillside where you fought Rugalea to find a Larval Tear surrounded by blue spiritgraves.
Pick up Greater Potentate's Cookbook [8] from the excrement pile southwest of the blue spiritgraves.
Greater Potentate's Cookbook [8]: Looted from a corpse atop a dung pile on the western section of northern Rauh Base, past the bear boss fight.

title: Black Knight Captain Huw
text: Head down to the river and follow it to a Ghost Glovewort [6] near some coffins in the water.
At the end of the river lies the entrance to Scorpion River Catacombs:
Take the lift down and grab the Scorpion River Catacombs grace.
Pick up Rejuvenating Boluses x3 from the first room on the left.
Quickly run across the bridge and pick up the Grave Glovewort [7] down a set of stairs ahead.
Continue to a room with Redflesh Mushroom x5 and a Bigmouth Imp.
Head down two staircases and pick up a Ghost Glovewort [6] from the corpse below an impaling mechanism.
Drop down next to the corpse and grab the Shadow Realm Rune [4] in the short corridor.

Shadow Realm Rune [4]: Scorpion River Catacombs. Found on a corpse in the area with two spike drops before the second lift. You must not take the lift and instead drop to a lower portion where Basiliks await.
Climb the ladder and drop down to a room with a Ghost Glovewort [7].
Return to the larger room and continue past the second impaling mechanism to find an altar with Black Knight Captain Huw.

Black Knight Captain Huw: Scorpion River Catacombs . Past the first ceiling with the falling spikes, reach the Yellow Fulgurbloom and turn right, you will see x2 Messmer Soldiers and a Black Knight. Between both of you, there is another ceiling with spikes, be mindful when engaging in combat. Once those enemies are defeated, head to the coffin at the end to find the Spirit Ashes.

guide.title: Path to Scorpion River Catacombs
text: The Scorpion River Catacombs is located on the far western section of Rauh Base. You can get here by traveling west past Temple Town Ruins where you will come across scarlet-inflicted pest enemies. The path here is dangerous because these enemies can stagger you while riding Torrent. From the Temple Town Ruins Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map, face the western direction and follow the river that's heading north, then to the west. You can also activate the Ravine North Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map as you are turning left. This is found on an upper section to the right side.

From the site of grace, jump down to the river below you. You will find a Horned Warrior standing in the middle of the water. You can fight it for a chance to get its armor, then, stick to the wall on your left side until you see gravestones come into view. As you reach the end here, you will see a door with 2 Ghostflame lanterns. This is your entrance to the Scorpion River Catacombs.

From the Site of Grace, head straight through the catacombs. In the first room, an Imp enemy will ambush you. Afterward, head left down a short set of stairs towards a large hallway and turn left into a small room. Inside, you'll find a corpse holding x3 Rejuvenating Boluses and two Imps guarding it. Take them out.

Exit the small room and cross the bridge in the middle of the large hallway until you find another set of stairs going down. Follow the path until you reach another large room with two Imp enemies inside. Eliminate them and head down the stairs of the large room. Just below the stairs is a corpse holding a Grave Glovewort [3]. Proceed through the tunnel entrance on the same level to find another room with an Imp guarding a plant on the left that gives you Yellow Fulgurbloom. At the other end of the room is another tunnel, but before proceeding, loot the corpse beside the tunnel to get x5 Redflesh Mushroom.

Head down the tunnel and go straight through the tight path, turning right towards another short set of stairs going down. Do not immediately exit the tunnel after turning right. There's a large spike trap that launches from above. Wait for the spike to go down, then immediately run to the right to a small space that keeps you safe from the spike trap. From here, you can either run to the right to get out of the spike area or go to the corpse on the other side that has the Ghost Glovewort [3] and then run to safety after looting it.

Once you're out of the spike trap area, turn left and drop down to another level, but be careful, as there are three Basilisks waiting to attack you. After killing the Basilisks, head through the tunnel on this level to find another corpse on the left, giving you the Shadow Realm Runes [4]. Exit the tunnel, and just to the left, you'll see another Yellow Fulgurbloom.

To the right, you'll find a ladder going up. Head up the ladder and take out an Imp enemy on the edge of the tunnel enjoying the view of the next room. Drop down into the room and loot the corpse on the right for another Ghost Glovewort [5].

Then, head to the left side of the room and up a short set of stairs. Turn left to find yourself back at the spike trap area. Cross the spike trap area again, but instead of dropping down to the Basilisk area, turn right. This leads to an open hallway with Messmer Soldiers inside. Before proceeding toward the Messmer Soldiers, run to a safe space on the right as the first half of the hallway is another spike trap. Once you cross the hallway, take out the two Messmer Soldiers and then the Black Knight with its back turned. After clearing the hallway, loot the corpse on the right near where you fought the Messmer Soldiers to get a Smithing Stone [5]. In the middle of the hallway, where the Black Knight stood, loot the altar to receive the Black Knight Captain Huw spirit.

Afterward, head back to the safe area of the second spike trap and climb the ladder going up. Once you reach the top, wait for the spike trap to go down. Before it goes back up, hop on top of it to reach a secret platform above. Loot the corpse there to get a Ghost Glovewort [6]. Hop on the spike trap again to go back to the level above the ladder.

Cross the bridge to the right, and before heading straight through the other tunnel, turn left and cross the ledge. Hop on the spike trap that goes down on the left to reach another secret platform and loot a corpse for the Imp Head (lion), paying attention to the Basilisk Eyes that active as you approach.

Return to the ledge, but before going back, turn left first to the tunnel here and enter the small room at the end. Kill two Imps guarding a corpse that gives you the Knight's Lightning Spear. Afterward, head back through the tunnel. Before exiting to the ledge area, turn left and go up the stairs to a small area with two Imps. Loot the corpse on the left to get x6 Yellow Fulgurbloom.

Once done looting, drop down near the corpse to find yourself back at the crossing point of the ledge where you crossed the bridge earlier. Go through the tunnel now and take the elevator down. Once you reach the bottom, head straight through the catacomb tunnels until you reach an intersection. Turn right and wait a few seconds for a shadow fireball trap to cross. When the shadow fireball passes and goes back, tail it down a set of stairs. There's climbable rubble up ahead, but first, check if the shadow fireball has crossed. If it has, climb up the rubble and turn right to the first path.

Follow the path until you reach a giant Imp guarding a short set of stairs. Loot the corpse to the right for a Grave Glovewort [4] before taking out the giant Imp. Head down the stairs after defeating the giant Imp and you'll find yourself in another large room. Head straight and loot the corpse and plant for a Yellow Fulgurbloom and a Ghost Glovewort [8]. Then, go down the ladder to the right of the plant and corpse. Once you reach the bottom, loot the corpse to the left for a Great Ghost Glovewort.

Head back up the ladder and turn left through another tunnel and head up the stairs. At the top, peek first because there are two Shadow Fireballs that will cross. Wait for them to pass above you and then run across the bridge. You can stop in the middle of the bridge and drop down to the left onto a small area to get a Yellow Fulgurbloom plant.

At the other end of this place, where you dropped down, is a ladder going up. Climb up to find a small room with some Imps and a chest containing the Ancient Dragon Knight's Cookbook [2]. Afterward, from the ladder, turn left through a tight tunnel that leads to the second level of a previous area. Loot the corpse on the right for x2 Rejuvenating Boluses.

Turn left towards another tunnel with a corpse containing a Broken Rune and a Yellow Fulgurbloom plant on the right. To the left of the tunnel is a drop-down path back to where the Shadow Fireball trap of the bridge you dropped down from earlier was. Cross the bridge completely and turn right at the end. There's another elevator here that goes down. At the bottom, walk straight to find a yellow mist that leads to the Death Knight boss battle. This boss drops the Death Knight's Longhaft Axe and Cerulean Amber Medallion +3.

title: Imp Head
text: Climb the ladder in the alcove, then face west and jump onto the impaling mechanism to reach a ledge with a Ghost Glovewort [9].
Stand on the balustrade near the other impaling mechanism to jump onto it and reach a ledge with Imp Head (Lion).

Imp Head: Head armor found in Scorpion River Catacombs. When you enter the area with two spiked ceilings and a run across a bridge under the gaze of a deadly basilisk. Cross the bridge towards the next lift, and stop at the end, then jump on the ledge to the left and follow it up towards the basilisk. Jump on the spiked ceiling as it drops and ride it up to a platform with this item.

title: Knight's Lightning Spear
text: Ride the mechanism down to the Basilisk statue, then pick up Knight's Lightning Spear from the corridor.

Knight's Lightning Spear: Incantation found in Scorpion River Catacombs. When you enter the area with two spiked ceilings and a run across a bridge under the gaze of a deadly basilisk. Cross the bridge towards the next lift, and stop at the end, then jump on the ledge to the left and follow it up towards the basilisk. You will see this item in a room guarded by two Lion Imps right behind the Basilisk statue

title: Ancient Dragon Knight's Cookbook [2]
text: Go up the stairs to find a corpse with Yellow Fulgurbloom x6.
Yellow Fulgurbloom: Following the Grave Glovewort [3] room, near the next door.
Take the lift below, then head past the floating eyes to reach a room with a Grave Glovewort [7].
Drop down to the right after going down the stairs for a Great Ghost Glovewort, guarded by Basilisks.

Great Ghost Glovewort: Scorpion River Catacombs . Take the stairs down to the right of the Yellow Fulgurbloom and the Ghost Fulgurblum [7] , on the lower ground there are x3 Basiliks, crouch to move slowly towards the item to not alert them.
Climb the ladder and pick up the Ghost Glovewort [8] in front of the coffin.
Ghost Glovewort [8]: Scorpion River Catacombs . Pass the giant imp, there is a room with two imps and a caster. Defeat them and on the right side, you will find this item, near a Yellow Fulgurbloom .
Continue past another pair of eyes, then at the bridge drop down to the right and climb the ladder to a chest with Ancient Dragon Knight's Cookbook [2].

Ancient Dragon Knight's Cookbook [2]: After taking the third lift down, you'll come to a room with a sorcered and two imps. Follow the path forward until you reach a room with two imps and a chest. Beware of the floating Death Blight eyes.

title: Boss: Death Knight (Scorpion River Catacombs)
text: Go through the narrow corridor and pick up the Rejuvenating Boluses x2 on the right.
Pick up the Broken Rune at the end of the upper section, then follow the eyes to the last lift.

Broken Rune: Fog Rift Catacombs . From the coffin at the end of the previous room, face the entrance and take the first alcobe on your left. This leads to another room with a falling ceiling. The item is in the middle of the room
Kill the Death Knight for Death Knight's Longhaft Axe, Cerulean Amber Medallion +3, and 130,000 runes.
Death Knight's Longhaft Axe: The weapon is obtained as a reward for defeating the Death Knight boss located at the Scorpion River Catacombs .
Cerulean Amber Medallion +3: A +3 variant of the Cerulean Amber Medallion can be obtained after defeating the Death Knight .
Death Knight: The Death Knight is an optional boss located at the Scorpion River Catacombs .

title: Golden Arcs
text: Head east along the outskirts of Moorth Ruins to find a Shadow Realm Rune [3] on the roof of a tall church.
Drop down the hole next to the church to reach a building with Whiteflesh Mushroom x3.
Pick up String x2 from the corpse on the upper floor balcony.
Drop down near the building, then turn around and follow the path to a Golden Horn Tender.
Golden Horn Tender: Can be found on a corpse on the ground in the Ancient Ruins of Rauh area. Beware of Bloodfiends and dogs guarding the area.
Head down the other path and pick up Golden Arcs from the chest on top of a building.

Golden Arcs: Head southeast of Moorth Ruins. From the Shattered Stone Talisman chest, drop down to the nearest platform and continue descending until you reach the ground where three Inquisitors are situated. Defeat them and enter the small building nearby to find this item inside a chest. IF YOU DIE GOING DOWN: you can enter this are from a descent slightly northeast from here.

title: Hefty Cracked Pot
text: At the bottom of the building, in front of the entrance, is a corpse with Shadow Sunflower x4.
Climb the ladder at the end of the tunnel to reach Bonny Village:
Activate the Bonny Village grace near the well.
Follow the path to a Hefty Cracked Pot and a Broken Rune by some large pots on the right.
Hefty Cracked Pot: Bonny Village, on top of a giant pot just south from the site of grace, before crossing the bridge
Broken Rune: Bonny Gaol. You'll find this immediately after you jump down the hole.

place.title: Bonny Village
walk: Use the Site of Grace after exiting the well. Look around and you will see multiple jars in the area. This area appears to be filled with them in every corner but they are not alive. You will be fighting shadow enemies here and encounter a Greater Potentate. You will find Redflesh Mushroom in the area or pick them up after defeating shadow enemies. Keep heading down the path in the village and look at the houses on the left side and pick up the Kukri under a small roof. When you see the broken bridge in front of you, turn around and look at the area to your right. You can pick up the Bonny Butchering Knife from a corpse here.

Make your way to the broken bridge and try to take out the ghost hounds here. You can also see the loot that they are guarding here. When it's safe, jump down the area and take Human Bone Shard and 2 Living Jar Shard from the corpses. Now, follow the path to the northwest until a figure comes into view. Don't worry, this area is safe. You can pick up the Revered Spirit Ash from this small altar. Now, teleport to the Bonny Village - Site of Grace and jump to the other side of the bridge. Head north past the orange trees here and you can see a corpse in the middle of the open ground. Pick up the O Mother Gesture here. After doing so, go to the bridge south of Bonny Village.

You will find spiked barricades and broken cages on either side of the path. Continue following this path and be careful of the 2 Giant Scorpions that will attack you from either side. Keep an eye out for an opening to the right side of the wall. When you see it, enter the cave to go to Bonny Gaol.
notes: Note: crossing the bridge to the east of the village and continuing north will trigger a story event (identical to the one that triggers when approaching Shadow Keep) which may lock you out of certain NPC dialogue and items if their questlines are not progressed far enough.

Based on the Bonny Village phantom dialogue (near the Whipping Hut), the Tooth Whip found east of the village, the Bonny Butchering Knife, and the multitude of jars littering the village, this place seems to have played a significant role in the Hornsent rituals which involved stuffing Shamans (Queen Marika's kin) into jars to be turned into saints, which resulted in the creation of the Jar Innards monstrosities.

There appears to be the discarded flesh of a giant snake, likely the molten skin of Eiglay the God Devouring Serpent, or possibly Messmer's Base Serpent, near the location of the O Mother Gesture. This is possibly the snake that Queen Marika is seen reaching into, in the Shadow of the Erdtree trailer. None of the lore items elaborate on its placement so the significance of it is unknown.

title: Bonny Butchering Knife
text: Pick up Kukri x5 and the Bonny Butchering Knife from two houses on the left side of the village.
Bonny Butchering Knife: Below a small shed, outside a house. Near the broken bridge.

title: Revered Spirit Ash
text: Drop down the broken bridge to pick up Human Bone Shard x2 and Living Jar Shard x5 from three corpses.
A statue with Revered Spirit Ash sits at the northwest end of the ravine.
Revered Spirit Ash: Can be found on the altar in the Village of Flies. Accessible only from Reclusive River Downstream area

title: Hefty Cracked Pot
text: At the other end of the ravine, near the cliff edge, is a corpse with Raw Meat Dumpling.
Raw Meat Dumpling: Fall down from the broken bridge and follow the path all the way south, you will find the item near the edge.
Pick up a Hefty Cracked Pot from the burnt remains of a building on the other side of the village.
Hefty Cracked Pot: Bonny Village. Past the broken bridge, among many enemies. Below a shed.

title: O Mother
text: Follow the path near the building to a dead tree with the O Mother gesture below it.
O Mother: From the Bonny Village Site of Grace, jump across the other side of the broken bridge and head north, almost until the edge of the area.

title: Tooth Whip
text: Head across the bridge to the southeast and pick up the Tooth Whip from the shack.
Tooth Whip: Found inside the Whipping Hut.

place.title: Whipping Hut
walk: The eastern region of Scadu Altus can be accessed through the Bonny Village. Players will find access to this area from the tunnel under Moorth Ruins connecting to the Site of Grace in Bonny Village. Teleport there and head east by crossing the bridge. You will find the Whipping Hut at the edge, and you can pick up the Tooth Whip from the corpse inside the hut. You can also interact with the ghost here just outside the hut.

title: Hefty Cracked Pot
text: Go across the second bridge and grab the Bridge Leading to the Village grace for later.
Cross the bridge southeast of the Bonny Village grace to reach the entrance to Bonny Gaol:
Head inside and activate the Bonny Gaol grace.
Enter the first room on the right for Frozen Maggot x8.

Frozen Maggot: Bonny Gaol :. x1 Defeat the Living Jar next to the door, then look behind you to see a broken jar. An enemy is hiding here. The Frozen Maggot can be found to the right of the broken jar.
Descend the pots below the edge, then pick up a Hefty Cracked Pot from the second cell.
Hefty Cracked Pot: Near the entrance to Bonny Jail, find two hanging pots on the side of the cliff and jump on them to descend. The item is in one of the cells under.

place.title: Bonny Gaol
walk: ER Shadow of the Erdtree Bonny Gaol Video Walkthrough

After entering from outside, you'll first encounter the Bonny Gaol site of grace See Shadow of the Erdtree Map and a Summoning Pool statue. Proceeding onwards, you'll find yourself at a massive icy cavern, with jars suspended by chains from the ceiling.

Take the path to the right, and a Jar Innards enemy will emerge up ahead and start attacking you. Once you're by the large metal grate where you can see a currently unreachable item, there will be multiple ways to proceed. To the right of the grate, you can enter a room where a Shadow Undead can be heard grovelling. Shadow Undead that are grovelling, kneeling, or sitting at tables don't attack you unless you attack them. Loot the body it was grovelling over for x8 Frozen Maggot, but watch out for the Jar Innards that will crawl out of an overturned jar to attack you.

After exiting the room, you'll see two hanging jars to the left, below the path you're on. Carefully jump down to the lower jar - it's actually a lift that will lower you to an area with two rooms. The closest room leads to a Shadow Undead that will run at you from behind some boxes, and x3 Frozen Maggot around the room that you can loot. Proceed to the second room, but beware the Jar Innards that will run out of the room as you approach. Entering the room, there will be another Jar Innards that will burst out of a jar to attack you, and a Hefty Cracked Pot that you can loot. Jars that Jar Innards can burst out of are always visibly cracked. Return to the ledge near the jar lift, where you can step on a stone sigil to call it back down. Ride the jar lift back up.

Proceed onwards from the original path, ignoring an open room to the right (you'll return here later), and enter a room with multiple cages. There's a Shadow Undead sitting at a table, as well as a corpse with x10 Bolt that you can loot. Be careful as you approach the corpse, as 3 Shadow Undead will lunge at you. Avoid their grab attacks, as they will latch onto you and bite you, and can drain significant amounts of your HP.

Open the door to your left, entering a room with 3 more Shadow Undead - one of them will lunge at you as you proceed onwards. Next to a lit brazier, there's a hole you can jump down which leads to a dark cave. You can pick up a Broken Rune close to where you landed. There are two ways to proceed - east and west. Head east, where you'll encounter multiple Giant Rat enemies. In the wide area with the big Giant Rat, you can enter a narrow cave to the right to take x4 Smithing Stone [2] from a corpse. Return to the path, continuing on until you reach a ladder you can climb up. At the top of the ladder, watch out for a Jar Innards that will burst out of a cracked jar. Before exiting through the hole in the wall, be sure to grab the Stalwart Horn Charm +2 talisman from a nearby corpse. Now, proceed through the hole in the wall, where you'll find a kneeling Shadow Undead and a Frozen Maggot - this is the room you ignored earlier. Exit the room.

Make your way back to the dark cave area that you jumped down to. This time, head west. As you proceed, you'll find an area where multiple Skeletal Slime enemies will drop from the ceiling. If you look around, you'll see that there are 2 paths to take from this area. Feel free to ignore the northwest path, as you'll just end up in a room with more Skeletal Slimes and just one Broken Rune that you can loot. If you take the south path, you'll encounter even more Skeletal Slimes. Just before you jump through the hole in the brick wall, if you turn around and head north, you'll find another Skeletal Slime waiting to drop from the ceiling, and an Invigorating Cured Meat on a corpse. Now, head through the hole to reach a new, lower area of the gaol, with mounds of countless dead bodies.

Follow the water, proceeding onwards until you reach a large area with light coming in from the ceiling. This area has many Living Jar enemies, both large and small. On the right (south) side of the room, there will be a Lost Ashes of War, behind one of the large stone pillars and in front of a large Living Jar soaking in a waterfall. On the left (north) side of the room, there will be a large Living Jar resting, and a corpse by a grate that you can loot a Broken Rune from. In total, there are x4 Frozen Maggot in the area. Once you're done with this area, head to the east end of the room and proceed through an opening into the next area.
