There will be an Innard Meat ahead of you that you can loot, but watch out for a Jar Innards that will burst out of a cracked jar hanging above you. As you head to the north side of the room, a Jar Innards will run out from a broken jar. Kill it, and then to the west side of the room, there will be a broken jar that with a Jar Innards that crawls out as you approach it. The broken jar it crawled out of contains a Raw Meat Dumpling. In total, this room contains x3 Frozen Maggot. Heading into the next room, you'll see a Frozen Maggot, as well as a hanging cracked jar containing yet another Jar Innards. Exit the room, where you'll see the large cavern with hanging jars again.

Take the stairs to the left, where you'll see multiple Shadow Undead up ahead. Once you're at the bottom of the stairs, if you turn left, you'll find a corpse in an open cell that you can loot for a Silver Horn Tender. Towards the ledge, there is a Frozen Maggot you can pick up, and 4 Shadow Undead, of which one of them is standing up and will turn to fight you. Opposite to the ledge, there will be another open cell, this time with a Shadow Undead and x3 Frozen Maggot. Just before you enter the next section, there will be another Shadow Undead that will lunge at you. You'll find a Frozen Maggot in the same room. Proceed to a door that you can open to enter a room with 2 Shadow Undead at a table. Upon exiting the room, you'll find yourself at a ledge where a jar is hanging below you. Get on it and it will start lowering, but instead of getting off the jar, stay on it and it will automatically take you all the way up to another area. If you got off the jar by accident and are now on the bridge, there's a sigil nearby that a Shadow Undead is grovelling over, which you can step on to call the jar lift back down.

If you rode the jar lift up, you'll now be at the top level of Bonny Gaol, where you can pick up the Night Set from a corpse by a guillotine, in front of 2 Shadow Undead. Go up the stairs, but watch out for the Jar Innards waiting for you at the top. Behind it, you can find a ledge with a corpse slumped over it, which you can loot the Shield of Night from. Head back to the ledge that you jumped onto to reach this area. There will be a stationary hanging jar below that you can use to safely jump down, to once again reach the jar lift. This time, get off the jar lift at the bottom, to reach a bridge.

Head across the bridge, where you'll encounter a Shadow Undead that runs and cowers from you, and 2 Jar Innards waiting for you in cracked jars. Once you're across the bridge, you can jump down to an area to the northwest. Follow the path ahead, where you'll find x2 Frozen Maggot and one final Jar Innards waiting to ambush you from an open cell. Head down the stairs to where 2 Shadow Undead are walking around. Just before you cross the golden fog, there will be x2 Frozen Maggot nearby, one of which will be around some breakable crates by a ledge.

You will be fighting Curseblade Labirith here, a boss that wields dual blades and can turn himself invisible. You will receive the Curseblade Meera summon upon defeating this boss. You can visit this page for a strategy on how to beat him.

title: Stalwart Horn Charm +2
text: Take the pot lift back up and grab the Bolt x10 on a spiked chair.
Open the door and hop down the hole to land next to a Broken Rune.

Broken Rune: Go to the right path to jump down to the lower levels of the gaol. The river will serve as the path here, so follow the stream. To your right, you will fight a Living Jar here. There's also a Broken Rune, the one that you saw from when you first entered Broken Gaol.
Head east first in the tunnel to find a corpse with Smithing Stone [8] x2 behind some stalactite.

Smithing Stone [8]: x4 Smithing Stone [8] can be found inside a chest. From the "Behind the Fort of Reprimand" site of grace, head north and climb the ladder, you'll immediately see the chest that contains the item. This area is accessed via spiritspring south, or by using breakable items from the fort to jump a wall.
Climb the ladder at the end and pick up the Stalwart Horn Charm +2.
Stalwart Horn Charm +2: Bonny Gaol. After you jump down the hole, head east past the rats and climb up the ladder. Defeat the Inner Jar monster, you will find the talisman in the room.

title: Lost Ashes of War
text: Follow the other path in the tunnel to a Broken Rune at the other end.
Turn back and follow the right tunnel to an Invigorating Cured Meat and a waterfall.

Invigorating Cured Meat: Bonny Gaol l: Look for the narrow area here and watch out for the slug-like enemies down here. They can be difficult to spot because of their color so listen closely to their sounds. This path will lead to a Broken Rune that you can pick up from a corpse. Then, look behind you to reveal another pathway where you can pick up the Invigorating Cured Meat to your left.
Drop down the waterfall and pick up the Broken Rune next to a gate.
Pick up Lost Ashes of War from a corpse in front of a waterfall.

Lost Ashes of War: The river will serve as the path here, so follow the stream. To your right, you will fight a Living Jar here. There's also a Broken Rune, the one that you saw from when you first entered Broken Gaol. Fight the next cluster of enemies here near the water and pick up the Lost Ashes of War next to the pillar behind them.

guide.title: The Third Path: Crossing the Greatbridge
text: After clearing Belurat Tower Settlement and the Western Gravesite Plain, return to the Three-Path Cross Site of Grace. Speak with Redmane Freyja, exhaust their dialogues, and head towards the bridge to your northeast. There are metal barricades along the bridge and as you get closer to the middle, a soldier manning the Ballista will start firing here. Pay attention to the items along the way to pick up Lost Ashes of War and Ballista Bolt here. Take out the enemy manning the ballista then go after the soldier tents on the side of the bridge and you can go through them and eliminate enemies as you go.

After crossing the bridge, you can pick up the Scadutree Fragment in the middle of the camp. You can also see the nearby Castle Front - Site of Grace behind the tent. Wallk towards it to activate it. To continue exploring, you will head to Fog Rift Catacombs. You can reach this place by heading west from the Castle Front - Site of Grace (front of Castle Ensis). You will pass through a small group of army here under a wooden scaffolding. Keep heading west and follow the trail here behind them. You will see gravestones along the way here and make sure to stay on the middle path so you don't come up a cliff. As you head further you will see 2 Ghostflame lanterns in the nearby north direction marking the door to the catacombs.

title: Night Set
text: Drop down another waterfall and pick up the Innard Meat in front of a pot.
In the same room, pick up a Raw Meat Dumpling from the pot with a Jar Dweller inside.
Raw Meat Dumpling: Bonny Gaol: Defeat the Living Jar next to the door, then look behind you to see a broken jar. An enemy is hiding here and will reveal a Raw Meat Dumpling under them.
Continue down some stairs to find a Silver Horn Tender on the left.

Silver Horn Tender: Bonny Gaol: Go to the next room and exit through the tall archway. This will reveal just how big the Bonny Gaol is. Take the path to the left, and you will find the item in a small nook.
Open the door up ahead and take the pot lift down. Stay on the lift until it ascends to reach the Night Set.

Night Set: This is a set that can be obtained from the top level of Bonny Gaol . To reach it, you have to progress most of the dungeon, then when you jump in a pot to get down, stay on that pot and wait for it to bring you all the way up again. The armor set contains the following pieces: Helm of Night Armor of Night Gauntlets of Night Greaves of Night

title: Shield of Night
text: Go up the stairs and pick up the Shield of Night at the end.

Shield of Night: Shield of Night is a new small shield that can be found in Bonny Gaol . The top level of this gaol can be accessed after using the jar lift near the bridge twice. You need to jump off at the bridge level, activate the switch, and then ride the jar going up. You will find this on the ledge behind the corpse on top of a table.

title: Boss: Curseblade Labirith
text: Return down the lift and kill Curseblade Labirith for Curseblade Meera and 100,000 runes.
Curseblade Labirith: This boss is found within the depths of Bonny Gaol . Drops 100,000 Runes and Spirit Ashes: Curseblade Meera upon death.
Curseblade Meera: This item is obtained as a reward for defeating Curseblade Smith found within Bonny Gaol .

title: Ash of War: Raging Beast
text: Travel to Bridge Leading to the Village and head up the right side of the woods for a teleporting scarab that drops Ash of War: Raging Beast.

Ash of War: Raging Beast: From the Bridge Leading to the Village Grace follow the path heading North. Once you get to the trees, keep looking east for a teleporting Teardrop Scarab that will have the Ash of War.

title: Boss: Furnace Golem (Scadu Atlus)
text: Note: Moving past this grace (or approaching the Shadow Keep) will break Miquella's charm. Make sure you have Thiollier's Concoction and the Forager Brood Cookbook [7] before proceeding.
Kill the Furnace Golem past the woods for the Cerulean-Sapping Cracked Tear and a Furnace Visage.
Cerulean-Sapping Cracked Tear: The item drops from the Furnace Golem located east of the Cathedral of Manus Metyr within the Scadu Atlus region.
Furnace Golem: Furnace Golem is located east of the Cathedral of Manus Metyr. Defeating this elite enemy drops the following items: x1 Cerulean-Sapping Cracked Tear x1 Furnace Visage

guide.title: Cathedral of Manus Metyr and Rabbath's Rise
text: Follow the path towards the north where you will reach an area where you will encounter Wolves and a Furnace Golem. Defeating the Furnace Golem here will drop Cerulean-Sapping Cracked Tear and a Furnace Visage. Continue the path ahead until you pass through Rabbath's Rise. Use the Church of High Road - Site of Grace before continuing. Head east to formally enter Rabbath's Rise here. This is a tower building with some of its steps destroyed. You will also see some glowing crystals on the ground floor.

Go through the door to your left and climb the spiral stairs. When you reach the study room with tall bookshelves lined on the walls, make sure to hit the wall with 2 arches. This is a secret wall hiding a stack of stones. Destroy it to reveal a nearby Spiritspring. You can't use the elevator yet, so you need to go outside the tower and look for the spirit spring. Summon Torrent and ride up the wind to reach the top of the tower. Open the chest to get Rabbath's Cannon. On your way down, you can now use the elevator that was previously stuck.

When you're done exploring Rabbath's Rise, you can now go to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr, which is just across the Rabbath's Rise. Activate the Site of Grace and enter through the closed gates. During your interaction with Count Ymir, he will give you 2 items:
Ruins Map
Hole-Laden Necklace

Talk to Swordnight Jolan, who is leaning against a pillar. NOTE: If you can't find her here, try resting at a site of grace and reload the location. She is a servant to Count Ymir and is fiercely loyal to him. For now, there's not much that you can do to progress their quest, except to roam around the area. Head outside through the arch near Jolan which will take you to the grave area. Summon Torrent and jump over the fence to your left to explore the edges of the Cathedral. Beware of skeleton enemies here and make sure to pick up a Glinting Nail on the ground. Continue going around the cathedral and eliminate skeleton enemies as you go. These enemies also drop a piece of their armor and Cuckoo Glintstone.
In the pond area south of the cathedral, you can pick up a Greater Potentate's Cookbook [4] from a corpse. Then, head southeast where you see a broken stone chalice to pick up the Starlight Shards.
See the next tab for the Rauh Base Walkthrough.to return to the tab selection.

title: Greasemonger's Bell Bearing
text: Follow the road to a high up ledge on the left, then shoot down the pot next to a tree for the Greasemonger's Bell Bearing.
Greasemonger's Bell Bearing: Scadu Altus: Looted by shooting a pot hanging behind a wolf pack south from the Church District Highroad site of Grace, before the Furnace Golem.

title: Rabbath's Cannon
text: Continue up the road until you see the Church District Highroad grace on the right.
Enter the rise near the grace and hit the stacked stones on the balcony (behind an illusory wall) to unseal the spiritspring just outside.
Use the spiritspring while facing southwest to reach the top of the rise and a chest containing Rabbath's Cannon.

Rabbath's Cannon: Rabbath's Rise. After you free the Spiritspring, head outside and use it while mounted on Torrent to reach the higher part of the tower. Loot the chest at the top to obtain this weapon.

place.title: Rabbath's Rise
walk: The Rabbath's Rise is located in the eastern region of Scadu Altus. You will find it along the path after exploring Bonny Village, an area where you will encounter Wolves and a Furnace Golem. Defeating the Furnace Golem here will drop Cerulean-Sapping Cracked Tear and a Furnace Visage. Continue the path ahead until you pass through Rabbath's Rise. Activate the Church of High Road - Site of Grace before continuing. Turn right to formally enter Rabbath's Rise here. This is a tower building with some of its steps destroyed. You will also see some glowing crystals on the ground floor.

Go through the door to your left and climb the spiral stairs. When you reach the study room with tall bookshelves lined on the walls, make sure to hit the wall with 2 arches. This is a secret wall hiding a stack of stones. Destroy it to reveal a nearby Spiritspring. You can't use the elevator yet, so you need to go outside the tower and look for the spiritspring.
Summon Torrent and ride up the wind to reach the top of the tower. Open the chest to get Rabbath's Cannon. On your way down, you can now use the elevator that was previously stuck.

title: Ash of War: Carian Sovereignty
text: Return to the grace and follow the road northwest through a tunnel to grab the Church District Entrance grace for later.
Head back and veer to the right as you exit the tunnel to reach the area above it and a Grave Glovewort [7] by some graves.
On a rock east-northeast of the graves sits a corpse with a Blessed Bone Shard.

Blessed Bone Shard: Shadow Keep - accessed from the Church District Side. From the Storehouse site of grace, find the ladder and climb it up, pass the enemies. Circle the area on your right and you will find an opening that leads outside. Continue following the path and you'll find this item on a corpse.
Interact with the Forager Brood near the castle wall to receive Forager Brood Cookbook [6] and Dewgem x3.
Pass time until nightfall at the Church District Highroad, then head west to find a Larval Tear surrounded by blue spiritgraves.
Head southwest from the spiritgraves and follow the lower path to a room with a scarab. Shoot it down to obtain Ash of War: Carian Sovereignty.

Ash of War: Carian Sovereignty: Acquired from a teardrop scarab inside a cave south west from Cathedral of Manus Metyr filled with glintslab fireflies. The scarab is located on the ceiling of the cave. To find this cave go to the Church District Highroad Site of Grace. Head directly southwest until you reach the cliffline and then continue south. The cave is embedded in the east cliff wall at the end of this path.
miss: Missed if you kill the Forager Brood before interacting with it or fail Moore's questline. If you tell Moore to 'Remain sad forever' after Miquella's charm breaks, the Forager Brood disappear and their cookbooks become unobtainable.

title: Greater Potentate's Cookbook [4] +1
text: Return to the grace and follow the other road to a cathedral. Follow the water's edge left to find a corpse with Greater Potentate's Cookbook [4].
Greater Potentate's Cookbook [4]: East of Cathedral of Manu Metyr. Can be found on a corpse sitting on the ground, surrounded by multiple Marionette Soldiers.
Greater Potentate: A third Greater Potentate is found guarding the Hefty Cracked Pot

title: Hole-Laden Necklace, Talk to Count Ymir +2
text: Continue south from the cookbook to find an astrolabe with Starlight Shards near the cliff.
Starlight Shards: Southeast of Cathedral of Manu Metyr, besides a basin-like structure.
West-northwest of the astrolabe, on the walkway along the cathedral wall, is a corpse with Glinting Nail x2.
Optional: At the edge of the water just west of the corpse is a duplication coffin you can mark on your map.
Enter the cathedral through the front entrance and grab the Cathedral of Manus Metyr grace.
Open the door and talk to Ymir to receive the Hole-Laden Necklace and the Ruins Map.
Hole-Laden Necklace: Given by Ymir when first interacted.
Count Ymir: NPC After you open the doors, move forward to find Ymir sitting. Teaches Sorceries
Ruins Map (2nd): Given by Ymir after ringing the hanging bell in the center of the Finger Ruins of Rhia.
Glinting Nail x2: Cathedral of Manu Metyr. Leave the main room from the opening on the side. Ride Torrent and circle the building, you will find a Marionette Soldier guarding this item.

place.title: Cathedral of Manus Metyr
walk: Starting from Rabbath's Rise, you can follow the path going south to reach the Cathedral of Manus Metyr. Start by exploring around the Cathedral, you will be able to find Greater Potentate's Cookbook (4) Map Link on a body that is surrounded by a mob. Behind the Cathedral, you will find a Remembrance Duplication Coffin Map Link. On the walkway around the Cathedral, you can find 2 Glinting Nails Map Link. Enter the Cathedral and activate the Cathedral of Manus Metyr Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map, in front of it there are gates that you can open. Open them to get through and you will find Jolan, a knight that serves Count Ymir, to the right, and on the throne is Count Ymir.
On your first encounter with Count Ymir, he will give you the Ruins Map and Hole-Laden Necklace. The necklace is a key item that will be used to sound a hanging bell at a hallowed ruin.

With the first map, you can travel to the Finger Ruins of Rhia. You can reach the Finger Ruins of Rhia by traveling southeast from the Cerulean Coast Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. Go past the toppled pillar and stick to the wall on your left side. Continue following it as you go up the ramp, past the glowing worm creatures. You will come around and find the entrance past the shoreline and behind the dragon. Go up the ramp and you will see a small-altar-like structure at the very end. You can pick up the Grave Glovewort (9) here. On the right side, you can jump down to activate the Ruins of Rhia Site of Grace. Explore the area, and once you reach the bell, interact with it and you will be granted the Crimson Seed Talisman +1. Return to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr then speak to Count Ymir again, and he will grant you the Ruins Map (2nd) and Beloved Stardust.

With the second map, fast travel to the Shadow Keep, Back Gate Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map, facing the entrance of the structure, go left and you will find a Summoning Pool that you can activate and a room you can go into. Head into the room, on the left is a message that reads "Have mercy, For the spirited-away shamans." and straight ahead you can pick up the Scadutree Fragment at the altar. At the altar, you will need to perform the O Mother Gesture in front of the altar to trigger it to move. Go through the hidden tunnel and you will find yourself at the Hinterlands. On your way to the Finger Ruins of Dheo, you will encounter a lot of smaller enemies that could potentially kill you so you will need to be careful in this area. Once you reach the end, you can interact with the bell, and you will be granted the Cerulean Seed Talisman +1. Return to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr and speak to Count Ymir and he will give you the Ruins Map (3rd).

With the third map, make sure you fast travel somewhere else and then fast travel back to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr so Count Ymir will not be there. Make your way over to the throne you once met Count Ymir on, this time you can examine the throne. Interact with it to see it slide back and reveal a rope ladder. Take the ladder down to reach the Finger Ruins of Miyr.

Once you head down, NPC invader Swordhand of Night Anna will appear, defeat her and you will be granted the Claws of Night. You will be able to find a few Finger Mimics scattered around the area, other than that, you can find the Finger-Weaver's Cookbook (2) on a body on the lower left walkway of the path. Nearing the bell, you can interact with the Summoning Pool to activate it and then interact with the hanging bell to teleport you to the Metyr, Mother of Fingers arena.

Once you defeat Metyr, Mother of Fingers you will be granted 420,000 Runes and the Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers. You can then fast-travel back to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr and head back to the throne and interact with it once more to encounter another NPC invader named Swordhand of Night Jolan, defeat her and you will have to face Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers. This is when Count Ymir borrows the powers of Metyr to fight you. Defeat her and you will be granted the High Priest Set that comes with the High Priest Hat, High Priest Robe, High Priest Gloves, and High Priest Undergarments, as well as Ymir's Bell Bearing and the Maternal Staff. Once Ymir is defeated, you can go outside to the graveyard to obtain the Cherishing Fingers sorcery which you can pick up in front of a gravestone.

title: Talk to Jolan
text: Optional: Exhaust Ymir's dialogue to unlock his inventory, then ask him about glintstone sorcery.
Optional: Talk to Jolan by a pillar in the room.

Jolan: Jolan is a Knight of Night that serves Count Ymir. After completing Ymir's questline, give Jolan the Eye of Occulation to receive the Sword of Night , or the Iris of Grace to receive Swordhand of Night Jolan Spirit Ashes

title: Crimson Seed Talisman +1
text: Optional: Ask Ymir about the knight in black armor.
Travel to the Finger Ruins of Rhia and sound the hanging bell in the central finger formation to obtain the Crimson Seed Talisman +1.

Crimson Seed Talisman +1: In the center of the Finger Ruins of Rhia. Go to the large ring of fingers (as shown by the Ruins Map given by Count Ymir), and then sound the hanging bell from one of the fingers that's pointing down. The Hole-Laden Necklace given by Ymir is required to sound it.

title: Beloved Stardust, Ruins Map
text: Return to Ymir to receive Ruins Map (2nd) and Beloved Stardust.
Beloved Stardust: Given by Ymir after ringing the hanging bell in the center of the Finger Ruins of Rhia.
Ruins Map: Given by Ymir when first interacted.

title: Ruins Map (3rd)
text: Ask Ymir about the nature of the world and about Miquella.
Optional: Talk to Jolan now that you've received the second ruins map from Ymir.
Ruins Map (3rd): Given by Ymir after completing her questline.

title: Moore's Bell Bearing, Verdigris Greatshield +1
text: Optional: Reload the area to find Ymir in the graveyard outside. Listen to his monologue to make him return to his chair on the next reload.
Talk to Freyja and ask what she intends to look into. Optionally, ask her what if she becomes the enemy.
Talk to Ansbach to make him relocate to the Shadow Keep.
Talk to Moore and you'll be faced with three options:
Put it behind you:
Note: The Forager Brood remain, but Moore disappears and later returns as one of Leda's allies in the Enir-Ilim fight.
After killing Leda and her allies in Enir-Ilim, loot Moore's Bell Bearing, the Verdigris Greatshield, and the Verdigris Set from his corpse in the arena.
Moore's Bell Bearing: Can be looted from Moore's body after defeating him in Enir-Ilim .
Verdigris Greatshield: Can be looted from Moore's body after defeating him in Enir-Ilim .

Verdigris Set: The following armor pieces of the Verdigris Set can be obtained by looting Moore's body after defeating him in Enir-Ilim : Verdigris Helm Verdigris Armor Verdigris Gauntlets Verdigris Greaves
Remain sad forever:
Note: The Forager Brood disappear and Moore is excluded from the fight in Enir-Ilim.
Moore dies next to the Forager Brood by the Church of the Crusade. Loot Moore's Bell Bearing, the Verdigris Greatshield, and the Verdigris Set from his corpse.
I don't know:
Note: Moore remains at his shop, and the choice is delayed until you select another option. Pick this if you don't have the first six Forager Brood cookbooks and haven't spoken to Thiollier yet.

If you don't make the choice before fighting Leda and her allies in Enir-Ilim, you'll have to kill him for his loot. Kill two of the Forager Brood to cause him to invade, then finish him off. His bell bearing can then be found where he usually sits.
Talk to Thiollier, then talk to him again after reloading the area twice to hear that he's heading south.
Optional: Exhaust Leda's dialogue and suggest the hornsent.
Exhaust Hornsent's dialogue until he leaves the Highroad Cross.
Talk to Leda after Hornsent has left.

title: Invader: Moore (Enir-Ilim)
text: Moore: From the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom Site of Grace, exit the room east and you'll find a gold summon sign for Pureblood Knight Ansbach and a red blood summon sign to challenge Needle Knight Leda and her allies. Interacting with the red blood summon sign will have Moore as one of the invaders to spawn in the area.

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Travel to The Fissure and enter the now open tunnel to grab the Stone Coffin Fissure grace.
Instead of heading down the first stone coffin, follow the upper right path across two gaps to find Congealed Putrescence x5.
Congealed Putrescence: It can be found on the ground, just a few meters from the Site of Grace.
Drop down some ledges and grab the St. Trina's Arrow x10 back near the first stone coffin.
Continue until the ground collapses, then go north for a corpse with Deep-Purple Lily x2 on the cliff's edge.
Pick up a Shadow Realm Rune [3] from a ledge with two Bloodfiends.

Shadow Realm Rune [3]: From the Stone Coffin Fissure Site of Grace, continue following the main path and descend carefully, you'll find this item being guarded by two enemies. Be wary of multiple enemies patrolling the area as well.
Activate the Fissure Cross grace and grab the Scadutree Fragment next to the cross.
Scadutree Fragment: x1 can looted from the ground by Miquella's Cross of the Fissure Cross Site of Grace.

guide.title: Exploring Stone Coffin Fissure
text: From the Site of Grace, head south and jump between the platforms until you see an enemy slime on the ground. Go past it and climb the ramp behind it and pick up x5 Congealed Putrescence at the edge.

Then, face the north direction and jump down in this thick pillar ahead of you. Make a right and pick up x10 St. Trina's Arrow from the corpse on the ground. Make a U-turn and watch out for a Bloodfiend here as you go down. It will come from the edge of the pillar. You can eliminate this enemy or just run away from it.

On the edge of this area, you will see this floor at the cliff. This is a collapsing ground and you can stand on it so you can reach the lower level. There are multiple bloodfiends here and you can eliminate them for a chance to get their items like Bloodfiend's Fork, String, or Runes. Head north towards the cliff where you see a corpse on the ground. Pick up x2 Deep-Purple Lily from this corpse. Then, face the southeast and find the way to the center of the dungeon. You will see 2 more Cursed Bloodfiends here sitting on the upper deck. Go towards them and defeat them. You can pick up the Shadow Realm Rune [3] behind them.

guide.title: Fissure Cross - Site of Grace
text: Face the east direction where you see Miquella's Cross and a Site of Grace. Walk over it and take the Scadutree Fragment on the ground and make sure to activate the Fissure Cross - Site of Grace. From here, face northwest where you see a large chunk of collapsed stone. There is a platform that lets you jump down to the lower section.

When you reach the bottom, face east and head to the lower level. Beware of the slimes that will fall from the ceiling. To the left, you can pick up the Velvet Sword of St. Trina tucked at the end of this short cave. Go to the other path where a Gravebird is resting on the edge. Do a sneak attack and then pick up the Nectarblood Burgeon from where it was sitting. Jump down the edge and then pick up the Grave Glovewort [3] right where you will land.

Face north and go up the ramp. There's another Gravebird here with purple markings on its wings. When you reach the slanted area, you will fight another Gravebird. Going to the top, you can pick up a Grave Glovewort [2] from a corpse. Then, head down through the broken bridge here. There are caterpillar-like enemies here on your path and they can shoot out laser-like projectiles. You can try to run from them or just take them out so it's safer to navigate later on.

Once you make it to the toppled building on the other side, go to the left side by facing west where you see these stone clusters. You can trigger the explosions by getting near them and then back off as they explode. You can pick up a Grave Glovewort [8] at the end here. Then, go to the right side by facing east and go to the top of the building. Jump down on the left side to pick up Nectarblood Burgeon and x2 Smithing Stone [6] here.

To continue your progress, face northeast where you see another caterpillar-like enemy. Ideally, you want to get rid of this so it will not bother you later. Then, jump down behind the caterpillar, and jump past another stone cluster of enemies. When you see this Site of Grace come into view, go to the right side first. Pick up the Grave Glovewort [7] from this corpse on the edge. Then, activate the Fissure Waypoint Site of Grace. While facing northeast, jump to the other platform and then jump down to the lower level.

Cross the bridge and pick up the Mass of Putrescence on the other side. To continue your progress, face northeast and go up the ramp. Watch out for the fire-throwing enemies. When you get to the upper area, you can pick up Nectarblood Burgeon and Congealed Putrescence. You can just ignore these enemies after getting the item and continue going up the ramp. At the top, you will find an archway next to a Skeleton Archer.

title: Velvet Sword of St Trina
text: Drop down the almost vertical stone coffin west of the grace to find a Grave Glovewort [7] inside the stone coffin in front of it.
Grave Glovewort [7]: From the Fissure Waypoint Site of Grace, head south and turn left, you'll find a corpse sitting on a ledge with this item.
Pick up the Velvet Sword of St. Trina in the tunnel below the coffin.

Velvet Sword of St Trina: From the Fissure Cross site of grace, walk north to the brick platform that's tilted nearly vertical. Climb down to a ledge that passes underneath the brick platform nearest the site of grace. The sword is in a small cave network there and guarded by several putrescent oozes.

title: Mass of Putrescence
text: Follow the tunnel to a ledge and pick up the Grave Glovewort [8] below it.

Grave Glovewort [8]: From the Fissure Cross site of grace, walk north to the brick platform that's tilted nearly vertical. Climb down to a ledge that passes underneath the brick platform nearest the site of grace. Descend the area and head northwest, you'll find this material on the ground guarded by multiple Abnormal Stone Clusters.
Go up the slope as it curves left, then continue upward to the top end of a stone coffin for a Grave Glovewort [5].
Head down the coffins to the other side, then take the first left to a Grave Glovewort [8] surrounded by explosive stone sentries.
Grave Glovewort [8]: Lying in front of a bull statue at the top of a wrecked stone coffin southwest of Cerulean Coast Cross Site of Grace.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [6] x3 between the two coffins higher up.
Drop down the overturned coffin at the end to reach the Fissure Waypoint grace.
Around the corner southeast of the grace, on the edge of the coffin, is a corpse with a Grave Glovewort [7].
Drop down to the lower path north of the grace to find Mass of Putrescence next to a rocky bridge.

Mass of Putrescence: From the Fissure Waypoint site of grace, head northeast. Just after hopping over the little gap, drop down on the left (north) side and make your way north where you'll find the spell on a corpse.

title: Boss: Misbegotten Crusader (Stone Coffin Fissure)
text: On the ledge with two Skeletons is a corpse with Congealed Putrescence x2.
Congealed Putrescence: Stone Coffin Fissure: x2 looted from a corpse where the skeletons throw firebombs at you before the Leonine Warrior
Continue to the top and kill the large mound of putrescence for Smithing Stone [8] x7 and Congealed Putrescence x8 (first time).
Pick up the Dewgem x3 next to the mound of putrescence.
Kill the Misbegotten Warrior up ahead to obtain Multilayered Ring of Light.
Multilayered Ring of Light: Drops from the Misbegotten Crusader in Stone Coffin Fissure.

Misbegotten Crusader: From the Fissure Waypoint Site of Grace, head east and continue following the path, go through the small cave with a giant putrescence, and turn left. As you exit the room, you'll find a Misbegotten Crusader in the area. Drops the Multilayered Ring of Light upon defeat.

guide.title: Fight the Spirit Form of Misbegotten Crusader
text: Jump down the archway but watch out for the giant slime here. Take the path to your left and you will be fighting the spirit of the Misbegotten Crusader. It will drop the Multilayered Ring of Light upon defeating it. Then, jump on the platform to the southeast and cross the bridge to your left. You can pick up x3 Nectarblood Burgeon here. Then, face southeast and follow the faint glimmer of the Site of Grace. Activate it and walk up the ramp.

Go towards the horned statue and jump down. At the bottom, you will reach a boss arena. You will be fighting the Putrescent Knight here, a skeleton riding a horse. It wields a massive weapon that behaves like a boomerang and can be thrown in an arc projectile. This boss can deal a good amount of damage and you can check out our Putrescent Knight page to see more info on how to defeat this boss. This boss will drop Remembrance of Putrescence upon defeating it.

A new Site of Grace will be revealed after the fight and it will also unlock the entrance to the Garden of Deep Purple. Go inside the cave and pick up the items inside. There are Nectarblood Burgeons on the ground and a St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook [3] here. Talk to St. Trina by interacting with the bright purple flower here. This marks the beginning of Thiollier's quest which requires you to return to Pillar Path Cross - Site of Grace and speak with him there. You can also view Thiollier's page to know more about his questline. For now, you are done in this dungeon and you will return to Cerulean Coast - Site of Grace to continue exploring this region.

title: Boss: Putrescent Knight
text: Make your way to the last stone coffin and activate the Fissure Depths grace.
Take the plunge and kill the Putrescent Knight for Remembrance of Putrescence and 220,000 runes.
Putrescent Knight: Legend Type boss. Grants 220,000 Runes upon defeat and drops Remembrance of Putrescence
Remembrance of Putrescence: Dropped by Putrescent Knight

title: St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook [3]
text: Optional: Thiollier's summon sign can be found in the arena if he has left the Pillar Path Cross.
Activate the Garden of Deep Purple grace after the fight.
Pick up St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook [3] from a corner in the cave.

St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook [3]: Can be found on the ground, surrounded by Nectarblood Burgeon flowers. From the Garden of Deep Purple Site of Grace, head west and enter the narrow path and you'll come across this item.

title: Talk to Thiollier (Stone Coffin Fissure)
text: Interact with St. Trina and imbibe her nectar six times (until she tells you to kill Miquella).
Exhaust Thiollier's dialogue and attempt to pass on St. Trina's words twice.

Thiollier: Thiollier only moves here if you pursue St. Trina and his quest line. You must clear the Stone Coffin Fissure location first to find St. Trina at the very end of the Stone Coffin Fissure. Imbibe St. Trina's deadly nectar once. Then Tholier moves in. Otherwise you may have to travel to Thiollier's initial location to tell him about St. Trina. Fast travel back to the Garden of Deep Purple checkpoint at the Stone Coffin Fissure and you'll find Thiollier in St. Trina's chamber.

title: St. Trina's Smile
text: Reload the area to be invaded by Thiollier. Defeat him to obtain St. Trina's Smile.

St. Trina's Smile: Obtained as a drop upon defeating Thiollier. Thiollier only becomes a hostile enemy if you pursue Thiollier and St. Trina's NPC quest. Please visit the Thiollier or St.Trina 's page for the NPC quest guide.
Talk to Thiollier again and pass on St. Trina's words.
miss: This item must be obtained before fighting Leda and her allies in Enir-Ilim.

title: Boss: Furnace Golem (Shadow Keep)
text: Kill the Furnace Golem in the encampment north of the Highroad Cross for the Crimsonburst Dried Tear and a Furnace Visage.
Crimsonburst Dried Tear: The item drops from the Furnace Golem located around the army campsite, outside of the Shadow Keep.
Furnace Visage: Dropped by the Furnace Golem upon defeat
Furnace Golem: Furnace Golem is located around the army camp. Defeating this elite enemy drops the following items: x1 Crimsonburst Dried Tear x1 Furnace Visage

title: Battlefield Priest's Cookbook [3]
text: Pick up Drawstring Messmerfire Grease, Battlefield Priest's Cookbook [3], and a Shadow Realm Rune [4] from the left side of the encampment.
Drawstring Messmerfire Grease: Found on a body, just outside a large tent.
Battlefield Priest's Cookbook [3]: The item can be looted from a corpse, located inside an army tent.
Shadow Realm Rune: In the last tent on the left side of the encampment in front of the Shadow Keep's front entrance.

title: Golden Vow
text: On the right side of the encampment is a corpse with Ember of Messmer x6.
Head up the slope to the west of the encampment and pick up the Golden Vow x2 about halfway up.
Golden Vow: At the end of the room, hanging from a body.

guide.title: The Main Plaza and Boss Fight
text: After defeating the Golden Hippopotamus, you can head to the western archway to continue heading deeper into the Shadow Keep. Follow the path, and you will encounter two Messmer Soldiers overlooking the ledge on your left. After defeating them, pick up the Festive Grease from a corpse, and you'll encounter another Messmer Soldier going down the stairs.

In the middle of the stairs, you can find a room with two more Messmer Soldiers along with a corpse that you can loot for x6 Smithing Stone [1]. You can find another room connected to this room on the right side, which contains two more Messmer Soldiers along with a Black Knight. On the dead body by the south side of the room, you can pick up the dagger Main-gauche. Afterwards, head back out the stairs on the west, then keep going up.

You will encounter two Messmer Soldiers looking over the ledge on the left with a corpse that you can loot for x7 Redflesh Mushroom, and two more Messmer Soldiers on the right. After defeating the Messmer Soldiers, head up the stairs again to find another room. There will be three Black Knights inside the room; one wielding a hammer and greatshield, the second one using a greatbow, and the third one wielding a twinblade. You can deal with the first Black Knight by dragging him outside of the room to where you came from, then you can deal with the other two easily inside the room. On the opening on the south wall of the room, you can pick up x1 Golden Vow from corpse hanging by the ledge and x1 Shadow Realm Rune [6] from a body near the archway on the east.

title: Black Steel Twinblade
text: Kill the Black Knight at the top of the slope to obtain the Black Steel Twinblade.
Black Steel Twinblade: Drops from Black Knight at the top of the hill encampment. He is guarded by many Messmer Soldiers along the way.

title: Ash of War: Rolling Sparks
text: Head toward the elevated part of the camp on the other side to find a corpse with Shadow Sunflower x2.
Kill the exploding scarab hovering in the air for Ash of War: Rolling Sparks.
Ash of War: Rolling Sparks: Dropped by a flying scarab southeast of Shadow Keep, where the Perfumers are. It's high in the air and tough to see if you don't look up

title: Furnace Keeper's Note
text: Pick up Perfumer's Bolt x20 and a Somber Smithing Stone [7] from a tent at the top of the hill.
Somber Smithing Stone [7]: Upgrade Material looted from a corpse along the riverbed under the waterfall.
Near the castle wall is a dead Furnace Golem. Loot the 3x Furnace Visages around it and the Furnace Keeper's Note in the tent.
Furnace Keeper's Note: On the tent at the left side of the dead Furnace Golem.
Furnace Visage: Looted from the destroyed Furnace Golem parts

guide.title: Shadow Keep (Entering through the Main Gate)
text: The main entrance of the Shadow Keep is pretty linear, as you can follow the path directly from Castle Ensis leading to the main entrance of the Shadow Keep. Along the path, you will encounter Messmer Soldiers in encampments, so tread carefully. By the eastern section of the keep's outer walls, you can loot a fallen Furnace Golem for x1 Furnace Visage. Nearby, you can find a tent containing a corpse with x1 Furnace Keeper's Note. Return to the path, and you will find a big archway to a room containing a lift. This will take you to the Shadow Keep Main Gate Site of Grace [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Elden Ring Map]]].

When you arrive at the top of the lift, activate the Site of Grace. The area ahead of it is a boss room. Once you are ready to fight it, enter the room and you will encounter the Golden Hippopotamus. Its attacks have a deceptively big hit box, using mostly its head to attack. For more guides and strategies on how to defeat the boss, you can visit this page. After defeating the Golden Hippopotamus, it will drop x2 Scadutree Fragment and the Aspects of the Crucible: Thorns incantation. Defeating the Golden Hippopotamus will give you access to the Main Plaza of the Shadow Keep, allowing you to explore the whole area. The Main Gate Plaza Site of Grace [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Elden Ring Map]]] will be unlocked after the boss fight, so you can activate it now.

title: Boss: Golden Hippopotamus, Scadutree Fragment +1
text: Enter the castle and take the lift up to the Shadow Keep Main Gate grace.
Kill the Golden Hippopotamus for Aspects of the Crucible: Thorns, Scadutree Fragment x2, and 200,000 runes.
Aspects of the Crucible: Thorns: This item is obtained after defeating the Golden Hippopotamus found in Shadow Keep .

Golden Hippopotamus: This boss can be found resting at the foot of the giant Marika Statue in the plaza. Use the elevator in the Main Gate of Shadow Keep to access this area. Drops 200,000 Runes, Aspects of the Crucible: Thorns , and x2 Scadutree Fragments upon death.
Scadutree Fragment: Obtain x2 Scadutree Fragment after defeating the Golden Hippopotamus found in Shadow Keep .
Scadutree Fragment: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted by Miquella's Cross of the Storehouse, Fourth Floor Site of Grace in the Specimen Storehouse section of the Shadow Keep.
Scadutree Fragment: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted in front of a small statue of Marika, located in the Dark Chamber entrance of the Shadow Keep's Specimen Storehouse.

guide.title: Scaduview
text: DESCRIPTION HERE
Teleport to Shadow Keep, Back Gate - Site of Grace
Defeat Commander Gaius to access Scaduview
Use the Scaduview - Site of Grace after defeating the boss
Go to Albinauric's Shack
Head north to Scadutree Chalice and get the x5 Scadutree Fragment
NOTE: This area is only accessible after you have completed the Shadow Keep - Church District exploration. Make sure to read the full Shadow Keep (Part 1) to know how to reach this location.

After exploring Charo's Hidden Grave and clearing Lamenter's Gaol, you will now teleport to Shadow Keep, Back Gate - Site of Grace to advance your game. Face north and go through the archway to fight Commander Gaius. You can view this page to read a comprehensive guide on how to defeat the boss. Use the newly-spawned Scaduview - Site of Grace and from here, head through the archway on the north. Keep following the path north until you see a broken-down house on the west of the path. Approach it, and you will be at the Albinauric's Shack.

title: Main-gauche
text: Optional: Freyja and Hornsent can both be summoned if you've spoken to them at least once.
Activate the Main Gate Plaza grace after the fight.
Pick up Festive Grease from a corpse next to a staircase.
Take the first right up the stairs to a room with Smithing Stone [7] x3.
Past the doorway in the room is a corpse with the Main-gauche.
Main-gauche: Midway through the Stairs, turn right and enter the room. Enter the room on the right, and defeat the enemies to find the body that contains this weapon on the other side.

title: Talisman of Lord's Bestowal
text: Return to the stairs and continue to a corpse with Redflesh Mushroom x7 draped over the edge.
Grab the Golden Vow and Shadow Realm Rune [6] in the dining hall up the stairs.
Shadow Realm Rune [6]: Shadow Keep, in the dining room. Cross the bridge and enter the room to find it, Beware of the black knight on the left side.
Below the bridge just outside the dining hall is a corpse with Smithing Stone [8] x3.
Smithing Stone [8]: x3 Upgrade Material looted from a corpse found on a small balcony in Ruins of Unte. Use this vantage point to activate the nearby Furnace Golem
Drop down and grab the Talisman of Lord's Bestowal next to a golden tree.
Talisman of Lord's Bestowal: Can be found beside the big golden tree.

guide.title: Exploring the Plaza
text: As you head out of the room, you can drop down from the bridge on the left side, and you'll find x5 Smithing Stone [5] from a dead body. Continue heading south, and you will see a golden tree. Directly beside it, you can pick up the Talisman of Lord's Bestowal. On the room south of the tree, you can pick up x2 Smithing Stone [8] from a dead body on the ledge northwest of the room. Northwest of the plaza, you can find a Black Knight facing a dead body with an item. Defeat the Black Knight, then pick up the x3 Golden Vow on the dead body. You can get back up by entering the room east of the corpse, which will contain a Messmer Soldier and a Black Knight. A ladder room will be on the eastern side, which leads you back to the room with the three Black Knights that you just fought.
## Shortcut access back to Main Plaza Grace

After opening the door back to the room, head east again through the archway to continue progressing through the Shadow Keep. On the northeastern side, which is a dead-end, you can loot a body for x1 Holyproof Pickled Liver. Keep following the path going to the southeast, and you'll encounter Shadow Militiamen by the boats. By the stairs heading up, you can pick up x1 Messmerfire Grease from the dead body lying on the stairs. South of it, you can find a ramp going down, in which you will encounter more Shadow Militiamen. Open the double door, which leads you back to the Main Gate Plaza Site of Grace.
## Obtain Domain of Dragons Painting

From the Main Gate Plaza - Site of Grace, exit through the door while facing Southeast. This will take you to an area with Satyr enemies. Outside, go up the ramp and make a right to the burning boats. Then, use the ladder on the left side to go down near a waterfall to the left.

Walk towards the waterfall to reveal a room here. Take the ladder going down and go through the door to your left. You will see the Domain of Dragons Painting here. Interact with it, then pay attention to the wall behind you.

title: Ash of War: Swift Slash, Talk to Hornsent +1
text: Go through the doorway close to a corner to find Smithing Stone [8] x2 on a wooden platform.
Return to the tree and pick up the Golden Vow x3 guarded by a Black Knight.
Grab the Smithing Stone [8] x2 behind a weapon rack in the nearby room.
Climb the ladder in the room and open the shortcut back to the dining hall.
This time, head across the bridge and pick up the Holyproof Pickled Liver in the left-hand corner.
Holyproof Pickled Liver: Head to the western wall ships area, and turn right to find the item on a corpse.
On a short flight of stairs past three funeral boats is a corpse with Messmerfire Grease.
Messmerfire Grease: Can be found on a corpse near one of the ships.
Head down the long set of stairs to pick up a Drawstring Golden Grease and unlock a shortcut back to the Main Gate Plaza.
Drawstring Golden Grease: Found in the big stairs by the door that opens a shortcut to the grace.
Return up the long staircase to find two summon signs on the right:

Note: To obtain all missable items in two playthroughs, you must either assist Hornsent in defeating Leda or assist Leda in killing both Hornsent (now) and Ansbach (later), then do the opposite in NG+. Helping Leda kill Hornsent and later siding with Ansbach is possible, but doing so causes you to miss a unique talisman, requiring a third playthrough to get all items.
Assist Hornsent:
Note: Skips the invasion part of Leda's questline, and depending on a later decision, Hornsent can become one of Leda's allies in the Enir-Ilim fight.
Use the gold summon sign and help Hornsent defeat Leda for Ash of War: Swift Slash and Leda's Rune.

Ash of War: Swift Slash: Assist Hornsent in the fight against Needle Knight Leda. You need to progress the quest to find two summoning signs here. Take the golden one to assist Hornsent and defeat Needle Knight Leda .
Leda's Rune: Obtained if you side with Hornsent and successfully defend him against Leda by interacting with the golden sign before the bridge and cooperating with him
Hornsent: Hornsent moves here after defeating Messmer the Impaler if you have advanced his questline.
Golden Vow x3: Can be found in the area with the big golden tree, it is guarded by a Black Knight.
miss: The summon signs disappear once you open the door to Messmer's chamber. The Ash of War becomes unobtainable if you assist Leda or fail to obtain it before opening the door to Messmer's chamber.

place.title: Shadow Keep
walk: ## Shadow Keep, Church District
## The Prayer Room: Fire Knight Queelign

Below, you should immediately see yet another corpse next to a small Crab. Loot the body to find x1 Lightningproof Pickled Liver. Go around, northeast, and you'll locate a locked door, this is the Prayer Room that requires the Prayer Room Key, a key that drops upon defeating the NPC Invader Fire Knight Queelign, encountered for the second time at the Church of the Crusade . If you have the key, you can unlock the door and find Fire Knight Queelign (NPC) in the flesh. Now, if you have an item called the Iris of Occultation, you can give it to the NPC, and after Queelign's dialogue, the NPC will drop a weapon you can loot. This weapon is Queelign's Greatsword. NOTE: If you give the Iris of Grace to Queelign, you'll receive the Spirit Ash "Fire Knight Queelign". The Iris of Occultation can be acquired in many ways, one way is by obtaining it as an item drop from defeating a Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit located in this area after you drain the flood.
## The Flooded Church District: Draining the Flood

NOTE: In the same hallway, there are two doorways on the left, the far most or second doorway will lead you to a lift that takes you to the Specimen Storehouse section of the Shadow Keep. You're free to roam here, but we highly recommend returning to the Specimen Storehouse after clearing the Main Plaza and Church District of the Shadow Keep. What you can do is enter the Specimen Storehouse, and activate the nearby Site of Grace (Storehouse, Back Section) so you can just fast travel here after exploring the Church District.

You can also return to the hallway to get the item sitting on the hand of Marika's statue. You can get the item by jumping on the hand, it may require a few tries as the platform that you need to stand on is quite narrow. Loot the item to acquire x1 Scadutree Fragment, then prepare to fight a group of Ignited Putrid Corpse as you jump down. Behind the same statue, you can find the Fire Knight's Seal weapon
## Exploring the Sunken Chapel
## Kill the Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit by the Large Tree
## Defeat the Second Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit

There is also building another where you'll find a pack of Crabs and Giant Crab enemies, one roaming around, and the other next to another body that you can loot to find x1 Shadow Realm Rune [5]. If you continue to go around this area, you'll reach the west side where you'll find the Sunken Chapel Site of Grace
## Find the Tree-Worship Site of Grace
## Scadutree Avatar
## Storehouse, Back Section

If you look over the railings from the Back Section Site of Grace, you can safely jump onto the bookcases and drop to the First Floor Site of Grace. This lets you explore the rest of Shadow Keep without the need to fight the Golden Hippopotamus that guards the Main Plaza.
## Storehouse, Loft

If you walk across the beam going west, you can climb down a ladder. On your left, just around the corner, you can loot a body for x4 Rada Fruit. Directly northeast of the ladder you descended on, you will find another ladder you can use to descend. You will reach an area similar to the Site of Grace.

If you head outside the archway on the northwestern side of the area, you will find a lift directly on your right. Take the lift going down, then keep following the scaffolding until you reach an area with a door and a lift. You cannot open the door yet, so use the lift nearby to go down. The lift will then lead you to the Shadow Keep, Back Gate Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map.
Defeating Commander Gaius will give you the Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider. It will also give access to Scaduview region.
## Shadow Keep: Main Plaza Entrance
## The Main Entrance of Shadow Keep
## The Main Plaza

After defeating the Golden Hippopotamus, you can head to the western archway to continue heading deeper into the Shadow Keep. Follow the path, and you will encounter two Messmer Soldiers overlooking the ledge on your left. After defeating them, pick up the Festive Grease from a corpse, and you'll encounter another Messmer Soldier going down the stairs.

In the middle of the stairs, you can find a room with two more Messmer Soldiers along with a corpse that you can loot for x6 Smithing Stone [1]. You can find another room connected to this room on the right side, which contains two more Messmer Soldiers along with a Black Knight. On the dead body by the south side of the room, you can pick up the dagger Main-gauche. Afterwards, head back out the stairs on the west, then keep going up.

You will encounter two Messmer Soldiers looking over the ledge on the left with a corpse that you can loot for x7 Redflesh Mushrooms, and two more Messmer Soldiers on the right. After defeating the Messmer Soldiers, head up the stairs again to find another room. There will be three Black Knights inside the room; one wielding a hammer and greatshield, the second one using a greatbow, and the third one wielding a twinblade. You can deal with the first Black Knight by dragging him outside of the room to where you came from, then you can deal with the other two easily inside the room. On the opening on the south wall of the room, you can pick up x1 Golden Vow from corpse hanging by the ledge and x1 Shadow Realm Rune [6] from a body near the archway on the east.
## Exploring The Plaza (Loot Detour)
## Shortcut Access
## Summon Signs

If you interact with the red sign, you will be summoned to assist Needle Knight Leda in defeating Hornsent - This will reward you with the Hornsent Set along with the curved sword Falx. If you interact with the yellow sign, you will be summoned to assist Hornsent in defeating Needle Knight Leda - This will reward you with the Ash of War: Swift Slash and Leda's Rune.
You can also opt to ignore both summon signs, and Leda's sidequest will only advance after you've defeated Messmer at the top of Shadow Keep.
## More Loot Detour

After you have arrived at the bottom of the ladder, follow the path going northwest until you come across with a dead body that has x1 Somber Smithing Stone [8]. Go back to the waterfall you passed through earlier, then go inside of the passageway behind it. Follow the path, then go down the ladder. Once you are at the bottom, go east to find a room with a painting. Pick it up, and you will receive the Domain of Dragons Painting.
## Main Plaza Continuation
## Shadow Keep: Specimen Storehouse
## Storehouse, First Floor (Detour)
## Exploring the Specimen Storehouse, First Floor

Head northwest of it, and you will find a room that has x3 Hefty Beast Bone on a corpse lying against a table with a specimen. In this room, you will find Ansbach on the northeastern corner of the room reading a scripture. Talk to him, and exhaust all of Ansbach's dialogues. Head back out of the room, then follow the path going northwest. Turn right on the first one, and you'll find two Shadow Undead reading books, along with a hostile Shadow Undead and a Vulgar Militiaman at the base of a staircase.
## Specimen Storehouse, Second Floor

Once you have picked up the smithing stone, you can drop down the railing opposite of it. You'll be in a room with a corpse containing the Boltdrake Talisman +3. On the northwestern wall, you can pull a lever that opens a hidden path back to the first floor near the Site of Grace. You'll find x2 Ember of Messmer on the dead body you'll find immediately after the path opens. Backtrack your way to the stairs going up, then head left again.
## Specimen Storehouse, Third Floor

Head back out of the room, then go up the area with railings. Cross the bridge on the south side. Along the bridge, you can loot a dead body for x1 Furlcalling Finger Remedy. Two Shadow Militiamen will attack you as you approach the end of the bridge. Look east near the end of the bridge, and you will find an area you can jump onto from the railings. On the southern wall, you'll find x1 Dueling Shield on a dead body by the wall. Return to the path, then go southwest.

Return to the bridge, then jump up to the feet of the hanging specimen. If you want to find more loot, you can jump down to the specimen below to get x1 Revered Spirit Ash. If you jumped down, make your way back up to the bridge, then jump up again on the feet of the hanging specimen. This time, make your way up to the head of the specimen, then jump to the fourth floor.

IMPORTANT: Starting Messmer the Impaler's boss fight for the first time will make the summon signs for aiding/invading Hornsent disappear (through the shortcut door, at the top of the ramp from the Main Gate Plaza grace) so make sure to complete that if you desire to complete Hornsent/Needle Knight Leda's questline. If you choose to invade Hornsent and help Needle Knight Leda, you should also go back to Sir Ansbach's location near the Storehouse, First Floor grace and choose to aid/invade him as well (The Sir Ansbach fight will not be available if you aid Hornsent). Read up on their questlines on their respective pages for more information.

Near the Dark Chamber Entrance Site of Grace will be a door. Opening it will lead you to the boss, who is then revealed to be Messmer the Impaler. Messmer the Impaler uses a spear as a weapon, so be mindful of the range of his attacks. His spear and attacks will be imbued with fire, so having fire resistance would be a good idea for this boss fight. For a more in-depth guide on how to defeat Messmer the Impaler, you can go to this page for more information.

After defeating Messmer the Impaler, you will receive Messmer's Kindling along with the Remembrance of the Impaler. Messmer's Kindling will be used to gain access to a legacy dungeon, Enir-Ilim See Elden Ring Map.

guide.title: Shadow Keep Depths (Main Gate to Recluse River)
text: Entering Shadow Keep to Main Gate to gain access to Recluse River and Eastern Scadu Altus
Teleport to Highroad Cross - Site of Grace
Head north and enter Shadow Keep through the Main Gate (defeat the Furnace Golem if you haven't)
Fight Golden Hippopotamus

Exit through the northeast and make your way around this section to unlock the shortcut back to the Main Gate Plaza - Site of Grace (NOTE: It is recommended to help Hornsent in this fight and use the gold summon sign since you can encounter Hornsent later on to get his items. You can earn additional rewards if you assist Hornsent to defeat Leda: Ash of War: Swift Slash and Leda's Rune.)
Head back out through the southeast and do the Hornsent vs Leda fight
Get Domain of Dragons Painting
Reveal the Illusory Wall and ride the coffin
Use the Castle Watering Hole - Site of Grace (explore here later)
Eliminate the Furnace Golem
Explore the Ruins of Unte
Reach Village of Flies
Make your way to Eastern Nameless Mausoleum and defeat Rakshasa
Complete Darklight Catacombs
Defeat Jori, Elder Inquisitor, and go through the new area

NOTE: This portion of the Game Progress Route will guide you on how to reach the area under Shadow Keep and explore the path to Recluses' River that will let you access the following locations: Ruins of Unte, Eastern Nameless Mausoleum and Darklight Catacombs in the Eastern Scadu Altus.
IMPORTANT: Needle Knight Leda and Hornest questline may get bricked if you accidentally enter the main boss in Shadow Keep. Make sure to read this guide to avoid canceling quests unintentionally.

title: Falx, Hornsent Set +1
text: Assist Needle Knight Leda:
Note: Ends Hornsent's questline and excludes him from the fight in Enir-Ilim.
Use the red summon sign and kill Hornsent for the Falx and the Hornsent Set.
Falx: Dropped by Hornsent when he is defeated in the staircase leading to the Church of the Bud in Ancient Ruins of Rauh after invading you.
Hornsent Set: Dropped by Hornsent when he is defeated in the staircase leading to the Church of the Bud in Ancient Ruins of Rauh after invading you.

Hornsent: If you have followed Hornsent's questline and done Messmer, he will invade at the top of the staircase leading to the Church of the Bud in Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Drops Falx and Hornsent Set upon defeat.

place.title: Scorpion River Catacombs
walk: Scorpion River Catacombs Full Video Walkthrough

First you must reach Rauh Base, which is found by take the path north of Moorth Ruins in Scadu Altus- explore east until you find a small pond and go through the ravine, then follow the cave to a swamp, past some gravebirds, and you'll emerge in Rauh Base. From here, go west to Temple Town Ruins, and from there you must follow the way north and west, past pests and scorpions. The exact location is shown on the Elden Ring Map here.

From the Site of Grace, head straight through the catacombs. In the first room, an Imp enemy will ambush you. Afterward, head left down a short set of stairs towards a large hallway, and turn left into a small room. Inside, you'll find a corpse holding Rejuvenating Boluses and two Imps guarding it. Take them out.

Exit the small room and quickly cross the bridge (there is a basilisk statue that causes constant Death Blight build up while in its line of sight) in the middle of the large hallway until you find another set of stairs going down. Follow the path until you reach another large room with two Imp enemies inside.

Eliminate them and head down the stairs of the large room. Just below the stairs is a corpse holding a Grave Glovewort (3). Proceed through the tunnel entrance on the same level to find another room with an Imp guarding a plant on the left that gives you Yellow Fulgurbloom. At the other end of the room is another tunnel, but before proceeding, loot the corpse beside the tunnel to get x5 Redflesh Mushroom.

Head down the tunnel and go straight through the tight path, turning right towards another short set of stairs going down. Do not immediately exit the tunnel after turning right. There's a large spike trap that launches from above. Wait for the spike to go down, then immediately run to the right to a small space that keeps you safe from the spike trap. From here, you can either run to the right to get out of the spike area or go to the corpse on the other side that has the Ghost Glovewort and then run to safety after looting it.

Once you're out of the spike trap area, turn left and drop down to another level, but be careful, as there are three Basilisks waiting to attack you. After killing the Basilisks, head through the tunnel on this level to find another corpse on the left, giving you the Shadow Realm Rune (4). Exit the tunnel, and just to the left, you'll see another Yellow Fulgurbloom.

To the right, you'll find a ladder going up. Head up the ladder and take out an Imp enemy on the edge of the tunnel enjoying the view of the next room. Drop down into the room and loot the corpse on the right for another Ghost Glovewort (5).

Then, head to the left side of the room and up a short set of stairs. Turn left to find yourself back at the spike trap area. Cross the spike trap area again, but instead of dropping down to the Basilisk area, turn right. This leads to an open hallway with Messmer Soldiers inside. Before proceeding toward the Messmer Soldiers, run to a safe space on the right as the first half of the hallway is another spike trap. Once you cross the hallway, take out the two Messmer Soldiers and then the Black Knight with its back turned. After clearing the hallway, loot the corpse on the right near where you fought the Messmer Soldiers to get a Smithing Stone (5). In the middle of the hallway, where the Black Knight stood, loot the altar to receive the Black Knight Captain Huw.

Afterward, head back to the safe area of the second spike trap and climb the ladder going up. Once you reach the top, wait for the spike trap to go down. Before it goes back up, hop on top of it to reach a secret platform above. Loot the corpse there to get the Ghost Glovewort [6]. Hop on the spike trap again to go back to the level above the ladder.

Cross the bridge to the right, and before heading straight through the other tunnel, turn left and cross the ledge. Hop on the spike trap that goes down on the left to reach another secret platform and loot a corpse for the Imp Head (Lion).

Return to the ledge, but before going back, turn left first to the tunnel here and enter the small room at the end. Kill two Imps guarding a corpse that gives you the Knight's Lightning Spear. Afterward, head back through the tunnel. Before exiting to the ledge area, turn left and go up the stairs to a small area with two Imps. Loot the corpse on the left to get x6 Yellow Fulgurbloom.

Once done looting, drop down near the corpse to find yourself back at the crossing point of the ledge where you crossed the bridge earlier. Go through the tunnel now and take the elevator down.Once you reach the bottom, head straight through the catacomb tunnels until you reach an intersection. Turn right and wait a few seconds for a shadow fireball trap to cross. When the shadow fireball passes and goes back, tail it down a set of stairs. There's climbable rubble up ahead, but first, check if the shadow fireball has crossed. If it has, climb up the rubble and turn right to the first path.

Follow the path until you reach a giant Imp guarding a short set of stairs. Loot the corpse to the right for a Grave Glovewort (4) before taking out the giant Imp. Head down the stairs after defeating the giant Imp and you'll find yourself in another large room. Head straight and loot the corpse and plant for a Yellow Fulgurbloom and Ghost Glovewort. Then, go down the ladder to the right of the plant and corpse. Once you reach the bottom, handle the 3 basilisks- who bill be facing away from you, and then loot the corpse to the left for a Great Ghost Glovewort.

Head back up the ladder and turn left through another tunnel, and head up the stairs. At the top, peek first because there are two Shadow Fireballs that will cross. Wait for them to pass above you and then run across the bridge. You can stop in the middle of the bridge and drop down to the left onto a small walkway. Watch out for the imp here, and then get a Yellow Fulgurbloom plant at the end of the walkway.

At the other end of this place, where you dropped down, is a ladder going up. Climb up to find a small room with some Imps and a chest containing the Ancient Dragon Knight's Cookbook (2). Afterward, from the ladder, turn left through a tight tunnel that leads to the second level of a previous area. Loot the corpse on the right for Rejuvenating Boluses.

Turn left towards another tunnel with a Yellow Fulgurbloom plant on the right. To the left of the tunnel is a drop-down path back to where the Shadow Fireball trap of the bridge you dropped down from earlier was. Cross the bridge completely and turn right at the end. There's another elevator here that goes down. At the bottom, walk straight to find a yellow mist that leads to the Death Knight boss battle. This boss drops the Death Knight's Longhaft Axe and Cerulean Amber Medallion +3.

title: Lacerating Crossed-Tree
text: Talk to Leda to receive the Lacerating Crossed-Tree, then speak to her again.
miss: Becomes unobtainable if you assist Hornsent or fail to help Leda kill him before opening the door to Messmer's chamber.

title: Domain of Dragons Painting
text: Talk to Leda after reloading the area, and she'll name Ansbach as her next target.
Pick up the Rada Fruit, Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot, and Smithing Stone [8] x3 by the funeral boats.

Smithing Stone [8]: x2 From the Spiral Rise Site of Grace, head up the stairs and exit through the roof. Continue following the path and you'll find this on a corpse on the right side of one of the roofs.
Descend the ladder near the boats, then go past the waterfall to find a Somber Smithing Stone [8].
Behind the waterfall you passed is a ladder that leads to a painting. Examine the painting to obtain the "Domain of Dragons" Painting.

Domain of Dragons Painting: Upon defeating the Golden Hippopotamus, proceed to the western wing of the Shadow Keep. When you find a large staircase that leads to the storehouse, continue straight to the eastern side of the rampart. Clear out the enemies in the area, then you'll find a ladder beside a body that has a Silver-Pickeld Fowl Foot item. Climb down the ladder and investigate behind the waterfall where you'll find another ladder. Climb the ladder to find a storeroom that has the painting.

title: Ash of War: Wall of Sparks
text: Hit the illusory wall nearby, then rest in the coffin at the end. Grab the Castle Watering Hole grace for later.
Return to the Main Gate Plaza shortcut and pick up the Bone Dart x8 and Smithing Stone [7] x2 up the stairs.
Take the lift past the Fire Knight to reach the Storehouse, First Floor grace.
Head through the doorway on the left to pick up a Rune Arc.
Rune Arc: From the Storehouse, first floor site of grace, take the exit to the left, to find a room with two enemies, the item is besides one of them.
Take the lift down, then go straight ahead for a Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot.
Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot: Take the left lift down from the Storehouse, first floor site of grace, and move forward until you reach a room with a Living Jar. The item is in the room.
Enter the corridor near the lift, then take a left to a balcony with Ash of War: Wall of Sparks.

Ash of War: Wall of Sparks: Take the left lift down from the Storehouse, first-floor site of grace. take the first exit to the right, and then the first one to the left. You will find this item on a corpse sitting on the rails.

guide.title: STOREHOUSE, FIRST FLOOR (DETOUR)
text: On the west side of the First Floor Site of Grace, you'll find a room filled with Shadow Undead, along with a dead body sitting against the stone tablets containing x1 Rune Arc. Head inside the room, and you will find a lift which you can ride going down.

After arriving at the bottom of the lift, you will be in a room connecting two other rooms. In the room west, you will find a corpse that you can loot for x1 Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot along with a Living Jar hiding by the entrance of the room. The second room is a hallway, which also connects two more rooms. The room on the left will have a Living Jar by the door along with a corpse sitting by the railing containing the Ash of War: Wall of Sparks.

In the northern room, you'll find a Living Jar running up the stairs. Defeat the Living Jar, but don't go down the stairs yet. Go to the hallway beside the stairs, then hit the Illusory wall to reveal a hidden room. You can obtain x1 Battlefield Priest's Cookbook (4). After obtaining the cookbook, you can now head down the stairs.

You will find yourself in a room filled with Living Jars. After dealing with the Living Jars, go west to find a corpse containing x5 Hefty Beast Bone behind a jar. Head south to get into another room filled with more Living Jars. On the eastern side, you'll find a Living Jar standing in front of an item. Defeat the Living Jar and two more small Living Jars, then loot the item to receive the Iris of Grace - an item you can hand over to an NPC later. You'll also find a dead corpse lying on a bed southwest of the Iris of Grace which contains x1 Hefty Cracked Pot.

After clearing the room, head west to enter a room. Be cautious as you are entering the room, as a Living Jar will attack you on the right side. Head down either staircase, as they both lead to the same area. This room leads outside to the West Rampart Site of Grace [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Elden Ring Map]]], which is another entrance to the Shadow Keep. Travel back to the Storehouse, First Floor Site of Grace to resume exploring the Shadow Keep.
## EXPLORING THE SPECIMEN STOREHOUSE, FIRST FLOOR

As soon as you arrive on the first floor, head east to find a dead corpse containing x1 Fireproof Pickled Liver. Afterwards, head west, passing by the archway instead of going inside the room. You'll find a path by the base of the specimen in the middle of the room going northeast. You will encounter numerous Shadow Undead and Shadow Militiamen on the first floor of the Specimen Storehouse. Keep following the path, and you'll a staircase going to the left, along with an Undead Shadow in the middle of it.
Go up the stairs, and you'll find yourself in a big room filled with bookcases. The northern side will be a dead-end, but it will have a corpse that you can loot for x1 Fire Coil.

Head northwest of it, and you will find a room that has x3 Hefty Beast Bone on a corpse lying against a table with a specimen. In this room, you will find Ansbach on the northeastern corner of the room reading a scripture. Talk to him, and exhaust all of Ansbach's dialogues. Head back out of the room, then follow the path going northwest. Turn right on the first one, and you'll find two Shadow Undead reading books, along with a hostile Shadow Undead and a Vulgar Militiaman at the base of a staircase.

After dealing with the enemies, you can keep exploring the west side of the first floor wherein you'll find a Fire Knight patrolling around a big bookcase. You can get a jump on the Fire Knight as you can easily backstab it. On the southern side of the bookcase, you'll find a corpse containing x5 Smithing Stone [8]. After looting the corpse, you can now head up the stairs.

title: Battlefield Priest's Cookbook [4]
text: Hit the illusory wall next to a staircase to find the Battlefield Priest's Cookbook [4].

Battlefield Priest's Cookbook [4]: Take the left lift down from the Storehouse, first floor site of grace. take the first exit to the right and continue forwad until the end of thehallway. Kill the enemy, and take the left route, hit the wall to reveal a path. The Battlefield Priest's Cookbook [4] is on a corpse, after the revealed hidden door.

title: Hefty Cracked Pot
text: Go downstairs and pick up the Innard Meat between two pots.
Pick up a Hefty Cracked Pot and an Iris of Grace from the infirmary.
Hefty Cracked Pot: Right to the location of the Iris of Grace, on a bed. in the Room after the West Rampart Site of Grace.

Iris of Grace: Directly below of the Ash of War: Wall of Sparks location. Take the left lift down from the Storehouse, first floor site of grace. Take the first exit to the right and continue forward until the end of the hallway. Kill the enemy, and take the right path down. Kill the enemies and turn left all the way to find the item.

title: Revered Spirit Ash
text: Continue past the infirmary to grab the West Rampart grace for later.
Return to Storehouse, First Floor and climb the horned beast to reach the Revered Spirit Ash on top of it.
Revered Spirit Ash: Climb up the statue's feet and carefully drop down the beast statue below, where you'll find a Revered Spirit Ash.

title: Boltdrake Talisman +3
text: On the floor near the beast's skull is a corpse with Fireproof Pickled Liver.
Fireproof Pickled Liver: Near the Storehouse, First Floor site of grace, to the side of the giant creature.
Follow the narrow path east of the corpse to a secluded area with the Boltdrake Talisman +3.

Boltdrake Talisman +3: Shadow Keep . From the Storehouse Site of Grace, First Floor, take the small stairs up and turn right while on the wooden platform. You will be attacked by a Fire Knight at a Distance, jump at what appears to be a dining area with tables and chairs to find the item there.

guide.title: SPECIMEN STOREHOUSE, SECOND FLOOR
text: After getting on top of the stairs, go up the smaller set of steps on the left side. On the west side, you'll find a corpse containing x4 Black Pyrefly sitting against a table. Head down the small set of steps, then follow the path. Once the path forks out, follow the path on the right. At the end of the path, you can find x3 Smithing Stone [5] on a dead body by the railing on the right.

Once you have picked up the smithing stone, you can drop down the railing opposite of it. You'll be in a room with a corpse containing the Boltdrake Talisman +3. On the northwestern wall, you can pull a lever that opens a hidden path back to the first floor near the Site of Grace. You'll find x2 Ember of Messmer on the dead body you'll find immediately after the path opens. Backtrack your way to the stairs going up, then head left again.

Before going up the stairs going to the third floor, you can find a Fire Knight on the section underneath it. Defeat the Fire Knight, then pick up x4 Beast Horn on the dead body next to it. You can then head up the stairs going to the third floor.

title: Ash of War: Shield Strike
text: Pull the lever to find a corpse with Ember of Messmer x2 behind an empty shelving unit.
Head up the stairs and grab the Fire Coil below the bridge on the right.
Fire Coil: Enter the eastern side of the library of the First floor of the Storehouse.
Enter the nearby room to find a corpse with Hefty Beast Bone x3 in front of some skeletal remains.
Exhaust Ansbach's dialogue in the same room.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [8] x5 guarded by a Fire Knight at the end of the first floor.
Go up the stairs to the second floor and pick up the Smithing Stone [7] x4 on the wooden walkway.
