Pick up the Beast Horn x4 and Black Pyrefly x4 on the second floor.
On the third floor, head west to pick up a Beast Horn that's guarded by a Fire Knight.
Next to some stone tablets at the other end is a Blessed Bone Shard.
Blessed Bone Shard: Located on the ground before walking across the statues resting on some tablets.
Pick up a Furlcalling Finger Remedy from a corpse on the wooden walkway.
Furlcalling Finger Remedy: From the middle area, take the set of stairs to the next floor. Move to the eastern side and on the bridge you'll find a corpse with this item.
On a ledge attached to the walkway is a corpse with the Dueling Shield.

Dueling Shield: From the middle area, take the set of stairs to the next floor. Move to the eastern side, climb the wooden platform, and fight the Vulgar Militiamen. Use the stone platforms to reach the other side, the item is against the wall.
Optional: This shield is equipped with Ash of War: Shield Strike. Remove it to make it available for compatible shields.

guide.title: SPECIMEN STOREHOUSE, THIRD FLOOR
text: Once you go up the stairs, you'll find a Fire Knight by the southwestern side looking over the ledge. Defeat the Fire Knight first to make it easier to explore the third floor. NOTE: Take note of this location, as you'll have to backtrack to this location after a certain event. Afterwards, you are free to explore the floor as it is only filled with numerous Shadow Undead. On the south side of the third floor, you can loot x1 Blessed Bone Shard on a dead body sitting against books.

On the western side of the third floor, you'll find a room filled with Shadow Undead reading scriptures. You'll also find a Fire Knight on the southwestern side of the room. After defeating the Fire Knight, you can loot a corpse near the Fire Knight's position for x1 Beast Horn.

Head back out of the room, then go up the area with railings. Cross the bridge on the south side. Along the bridge, you can loot a dead body for x1 Furlcalling Finger Remedy. Two Shadow Militiamen will attack you as you approach the end of the bridge. Look east near the end of the bridge, and you will find an area you can jump onto from the railings. On the southern wall, you'll find x1 Dueling Shield on a dead body by the wall. Return to the path, then go southwest.

You'll find a room containing more Shadow Undead. In the first room, you'll find x2 Lump of Flesh on a dead body by the wall on the northern side. Head to the second room, and you'll find another Fire Knight patrolling around a bookcase. Backstab the Fire Knight, then finish it off. On the eastern side of the room, you can find a dead body containing x4 Beast Horn sitting against the railing.

Return to the bridge, then jump up to the feet of the hanging specimen. If you want to find more loot, you can jump down to the specimen below to get x1 Revered Spirit Ash. If you jumped down, make your way back up to the bridge, then jump up again on the feet of the hanging specimen. This time, make your way up to the head of the specimen, then jump to the fourth floor.

title: Storehouse Cross Message, Scadutree Fragment
text: Grab the Lump of Flesh x2 and Beast Horn x4 in the section past the balcony.
Climb the crucified specimen to reach the fourth floor. Pick up the Scadutree Fragment and Storehouse Cross Message, then grab the Storehouse, Fourth Floor grace.
Storehouse Cross Message: Climb the feet of the statue and move towards the head, jump to the next area. You will find the item on a table, next to a Miquella's Cross and a Site of Grace
Scadutree Fragment: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted by the roots in front of the chalice.

guide.title: SPECIMEN STOREHOUSE, FOURTH FLOOR
text: After jumping onto the fourth floor, you can loot x1 Scadutree Fragment and a Storehouse Cross Message in the middle of the room. Activate the Storehouse, Fourth Floor Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map, then you can resume your exploration of the Shadow Keep.

After activating the Site of Grace, head west to go outside. On the right side, you can find x3 Stormhawk Feather on a dead body near the ledge. Afterwards, head south, then go up the stairs. On the next set of stairs, a Fire Knight will be aggressive towards you, casting spells from afar. Before going up the stairs, you can loot a corpse on the right side of the stairs for x4 Black Pyrefly. After defeating the Fire Knight, follow the path until you find a staircase going down. Defeat the Giant Bats near the top of the stairs, then go down the stairs. On the ledge by the stairs, you can find a corpse with x1 Shadow Realm Rune [5].

After looting the dead body, head inside the room, which is another section of the fourth floor. On the northeastern side, behind the bookshelf, you can find x1 Secret Rite Scroll - an item that you need for a quest later involving Ansbach and Redmane Freyja. On the south side of the room near the entrance, you can loot a corpse for x1 Holyproof Pickled Liver. Head back out of the room, then continue following the path. Near the end of the path, you'll find a room on the left side. Before entering it, defeat the Giant Bat at the end of the path, then loot the dead body by the ledge for x3 Ember of Messmer. After looting the corpse, you can head inside the room, which will be the fifth floor of the Specimen Storehouse.
## SPECIMEN STOREHOUSE, FIFTH FLOOR
On the western partition of the fifth floor, you will encounter three Shadow Undead in the area. Defeat the enemies, then loot the body on the western wall for x2 Smithing Stone [6].

Afterwards, keep going in the northeast direction, clearing the path of the Shadow Undead that you encounter. You can find x2 Fire Coil on a corpse by a lectern between a bookshelf along the way. Keep following the path, eventually going north, and you will encounter another Fire Knight. Near the Fire Knight, you can find x3 Smithing Stone [7] on a corpse resting by the wall on the right. Continue following the path, and you will eventually get to the stairs leading to the sixth floor. Head up the stairs, and you'll find x1 Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot on a corpse near the top of the stairs.
## SPECIMEN STOREHOUSE, SIXTH FLOOR

After arriving at the sixth floor, go to the room on the south. In this room, you will encounter three Shadow Undead along with a Fire Knight with its back turned against you. After defeating the enemies, you can loot a dead body near the Fire Knight for x1 Spirit Calculus. Head back out of the room, and another Fire Knight patrolling the area will approach you. Deal with the Fire Knight, then head up the stairs to get to the seventh floor.
## SPECIMEN STOREHOUSE, SEVENTH FLOOR

On the seventh floor, you can find a corpse containing x2 Sliver of Meat sitting by the rail near the stairs. Go to the room on the southwest, then activate the Storehouse, Seventh Floor Site of Grace [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Elden Ring Map]]]. In this room, you can find Redmane Freyja on the other end reading a stone tablet. Talk to her, and exhaust all of her dialogues - this is part of a quest. After talking to Redmane Freyja, go back to the Storehouse, First Floor Site of Grace.

title: Secret Rite Scroll
text: Head outside and pick up the Stormhawk Feather x3 on the right.
Next to a staircase and a funeral boat up ahead is a corpse with Black Pyrefly x4.
Continue to a staircase that leads downward. Pick up the Shadow Realm Rune [5] next to it.
Shadow Realm Rune [5]: Found on a corpse under the stairs by the bats, guarded by 3 Shades.
Grab the Holyproof Pickled Liver and Secret Rite Scroll in the room by the staircase.
Secret Rite Scroll: Located on a table inside the room down the stairs, after progressing outside from the fourth floor. It's near the edge of this area.
Holyproof Pickled Liver: Located on a corpse just inside the room down the stairs, after progressing outside from the fourth floor.

title: Revered Spirit Ash
text: Head back outside and pick up the Redflesh Mushroom x6 and Ember of Messmer x3 at the end.
Go left when heading inside to find a corpse with Smithing Stone [7] x4.
Head down the other way and pick up the Fire Coil x2 behind a shelving unit.
Continue to a corpse with Smithing Stone [8] x3 around a corner.
Pick up a Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot on the staircase to the sixth floor.
Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot: Against the rails, near the eastern wall, by a ladder leading to a secret way to Ruins of Unte
In the room straight ahead, you'll find a Spirit Calculus guarded by a Fire Knight.
Spirit Calculus: At the side of a Fire Knight on the sixth floor, below the Seventh Floor site of grace.
Pick up the Sliver of Meat x2 up two sets of stairs and grab the Storehouse, Seventh Floor grace.
Talk to Freyja in front of the fireplace.
Climb onto the horned beast across the wooden bridge for a Revered Spirit Ash.
Revered Spirit Ash: From the Seventh Floor Site of Grace, head to the opposite side, and jump on the railings on the left side and you will find this item on the hanging statue.

title: Winged Serpent Helm, Ash of War: Flame Spear
text: Pick up the Ember of Messmer x5 and Shadow Realm Rune [5] on the floor below the beast.
Shadow Realm Rune [5]: At the edge of the floor in the sixth floor, in an area guarded by Shadows near the lever.
Pull the lever to shift the central mechanism, then climb it outside. Go up the stairs and pick up Ember of Messmer x3 from the eighth floor.
Kill Fire Knight Kood on the bridge to obtain the Winged Serpent Helm and Ash of War: Flame Spear.

Winged Serpent Helm: Sixth Floor: Climb the statues once you've used the lever to move them. Head outside, turn right and head up the stairs, turn left to find a Fire Knight at the end of the bridge. Drops this item and Ash of War: Flame Spear .

Ash of War: Flame Spear: Sixth Floor: Climb the statues once you've used the lever to move them. Head outside, turn right and head up the stairs, turn left to find a Fire Knight at the end of the bridge. Drops this item and Winged Serpent Helm .

guide.title: HEADING DEEPER INTO THE SHADOW KEEP
text: Go back to the Storehouse, Seventh Floor Site of Grace, then go down to the sixth floor. Go to the lever room on the east, then jump on to the beam in the middle. Make your way up the specimens, climbing onto the one with the horn. Cross it, then jump to a balcony across the horn on the west side. You will be in a room full of creatures and Shadow Undead.

Head out the room by going through the archway west of the room, then follow the path going north. Head up the stairs, and you'll find a room on the right, and a Fire Knight on the left guarding a door. Head inside the room first. In the room, you will encounter three Shadow Undead here, along with a corpse that you can loot for x3 Ember of Messmer. After clearing the room, head out then defeat the Fire Knight across the bridge. This Fire Knight is different than the rest of the Fire Knights you have found throughout exploring the Shadow Keep, as its attacks are more aggressive compared to the normal Fire Knights. Defeating this Fire Knight will give you the Winged Serpent Helm and Ash of War: Flame Spear.

Open the door across the bridge, then pick up the Scadutree Fragment directly in front of you. Head up the stairs, then activate the Dark Chamber Entrance Site of Grace [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Elden Ring Map]]] at the top. Be prepared for a boss fight, as opening the door next to the Site of Grace will lead you to the boss of the Shadow Keep.

title: Boss: Kood, Captain of the Fire Knights
text: Kood, Captain of the Fire Knights: Sixth Floor: Climb the statues once you've used the lever to move them. Head outside, turn right, and head up the stairs then turn left to find Kood, Captain of the Fire Knights, at the bridge's end. Drops the Winged Serpent Helm and Ash of War: Flame Spear.

guide.title: OBTAINING THE IMPENETRABLE THORNS
text: After activating the Dark Chamber Entrance Site of Grace, you'll want to retrace your steps as to obtain the Impenetrable Thorns sorcery. Return to the bridge where you fought Kood, Captain of the Fire Knights, then cross it to the other side. Head down the first set of staircases, where you will encounter two Shadow Undead patrolling as you explore the area. You will then find a Shadow Undead overlooking the ledge. Defeat the Shadow Undead, then look down the ledge to see a platform wherein you can safely drop. After you drop to the platform, defeat the Giant Bat that you will encounter immediately after dropping. You will then see a dead body sitting against the wall nearby which you can then loot for the Impenetrable Thorns sorcery. You can then return to the Dark Chamber Entrance Site of Grace to progress through the Shadow Keep.

title: Impenetrable Thorns, Scadutree Fragment
text: Grab the Scadutree Fragment behind the door, then activate the Dark Chamber Entrance grace for later.
Head back outside to the bridge, then walk off the ledge down the stairs to reach a platform with Impenetrable Thorns.

Impenetrable Thorns: In Shadow Keep from the Storehouse, Seventh Floor site of grace, cross the center of the storeroom after pulling the lever to rotate the center beams. Once outside, carefully walk off the ledge (you'll see a bat below). You'll find the spell on a corpse
Scadutree Fragment: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted by the roots in front of the chalice.

title: Letter for Freyja
text: Tell Ansbach about Freyja's decision first. Then give him the Secret Rite Scroll and exhaust his dialogue.
Reload the area and talk to Ansbach to receive the Letter for Freyja.
Letter for Freyja: Given by Sir Ansbach after handing over the Secret Rite Scroll.
miss: The letter is unobtainable if you give Ansbach the Secret Rite Scroll, exhaust his dialogue, and reload the area without telling him about Freyja's decision. If Ansbach has left without giving the letter, your only option to get it is to trigger Leda's invasion and help her kill Ansbach. The letter can then be found at his spot.

guide.title: ANSBACH AND FREYJA
text: After arriving at the first floor, backtrack your way to Ansbach. Talk to him, then hand over the Secret Rite Scroll you found earlier to him. Keep talking to him until you get the prompt to tell him about Freyja's decision. Click on it, then Ansbach will give you the Letter for Freyja after talking to him. Go to the seventh floor, then give the Letter for Freyja to Redmane Freyja. She will then give you the Golden Lion Shield after talking to her one more time.

title: Golden Lion Shield
text: Give the letter to Freyja, then talk to her to receive the Golden Lion Shield.
Golden Lion Shield: Given by Redmane Freyja after you hand her over the Letter for Freyja.
miss: This item is unobtainable without the Letter for Freyja. If Ansbach has left the Shadow Keep without giving the letter, your only option to get it is to trigger Leda's invasion and help her kill Ansbach. The letter can then be found at his spot.

guide.title: Shadow Keep (Main)
text: Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Shadow Keep - A Legacy Dungeon
Return to Main Gate Plaza - Site of Grace
Head back out through the southeast doorway and go inside the main building in the northern direction
Use Storehouse, First Floor - Site of Grace
Find your way to West Rampart - Site of Grace then return to the first floor of Storehouse (you will use this later after defeating the main boss of Shadow Keep)
Speak with Sir Ansbach
Obtain Secret Rite Scroll
Use Storehouse, Seventh Floor - Site of Grace
Speak with Redmane Freyja

Progress both NPC questlines by giving the scroll to Sir Ansbach, informing him about Redmane Freyja and give the Letter to Freyja to Redmane. (Use teleporter and exhaust both of their dialogues to receive the Golden Lion Shield from Freyja)
Use the switch found on the 6th floor to switch the ceiling statues
Return to the first floor and jump between the newly moved statues to reach an upper area

Use the Dark Chamber Entrance - Site of Grace NOTE: Before going inside, make sure you have progressed Needle Knight Leda and Hornsent questline. Hornsent's quest can get bricked if you trigger Messmer's cutscene by going inside his room. In our playthrough, we progressed this after entering through the Main Gate for the first time. See #15 of the Game Progress or Shadow Keep Underground (Main Gate and Recluse River).
Fight Messmer the Impaler (It's important to summon Hornsent during the fight for his questline)
Return to Hornsent Grandam in Belurat Tower Settlement (You will receive one final item from her)
Teleport to West Rampart - Site of Grace
Cross the bridge to reach the Ancient Ruins of Rauh
## MAIN PLAZA CONTINUATION

After arriving in the Main Gate Plaza, use the shortcut you just opened then go up the ramp, in which you'll be surrounded by four Shadow Militiamen. After arriving at the top of the ramp, you can head up the stairs. You can pick up x8 Bone Dart from a corpse by the stairs. A Fire Knight will be waiting across the bridge. As you are walking to the Fire Knight, pick up the x8 Smithing Stone [2] from the dead body. The Fire Knight uses slow wide swings when attacking, so you can attack or even stagger it after dodging one attack.

After defeating the Fire Knight, you can go through the big archway it was previously patrolling, which leads to a lift. Use the lift to go up, and you will end up in the Storehouse, First Floor Site of Grace [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Elden Ring Map]]].

title: Talk to Redmane Freyja
text: Redmane Freyja: By the Seventh Floor site of Grace.

title: Pearldrake Talisman +3
text: Note: If you want to exclude her from the fight in Enir-Ilim, you must kill her before reloading the area.
Talk to Ansbach and pass on Freyja's message.
Make your way up to the wooden walkway on the third floor and loot the Pearldrake Talisman +3 from the crucified specimen.

Pearldrake Talisman +3: After using the lever to move the statues in Specimen Storeroom, head to the second floor where the Fire Knight is gazing at the center of the room in the wooden structure. Head to his right and reach the rail to find the statue's head with this item.

guide.title: OBTAINING THE PEARLDRAKE TALISMAN
text: After the specimens have moved, make your way back to the area with the Fire Knight on the third floor (See note here). On the western side of the railing, you can find the Pearldrake Talisman +3 on a specimen that has moved up.

title: Ansbach's Longbow
text: If you helped Leda kill Hornsent, you'll find two summon signs in Ansbach's room:
Assist Ansbach:
Note: Skips this part of Leda's questline.
Use the gold summon sign and help Ansbach defeat Leda for Ansbach's Longbow and Leda's Rune.
miss: The summon signs disappear once you encounter Leda in the Cleansing Chamber in Enir-Ilim. Ansbach's Longbow becomes unobtainable if you help Hornsent defeat Leda. Leda's Rune becomes unobtainable if you assist Leda against both Hornsent and Ansbach. Both must be obtained before you encounter Leda in Enir-Ilim.

title: Ansbach's Set
text: Assist Needle Knight Leda:
Note: Ends Ansbach's questline and excludes him as a potential summon for Leda and her allies and Promised Consort Radahn.
Use the red summon sign and kill Ansbach for Ansbach's Set and Ansbach's Longbow.
miss: Ansbach's Longbow becomes unobtainable if you help Hornsent defeat Leda or fail to obtain it before you encounter Leda in Enir-Ilim.

title: Retaliatory Crossed-Tree
text: If you didn't receive the Letter for Freyja from Ansbach before he left, you can find it at his spot.
Talk to Leda to receive the Retaliatory Crossed-Tree.
miss: Becomes unobtainable if you help Hornsent defeat Leda or fail to assist Leda in killing Ansbach before you encounter her in Enir-Ilim.

title: Talk to Fire Knight Queelign
text: Travel to the Church District Entrance, then pick up Crab Eggs x2, Thin Beast Bones x4, and Strip of White Flesh x2 from the first rooftop.
Jump across the logs in the water to reach a stone platform with a Great Grave Glovewort.

Great Grave Glovewort: Shadow Keep . As you enter from the Church District Entrance site of grace. Jump from the platform to the flooded roofs. Take the left side, and jump towards the wooden shipwrecks. Until you reach the circular platform. Use the wooden platforms to reach the other side. Turn left and jump to grab the item at the end of the pathway.
Return to the rooftop, then use the dormers to jump to a building with a Fireproof Pickled Liver.

Fireproof Pickled Liver: Shadow Keep . As you enter from the Church District Entrance site of grace. Jump from the platform to the flooded roofs. From the roofs, jump to the platform directly in front of you, round it to the other side to find the item. Beware of the exploding enemies.
Pick up Ember of Messmer x3 and a Slumbering Egg from the next rooftop.
Slumbering Egg: Shadow Keep . On the roof where you fight the Fire Knight, on a corpse against a column.
Climb the nearest flying buttress, then drop through the hole in the roof and pick up Stormhawk Feather x3 from the intersecting ribs.
Drop down to the first floor and pick up the Lightningproof Pickled Liver next to a crab.
Lightningproof Pickled Liver: Shadow Keep . After you fall from the big hole, take down the next hole down, and find the item next to a crab.
Unlock the nearby door to find Queelign curled up on the floor:
Use Iris of Grace:
Use an Iris of Grace to obtain Fire Knight Queelign.
Fire Knight Queelign: Found inside the Prayer Room. Use Iris of Occultation on the NPC in the Prayer Room to receive Queelign's Greatsword.
miss: Becomes unobtainable if you use an Iris of Occultation.

guide.title: THE PRAYER ROOM: FIRE KNIGHT QUEELIGN
text: Next, face the east side of the compass and you should see a narrow ramp structure of one of the churches. Do a running jump to land on it safely, then walk to the top where you'll find two large openings or holes on the big roof. Slowly drop down onto the narrow structure that's on the right side, then you can walk down so you can safely run onto the other structure that is on the left so you can loot the body that holds x3 Stormhawk Feathers [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]]. Go back and then drop down onto the opening of a ceiling (see the third image above for reference).

Below, you should immediately see yet another corpse next to a small Crab. Loot the body to find x1 Lightningproof Pickled Liver. Go around, northeast, and you'll locate a locked door, this is the Prayer Room that requires the Prayer Room Key, a key that drops upon defeating the NPC Invader Fire Knight Queelign, encountered for the second time at the Church of the Crusade [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]]. If you have the key, you can unlock the door and find Fire Knight Queelign (NPC) in the flesh. Now, if you have an item called the Iris of Occultation, you can give it to the NPC, and after Queelign's dialogue, the NPC will drop a weapon you can loot. This weapon is Queelign's Greatsword. NOTE: If you give the Iris of Grace to Queelign, you'll receive the Spirit Ash "Fire Knight Queelign". The Iris of Occultation can be acquired in many ways, one way is by obtaining it as an item drop from defeating a Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit located in this area after you drain the flood.

title: Queelign's Greatsword
text: Use Iris of Occultation:
Use an Iris of Occultation to obtain Queelign's Greatsword.
Queelign's Greatsword: Use Iris of Occultation on the NPC in the Prayer Room to receive Queelign's Greatsword .
miss: Becomes unobtainable if you use an Iris of Grace.

title: Mantle of Thorns, Boss: Ulcerated Tree Spirit
text: Go down the other path and take the first left to find a Rune of an Unsung Hero.

Rune of an Unsung Hero: Shadow Keep . After you fall from the big hole in the roof, drop down again through the second broken floor. Continue forward and turn left on the first opening available to find this item.
Before taking the second left across a bridge, pick up the Ember of Messmer x2 in the curved corridor.
Head across the bridge, then grab the Hefty Beast Bone x3 in an alcove before a ladder.
Climb the ladder and push the lever to drain the water. Drop down next to the ladder afterward for a Somber Smithing Stone [9].
Head left out the doorway to find a Well-Pickled Turtle Neck in a corner.
Well-Pickled Turtle Neck: Shadow Keep . From the Sunken Chapel Site of Grace. Take the western exit and explore the empty area by the edge of the water to find the item on a corpse.
Enter the nearby ruins of a building and activate the Sunken Chapel grace.
Exit east to find a Ghost Glovewort [7], then continue along the outer wall to pick up Crab Eggs x2.
Kill the Ulcerated Tree Spirit that ambushes you near a large dead tree for Mantle of Thorns.
Mantle of Thorns: This item drops from the Lesser Ulcerated Spirit enemy that emerges beneath the ground, near the large tree.
Ulcerated Tree Spirit: A unique Ulcerated Tree Spirit will spawn here, can only be defeated once but does not have a boss health bar. Drops an Iris of Occulation

guide.title: EXPLORING THE SUNKEN CHAPEL
text: For some clarity, we recommend that you start by fast-traveling to the Church District Entrance checkpoint [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]] since you can now use the lift near the Site of Grace. From the checkpoint, go left, use the lever to call the lift, then step on the center to ride it down. You'll now be able to explore the open area of the Sunken Chapel. At the center, you will see a large tree, only approach the tree if you're prepared to fight because a Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit will emerge beneath the ground. Killing it will drop the Mantle of Thorns, and resting against the tree is a corpse holding x1 Somber Smithing Stone [5].

The second Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit is located around the east area of the sunken chapel (see the images above for reference). Defeating it will drop x1 Iris of Occultation which (if you don't have it yet) you can give to Fire Knight Queelign (see here) in the Prayer Room to obtain Queelign's Greatsword. Also in the east area, you can find open buildings. One building houses two bodies that you can loot to find x4 Smithing Stone [4] and x6 Kukri [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]].

There is also building another where you'll find a pack of Crabs and Giant Crab enemies, one roaming around, and the other next to another body that you can loot to find x1 Shadow Realm Rune [5]. [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]]. If you continue to go around this area, you'll reach the west side where you'll find the Sunken Chapel Site of Grace [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]]

Head north towards the entrance of the main church then immediately turn left to find a corpse by a corner. Loot the body to find x3 Shadow Sunflower. Clear out the enemies then approach the small room that has Marika's statue (the same statue where you got the Scadutree Fragment and the Fire Knight's Seal weapon. Make a right and you'll enter a large room. Straight ahead, you'll see some stairs on both ends, walk up to the upper platform and investigate the railings to discover a body hanging on top of it.

Loot the body to obtain the Battlefield Priest's Cookbook [1], [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]]. Walk back down the stairs and check under the upper platform to find a door. Open that door and you'll find another lift that takes you underground. Ride it to find and activate the Tree-Worship Passage Site of Grace See Shadow of the Erdtree Map.

title: Iris of Occultation, Boss: Ulcerated Tree Spirit
text: Pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [7] next to the tree.
Go up the stairs east of the tree and optionally activate the shortcut lift back to the entrance.
In the building next to the lift is a Shadow Realm Rune [5].

Shadow Realm Rune [5]: Shadow Keep . Once you have lowered the water level, take the lift to the left passing the Church District Entrance site of Grace. Head to the entrance of the right building and fight the giant crabs, you wil find the item on a body.
Kill the Ulcerated Tree Spirit that ambushes you northwest of the building for an Iris of Occultation.
Iris of Occultation: This item drops from a second Lesser Ulcerated Spirit enemy that can be found around this section of the sunken chapel.
Ulcerated Tree Spirit: A unique Ulcerated Tree Spirit will spawn here, can only be defeated once but does not have a boss health bar. Drops the Mantle of Thorns sorcery

guide.title: SHADOW KEEP EXPLORATION
text: Head out of the room, then head to the northeastern section of the seventh floor. Defeat the Fire Knight in this section, then head southeast to find a specimen that you can jump on to by the railing. You can find x1 Revered Spirit Ash on the back of the specimen.

Afterwards, head to the eastern room on the sixth floor. You will encounter numerous Shadow Undead in this area, along with a corpse that you can loot for x1 Shadow Realm Rune [5]. On the southern wall, you can find a lever on a platform. Pull the lever, and the mechanism in the middle will move up, also moving up the specimens hanging on it.

title: Death Mask Helm
text: Grab the Rada Fruit x4, Crab Eggs x2 (behind the wall), and String x6 around the street.
Rada Fruit: Crafting material looted from a corpse by one of the burning boats. Beware of a shadow militamen ambush
Pick up Kukri x6 and Smithing Stone [8] x5 from the last building.
Enter the church near the dead tree and kill Fire Knight Wego for the Death Mask Helm.
Death Mask Helm: Head Armor dropped by unique enemy Wego, Fire Knight Elder. Found inside the chapel after draining the water in Church District

guide.title: Shadow Keep (Church District and Scadutree Base)
text: Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Part 1 of Shadow Keep - Church District and Scadutree Base. This section covers the Church District including draining the water in the Shadow Keep and defeating the Scadutree Avatar.
Teleport to Church District Highroad - Site of Grace
Look for the Forager Brood just outside the entrance of the Church District - Shadow Keep
IMPORTANT: Talk to all NPCs and travel to their respective Site of Graces before you enter the Church District
Enter Shadow Keep through the Church District Entrance
Use the Prayer Room Key (from Church of the Crusade) to speak with Fire Knight Queelign: Give him Iris of Grace or Iris of Occultation.
Drain the water using the lever
Reach Sunken Chapel
Fight the lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit to activate the elevator and unlock the shortcut back to Church District Entrance - Site of Grace
Reach Tree Worship Passage - Site of Grace and then, reach Tree Worship Sanctum - Site of Grace
Defeat Scadutree Avatar
Activate Scadutree Base - Site of Grace after defeating Scadutree Avatar
Teleport back to Sunken Chapel Grace
Take the big, round elevator to Specimen Storehouse
Make your way to the Storehouse, Loft - Site of Grace
Reach Shadow Keep, Back Gate - Site of Grace (you will use this later to progress a questline and to explore Scaduview (Hinterlands).

IMPORTANT: To avoid breaking NPC questlines, make sure to follow this walkthrough and avoid entering the room of this legacy dungeon's main boss. Accidentally entering its room will lead to the cancellation of the Hornsent-Leda questline. Before entering Shadow Keep, make sure to speak with all NPCs, after you get the notification that a great rune has been broken. You will get additional dialogues from affected NPCs, and talking with them will progress their questlines.

From the Church District Highroad - Site of Grace, travel towards the entrance and look for the pest found west of the nearest Site of Grace on top of the tunnel road. Head to the cliff edge and seek the pest near the outer wall of the keep. Interact with it to receive the Forager Brood Cookbook [6]. The main entrance of the Church District of the Shadow Keep is located on the east side of the Shadow Keep. The direct path to finding it is to travel from the Church District High Road Site of Grace [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]]. You'll know you'll arrive when you enter a large doorway and pass through a long hallway. At the end of the hallway is where you'll formally arrive at the church district and discover the Church District Entrance checkpoint [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]].

The Church District is a flooded area, and the goal is to traverse the area by using high ground and finding a mechanism that drains the water. Please take note that falling into the water will result in death. Ignore the path on the left since you won't be able to use the lift until you drain the flood. Instead, jump across (using a running jump) to land on the roof of a building, then check the right side to find a small Crab and a body next to it that can be looted to acquire x2 Crab Eggs. Continue walking around the roof to find another body that's being eaten by a Crab. Loot the body to obtain x4 Thin Beast Bones. Continue south and you'll find another body being eaten by a Crab, check the body to find x2 Strip of White Flesh.

Next, jump on the floating log to reach a large broken-up circular platform. The path here is fairly straightforward, try to reach the opposite end by using the floating logs and wooden platforms, and make sure to loot the body on the circular platform to find x1 Great Grave Glovewort. Retrace your steps to the rooftop of the building where you looted bodies and killed the small Crabs, and this time, head west where you can jump across to progress (see the second image above for reference).

Once you're across, walk around the sides to reach the platform and loot the body that is guarded by Ignited Putrid Corpse enemies to obtain x1 Fireproof Pickled Liver. Jump back onto the sides of this building so you can walk to the top and proceed west where you'll have to do a running jump to safely land on top of another roof of a building. On the roof of the building, you should encounter a Fire Knight enemy walking around. Kill it and then loot the body that's near the spot where the Fire Knight enemy was walking to obtain x3 Ember of Messmer. Keep going straight until you reach a wall, then turn around to find a body sitting against one of the roof's structures. Loot it to acquire x1 Slumbering Egg [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]].

title: Fire Knight's Seal, Scadutree Fragment
text: In an alcove near the entrance is a corpse with Shadow Sunflower x3.
Ride the lift in the opposite alcove, then take the first right to another lift. Take it up to find a Somber Smithing Stone [9] on the right.
Continue just ahead to grab the Storehouse, Back Section grace for later.
Return down the lift, then jump onto the headless statue in the middle for a Scadutree Fragment.
Drop down and pick up the Fire Knight's Seal behind the statue.
Fire Knight's Seal: Shadow Keep . In the area with the giant Queen Marika statue, it is behind the statue. You have to use the lever to lower the water level.
Scadutree Fragment: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted by the roots in front of the chalice.

title: Battlefield Priest's Cookbook [1]
text: Head down the northeast corridor, then grab the Battlefield Priest's Cookbook [1] up the stairs.

Battlefield Priest's Cookbook [1]: Shadow Keep . Facing the Queen Marika's statue from the front, take the right room and continue towards the stairs, to reach the upper level in which this cookbook can be found.

title: Boss: Scadutree Avatar
text: Open the door below and take the lift down to the Tree-Worship Passage grace.
Head through the passage to find an Iris of Grace in front of a headless Marika statue.

Iris of Grace: Can be found at the base of the headless statue of Marika in the building west of the Sunken Chapel. Drain the water in the church district, follow the path of the Tree-Worship Passage to find the statue there.
Go down the stairs to grab the Tree-Worship Sanctum grace and a Marika's Rune.
Marika's Rune: Consumable looted from a corpse by the nearby Grace before the boss fight.
Kill the Scadutree Avatar for Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower, Miquella's Great Rune, and 260,000 runes.
Scadutree Avatar: Legend Type Boss Drops Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower , and Miquella's Great Rune . Grants 260,000 Runes upon defeat.
Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower: Dropped by the Scadutree Avatar boss.
Miquella's Great Rune: Drops from Scadutree Avatar

guide.title: SCADUTREE AVATAR
text: After activating the Tree-Worship Passage Site of Grace, follow the path going down, then cross the bridge. Enter the structure through the archway, and you'll find the Iris of Grace (you can give this to Fire Knight Queelign, see here) if you still haven't obtained it. Go down the stairs on either side, and you can activate the Tree-Worship Sanctum Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. South of the Site of Grace, you can find x1 Marika's Rune on a corpse sitting against the wall.

North of the Tree-Worship Sanctum Site of Grace, you can go through the boss fog to fight the Scadutree Avatar at the Scadutree Base. The Scadutree Avatar uses its tree trunk-like arms to attack. It has different attacks, such as uprooting thorns over an area. There is a dedicated page here containing information on how to defeat the Scadutree Avatar.

After defeating the Scadutree Avatar, you will receive the Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower along with Miquella's Great Rune. From here, (if you followed the tip earlier by activating the Storehouse, Back Section checkpoint in the Specimen Storehouse) you can fast travel to the Storehouse, Back Section Site of Grace to start exploring the Back Section of the Specimen Storehouse.

Upon entering, look to the right immediately to see a noble corpse against the wall. Loot it to obtain x1 Somber Smithing Stone [9]. Proceed to the left side, through the doorway, where you'll find the Storehouse, Back Section checkpoint. Continue moving straight until you walk past a ladder. Do not climb the ladder first, instead, keep going straight to find some items. First, look to your left to see, another noble corpse sitting against a desk, loot it to obtain x3 Glintslab Firefly. Then at the end, you'll see a Fire Knight and three Shadow Undead standing next to another corpse, kill the enemies then loot the body to acquire x1 Carian Thrusting Shield.

Go back and climb the ladder to the top where you'll encounter another Fire Knight and two Shadow Undead reading a book. You can sneak behind the enemies to backstab them. Continue to the right side and walk carefully up the stairs to avoid aggravating the Fire Knight, roaming the floor above. At the top of the stairs, turn to the corner on the right to find a corpse to loot x3 Fire Coil. Kill the enemies on this floor, then continue moving straight. You'll discover another noble corpse sitting against a small table, loot it to obtain x4 Rada Fruit, and go straight towards the balcony to find another noble corpse that holds the Fire Serpent incantation. Go back, and look behind the bookcase to find an opening on the wall.

Through the opening, turn right and you'll find another noble corpse sitting by the edge of the narrow scaffolding. Loot the body to acquire x6 Shadow Sunflower. Continue going up, and by the ramp, you should find another noble corpse that you can loot to obtain x1 Blessed Bone Shard. Continue going up and you'll arrive at the loft section of the storehouse. Activate the Storehouse, Loft Site of Grace before you proceed to explore.

title: Carian Thrusting Shield
text: Activate the Scadutree Base grace in the middle of the arena.
Travel to the Storehouse, Back Section grace and grab the Glintslab Firefly x3 and Carian Thrusting Shield past a ladder.

Carian Thrusting Shield: Shadow Keep - accessed from the Church District Side. Past the Storehouse site of grace, continue forward you will reach a room where you find a Fire Knight and a few other enemies. The item is right past the Fire Knight and can be found on a corpse under the table.

title: Fire Serpent
text: Climb the ladder, then turn right at the top of the stairs to find a corpse with Fire Coil x3.
Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [7] near the edge and the Fire Serpent at the end.

Fire Serpent: Shadow Keep - accessed from the Church District Side. From the Storehouse site of grace, find the ladder and climb it up, pass the enemies, and move forward until you reach the balcony. You will find the item there.

title: Wrath from Afar
text: Head through the hole in the wall and pick up the Shadow Sunflower x6 and Blessed Bone Shard on the wooden platforms.
Blessed Bone Shard: Crafting Material looted from a corpse propped against the cliff wall. Beware of spawning skeletons nearby
Continue to the top and activate the Storehouse, Loft grace.
Take the lift up and make your way to a corpse with Thin Beast Bones x7 just past a ladder.
Climb the nearby ladder, then pick up the Smithing Stone [8] x4 beside a wooden pillar.
Continue along the beams, then drop down onto a wooden gear to pick up Wrath from Afar.

Wrath from Afar: Shadow Keep - accessed from the Church District Side. Take the elevator at the Storehouse, Loft site of grace. Once you are on the upper level, turn left, and turn left again. As soon as you can turn right. Beware of the bat hanging from the ceiling. Reach the other side, and take the ladder up. Turn left and move towards the area in which there is a giant gear (the one that does not have a bat on it), once you are aligned fall down to find the spell behind the column.

guide.title: STOREHOUSE, LOFT
text: Once you have activated the Storehouse, Loft Site of Grace, proceed to the lift north of the Site of Grace to go up. You will end up on beams above the Specimen Storehouse. This level will be filled with Giant Bats roaming the area. The only path you can follow will be the one going west, so keep following it. There will be a lot of ways you can walk on the beams, but the only way you can progress through this area is through the ladder. Pick up x7 Thin Beast Bones from a body at the edge of a beam, then go up the ladder that you walk past through just before picking up the loot.

After climbing the ladder, you will arrive in a new level. If you go to the southeast section of the level, you can find x4 Smithing Stone [7] from a dead body. Following the path from the south side will lead you to a pillar blocking your way. If you look down, you can find a platform that you can jump off of, and it will contain the Wrath from Afar incantation. Next, jump on the beam to the north, then climb up the nearby ladder to the west of where you landed. You will end up on the beam that a pillar was blocking earlier. You can aggro the bats here, so be careful when attacking as you might fall off of the beams.
You can find a lift in the middle of the beam going west with an item above it, along with a Fire Knight on a nearby beam which will be hostile if you approach the lift.

If you use the lift to go down, you will end up in an area with a Fire Knight facing the other way around. You can easily dispose of the Fire Knight by backstabbing it and staggering it continuously. After dealing with the Fire Knight, you can pick up x1 Rune of an Unsung Hero on the southwestern corner of the area. The area will be clear, and you can head back up the beams using the lift. If you want to get the item above, you can ride the lift, then exit it before going down. A second lift will arrive just beside it, then do it again. Jump on the roof of the first lift just as it is arriving, and you will be able to reach the item, which is a Fire Knight Hilde summon.

If you walk across the beam going west, you can climb down a ladder. On your left, just around the corner, you can loot a body for x4 Rada Fruit. Directly northeast of the ladder you descended on, you will find another ladder you can use to descend. You will reach an area similar to the Site of Grace.

If you head outside the archway on the northwestern side of the area, you will find a lift directly on your right. Take the lift going down, then keep following the scaffolding until you reach an area with a door and a lift. You cannot open the door yet, so use the lift nearby to go down. The lift will then lead you to the Shadow Keep, Back Gate Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map.

This area leads you into two areas. There is a room on the east, just beside the Site of Grace. In this room, you can pick up x1 Scadutree Fragment. After that, you will see an archway heading outside on the north-northeast side of the room. This is a boss area in which you will be fighting Commander Gaius. For a more detailed guide on how to defeat Commander Gaius, you may go to this page.

Defeating Commander Gaius will give you the Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider. It will also give access to Scaduview region. We don't recommend fighting him right away, instead, make your way to the Cerulean Coast (Southern Shore) to minimize backtracking. This covers the Church District part of your Shadow Keep exploration.
See the next tab for the Cerulean Coast (Southern Shore) Walkthrough.to return to the tab selection.

title: Fire Knight Hilde
text: Jump to the other side and climb the ladder to a lift. Take it down to an area with a Rune of an Unsung Hero.

Rune of an Unsung Hero: Shadow Keep - accessed from the Church District Side. From the gear in which you found Wrath from Afar, jump towards the next platform and head to the ladder on the left. Climb it up. Once at the top, take the wooden beam on your left and turn right towards the lift. Take the lift down, kill the fire knight, and on the right of the Fire Knight's original location you will find the item.
Take the lift back up, then send it down without riding it. Send the second lift down to raise the first and drop onto it as it ascends to reach a corpse with Fire Knight Hilde.

Fire Knight Hilde: Shadow Keep - accessed from the Church District Side. From the gear in which you found Wrath from Afar, jump towards the next platform and head to the ladder on the left. Climb it up. Once at the top, take the wooden beam on your left and turn right towards the lift. Activate the lift but quickly return to the platform. Another lift will appear do the same, and jump on the first lift Roof. Stay there until it stops. Jump across the platform to reach the corpse on the other side and loot the Spirit Ash.

title: Talk to Sir Ansbach
text: Sir Ansbach: Enter the room directly to the north of the Storehouse, First Floor Site of Grace, the one with a fish-like creature skeleton on a table.

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [8] from the corpse down the next ladder.

Somber Smithing Stone [8]: Can be found on a corpse sitting on the edge of the platform down by the water. To access this area, use the ladder on the eastern side of the bridge with the burning boats.
Descend the last ladder and take the two lifts outside down to the Shadow Keep, Back Gate grace.
Pick up the Scadutree Fragment next to a headless statue near the grace.
Scadutree Fragment: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted by the roots in front of the chalice.

title: Boss: Commander Gaius
text: Kill Commander Gaius for Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider and 230,000 runes.
Commander Gaius: Legend Type Boss Drops Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider , and grants 230,000 Runes upon defeat.
Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider: Dropped by Commander Gaius .

title: Gaius's Greaves
text: Activate the Scaduview grace after the fight.
Head past the rampart and kill the Albinauric Archer near a shack for Gaius's Greaves and an Albinauric Bloodclot (first time).
Gaius's Greaves: Wolf Rider Enemy. Drops Gaius's Greaves . The rider grants +6381 Runes and the wolf +5490.

title: Sharpshot Talisman
text: Pick up the Sharpshot Talisman from a corpse in the shack.
Sharpshot Talisman: Found inside Albinauric's Shack

place.title: Albinauric's Shack
walk: To get to the Albinauric's Shack, you must first defeat Commander Gaius to gain access to the area behind the Shadow Keep. You can get to Commander Gaius by first going to the Church District section of the Shadow Keep. Progress through the Shadow Keep from that side to get to the Storehouse, Back Section, and then eventually the Storehouse, Loft section, where you need to traverse through the beams above the Specimen Storehouse. Progressing through the Storehouse, Loft section will lead you to the lift going to the Shadow Keep, Back Gate Site of Grace [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Elden Ring Map]]]. Once you are at the Shadow Keep, Back Gate, you can walk through the archway going outside to fight Commander Gaius. You can view this page to read a comprehensive guide on how to defeat Commander Gaius. After defeating Commander Gaius, the Scaduview Site of Grace [See Elden Ring Map] will be unlocked, and you are free to explore the area behind the Shadow Keep.

From the Scaduview Site of Grace, head through the archway on the north. Keep following the path north until you see a broken-down house on the west of the path. Approach it, and you will be at the Albinauric's Shack.
An Albinauric Wolfback Archer will be stationed in the Albinauric Shack. Once you have defeated the Albinauric Wolfback Archer, you can loot it to receive Gaius's Greaves.
Head inside the shack to obtain the only item there, a Sharpshot Talisman.

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Continue uphill to find 5x Scadutree Fragments in front of the Scadutree Chalice.
Scadutree Fragment: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted by the roots in front of the chalice.

place.title: Scadutree Chalice
walk: To gain access to this area, you must first defeat Commander Gaius who is located near the Shadow Gate, Back Gate Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. To get there, you must first explore the Shadow Keep Church District by entering from the east side. Afterwards, you can get access to the Back Section from the Church District side, which will then lead you to the Storehouse, Loft Site of Grace [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Elden Ring Map]]]. From the loft section, you can find your way to the Shadow Keep, Back Gate Site of Grace [See Elden Ring Map] by walking through the beams above the Specimen Storehouse. You'll find a room heading outside to a lift area and a locked door. Take the lift, and you will arrive at the Back Gate section once you get to the bottom of the lift. If you go through the archway going outside, you will be able to fight Commander Gaius. For a more detailed guide on how to defeat Commander Gaius, you can go to this page.

After defeating Commander Gaius, you will gain access to the area behind the Shadow Keep. Head straight through the archway north of Scaduview Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. Follow the path going north, and you will see a big wall structure with an archway in the middle. Go through the archway in the middle, and you will be in Scadutree Chalice.

In Scadutree Chalice, there will be several items on the ground that you can pick up. There are x5 Scadutree Fragments and x6 Blessed Bone Shards by the giant chalice. The Blessed Bone Shards can be found inside of the skeletons surrounding the chalice.

title: Boss: Messmer the Impaler
text: Travel to the Dark Chamber Entrance grace and kill Messmer the Impaler for Remembrance of the Impaler, Messmer's Kindling, and 400,000 runes.
Messmer the Impaler: Demigod Grants 400,000 Runes upon defeat. Drops Messmer's Kindling and Remembrance of the Impaler
Remembrance of the Impaler: Dropped by Messmer the Impaler . Can be traded to Enia at the Roundtable Hold for: Spear of the Impaler or Messmer's Orb .

guide.title: THE DARK CHAMBER
text: IMPORTANT: Starting Messmer the Impaler's boss fight for the first time will make the summon signs for aiding/invading Hornsent disappear (through the shortcut door, at the top of the ramp from the Main Gate Plaza grace) so make sure to complete that if you desire to complete Hornsent/Needle Knight Leda's questline. If you choose to invade Hornsent and help Needle Knight Leda, you should also go back to Sir Ansbach's location near the Storehouse, First Floor grace and choose to aid/invade him as well (The Sir Ansbach fight will not be available if you aid Hornsent). Read up on their questlines on their respective pages for more information.

Near the Dark Chamber Entrance Site of Grace will be a door. Opening it will lead you to the boss, who is then revealed to be Messmer the Impaler. If you choose to aid Hornsent his summon sign will be inside the boss room. Messmer the Impaler uses a spear as a weapon, so be mindful of the range of his attacks. His spear and attacks will be imbued with fire, so having fire resistance would be a good idea for this boss fight. For a more in-depth guide on how to defeat Messmer the Impaler, you can go to this page for more information.

After defeating Messmer the Impaler, you will receive Messmer's Kindling along with the Remembrance of the Impaler. Messmer's Kindling will be used to gain access to a legacy dungeon, Enir-Ilim See Elden Ring Map. If you summoned Hornsent during the fight, rest at Messmer's Dark Chamber grace ONLY ONCE (any more than once and he will disappear) and exhaust his dialogue to continue his questline.
See the next tab for the Ancient Ruins of Rauh Walkthrough.to return to the tab selection.

title: Boss: Base Serpent Messmer
text: Base Serpent Messmer: Base Serpent Messmer is the transformed version of Messmer the Impaler. Grants 400,000 Runes upon defeat. Drops Messmer's Kindling and Remembrance of the Impaler
Messmer's Kindling: Key Item Dropped by Messmer the Impaler

title: Message from Leda
text: Optional: Hornsent can be summoned if you've spoken to him at least once. Successfully killing Messmer with him will cause him to invade you in Rauh Ruins, excluding him from the fight in Enir-Ilim.
Optional: Jolan can be summoned instead if you've received the second ruins map from Ymir and talked to her.
Activate the Messmer's Dark Chamber grace and rest at it.
Exhaust Hornsent's dialogue in the chamber or at the Highroad Cross.
Pick up the Message from Leda at the Highroad Cross or near any of the other crosses.
Message from Leda: Key item found by the Rauh Ancient Ruins, East
Talk to Hornsent Grandam to receive a Gourmet Scorpion Stew.
Gourmet Scorpion Stew: An upgraded version of the Scorpion Stew can be obtained from Hornsent Grandam if you talk to her after defeating Messmer the Impaler
Exhaust Hornsent Grandam's dialogue, then reload the area to find a Gourmet Scorpion Stew in front of her.
miss: This item becomes unobtainable if you kill Messmer before finishing her first set of dialogue with the Divine Beast Head, causing her to become unresponsive. This item becomes unobtainable if you kill Messmer before finishing her first set of dialogue with the Divine Beast Head, causing her to become unresponsive.

title: Boss: Tree Sentinel
text: Use the O Mother gesture in front of the statue near the Shadow Keep, Back Gate grace to reveal a path to the Hinterland grace.
Kill the first Tree Sentinel past the grace for a Blessing of Marika, then kill the second for another blessing and 120,000 runes.
Tree Sentinel: The Tree Sentinel can be found near the Hinterland Bridge
Blessing of Marika: Dropped by the Tree Sentinel .

title: Minor Erdtree, Boss: Tree Sentinel
text: Optional: Jolan can be summoned if you've received the second ruins map from Ymir and talked to her.
Head up the slope near the first Tree Sentinel toward Shaman Village to find Minor Erdtree amidst some glowing flowers.
Minor Erdtree: Located at the Shaman Village in the Scaduview region. The spell can be found in the field of flowers.
Tree Sentinel: The Tree Sentinel can be found near the Shaman Village .

guide.title: Hinterlands
text: Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree - Hinterlands (continuing the quest of Count Ymir and Jolan)
Reveal the entrance to Hinterlands through the Statue of Marika in Shadow Keep, Back Gate (This is part of the Finger Ruins Questline that includes Count Ymir and Jolan)
Defeat Tree Sentinel
Explore Shaman Village
Cross the bridge and use Hinterland Bridge - Site of Grace

NOTE: You can only enter this area after you have obtained the O Mother (Gesture) near Bonny Village in Scadu Altus. This exploration picks up from the Shadow Keep (Church District exploration) and will continue from the Shadow Keep, Back Gate - Site of Grace. Teleport there and follow this guide to help you explore Scaduview and reach the Hinterlands while progressing the quests related to Finger Ruins, Count Ymir, and Jolan.

guide.title: How to Access Hinterlands
text: Fast travel to the Shadow Keep, Back Gate Site of Grace, facing the entrance of the structure, go left and you will find a Summoning Pool that you can activate and a room you can go into. Head into the room, on the left is a message that reads "Have mercy, For the spirited-away shamans." and straight ahead you can pick up the Scadutree Fragment at the altar. At the altar, you will need to perform the O Mother Gesture in front of the altar to trigger it to move.

Go through the hidden tunnel and you will find yourself at the Hinterlands. You can activate the Site of Grace as soon as you exit the tunnel and go down the steps. To begin exploring, you will head to Shaman Village. From the Site of Grace, follow the main path on your right and as you turn here, near the ramp, you will encounter a Tree Sentinel. This is a field boss that you can run away from if you can get far enough. You can ride Torrent inside this location so take advantage of that if you don't want to defeat this boss. Head up the ramp to the east and keep going until the Shaman Village flashes on your screen.
Once you cross the bridge entering the village, head straight through the garden of flowers, and you'll find a Minor Erdtree plant in the middle of the garden, specifically illuminated by sunlight.

After looting the Minor Erdtree, head up the hill to the left where there are abandoned structures, and turn right towards the cliff overlooking an abandoned house below. By the edge of the cliff, you'll find Marika's Rune.

Afterward, continue up the hill to see more abandoned structures. On the right side of the area, you'll find a large tree with an open trunk. Inside this tree trunk, you can loot a corpse to obtain the Golden Braid.

When you're done here, head back down the ramp where you encountered the Tree Sentinel. This time, head northeast and turn right as you go down the ramp. There's another Tree Sentinel here that you can choose to fight or run away from. Continue ahead and go past the bridge. Use the Hinterlands Bridge - Site of Grace before proceeding.

title: Golden Braid
text: Pick up the Golden Braid from a dead tree at the top end of the village.

Golden Braid: The talisman can be looted from the ground, in front of a statue of Marika that is inside a tree trunk near the Shaman Village. The Shaman Village is located in Scaduview, which can be accessed by using the O Mother gesture in front of the statue of Marika located near the Back Gate Site of Grace of the Shadow Keep.

place.title: Shaman Village
notes: As of Patch 1.12, Marika's Rune, which was previously found in this location has been removed.

title: Spellmachinist's Bell Bearing
text: From the dead tree, head southeast and descend the lower cliff to drop onto Rabbath's Rise and find a puppet of Anna. Drop below the puppet to pick up the Spellmachinist's Bell Bearing.

Spellmachinist's Bell Bearing: Starting at Shaman Village head southeast and follow the path to the lower peak, from here carefully jump down the ledges until you overlook Rabbath's Rise . Carefully jump to the balcony below and enter the room, jump to the lower level and you will see a body containing the bell bearing

title: Boss: Fallingstar Beast
text: Return to the Hinterland and follow the path across a bridge to grab the Hinterland Bridge grace.
Drop down twice southeast of the grace to find Pearlescent Scale, Shadow Sunflower x3, and Fingerprint Nostrum x2 in the right-hand corner.
Pearlescent Scale: Crafting Material looted from a corpse guarded by several Fingercreepers
Head back to the road and activate the Fingerstone Hill grace on a ledge by the roadside.
Kill the Fallingstar Beast in the crater northeast of the grace for Gravitational Missile and 170,000 runes.
Gravitational Missile: Dropped by the Fallingstar Beast .
Fallingstar Beast: The Fallingstar Beast can be found in the crater in Fingerstone Hill.

title: The Two Fingers
text: Return to the grace and make your way down to the foggy area on the left. Near the cliff edge is a corpse with The Two Fingers gesture.
The Two Fingers: Found in the north side Dheo Finger Ruins by interacting with a corpse doing the gesture.

place.title: Remembrance Duplication Coffin
notes: There are exactly three coffins in the game, all exclusive to Shadow of the Erdtree — none exist in the base game.
That caps DLC remembrance duplication at three, so decide which bosses' rewards matter most before spending one.
The first sits in the lake just southwest of the Cathedral of Manus Metyr.
The second is in the southeast of the Finger Ruins of Rhia, down the cliff from the grace of the same name and up into the valley to the southeast.
The third is in the north of Scaduview, by the Finger Ruins of Dheo.

title: Fingercreeper Ashes
text: Optional: Just east of the corpse is a duplication coffin you can mark on your map.
Head south from the coffin to find a large hole in the ground with the Fingercreeper Ashes inside, guarded by a massive Fingercreeper.

Fingercreeper Ashes: Go east from Fingerstone hill Grace. You'll find a two fingers emote but continue onward until you find 2 leech-men as well as 2 hands buried in the ground. Soon after those hands there's an opening in the ground by the cliff guarded by many fingercreepers. Drop down and face against a GIANT hand, defeat it (fire works well) and grab the spirit ashes.

title: Cerulean Seed Talisman +1
text: Continue through the tunnel to find a Shadow Realm Rune [6] on a ledge.
Shadow Realm Rune [6]: Looted from a corpse by the exit of the cave where you found the Fingercreeper spirit ashes
Head to the finger ruins and sound the hanging bell to obtain the Cerulean Seed Talisman +1.
Cerulean Seed Talisman +1: Can be found at the center of the Finger Ruins of Dheo. You need to sound the hanging bell to acquire this talisman.

place.title: Finger Ruins of Dheo
walk: After completing the first few objectives of Talking to Count Ymir, and ringing the bell at the Finger Ruins of Rhia, you will need to head to the Finger Ruins of Dheo to ring the second bell.

Fast travel to the Shadow Keep, Back Gate Site of Grace, facing the entrance of the structure, go left and you will find a Summoning Pool that you can activate and a room you can go into. Head into the room, on the left is a message that reads "Have mercy, For the spirited-away shamans." and straight ahead you can pick up the Scadutree Fragment at the altar. At the altar, you will need to perform the O Mother Gesture in front of the altar to trigger it to move. Go through the hidden tunnel and you will find yourself at the Hinterlands.

On your way to the Finger Ruins of Dheo, you will have to fight through a crowd of Fingercreepers of various sizes, but the true threat lies in the Finger Ruins proper, which is populated primarily by Lampreys. These are unlike the Lampreys seen in the Finger Ruins of Rhia - the black Lampreys can fire pink homing projectiles that will stun you on contact, and these will trigger a pink Lamprey to teleport to your location for a free grab attack. The black Lamprey can fire another projectile during your recovery time, and they have a very long sight range, so use the area geometry as cover. Refrain from taking the direct route to the bell; circumvent the black Lampreys while fending off the pink ones.
Once you reach the end, you can interact with the bell and you will be granted the Cerulean Seed Talisman +1.
Return to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr and speak to Count Ymir and he will give you the Ruins Map (3rd) to ring the bell in the Finger Ruins of Miyr.
notes: There is a Remembrance Duplication Coffin found in the north of Scaduview, below the cliff the Fingerstone Hill site of grace sits atop. Head north-east after descending down the path from the site of grace. Elden Ring Map Link Remembrance Duplication Coffins offer players in Shadow of the Erdtree the same service as Walking Mausoleums did in the base game, allowing them to duplicate Remembrances.

title: Invader: Swordhand of Night Anna, Claws of Night
text: Optional: Travel to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr and exhaust Jolan's dialogue.
Talk to Ymir to receive Ruins Map (3rd), then ask him about the nature of the world.
Reload the area, then move Ymir's chair to discover a ladder to the third finger ruins, where you'll be invaded by Swordhand of Night Anna. Kill her to obtain the Claws of Night.
Swordhand of Night Anna: Invades you when approaching the ruins under the Cathedral of Manus Metyr, after advancing Ymir's questline. Drops Claws of Night
Claws of Night: Dropped by NPC invader Swordhand of Night Anna, found in the ruins underneath Cathedral of Manus Metyr. This area can only be accessed by progressing Ymir's questline.

guide.title: Finger Ruins of Miyr under the Cathedral
text: Once you head down, an NPC invader Swordhand of Night Anna will appear. Defeat her and you will be granted the Claws of Night. You will be able to find a few Finger Mimics scattered around the area, other than that, you can find the Finger-Weaver's Cookbook (2) on a body on the lower left walkway of the path. Nearing the bell, you can interact with the Summoning Pool to activate it and then interact with the hanging bell to teleport you to the Metyr, Mother of Fingers arena.

Once you Defeat Metyr, Mother of Fingers you will be granted 420,000 Runes, and the Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers. You can then fast-travel back to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr and head back to the throne and interact with it once more to encounter another NPC invader named Swordhand of Night Jolan. Defeat her and you will have to face Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers. This is when Count Ymir borrows the powers of Metyr to fight you. Defeat her and you will be granted the High Priest Set that comes with the High Priest Hat, High Priest Robe, High Priest Gloves, and High Priest Undergarments, as well as Ymir's Bell Bearing and the Maternal Staff.

Once you've successfully defeated both, rest at the Site of Grace and return to Jolan's initial spot to find her sitting on the ground against the pillar. As you approach Jolan, she will tell you she's losing her vision, and can't see the sky or the stars. You have 2 options for what item you want to give:
Iris of Grace: Giving this item will turn Jolan into Swordhand of Night Jolan.
Iris of Occultation: Giving this item will make Jolan pass quietly and they will drop the Sword of Night, thus ending her questline.

IMPORTANT: Giving her the Iris of Grace will continue her questline where you can combine the ash with another to make it more powerful. You may only give her either the Iris of Occultation or the Iris of Grace to obtain only one reward per playthrough.

To continue Jolan's questline, you need to return to Hinterlands, go to Shaman Village, and go to the very top of Rabbath's Rise. Look for a pathway at the back of the village, and travel down the cliffside, leading to a secret top part of Rabbath's Rise. Here you will find her puppet body, where you will be asked to combine the spirits together, claiming the Jolan and Anna Spirit Summon.
NOTE: If you don't have these required items yet, read below if you want to find out where you can get Iris of Occultation and Iris of Grace.
Iris of Occultation locations:
Acquired as an item drop from defeating a Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit located in this area after you drain the flood in the Church District. See Shadow of the Erdtree Map
Acquired as an item drop from a Lesser Omenkiller. Drop down the well in the main arena of Fort of Reprimand. The enemy will ambush you there among some items. See Shadow of the Erdtree Map
Iris of Grace locations:
Can be looted at the Specimen Storehouse of the Shadow Keep. See Shadow of the Erdtree Map

Can be found at the base of the headless statue of Marika in the building west of the Sunken Chapel. Drain the water in the church district, and follow the path of the Tree-Worship Passage to find the statue there. See Shadow of the Erdtree Map
See the next tab for the Jagged Peak Walkthrough.to return to the tab selection.

title: Finger-Weaver's Cookbook [2]
text: Optional: Return to Jolan and tell her you were attacked by a Swordhand of Night underground.
Head back underground and pick up the Finger-Weaver's Cookbook [2] from the lower left path.
Finger-Weaver's Cookbook [2]: Found on a corpse before the bell in Finger Ruins of Miyr. Only accessible after progressing Ymir's questline and finding the secret path under the Catherdal.

title: Boss: Metyr, Mother of Fingers +1
text: Sound the last hanging bell and kill Metyr, Mother of Fingers for Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers and 420,000 runes.

Metyr, Mother of Fingers: Boss found only by progressing Ymir's questline and finding the secret Finger Ruins of Myir under the Cathedral of Manus Metyr, and using the bell there. Drops 420,000 runes, and Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers
Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers: Dropped by Metyr, Mother of Fingers, found in the underground ruins accessed from Cathedral of Manus Metyr after progressing Ymir's questline.

place.title: Finger Ruins of Miyr
walk: After completing the first few objectives of Talking to Count Ymir, and ringing the bells at the Finger Ruins of Rhia and Finger Ruins of Dheo, it is time to ring the bell at the Finger Ruins of Miyr.

Head to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr by fast traveling to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map and heading over to the throne you once met Count Ymir on, this time you can examine the throne. Interact with it to see it slide back and reveal a rope ladder. Take the ladder down to reach the Finger Ruins of Miyr.

Once you head down, NPC invader Swordhand of Night Anna will appear, defeat her and you will be granted the Claws of Night. You will be able to find a few Finger Mimics scattered around the area, other than that, you can find the Finger-Weaver's Cookbook (2) on a body on the lower left walkway of the path.
Nearing the bell, you can interact with the Summoning Pool to activate it and then interact with the hanging bell to teleport you to the Metyr, Mother of Fingers arena.

Once you Defeat Metyr, Mother of Fingers you will be granted 420,000 Runes, and the Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers. You can then fast-travel back to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr and head back to the throne and interact with it once more to encounter another NPC invader named Swordhand of Night Jolan, defeat her and you will have to face Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers. This is when Count Ymir borrows the powers of Metyr to fight you. Defeat her and you will be granted the High Priest Armor Set that comes with the High Priest Hat, High Priest Robe, High Priest Gloves, and High Priest Undergarments, as well as Ymir's Bell Bearing and the Maternal Staff.

title: Boss: Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers +2
text: Activate the Finger Birthing Grounds grace in the arena.
Interact with Ymir's chair to be invaded by Swordhand of Night Jolan. Defeat her, then kill Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers for Ymir's Bell Bearing, Maternal Staff, High Priest Set, and 210,000 runes.

Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers: Boss event triggers after completing Ymir's questline and defeating the boss of Finger Ruins of Myir: Metyr, Mother of Fingers. Drops Ymir's Bell Bearing, Maternal Staff, High Priest Set

High Priest Set: The following armor pieces of the High Priest Set can be obtained after defeating the Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers found inside Cathedral of Manus Metyr . Ymir's Bell Bearing High Priest Hat High Priest Robe High Priest Gloves High Priest Gloves
Maternal Staff: Dropped by Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers
Ymir's Bell Bearing: Dropped by Ymir, Mother of Fingers upon defeat. This boss is only available after completing Ymir's questline
Swordhand of Night Jolan: Swordhand of Night Jolan invades after progressing Ymir's questline and defeating the boss of Finger Ruins of Myir: Metyr, Mother of Fingers.

title: Cherishing Fingers
text: Pick up Cherishing Fingers from Yuri's grave outside the cathedral.
Cherishing Fingers: It can be picked up in the graveyard to the west of the Chathedral of Manus Metyr after completing Count Ymir's questline in full.

title: Swordhand of Night Jolan
text: Reload the area to find Jolan slumped against the pillar from earlier:
Use Iris of Grace:
Use an Iris of Grace to obtain Swordhand of Night Jolan.

Swordhand of Night Jolan: Jolan is a Knight of Night that serves Count Ymir. After completing Ymir's questline, give Jolan the Eye of Occulation to receive the Sword of Night , or the Iris of Grace to receive Swordhand of Night Jolan Spirit Ashes. Note: if you don't get these spirit ashes, you cannot get the "Jolan and Anna" spirit ashes either.
miss: Becomes unobtainable if you use an Iris of Occultation.

guide.title: Return to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr
text: With the third map, make sure to rest at a grace somewhere else and then fast-travel to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr so Count Ymir will not be there. Make your way over to the throne you once met Count Ymir on. This time, you can examine the throne. Interact with it to see it slide back and reveal a rope ladder, take the ladder down to reach the Finger Ruins of Miyr.

title: Jolan and Anna
text: Return to the puppet in Rabbath's Rise from Shaman Village and usher Anna into the ashes to obtain Jolan and Anna.

Jolan and Anna: Found at the very top of Rabbath's Rise, only accessible by carefully dropping down from the Hinterlands area above. You can only obtain this Ashes if you progressed Count Ymir's questline and finished Jolan's invasion, then gave her the IRIS OF GRACE to obtain her Spirit Ashes. Interact with the puppet in this room and you can merge Jolan and Anna to create this spirit ash. You can interact again to undo the merge.
miss: Becomes unobtainable if you use an Iris of Occultation.

title: Sword of Night
text: Note: The puppet can only be used if you've given Jolan the Iris of Grace in the same playthrough. Anna cannot be combined with Jolan's ashes from a previous NG cycle, and Jolan and Anna cannot be separated after entering NG+.
Use Iris of Occultation:
Use an Iris of Occultation to obtain the Sword of Night.

Sword of Night: Jolan is a Knight of Night that serves Count Ymir. After completing Ymir's questline, give Jolan the Iris of Occultation to receive the Sword of Night , or the Iris of Grace to receive Swordhand of Night Jolan Spirit Ashes
miss: Becomes unobtainable if you use an Iris of Grace.

title: Boss: Furnace Golem (Ruins of Unte)
text: Travel to the Castle Watering Hole grace and pick up the Furnace Visage just east of it.
Furnace Visage: Looted from a broken Furnace Golem in the area
In the hand of an inactive Furnace Golem farther east is another Furnace Visage.
Furnace Visage: Looted from a destroyed Furnace Golem
Kill the Furnace Golem to the southwest for the Oil-Soaked Tear and a Furnace Visage.
Oil-Soaked Tear: The item drops from the Furnace Golem located at the Ruins of Unte.
Furnace Visage: Dropped by the active Furnace Golem upon defeat
Furnace Golem: Furnace Golem is located at the Ruins of Unte. Defeating this elite enemy drops the following items: x1 Oil-Soaked Tear x1 Furnace Visage

guide.title: Path to Ruins of Unte and Eastern Scadu Altus Dungeons
text: This blank wall is a secret passage and you can attack it to reveal a new area. This will lead you to an area beneath Eastern Scadu Altus region and allows you to reach Eastern Nameless Mausoleum and Darklight Catacombs. To continue, go through the secret room and follow the stream of water.
Go down the steps and turn left. You will see a coffin at the edge here. Rest in the coffin to travel to a new location.

After the short cutscene plays you will arrive at a new location. Go through the door then activate the Castle Watering Hole - Site of Grace left of the doorway. Then, summon Torrent and ride southeast here. You will come across a Furnace Golem here and it's up to you if you want to defeat it. You will arrive at Ruins of Unte, a new area that you can explore.

When you first arrive at the Ruins of Unte, you'll encounter one Furnace Golem that rises when you approach it See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. Defeating this Furnace Golem drops the Oil-Soaked Tear crystal tear and a Furnace Visage. Defeat it and head toward the ruins and you'll notice one "dead" or "unlit" Furnace Golem blocking the ruins' entrance. Head to the east side and use your mount to jump over the rubble and remains of the buildings until you reach the balcony overlooking the "dead" Furnace Golem. To wake up the Golem, you need to have a Hefty Furnace Pot in your inventory, equip it, and throw it on its head.

A Hefty Furnace Pot can be crafted with the following materials: x1 Redflesh Mushroom, x1 Ember of Messmer, and x1 Furnace Visage. The recipe to learn how to craft this item requires the player to acquire the Greater Potentate's Cookbook (2) item which can be looted from a dead body at the Run-Down Traveler's Rest in Gravesite Plain See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. Defeating this awakened Furnace Golem drops the x1 Bloodsucking Cracked Tear and x1 Furnace Visage.

From the Castle Watering Hole - Site of Grace, travel south and you will stick to the mountain side on your left. Make sure to pay attention to the gaps on the platform here. Once the path to the left side ends, jump over to the other side. This time, you will stick to the mountainside to the right.

From here, you can activate the Recluses' River Downstream - Site of Grace. This is important because you will be returning to this location to reach the Southern Shore. Next, you will go down some platforms near this Site of Grace. When you reach the river level, head north and turn right until you reach the end where you'll find the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum and the Darklight Catacombs.
Rakshasa Set
Rakshasa's Great Katana

title: Revered Spirit Ash
text: Return to the grace and pick up the 10x Furnace Visages around the Furnace Golem remains.
Furnace Visage: Looted from a destroyed Furnace Golem
Pick up Ember of Messmer x5 from the balcony of a building in the water.
By the cliff behind the building sits a statue holding a Revered Spirit Ash.
Revered Spirit Ash: Found on the altar by the stone wall southeast from Ruins of Unte

title: Bloodsucking Cracked Tear +1
text: Head north from the statue to a thin wall with Whiteflesh Mushroom x3 behind it.
Continue north around the ruins wall to further explore the Ruins of Unte:
Pick up the Lost Ashes of War on top of a wall, accessible from the second floor of a building.
Lost Ashes of War: Looted from a corpse on the walkable ruined walls of the Ruins of Unte
Continue up the rooftops to reach a balcony with Smithing Stone [8] x3.
Throw a Hefty Furnace Pot into the inactive Furnace Golem, then kill it for the Bloodsucking Cracked Tear and a Furnace Visage.
