Bloodsucking Cracked Tear: Defeat the Furnace Golem that requires to be lit by throwing a Hefty Fire Pot on its furnace head. Killing the creature drops this item, along with x1 Furnace Visage.
Furnace Visage: Dropped by the Furnace Golem you activate to enter the ruins upon defeat

Furnace Golem: You'll find a "dead" or unlit Furnace Golem resting against a wall. Craft if you don't have one, equip the item Hefty Furnace Pot and throw it on its furnace head to ignite the creature. Defeating this elite enemy drops the following items: x1 Bloodsucking Cracked Tear x1 Furnace Visage

title: Giant Golden Arc
text: Pick up Giant Golden Arc from the chest in the shrine.

Giant Golden Arc: Incantation found inside a chest in a chapel in the Ruins of Unte. You can only access this area if you first craft a Hefty Furnace Pot and activate the Furnace Golem that is blocking the entrance to the ruins by throwing it at its main furnace above its head.

title: Sword of Darkness, Stone-Sheathed Sword
text: Outside the shrine is a stele that can be used to raise your Stone-Sheathed Sword into the Sword of Darkness (if you got it in Fog Rift Catacombs).

Stone-Sheathed Sword: This is one of the three altars that affect the Stone-Sheathed Sword. The first one gives you the sword, then you may get the Sword of Darkness or the Sword of Light. Raise the Stone-Sheathed Sword to the light or darkness at this altar to unlock the Sword of Light or Sword of Darkness

title: Dryleaf Seal
text: Note: Once turned in, the Stone-Sheathed Sword cannot be reacquired until NG+ (though its light and dark variants can still be swapped at their respective steles). If you obtained the Stone-Sheathed Sword here, the Sword of Darkness is instead acquired at the stele in Fog Rift Catacombs.
Head to the waterfall south of the ruins and grab the Recluses' River Upstream grace beside it.
Follow the cliffside path across two gaps to find Thin Beast Bones x6 at the end.
Thin Beast Bones: x6 can be looted from a corpse by the cliff, surrounded by Man-fly enemies.
Cross the gap to the other side, then head west for Fly Mold x4.
Follow the other direction until you see a corpse with Smithing Stone [7] x2.
Drop down to activate the Recluses' River Downstream grace.
Shoot down the hanging pot northeast of the grace; you'll collect it in a later step.
From the grace, keep right along the northern path to a grassy field with Fly Mold x3 on the edge.
In the cliff behind the corpse is a small cave with Nascent Butterfly x2.
Continue northwest along the upper path, then drop down once at the end to pick up the Dryleaf Seal.
Dryleaf Seal: Sacred Seal looted from a platform under the message in the lower areas of this region.

title: Dane's Set, Scadutree Fragment
text: Drop down until you reach the top of the waterfall (no lower), then follow the river upstream to find a Somber Smithing Stone [7] and a Scadutree Fragment at the end.
Head back and pick up Dane's Set under the waterfall.
Scadutree Fragment: Northwest of the Moorth Ruins Site of Grace, there is a Messmer Soldiers encampment. x1 Scadutree Fragment can looted by the statue of Marika.

title: Boss: Rakshasa
text: Just east-southeast of the waterfall is a corpse with a Human Bone Shard.
Kill the scarab just past the corpse to obtain a Somber Smithing Stone [8].
Somber Smithing Stone [8]: Upgrade Material dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in the riverbed in the lower area of this zone.
Continue to a mausoleum and kill Rakshasa for Rakshasa's Great Katana, Rakshasa Set, and 90,000 runes.

Rakshasa: Rakshasa can be found in the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum. This area can only be accessed by using the ladder in Shadow Keep to get down to a special teleport coffin. This will take you to Ruins of Unte and you must follow the cliffs downstream and then carefully drop down to bottom level to reach the mausoleum. This boss drops 90,000 Runes, Rakshasa's Great Katana, Rakshasa Helm, Rakshasa Armor, Rakshasa Gauntlets, and Rakshasa Greeves.
Rakshasa's Great Katana: Dropped by Rakshasa at Eastern Nameless Mausoleum.

Rakshasa Set: The following armor pieces of the Rakshasa Set can be obtained after defeating Rakshasa found inside Eastern Nameless Mausoleum . Rakshasa Helm Rakshasa Armor Rakshasa Gauntlets Rakshasa Greaves

place.title: Eastern Nameless Mausoleum
walk: The Eastern Nameless Mausoleum is a location found in the depths section of the Scadu Altus region. To reach this, you need to use the coffin that's located under the main plaza section of the Shadow Keep. When you reach the bridge section of the main plaza (the area where you encounter the Shadow Militia enemies), check the east side of the bridge to find a ladder that you can climb down to the underground area of the Shadow Keep's main plaza. (The ladder is next to a body that you can loot that has a Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot item.)

After climbing down, you'll see a waterfall next to it, go through the waterfall to find a room that has another ladder. Climb down the ladder and you'll find a small storeroom that contains an item, the Domain of Dragons Painting. Approach the wall on the right and hit it to reveal an illusory wall. Beyond is a pathway leading to a sewage area where you'll find a coffin that you can interact with. Resting in the coffin will trigger a short cutscene and you'll be teleported to the depths section of Scadu Altus, specifically by the Castle Watering Hole site of grace See Shadow of the Erdtree Map.

From the site of grace, head southeast where you'll pass the Ruins of Unte. Follow the winding river to the south until you reach the Recluses River Downstream Site of Grace See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. From there, just to the southeast, take the tombstone platforms down and use them to safely reach the bottom. Be sure to take the platforms to the north on the way down, as taking the southward path will take you to the bottom of the waterfall, rather than above it. Next, go north toward a smaller waterfall, and when close to it, turn east and on through a mess of slimes in a narrow canyon, until you reach the end where you'll find the mausoleum.

By the entrance, there is a Summoning Pool or effigy for players to use for co-op. There is also a Stake of Marika that you can use to respawn by the entrance of the mausoleum in case you die. As mentioned, the location is where you'll fight against a mini boss, so make preparations before you pass through the mist. For guides and strategies on how to defeat the boss, please visit the Rakshasa boss page. Defeating this mini boss rewards the player with the following items:
Rakshasa Set
Rakshasa's Great Katana

title: Moldmonger's Bell Bearing
text: Follow the river to the other end to pick up the Moldmonger's Bell Bearing you shot down earlier.

Moldmonger's Bell Bearing: Inside a pot hanging from a rock wall right next to the Recluse's River Downstream grace. Shoot it down with a bow and drop down from the graves sticking out from the waterfall to grab it.

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Pick up the Glass Shard between two bushes beside the top of the waterfall.
Glass Shard: Looted from a corpse on a small ledge by the bottom waterfall.
Descend the gravestones to the base of the waterfall, then head northeast until you see an alcove on your left with Scorpion Liver x4.
Kill the two Hippopotamuses in the water for 2x Scadutree Fragments.

Scadutree Fragment: x1 Scadutree Fragment drops from one of the two Hippopotamus enemies in the area. This area can only be accessed by using the ladder in Shadow Keep to get down to a special teleport coffin. This will take you to Ruins of Unte and you must follow the cliffs downstream, and then carefully drop down to the bottom level to reach it.

title: Man-Fly Ashes
text: Pick up Smithing Stone [8] x4 from the slanted island in the middle of the water.
Travel to the Recluses' River Downstream grace and head south down a multitude of drops to a grassy slope. Follow it up to reach the Village of Flies:
Pick up a Revered Spirit Ash from the statue near the top-left corner of the slope.
Just southeast of the statue is a corpse with Silver Horn Tender.
Silver Horn Tender: 1x looted from a corpse guarded by 2 man-fly in Village of Flies
Continue to the top to find a Shadow Realm Rune [4] and Man-Fly Ashes.

Man-Fly Ashes: Spirit Ashes looted from a grub corpse in Village of the Flies. Can only be accessed by going down the river from Shadow Keep and unlocking the Recluses River Downstream site of grace area. The Ashes are found on the top part of the village, guarded by two shadow casters and several man-fly enemies.

place.title: Village of Flies
walk: To find this area, you must first unlock the path down Recluses' River from Shadow Keep's secret ladder to a teleport Coffin. Once you do this, follow the river south from Ruins of Unte until you reach Recluses River Downstream. Now follow south and stick to the western wall as you navigate many man-fly enemies and a Deathblade. In the small clearing where the Curseblade attacks, look west and north for an upward path to Village of the Flies.
notes: Use a fast area-of-effect Ash of War like Stormcaller to avoid getting overwhelmed by flies. An Ash of War like Flame of the Redmanes can be effective but takes too long to activate, will often get interrupted by the mob of flies, and will often miss the flies because of the uneven terrain.
There is nothing of interest except for the Man-Fly Ashes and Revered Spirit Ash, so a player is advised to run through and grab the items. Further exploration will not bring satisfaction.

title: Viridian Amber Medallion +3
text: Walk around the rock with the ashes to find a Golden Horn Tender.
Golden Horn Tender: Consumable looted from a corpse in a narrow back path near the top of Village of the Flies.
Follow the grassy slope all the way down to reach a misty area with the Darklight Catacombs entrance:
Take the lift down and activate the Darklight Catacombs grace.
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [6] from the first room.
Optional: Continue to a room with a staircase and pull the lever below it to turn on the lights.
From the balcony ahead, jump over the railing and follow the narrow ledge to an archway below it. Loot the Viridian Amber Medallion +3 from the chest inside.
Viridian Amber Medallion +3: Darklight Catacombs : In a chest found by dropping down a ledge in the main area, and going to the archway in the wall

place.title: Darklight Catacombs
walk: ER Shadow of the Erdtree Darklight Catacombs Video Walkthorugh
ER Shadow of the Erdtree Jore Elder Inquisitor Video Walkthorugh

The Darklight Catacombs is located south of the Scadu Altus region, directly south of the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum. To get there, go to the Recluses' River Downstream Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map, then go traverse the cliffs going south. As you get to the bottom, keep going south. By going in this direction, you will stumble upon the door leading to the Darklight Catacombs. Open the door to gain access inside the catacombs.

Once you are inside the Darklight Catacombs, follow the path leading to a lift. After arriving at the bottom, you can activate the Darklight Catacombs Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. After activating the Site of Grace, head north to pick up x1 Grave Glovewort [5]. A lionhead Imp will jump on you as you approach the item, so take caution. Once you have picked up the Grave Glovewort, go to the eastern hall right before picking up the loot. Grab x1 Yellow Fulgurbloom right as you head down the path. Turn left, and you'll find another path going down, with x1 Yellow Fulgurbloom in the middle of the stairs.

You will arrive on a ledge area with two Fanged Imps. Defeat the enemies, then drop down the ledge or walk down the ramp. Immediately on the west of where you dropped is a passageway leading to a lever that will turn on the lights when pulled. Go back to where you dropped, then head southeast, passing through the archway. As you turn the corner to the archway, a bigmouth Imp will attack you.

In the room overlooking the lit area, you can drop from the railings onto a ledge, then drop from the broken section of the ledge to a room with a chest containing the Viridian Amber Medallion +3. Afterwards, drop down to a bridge. The room on the south connecting to the bridge contains x1 Grave Glovewort [1] on the east side, and x2 Yellow Fulgurbloom right by the western wall. After clearing the area, follow the path going north leading to another lift. Use the lift to go down.

Follow the path north, going through the ramp on the right side to progress. A Fanged Imp will be waiting for you at the bottom of the ramp. Keep heading north, and you'll find x1 Yellow Fulgurbloom along with a bigmouth Imp opposite of it. After dealing with the imp, go back a few steps and you'll see a ladder going up. Climb the ladder, then turn right through the tight passageway, dropping to a room with a lever. Pull the lever, and you will activate the lights in another area. By the lever, you can drop down safely into a staircase below containing x4 Thin Beast Bones. Follow the path going up the stairs.

Once you have arrived at the top of the second set of stairs, look down by the opening, then drop down to the ledge. Follow the ledge going west, then climb up the ladder in the corner. In front of you, you can pick up x1 Shadow Realm Rune [5] from a corpse, and you will encounter an Inquisitor. You can safely drop to the room below with a body that has x1 Ghost Glovewort [2]. A Fanged Imp will attack you from behind after dropping. You can exit through the archway to the east. You'll be back in the area where you climbed up a ladder to the lever room.

You'll find a broken section of the railings. Drop down to the ledge bellow it, and you'll find a hallway with an Inquisitor on the southeastern corner. In this hallway, you can obtain the Death Knight Set from a dead body by the ledge on the north. South of the hallway, you can find an opening with a ladder going down. Climb down the ladder then head east through the archway. On your left, you'll find x1 Ghost Glovewort [9]. On your right, a Inquisitor will be attacking you. Defeat the Inquisitor, then drop down the ledge.

After dropping down, you can pick up x1 Yellow Fulgurbloom just where you dropped. Go east, then go through the archway going down, leading you to another lift. After arriving at the bottom of the lift, keep heading east. You will encounter a giant Bigmouth Imp which shoots fireballs towards you. Run through it, then turn left to head north. There will be a section here that has a pillar that can serve as a safe spot for you. As you are in the safe spot, a Fanged Imp will approach you. After dealing with the Fanged Imp, sprint to the area where it came from, then pull the lever in the room. Afterwards, kill the giant Bigmouth Imp, then defeat the Fanged Imp that spawns after it.

NOTE: Do not kill the Giant Bigmouth Imp before pulling the lever, or else the Great Ghost Glovewort that it drops will be stuck in the air. If you do kill it and then pull the level, return after respawning at a Stake and you can kill it again to get its item.

Go back to where you dropped, and you can pick up x2 Yellow Fulgurbloom and x1 Ghost Glovewort [8]. Afterwards, head to the pathway that the giant Bigmouth imp was blocking, then enter the room to loot a chest containing x1 Bigmouth Imp Ashes. Head up the ladder on the eastern wall, then keep heading east through the hall. You will encounter a Fanged Imp at the end of the hallway. You can safely drop, then head north. In the northernmost wall, you can pick up x1 Grave Glovewort [4] from a dead body. Head back south going down the ramps, and you'll find another lift which leads you to a boss fog.

Once you head inside the boss fog, you will encounter Jori, Elder Inquisitor. For a more detailed guide on how to defeat Jori, Elder Inquisitor, you can visit this page. After defeating Jori, Elder Inquisitor, you will obtain the Barbed Staff-Spear and the Forsaken Graveyard Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map will be unlocked.

NOTE: The Abyssal Woods can be accessed after defeating the boss of the Darklight Catacombs. After you have defeated Jori, you can follow the path going south to get to the Abyssal Woods region. You can't use your mount in the area, so you will get kicked off of your mount as you approach the region. Keep going south, and you can activate the Woodland Trail Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. To unlock the map for the Abyssal Woods region, you can keep following the path going south, and you will come across a glowing column with an item. Pick it up to get the Map: Abyss. Nearby, you can activate the Abandoned Church Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map.

title: Death Knight Set
text: Drop onto the slope, then head south to find a Grave Glovewort [7] in a dark room.
Take the lift down the slope. Drop down straight ahead to the left of a balustrade, then climb the ladder to a Shadow Realm Rune [5]. Be wary of the Catacombs Sorcerer around the corner.
Shadow Realm Rune [5]: Can be looted in the Darklight Catacombs location.
Drop down and pick up the Ghost Glovewort [7] in the same room.
Optional: Go down the first flight of stairs and climb the ladder behind a wall to reach a room with a lever, then turn on the lights.
Pick up Thin Beast Bones x4 from the flight of stairs below the lever.
At the top of the stairs, drop through the gap in the balustrade to find the Death Knight Set on your left.

Death Knight Set: The following armor pieces of the Death Knight Set can be obtained by looting a dead body hanging by a ledge located at the Darklight Catacombs . Death Knight Helm Death Knight Armor Death Knight Gauntlets Death Knight Greaves

title: Bigmouth Imp Ashes
text: Descend the ladder on the opposite side and pick up a Ghost Glovewort [9] from the ledge.

Ghost Glovewort [9]: South of the hallway, you can find an opening with a ladder going down. Climb down the ladder then head east through the archway. On your left, you'll find x1 Ghost Glovewort [9].
Take the next lift down, then after dropping down some stairs, turn around for a Ghost Glovewort [8].
Pull the lever north of the giant Bigmouth Imp to turn on the lights and lower the middle platform.
Kill the giant Bigmouth Imp for a Great Ghost Glovewort (first time).
Great Ghost Glovewort: Drops from the Giant Bigmouth Imp enemy located in the Darklight Catacombs location.
Note: If the Imp didn't spawn or the item is floating in the air, just come back after the boss.
Drop down behind the middle platform to discover a chest containing the Bigmouth Imp Ashes.
Bigmouth Imp Ashes: The Bigmouth Imp Ashes can be found inside a treasure chest at the Darklight Catacombs location.

title: Boss: Jori, Elder Inquisitor
text: Climb the ladder and continue until you drop down, then turn back for a Great Ghost Glovewort.
Take the final lift and kill Jori, Elder Inquisitor for Barbed Staff-Spear and 260,000 runes.
Jori, Elder Inquisitor: Jori, Elder Inquisitor is the boss located in the Darklight Catacombs location.
Barbed Staff-Spear: Dropped by Jori, Elder Inquisitor , and grants 260000 Runes upon defeat.
Activate the Forsaken Graveyard grace after the fight.

title: Invader: Madding Hand, Madding Hand
text: Follow the path into the woods and grab the Woodland Trail grace on the side of the road.
Kill the Madding Hand patrolling the road farther south to obtain the Madding Hand.
Madding Hand: Madding Hand is a hostile NPC located in the Abyssal Woods. This NPC is found patrolling this area, by the trail of messages.
Madding Hand: The weapon is acquired upon defeating the hostile NPC, Madding Hand.

guide.title: Abyss
text: Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree - Navigating Abyssal Woods
Activate Woodlands Trail - Site of Grace
Obtain Map: Abyss
Reach Abandoned Church
Return to Woodlands Trail, then make your way to Abyssal Woods - Site of Grace
Explore Midra's Manse

NOTE: The Abyssal Woods can be accessed after defeating the boss of the Darklight Catacombs. You can follow the path going south to get to the Abyssal Woods region. If you haven't reached this location, you can follow the #15 of the Game Progress Route or Shadow Keep Underground (Main Gate and Recluse River) and follow the guide to clear Darklight Catacombs.

After defeating Jori, Elder Inquisitor, you will unlock an entrance to the Abyssal Woods. First, activate the Forsaken Graveyard - Site of Grace that spawned after the fight then head through the archway and head south. NOTE: Down here, Torrent can't be summoned because it is terrified, and you will be walking on foot. Continue heading south until you see another Site of Grace as soon as you formally enter the region. You can see it right in front of the thick tree. Use the Woodlands Trail - Site of Grace.

From there, head south and follow the dirt path. You will pass through some creatures here and skeleton enemies. As soon as you see the elevated thick tree, turn left and you will be heading east this time. You know that you are in the right place if you can spot the church-like structure from a distance. Along the trail, you will encounter a hostile NPC, the Madding Hand (NPC) who drops the Madding Hand weapon if you kill the NPC. Continue along the path until you reach the pillar and the Abandoned Church. The map is right in front of this building so make sure to pick up Map: Abyss first. This will help you navigate the area easily.

title: Map: Abyss
text: Continue along the road to reach a stele with Map: Abyss.
Map: Abyss: Map of the Abyss at the east of the Gravesite Plain. Found besides a column.

title: Frenzyflame Perfume Bottle, Scadutree Fragment
text: Activate the Church Ruins grace in the church by the stele.
Pick up Scadutree Fragment x2 and Frenzyflame Perfume Bottle from the church.
Frenzyflame Perfume Bottle: The weapon is looted from a dead body located by the northern interior of the Abandoned Church.
Scadutree Fragment: x2 Scadutree Fragment can be looted in front of the altar inside the Abandoned Church.

guide.title: Abandoned Church
text: Inside the abandoned church, you can find x2 Scadutree Fragment in front of the altar.
Check the north side interior of the church to find a body sitting against the wall. Loot the corpse to acquire x1 Frenzyflame Perfume Bottle.

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Pick up Scadutree Fragment x2 and Frenzyflame Perfume Bottle from the church.
Scadutree Fragment: From the Abyssal Woods Site of Grace, head north to find a corpse sitting against a tree. Loot the dead body to obtain x1 Scadutree Fragment.

title: Aged One's Exultation
text: Next to a tree north of the church entrance is a corpse with Clarifying Boluses x2.
Clarifying Boluses: Found on a corpse on an elevated ledge
On top of a ledge just west from the church entrance is a Shadow Realm Rune [7].
Shadow Realm Rune [7]: Can be found on a corpse perched atop a ledge west of the Abandoned Church.
From the ledge, head south below an arched root to find a corpse with Surging Frenzied Flame and a Somber Smithing Stone [9].
Keep the wall on your left as you go west-northwest. To the left of the largest tree is a corpse with Clarifying Cured Meat x2 and a Ghost Glovewort [9].
Go up the slope southeast to find a corpse with some Clarifying Boluses.
Head north-northwest and around the cliff to find a path on your left. Kill the Aging Untouchable for the Aged One's Exultation.

Aged One's Exultation: Talisman dropped by the Winter Lantern enemy you kill nearest to the Abandoned Church. These enemies can only be killed by executing a parry and riposte just as they are about to catch you.

title: Mad Craftsman's Cookbook [1]
text: Note: This enemy type can only be damaged after a successful parry. [See parry guide]
Kill the Aging Untouchable farther in for a Swollen Grape.
Swollen Grape: Upon entering Midra's Manse, immediately enter the room on the right and you'll find this on a corpse on the ground beside a table.
Continue west until the area turns foggy. Kill the Aging Untouchable in the fog for a Swollen Grape.
On the south side of the foggy area is a large tree with Clarifying Boluses x3 beside it.
Travel to the Woodland Trail grace, then head straight west to find the Abyssal Woods grace.
From that grace, head toward the southeast hills to find a Shadow Realm Rune [7] between two giant trees.
Return to the Abyssal Woods grace and follow the northern path to a dead end. Pick up Clarifying Cured Meat x2, Smithing Stone [7] x2, and a Scadutree Fragment from the two corpses there.
Head back and kill the Aging Untouchable near the Abyssal Woods grace for a Swollen Grape.
Kill the last two Aging Untouchables farther west for 2x Swollen Grapes.
On a ledge overlooking the path with the two Aging Untouchables is a Great Grave Glovewort.
Drop back down and follow the path straight ahead to discover the Divided Falls grace.
Pick up the Mad Craftsman's Cookbook [1] at the top of the slope southwest of the grace.
Mad Craftsman's Cookbook [1]: Found on a corpse on the higher areas west of the Waterfall in Abyssal Woods

title: Mad Craftsman's Cookbook [2]
text: Return to the grace, then head south-southeast below an arched slope. From there, head south-southwest and go up the long slope at the end. Pick up the Mad Craftsman's Cookbook [2] at the top.
Mad Craftsman's Cookbook [2]: Found on a corpse among the large roots in the higher area of the midle portion of the Abyssal Woods
Make your way down the southwest side of the slope to discover Midra's Manse at the end.

title: Torn Diary Page
text: Open the door and pick up a Swollen Grape from a side room before the grace.
Activate the Manse Hall grace in the main hall.
Hit the painting to reveal a corridor, then take the first left to a room with a Torn Diary Page.
Torn Diary Page: From the Manse Hall Site of Grace, hit the painting on the left to reveal a hidden path, then enter the room on the left, you'll find this item on a corpse.

title: Mad Craftsman's Cookbook [3], Surging Frenzied Flame x3
text: Climb the furniture in the room to reach a corpse with Swollen Grape x2.
Enter the dining hall at the end of the corridor and pick up the Thin Beast Bones x4 by the fireplace.
Head down the next corridor and pull the lever at the end.
Climb the ladder behind the bookcase that moved to find a Shadow Realm Rune [6] on some beams.

Shadow Realm Rune [6]: After pulling the lever, follow the room on the east, hugging the wall, and you will find a ladder going up. You'll end up in a room with Shadow Undead scattered around. You'll find this on a corpse hanging on a beam.
Pick up Surging Frenzied Flame x3 from the other side of the second floor balcony.
Climb the ladder on the balcony to continue, then pick up Mad Craftsman's Cookbook [3] from a dark room next to the wooden beams.

Mad Craftsman's Cookbook [3]: Midra's Manse: At the upper level, you will be walking across beams. As you traverse through the beams, there will be Frenzied Giant Rats on the right archway that might attack you. If you enter the dark room the rats are in, you can loot the cookbook. Keep heading west, and you will arrive at the Midra's Library Site of Grace.

Surging Frenzied Flame x3: After pulling the lever, follow the room on the east, hugging the wall, and you will find a ladder going up. You'll end up in a room with Shadow Undead scattered around. You can pick up x1 Shadow Realm Rune [6] from a dead body hanging by a beam. Head to the next room, the balcony where the Shadow Undead using Flame of Frenzy on you is located. You'll find this material on a corpse in the southwestern section of the balcony.

title: Nanaya's Torch
text: Cross the beams to the other side and activate the Midra's Library grace.
On top of a bookcase in the library is a corpse with Golden Horn Tender x2.
Jump onto the bookcase below the corpse for a Shadow Realm Rune [7].

Shadow Realm Rune [7]: From Midra's Library Site of Grace, head west and you will be in the library. You will encounter frenzied enemies throughout the library. On your left, you can cross a beam to get on top of the library shelves. Jump to the middle platform and grab an item, then jump down again to the corpse on another shelf below.
Drop to the floor and grab the Swollen Grape x2 at the west end of the library.
Go through the doorway at the opposite end and open the shortcut back to the Manse Hall grace.
Hit the painting near the shortcut to reveal a path to a lever. Pull it to move the last bookcase into place.
Make your way across the bookcases to reach a corpse with Nanaya's Torch.

Nanaya's Torch: From Midra's Library Site of Grace, you'll need to move one of the bookshelves by pulling a lever in the same room. The balcony you need to reach is directly above the inquisitor below. This torch is on a corpse sitting on a chair, wearing a yellow cloth that resembles that of Hyetta.

guide.title: Midra's Library
text: Head west of the Site of Grace, and you will be in the library. You will encounter frenzied enemies throughout the library. On your left, you can cross a beam to get on top of the library shelves. On the shelf in the middle, you can grab x1 Golden Horn Tender from a dead body. You can drop down to another shelf, which contains x1 Shadow Realm Rune [7]. Drop down the shelf, then go to the eastern side to find a door.

Open the door to gain access to a shortcut to Manse Hall. After opening the door, look at the southern wall with the painting just before the previously closed door. Attack it to reveal another hidden path. This leads to a lever that you can pull to move a bookshelf, opening up another path.

Backtrack your way to the bookshelf where you obtained a Golden Horn Tender. Instead of dropping down again, jump on the ledge north of it. Follow the path, crossing the run-down path. Make the jump to get to a balcony with a dead body, in which you can loot x1 Nanaya's Torch.

On the recently opened path, head up the stairs. You can pick up x2 Swollen Grape from a dead body just before the path. You will be in a room on the upper level of the library, along with a Greater Inquisitor in the area which drops a Revered Spirit Ash. After defeating the Inquisitor, head up another set of stairs on the east. Keep following the path, clearing the room of the Inquisitors, and you will discover the Second Floor Chamber Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map.

Head north of the Site of Grace, and you will see a chandelier along with a ladder going down. Kick the ladder down before jumping to the chandelier to obtain x1 Revered Spirit Ash. You can drop down safely to the ground without receiving any damage. Climb up the ladder you just kicked to the Second Floor Chamber Site of Grace, then go directly east of it through the archway. You will hear a person wailing in the room nearby. Approach the wailing man, and it will be hostile towards you. Defeat the enemy, and it will trigger a cutscene.

title: Revered Spirit Ash
text: Kill the large Inquisitor below for a Revered Spirit Ash (first time).
Revered Spirit Ash: When you reach the Library, jump on the bookshelves and make your way to the other side where you see a large enemy. Defeat it to acquire a Revered Spirit Ash.

title: Revered Spirit Ash
text: Continue through the eastern doorway to reach the Second Floor Chamber grace.
Kick down the shortcut ladder, then jump onto the chandelier to pick up a Revered Spirit Ash.
Revered Spirit Ash: Can be found on a body hanging on the chandelier next to the Site of Grace.

place.title: Midra's Manse
walk: ## Midra's Manse Entrance
## Midra's Library
## Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame
notes: Notes go here

title: Boss: Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame
text: Kill Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame for Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame and 410,000 runes.
Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame: Legend Enemy. When defeated, grants Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame and 410,000 Runes.

Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame: Dropped by Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame . Can be consummed for Runes or handed to Enia at the Roundtable Hold , for Greatsword of Damnation or Midra's Flame of Frenzy
Activate the Discussion Chamber grace after the fight.

guide.title: Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame
text: After defeating the wailing man, it will then be revealed in the cutscene that he is Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame. You will then fight the true form of Midra, the embodiment of the Frenzied Flame. He will be using a spear made out of the weapon that was formerly impaling him. For a more detailed guide on how to defeat Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame, you can refer to this guide.
After defeating Midra, you will receive the Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame and the Discussion Chamber Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map will be unlocked.
See the next tab for the Shadow Keep (Main).to return to the tab selection.

title: Greater Potentate's Cookbook [6]
text: Travel to the Dragon's Pit Terminus grace and return where you killed the drake. Follow the northeastern path to a spiritspring, then head north from it to find Greater Potentate's Cookbook [6] on the cliff edge.
Greater Potentate's Cookbook [6]: Found on a cliff edge corpse north of the spiritspring used to launch up towards the Foot of the Jagged Peak Site of Grace.

title: Boss: Jagged Peak Drake (Foot of the Jagged Peak)
text: Take the spiritspring up, then grab the Foot of the Jagged Peak grace across the bridge.
Kill the Jagged Peak Drake (fighting another) for Dragon Heart, Dragonscale Flesh, and 120,000 runes.
Jagged Peak Drake: Can be found fighting another dragon near Foot of the Jagged Peak Site of Grace. Drops 90000 Runes, Dragon Heart, and Dragonscale Flesh.
Dragon Heart: Dropped by the Jagged Peak Drake.
Dragonscale Flesh: Dropped by the Jagged Peak Drake.

guide.title: Jagged Peak
text: Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree - Navigating Jagged Peak
From the Dragon's Pit Terminus - Site of Grace, travel to Foot of Jagged Peak - Site of Grace and defeat the 2 Jagged Peak Drake
Talk to Igon and receive Igon's Furled Finger
Fight Ancient Dragon's Senessax
Summon Igon to defeat Bayle The Dread
Return to Igon's location near Foot of the Jagged Peak where you fought the 2 Dragons
Return to Dragon Communion Priestess

Head out to the Foot of the Jagged Peak by returning to where you fought the first dragon, but this time, you will head north and pass through the pillars. This will take you to the cliff of the mountain.

Use the Spiritspring at the end of this path, then veer right and cross the bridge. Activate the Foot of the Jagged Peak site of grace here before proceeding. This is very important because you will be fighting a boss in the next area. This is where you will respawn if you die during the fight.

Next, continue up ahead until you reach the boss arena. You will be fighting another Jagged Peak Drake, but this time, there will be two of them. After this fight, you will hear the voice of Igon nearby. Locate him towards the east and head towards the area where the red smoke is thick. Talk to him there and exhaust his dialogues. He will ask you to summon him and let him join you in the fight against Bayle The Dread. You will receive Igon's Furled Finger.

From here, take the Spiritspring behind him, and another one at the next level. On the third level, you will see the entrance to the cave of the next dragon. Go inside the cave and watch out for the rolling boulders here. You can avoid it by going to the right area of the cave, and then crossing to the left as soon as the boulder rolls down. Before crossing, you also need to pay attention to an item on your right at the end and pick up the Scadutree Fragment here. Once you make it to the left side of the room, you will reach the arena of another boss.

You will be fighting Ancient Dragon Senessax. After defeating this boss, go up the north exit where you will see the remains of other dragons on the ground. This serves as your guide that you are headed to the right place.

Outside this area, activate the Jagged Peak Mountainside - Site of Grace. Then, head to the top of the mountain by heading southwest. You will see the dragon remains here and keep following it. There are also lightning effects that will occasionally strike. Then, use the Spiritspring and continue going to the south.

Stick to the wall here to your left and use another Spiritspring. You will find yourself at a level with multiple dragon remains and a small cave entrance in front of you. Go inside and pick up the Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone on the right side, then walk over to your left and use another Spiritspring at the end.

Use the Site of Grace at the top and this is the one that you will be using in case you die during the boss fight. (Beware: You probably will). Go towards the small opening here and once you enter the arena, Bayle The Dread will land once you are inside. Now, the key to completing Igon is to summon him here. He can't be summoned from the outside but you need to locate his summon sign inside the arena after this boss fight is triggered.
After defeating this boss, return to Igon's last location where you fought the two Jagged Peak Drake. See the SOTE Elden Ring DLC Map He will drop his items that you can loot:
Igon's Greatbow
Igon's Helm
Igon's Armor
Igon's Gauntlets
Igon's Loincloth
Igon's Bell Bearing

Once you have collected these items, go to the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion. Teleport to the site of grace that you previously used. The Dragon Communion Priestess has vanished and will leave the following items behind:
Priestess Heart
Flowerstone Gavel
NOTE: There is an alternate ending for this NPC quest, but there are some requirements to meet before your fight with Bayle. The following requirements are:
Meet Thiollier before Moore leaves the Main Gate Cross Site of Grace
Speak to Moore and receive the Black Syrup from Thiollier
Give Thiollier the Black Syrup in exchange for Thiollier's Concoction

After you have met all these requirements, you will need to see the Dragon Communion Priestess at night. She will be seen speaking with Lord Placidusax. You can speak to her and give her Thiollier's Concoction.

(IF GIVEN THE CONCOCTION SHE WILL NOT DROP THE PRIESTESS HEART OR THE GAVEL)If you give her Thiollier's Concoction she will fall asleep, wait 1 full day and she will wake up and express disappointment that she had succumbed to slumber.After defeating Bayle, return to her and she will give you the Dragonbolt of Florissax Incantation. Then if you confess that it was you that put her to sleep she will pledge to follow you and you will be given the Ancient Dragon Florissax Spirit Ashes.
See the next tab for the Shadow Keep Depths (Recluse River) Walkthrough.to return to the tab selection.

title: Igon's Furled Finger
text: Talk to Igon after the fight to receive Igon's Furled Finger.
Igon's Furled Finger: Will be given by Igon by interacting with him after defeating the Jagged Peak Drake in the area.
miss: Must be obtained before killing Bayle or you will also miss out on Ash of War: Igon's Drake Hunt.

title: Talk to Igon
text: Igon: Igon can be found southeast of the Foot of the Jagged Peak site of grace.

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Take the two spiritsprings ahead to a corpse with Red Fulgurbloom x8.
Head up the slope with two rolling boulders to find a Scadutree Fragment where they first hit the ground.
Scadutree Fragment: After getting past the two Spiritsprings, take the path on your right, and be careful of falling boulders. You'll find x1 Scadutree Fragment on a dead body.

title: Boss: Ancient Dragon Senessax
text: Kill Ancient Dragon Senessax for an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone, Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone, and 200,000 runes.

Ancient Dragon Senessax: Ancient Dragon Senessax can be located West from the Jagged Peak Summit Site of Grace Sleeping in the middle of the pathway. It drops 200,000 Runes, Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone, and Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone: x1 Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone can be looted inside a treasure chest. The chest is located at the top area of the Suppressing Pillar, just ride the lift to reach it.
Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone: Dropped by the Ancient Dragon Senessax upon defeat.

title: Igon's Cookbook [2]
text: Continue up a steep slope of dead drakes to reach the Jagged Peak Mountainside grace.
A corpse with Igon's Cookbook [2] sits at the edge of the cliff northeast of the grace.
Igon's Cookbook [2]: Can be found at the edge of a cliff near the Jagged Peak Mountainside site of grace.

title: Flowerstone Gavel
text: From the grace, head southwest to a spiritspring and take it up. When safe, drop down onto the lower right path and follow it in the opposite direction to find Rock Heart (painting reward).
Rock Heart: A special item obtained from completing the "Domain of Dragons" Painting puzzle. Allows players to transform into an Ancient Dragon
Return up the spiritspring, then use the next spiritspring while facing north to reach a ledge that leads to a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone: From the Jagged Peak Mountainside Site of Grace, follow the path southwest and use the 2 spiritsprings to get to the elevated areas. Once you make it through the second spiritspring, turn around and drop down the area just below you, follow the path northeast and you'll find this material on a corpse.
Use the spiritspring while facing east, then continue straight ahead to an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone: After using the second spiritspring, continue heading east and you'll find this on a corpse sitting in a corner.
Take the last spiritspring and activate the Jagged Peak Summit grace.
Optional: Talk to Florissax and ask her about Igon.
Before fighting Bayle, choose how to conclude Florissax's questline:
Do nothing:
After killing Bayle, pick up Priestess Heart and Flowerstone Gavel from where she stood.
Priestess Heart: The Dragon Communion Priestess drops this item at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion after defeating Bayle The Dread.
Flowerstone Gavel: The Dragon Communion Priestess drops this item at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion after defeating Bayle The Dread.
miss: Both are unobtainable if you give her Thiollier's Concoction.

title: Dragonbolt of Florissax
text: Use Thiollier's concoction:
Pass time until she appears at night, then use Thiollier's concoction on her.
Pass time again until she wakes back up, then talk to her.
Talk to her after killing Bayle to be rewarded with Dragonbolt of Florissax.
Dragonbolt of Florissax: Incantation received from Dragon Priestess at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion after defeating Bale the Dread.
miss: Becomes unobtainable if you kill Bayle without first using Thiollier's Concoction on her.

title: Ancient Dragon Florissax
text: Confess to putting her to sleep, then talk to her again and choose to take her with you to obtain Ancient Dragon Florissax.

Ancient Dragon Florissax: WARNING: DOING THIS WILL LOCK YOU OUT OF THE PRIESTESS HEART (The one that buffs dragon cult incantations, You can get a different dragon transformations stone called ''Rock Heart'' from another place that buffs dragon communion spells instead.) Find Thiollier near Pillar Path Cross (after the bridge and on your way to dragon's pit, the leftmost/eastmost path leading to a small swamp on map). Exhaust her dialogue. Just to clarify that the road doesn't really lead to the swamp (which is down below the cliff), it just looks like so on the map) Go back to the blessing outside Belurat and talk toMoore. He will give you an item for Thiollier. Deliver the item to Thiollier and exhaust her dialogue again to obtain another item. Give the item to the dragon priestess (near Grand Altar of Dragon Communion) at night, this will put her to sleep. Wait for a few rounds and she will have woken up, exhaust her dialogue. Kill Bayle the Dread. Remember to summon Igon (his sign is within the arena, to the left after you enter the mist) Go to the Altar and talk to her, confess to putting her to sleep and accept to become her lord. collect her ash.
miss: Becomes unobtainable if you kill Bayle without first using Thiollier's Concoction on her.

title: Boss: Bayle the Dread
text: Kill Bayle the Dread for Heart of Bayle and 490,000 runes.
Bayle the Dread: Bayle the Dread can be located in the middle of the volcano near the Jagged Peak Summit and Rest of the Dread Dragon Site of Grace. It drops the Heart of Bayle.
Heart of Bayle: Dropped by Bayle the Dread upon defeat.

title: Igon's Greatbow, Igon's Set +1
text: Optional: Igon can be summoned for an epic fight if you got his furled finger.
Activate the Rest of the Dread Dragon grace after the fight.
Return to Igon and pick up Igon's Greatbow, Igon's Set, and Igon's Bell Bearing from his corpse.
Igon's Greatbow: After defeating Bayle the Dread while Igon is summoned, Igon will drop this item at his last location at the Foot of the Jagged Peak Drake.
Igon's Set: Igon will drop the following items at his last location in the Foot of the Jagged Peak Drake after defeating Bayle The Dread : Igon's Helm Igon's Armor Igon's Gauntlets Igon's Loincloth
Igon's Bell Bearing: After defeating Bayle the Dread while Igon is summoned, Igon will drop this item at his last location at the Foot of the Jagged Peak Drake.

title: Ash of War: Igon's Drake Hunt
text: If you received Igon's Furled Finger, his bow comes equipped with a unique ash of war. You can remove it to make Ash of War: Igon's Drake Hunt available for compatible bows.
miss: Igon's Furled Finger must be obtained before killing Bayle.

title: Salza's Hood, Rain of Fire
text: Travel to the West Rampart grace and open the smaller door. Pick up the first three items on the bridge: Smithing Stone [7] x3, Beast Liver x3, and Beast Blood x3.
Rush to the end of the bridge on horseback to kill Fire Knight Salza for Salza's Hood and Rain of Fire.

Salza's Hood: From the West Rampart Site of Grace, take the bridge all the way. Use Torrent to avoid being trappped in the Rain of Fire. Defeat the Fire Knight at the end to obtain this and Rain of Fire .

Rain of Fire: From the West Rampart Site of Grace, take the bridge all the way. Use Torrent to avoid being trappped in the Rain of Fire. Defeat the Fire Knight at the end to obtain this and Salza's Hood .

guide.title: Crossing the Bridge from Shadow Keep
text: If you have been following this walkthrough, teleport to the West Rampart - Site of Grace in Shadow Keep. If you haven't unlocked this section, please see Shadow Keep or the Shadow Keep (Main) Tab on this page for the full walkthrough on how to reach the area.

From the Site of Grace, enter through the small archway on the right side of the bridge. It is recommended to ride Torrent here as you cross the bridge so you can move faster and loot as you travel. There will be giant bats on this bridge but you will move fast enough and they shouldn't be able to reach you. You will find lootable corpses here, the first one to the left which is a Smithing Stone [3]. Up ahead, you can loot more 3x Beast Liver, 3x Beast Blood, Smithing Stone [4], 5x Redflesh Mushroom, 8x Thin Beast Bones, and a Somber Smithing Stone [2].
At the other end of this bridge, you will encounter a Fire Knight wearing a red cloak. It wields dual daggers and can cast fire magic and will drop Salza's Hood and Rain of Fire upon defeating it.

Go inside the building behind the enemy you just defeated and take the Somber Smithing Stone [9] from the corpse on the corner. Take the spiral stairs next to it and you will reach an elevator at the top. This will take you to a new gate and then, interact with the Viaduct Minor Tower - Site of Grace here.

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Grab the remaining items on the bridge: Somber Smithing Stone [6], Thin Beast Bones x8, Redflesh Mushroom x5, and Smithing Stone [7] x3.
Somber Smithing Stone [6]: Found on a corpse on some higher up debris by a door, In the area filled with Spider-Scorpions.
Thin Beast Bones: x8. Near the edge.
Pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [9] in the room at the end of the bridge.
Somber Smithing Stone [9]: Looted from a corpse in the room Behind Salza, Sage of the Fire Knights.
Go up the stairs and take the lift to the Viaduct Minor Tower grace.
Follow the southeast path to a lift. On a pillar behind it is a corpse with Spirit Calculus.
Spirit Calculus: Found on a body on a broken column, in Ancient Ruins of Rauh . To the left side of the first site of grace of the area.
Take the lift down, then pick up Sacred Bloody Flesh x3 and a Somber Smithing Stone [8] from the room around the corner.

Somber Smithing Stone [8]: Then, use the elevator to go down to the lower level. As you go down, face the southwest direction so you are ready for the Bloodfiend waiting here. Then, follow the path behind it where a group of Bloodfiends is gathered. This can be difficult since you are outnumbered, but if you have a magic build, you can use Adula's Moonblade to effectively take out the group. After fighting them, you can pick up Somber Smithing Stone [8] from the corpse behind the group.
Head out the narrow passage while keeping to the right to find Thin Beast Bones x8 at the end.
Turn back and kill the Hippopotamus down the stairs for a Scadutree Fragment.
Scadutree Fragment: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted by Miquella's Cross of the Rauh Ancient Ruins, East Site of Grace.

title: Revered Spirit Ash
text: Return to the grace and walk around the right side of the tower to find a Golden Horn Tender.

Golden Horn Tender: Past the Spider-Scorpions after entering the tunnel, move forward, and turn right. Locate the Shadowpot Enemy and kill it to obtain x1 Scadutree Fragment and x1 Golden Horn Tender.
Back at the grace, follow the western path to an ancient ruins entrance. Kill the pot-carrying Shadow Commoner inside for a Revered Spirit Ash and Silver Horn Tender (first time).
Revered Spirit Ash: Dropped by a Shadowpot Enemy in the ruins west of the Viaduct Minor Tower Site of Grace.
Silver Horn Tender: Droped by a Shadowpot Enemy.

guide.title: Eastern Section
text: Upon exiting the archway, face the western direction and go through the collapsed tree. Follow the path ahead where you will see small creatures and make a right to to enter the building marked by these 2 standing lanterns. This area is filled with shadowy enemies and there are variations of them. Others are hunched on the ground, while there are some walking around carrying a jar. Take note that some of these enemies carry an important item. If you see them glimmering in the dark, eliminate them to take their item.

As you enter, go to your immediate right and climb up the overgrown roots. Head towards the northeast and turn left behind the pillar to pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [9] from the edge of this root. Go around this area and return to the entrance side and eliminate the Shadowpot here. This one is carrying a Revered Spirit Ash and a Silver Horn Tender. Pick it up later after you fight the Curseblade. This behaves similarly to the boss but has a lesser health pool. After defeating these enemies, face the northeast where you see this tall door.

Don't enter through the door yet, instead turn left and you will see this burning cauldron. You can pick up the Fire Spritestone on the right side of this cauldron. Then, return to the door but make sure to defeat the nearby enemies here so they can't interrupt you. Open up the door and head down the steps. You will be fighting a Giant Scorpion here, then turn left where you will fight more of these Giant Scorpions. You can pick up the Shadow Realm Rune [5] just past this lit stone.

After picking up this item, look behind you and attack this illusory wall. Go inside and pick up the Bondstone and Antiquity Scholar's Cookbook (2). Leave this area and turn right to progress. Go down the steps where a group of Shadow Undead are gathered. Pay attention to the glimmering one carrying a jar and make sure to eliminate them to get 3x Spirit Calculus from them. You can also pick up a Broken Rune in front of this square hole to the southeast. (Take note of this location because you will be coming back here later)

Go through this square hole and once you reach the other side, you will be fighting more Giant Scorpions. Watch out for the ones hiding and sleeping on the ceiling. They will attack you as you approach this loot on the corner. Go up the stones and take the Somber Smithing Stone (6) from the corpse here. Exit this area and turn right. Look for this glimmering enemy carrying a jar and defeat it. It will drop a Scadutree Fragment and Golden Horn Tender.

Then, look behind you and face the northeast direction. You will be able to see a Curseblade on the second pillar. This one will not go down unless you go near it, so you can just use range attacks to defeat it without getting damaged. After killing it, walk in front of you and pick up the 5x Throwing Dagger on the next alcove.

From the last alcove, turn right, then left. You will be facing a group of Shadow Undead and a giant scorpion here. Make sure to take them out before you continue exploring here. Loot the corpse here to get x1 Glass Shard. Continue up ahead and turn right to this room where you see a scorpion suspended in the air. You can see multiple corpses on the ground with loot on them but you need to eliminate this enemy first. Try not to the aggro of the Giant Scorpion on the other by doing ranged attacks. After doing so, pick up the x2 Sliver of Meat, x3 Scorpion Liver, and Spider Scorpion Ashes.

Head to the next area filled with white flowers and defeat the Giant Scorpions here. You can also pick up 2x Dewgem from the corpse here. Then, return to the other side of the square hole that you entered earlier. Trace your steps and return to the area where the Shadow Undead are gathered. Open the door here facing southwest, then, take the 5x Rauh Burrow from the corpse to your right.

Follow this path until you reach this Spiritspring with surrounding nails. You can jump down here while riding Torrent and you will not be damaged. Face the southeast direction and go to the very end of this path. Pick up the Shadow Realm Rune (6) behind the Spiritspring. Don't go up the spiritspring and head back towards the area where you came from.

Turn right behind the 3rd pillar, and then go up the thick roots to pick up the Fine Crucible Feather Talisman. Then, head southwest and exit through the small archway at the end. Turn left and you will see an item on the top of the first archway to your left. Behind it, you can use the overgrown branch to climb this arch and then pickup the Shadow Realm Rune (7) from the corpse. Continue riding southeast and you will reach the outdoor area.

When this enemy comes into view, don't try to take its aggro right away. You want to be able to reach the nearby Site of Grace here by walking only on the right side. Stick to the edge on your right and you will see Miquella's Cross here near the edge. The Rauh Ancient Ruins, East - Site of Grace is on your right and you can pick up an Ancient Ruins Cross Message and Scadutree Fragment on the ground near the cross.

From the Site of Grace, face northeast and go towards the pillar here. Walk over the edge to find an item near the waterfall. Pick up the Ash of War: Dryleaf Whirlwind here. Then, return to the enemy that you saw earlier. This Lesser Crucible Knight will drop Devonia's Hammer and Crucible Hammer-Helm upon defeating it.

After defeating this enemy, cross the bridge facing southwest. There's a Furnace Golem at the other end of this bridge and it will start attacking you as you jump down. There are also Shadow Undead along the way and you can pick up 4x Dewgem and 2x Flight Pinion. Then, jump down to the right side here. Ride up ahead but make sure to sprint so you can safely reach the covered area here. Then, go past the Furnace Golem, and don't fight it for now. The Rauh Ancient Ruins, West - Site of Grace is in the area behind it so you want to get the checkpoint first.

title: Bondstone
text: Climb the root at the start of the room to reach a Somber Smithing Stone [9].
Somber Smithing Stone [9]: On top of the branch from where the enemy is casting spells at you.
Head left at the giant door to find a Fire Spritestone on a ledge.
Open the door and continue to a Shadow Realm Rune [5] beside the left wall.
Shadow Realm Rune [5]: You will see a shadow realm rune guarded by a group of Spider-Scorpions, and in front of it is a hidden wall.
Hit the illusory wall between two braziers northeast of the rune to discover an area with a Bondstone and Antiquity Scholar's Cookbook [2].
Bondstone: Can be found behind an illusory wall inside a tunnel area guarded by scorpions

title: Spider Scorpion Ashes
text: Continue down some stairs for a Broken Rune and a pot-carrying Shadow Commoner that drops Spirit Calculus x3 (first time).
Broken Rune: In the area filled with shadows, before the big door.

Spirit Calculus: Pay attention to the glimmering one carrying a jar and make sure to eliminate them to get 3x Spirit Calculus from them. You can also pick up a Broken Rune in front of this square hole to the southeast.
Open the giant door to find a corpse with Rauh Burrow x5 right behind it.
Ignore the path behind the door. Instead, go through the narrow passage in the earlier room. Pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [8] from a heap of rocks in the sand.
Heading into the large room, pick up Throwing Dagger x5 from the second corner on the left.
Next to the corner is a corridor that leads to a corpse with Glass Shard on the left.

Glass Shard: From the last alcove, turn right, then left. You will be facing a group of shadow enemies and a giant scorpion here. Make sure to take them out before you continue exploring here. Loot the corpse here to get Glass Shard.
Past the corpse is a room with Sliver of Meat x2, Spider Scorpion Ashes, and Scorpion Liver x3.
Spider Scorpion Ashes: In the area where the spider-scorpion hangs from a ceiling and there are a bunch of items on the ground. One of them is this.
Sliver of Meat: x2. In the area where the spider-scorpion hangs from a ceiling and there are a bunch of items on the ground. One of them is this.

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Continue to find a corpse with Dewgem x2 by some flowers.
Dewgem: Droped by a Shadowpot Enemy.
Return to the large room and kill the pot-carrying Shadow Commoner in the second corridor on the right for a Scadutree Fragment and a Golden Horn Tender (first time).
Scadutree Fragment: Past the Spider-Scorpions after entering the tunnel, move forward, and turn right. Locate the Shadowpot Enemy and kill it to obtain x1 Scadutree Fragment .
Golden Horn Tender: From the entrance to the Ancient Ruins of Rauh location, step outside of the building and head north, and border the building to the east, until you will find the item.

title: Fine Crucible Feather Talisman
text: Jump down the spiritspring and pick up the Shadow Realm Rune [6] behind it.
Shadow Realm Rune [6]: Fall to the Spiritspring inside the cave, there are a few Fly-Man guarding the item.
At the opposite end of the room, head northeast to pick up the Fine Crucible Feather Talisman from a root.
Fine Crucible Feather Talisman: Climb up on the first tree branch and jump on the second one on the left to find the talisman.

title: Ash of War: Dryleaf Whirlwind
text: Head down the other path and pick up the Shadow Realm Rune [7] up on a ledge underway.
Shadow Realm Rune [7]: On top of the branch, guarded by 2 Fly-Man.
Keep to the left until you find Ash of War: Dryleaf Whirlwind next to a waterfall.
Ash of War: Dryleaf Whirlwind: Found on the edge, besides a column and near a waterfall by Rauh Ancient Ruins, East site of Grace

title: Ancient Ruins Cross Message, Miquella's Cross +1
text: Pick up the Ancient Ruins Cross Message and Scadutree Fragment by the Miquella's Cross to the southwest, then grab the Rauh Ancient Ruins, East grace.
Ancient Ruins Cross Message: Located in the area where you find Devonia, Crucible Knight.
Miquella's Cross: "I abandon here the last of the flesh of my body" Located in the area where you find Devonia, Crucible Knight

Scadutree Fragment: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted by the statue of Marika located at the Messmer Soldiers encampment. If you aggroed the Furnace Golem in this area, chances are the creature can destroy the statue. But you can still find the Scadutree Fragment there.

title: Devonia's Hammer, Crucible Hammer-Helm
text: Kill Crucible Knight Devonia near the grace for Devonia's Hammer and Crucible Hammer-Helm.
Devonia's Hammer: Devonia, Crucible Knight, Grants 16289 runes, and drops Devonia's Hammer , and Crucible Hammer-Helm .
Crucible Hammer-Helm: Devonia, Crucible Knight, Grants 16289 runes, and drops Devonia's Hammer , and Crucible Hammer-Helm .

title: Boss: Devonia, Crucible Knight
text: Devonia, Crucible Knight: Devonia, the Crucible Knight, is located on a rock next to a broken structure in the Ancient Ruins of Rauh area. Defeating him yields the Crucible Hammer-Helm and Devonia's Hammer.

guide.title: Ancient Ruins of Rauh
text: Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree - Path to Ancient Ruins of Rauh
Activate Viaduct Minor Tower - Site of Grace
Explore the southern section
Head to the eastern section
Fight Devonia, Crucible Knight
Eliminate Furnace Golem
Continue to the western section
Head up the ramp and fight this NPC invader
Fight Romina, Saint of the Bud

title: Boss: Furnace Golem (Rauh Ancient Ruins, West)
text: Quickly pick up Dewgem x4 and Flight Pinion x2 from the upper half of the bridge.
Kill the Furnace Golem for the Crimson-Sapping Cracked Tear and a Furnace Visage.
Crimson-Sapping Cracked Tear: The item drops from the Furnace Golem located in the west section of Rauh Ancient Ruins.
Furnace Visage: Dropped by the Furnace Golem upon defeat
Furnace Golem: Furnace Golem is located in the west section of the Rauh Ancient Ruins. Defeating this elite enemy drops the following items: x1 Crimson-Sapping Cracked Tear x1 Furnace Visage

guide.title: The Western Section Part 1
text: From the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West - Site of Grace, go down the ramp and fight the Furnace Golem. It will drop the Crimson-Sapping Cracked Tear and a Furnace Visage upon defeating it.

After fighting the Furnace Golem, teleport to the Site that you had just activated. Face the southwest direction and go toward the double archway. There are different Shadow Undead here, like shadow mage and shadow hound. Eliminate them as you go and go up the stairs to the right. You can pick up a 6x Kukri on the steps and Redflesh Mushroom from the enemies.

Go up the steps, then, go to the right side and eliminate the glimmering Shadowpot here. It will drop x3 Spirit Calculus and a Rauh Burrow. Then, defeat the 2 Shadow Mages here. At the center of this map, there's a Curseblade. This one uses death spells and is just as dangerous as the boss version. On the northwest side, there's an altar where Shadow Undead are worshipping. Go towards it and pick up the Scadutree Fragment.

Then, explore towards south and then turn right. Make sure to pick up the Rauh Burrow and 2x Spiritgrave Stone along the way. Then, use the elevator at the end of this path that will take you to the stone pillar section. Go to the left then jump down on the stone pillar below you. Try to land on the widest portion here and follow the steps 1 to 3. When you get to the 3rd jump, look to the pillar behind you and pick up the Four-Toed Fowl Foot from the corpse.

Keep following the steps here and then face southeast and jump towards the building on the far end to the left. Eliminate the 2 enemies holding a candlestick standing in front of the steps here. Face the building and go towards the square hole to the left, then turn left again to reach the chest. You can get the Talisman of All Crucibles inside.

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Go south up a short hill to find the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West grace by the cliff.
Head into the ruins and pick up Kukri x6 from the first flight of stairs.
Kill the pot-carrying Shadow Commoner in the room upstairs for Spirit Calculus x3 (first time).
Spirit Calculus: From the Ancient Ruins, Grand Stairway Site of Grace, descend the stairs and turn right, you'll find this on a corpse sitting at the edge of a cliff.
Pick up the Scadutree Fragment in front of the altar in the room.

Scadutree Fragment: From the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West Site of Grace, head towards the building and climb up the stairs. Beware of the enemies in this room. Reach the end to find x1 Scadutree Fragment in front of the large altar.

title: Talisman of All Crucibles
text: Head through the southwest corridor to find a corpse with Spiritgrave Stone x2.
Take the lift up, then drop down twice to the left of it to reach a corpse with Four-Toed Fowl Foot x3.

Head across the thin platforms to a lift, but don't take it up yet. Instead, continue southeast across more platforms to reach a narrow passage. Open the chest inside to obtain the Talisman of All Crucibles.

Talisman of All Crucibles: Start at the Ancient Ruins, Grand Starway Site of Grace, and head southwest to the elevator. At the bottom of the elevator looking south west, there are 2 paths of floating platforms, go to the left one, follow it around and it loops to the chest with this talisman.

place.title: Enir-Ilim
walk: ## Gaining Access to Enir-Ilim
## Arrival in Enir-Ilim
## Exploring Around First Rise
## Heading Deeper into Enir-Ilim
## Loot Detour
## Spiral Rise Site of Grace
## How to Get the Euporia Weapon in Elden Ring

Keep following it, and you will acquire x10 Lordsworn's Bolt from a dead body at the end of it. After looting the body, follow the ledge to the other direction going down, and you'll be at a broken section of the ledge. Drop down it, and you will land near a hostile Shadow Undead. Kill it, then pick up x1 Somber Smithing Stone [5] nearby. Go down the stairs, and you'll find x1 Fireproof Pickled Liver from a dead body.
## Belurat Tower Settlement Section
To progress further, sprint jump down the window south of the dead body containing x1 Fireproof Pickled Liver.
After obtaining the Euporia twinblade, head back to the Spiral Rise Site of Grace to continue going up Enir-Ilim.
## Heading up the Spiral Rise
## Another Loot Detour
## Going Up Enir-Ilim
## Cleansing Chamber Anteroom Site of Grace
## Encounter with Needle Knight Leda
## Promised Consort Radahn

After you have defeated Radahn, you will receive the Remembrance of a God and a Lord. The Gate of Divinity Site of Grace [See Elden Ring Map] will also be unlocked. If you look around the area, southeast of the Site of Grace, you can pick up the equipment of those who assisted you in the fight. You can pick up Thiollier's Set along with his weapon, Thiollier's Hidden Needle, from his body. You can also pick up Ansbach's Set, his weapon Obsidian Lamina, and the incantation Furious Blade of Ansbach.
In the middle of the arena, you can obtain the emote Let Us Go Together. You can play a memory, triggering a cutscene. After the cutscene, you will obtain the Circlet of Light.
notes: Notes go here

title: Boss: Divine Beast Dancing Lion (Ancient Ruins of Rauh)
text: Return through the next passage, then take the lift up to the Ancient Ruins, Grand Stairway grace.
Going down the stairs, hug the right side until you see a corpse with Spirit Calculus at the cliff's edge.
Return to the stairs and grab the Smithing Stone [7] x3 guarded by two dogs.
At the end of the stairway, drop down and continue to a Shadow Realm Rune [7].
Shadow Realm Rune [7]: Can be found on a corpse just across the summoning pool in the area, guarded by two enemies.
Drop down southeast and kill the Divine Beast Dancing Lion for Divine Beast Tornado and 180,000 runes.
Divine Beast Tornado: Dropped by the Divine Beast Dancing Lion located North East from the Temple Town Ruins Site of Grace.

Divine Beast Dancing Lion: The field boss version of the Divine Beast Dancing Lion is located near the Ancient Ruins, Grand Stairway Site of Grace. Head northeast down the grand stairway from the Site of Grace and you'll find the Divine Beast Dancing Lion roaming in a small area that looks like an open temple. Grants 180,000 Runes and the Divine Beast Tornado upon defeating it.

title: Revered Spirit Ash
text: Travel to the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West grace and return to the altar. This time, head outside and pick up the Revered Spirit Ash in a gazebo.
Revered Spirit Ash: Found on the statue in the middle. Beware of enemies in the area.

title: Pest-Thread Spears
text: Continue to an area with scarlet rot, then take the lift on the left side. Pick up the Scarlet Bud x6 to the right of a staircase.
Behind the staircase is a corpse with Pest-Thread Spears.

Pest-Thread Spears: Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Use the elevator to reach the upper level. Still within the scarlet rot swamp area, head to either side of them before going up the stairs, and at the back you'll find this incantation guarded by a couple of Kindred of Rot

guide.title: The Western Section Part 2
text: This covers the rest of the exploration of the western section where you will be invaded by an NPC.

From the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West - Site of Grace, face the southwest section and climb up the stairs to the left. This is the same area that you explore earlier but instead of going to the left section, you will head northwest towards the outdoor area. Head straight into the gazebo in front of you and you can pick up the Revered Spirit Ash on this altar. Watch out for the enemy nearby but since you are riding Torrent, you can just outrun them.

Continue exploring the path behind this gazebo and make sure to pick up this Rauh Burrow on the wall. Take note of the location on your left because you will be returning here later. For now, continue ahead and jump down on the platform behind this stone.

Go to the bottom of the steps and head northeast. You will find hounds inflicted with Scarlet rot here and you can pick up Golden Horn Tender from this corpse in the middle. There's a Bloodfiend here in the middle of this section but it's up to you if you want to fight it. You can get 5x Sacred Bloody Flesh if you want to fight it. Continue traveling north where you will encounter another Bloodfiend, then turn left where more enemies are waiting. Take out the hounds and bloodfiends here for a chance to get Beast Blood and a piece of the bloodfiend's gear, like Bloodfiend's Fork.

On the upper area, while facing northwest, you will see this glimmering Shadowpot. To go there, you need to head to jump down on the area below it. Summon Torrent and try to land on the highest part here to minimize your fall damage. The elevator is right here when you go down, but before that, make sure to head to the area on the northeast. This area is protected by giant flies, so you need to eliminate them first.

Take the Somber Smithing Stone (1) from the corpse lying on the stone. After doing so, head east where you see the Pink Flowerbloom. Go towards it and then pick up the Aspects of the Crucible: Bloom. Now, return to where you jumped down and take the elevator to go up. On the top level, you will reach a Shadowpot which drops a Revered Spirit Ash. You can then eliminate the nearby enemies to get a Redflesh Mushroom and Silver Horn Tender.

This is your last stop in this area and you will now be returning to the area that we mentioned that you will be coming back to. Jump down on the same ledge that you are facing as you approached the loot, then look behind this pillar and you will see a corpse here. Take the 3x Knot Resin from it then go up the stairs.

Turn right where you will be facing scarlet rot-inflicted enemies. There's a scarlet version of Lesser Kindred of Rot (Pests) here, be careful of them because they can deal a high amount of damage when you get struck by them.

Go to the northwest arch and pick up the Dappled White Cured Meat. To your right, there are more pest enemies here. There's a large group of them in the next section and try to cheese them as much as you can. If you have any ranged or magic attacks, make use of them to eliminate them before they get near you. You can obtain these items from the ground here: x3 Immunizing Cured Meat, x4 Fly Mold, and x8 Smithing Stone (2). After fighting them, exit through the archway on the left side. Look on the stack of stones to your right and you will see a corpse here. You can pick up the Greater Potentate's Cookbook (9) from it.

Face the tower to the northeast and walk straight towards it. This is the Unseen Bridge that connects the main building to this tower. Cross to the other side and interact with the altar: if you have the Stone-Sheathed Sword, you can use it on this altar and it will turn into the Sword of Light.

Go back to the main building the same way you got here and then continue exploring by going to the left past the room. Then, turn right to use the elevator that will take you to the upper level. There are more pest enemies here at the top and you will see the stairs in the middle. Just take note of these areas for now because you will be returning here later.

First, turn your attention to the nearest enemy standing next to the archway then go out to the area outside. Go past the gazebo and look at the corpse in the middle of the water. Go towards it and then pick up the Divine Bird Feathers.

The elite enemy here will be aggro-ed upon picking up the item. Take your time as you deal with it and use the pillars of the gazebo to defend yourself against some of its attacks. After fighting it, go up the ramp and go to the edge. You will see the clusters of stones that unlock a Spiritspring after destroying it.

Jump towards the Spiritspring, then use it again to reach the area on the other side. Go to the right side and walk to the area behind the thick pillar and go around it to pick up x2 Beast Horn from the corpse. Then, go up the stairs that you saw earlier and open the chest at the top to get Mottled Necklace +2. Use the Spiritspring again to return to the other side. Head back inside where you used the elevator and then turn left.

Fight the pests that you will come across here and then turn right at the end. You can pick up the Pest-Thread Spears next to the wall on your right side. Go around this area and get ready for a fight before you head up the stairs. As you approach the top section, Hornsent will invade you. This is potentially a long walk back if you didn't activate the Spiritspring beforehand, but if you have been following this walkthrough, you will have a faster way of reaching this area in case you die.
The Spiritspring is located just northwest of the Site of Grace, in the pool area. Defeating Hornsent here will reward you with the following items:
Falx
Caterpillar Mask
Braided Cord Robe
Braided Arm Wraps
Soiled Loincloth
## Fight Romina in the Church of the Bud

Romina, Saint of the Bud, is a mid-sized boss with a body resembling a centipede, a scorpion, the wings of a butterfly, and a human. She wields a spear, centipede fangs, and a scorpion stinger, making her a unique foe. To defeat Romina, you'll need a balanced approach, mixing both offense and defense. When facing her as a melee character, focus not only on her central human body but also observe her centipede fangs and scorpion stinger, which act as her arms.

Defeating Romina Saint of the Bud will reward you 280,000 Runes and Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud. This fight will also let you access the Sealing Tree behind the arena. You will need Messmer's Kindling to burn the Sealing Tree to gain access to the final legacy dungeon. After the short cutscene, the real Enir-Ilim will be revealed and you will be transported to the base of Enir-Ilim.
See the next tab for the Enir-Ilim Walkthrough.to return to the tab selection.

title: Divine Bird Feathers
text: If you killed Messmer with Hornsent's help and exhausted his dialogue afterward, he'll invade on the staircase. Kill him for the Falx and the Hornsent Set.
Activate the Church of the Bud, Main Entrance grace up the stairs for later.
Go back down the stairs and out the southeast exit, hugging the left wall until you see some stacked stones. Destroy them to unseal the spiritspring below.
From the stones, head south-southwest and pick up Divine Bird Feathers from a corpse in the water.

Divine Bird Feathers: Can be found the corpse in the middle of the lake in the higher area of Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Go past the gazebo and look at the corpse in the middle of the water. Go towards it and then pick up the Divine Bird Feathers.

title: Greater Potentate's Cookbook [9]
text: Jump onto the roof of the gazebo east-southeast of the corpse to reach a Shadow Realm Rune [4].
Drop down and head back through the scarlet rot to find Dappled White Cured Meat x2 at the end.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [8] x6, Immunizing Cured Meat x3, and Fly Mold x4 in the scarlet rot.
Head outside to find the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [9] on some rocks beside the wall.

Greater Potentate's Cookbook [9]: After getting past the scarlet rot swamp area in Ancient Ruins of Rauh, head outside and you'll find this item on a corpse near the wall before the invisible bridge that leads to a nearby tower.

title: Sword of Light
text: Cross the invisible bridge to reach a stele that can be used to raise your Stone-Sheathed Sword (or Sword of Darkness) into the Sword of Light.

title: Aspects of the Crucible: Bloom
text: Note: If you obtained the Stone-Sheathed Sword here, the Sword of Light is instead acquired at the stele in the Ruins of Unte.

Jump to the plateau beside the bridge, then, facing its west-southwest edge, drop down twice to an area with red trees. Continue down to a lift, then go past it to find a Somber Smithing Stone [9] on some rocks.
Pick up Aspects of the Crucible: Bloom from a corpse guarded by Miranda flowers at the end.
Aspects of the Crucible: Bloom: Can be found on a corpse near the Giant Miranda Sprout in Ancient Ruins of Rauh

title: Mottled Necklace +2
text: Head back to the lift and take it up to a pot-carrying Shadow Commoner that drops a Revered Spirit Ash and a Silver Horn Tender (first time).
Drop down and go out the south-southeast exit to find Knot Resin x3 behind the second pillar.
Go up the first flight of stairs, then head northeast and kill the Chief Bloodfiend accompanied by dogs for Sacred Bloody Flesh x5 (first time).
Pick up a Golden Horn Tender from the corpse between two of the pillars.
Use the spiritspring in the middle while facing east, then pick up Beast Horn x2 from the roof of some connecting pillars to the south.
Head up the final sets of stairs to reach a chest containing the Mottled Necklace +2.

Mottled Necklace +2: Talisman found in the upper area of Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Use the spiritspring in the area to reach the platform to the east and go up the stairs, at the end of the path you'll find a chest with this Talisman.

title: Boss: Romina, Saint of the Bud
text: Travel to the Church of the Bud, Main Entrance grace and kill Romina, Saint of the Bud for Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud and 380,000 runes.
Romina, Saint of the Bud: Legend type boss Drops 380,000 Runes when defeated and Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud
Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud: Dropped by Romina, Saint of the Bud . Can be consumed for Runes or handed to Enia at te Roundtable Hold , for Poleblade of the Bud or Rotten Butterflies .
Optional: Dryleaf Dane's summon sign can be found next to the road outside.
Activate the Church of the Bud grace after the fight.
