Continue ahead and use Messmer's Kindling to burn the Sealing Tree.

title: Spiraltree Seal
text: After burning the Sealing Tree to end up in Enir-Ilim, turn around for a Somber Smithing Stone [9].

Somber Smithing Stone [9]: Upgrade Material found in Enir-Ilim, right next to the Site of Grace and directly next to where the Tarnished will spawn when they teleport into the location from Church of the Bud
Activate the Enir-Ilim: Outer Wall grace next to the shut door and rest at it.
Travel to the Temple Town Ruins grace, then head up to the Northern Nameless Mausoleum. Halfway down the slope southwest of it, you'll now find the Spiraltree Seal (painting reward).
Spiraltree Seal: Reward for completing "The Sacred Tower" Painting Puzzle .

title: Revered Spirit Ash
text: Return to Enir-Ilim and make your way into a tower with the First Rise grace inside.
Continue down the corridor to find some Messmerfire Grease on a flight of stairs.
Messmerfire Grease: From the First Rise Site of Grace, just follow the path heading East, and beside the big archway door is an item.
Optional: You can send the shortcut lift down to Belurat, but it is already usable from both ends.
Head up the stairs near the grace to find a Somber Smithing Stone [8] on a broken span.
Drop down from the roofs and go up the stairs. Pick up a Broken Rune from the ash on the right.
Broken Rune: In the entrance to the outdoor Garden with White Trees. The item will be on the right side of the garden if you are coming from the north.
Jump over a branch in the nearby room to find a Rune Arc on a small altar.
Rune Arc: Continue following the path up the stairs and you'll see a corpse on the ground with this item.
Kill the large Inquisitor circling the fountain for a Revered Spirit Ash (first time).

Revered Spirit Ash: After defeating the Divine Beast Dancing Lion, head to the right side of the arena to find a lift. Take the lift up and proceed forward to open a large door. Once through, you will find the altar nearby that has a Revered Spirit Ash.

title: Furlcalling Finger Remedy, Revered Spirit Ash x2
text: Pick up the Budding Horn x4 surrounded by a group of Inquisitors.
In the courtyard's eastern corner is a corpse with Lightningproof Pickled Liver x2.
Looking north, jump over the fence to land next to a corpse with Thin Beast Bones x8.
Circle around the tree to pick up Whiteflesh Mushroom x3.
Follow one of the tree's roots to a corpse with Redflesh Mushroom x4.
Pick up the Revered Spirit Ash x2 guarded by Man-Flies at the end.
Head up the stairs in the courtyard to continue. Before you encounter the Divine Beast Warrior, drop down onto the same tree for Furlcalling Finger Remedy x3 behind you as you drop.

Furlcalling Finger Remedy: After dealing with the Horned Warrior, you will see a platform on the northern side with a tree shaman and an item. You can drop down to the tree branches below if you want to go there. Immediately after dropping down, you can loot x3 Furlcalling Finger Remedy behind you.
Revered Spirit Ash x2: In an indoor Altar like room with Man-Fly(s) praying to an idol sculpture. The x2 Revered Spirit Ash will be at the base of the statue.

title: Spira
text: Follow the tree's northern branch to a separate platform. Pick up Spira from the altar.
Spira: Enir-Illim: Found on small altar that is directly in front of statue, accessed by walking on the tree branches leading to this small broken-off platform

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Past the Divine Beast Warrior is a corpse with a Dragonbolt Grease.
Head up the first set of stairs, then pick up a Drawstring Golden Grease from the left alcove.

Drawstring Golden Grease: Continue following the path going up the stairs. Once you get past the Dragonbolt Grease, continue heading up the stairs. Be wary of enemies in the area. Check the left side corner and you'll find a corpse with this item.
Quickly grab the Fire Arrow x10 and Golden Bolt x10 when running up the rest of the stairs.
Open the door, pick up the Scadutree Fragment, and activate the Spiral Rise grace.
Scadutree Fragment: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted by Miquella's Cross of the Spiral Rise Site of Grace.

title: Inquisitor Ashes
text: Head back and down the stairs in the other alcove to discover a room with the Inquisitor Ashes.
Inquisitor Ashes: They can be found on a corpse in Enir-Ilim, beneath the second to last enemy before reaching the Spiral Rise site of grace (coming from First Rise site of grace).

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: To the right when exiting the room, jump down onto a bridge for Fireproof Pickled Liver x2.
Fireproof Pickled Liver: Drop down to the stairs, and you can pick up x2 Fireproof Pickled Liver from the body.
From the tower, drop down and make your way across the arches to reach a Holyproof Pickled Liver.

Holyproof Pickled Liver: Found after dropping down from the spiral incantation inquisitors. You'll come across a broken section of the narrow edge going to an item. Jump to get to the other side, and you can pick up x1 Holyproof Pickled Liver.
Drop through the broken arch to land near a corpse with Smithing Stone [8] x3.
At the other end, drop down to another ledge and follow it up to a corpse with Lordsworn's Bolt x10.

Lordsworn's Bolt: x10 Jump down to progress toward Euporia. Found as you drop down to a spiral ledge and traverse the ledge going southwest. Keep following it, and you will acquire x10 Lordsworn's Bolt from a dead body at the end of it.
Follow the ledge down to drop onto a staircase, then grab the Somber Smithing Stone [8] in the tower.
Pick up the Fireproof Pickled Liver just down the stairs.

Fireproof Pickled Liver: Follow the ledge to the other direction going down, and you'll be at a broken section of the ledge. Drop down it, and you will land near a hostile Shadow Undead. Kill it, then pick up x1 Somber Smithing Stone [5] nearby. Go down the stairs, and you'll find x1 Fireproof Pickled Liver from a dead body.
Do a running jump to the window below to land in Belurat. Head outside for a Scadutree Fragment.

Scadutree Fragment: From the First Rise Site of Grace of Enir-Ilim, progress the area until you're about to reach the Spiral Rise Site of Grace. Near the checkpoint, you'll find a stairway that leads down to a room where you can loot the Inquisitor Ashes. Outside of this room, jump down onto a broken staircase that might look like a dead-end. Check the east side of this staircase to drop onto the narrow edge of the wall. Wrap along the side of it until you reach a platform that has a body holding x10 Golem's Great Arrow. Look south and do a running jump to jump across the pit and towards a window. Drop down to formally arrive in a secret section of Belurat Tower Settlement. Continue forward from here until you find a covered statue where you'll find x1 Scadutree Fragment by the foot of the statue.

title: Euporia
text: Optional: Up the northeastern stairs is a lift that takes you back to Enir-Ilim.
Take the lift down the southeastern stairs, then continue until you reach a door with the Euporia inside.
Euporia: Found after dropping down a secret area in Enir Ilim, after doing some difficult platforming

title: Horned Warrior Ashes
text: Return to the Spiral Rise grace and go up the stairs to reach the rooftops. Pick up Smithing Stone [8] x5 from a raised roof on the right.
Continue to a room on the left with the last Revered Spirit Ash.
From the stairs, jump over the railing to land on a staircase with a Silver Horn Tender.
Silver Horn Tender: Head down the stairs and jump down the other set of stairs below, you'll find this item on a corpse at the end of the broken staircase.
Pick up Horned Warrior Ashes, Stanching Boluses, and Neutralizing Boluses x2 from the room ahead.
Horned Warrior Ashes: After jumping down the broken staircase, head up and enter the room, you'll find this on a corpse on the left side.
Stanching Boluses: After jumping down the broken staircase, head up and enter the room, you'll find this on a corpse on the right side. This is the same room as the Horned Warrior Ashes

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Climb the ladder to a corpse with a Golden Horn Tender hanging from the broken balustrade.
Climb the second ladder to get the high ground on the Divine Beast Warrior. In the room to the northwest, you'll find a Scadutree Fragment.

Scadutree Fragment: Location: Outer Tower of Enir-Ilim. After picking up the previous Revered Spirit Ash, continue heading up the stairs and you'll find a room with an altar where x1 Scadutree Fragment can be picked up.

title: Gravebird Helm
text: In the corner east of the room is a corpse with Sunwarmth Stone x2.
Continue up to a tower, then pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [7] at the bottom of the stairs.
Use the lift up the stairs while facing south-southwest. Jump off halfway to grab the Gravebird Helm. (If you failed the jump, it can also be reached from the broken staircase near the lift.)
Gravebird Helm: Found on a ledge by the lift on the spiral staircase - technically above the site of grace. Accessed by jumping onto the platform from the lift

title: Horned Warrior's Greatsword
text: Drop down, then head outside for a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone at the end.

Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone: From the altar with an elevator, head outside and go down. Be wary of an enemy lurking in the area. Get past the enemy and you'll find this material on a corpse at the edge of a broken stairs.
Take the lift back up, then kill the final Divine Beast Warrior for the Horned Warrior's Greatsword.
Horned Warrior's Greatsword: Guaranteed drop from the Wind-Aspected Horned Warrior towards the end of Enir-Ilim.

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Activate the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom grace and grab the last Scadutree Fragment.
Scadutree Fragment: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be found on the altar near the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom Site of Grace.

title: Leda's Sword, Invader: Needle Knight Leda (Enir-Ilim)
text: Note: This is your last chance to decide Moore's fate, pass St. Trina's final words to Thiollier, deliver Freyja's letter, and give Ansbach the Secret Rite Scroll before exhausting his dialogue.
Enter the chamber and kill Needle Knight Leda and her allies for Leda's Sword and 300,000 runes.
Leda's Sword: Dropped by Needle Knight Leda upon defeat.

Needle Knight Leda: From the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom Site of Grace, exit the room east and you'll find a gold summon sign for Pureblood Knight Ansbach and a red blood summon sign to challenge Needle Knight Leda and her allies. Interacting with the red blood summon sign will have Needle Knight Leda as one of the invaders to spawn in the area.

title: Freyja's Greatsword, Freyja's Set
text: Optional: Thiollier can be summoned if you passed on St. Trina's final words after his invasion. Summoning him unlocks a dialogue option with Ansbach (if he is also summoned).

Optional: Ansbach can be summoned if you gave him the Secret Rite Scroll and exhausted his dialogue. Summoning him causes him to appear before the final battle, allowing you to speak with him for some extra dialogue.
Optional: Sanguine Noble Nataan can be summoned if Ansbach is not available.
If Moore appeared in the fight, loot Moore's Bell Bearing, the Verdigris Greatshield, and the Verdigris Set from his corpse.
If Freyja appeared in the fight, loot Freyja's Greatsword and Freyja's Set from her corpse.
Freyja's Greatsword: Can be looted from Freyja's body after defeating her in Enir-Ilim .

Freyja's Set: The following armor pieces of the Freyja's Set can be obtained by looting Freyja's body after defeating her in Enir-Ilim : Freyja's Helm Freyja's Armor Freyja's Gauntlets Freyja's Greaves

title: Invader: Redmane Freyja (Enir-Ilim)
text: Redmane Freyja: From the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom Site of Grace, exit the room east and you'll find a gold summon sign for Pureblood Knight Ansbach and a red blood summon sign to challenge Needle Knight Leda and her allies. Interacting with the red blood summon sign will have Redmane Freyja as one of the invaders to spawn in the area.

title: Dane's Footwork, Invader: Dryleaf Dane (Enir-Ilim)
text: If Hornsent appeared in the fight, loot the Falx and the Hornsent Set from his corpse.
Pick up Dane's Footwork from Dryleaf Dane's corpse.
Dane's Footwork: Defeat Dryleaf Dane as part of the Enir-Illim event.

Dryleaf Dane: Enir-Ilim - From the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom Site of Grace, exit the room east and you'll find a gold summon sign for Pureblood Knight Ansbach and a red blood summon sign to challenge Needle Knight Leda and her allies. Interacting with the red blood summon sign will have Dryleaf Dane as one of the invaders to spawn in the area.

title: Leda's Armor
text: Pick up Leda's Armor from her corpse beyond the room.
Leda's Armor: Can be looted from Leda's body after defeating him in Enir-Ilim .

title: Boss: Radahn, Consort of Miquella +1
text: Optional: If you summoned Ansbach, he appears at the top of the last lift. Ask him about Mohg's death. If you also summoned Thiollier, you can also ask him about Thiollier.
Head up the final set of stairs to activate the Divine Gate Front Staircase grace.
Kill Promised Consort Radahn for Remembrance of a God and a Lord and 500,000 runes.
Promised Consort Radahn: Promised Consort Radahn is an imposing, fully armored humanoid enemy adorned in red and gold, wielding two colossal swords. and is found in Enir-Ilim.
Remembrance of a God and a Lord: Dropped by Radahn, Consort of Miquella upon defeat.
Radahn, Consort of Miquella: This is the next form of Radahn that's faster and more dangerous.

title: Thiollier's Hidden Needle, Thiollier's Set
text: Optional: Thiollier's and Ansbach's summon signs can be found outside the entrance if they were each summoned against Leda and her allies.
Activate the Gate of Divinity grace and rest at it to reload the area.
Pick up Thiollier's Hidden Needle and Thiollier's Set from his corpse.
Thiollier's Hidden Needle: Summon Thiollier during the battle at the end of his questline, then loot his body in the boss arena after the fight.-

Thiollier's Set: Summon Thiollier during the battle at the end of his questline, then loot his body in the boss arena after the fight. Thiollier's Hidden Needle Thiollier's Mask Thiollier's Garb Thiollier's Gloves Thiollier's Trousers
miss: You must pass on St. Trina's final words to Thiollier before fighting Leda and her allies in Enir-Ilim.

title: Obsidian Lamina, Furious Blade of Ansbach
text: Pick up Ansbach's Set, Obsidian Lamina, and Furious Blade of Ansbach from his corpse.

Obsidian Lamina: Complete the entirety of Sir Ansbach's questline by assisting him. This weapon will be available at the end of his questline after the Final Boss where he will be by the entrance to the arena after the fight.

Furious Blade of Ansbach: Complete Sir Ansbach's questline all the way through the end, and side with him when facing Leda, and then Promised Consort Radahn / Radahn, Consort of Miquella . After the fight is over, Sir Ansbach's body will be near the site of grace, alongside with his equipment and this Incantation.
miss: The Obsidian Lamina and Furious Blade of Ansbach are missable if you don't give him the Secret Rite Scroll and exhaust his dialogue before fighting Leda and her allies in Enir-Ilim.

title: Let Us Go Together
text: If you didn't die to Radahn's grab attack, pick up the Let Us Go Together gesture beside the memory.
Let Us Go Together: Obtained after being grabbed by Radahn, Consort of Miquella while charmed or by picking it up inside the arena after the fight.

title: Circlet of Light
text: Touch Miquella's memory to view a short cutscene and obtain the Circlet of Light.

Circlet of Light: First, defeat Promised Consort Radahn / Radahn, Consort of Miquella in Enir-Ilim. After the battle, at the center of the boss arena, towards the golden orb. Select "Touch Memory" to trigger a cutscene. You'll obtain this item after the cutscene plays.

title: St. Trina's Blossom
text: Travel to the Garden of Deep Purple grace and pick up St. Trina's Blossom from St. Trina's corpse.
St. Trina's Blossom: This item drops after completing St. Trina's questline. It can be picked up from her fallen body inside the Garden of Deep Purple.

If you forgot to make the choice for Moore's questline and he is still at the Main Gate Cross, you'll have to kill him for his loot. Kill two of the Forager Brood to cause him to invade, then finish him off for the Verdigris Greatshield and the Verdigris Set. Pick up Moore's Bell Bearing from where he usually sits.
Congratulations on completing Shadow of the Erdtree! Now return to the base game or prepare for NG+.
